quests.name: 10th Birthday ArchFiend Helm
quests.description: Loyal members of Nulgath's Nation, take heed! You are the deadliest partiers to stalk the land of Lore. I've crafted a gift to help you celebrate. Lightguard Paladings in /noxustower stole the gift I'd planned to give you. Slay them until you find a Dire Gift Box. Complete my quest to see if the helm you seek is inside.

quests.name: 10th Birthday Paragon Helm
quests.description: My Undead Legion warriors like to /party as hard as any living hero, and I crafted a gift to help you celebrate. Lightguard Paladins in /noxustower stole the gift I'd planned to give you. Slay them until you find a Bony Gift Box. Complete my quest to see if the helm you seek is inside.

quests.name: 13th Frost Collection Chest Badge
quests.description: The normally bright magic of the holidays has been tainted with the darkness of Frostval the 13th, and the cold hearts of the Snow Golems in the /northlands have turned into dark icy diamonds. Defeat one of them to keep it as a souvenir of the double holiday, and you'll be rewarded with the Frostval 2019 collection character page badge.

items.name: Frostval the 13th Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Shadow Essences
quests.description: Deeper in the fortress, beyond this passage, there are creatures of pure shadow. Capture their essence in this jar, and then bring it back here. Miko will use her light to banish it, and that will weaken the Shadow's hold on all of the beings in the fortress.

quests.name: New Recruits
quests.description: Now that the shadow is weaker in strength, fight Jaaku's remaining samurai. Most of them are only loyal by force — just like I was. Hopefully, some of them will come to their senses and join our fight.

quests.name: Shadow Heads
quests.description: Now that you've removed some of the threat, I will let you through to the rest of the fortress. There, you will find my remaining 7 heads, deep in a healing slumber. Feed each of them some of the juice from your kappa friends' heads - it will keep them subdued while you fight the shadows that emerge from them.

quests.name: A Head has Woken
quests.description: All this commotion has awoken one of my heads - one that is still under the shadow's control! Subdue it before it wakes the others - or worse!

quests.name: Please Fix Me
quests.description: The journey here was long, and your body is already starting to unravel. Bring me the shadows of the beings you kill, and I will use them to stitch you back together again.

quests.name: Get the Slime
quests.description: You know where the armor you seek is kept, but it remains out of your reach… until you break the spell that hides it. I can help with that. Kill the slimes near the tower, and pull from them their life-giving cores. Collect 8 of them, and bring them to me.

quests.name: Reach for the Heart
quests.description: I will need the heart of a powerful enemy to act as a catalyst. The horc, Yargol Magebane, is the strongest creature in the vicinity. His will have to do.

quests.name: Get More Shadows
quests.description: The bonds that hold you together grow weak again. Gather more shadows, and I will reinforce them. But this time, only bring me the most potent ones you find.

quests.name: Garen's Key
quests.description: They've got the tower locked down, and it looks like you'll have to go through all of them to get what you came for! Garen holds the key to the first door. Take it from him.

quests.name: Selby's Key
quests.description: Guardian Selby holds the key to the third floor. Take it from her, and open the door.

quests.name: Get Rid of Bolton
quests.description: Guardian Bolton is the last thing standing between you and the power you need to save your true love. Kill him, and take your prize.

quests.name: Plans for Frostval
quests.description: First things first! We should talk to Syrrus and Blizzy to see what they have planned for Frostval. Also, I heard Blizzy saying that the local wildlife took apart his snowglobe and are hiding it from him! Go get the pieces back and bring them to me. If I can fix it, it will be the first Frostval present ever given in Cryostorm!

quests.name: Find the Missing Presents
quests.description: The wildlife here must be getting into the Frostval spirit as well! Unfortunately, I don't think they get the idea. They have hidden the presents around Cryostorm! Take a look around and see if you can find them all!

quests.name: More Gifts
quests.description: We should make some more presents for the villagers! We should look around for some stuff that will really brighten their day! You could get some Cloth from the Arctic Wolves to make capes for the children so they can pretend to be Heroes, some Fur from the Mammoths to make coats for the adults, and some Bells from the Glacial Elementals to fill this place with some music!

quests.name: Warmth for the Small
quests.description: Although most of us are used to the frigid air of the Tundra, the newborns and children are not! Let's get some fur from the Arctic Wolves for some blankets to not only warm them up but also show them what Frostval is all about!

quests.name: Cut Down the Tree
quests.description: Blizzy told me the most important part of Frostval is to have a big, nice tree to decorate. I know the perfect tree! If you head to the upper level of the town you will find it. Be careful, though! There is a pack of Arctic Wolves that guard it. You will have to take care of them before you can get the tree!

quests.name: Decorate the Tree
quests.description: Dang it! Those creatures have taken our stuff, again! This time, they took all our decorations! Defeat these monsters and get all of the tree decorations back. It won't be Frostval without a decorated tree.

quests.name: Find the Ice StarStone
quests.description: Uh oh! Syrrus's StarStone for the top of the tree is missing! I heard some of the townspeople talking… They said the Behemoth has it… Hero… I think we should just leave it alone. The Behemoth isn't something you want to mess with!

quests.name: Battle Abyssal Guards
quests.description: My Master is waiting for you at the top of the Midnight Mountain. But only the strongest are permitted to face him. Battle 13 of his Abyssal Guards to prove your worth.

quests.name: Battle the Underbeasts
quests.description: My Master waits at the top of the Midnight Mountain… but many will never reach that far. Battle 13 of the Underbeasts which live in my lair. Survive them, and you may be strong enough to face my Mater.

quests.name: Defeat the Devourer of Souls
quests.description: Generals in the Undead Legion must find their own feasts. My Master has been waiting for you. I am hungry, but he is… STARVING. He wishes to consume only the strongest of heroes. Your strength will feed him well.

quests.name: Gifts of the Cryomancer
quests.description: Becoming Hollowborn has given me the opportunity to do things I never could before, and I plan to seize this chance and make the most of our meeting, maybe we could help each other. I need Shards from the Ice Crystals in /icedungeon and ShadowLord Auras for… well… no need for you to know right now. But if you bring me some, I'll give you a pretty cool reward.

items_required.name: Ice Crystal Shard x10 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Ice Nine
quests.description: The path to Guwio is filled with Frost Monsters which will make it difficult to travel to other towns to get supplies for the winter. If you can defeat Snow Golems this will help clear the way for travelers. Bring back 9 Ice Cubes to show that the path is a little bit safer.

quests.name: Ice Wyrms
quests.description: You know what is even worst than Snow Golems? Frost Wyrm Riders - and the path ahead is filled with them. If you could get rid of 4 Frost Wyrm Riders this would make the path ahead much easier to travel. Frost Wyrm Riders are harder to defeat, so if you bring me back 4 Wyrm's Spikes I'll reward you handsomely.

quests.name: Cathedral of Time
quests.description: I can't go into the Cathedral with you, but I'll be able to talk to you using the various Data Stations contained within it. Use the Light Portal to transport yourself into the Cathedral of Time, and then talk to me using Data Station Aion. Just look for the small, floating droid in the room that the portal drops you off in.

quests.name: Coffee for the Mind
quests.description: First, we need to get me in shape. That means more coffee! The lady inside the coffee shop in /vendorbooths refuses to sell me any more cups due to "health concerns", so we have to do this ourselves. First, gather coffee beans from the imps all around the shop. Over in /artistalley there is a realm guardian beside me. In his realm, there are poisonous snake-like monsters - they will be a great source of the tasty poison. We should probably get the antidote, too… just in case. I think I remember hearing something about burned trails and vines.

quests.name: Ectoplasm for the Body
quests.description: Without having my accessories active, my strength is greatly reduced and I just don't have the strength to move everything that Secretteller needs. I will need some ectoplasm to fuel my accessories. This dimension is a bit different, so I have trouble catching the stray ectoplasm from the air myself. How about you get me some? Bring me some Refined Ectoplasm from the Doomwood Ectomancers, and a bit of Ektorax's Ectoplasm.

quests.name: Secretteller's Building Materials
quests.description: Secretteller told me he can get most of the stuff he needs by himself, but needs our help with gathering the things he needs a huge quantity of. Wood can be easily gathered from Doomwood Treeants. Iron can be found in the factory in /extinction, and big iron bolts can be obtained from the Dwakels in /crashsite. Also, some cake as a snack would be nice too, don't you think? A girl named Xeven told me about the cake in /portalmaze. If you can get the wood, iron, bolts and cake that would be great! ST is relying on us, so let's do our best!

quests.name: Deadly Dedication of a Hero
quests.description: Hey, Hero - I am usually used to fighting with a weapon and right now I don't have one. Would you be so kind and help me create a superstronstrong one, pretty please?! With a proper ecto weapon, I'll be able to defend myself against all the scary unknown monsters from this dimension and look super cool while doing so! Secretteller made a list of materials I could find useful and then promptly decided to teleport me away before telling me where to find them. So good luck with the unfair scavenger hunt, Hero! It is officially your problem now, not mine. See you later!

quests.name: Melody of Cuteness
quests.description: Ugh, the smell… Love is in the air! Someone in close proximity to us is using Heroes Heart Day gear… and I really dislike that holiday. It's just not … ecto enough! How about we treat ourselves a bit? Let's create some lovely ecto gear out of that pink and red gear that those lovers of Heroes Heart day love to wear.

quests.name: Day of the Fools
quests.description: Hey, Hero, do you know which month is the best one of them all? No matter what you answer, I'm going to pretend you said April. Why? Because that's what month the coffee lady said it was… And that was REALLY good coffee. Because of that coffee, I totally have the energy to give you this quest for insanely cursed gear. Got it?

quests.name: The Queen of Envy
quests.description: Confront the Queen of Envy!

quests.name: Nulgath's Recognition (Badge Quest)
quests.description: (gives Character Page badge) Fiends will not answer to anyone but Nulgath or his most trusted Generals… unless they become corrupted. Master received word that one of his DreadFiends in /originul is considering switching sides. Destroy him, and Master will reward you!

quests.name: 99th Birthday
quests.description: We're tasked with guarding the shore from the Dragon's army, but the Yokai are causing a disturbance. It seems these Tsukumogami recently began to move, and are acting out because they were left outside. We'll quell them, and make sure they won't cause a fire.

quests.name: Red and Blue
quests.description: The situation on land is beginning to escalate. Haku Village is being harassed by the Mountain Oni - Yokai that revel in wanton death and destruction. Slay the Oni, and find Haruki. He is of Oni blood, and may know why his brethren are here despite the presence of the Isles' warriors.

quests.name: Cold Sunshower
quests.description: I shouldn't have let my Granddaughter and Baoyu leave so quickly. The Yokai are acting suspiciously. It must have something to do with the Dragon's return. I heard that Yue found a Memo that Baoyu left behind. Read that Memo and capture the Tsukumogami. I have a hunch.

quests.name: Inari Boom
quests.description: Confront all the villagers spreading rumors about the Great Yokai Spirit. I'll dispel the sorcery those Fox Spies are using to disguise their ears and tails. We need to reveal their schemes before they whip Haku Village into a frenzy.

quests.name: Cui Niao
quests.description: I've received a report that a man washed up on the beach, and that he's being attacked by draconic sea creatures. The locals call them Nagami, but they could be aquatic dragons from Zakhvatchik's army. Quickly, save that man from the so-called Nagami, and find out where he's from.

quests.name: Swab the Deck
quests.description: Dat blasted Bounty Hunter was always so short sighted. He disabled the main production line, but ne'er bothered t' destroy the maintenance droids! It seems they 'ave brought the factory back t' an operational status. Which means we'll 'ave t' swab the deck 'n take care of the new security.

quests.name: Raise the Sails
quests.description: Ye make a great distraction! While security was focused on ye, I slipped by 'n scouted the place out. I 'ave a hunch as t' where the treasure be. We be lookin' fer the plans t' a droid prototype dat ne'er formally began production. Where better t' stash 'em than the Research 'n Development Division! The problem be the division be without power 'n the door can't be moved. Get me the security key from one o' the Bodyguard Droids 'n we can restore power from the control cabin.

quests.name: Onward!
quests.description: I can hear the credits pourin' into me hands as we speak. Get t' the control cabin 'n insert the security key t' restore the power, 'n be careful o' the bodyguard droids dat be monitorin' the panel!

quests.name: Batten Down the Hatches
quests.description: Good news! We found the plans. Bad news. Our intelligence was wrong about the prototype ne'er bein' produced. Ye'll 'ave t' take dat thing down in order t' snag the plans!

quests.name: Take to the Skies
quests.description: One can never tell where an owl will strike. They cling the treetops but on just as ferocious on the forest floor. Hop from branch to branch in hope of surveying the entire Dragon Den.

quests.name: Ready to Pounce
quests.description: If a tree falls in a forest and nobody's around, an owl still hears it. Gather up extra earlobes from the Cave Creepers and I'll construct quite the hearing device. This way you can hear talk about Rivensylth's location same as your chaotic spirit animal.

quests.name: What a Hoot
quests.description: The combined might of the Earth Titan's forces will surely overpower you if you face them alone. I've laced these tree-traps with an almost irresistible hypnotic honey, lay enough around Dragon's Den and you may stand a chance.

quests.name: Shroom Spreading
quests.description: While you were galavanting off placed tree-traps I witnessed a valuable trait of the Dragon Den mushroom. After a Draklet bumped into the shroom's head, a little powder erupted and the Draklet started going crazy. Maybe we can use this mushroom defense mechanism to our advantage.

quests.name: Protect the Nest
quests.description: At the rate of our progress through the lands, I fear an offensive from the creatures around there. Tap into the sap trees around here and gather some straw from the Grizzly Bear in pines so we can improve our defenses.

quests.name: Night in Shining Armor
quests.description: Based on the work we have done, I have come to a conclusion as to where Rivensylth is located. Instead of continuing out sly and crafty approach, I just want you to clear the path to where I'm positive the dragon be located. Don't show any mercy.

quests.name: Finding Rivensylth
quests.description: Our work has brought us far. Go forward and locate the stone that will summon Rivensylth. She has aged since Nevanna first found her egg.

quests.name: Zero Tolerance for Nature
quests.description: Rivensylth must be freed, and Avada must be defeated.

quests.name: Soul Searching
quests.description: The Underworld Souls linger in these dark depths, currently awaiting judgment. They need your help to find their final resting place. Help 8 Underworld Souls achieve enlightenment and I will give you a Golden Bough that will open the chambers to the Guilty Joys.

quests.name: Chamber of Grief
quests.description: Are you ready to defeat the first Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Grief and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy. Return to me once you have completed your mission.

quests.name: Chamber of Anxiety
quests.description: Anxiously awaiting victory against the second Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Anxiety and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Disease
quests.description: Can you defeat the third Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Disease and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Old Age
quests.description: Old Age haunts us all. Can you defeat the fourth Guilty Joy? Enter the Chamber of Old Age and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Fear
quests.description: There is nothing to fear but Fear itself. Enter the Chamber of the Fear and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Hunger
quests.description: Hungry for a challenge? Enter the Chamber of Hunger and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Death
quests.description: The next Guilty Joy is dying to meet you. Enter the Chamber of Death and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Agony
quests.description: You have almost defeated all the Guilty Joys… and now you must defeat the next Guilty Joy. Enter the Chamber of Agony and defeat the monstrous personification of this Guilty Joy.

quests.name: Chamber of Sleep
quests.description: This is not time to rest! Enter the Chamber of Sleep and defeat the monstrous personification of this final Guilty Joy.

quests.name: AFK Quest
quests.description: *No description*

items.name: YOU... DID... NOTHING! Character Page Badge

quests.name: Interview the Troops
quests.description: Now that I know you can be trusted, you have work to do for the Silent Sentinels. Go around the Tower and talk to the troops. See if you can find any clue about who the traitor is.

quests.name: The Drop Spot
quests.description: From what theotherothers said, Baxter has a drop spot somewhere inside the tower. The trooper overhead him talking about a Guardian Blade. Check every sword hanging in the tower for Baxter's drop spot. If we can find it then it might help us track him down.

quests.name: The Spider's Gem
quests.description: It seems that you need a rare Spider Gem to activate the teleporter. Check the Spiders in Eastern Greenguard forest. the Spider Gems are rare but you may find one on them.

quests.name: Enemies on the Other Side
quests.description: Whatever you find on the other side of that portal will be guarded. Capture as many of the enemy as you can and bring them back here for questioning. The upstairs Teleporter is waiting for you.

quests.name: Get Some Answers
quests.description: Whoever trained those Strange Knights trained them well. They haven't said a word. Maybe you'll have more luck getting them to talk. We've rigged the Teleporter to take you to a hidden area of the tower. Enter the Teleporter and get some answers.

quests.name: Recovery of Stolen Goods
quests.description: While the Silent Sentinels take a look at the Strange Knights construction, you should head back through the Teleporter to the cavern. Take back as many of the supplies as you can. Report to me when you're done.

quests.name: Face the Traitor!
quests.description: It appears that the Strange Knights bore the mark of a group called the Jus Divinum. Our only hope of learning more is bringing the traitor Baxter back alive. Head to the cavern one last time and defeat Baxter! Be careful, he is a trained Guardian.

quests.name: Agitated Orb Quest
quests.description: Agitated Orbs need to eat, too, you know. Bring me 5 irradiated socks from the monsters in the forge and I'll tell you what Cysero's Secret REALLY is. I'm nice like that

quests.name: 2nd Agitated Orb Quest
quests.description: Agitated Orbs don't exist on irridated socks alone, y'know. All that wool n' stuff makes us thirsty! Bring me 10 Moglinberries from the shrubs in the /cellar and this time I PROMISE I'll tell you what Cysero's Secret REALLY is. Really. Honest.

quests.name: Ritual Greed
quests.description: The disgraced warrior saw his punishment coming, and has corrupted his former brothers in arms to distract us. Please free the Pesugihan Boar from the sway of this dark sorcery!

quests.name: Dark Dance
quests.description: The disgraced warrior is cornered at the end of the hall! Defeat and expel him from Wentira! Be wary- he has dabbled in Santet, a form of dark sorcery that causes pain and death. Bring me his spear as proof that you have completed your test.

quests.name: Boarish Audacity
quests.description: That disgraced warrior is a persistent one! I had hoped he would learn from the shame of being made to leave Wentira, but he keeps returning with more corrupted warriors. I must ask that you expel them again.

quests.name: Chaos Pirate Collection Badge
quests.description: I be needin' more purple and greens in my diet. Bring me a Chaos Kelp Salad. Ye'll find it if you slay enough of the Chaos Kelp in /LagunaBeach.

items.name: Chaos Pirate Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Dog Days
quests.description: I first began to notice my father acting oddly when he sent his most loyal ninja and samurai to go ransack a village who could not pay their taxes after he raised them unreasonably high. My father would never cause his people that kind of hardship. Go to Hachiko Tower in town (to the right from here) and question 5 ninja and 5 samurai then return to me with their answers.

quests.name: Faceless Threat
quests.description: You have to defeat those faceless Nopperabo yokai, and find out what they have done with the soldiers that they have replaced! Search Hachiko Tower and find the Samurai Nopperabo for clues. Return to me when you find something.

quests.name: Zodiac Puzzle Key
quests.description: You may have noticed that the roof is locked. That's my fault. I used to go play on the roof as a child so my father had it locked and had the Zodiac Puzzle Key split into 4 pieces. Search the Ninja Nopperabo and Samurai Nopperabo until you find all 4 pieces of the Puzzle Key, then return to me with the 4 pieces! Look at the walls, and in front of the doors to get clues as to which rooms you need to enter for the pieces. The Ninja Nopperabo and Samurai Nopperabo inside the rooms will have the keys - the ones in the halls are there to slow down your quest. Hurry, our soldiers are in danger!

quests.name: Rescue!
quests.description: There, the key is finished. Hurry, our soldiers must be waiting for you on the roof. Take care, hero… if they could have escaped by now then they would have. Something is keeping a close eye on them up there and whatever it is, it won't be happy to see you.

quests.name: Tail End
quests.description: Yiren is organizing the Wuji Descendants. Two of them are waiting outside at the Mikoto Shrine. Find them, and relay his instructions. This will seal the Mikoto Shrine's mirror, and prevent Koschei from escaping. I've sent Shikigami to guard them, but they will need to be tamed.

quests.name: A Thousand Hills
quests.description: Half of the seal is in place, but the other half needs your attention. Relay Yiren's instructions to Kana and Li. The Snake Shikigami with them will need to be pacified as well. They're confused, and won't follow my commands because they don't recognize me as Ai No Miko yet.

quests.name: Mount and Land and Skies
quests.description: With the seal in place, all that needs to be done is to unify the rest of the Descendants' innate magic. Shi Wa Lam and Baoyu are waiting for you to relay Yiren's instructions to them. Be on your guard. Koschei has sensed our activities, and sent her Dragonling Puppets to stop you.

quests.name: Distant Shores
quests.description: Alas, the Descendants of the Jade Ox Prince is missing. It will put more burden on the others, but I trust their strength. Yue and Ramona are waiting for you to give them Yiren's instructions. The Dark Zmey are stalking them. Stop them before Ai No Miko's relatives are harmed.

quests.name: Taizi
quests.description: The Descendant of the Jade Mouse Princess is waiting for you to relay Yiren's instructions. He is the rebellious sort, but is skilled despite his youth. The Dragonlings and Zmey are fighting him. Help Chen wipe out the last of Koschei's puppets.

quests.name: Begrudged Oni
quests.description: We've completed as much of the ritual as we are able to. Now it's time to let Yiren know. He's stationed to the south of this cave, where the spirits of deceased Yokai begin their path to reincarnation. Cut the strings blocking the way forward, and pacify the Oni Spirits lingering nearby.

quests.name: Linking Discord
quests.description: I've asked my Shikigami to survey the path ahead. Find him. He has gone to where his fellow spirits will drift, reincarnate, and forget about him. He'll need you to keep the Spirits from resisting the flow. Their lingering outrage will only serve to help Koschei by obstructing us.

quests.name: Yokai's Cycle
quests.description: Koschei is nearby. She has run out of puppets, but her mere presence is causing the spirits of the Realm to become frenzied. Please, pacify them. If they stray too far in the confusion, the Yokai will never be able to reincarnate.

quests.name: Kojutsu
quests.description: Ai the edge of the path to reincarnation is a guardian meant to protect the cycle of the Yokai Realm. The role is currently held by an Inugami, and Koschei's influence is causing them to lash out violently. Pacify them, so that they can herd the Yokai to their rightful place.

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.name: Glaring Errors
quests.description: Can you identify all the errors left behind in this gallery by the EbilCorp AI Blender? AI Oh No Miko has her eye on you, so best keep yours peeled.

items.name: Art-ificially Ebil Creator Character Page Badge

quests.name: Glorified Pest Control
quests.description: The tour of Diauhtla begins with us learning about its customs. Before this was a bustling vacation town, it was a hunter's outpost. Wreaths decorated with owl feathers and fox fur were a heartfelt gift back in the day. Because of how dangerous the wildlife was, the present signified that you wanted to protect the giftee. Part of the fun in crafting is getting the materials. You'll find foxes and owls all over the place!

quests.name: Mingling Sights
quests.description: Hanging up lights, ornaments, and wreaths is an essential Frostval activity. Usually, I provide guests with my own decorations but the wreaths you and Alina made are beautiful! May I have the honor of hanging them on the walls of the inn? And with how many you made, we can share them with the townspeople. If you head east, you'll find Lief the Cafe owner. He loves chatting and he'll love your wreaths!

quests.name: Sore Long Faces
quests.description: Oof, Rolith and his team are still having trouble with fixing his sled. Last I saw, his horses were galloping around the starting line. The Tundra Steeds aren't usually this ornery but they might be holding the sled crash against him. Poor Rolith always keeps his chin up when his whole team is neck deep in trouble. I think he would appreciate us rounding up his horses, and you'll get to see the view of the mountain range!

quests.name: Eggcellent Trade
quests.description: Oh dear, the foxes are starting up trouble again. They're mischievous little fellows, stealing the wood planks Rolith's team needs to rebuild their sled. They just want to play, or to exchange the DIY supplies for some snacks. Here, I boiled a carton of eggs. Playfight with the foxes for long enough, and they'll accept the trade. Hmm, maybe I should offer this sort of experience to other visitors.

quests.name: Homemade Stars
quests.description: The racers are ready to go, and participants would like you to have the honor of lighting their torches. Those torches are able to burn so bright and be seen from the top of the mountain because they're fueled by owl feathers. We found out how flammable they were the hard way when a member of my staff got a candle too close to a wreath. So collect feathers, light the torches, and I'll be on the sidelines watching you send the racers off.

quests.name: Missing Lion
quests.description: As part of our tradition, we have a lion that goes from door to door looking for lettuce that is hanging from the front of our houses and stores. The lion then eats the lettuce and scatters the leaves symbolizing a fresh start for the new year and the spread of good luck. Our lion was lion-napped and, by the foot prints left behind, it seems like Ninja Nopperabo have something to do with it. You may find Ninja Nopperabo in Hachiko's Hotel. Please get our Lion back!

quests.name: Head of Lettuce
quests.description: Besides retrieving our lion we also need to find our heads of lettuce. See, without the heads of lettuce we won't be able to bring good fortune to our homes and business, because the lion won't have anything to eat and scatter around. We know that Kappa Ninjas like to eat lettuce and, judging by the trail they left behind, they were headed to the Yokai River. Can you find 3 heads of lettuce before the Kappa have a chance to eat them?

quests.name: Bad Spirit Away
quests.description: A new year can't be complete without fireworks. The Fireworks loud noise will keep bad spirits away. Skello Kitties being as mischievous as they are, detest the sound of fireworks and, according to the trail of bones that was left behind we can assume they were the ones that took our fireworks. The Skello Kitties can be found in the Yokai Graveyard. Please find 4 fireworks and bring them back.

quests.name: Goat Gone Wild
quests.description: Something happened to all the goats and wolves! They're all purple now, and they have tentacles. I want to go home, but I'm scared they'll hurt me. Can you make it safe for me? Please?

quests.name: Creepy Eyes
quests.description: Those flying eyeballs can see me if I leave the bushes. Can't they? Please, make them go away!

quests.name: Find My Parents
quests.description: I hope my parents are ok. Can you help me find them? My home is not too far from here. I'll meet you there!

quests.name: Gather the Shadows
quests.description: We must prepare for war. Our magi can use Shadow Oil to empower their spells. Go back to the /valleyofdoom and collect as much as you can from the shadowy creatures there.

quests.name: Journey Through the Dark Night
quests.description: Tara went inside the forge, and started skimming a book left behind on that table. Could you ask her to read it to me? I don't remember if I'm literate, but I liked all the stories she told me about your adventures. Did you know she wrote them down?

quests.name: Lunar Caustic
quests.description: Dahlia shot off as soon as the forge's doors opened. Tara's pointing down the western hall. It smells smokey, which means there are Maleno Elementals around. We should clear that side, and see what Dahlia's doing. The Elementals aren't bothering her. If she's not human, is she one of them?

quests.name: Like Water and Lithium
quests.description: I ticked Warlic off pretty bad. He went down the eastern hall to deal with the Draconians that broke into the forge. They came to help that Dragon claim it as their lair. Think Warlic would be less angry if we talked and got rid of the Draconians together?

quests.name: The Shadows Lengthen in...
quests.description: The guardian of Maleno, Admin B, said the room containing the flames is locked. That's…weird. The key should be in one of the other rooms, so try pushing yourself up against their doors. While you're doing that…

quests.name: Blithe Hospitality
quests.description: I told Tara about the key. She thinks it's a trap. Like, a surprise that's going to hurt us. Wait, of course you'd already know what that is. I'm going to help her prepare in case it is a trap while you clear out the last of the Elementals and Draconians.

quests.name: Sal Volatile
quests.description: There's nothing we can do but destroy the Dragon, inside Maleno's flames, and hope that Admin B is going to seal the forge. They told us the Fire Dragon's name was Idalion the Elegant. Remember? Tara doesn't like hurting Dragons so it's up to us.

quests.name: Pet-ty Plumbing Problems
quests.description: It takes a certain type of person to fix plumbing, and I am not that person. My animals, though, are in dire need of a drink, and all the pipes are clogged! Or bent, or broken or, or… I don't know! Find me 12 new pipes and 1 Bronze Washer from an Octo so the Skyguard's plumber will have something with which to work!

quests.name: Dogs and Cogs
quests.description: Even robodogs made up of cogs and bits and bolts need to play sometimes! But I am woefully short of toys now that I'm working for the Skyguard. They aren't much givenforto play. Can you bring me some robodoggie toys? They'd like sticks and… hmm, furry squeaky toys if you can find them!

quests.name: SteamOcto Ahoy!
quests.description: Recently a host of strange creatures have appeared in the Hover-base. At first, the Skyguard thought they were friendly, and set me to taming the creatures. However, they began to attack as soon as I came near. The recruits think they are spies for some nefarious villain, but I disagree. Help me capture 8 SteamOcto's so that I can continue my efforts to tame them.

quests.name: Alina's Go-Go Potion
quests.description: This is supposed to be the happiest day of our lives. They don't tell you that it's also the most exhausting. We're both so exhausted that we're sleeping on our feet but if I had some coffee beans and soil from the /farm I could make some energy potions with the extracted caffeine and B12!

quests.name: From The Heart
quests.description: Rolith and I agreed not to buy each other wedding gifts… so I plan on making him one but I need your help gathering the materials! I will need a Default Sword from /yulgar's weapon shop, a Perfect Chaotic Fang from the wolves in /forestchaos and some 5 perfect crystals from Leatherwings in /pines!

quests.name: Free Advertising
quests.description: Ah, hello there! I'm not sure why, but my business hasn't exactly been booming as of late. Perhaps it's because people are always coming and going here in Dreadrock. I'll need to find a way to attract new clientele…would you mind going around and advertising my shop to the locals? A good place to start would be the faction recruiters on the other side of town. It wouldn't hurt to clear some of the monsters you see on the way back, either - they're bad for business.

quests.name: Supply Run
quests.description: It seems a few thieves have run off with my supplies. If you would, please get them back to me as soon as possible. You'll probably find them on some of the locals around here.

quests.name: Pisces Alpherg
quests.description: In the light of Lore's day, the Astravians see me as a light that blesses the land. The First King warned me that it would change in the shadow of night. They would no longer think so well of me. As your ancestors arrived to receive the throne, one by one, they proved him right. Activate the portal, and gaze upon my true form - your origin.

quests.name: Pisces Ishtar
quests.description: Asking for you to defeat me would be unfair. To pass my test, you need only to survive. I have reached my hand out to you, as I have with our bloodline. Know that even though you are my kin, your life will be forfeit if you fail. Now, fight me to your last or return to my embrace.

quests.name: Pay Homage to Caladbolg
quests.description: As a devout follower of the Undead Legion, it is a privilege to pay homage to the Altar of Caladbolg. Your donation of 5 Legion Tokens and 1 soul shard from a skeletal warrior in /underworld will earn you eternal respect from The Dark Lord.

Altar Of the Hollowborn Caladbolg's Ques.name: Altar Of the Hollowborn Caladbolg's Quests

quests.name: Pay Homage to Caladbolg (Again)
quests.description: As a devout follower of the Hollowborn, it is a privilege to pay homage to the Hollowborn Altar of Caladbolg. Your donation of 5 Legion Tokens and 1 Hollow Soul may earn you eternal respect from The First Hollowborn.

quests.name: How Much For One Rib?
quests.description: I have a true challenge for you. Bring me a Dark Unicorn Rib from the beastly monster unicorn known as Binky. In return I will reward you with Hollow Souls. I might possibly offer you an even more rare reward if I find your performance pleasing.

quests.name: Can I Axe You a Question
quests.description: Our Master wishes to bring more Undead into MystCroft! As he wishes, so must we do. But all of our axes are broken. Without those, we cannot chop down the Dead End sign. Please, Hero, kill monsters until you have 15 metal shards so we can forge a new axe!

quests.name: Don't Forge-t
quests.description: Take the Metal shards you gathered to the Forge! Click on the Forge to fire it up (push-button smithing is Cysero's latest innovation!) and your metal will become an all-metal ax!

quests.name: Stellar Dynamics
quests.description: Ugh, this is so annoying. Other stars snuck inside the cave! They must have figured us out - I mean, they must have seen how lucky we were having you to help us get home! Give these Astral Spirits a good punt and send them back into space!

quests.name: Hokey Horoscope
quests.description: How did that Astromancer lady get inside the cave? She's not supposed to be here! Tell Kylokos to give us some space! She's over there admiring the paintings we made of Suzaku and Genbu. Hmm…You should go admire them too ~

quests.name: Tokaki
quests.description: Little tiger cubs chased after us from the cosmos. Don't mind them! They're just ankle biters made from our stardust. I guess scampering tripping hazards would be dangerous for someone with legs, so shoo them off. They'll only hate you for a couple of decades.

quests.name: Ekie
quests.description: The purple lady got inside the cave too! Tell her it's okay to steal our self-portrait, and that picture of that ugly blue noodle Seiryuu. Make sure to show it off and put it somewhere high! We'll visit it after we finish being alone with you.

quests.name: Subaru
quests.description: The Byakko Cubs and Astral Spirits are crowding the cave. We don't have any breathing room to talk with you, and our cool paintings are going to get messed up! Clear them out for us, pretty please with sparkles on top ~

quests.name: Kagasuki
quests.description: This was supposed to be a cave, not a rave! It's lit like a sunny day from all the visiting stars. Even further inside are lights from Rigel. We'll save our special talk for later. We need to make the Rigel Strays leave!

quests.name: Amefuri
quests.description: The Lunar Hazes are seeping in. They have a habit of bothering me specifically, so it'd be so nice if you could kill them! Wreck them! Hurt them, and ignore the walls. Definitely ignore the stuff on the walls. Erm…that wasn't supposed to be here…

quests.name: Tatara
quests.description: The Champion of Nature's staring at that very unimportant and meaningless picture on the wall. Did she get left behind by the purple lady? You should grab her before she gets lost again.

quests.name: Toroki
quests.description: We aren't too far from the end of the cave. That's where the Lunar Hazes and Rigel Strays are trickling in from. They're all so greedy for attention! Make them wait their turn! Or… you could not give them a turn at all, ehehe ~

quests.name: Komokuten
quests.description: Oops! I fell out by accident! Hey, help me back to Byakko and we'll have a real one-on-one duel! As our original self, we'll win for sure! When we do, you'll make us the Tiger of Space! No more stalling, and no interruptions! Fight us!

quests.name: Feeding the Frozen Flame
quests.description: The Fotia Elementals feed off the Frozen Flame's soul. By defeating these Elementals, we can help restore power and strength to the Frozen Flame. Return to me after you have defeated 4 Fotia Elementals.

quests.name: Fire for the Frozen Flame
quests.description: Just like the Fotia Elementals, the Fotia Spirits thrive off the Frozen Flame's soul. We can help make the Frozen Flame stronger by sacrificing Fotia Spirits. After you have defeated 5 Fotia Spirits, the Frozen Flame will burn brighter!

quests.name: Lore Cores
quests.description: The lava shows no signs of slowing down; what we need now are Fire Cores! Fire Cores are legendary auras that some Fotia creatures contain. Capture 7 Fire Cores from the Fotia Spirits and Fotia Elementals to pay more respect to the Frozen Flame.

quests.name: Volcanic Exploration
quests.description: Hmm… the volcano still shows signs of erupting! Perhaps we need additional Cores found within the Femme Fatalities? Engage in friendly competitive sparing against the Femme Cult Worshipers near the volcano, and retrieve 6 Lava Cores from them! Hurry!

quests.name: Retrieve the Ancient Artifact: Fire Staff
quests.description: As the Frozen Flame is an ancient relic herself, the Fire Staff that the Skeletal Fire Magi uses dates back centuries. The Fire Staff might contain an ancient power that the Frozen Flame can harness. Travel to /join portalundead, /join battleundera, and /join darkoviagrave to find the Fire Staff!

quests.name: Retrieve the Ancient Artifact: Ice Orb
quests.description: Much like the Fire Staff, the ancient Ice Orb Staff that the Skeletal Ice Magi use dates back centuries. If we can combine the Ice Orb's power with the Fire Staff, then perhaps the Frozen Flame will be able to stop the Fotia Volcano from erupting! Head to /join swordhavenundead, and /join battleundera to get the Ice Orb Staff from a Skeletal Ice Mage!

quests.name: This Guy's on Her Side
quests.description: What does the Frozen Flame and the Archfiend Nulgath have in common? A mutual hatred towards Dage the Evil! If you can retrieve 50 Archfiend's Favor from the /join Underworld, then perhaps the Frozen Flame will burn brighter than ever and save the Isle of Fotia from the Volcano! Please make haste!

quests.name: Star Light, Star Bright
quests.description: Would you help me, if you have time? Defeat Light Elementals and bring me the Light Particles you find after they dissipate.

quests.name: Rip Space
quests.description: The room that the Nation's Casters are occupying used to be where I was trained in combat. Odd cracks have formed on the ground, and the Casters are conducting some sort of ritual. Are they causing that? We need to get them to tell us before we continue on.

quests.name: Permanent Record
quests.description: The Nation Outriders are guarding what used to be my bedroom. They're under strict orders from the Blood Void to keep us out. Carnage must have found Carcano! Beat the Outriders down! They wouldn't have it any other way.

quests.name: Blood and Water
quests.description: The pig pen's a lot quieter now. Oh, that's what my brother and I called this room when we were trapped here. Is my memory still clear, or am I forgetting anything? Take a look at the drawings on the wall, and at that notebook on my brother's old bed.

quests.name: Family Feud
quests.description: The clash between the forces of the Nation and the Paladins of the Lightguard are reaching a frenzy. Argh, they're all so blinded by bloodlust that they're lashing out at anyone, even their own! We need to stop them before the floor caves in.

quests.name: Twisted Helix
quests.description: Carnage, the Fiend leading the Nation Outriders, is charging into the Eastern Wing! He's caught the traitor's scent. We need to get to Carcano and the dying star first! Don't let Carnage get ahead of us! And if I look like I'm about to kill him, stop me before it's too late.

quests.name: Gathering Power
quests.description: So you want the armor of the Arch Doomknight? That is a highly valuable and powerful artifact I'm afraid I can't give it away so easily. Bring me what I need and I will see if it is sufficient enough as to me this set my last memento of an old friend and to the shadowscythe a highly powerful artifact. You can find dragon energy from Lair and Human Souls of value can be found in Noxus Tower.

quests.name: Death's Door
quests.description: Death holds a very important role in the balance of all things and his power over life is one to be feared. If you can get me a fraction of his power and souls he's collected over the years then I will see fit to allow you to continue. He won't give them to you willingly so be prepared for a fight.

quests.name: Chaotic Lords
quests.description: The chaos lords hold great power, a power that took out Sepulchure, so I must ask of you to obtain a piece of each of the lords and some of their power. Not only for revenge but because these powers are unlike any other in lore and I wish to study them to aid in my personal research.

quests.name: A Means to an End
quests.description: For your final task I will need you to bring me immense amounts of doom energy. The Arch Doomknight armor that Sepulchure empowered may have lost its once great spark but the energy to replace what was lost is still needed now that he is gone. If you bring me these catalysts of energy I will let you have the reward you seek as this will be the means to an end.

quests.name: Nightmarish Collection
quests.description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk under the waves. But they have not yet taken down one of the most powerful of Eldritch gods… Kathool! Defeat him in the /deepchaos map to unlock the Ancient Nightmares character page badge.

quests.name: Trailblazer
quests.description: Thanks for coming for us but until Xan takes his monsters and leaves our town, we're trapped here. I think it might be safe enough for us to make a dash back to our parents if you get rid of 12 of the fire monsters. Let me know when the coast is clear.

quests.name: Fire Brigade Of One
quests.description: You took care of a lot of Xan's monsters but now the fires raging through town are getting out of control. We have a well but the monsters have stolen the bucket! See if you can find our towns only bucket on one of the remaining monsters.

quests.name: Fire Control
quests.description: Now that you have the bucket you'll be able to put out the fires. You'll have to do it once bucket of water at a time. Refill your bucket at the well in town then click on each fire you see until they are all out!

quests.name: Andesi's Family Pendant
quests.description: I was hoping that it would be safe enough to get everyone back together but it's still too dangerous. You've been gone a long time. I want to get a message to my mom but I know she's freaking out. If you get the indent from my house, I'll put a small note in it and she'll know it's me. We live in number 26, near the well. Find the pendent please.

quests.name: Signed, Seared, Delivered
quests.description: OK, all you need to do is deliver this to my mom, Scoria. Once she has it she will relax a little. We're just ride things out here. Don't worry. We'll be OK.

quests.name: Or Maybe THIS Is True Love
quests.description: Of course I am thrilled to be out of here! But darling, how can I possibly leave without my sweet Gisele? I was heartbroken when she vanished, and I know I saw her reflected in a mirror when I was being taken to mine. You'll rescue her too, right? Just keep heading further in, and I know you'll find her mirror.

quests.name: Quest for the Jade Monkey
quests.description: The Jade Monkey was stolen centuries ago, and all my searching has led me here. I just KNOW those Gravediggers have stolen it, and I won't rest until it's MINE! Bring me any evidence of the monkey you can, and I will reward you handsomely!

quests.name: Hunt for the Silver Snakes
quests.description: Legend has it that the Silver Snakes were deities that displeased the Queen of Monsters. I would like to find evidence of their existence. They molt, so you should be able to find their scales or fangs. I expect the Gravediggers and infantrymen will have some for you.

quests.name: Battle for the Legion Staff
quests.description: A few days ago, I found a staff deep within the crypt-but after I took it, a Legion DoomKnight came out of nowhere and attacked me! I managed to get away, but dropped and broke the weapon somewhere inside. I'm busy hunting for more important relics at the moment, but you're more than welcome to head in there and recover the pieces from whoever may have picked them up.

quests.name: Lightning Up the Night
quests.description: Hero, I fear for my element. If I am to be its custodian someday, I must protect it even now! But I am not strong enough. Please, separate the10099 spirits of the Air from the Earth's lightning where they are clashing inside the temple, and bring me a Breath from a Living Air!

quests.name: Will You Take Omom?
quests.description: My little friend, Omon, she has been with me since I was a young one in the clutch. I care for her, and she watches my back and plays Catch-the-tail to lighten my mood in these dark times. Some Living Air creature has stolen her. Please, get her back!

quests.name: The Molten Heart
quests.description: Though Kasuko has successfully repelled an intruder, he seeks reassurance that the will of humankind has not weakened. If you duel and defeat the dragon with your own strength of body and character, it will stop Kasuko from setting the nearby villages ablaze. You will have the respect of Kasuko, and I will arrange for your efforts to be properly honored.

quests.name: Forge the Blaze of Awe
quests.description: Kalayo senses great power in you, and wishes to continue dueling so he may hone his own claws. In turn, we will hone yours. If you gather Volcanic Essence from Kayalo, the scales of the great dragon in /gravestrike, the Molten Cores from monsters lurking in /battleundere, and Scrolls of Scorched Steel, we will turn your Blade of Awe into an eternal blaze.

quests.name: Forge the Blazing Light of Destiny
quests.description: Fire and Light are similar indeed, and I believe we can make your Blinding Light of Destiny blaze with brilliance. Kalayo wishes to continue dueling with you to hone his claws, and will give you the Volcanic Essence needed to forge this weapon. Our craftsmen will also need the scales of the great dragon in /gravestrike, the Molten Cores from monsters lurking in /battleundere, and Scrolls of Scorched Steel.

quests.name: Forge the Burning Sword of Doom
quests.description: That is a very dangerous sword, but I would rather it be in your hands than that of the unworthy. Pit that blade against Kalayo for Volcanic Essences, retrieve the scales of the great dragon in /gravestrike, Molten Cores from monsters lurking in /battleundere, a Flame Heart from Smoldur in /ashfallcamp, and Scrolls of Scorched Steel. We will take those materials and bathe your Sword of Doom in fire.

quests.name: Ruined Ruins
quests.description: So you're looking for the last piece of the Runix Cube? Ok, let's make a deal. I can't learn ANYTHING from these ruins with the Chaos Lord's minions crawling all over the place. You clear out… say… 8 gargoyles and I'll help ya. But I'll need to see proof.

quests.name: Energize!
quests.description: Good luck trying to find your way around this place. My notes tell me that there SHOULD be a teleporter around here. If you found it then you could probably find what you're looking for much more easily. See if you can find it.

quests.name: Blueish Glow
quests.description: Hmmm. I think we can charge up the teleporter pad if we had enough power sources. The gargoyles are animated using a magic blue gem in the center of each gargoyle. If we had 10 Blue Gems we might be able to get it working.

quests.name: Quickdraw
quests.description: Time to test out the teleporter! I'm not sure where it will take you but whatever you find, I need you to make a quick sketch of it. I should be able to give you more information once I see your drawing.

quests.name: Arm Yourself
quests.description: Ok, fine. That golem wants to play hardball… then I'm… I mean your just the hero to do it. I bet the piece of the Runix Cube is INSIDE that golem. Defeat the golem and bring me his Arm and we'll crack it open and see what's inside.

quests.name: You've Been Framed
quests.description: OF COURSE! This is a piece of the frame from that moglin painting in the main hall! Try completing the frame and see what happens. We're close now…. I can feel it!

quests.name: Reduce, Respawn, Recycle
quests.description: You're a superhero, right? Nothing is more super than saving the planet—by recycling! Check the Trashcans and bring me 10 Recyclable Products.

quests.name: Mind your Manners
quests.description: There are some mean bullies who keep beating people up! Won't you teach them a thing or two in manners? Show 8 Bullies the power of proper manners!

quests.name: FUNdraisers!
quests.description: Will you help me recover the Money for my fundraiser? I went door to door and selflessly asked for Fundraiser Donations, but the thugs and bullies stole all the donations!

quests.name: Bully the Thug
quests.description: Yippie! You helped me—so I'll help you! The Boss is hiding at the very end of the Alleyway. Go take him out.

quests.name: Scratch Test
quests.description: Hi there! You'll never find better weapons than the ones I make – lightweight, yet strong and sharp as dragon's claws! Part of the reason they're so great is that I always try each one out on various minerals to test their strength. Want to help me out? Take this one to Earthstorm and give it a whirl!

quests.name: Stinging Dagger of Serpents
quests.description: Turn in a "War Prize!" to obtain the Stinging Dagger of Serpents! (Member Only)

quests.name: Dagger of Serpents!
quests.description: Turn in a "War Prize!" to obtain the Dagger of Serpents!

quests.name: Royal Blade of Thorns
quests.description: Turn in "War Prize!" to obtain the Royal Blade of Thorns! (Member Only)

quests.name: Blade of Thorns
quests.description: Turn in "War Prize!" to obtain the Blade of Thorns!

quests.name: Staff of the Burning Abyss
quests.description: Turn in "War Prize!" to obtain the Stinging Staff of the Burning Abyss! (Member Only)

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs the Moglurker
quests.description: Aspiring Pockey-Mogs champions! Your first battle is against: The Moglurker! Send in your Pukasnooze, and may the best Pockey-Mog prevail!

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Zaplin
quests.description: Ash and Aria, you won the last round, so you get to go in again! This time, your Pukasnooze is up against an electric Pockey-Mog: the Zaplin! Good luck!

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Blood Moggot
quests.description: Time for Round 3! Can you keep up your winning streak? Only this battle against your opponent's Blood Moggot will tell!

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Flamog
quests.description: Let's see how your Pukasnooze does against something a little… hotter! Your next opponent is Flamog, and he is on fire! Literally.

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Vizally
quests.description: As the undefeated tournament champions, you're in for a special treat! Your next battle is up against Annie of Team Wreckit, and her best Pockey-Mog fighter, Vizally!

quests.name: Pukasnooze vs Toglin
quests.description: Your Pukasnooze may have beaten Annie's Vizally, but let's see how it does against Oakley's Toglin? Team Wreckit hasn't lost yet!

quests.name: They're Gonna Wreckit!
quests.description: You thought you could come in here and use your fake Pukasnooze to win our tournament and take all of our Pockey-Mogs? NOT COOL. Team Wreckit is gonna teach you a lesson!

quests.name: Tip Out
quests.description: My shift is just about over. But goodness me, my Tips are strewn all over the bar! Under the tables, beneath the chairs, ughm, they're everywhere! Can you do me a big favor and help collect my Tips for me? Just click on each golden coin you find around the bar and bring them back to me when no more tips can be found! Thanks, sugar!

quests.name: War Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Defeat opponents in the Black Hole Sun war to obtain 5 Black Hole Sun war medals. Turn these in to raise the war meter. Once the meter hits 100%, you'll unlock the war boss!

quests.name: Mega War Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Defeat opponents in the Black Hole Sun war to obtain 3 Mega Black Hole Sun war medals. Turn these in to raise the war meter. Once the meter hits 100%, you'll unlock the war boss!

quests.name: Bring the Pain
quests.description: The Black Hole Sun has come, and now it's time YOU bring the pain. Take out 5 of the Black Hole Sun's creatures and I'll craft a 4th Dimension Gem from the bursts of Black Light they shed.

quests.name: Reflection of Death
quests.description: The light from the Black Hole Sun passing through the 4th Dimensional Pyramid has created… something incredible! But also deadly. Take out the Reflecteract before it twists YOU into knots!

quests.name: Apocalyptic House Items
quests.description: Ground bonemeal is a VERY useful building material. Bring me a femur from the Undead Vikings in /graveyard and I will craft a piece of furniture for you.

quests.name: Sploosh Some Solars!
quests.description: Well, what are you waiting for? Grab a weapon and go sploosh some of those Solar Elementals!

quests.name: Sploosh Some Bigger Solars!
quests.description: Some of the emerging solar elementals are more powerful than the others. But you can't tell which are which just from looking at them! If you happen to sploosh some of the more powerful ones, let me know.

quests.name: Curious Monkeys
quests.description: The gibbons who hang around the temple are very curious - and very naughty. They keep stealing our unused water balloons. See if you can get some of the back from them, ok? Our resources aren't unlimited, after all!

quests.name: Owwie!
quests.description: Exposure to all these solar elementals has left a lot of people sunburned! Think you could collect some Aloe Gel for me so I can help them ease the pain? You should be able to find plenty of Aloe plants in the jungle nearby.

quests.name: Naughty Monkeys
quests.description: Those naughty monkeys have started stealing our water guns, too! If you can manage to get any of them back, we'd all be thankful.

quests.name: The Big One
quests.description: Oh, no! We were all having so much fun - but we made it angry! And now, it's going to destroy everything! Please, you have to stop it!

quests.name: Ow, The Blisters
quests.description: Exposure to all these solar elementals has left a lot of people sunburned! Think you could collect some Aloe Gel for me so I can help them ease the pain? You should be able to find plenty of Aloe plants in the jungle nearby.

quests.name: Even Naughtier Monkeys
quests.description: Those monkeys just like to steal everything, don't they? The temple staff are trying to clean up the mess left behind from the Solar Festival, but the monkeys keep taking our clean rags. Help me get them back?

quests.name: AQW Arcade
quests.description: Wait… this game only LOOKS broken! But it takes Twiggy Tokens. Defeat the Mascots to get the Tokens, and you'll be able to get a prize.

quests.name: Wayfarer Potion
quests.description: The creatures and plant life here should be enough for us to create a potion that will reveal the way for us. Would you collect some ingredients for me?

quests.name: The Path Revealed
quests.description: With the potion complete, we should be able to find our way to the voice that I keep hearing! There may be some beasts in our way, however. Help me clear them out… and find the source of that voice!

quests.name: Summon Help
quests.description: I need you to summon a friend of mine. He can help us locate the portal to underworld, which we can investigate. Before you can summon our helper you need to collect : 1 Holy Water from the waterfalls, 10 Bright Flower Seeds from your Infernal Knights, and 1 Golden Grain from the Celestial Bird of Paradise.

quests.name: Power Up!
quests.description: Well done Hero! Now you will have to learn the summoning spell, be aware that this is not an easy spell and you will need a lot of power. Battle Celestial Birds of Paradise until you get 10 Potions from them. You can purchase Basic Guard Potions from Skira in /embersea and the Fallen Knights have the pieces of the spell.

quests.name: The Final Spell Fragment
quests.description: Amazing, we are almost there! The Spell notes that you retrieved are not complete yet. You will have to find the final piece, so that we can read the spell.

quests.name: Find the Map
quests.description: Hero, Ilahi Sama needs our help to locate the portal. He wants you to collect a Map of Lore, which the Infernal Knight has stolen, and he will also need a Map Decoder to understand the readings on the map. You can get the decoder from one of the Dwakels' machines in /crashsite… just press the red button!

quests.name: Reveal the Portal!
quests.description: We are getting closer! Ilahi Sama has found the portal to the Underworld and made it visible for all. Please find it and return for instructions once you have.

quests.name: Your Garden
quests.description: We begin with a seed. Reach out to this fragment of us, and begin your personal journey. Where did you grow? What did you learn? Return to Oaklore, and take us with you. Defeat the very first foe you met, and continue from there.

quests.name: Love and Loss
quests.description: You have endured several lifetimes' worth of joy and despair, feelings many like us envy deeply. Help us grow in your heart. Nurture us with love, and trample on us with loss. The Fool will only learn through experience.

quests.name: Dawn Before Dusk
quests.description: A journey isn't complete without mishaps. For you to transform, a part of you must die. Have you undergone such an experience? Show us. The fear of death is essential to the process of growth, yet it has evaded us time and time again.

quests.name: Dusk Before Dawn
quests.description: Come catastrophe or the death of stars, tomorrow will arrive, even if the Sun refuses to rise. Show us your resolve to complete this journey, and realize your new self. In witnessing your rebirth, we will reach another awakening.

quests.name: Endless Beginning, Final Ends
quests.description: Completion nears. The shell of your egg is cracking. The final step is challenging the remnants of your old self, committing them to memory, and realizing your new form.

items.name: Arcana Invoker Class Character Page Badge

quests.name: Ancient Essential Magics
quests.description: To become a great mage one has to start with the basics. One has to know how to combine natural ingredients to make your own potion. Gather only the finest ingredients so you can create a very powerful potion. Go into the Guru forest and bring me 2 Leather Wing tails and a Trobble feather.

quests.name: Ancient Glimpse of the Dark Side
quests.description: One thing is to be able to create ones own potion but to be master one's own spells, that is where true power lies. Of course one needs to acquire knowledge even in places non ordinary human dare cross. Go deep into the Marsh and fight the evil that resides there. (Bring me 1 Berserker tooth and 1 Witch hair to complete this quest)

quests.name: Ancient Undead Energy
quests.description: A mage must understand the forces that power both life and death in order to even begin the quest for deeper knowledge of the universe. Go to the graveyard and bring me Jack Sprat's and two of his undead minion's un-life forces

quests.name: Ancient Mage Essence
quests.description: You have proven that you possess the skills necessary to be a true master of the art of wizardry. Recently, nearby Bludrut Keep has begun radiating an evil energy… which should provide you with an excellent opportunity to practice your skills as you gather ingredients I can use to further my research. Go explore the Keep, and return to me with the essences of the foul creatures that dwell within it… I believe 5 rock essences and 5 fire essences should suffice. (Bring back 5 rock essence and 5 fire essence to complete this quest)

quests.name: Essential Magics
quests.description: To become a great mage one has to start with the basics. One has to know how to combine natural ingredients to make your own potion. Gather only the finest ingredients so you can create a very powerful potion. Go into the Guru forest and bring me 2 Leather Wing tails and a Trobble feather.

quests.name: Glimpse of the Dark Side
quests.description: One thing is to be able to create ones own potion but to be master one's own spells, that is where true power lies. Of course one needs to acquire knowledge even in places non ordinary human dare cross. Go deep into the Marsh and fight the evil that resides there. (Bring me 1 Berserker tooth and 1 Witch hair to complete this quest)

quests.name: Undead Energy
quests.description: A mage must understand the forces that power both life and death in order to even begin the quest for deeper knowledge of the universe. Go to the graveyard and bring me Jack Sprat's and two of his undead minion's un-life forces

quests.name: Mage Essence
quests.description: You have proven that you possess the skills necessary to be a true master of the art of wizardry. Recently, nearby Bludrut Keep has begun radiating an evil energy… which should provide you with an excellent opportunity to practice your skills as you gather ingredients I can use to further my research. Go explore the Keep, and return to me with the essences of the foul creatures that dwell within it… I believe 5 rock essences and 5 fire essences should suffice. (Bring back 5 rock essence and 5 fire essence to complete this quest)

quests.name: Sorcerer Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the Sorcerer class) You have proven your worth - you are now a Warlord. Sometimes however, these skill are not what is called for, but the look always is.

quests.name: Hex of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if wielding the arcane is more your style. Lightly armored, Hex Voids are the mystic breeds in my legion. They can decimate my enemies with black magic, elements and curses.

quests.name: Arcane Dark Caster Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you have the Arcane Dark Caster Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)

quests.name: Arcane Dark Caster CLASS Owners: Armor Quest
quests.description: If you have the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster Armor for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)

quests.name: Dark Gunner Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you have the Shadowed Dark Gunner Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)

quests.name: ShadowCraft Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you created the Shadowcraft Dark Gunner Armor by merging your Arcane Dark Caster Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and he'll give you the class)

quests.name: Shadowy Dark Gunner Owners: Arcane Class Quest
quests.description: If you have the Shadowy Dark Gunner Armor, you can unlock the Arcane Dark Caster CLASS for free! (Bring Dage a golden bone from the Skeletal Warrior in /graveyard, and purchase a 1k AC token from the merge shop and he'll give you the class)

quests.name: Get Those Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Even More Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Keep Soul Searching!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Sell Those Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can bring in this type of soul, you will be rewarded with Tokens!

quests.name: Hearts and Souls!
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can get Dragon Souls AND Dragon Hearts, you will be amply rewarded!

quests.name: Hearts and Souls! (Member)
quests.description: As the years march on, Dage's need for souls only increases. The more powerful the soul, the better he likes them, and Dragon souls are the BEST. If you can get Dragon Souls AND Dragon Hearts, you will be amply rewarded!

quests.name: Hemophilia
quests.description: I am to give you a tour of the God of Fiends' innards. Blood is guaranteed. If you would please dispatch the Bloodfiends stalking us down the path, we can hurry this act to its conclusion.

quests.name: A Dash of Hope
quests.description: The Hushed stir once more. They sense that Adimonde selected some of them to 'regurgitate' in order to entertain you. Tear them down, dash their hopes, and toss them into the abyss below. They'll come to understand that it's a mercy.

quests.name: Blood Cultivation
quests.description: Do you smell that? The stench of copper and iron…I believe I'm familiar with who Adimonde plans to reconstruct to entertain you. Go deeper, find the junction where all these veins bind into a crimson knot, and learn for yourself.

quests.name: Forever Fall
quests.description: I have a suggestion…a dangerous one. It'd be ideal if we could discuss this without the Hushed and Blood Fiends distracting us. Cut them down, and send them back into the abyss of the Fiend's Void.

quests.name: Hydrops Fetalis
quests.description: Adimonde wanted to show you the Blood Cocoon, and the ancient Archfiend growing inside it. I wonder…can you smash it, and stop him from being reborn? At the very least, you can slow down whatever plans the Fiend God has in motion.

quests.name: Skimmed Off the Top
quests.description: Rodeleros…we'll find her through the spiral. Void Fangs lurk there, and complete solitude made them forget their loyalty to Nulgath. They've been inside the Fiend's Void for too long. Kill them. I doubt their creator will sense anything amiss.

quests.name: Sleeping Soldier
quests.description: Rodeleros is nearby, and it appears that her cocoon hasn't been completed yet. The Arachnids are scurrying about, looking for sustenance to weave more silk. Crush them, and look for anyone who knows about this third rebirthed Archfiend.

quests.name: Espadachina
quests.description: The Crystalized Cocoon looks studier than the one before. Smash it, burn it, do whatever it takes to ruin Adimonde's plan for the Archfiend growing beneath the silk. It's worth a try, even if it only serves to annoy the Fiend God.

quests.name: Ingrained in Flesh
quests.description: …I can sense Adimonde's intentions. They're ripping through my flesh. Apologies. Eliminate the rest of the Void Fangs and Arachnid Seekers. I must prepare myself, and there's nothing I can do to resist it.

quests.name: I Know, Therefore I Suffer
quests.description: Meet me inside the tower all the way at the edge. Adimonde kept my old library, and intends for us to fight there for…your amusement. I humbly ask for you to make it quick. If it seems like I'm not making an earnest resistance, know that I have no choice.

quests.name: The Tale Never Dies
quests.description: Weberich, famous author of Sepulchure's tale, lingers here in the depths of the Necropolis. Restore his tools to him and perhaps he'll have another tale to tell! Bring him 5 vials of Shadow Ink from imps, 1 Inkstone from the Shadowstones, and hunt for his quill and 3 parchments!

quests.name: Lion Hunting
quests.description: Scout Onslaught Tower and see if you can find Archlord Lionfang. I don't imagine this will be that simple but the fates have been with us so far. Search every room and return to me for further instruction.

quests.name: Secret Of The Death Fog
quests.description: The Golden Onslaught soldiers are not affected by the Death Fog. We have to find out how they are blocking the effect. Search 8 of the soldiers and keep your eyes open for anything unusual.

quests.name: The Key To Survival
quests.description: Every living Golden Onslaught Soldier in here is carrying, somewhere on their person, a Death Fog Protection Amulet. Do what you must to recover at least 4 Amulets.

quests.name: The Tools
quests.description: Archlord Lionfang's field alchemy skills are well known by the Shadowscythe Army. This Death Fog is an interesting creation but we can neutralize the effects with the amulets. I will need several alchemical reagents to chance how they function. Search the tower and bring me 8 alchemical reagents.

quests.name: The Talent
quests.description: The amulets are almost ready to neutralize the effect of the Death Fog for anyone in range, but their power needs to be amplified. Take these to Empress Gravelyn and ask her cast a darkness enchant on them, then bring them back to me.

quests.name: The Local Locale
quests.description: The amulets are fully powered but for them to protect everyone in the area, you will need to place them in four key locations through the tower. I have drawn you a map. Make sure that you have placed all 4 amulets exactly where they need to be and return here.

quests.name: Who Holds The Key?
quests.description: Now that the Death Fog has been neutralized, it is safe for us to free the captives. The key to the dungeon must be around Onslaught Tower somewhere. Search 6 of the soldiers and return if you find anything.

quests.name: Leave No Rug Unturned
quests.description: The key to the dungeon must have been hidden somewhere in the tower by the soldiers. Search every room until you find where the dungeon key is hidden and bring is back here as soon as you can!

quests.name: Tame The Lion
quests.description: Now that you have the key all that remains is freeing the heroes of Battleon and King Alteon. In the name of the Great Truce, in the name of Empress Gravelyn… Archlord Lionfang of the Golden Onslaught must fall!

quests.name: Blood and Ashes
quests.description: First, we need a tincture. A tincture made of blood and ash… of life and death. The blood, you'll get from any of the invading forces. The ash, you'll take from the flames.

quests.name: Drink and Fight
quests.description: Drink the tincture, and you'll feel it changing you. Don't worry, it's only temporary. But while you're under its effects, you'll be able to extract the essence of time from any living thing. You'll need a lot. Go get it.

quests.name: Oooommm
quests.description: I won't lie, this next part is probably gonna suck. Anoint yourself with the Essence of Time. Burn this incense I've made from it. And then meditate - the best place is on these pillows. You're gonna feel a little queasy, and you'll be dizzy for awhile. But… if you're strong enough, it will work.

quests.name: SMASH a Path
quests.description: There are too many of these Shadow creatures for me to think straight! Put them on ice so I can come up with a plan!

quests.name: Cold Open the Portal
quests.description: This "Dragon Gate" of yours seems like it will do the trick. It looks like we'll need to calibrate it to my world. The essence of these Shadow Creatures should do the trick! Bring me the essence of their specific locations and I should be able to pinpoint my Earth.

quests.name: VolcaNO Thank You
quests.description: It looks like Super Death is repeating his Trials from before. We'll have to fight our way through four areas before we get to his Shadow Realm. First up, the Volcano! Take out these Igneous Crabs so we can get a move on!

quests.name: Return to Cinder
quests.description: The Cinder Bender was the boss monster Super Death sent last time! It seems just as dangerous as before! Get ready to SMASH your way through it!

quests.name: Hottica
quests.description: Oh no! It's my Arch Nemesis, Hottica! She has been taken over by Super Death! Do we really have to save her? No, you're right… But don't think I like the idea of saving her!

quests.name: Liquidate Liberate
quests.description: These Slime Collectors have gobbled up these mall patrons! We have to free them! Make sure you don't hit them while you're attacking!

quests.name: Lord of the Mall
quests.description: The Slime Lord upstairs is in complete control of all the Slime monsters in the area. We aren't getting anywhere with him in our way! Take him out so we can free whoever is in that Slime cocoon!

quests.name: Electina
quests.description: The next captive you're going to face is Electina, the Electricity Heroine! She's a force to be reckoned with! I have no doubt you'll be able to break her free of Super Death's control!

quests.name: Carpool Lane
quests.description: Here in Trader Town, it's a complete dump! It's in the future though! At least I hope this is the future and not the present! Things are looking pretty grim! But let's not think about that now! We got Riders coming this way!

quests.name: The BlasterMaster
quests.description: The BlasterMaster looks like a huuuuge pain! Wait… Which one is the BlasterMaster? The big one or the one with the cat mask? Ehh, doesn't matter! Take them both on so we can get into that dome and save another hero!

quests.name: General Smash
quests.description: Uh oh, General Smash is next! He's a hero but he can be a little… "much" at times. Now that he's under Super Death's control, I think I'm just going to stay out of the blast radius! Good luck!

quests.name: Left In-giRuins
