quests.description: Ingiru is such an interesting place! So much history, mystery, and adventure! Not to mention that these frozen mountain tops really put me in my element! This is the final trial before we reach the Shadow Realm! Let's take out these Cave Yeti and get a move on!

quests.name: Rock Me Khali May-eus
quests.description: It's Khali May, Guardian of Ingiru! Someone must have glued her back together or something because we destroyed her last time! Guess we'll just have to SMASH our way through her and see who lies ahead!

quests.name: Charries
quests.description: It just had to be Charries! I don't really care for his whole bunnies-shtick! Like what's so evil about bunnies?! Let's just hurry and beat him up, then get out of here so I don't have to listen to him ramble on and on about all his pet rabbits!

quests.name: Shadow Realm Cleansing
quests.description: First things first, we need to clear out a lot of these Shadow Monsters! Keep fighting until their numbers get small enough to have some breathing room!

quests.name: Forging the Shadow Key
quests.description: It looks like we'll need to make a special Key to get into Super Death's room. Each of the 4 Shadow Monsters in this area should have the parts we need!

quests.name: Charge the Key
quests.description: Go back and fight the Heroes and Villains we already faced and absorb the remaining energy inside them to completely free them from Super Death's control and charge the Shadow Key!

quests.name: Super Death
quests.description: We have to be careful… Super careful! Super Death has powers you couldn't even imagine! I'm pretty sure he even has the power to give himself even more powers! It won't be easy, but we've beaten him before, and with you, we can beat him again!

quests.name: Find Riddrug
quests.description: Head east again, but once you're past the gate, go down into the valley. That's where all the dragons are fighting. There's a Drakel out there who might be willing to help you with the second half of your job.

quests.name: World Wide Web
quests.description: My fellow Arachnids and I are currently constructing a massive web that we hope will one day span across the entire world. This may seem sill to some, but this web would allow every Arachnid in the world to communicate with one another. It would allow us to better understand the world around us with hopes of living in a peaceful society one day. Won't you help us achieve this dream? Collect 4 bundles of Interweb from our enemies: the Dreadspiders!

quests.name: Cocoon of Doom
quests.description: The Toxic Souleaters have been dubbed as such due to their aggressive lifestyle. But as of late, they have become drastically worse. Instead of eating only enough to survive, the Souleaters are now killing for the fun of it. This is not the way Arachnids should act. Wipe out as many Toxic Souleaters as you can and collect 10 Doom Cocoons from their grasp. Only then will they learn that gluttony is NOT the Arachnid way!

quests.name: A Web of Lies
quests.description: Have you seen the Toxic and Burning Souleaters? These Arachnids were once our ally, believe it or not. But then their outlook changed once Gressil took over. He told these spiders a web of lies and convinced them to rebel against the Arachnomancers… and anyone who sided with our kind. Their species grow stronger every day, and we have no choice but to eliminate the Souleaters before things spin out of control. Bring me back 8 Souleater Abdomens so that I may think you accordingly.

quests.name: Tyrantula
quests.description: A long, long time ago, the Arachnids lived together in harmony. We used to make beautiful, symmetric webs that would reflect our peaceful, symmetric lives. But the rise of Gressil changed that. This tyrant tarantula always showed an intense hatred towards the Arachnids and their carefree way of life. He became obsessed with absolute power and eventually destroyed our once peaceful lifestyle. Please, hero, you must defeat Gressil untill he surrenders! Only then can the Arachnids look forward to a promising future once more!

quests.name: Sticky Situation
quests.description: Our war with Gressil has taken a toll on my fellow Arachnomancers and our arachnid allies. Bring me 8 bundles of spider silk from any of the enemy spiders in Twlight, and I can use it to bind their wounds. I'll need the stickiest silk you can find, so it will hold.

quests.name: Understaffed
quests.description: We've gained some allies against Gressil and his loyalists, but they will need to be armed before they can help us fight. Battle Gressil's dreadspiders and confiscate their bone staffs — our new combatants can fight with those.

quests.name: Soul-ar Power
quests.description: Gressil gains power from each soul that his souleaters consume. Defeat the Toxis Souleaters and the Burning Souleaters, and free the souls from their control

quests.name: Insert Brain Pun Here
quests.description: Some Arachnomancers have theorized that Gressil may be keeping his followers loyal via mind control. Collect brain stems from a Dreadspider, a Toxic Souleater and a Burning Souleater. If we compare enough samples we should be able to help us determine if this is true.

quests.name: Soul Food
quests.description: This is not common knowledge, but Gressil himself is a souleater, too. He consumes the souls of each Arachnomancer he kills. Please, defeat him, and free the soul of one of these brave Arachnomancers.

quests.name: A Timely Meating
quests.description: Business was booming awhile ago… but I can't sell what I don't have! I have run completely out of meat, and if I don't get any soon, I will have to close my shop. But, if a certain hero would, like, get me some more, then maybe I can give that certain someone a prime cut in exchange! I need 10 Top Loin Steaks from Safiria's Lycans, 10 Chicken Drumettes from Chaos Chickens, and 10 pieces of Sliced Bacon from wolves on Skullcrusher Mountain. Hurry!

quests.name: Pet Food Delivery
quests.description: Hi there! Say, maybe you can help me out. My delivery of hay from the Farm is late, and all my animal friends are getting hungry. I'd go get it myself, but the last time I left these guys alone, they wandered into town and it took me DAYS to round them up again. I'm not sure exactly where you might find my hay, but I hear that scarecrows are made from bundles of hay… (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop once you have 5 bundles of hay.)

quests.name: Starving Pets
quests.description: This is a disaster! Almost all of my pet supplies have been sent to the pet shop in Swordhaven! I can't leave these guys alone or they'll start eating each other. Could you go get some food for me? 10 Rat Ears would be great, and Yulgar's basement is crawling with Greenrats! (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop once you have all 10 Rat Ears.)

quests.name: Picky Eaters
quests.description: Thanks for the help but things are still insane around here. Some of the pickier eaters won't touch the rat ears. Maybe you could go get some fish from the Zardmen Fishers and River Fishmen by the river. They probably won't give them up without a fight. I think 5 fish will do. (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop once you have all 5 Fish.)

quests.name: Missing Crate
quests.description: Excellent! Now that everyone has a full belly I can concentrate on the missing pets! A crate of trobbles never made it off the delivery ship. I think that Shark Bait, leader of the fishmen, must have the crate on him. You'll find him on the ship in Lolosia! (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with the Trobble Crate.)

quests.name: Wilderness
quests.description: Oh NO! The crate is empty and I have so many orders to fill! Say, could you capture a wild trobble for me? Don't worry, I'll train it…I just need you to catch it for me, The Guru Wetlands are the the only place that I know of around where you can find wild trobbles. (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with the Wild Trobble.)

quests.name: Trobble Bath
quests.description: Ew! This wild trobble has all kinds of sticky swamp goop on him! There is only one thing that I know of that can clean out trobble fur and feathers and that's a slime based shampoo. I'll need 10 jars of Slick Slime. You should be able to find some slimes near the pizza shop in Swordhaven. (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with 10 Jars of Slick Slime.)

quests.name: Home Sick
quests.description: The trobble seems to be dying of homesickness! Deep in the Marsh there is an powerful undead named Soulseeker. His robes will be full of musty swamp spores and fungus that will remind our trobble of home! He's dangerous so I'd bring a few friends, but be quick… the trobble is fading fast! (Return to Aria in the Battleon Pet Shop with the Musty Robes.)

quests.name: Molting to Revive
quests.description: My Dragonlord's berserk state of mind is emanating an aura that is attracting black wyverns. Their presence will make it difficult to contain him, but they seem to be related to the Hollowborn as well. Examining their scales could help us.

quests.name: Dragon's Despair
quests.description: My Dragonlord's mind has been broken by despair, and he is lost in an eternal, mindless rampage. I beg you, please defeat him. It may calm him down, and bring him back to his senses.

quests.name: Studying the Bard
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Bard's rejuvenating composition, O'Carolan's Reel. The Bruise Brothers may have a copy - they've been known to play it on occasion. To fully understand how bards use this ability, try to get some lo-fi recordings of it - from a music pirate, maybe?

quests.name: Studying the Berserker
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Berserker's retaliatory ability, Blood For Blood. Many Horcs are berserkers, so one of them may have what I need - perhaps the Sellsword in /Sandport? Bring back a couple of Rage Potions, too - the Horc Warriors often carry them - so we can truly feel what it's like.

quests.name: Studying the Blood Ancient
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Blood Ancient's life-stealing ability, Regeneration. Sanguine, in Lycan Ridge, has been known to carry a scroll detailing it. Bring back some Vials of O-Negative to practice with, too - Albino Bats are a good source for it.

quests.name: Studying the Blood Titan
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Blood Titan's self-sacrificing skill, Blood Thief. Of course, no one knows more about that than the Blood Titan himself, in East Greenguard Forest! I've heard the trick to this ability's slowing effect involves the venom of spiders. You should be able to find some in the surrounding woods.

quests.name: Studying the DragonSlayer
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the DragonSlayer's Dragon-targeting ability, Bane of Scales. The info I need was recorded by Galanoth himself, but has been stolen by the Red Dragon in Vasalkar lair. To help us understand this skill better, bring me some of the most unbreakable scales you can find from the Draconians there.

quests.name: Studying the Healer
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Healer's iconic restorative ability, Healing Word. While not our ally, the Chaosweaver Cleric in /chaosweb has knowledge of this skill as well. Some Potions of Intellect will help us practice it - you should be able to get some from the Chaosweaver Magi in /ravenloss nearby.

quests.name: Studying the Legendary Hero
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Legendary Hero's devastating attack, Legendary Crater. To gain this knowledge you'll need to visit a different crater - the one that formed when the /comet hit near the Guardian Tower. The monster it brought with it will have what you need.

quests.name: Studying the Mage
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Mage's protective spell, Arcane Shield. This one, you'll have to travel to the Mirror Realm to find - seek out Evil Archmage Brentan in Lightovia Cave. To practice it, we'll need a few good wands, too. Nethermages carry some exceptionally well-made ones - wherever they may be found.

quests.name: Studying the Ninja
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Ninja's stunning skill, Shadowburn. For this one, you'll want to turn to the shadows themselves. Find the Fragment of Doom in the Shadow Void, and you'll get what we seek. We'll need a few Motes of Shadow to really get it right - you should be able to get some from the Shadowfiends nearby.

quests.name: Studying the Ranger
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Ranger's targeting skill, Mark for Death. And where would you learn about this skill but from Death himself? Hunt him down in either /shadowattack or /underrealm. To truly understand this class, we''ll need some gunpowder, too. The best source for that is Pachelbel's Cannons, wherever you may find them.

quests.name: Studying the Rogue
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Rogue's deadly finishing move, Opportunity's Strike. This skill works alongside poison, so in order to fully understand it we'll need some poisoned daggers to practice with. Drow Assassins often carry them. D'wain Jonsen utilizes the poison of a scorpion mixed with the sneakiness of a Rogue - he has the Scroll that you require.

quests.name: Studying the Oracle
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Oracle's unpredictable ability, Group Divination. We will want a few divining crystals as well. Dimensional Crystals work well for this. You can find them in /yasaris and in /whitehole. Sekt in the /fourdpyramid will be holding on to the Scroll containing the Group Divination knowlege.

quests.name: Studying the Thief of Hours
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Thief of Hours' timebending skill, Sonic Piledriver. The data we need has been lost to Lore… but it still exists inside the Cathedral of Time. You'll need to fight the Incarnation of 2016 to find it, though! We'll need a few Spacetime Anomalies to get this one right. Unfortunately, the best source of those is Timewraiths. But you can survive a few of those, right?

quests.name: Studying the Warrior
quests.description: I'm looking for information on the Warrior's defensive stance, On Guard. For this one, you'll need to battle through the Celestial Arena - it's in the possession of the Infernal Warrior. To master this one, we'll want a few good shields as well. Go to /onslaughttower and take them from the Golden Warriors.

quests.name: Gather Flowers
quests.description: As Attar says, if we want Rangda to show herself, we'll need to lure her with the offer of a gift. Flowers of seven forms—this is what she loves the most. Gather some flowers from the bushes nearby… be sure to get a nice mix.

quests.name: Purify the Tuyul
quests.description: We can use my Celestial power to lure Rangda closer. Fight her Tuyul and I will use my power to purify them. You will bring me their purified auras.

quests.name: Give an Offering
quests.description: Kill as many evil spirits as you can manage… hopefully that will help us get Rangda's attention. Then, place this offering for her at the main gate. It's the flowers you plucked before… as well as the auras you helped me purify.

quests.name: Defeat Rangda
quests.description: Rangda is here, and BOY is she mad! Now’s our chance, friend—we’ve got to fight her NOW! We can’t allow her to harm anyone else.

quests.name: Undead Assault (Storyline)
quests.description: The army of the undead swarms the streets of Swordhaven. They are being dropped out of the giant flying castle above the city! Protect the people of Swordhaven by slaying 10 skeletal soldiers.

quests.name: Skull Crusher Mountain (Storyline)
quests.description: The Skeletal Ice Mages are trying to break the castle walls with their ice magic! Give them the cold shoulder… battle Skeletal Ice Mages and bring me back 8 Frozen Bone Heads. Maybe we can use them to put out some fires!

quests.name: The Undead Giant (Storyline)
quests.description: Theundeadarmy of darkness has sent a Undead Giant to smash open the gates of the castle. We are the only means of defense between the undead and the castle. Defeat the Undead Giant before he succeeds and bring me back his Undead Giant's Sword to boost the morale of the townsfolk!

quests.name: Bony Battalion
quests.description: The Undead have overrun DoomWood and are closing in on Lightguard Keep! The bony battalions, led by skeletal sergeants, must be driven back if the town is to stay safe! Bring back proof that you've faced our foes skull-on!

quests.name: Warrior Rez-queue
quests.description: We are not sure where all of the Paladins have disappeared to, but in their absence, the Keep's soldiers have been valiantly battling the Undead! Unfortunately, our warriors are being beaten back, and some have fallen. Please, Hero, rescue them before the Undead can get to the wounded!

quests.name: Bone-tired Backup
quests.description: I've just received word that there is a lone warrior guarding the clearing at the end of the upper-hand path. Waves of Undead are attempting to bury him! Can you help him defend this vital vantage point?

quests.name: Reconnaissance Route
quests.description: Relay messengers from the front have sent word that they have seen our worst nightmare in action. Undead Paladins! Hero, please, to put an end to our fears, make your way SOUTH through the fighting to see if these horrors - perhaps our fallen warriors - have actually had their Light extinguished.

quests.name: Fight Against Shadowed Light
quests.description: We CANNOT leave the animated bodies of our slain in the hands of the Undead. Even if they are fighting against us! Please, Hero, liberate the Undead Paladin. He- he would want to be free!

quests.name: Camouflage: Skelly-Style
quests.description: It has been decided. To easily move behind enemy lines, you will need to go undercover and place a transport rune. To know your enemy, you must BECOME your enemy! Ha! No, we're not going to kill you, Hero. But you will need to make an Undead-costume to feel just like one of those numbskulls.

quests.name: De(ad)ception
quests.description: It's all up to you now, Hero! Now that you're my Undead slave, you have no choice but to serve me! May the Darkness be with you and the Light be never at your back. (Takes place in /doomundead - you must go there to do the quest)

quests.name: Well of Knowledge
quests.description: There is a trial every Celestial must go through. They must visit the Well of Knowledge to find out their purpose. There will be many battles on your quest to locate the Well, so be prepared!

quests.name: Gather the Artifacts
quests.description: The Well does not give its knowledge freely. First, you must gather sacrificial artifacts to activate its power. There should be one representing every creature you've seen in this Realm, as well as one representing the Realm itself.

quests.name: Oh Well, Oh Well Guardian
quests.description: The Well holds one final test. The Well Guardian, a construct created by the Bright One to hold the purpose of every Celestials creation. Prove your worth to it and it shall reveal your purpose to you.

quests.name: Infernal Commands
quests.description: These Infernals are taking commands from Azalith herself. They should know where she is, so let us retrieve intel on her location.

quests.name: Forward Unto Azalith
quests.description: Azalith’s forces will not let us easily approach her. We must fight our way through if we wish to confront her!

quests.name: Azalith Faced
quests.description: There she is! We are not prepared to face her, but we must! Give it your all, Hero!

quests.name: Bright Paladin Presents
quests.description: Welcome to your 15th Anniversary party, Hero! To celebrate 15 years of your epic achievements, victories, and adventures, I have commissioned 4 new weapons for you. But that cake smells SO GOOD… I cannot remember where I put your gifts. Please bring me a slice of cake, a fork, and a bottle of Holy Wasabi (from the Birthday Cake) to help me remember.

quests.name: Soulless Paps
quests.description: I would love to show you inside the Skull Dome, but we have to wade past the Photoghoulphers first! Please go ahead and slay them before they snap pictures of us trying to nap again.

quests.name: Vanquished from the Premises
quests.description: Our dressing room is on the left, past all of the plaque-caked teeth - and the Necroupies that Brain Matter sent to mess with us. Do your bodyguarding thing and shut those sour fans out!

quests.name: Clear Space, Clear Mind
quests.description: Alina and Zhoom are excited to see you again! They are holding out in the dressing room on the far left. While we head there, we should clean up all the trash the Necroupies left behind.

quests.name: Rusty Metal
quests.description: We are going to head over to the Brain Matter's dressing room to ask them to get their fans to stop stalking us. Their dressing room is all the way to the right, but we will need to defeat the Armored Zombies blocking the way.

quests.name: Concert Crush
quests.description: Is that a tidal wave coming towards us? No, it is a crush of Photoghoulphers and Necroupies stampeding towards us! Stop them before they turn us into the DeadPCs!

quests.name: Hashtag Dead Ugly
quests.description: We could not convince Brain Matter to stop their fans from attacking us, so we will have to forge through it during the concert! Please escort our band inside the arena, and keep those Photoghoulphers at bay!

quests.name: Ghoulish Fan Culture
quests.description: The final concert clash is about to start, and we need to get to our stage on the left side of the arena as fast as possible. The Necroupies are already there, so do your bodyguarding thing and kick them out!

quests.name: No Honor Among Rockers
quests.description: Brain Matter is on the second stage, but it looks like Larryn and Bellum are out in the crowd! This could be our chance to make this a clean clash! Go over there and convince them to call their raving fans off of us any way you can!

quests.name: Musical Altercations
quests.description: Look! Brain Matter's drummer and guitarist just hopped off the stage to talk to their fans! Oh, wait, nevermind… they're just coming over here to rearrange our faces. We need you to head over to the right side of the arena to keep them in their lane!

quests.name: Lacking Brain Substance
quests.description: When Brain Matter said 'form up', they meant it extremely literally! They have fused into a giant brain, and sucked us into some kind of neural pocket dimension! The NPCs can not fight during the concert, so we are counting on you to give this massive mind a serious concussion!

quests.name: Undead Invasion
quests.description: Greetings and salutations! The city is overrun with undead. I think the Doom Knight Sepulchure is behind the invasion. (At least that is what he said on the homepage.) They picked the wrong town to mess with! It is time to push them out of the city. Defeat undead minions to earn Slayer Medals. Bring back 20 and I will have your next quest ready for you! (Return to Artix in the Swordhaven Inn with 20 Slayer Medals.)

quests.name: Defend the Gates
quests.description: More undead are trying to push through the front gates. There is a really big one with them too! We need to hold them off. Take some friends with you and defend the bridge at all costs. Defeat the big one and bring back his weapon to boost the morale of the town! (Return to Artix in the Swordhaven Inn with the weapon.)

quests.name: Undead Slaying!
quests.description: If there is one thing all Paladins must be good at, it is slaying the undead! Go to the Graveyard and turn the enemies you find there into nothing more than piles of bones. Bring me 20 Graveyard Tokens to prove your might and I will give your next quest on the path to become a Paladin

quests.name: Evil Must Be Stopped!
quests.description: One of a Paladin's most serious missions is to protect the innocent from evil! Journey to the Marsh and the perils of evil there. Return 2 Marsh Lurker's Eyes to me for your reward.

items_required.name: Marsh Lurker's Eyes x2 (Stacks up to 12)

quests.name: I Heal Good!
quests.description: Paladins must utilize the magical powers of healing in much the same way as Healers themselves do. Search for a werewolf and bring me back his Regenerative Aura to help us learn more about healing.

quests.name: Infernal Destruction
quests.description: You'll need to enter the Infernal Spire to find Aranx. While you look for him, slay as many Infernals as you can find. Each one you take down is one more that does not make it into our realm!

quests.name: Gone Without A Trace
quests.description: You've seen no sign of Aranx? Surely that can't be true! Take a closer look - there must be something in the Spire that will tell us where he went. Search every room… and every infernal you see! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Helzekiel
quests.description: This does not look good! Hero, we must get to him before it's too late! See if you can find one of the leaders of this invasion. They may be able to tell you where he is… though you may need to pound it out of them first.

quests.name: Get the Keys
quests.description: Oh, no! All those feathers and silk we found… they weren't just from Aranx. These beasts have been capturing everyone who has come in here to fight them! We must free them! Wreak vengeance on any infernals you find in here - and see if any of them have the keys to these cells!

quests.name: Free the Captives
quests.description: Quickly, use the keys you found to unlock all of these cells and free the Celestial captives!

quests.name: Energy Needed
quests.description: The Celestials you freed are too weakened to escape - it looks like someone was draining their Celestial Energy! You'll have to get it back. Surely if it has been taken, then these Dungeon Fiends must have it! Once you have recovered a few samples of Celestial Energy, give one to each of the captive Celestials. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Interrogate the Jailer
quests.description: We rescued many people, but there's still been no sign of Aranx! He must be here somewhere. Find Garvodeus the Jailer, the Infernal in control of this dungeon. If anyone has answers, it will be him!

quests.name: Get the Code
quests.description: It looks like we've found the factory where they're creating their Celestial weapon. We have to shut it all down! See if you can get the override code from one of these Fallen Knights - and make sure you destroy every Infernal you see!

quests.name: Enter the Code
quests.description: Now - find the control console, and enter the override code to shut the system down.

quests.name: Smash It Up
quests.description: If we can't override the production machinery, there's only one thing left to do - smash it all to bits! Oh, how I wish I could be there doing this with you!

quests.name: Take out the Overseer
quests.description: The Overseer should be in that room up ahead. Defeating him will make it even more difficult for them to get this system running again.

quests.name: Deposit Depot
quests.description: Dage the Evil needs Obsidian Rocks for his Soul Forge. Collect Obsidian Deposits from lava and fire creatures from all over Lore. When you have 8 Deposits, hand them over to me and I'll craft you Obsidian Rocks. I will pay you well.

quests.name: Souldier
quests.description: Dage needs Undead Legion soldiers to obtain Solidified Souls. Search all over Lore for Undead, zombie, and ghostly monsters that drop Shards of a Soul. After 8 Shards of a Soul have been collected, I will give you Solidefied Souls and a bounty of Gold and Experience.

quests.name: Coliseum Combatants
quests.description: Want Legion Tokens? Fine, UndeadWarriorChampion. I'll give you some… if you can prove your worth. Defeat the combatants of Battleon's Battle Coliseum and bring me their weapons: Lord Brentan's Regal Blade, Roderick's Chaotic Bane, Knight of Thorns' Sword, Platinum of Johann Wryce, and Khai Khaldun's Scimitar. Even when defeated, don't expect these bad boys to give up their weapons willingly. I wouldn't… but then again I'd never let myself be defeated…

quests.name: Beginning the Final
quests.description: MORE Legion Tokens? Someone's greedy. I like that. Here's the deal, UndeadWarriorChampion: defeat Desoloth the Final, and bring me Desoloth's Bane. Oh yes, that is pure evil… but the rotten apple doesn't fall far from the Undead Legion tree…

quests.name: Protect the Plague Sufferers
quests.description: With sick people throughout Pyrewatch Peak, we cannot have monsters roaming the tunnels! Clear them out to protect the plague sufferers, and bring me fire-starting tools from the Lavazards, Caustocrush, and Coal Creepers to help drive the monsters out.

quests.name: Ease the Ill
quests.description: With Embersea's shipment of medicine destroyed, we're entirely out of Feverbane elixir, and we cannot contact Feverfew temple for more, now that the Onslaught has destroyed our signal mirrors. But we CAN make something to ease them… I hope. Bring me 5 Baneberry blossoms from the mountainside, 3 pieces of Wickskin root from Lavazards, 2 vials of Living Lava blood, and 3 lumps of Zard Marrow.

quests.name: Defend Pyrewatch Peak
quests.description: Our worst fears have been realized! The Firestorm Onslaught have flanked the Peak, and are coming at us from the south! Take out 10 of the invaders to buy us time to move the sick!

quests.name: Signal Fire
quests.description: We've GOT to get ahold of Embersea and Feverfew Falls to let them know the Onslaught have reached this far. But those Coalsuckers stole our signal mirrors. Bring me 1 jar of Polish, 1 Cloth, 8 Stand Legs, and 4 Reflectors from the Firestorm invaders and tigers so we can rebuild them.

quests.name: Spreading Like Wildfire
quests.description: Excellent! All the parts to rebuild the mirrors are here. You know what to do - go around to the mirror platforms and rebuild them, then I'll direct the first signal to Feverfew Falls' temple!

quests.name: A Fresh Breath of Life
quests.description: If you are going to subdue Desoloth, we must steal the very air from his lungs. As like calls to like, you must bring me 10 Breaths of Life from the Wind Elementals and Living Air monsters.

quests.name: Where Air You?
quests.description: You have shown yourself skilled by now, Hero, but can you see what isn't there? The very air? Where do you think my temple lies? It is not so obvious. Below the ground, under the sand. If you would understand, seek my temple where dragons cannot fly.

quests.name: Invading Your (Sacred) Space
quests.description: I jest, to be sure, Hero! You could not invade this sacred realm if I had not given you leave to be here. Or… so I thought before Desoloth arrived. HIM, I fear. You… you will help. Collect 10 samples of the air in the indicated Sacred Spaces. You will learn soon enough what it is for.

quests.name: There's Magic Every-Air
quests.description: You see the crystals all around my temple? I store magic in them. But now, now they must be released, and aggressively. It will tinge the magic with your emotion. Break 12 of the crystals on the wall to release their Airther. From the King Crystal, I will need you to waken my Air Spirit Guide.

quests.name: Dragon's Fire Blossom to be Found
quests.description: The fire in his heart must be extinguished, blown out. Wshhht! Like so. But he is strong, so strong. The strongest of all, perhaps. But you, you are stronger, no? As I do, so it will be done. I need Caustic Pollen from Sulfur Imps and you should gather Fire Blossom Petals. Bring them all… to me.

quests.name: The Space Between
quests.description: I seek the space between… between the wicked lies… I tell… my dragons I fear for them! And me. Do not let my fickle, fuddled words confuse you. You must not let Desoloth destroy us all! The Space Between, retrieve it from the Energy Tornado. It is the last physical spell component I need.

quests.name: The Burning Question
quests.description: You must go to Hs'Sakar, High Priest of Fire, and retrieve the formula which will help make this spell complete. Take your time, go slowly, for the road is dangerous. Talk only to him, and once you have your answer, /rest, then make your way back here. Then we shall see what is to become of us all!

quests.name: Visceral Memory
quests.description: ﻿We were made aware of Seabase Undine very recently. It would have remained a secret from us, but there are Shadows Viscera in the /MidnightZone that are very similar to the enemy the Queen tasked us with destroying. If time permits, honored Hero, would you bring me samples?

quests.name: Boneless
quests.description: ﻿﻿The Lightguard's duty is to eradicate the undead. I heard that Necro Adipocere were spotted in the /AbyssalZone of Seabase Undine. Though I hate to bother you, my Paladins have never seen these abominations. If you could bring us specimens, I'll teach them how to combat them.

quests.name: Astral Hanzo Orb Quest
quests.description: If you would reap the rewards of the Blood Hanzo Orb, prove your battle prowess. Spill the blood of Big Jack Sprat, the DreadSpider, Dark Makais, and Rattlebones.

quests.name: The Shadowscythe Needs YOU!
quests.description: You're here for the recruitment drive, eh? Well, thanks for the interest, but we're looking for STRONG heroes. Real tough fighters. We're going to be going up against the Queen's army, you know.

quests.name: Show Me More, Shadow-Noob
quests.description: You did well, but that first round was just to weed out the weak. A real Shadowscythe champion can take on even the toughest Legion and Nation scum - I mean fighters. Right. We're working together now. Defeat the Veterans in the Arena - Legion Fenrir and Carnage!

quests.name: For the Shadowscythe!
quests.description: We weren't expecting anyone to make it this far, but we set up an arena full of the very best Legion and Nation volunteers we could find, just in case. Go kick their Elite butts! Defeat Legion Cannons, Paragons, Minotaur of War and Crag and Bamboozle!

quests.name: Gravelyn Likes Your Style
quests.description: You're showing a lot of potential, Prospect – maybe you're even good enough to become Gravelyn's right-hand Hero! Want to show her what you're made of? Head into the arena and prove yourself by defeating the Shadow Destroyer!!!

quests.name: Shadowscythe Recruits: Embrace the Shadow
quests.description: The Darkness gifted Empress Gravelyn with these Shadow Seals and Gems of Superiority. Each of the Nation warriors in this arena carries a Shadow Seal and each Legion warrior possesses a Gem of Superiority. Best them for a chance to recover 25 seals and 1 Gem, then return to me for your reward!

quests.name: Shadowscythe Loyalty Rewarded
quests.description: Loyal members of the Shadowscythe like you have proven themselves worthy of even greater rewards. Relics of defeated, powerful enemies can be used to create strong magic. Bring me the remains of your defeated foes and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Locate Kezeroth
quests.description: Somewhere there should be a chasm… if we can find THAT, we should find the entrance to where Kezeroth waits.

quests.name: Chronoton Detection
quests.description: We must determine just how long these snow golems have been here. Slay 10 of them to collect the living snow. The chronoton-reading they give off will tell us how long they've existed… and how long this area has lain undisturbed.

quests.name: Core Knowledge
quests.description: The snow golems have lived here for many years. Now we must see how long the area itself has been here. Collect 6 ice cores to test the land's age.

quests.name: Temporal Revelation
quests.description: Use Athon's pocket watch to reveal the chasm. But stand back, we cannot know what could emerge!

quests.name: Before the Darkest Hour
quests.description: We must locate Kezeroth's temple. Once at its entrance, we can begin our descent into darkness. Stay strong, Hero, our quest is only just beginning!

quests.name: Undying Fealty
quests.description: Did someone leave this sword here? It feels.. Unnaturally hungry for souls. I should try feeding it some of these-

quests.name: Defeat the Minions
quests.description: Rangda has not yet appeared, but her minions have! Fight them, and take their tongues. With these, I will "interrogate" them about their Queen's whereabouts.

quests.name: Create a Barrier
quests.description: Take these Spears of Mindbreaking. Dip them in the blood of the Leyak, and then place them in a semi-circle around the main gate. The Leyak won't be able to cross the barrier they create. This will buy us some time, and ensure they cannot harm anyone else.

quests.name: Out of Time
quests.description: The Time Wraiths here exist only to serve as our tools. Several have refused to follow orders and need to be dealt with. Can I trust you to do what needs to be done?

quests.name: Time to Mess with ChronoLords
quests.description: In /portalmazec, there are a group of ChronoLords stationed. To truly prove your worth, go there and face them. Show them the might of the Corrupted Chronomancers!

quests.name: Stealing Augold's Assets
quests.description: Ugh. I may be more successful and reliable than my brother, but I cannot deny his popularity. His success is stealing my customers! Therefore, I have a job for you: sabotage his bank. He keeps two treasure chests near his vault in /battleontown that contain a tremendous amount of gold. I want you to retrieve those chests for me, along with two Chest Keys to help unlock them. You should be able to get the keys from Warden Elfis in /dwarfprison.

quests.name: Extra Protection
quests.description: There's no place I'd rather do business than here in Dreadrock. However, I can't deny that it's a dangerous city. A strong hero such as yourself should be able to provide me with some extra security. *Persuade" some of the Crag and Bamboozles in /Shadowblast Arena to guard my bank vaults. Let them know that they still owe me quite a bit of money…though a little rough-housing wouldn't hurt.

quests.name: Make a Donation
quests.description: While I appreciate the help you've been giving me, nothing is more valuable than a generous donation of gold! You'll find a Donation Receipt in Deathgore's shop - and for a low price, at that. When you're ready to donate, bring it here.

quests.name: More Food
quests.description: We weren't expecting a third mouth a feed, and will need some more food for the journey ahead of us. Will you help us? The goats and wolves have been chaorrupted, but their milk and meat are still fine.

quests.name: Clear the Way
quests.description: We are ready to leave town, but a vicious chaorrupted bear blocks our path! Slay it for us so that we can get to safety.

quests.name: Who Screamed?
quests.description: These woods have an echo - and that makes it hard to tell where that scream came from. We're going to have to check all of the buildings until we find an answer. Start with the Black Knight's cabin - those guys have always seemed kinda sketchy to me.

quests.name: Check the Other Cabin
quests.description: It looks like Shrade's return has awakened a lot of restless spirits in these woods! Check the Dark Makai cabins next, and if you see any of those ghosts, put them to rest.

quests.name: Check the Staff Building
quests.description: Machete slashes… and a torn camp counselor's uniform? Shrade has definitely been here, and it sounds like one of his victims was staff! See what you can find in the Staff Building - and take care of any ghosts you find in there!

quests.name: What are They Looking For?
quests.description: The stolen boat is docked out in the middle of the lake, but it doesn't look like anyone is actually ON it. Maybe they took a dive? Get out to the boat, and then follow the rope down to the bottom of the lake. See what you find.

quests.name: Cysero was Right!
quests.description: Ha! So there ARE fish people at the bottom of Lake Gonnagetcha! Ten points to Cysero. I wonder what clues we can get from THEM? Why don't you "have a chat" with them and see what they offer up.

quests.name: Explore the Black Knight's Cabin
quests.description: The key to the Black Knights cabin! This is all coming full circle. Unlock the cabin door, and then go in and see what you can find in there.

quests.name: Get Through the Mirror
quests.description: We've got to find out what's behind this wall! There's only one problem - that hole is WAY too small for some of us to wriggle through. Smash a bigger hole in the mirror, and then meet me on the other side.

quests.name: Rescue the Campers
quests.description: We've got to get these kids out of here, and fast! Those cultists are sure to have the keys - get them, and then unlock those cages and get the kids to safety!

quests.name: Stop the Ringleader
quests.description: The woman in red seems to be the ringleader here. Once we've stopped her, maybe she can shed some light on what exactly is going on, here… and lead us to Shrade himself.

quests.name: Defeat Shrade!
quests.description: Can you believe it? Shrade is REAL! I mean, I knew this all along, of course. But now we have proof! Now's your chance to be a hero, Hero - and go down in history as the one who ended the threat of Shrade!

quests.name: Revitalize the Camp
quests.description: This would be a great place to take creepy kids who love spooky stories. If this camp were cleaned up just a bit, we could really breathe new life into it. What do you say, Hero?

quests.name: Dorian
quests.description: This isn't our first time sneaking out but, I've never chaperoned you outside of the capital before. Look at you, all bright eyed like the fresh meat that shows up at the knights' training grounds. Let's not go too crazy. How about we chat up someone in town? Look, there's a kid playing outside his house. Try to be casual, treat him like another adult. We're outside the castle so we'll drop formalities. Haha, nervous? You'll get used to it.

quests.name: Hypophrygian
quests.description: Loshe figured out we were from the capital because of how nice our clothes are. The bandits can tell too. That's what I get for taking you shopping. You drag me into a boutique and I get mistaken for being bougie. Let's get rid of these pests discreetly. Them and their dogs. Hmm, I'm getting a bad feeling from this.

quests.name: Ionian
quests.description: We've spent too much time in the village. Loshe said that the shapeshifter had been taken today. If we're fast enough, we can catch up to them in the forest. I wish our maps weren't so outdated. The capital doesn't pay enough attention to remote villages to keep them up to date. And of course, the path is hidden by the foliage. Let's scout ahead carefully, and make note of markers. That way, I won't get executed for losing the Prince in the woods.

quests.name: Lydian
quests.description: Look at these layabouts. The bandits were taking their time, lounging in the woods having a breather. I'll count that as lucky for us. We'll go through them one by one and shake them down for information. You know how I love to pounce on someone with their head in the clouds, or buried in a book. Pay attention if you don't want a scare.

quests.name: Mixolydian
quests.description: Found them! And someone's already rearranged their faces and limbs, ouch. That must have hurt, considering whoever did this also pried open the bars of that cage with their bare hands. The kid escaped, hopefully unscathed. We need to find them before the bats swarm. All this ruckus riled them up. I can see why Astravians don't take vacations to Eridani often. My ears…

quests.name: Hypomixolydian
quests.description: What were the Eridani villagers afraid of? Tripping over the poor kid. I guess there was a real danger of that when they were kicking him. Let's get his side of the story and treat his wounds. In the meantime, could you scout ahead? I'd do it myself but the kid's a hugger. Stay hidden and don't take risks. I'm giving the bandages I was saving for you to the kid.

quests.name: Locrian
quests.description: The bandits up ahead must have sensed that something was wrong. Great, and none of the sleepyheads around us are conscious. Is it too late to wake one of them up to lie about everything being fine? I'll work on that and you can handle the dogs that got sent our way. Hurts to have to fight them. I know Titania would be devastated. He's a real dog lover. Huh? You have a plan? Sure, I'll help you catch some bats.

quests.name: Aeolian
quests.description: Did you just ask the kid to hug me and cry if I tried to leave you behind with them? You know I can't leave weepy kids alone! Including you. I'm not letting you into that cave alone! It'll gobble you up! Don't get me wrong, you got the guts. But, a real fight without me to help you is a lot different from one in a closed arena…Ugh, at least put together a disguise and take them by surprise.

quests.name: Troubadour
quests.description: The Outsider did make it in first! Wow, literally mopped the floor with the bandits. There's more of them on the ground than there is dirt. Hm…She seems angry. I think it's because you're dressed like a bandit. Quick, tell her you're a concerned noble in disguise! That's not really a lie. Ah…made it worse did it? Stall then! Defend yourself, and I'll run over as fast as possible!

quests.name: Fungi for a Fun Guy
quests.description: The antidotes and poisons shrooms offer are endless. I've mastered flowers, but need more in my arsenal to take on the Queen of Monsters. Gather a colony of Monstrous Spores to study. I need at least one spore kept alive for closer inspection.

quests.name: Rose By Any Other Name
quests.description: A foe never expects beauty to pack a punch. I mutated the Treeant's concealed upper branches years ago to sprout roses in hopes of impressing a certain lady druid. After that successful Hero Heart's Day, I saw the power of a Rose's thorns. Take out Bright Treeants and return to me with a bunch and I'll let you in on a Greywhorl family secret.

quests.name: Don't Hold Back
quests.description: The very first opponents you'll encounter in the Arena should be easily manageable for someone of your standing. These Dark Legion Guards, Sergeants, and Gladiators are no more than grunts. Just like rowdy children, this bunch needs to be taught how to behave. Show me what you can do.

quests.name: They Just Won't Learn
quests.description: The next round of warriors are stronger than your typical Legion members; they are the Legion's deadliest malcontents - Paladins, Undead Legends, and Blade Masters who have forgotten what loyalty means. They are a troublesome group, and this isn't the first time they been here. I think they actually enjoy the fighting and pain. Feel free to not show them any mercy. I actually think they prefer it that way too.

quests.name: Test Your Might
quests.description: I am sure Dage would be grateful for your help teaching his wildest warriors discipline. You deserve a reward, and battles against some of the Legion's finest. The stronger your opponents, the more likely it is that they'll have what you need to get new gear from me

quests.name: First Class Entertainment
quests.description: You know, many in the legion already have a miniature assistant to help them out when it comes to getting the Legion Tokens Dage likes so much. Some poor souls don't seem to have one. I usually help out with that. I can't lie, I love a good show. What better way to be entertained than watch someone throw their life away for a few measly tokens? Say, Hero, wanna take part in it? I placed something that belongs to me on the Undead Rider. A brooch. Retrieve my brooch and I will hand you a generous amount of tokens. Sound simple enough?

quests.name: Worthy of the Blade
quests.description: I will teach you the ways of The Blade Master, but I need proof that you can withstand the training. Travel all across Lore and find me the things I need to craft something to serve as an example of your skill. Survive and return in one piece, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Head Hunter
quests.description: A Darkblood colleague of mine has his sights set on you. I mentioned you the last time we met, and he's willing to give his gear to a brother-in-arms. Prove yourself by defeating the Colossal Primarch in /BossChallenge.

quests.name: Gone But not Forgotten
quests.description: The vast majority of the Order might be missing, but they haven't been forgotten! We will honor them whether they are here or not, and to do that, we can't just leave their weaponry lying in the dust or in an enemy's hands. Collect the swords on the ground and the axes that the Undead have looted and return them to me.

quests.name: Hole-y Armor Patching
quests.description: Part of a Paladin's protection comes from their Armor. So you can imagine what happens when they don a hole-y armor - their defenses go down! We need to make sure all the spare armors is in perfect condition. In case they come back. Find me armor-fixing components so the armorers can get to work!

quests.name: Palladinum Paladin Parts
quests.description: There's this substance, Palladinum, known only to our Warriors. We mix it with our Blessed Water to make a coating for weaponry. But I have a feeling that Ectoplasm would do… interesting things to it. I'd like to experiment. Bring me 1 of Blessed Water from the fountain, 2 globs of Ectoplasmic Goo, and 4 beams of light from the windows! (Quest can only be done once per login)

quests.name: Up to the Highest Heights
quests.description: Let's go kill our fright! Our fear of the highest heights! I hear monsters roaring. Up at the atmosphere, come, I will take you there. Let's go… go kill our fright!

quests.name: High-sterical
quests.description: You should laugh in the face of your fears, but for some people, a fear of heights is hardly funny business. They are being mocked by Fear Munchers and Banished Banshees who have no sympathy for them. Collect 6 Fear Muncher teeth and record 4 Banshee wails to prove they'll never mock again.

quests.name: Elevation Sensation
quests.description: As if it were'nt bad enough to be so hig up, Banished Banshee and Cloaked Fiends don't even touch the ground! Can you take them higher, to a place where Terrorkind can see? That it's not right to frighten people, who only want to live their dreams? Elevate 5 Banished Banshee and 5 Cloaked Fiends.

quests.name: Altitude Adjustment
quests.description: These Cloaked Fiends and Abandoned Dollys think their ability to terrify makes them cunning, crafty, and definitely high and mighty. They really need an altitude adjustment! Give 3 Cloaked Fiends and 5 Abandoned Dollys a reality check!

quests.name: Conquer Vertigo
quests.description: It's not easy to be afraid of heights. Think of all the things it prevents a person from doing: climbing mountains, having their bedroom on the second floor, and- if it get REALLY bad- just standing up! For everyone who is afraid of the heights, face Vertigo, and stand up for their fear!

quests.name: Battle Azal
quests.description: You…I know you. YOU are the one who is responsible for THIS! YOU are the one who chained me to this fate. This life. The agony I suffered. I will crush you and use your bones to pick my teeth. Come "hero" you will be the last fight I personally enjoy.

quests.name: Fallen Feathers
quests.description: Well, well. Aranx isn't the only Celestial that Anethyx'o took control of. I recognize the Infernal Pegasi guarding the path to The Bright One's throne. They were guardians that were forcibly transformed. Destroy them. It'll be a mercy.

quests.name: Seven Heavens
quests.description: W-what is this? The Bright Dominions further up the tower are Infernals that reverted back to their Celestial forms. How could this even be possible? Bring them to me. This has to be some sort of joke.

quests.name: Omniscient Judgement
quests.description: We're being spied on. Do you notice that the tower is growing eyes? The Bright One's gaze is upon us, and I rather value my privacy. I don't know why Arthelyn thought that being watched was comforting. Search the tower, and close those eyes.

quests.name: Rapturous Ascent
quests.description: The Infernal Pegasi and Bright Dominions are taking formation. Someone has taken command of them. Clip their wings, break their horns, and shatter their defenses. Drench this tower in black and gold blood.

quests.name: Broken Stoicism
quests.description: There, in front of that golden effigy. That is the Arthelyn of the present. She is nothing more than a fallen husk, puppeted by the greater will of The Bright One. This isn't anything like my Infernals. I can't stand to look at this. Take her down!

quests.name: Bitter Blessing
quests.description: Our confrontation with Anethyx'o nears, and I can tell that they are anticipating us. New Eudae are appearing, caught in between their Celestial and Infernal forms. Free them from The Bright One's will, and bring them silence.

quests.name: Life and Spirits
quests.description: Despite Aranx's plight, his fellow Celestials have chosen to remain loyal to Anethyx'o. The Avatars of Life and Spirits have been sent to take our heads. We will cast them down, and I will revel in their shame.

quests.name: On Your Time
quests.description: I was wondering where the third of the Celestial Avatars was. Only the Avatar of Time remains in our path…and The Bright One's hold on them is stronger than it was with the others. Hmm, you seem incensed. I won't get in your way. Cast this pretender down.

quests.name: Rapid Metanoia
quests.description: The last of the Eudae stand between us and The Bright One's throne. With them gone, Anethyx'o will have no choice but to face our wrath. Come. We will end this on our terms, and free our fates.

quests.name: Filial Impiety
quests.description: I sense that Aranx's transformation into an Infernal is complete. We will defeat him, but The Bright One is our true adversary. Once we fight Aranx to a standstill, you'll meet my maker, and I'll bring my brother back.

quests.name: Journal Entry 1
quests.description: This cell is cramped. You can hear the screams and moans of the other celestials trapped. All of us are aware of one thing. We must suffer until Aranx can arrive. He will surely save us. All we need is to have faith. Until then all we can do is keep the Imps out of our cells.

quests.name: Journal Entry 15
quests.description: They let us out sometimes. While the logic says to attack and escape, we're bound by dampening chains and cuffs. Our magic and our strength are being drained. They tell us this is our new life. They tell us Aranx won't be coming for us. The Hero hasn't come. Do we wait for them? Of course we do. They will come for us. But for now, food is extremely scarce. The Imps are the only source of food. But we have to catch them.

quests.name: Journal Entry 56
quests.description: A chance. There's a chance. A guard was caught off guard. We took it. He looked new. There was hesitation in him. He hesitated in everything, really. That's fine. We took advantage of that hesitation. Odd though, was that a hint of white in its wings? No matter.

quests.name: Journal Entry 77
quests.description: We learned the truth. The Rookie Guard was a Celestial. They dressed him as one of their own and sent him out there as a guard. We…We killed one of our own? And so savagely..so horrendously… Is that why they laughed and didn't interfere that day? What are we doing? We can't be forgiven now. Just eat. Forget. Don't remember. Food will take the mind off things.

quests.name: Journal Entry 151
quests.description: These infernal pests are starting to taste good. Maybe that's just familiarity kicking in. Maybe my mind is trying to make the best out of a situation. It's fine though. The one Celestial on the other side of my cell keeps taking more than his share of food. If he keeps taking more food, things will not look good for him. Doesn't he remember to share? I'm taking him out tonight in the hall when no one's looking.

quests.name: Journal Entry 324
quests.description: The other Celestials seem scared of me. Why? I'm one of them aren't I? Why are they treating me as if I'm some rabid dog. Why do they look at me like that? What are they thinking when they look at me? Oh well. More food for me. I'll have to take it from another Celestial during the night. They aren't sharing their portions.

quests.name: Journal Entry 583
quests.description: I don’t know how long I been here. The only "dates" I have are the number of entries I’ve written. I wonder, is this for myself? Is this for the Hero to find? Is this for proof of the suffering I endured for that Aranx? Why am I writing these? There doesn't seem to be a point in this. There doesn’t seem to be a point in anything anymore. I’m gonna try something risky. There’s a Guard with a hound of some sort with him. I’m gonna try and take them out.

quests.name: Journal Entry 600
quests.description: I don't know where they took me. I was in more chains and I was blindfolded. They had me laying down somewhere. A table? It was something, that's all I can tell now from how long I been here. But the pain I felt. The absolute mortifying pain. Were they clipping my wings? It was like part of me was being chipped away and filled in with something else. I have to leave. I will die here. They aren't going to come for me. Survive. That's all I need to do. Just survive for now. The hounds here are alone and weak. They can be a good meal.

quests.name: Journal Entry 826
quests.description: I can walk out of my cell more freely now than before. The Infernals don't seem to be on guard. In fact they…talk? With me. Like I'm one of their own… Why do I feel so familiar with them? They're telling me things they shouldn't. My wings look darker. Maybe all the dust finally seeped in and started to make them seem darker. Since they don't care, I'll just steal what rations I can from the wandering Celestials.

quests.name: Journal Entry 1000
quests.description: I got into a fight with some of the Infernals. In this state, I lost, of course. But some of their demonic blood got into my open wounds. There's a big change in me. I HAVE to leave tonight. I will leave tonight. I must defeat the Guard Captain in order to make my escape into Dreadrock…

quests.name: Poor Baby
quests.description: MAMA! Y u hurt Mama? *sniff* Make better? Pls Pinkmeat Notfood? (Yara says: Defeat lavarock for the Dragonsboon Ore and Lava Mages for Burnwort. Prick your finger on that stone over there for the “life essence” we need – “sanguis vitae”)

quests.name: FlameTongue's Treasure
quests.description: Baby Dragon not sure you can be trusted to look after him. Prove you can by slaying Uriax, Akriloth and Drakonnan.

quests.name: Dedicated Denial of Resources Attack
quests.description: Gruh, those Horcs. Always watching, waiting for us to let our defenses down. Then BOOM, they'll strike, burn us out of our homes. But not if they've got to focus on feeding themselves! Then we'll be safe for awhile. Take out 7 Vultures, 5 Boars, and 3 Rhisons. That'll keep them out hunting, and not attacking!

quests.name: Trolls of War
quests.description: Eh, you, Hero. You'll appreciate my newest song. I'm sure you've heard it around town. Called "Trolls of War," made to stir these young Trolls into a fightin' mood! Can't play it just now, got no instruments. They're all out for repairs. Can you bring me 7 Drum Leathers from Boars and 10 Vulture Talon Rattles?

quests.name: Gentle Muse, Breathe Life into my Art!
quests.description: A Troll's got to pay his way in this town as long as the Elders are in charge, and there's no way I'd rather do that than play. But all THEY want are gentle songs. And to do that, I need new strings. BAH. Any of the monsters will have what I need. Just bring me back 15 Uncured Harp Strings and I'll owe you a mug of Berry Juice.

quests.name: Fight the Darkness
quests.description: You must find Jinella and Raskar. They are in /Darkoviaforest. On your way, Battle the bats in Darkoviagrave who spy for the Vampires. We cannot take the chance they will reveal our plan.

Bag of Gems Quest Cape's Quest.name: Bag of Gems Quest Cape's Quest

quests.name: Frostval 2020 Collection
quests.description: Have a holly jolly Frostval, hero! We need another crystal for our bag of gems.Bring me a crystal from the Ice Crystals in the /icedungeon zone and I will give you a character page badge to display!

quests.name: Camping Out
quests.description: If we are to spend the night in the Marsh, the first thing we will need is a fire. A fire will provide light and warmth, both of which will assist in keeping the foul marsh creatures at bay while I work. Venture forth into the Marsh and bring back some lumber from the native trees, but beware the foul creatures that call this Marsh home. (Bring back 8 pieces of lumber to complete this quest)

quests.name: Something in the Water
quests.description: The Undead have always been drawn to this Marsh, and no one have ever been able to figure out why. My research, however, suggests that it has something to do with the Marsh Lurkers who make their home here. I suspect that they somehow alter the chemistry of the water to make it poisonous to the living, but irresistable to the Undead. The answer is so close… I just need another 10 Lurker Glands to continue my research. (Return with 10 Lurker Glands to complete this quest)

quests.name: Hair, Tooth and Bone
quests.description: My research is progressing well thus far; however, there are forces that are disrupting my power. Somewhere in this marsh there are three very powerful creatures: a Dark With, and Undead Beserker, and something only known as a Soulseeker. I believe that some form of mystic aura binds these three creatures together. If you can, bring me a sample from each: a lock of hair, a tooth and a finger bone. By studying these items, I hope to define the nature of the force that binds them. (Return with a Witch Hair, Beserker Tooth, and Finger Bone to complete this quest)

quests.name: Ruined Plans
quests.description: An orc named Thrax Ironhide has been searching around the ancient ruins which lie deep within the heart of the marsh. He's got some sort of treasure map that he never lets out of his sight. If you can get his map from him maybe he'll just… go home. Please, stop him before he ruins the… uh… ruins. (Return to Bal Gravestorm in the Marsh with Thrax's Treasure Map.)

quests.name: Unreadable Map
quests.description: That Thrax Ironhide is very clever for an Orc. He actually coded the map so it would be unreadable. To decode his map it would take me ages without the decoder. Can you bring me back the Map Decoder? Thrax never goes anywhere without it… (Bring back the Map Decoder to complete the quest.)

quests.name: BallyCool's Generosity Coins
quests.description: I want to thank you for being such a kind Hero by giving you two free Generosity Coins to spend in the Merge Shop! I left them over by the Frogzard in /Battleontown, so you miiiiight just need to defeat it to get your coins back. Happy Frostval!

quests.name: Diamond Exchange
quests.description: (This quest subject to change)

items_required.name: Dark Makai Sigil x1 (Stacks up to 13)

quests.name: Supplies to Spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: Nulgath requires relics of power. Chaos infests the lands and the chaorrupted items are what he seeks. Bring me a cursed relic of chaos and you can spin my wheel!

quests.name: The Assistant
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many wars. There are unique items from these wars to be found, and I'm interested. Bring me War-Torn Memorabilia from Yulgar's Armor Shop, and you can spin my wheel!

quests.name: Voucher Item: Twin Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says your voucher will get you the "Twin Blade of Nulgath". This weapon is for blade masters. Your enemy will tremble at the mere sight of you dual wielding this weapon. Redeem your purchase here.

quests.name: Bamboozle vs Drudgen
quests.description: Bamboozle says, so this Drudgen got a promotion I hear. I guess it's time I step up my game. I know of another valuable resource if you're willing to act as the muscle. Bring me some Tainted Cores and I'll trade you a chaos item so you can spin the wheel.

quests.name: The Poisonous Deal
quests.description: You want more? More Tainted Gems and Dark Crystal Shards to hoard for Master Nulgath's most desired rewards? Then prove you deserve it. Bring us the Bone Axe, 2 of the Archfiend's Blood Gems, and 30 bags of dirt. Crag loves dirt. Bring them back to us for your reward, and don't you dare complain that it isn't enough! If Master Nulgath wouldn't go easy on you, then why should we?

quests.name: The Refreshing Deal
quests.description: You want more? More gems and totems to hoard for Master Nulgath's most desired rewards? Then prove you deserve it. Bring us the Dragon Bone Hammer, 2 of the Archfiend's Blood Gems, and 30 bags of dirt. Crag loves dirt. Bring them back to us for your reward, and don't you dare complain that it isn't enough! If Master Nulgath wouldn't go easy on you, then why should we?

quests.name: Papers Please
quests.description: Yue said there were strange birds flying around the ship's mast? I'll take a look, but could I ask you for a favor while I make the climb? A rough patch of waves caused the ship to tilt and scatter some of my paperwork. Would you please gather them for me?

quests.name: King and Coral Snakes
quests.description: All hands on deck, we have a situation! Can I get you to help me do a roll call? Read the scroll you helped me put together and check through our ranks of Warriors and Pirates. If there are inconsistencies, then that means you've found a spy.

quests.name: Horizon's Green Flash
quests.description: Our location has been discovered, but we're not sure who exactly is on our tail. We'll head back up to the mast for another look. The owls are still up there and Empress Ai No Miko asked that they be captured.

quests.name: I Can't Touch This
quests.description: I'd be honored to help Drakath, but unfortunately I can't create the enchantment he needs without a body. The life force of living beings can help me become stronger, and luckily this swamp is full of nasty monsters that no one will miss.

quests.name: Nope, Still a Ghost
quests.description: The life force made me stronger, but I still can't interact with the real world yet. The RedDeath Moglins use Boneweed to control the Swamp Wraiths. Collect some and bring it to me. Then grind it to powder and burn it as an incense. Its smoke will help me solidify.

quests.name: First We Need a Beacon...
quests.description: Right, so. The first part of our enchantment will be a spirit beacon - it will draw both Xangs' spirits into the mirror. Purified water is what we need, but all we have is a swamp. If you can find some reasonably clean swamp water, I'll see how my purification spell works on it.

quests.name: Light It Up
quests.description: Now, we need a strong light to combine with the purified water to complete the beacon. The fire leeches here emit a flame that water doesn't douse. Their flame glands should be just what we need.

quests.name: ...Next We Need a Trap
quests.description: Once we've drawn the spirits through the mirror, we need to keep them trapped on the other side. Reddeath Swamp is infested with giant spiders - their webbing would make a good base for such a trap. Make sure it's nice and sticky.

quests.name: For Spirits, Not People
quests.description: Since we're trapping spirits with this enchantment, we'll need to coat the webbing you collected with ectoplasm. You can get some from the Swamp Wraiths, but only bring me the most viscous samples you can find. Otherwise, it won't stick to the webbing.

quests.name: Still Too Fragile
quests.description: This is looking good, but the white twins' spirits are strong, and I'm afraid it won't hold them. Gather some spectral energy from the wraiths in the swamp; that will help me strengthen both the webbing and the spell.

quests.name: Barnabas Castle Quest
quests.description: If you wish to live in a castle like this, you will need to bring me the items I require from the Graveyard: Bony Viking Helm, Tongue of Sprat, Powdered Warrior Heart.

quests.name: Blood Moon Token
quests.description: Sometimes, the only way to defeat your enemy is to BECOME him. Or, as the Pyromancer say, fight fire WITH fire. Bring me a Moon Stone from the Lycan Guard and a vial of Black Blood from the Black Unicorn and I will give you a Blood Moon Token.

quests.name: Blood Moon For Members
quests.description: Sometimes, the only way to defeat your enemy is to BECOME him. Or, as the Pyromancer say, fight fire WITH fire. Bring me a Moon Stone from the Lycan Guard and a vial of Black Blood from the Black Unicorn and I will give you a Blood Moon Token.

quests.name: Sailor of the Celestial Skies
quests.description: 've heard tales o' a legendary pirate who used t' sail through th' celestial realms. I didn' used t' reckon he was real, but his magical trophy sword was found in an icy lich's tomb. Maybe if we follow th' rest o' th' legend, we can find his other treasures. I'll even split it 1:9 wit' ye! I got a trail leadin' t' a demonic warlord at th' helm o' an army in /lostruinswar.

items.name: Celestial Pirate Commander Character Page Badge

quests.name: Jules' Rules of Cool
quests.description: 'Ello, 'ello, 'ero! You! You will be 'aving a fine 'ead of 'air once I'm done with you! But to complete the masterpiece I see taking shape before my eyes, I will need one simple thing. A teeny little leather top 'at adorned with Harpy feathers! Bring me leather from Sky Pirate Draconians and the feathers from Harpies.

quests.name: Warlord of the Hair
quests.description: Surrounded by Warlords, and none of them take care of their 'air! If only I had one Skyguard recruit to take under my wing, to train up as the Warlord of the 'Air, I would be so 'appy! Perhaps I can entice one to train with me, if you will help. I will need to style their 'air into a most becoming fasion. Please bring me the copper from 10 SteamOcto's.

quests.name: Missing Servant
quests.description: Before you venture back to the Cauldron Sisters and Cysero's Forge Kitchen, I need you to find a very special minion of mine. This little imp has gone missing! I tackled her to restrain her…for her own safety…but she escaped. Find her, and bring her to me and I will reward you handsomely.

quests.name: What's for Desert?
quests.description: A Sandsea delicacy is taking the sweet Prickly Pears from Cactus Creepers and combining them with a bushel of Sand Flowers. These flavors complement one another for a tasty and healthy treat! Search the Oasis for 13 Sand Flowers and 3 Prickly Pears that the Cactus Creepers produce so I can cook up a Sandsea favorite!

quests.name: Porter-Inn Steaks
quests.description: Ever had Bupers Camel Steak? It is… an acquired taste… but serves as a Sandsea delicacy. By taking Robust Camel Steak and grilling them with Palm Plant Fronds, you get a unique taste quite unlike anything else. You have to try it! Bring back 8 Bupers Camel Steaks and 7 Palm Plant Fronds while I start preparing the grill.

quests.name: Delectable Desert Desserts
quests.description: My shipment of imported sweets hasn't arrived and I'm running low on ingredients for making desserts. Want to do some traveling? I'll pay you very well if you come back successful! Here's the list of what I need:

quests.name: Oil Spills
quests.description: Gah! I'm desperately low on cooking oils! How can a chef cook without the basics!? Help me out again by fetching the following oils found all over lore:

quests.name: The Scarab Sandwich
quests.description: If there is one food that that best defines the Sandsea, it would be my famous Scarab Sandwich. Most of the ingredients can be found locally but what really makes the sandwich legendary is hard to come by. Here's the recipe… good luck finding the last one!

quests.name: Lore Style Surf and Turf
quests.description: Can't decide between meat or fish as your entree? Why not have the best of both worlds on your plate! The Lore Style Surf and Turf features:

quests.name: The Land of Monsters
quests.description: Monsters have scared away everyone! Explore Terra da Festa and report back to me with your findings. Oh, and bring me a Mapinguiari Foot… for luck!

quests.name: Battle and the Beasts
quests.description: Now that you have seen all the monsters, it is time to beat them up! Defeat two monsters of every type and come back to me when the job is done.

quests.name: Festooned in Feathers
quests.description: The monsters have stolen all the Carnaval Feathers! Collect 12 Carnaval Feathers from the monsters and bring them back to me. Hurry—Carnaval will begin shortly, and we need those fantastic feathers!

quests.name: Mask your Emotions
quests.description: These monsters really want to ruin Carnaval, don't they? We will show them! Beat up the baddies until you find 10 more Carnaval Headdresses. The Terra da Festa dancers need Headdresses to dance down the Sambódromo!

quests.name: Crafting the Carranca
quests.description: Carrancas are wooden sculptures used to ward off evil spirits. So let's make one to scare away all the monsters before Carnaval begins! We will need 5 Pieces of Wood from the Terra Trees, 2 Fangs from the Boiúna, Cuco's Claw for carving, Mulher de Branco's Hair, and a Horse Tail Paint Brush from Mula Sem Cabeça. Good luck!

quests.name: Party Like a BOSS!
quests.description: Carnaval is about to begin! Take the Carranca to the Sambódromo Arch and defeat the beast who is the ultimate party crasher! If you can defeat him, then Carnaval can begin. Best of luck! Battle on, hero!

quests.name: Beat the Dire Groglurk!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Dire Groglurk - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Mutated Void Dragon!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Mutated Void Dragon - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Underbeast!
quests.description: Head to /ravenloss and take on the Underbeast - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Manticore!
quests.description: Head to /venomvaults and take on the Manticore - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat Binky!
quests.description: Head to /doomvault and take on Binky the Unicorn - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Beat the Bracken Kraken!
quests.description: Head to /vampirates and take on the Bracken Kraken - I promise it will be MUCH easier with my help!

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: Do not let these wedding crashers insult Adam… or stop the wedding! Defeat 8 Silver Knights to save the wedding!

quests.name: The Knight is Dark
quests.description: And these battles are full of terror! Defeat 8 Black Knights to make sure the wedding continues!

quests.name: The Most Brutal Battle
quests.description: There is nothing more brutal than an interrupted wedding… and BrutalCorn is ready to make sure Adam and Michelle NEVER get married! Take him down to keep the ceremony going!

quests.name: Ebilcorp Ninja Nightmare
quests.description: Zhoom don't like them ninjas, and neither do the Bridal Party! While the Groomsmen and Bridesmaids defend Adam and Michelle, YOU take down 8 Ebilcorp Ninjas!

quests.name: EbilCorp Drones: On!
quests.description: Chairman Platinum activated his robotic drones! Disassemble 8 drones to make sure he cannot track any of the guests after the wedding!

quests.name: EbilCorp Overshadow(scythe)d
quests.description: Chairman Platinum will stop at nothing to stop the wedding! Defeat 10 Ebilcorp Shadowscythe monsters to thwart the Chairman's plans!

quests.name: Ebilcorp CEOverkill
quests.description: There is NO WAY Chairman Platinum can stop the wedding with you around! Take down the Chairman to keep the wedding running smoothly.

quests.name: Protect the Cake!
quests.description: If the ninjas eat the cake, there will be none for the guests! Slay 12 of the ninjas to ensure there is food at the reception!

quests.name: Bellhop and They Don't Stop
quests.description: These bellhops want to help you check out… permanently! Send 12 of them packing instead!

quests.name: Dork Knight Rising
quests.description: Out of the night, the wyverns rise to attack! Defeat 8 of the Nightwyvern minions and prevent Michelle from being stolen!

quests.name: Iron Hero... RUSTED!
quests.description: The Iron Hero is famous for his meticulous plots. Find the plans to discover his weakness!

quests.name: Crush the Wedding Crasher
quests.description: Iron is strong, but YOU are stronger! Defeat 8 Iron Heroes to crush the wedding crushers once and for all!

quests.name: Hats Off to You
quests.description: Little-known fact: Bellhops get the strength to carry those heavy bags from super-reinforced magical Bellhop hats. Steal 5 hats to increase your power and reduce theirs!

quests.name: This Boss is a Real Drag(on)!
quests.description: Don't give up now, Hero, the wedding is JUST about to continue! Take on the Hotel Manager before he can shut the wedding down!

quests.name: Eye See Victory!
quests.description: They can't hit you if they can't SEE you! Put the lights out for 10 of these Flying Eyeballs!

quests.name: Eye Love Battle
quests.description: Whenever you look at Adam and Michelle, you can see the love in their eyes… and so can these Jimmy "the Eye" Heart! Blind his hatred by gathering 6 of his eye hearts.

quests.name: Groundhorc's Day
quests.description: General Porkon in the Horc Fort has stolen Philip, the weather predicting Groundhog! That pig-headed general doesn't understand that if Philip doesn't at least LOOK at his shadow winter will NEVER END! If you rescue him I can give you one of these GROUNDHORC DAY ONLY seasonal rares! Please go to the Horc Fort and rescue Philip!

Beach Scavenger Zorbak Quest Pet's Quest.name: Beach Scavenger Zorbak Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Scorching Summer Badge
quests.description: If you can't stand the heat… defeat the Solar Elementals! Defeat any Solar Elemental in-game to unlock the Scorching Summer collection chest character page badge.

quests.name: Sneak and Survey
quests.description: The "good" warrior fights his way through the fray making every enemy aware of his might. You are not that empty headed. Reach the end of the Dragon's den but make not a soul aware of our presence.

quests.name: Finding Weakness
quests.description: The Earth Titan's minions will not give up Rivensylth's location willingly. Take this time to learn every creature's weakness so we capitalize on their insecurities.

quests.name: Swiper Yes Swiping
quests.description: A single spider is hard enough to deal with, let their eggs hatch and we have an army on our hands. Go find any expecting Cave Spiders and make our a little easier.

quests.name: Sly Trickster
quests.description: Use the foxes bad rap to your advantage. Cause a little mischief between the Draklets and Mushrooms by beating up one and blaming it on the other.

quests.name: Courage Means Crazy
