quests.description: You chose the evil animal alignment for a reason. You realize that barging in guns ablaze is no way to save Rivensylth. Surprise and destroy Earth Titan Minions until one spills the beans on their leader.

quests.name: Outfox Cave Creepers
quests.description: Rivensylth is near. Now all that stands between us and him are these pesky little Cave Creepers. Clear the path to the dragon.

quests.name: Finding the Dragon
quests.description: Aren't you glad you chose the path of evil? Instead of wasting time embracing nature, we just did what had to be done and now here we are at the very edge of Rivensylth's lair. I'm proud of what we've accomplished - find the stone that will summon Rivensylth.

quests.name: Cut the Rose
quests.description: *grumbles* Just when you think you've finished, there always has to someone else to delay the victory. Avada poses a threat to the continued prosperity of Brightoak and she must be stopped.

quests.name: Dungeons & DOOMFights
quests.description: We're in Dungeons & DoomKnights… the newest of our videogame worlds, and--Oh no! You can see the Death of Games' influence is already starting to creep into our game universe. You'll need to take out all these 8-Bit undead so we can pass through the portal to the next game world.

quests.name: AQ3Destruction
quests.description: Phew! We survived the digital destruction and now we're in… O_O an entirely new world with a whole extra dimension. This must be AdventureQuest 3D… and the disintegration has spread even further. Hurry, kill the 3D monsters so we can get to the next world… FAST!

quests.name: OverSoul Under Attack
quests.description: There are many worlds in our game universe, and many realms and timelines. The Death of Games' corruption is reaching into them ALL! Look at what's happened to the OverSoul. We're running out of time. Slay all the creatures here so we can reach the next portal.

quests.name: HeroSmashed
quests.description: I need a Hero… to SMASH this Death of Games guy in the FACE! Look at what he's done to the world of HeroSmash. Based on how quickly and far the Death of Games' corruption is spreading, we're running out of time. Kill the Riders, Blaster Master, and Super Death so we can reach him.

quests.name: EpicDuel vs DoG
quests.description: This world is WAY too Epic to let the Death of Games destroy it. We can't stop now, or even slow down. Kill the Cyber Hunters and God of War so we can keep moving forward.

quests.name: AQWorlds At Risk
quests.description: It's kind of mindblowing to think that we're HERE in this version of our world at the same time as we're ALSO in the larger game world. But we can't let ourselves get distracted… the disintegration of our world grows worse with each game we travel through. Defeat these iconic AQWorlds monsters so we can reach the Death of Games as quickly as possible!

quests.name: MechQuest For Glory
quests.description: 5,000 years before the DragonFable universe, the MechQuest world was thriving. We CAN restore it to its former glory… but first we have to stop the Death of Games. Take out these mecha, then continue on to the boss fight ahead.

quests.name: DragonFables & Lore
quests.description: O_O The rich world and lore of DragonFable have been almost entirely destroyed by the Death of Games! We're almost out of time! If he disintegrates our game worlds completely… I don't how how we would reboot the servers. We've got to take out the monsters the enemies ahead of us and MOVE MOVE MOVE!

quests.name: AdventureQuest for Victory
quests.description: We've reached as far back into our game universe as we can go… the original AdventureQuest from 2002. We have just a bit farther to go. You can DO THIS, Hero! Don't let the Death of Games become a Deus ex Machina. Take out this last round of enemies and let's get to the final boss fight!

quests.name: Battle On... FOREVER!
quests.description: OMG, the Death of Games just KILLED the AQWORLDS GAME SERVER! Take him down NOW, then we can restore the future of AdventureQuest Worlds.

quests.name: Metamorphosis
quests.description: What? Your Void Beetle General is evolving!

quests.name: Pink-a-licious-Prowl
quests.description: I think Pink Coral is absolutely beautiful, but it sure is hard to come by— specially since I can't breathe underwater. And Amaranth Flowers are sooo gorgeous, sooo pink, and have a unique history: they've been used in Ancient Temple rituals for centuries! Hint: monsters will drop the items… but it's up to you to figure out which ones! Bring me 3 Pink Corals and 5 Amaranth Flowers, and I'll give you 10 Fuchsia Dyes for your hard work. Good luck —I know you can figure it out =D

quests.name: Pink Petal Power!
quests.description: I lovelovelove flower petals! Especially Puce and Rose Petals! But one Chaorrupted spider has stolen ALL the Puce Petals. I wonder what Forest it could be hiding in…? And there's only one monster man enough to carry a Rose, so I bet that's where you can find Rose Petals! Remember: monsters will drop these items…but it's up to you to figure out which ones! Using these hints, bring me Puce Petals and Rose Petals, and I'll give you 5 Magenta Dyes for your hard work. Good luck!

quests.name: Flowers for the Pink Gal
quests.description: Awwweee! You wanna bring me flowers? *blush!* How thoughtful! Some of my favorite are the super hot pink Fandango Flowers and Lotus Flowers. I heard that Fandango Flowers are grown on Cacti while a certain species of spider grows Lotus Flowers on their back. But where to find them? You're ganna have to beat up baddies to find 'em, duh! Bring me 5 Fandango Flowers and 4 Lotus Flowers and I'll reward you with 8 Fuchsia Dyes and 3 Magenta Dyes!

quests.name: Dyeing for a Challenge
quests.description: You ready for a challenge, Member? Carmine is a super-duper bright pink pigment produced by shelled insects. I wonder what creepy crawly you can find Carmine Pigments from? I also LOVE the beautiful Cerise Flower. It's pretty rare and valuable, considering it only grows on 1 type of spooky woodland tree. And last but not least, I want an Anthurium Flower. This jungle flower only grows in tropical regions, so you might have to travel to paradise in order to find one! Remember that all these items can be found from monsters around the world! Good luck =D

quests.name: Dyeing for Gemstones
quests.description: Heya Member, want 50 Fuchsia Dye? Okay… but this quest is a toughie! Have you seen the Garnet Gem? It's a beautiful deep pink gemstone protected by an ancient being. The protector of that stone sure knows how to keep the Garnet a secret! I also want some Spinel Gems. Just like Garnets, ancient guardians protect Spinel Gems. But the baddies who guard Spinels are stone-cold killers—and I hope that they won't ruin you during your hunt! Come back to me when you have obtained 2 Garnet Gems and 6 Spinel Gems! And remember, these items will drop from monsters, so happy hunting and good luck!

quests.name: Frevo's Dancers Need Feathers!
quests.description: Hello! Welcome to Terra de Festa! I have a friend who is in need of some brightly colored Cuco feathers for the Carnaval celebration. Could you gather some and bring them to him? You can find him by heading down the ramp, and then to the left.

quests.name: No Gilding, Only Gelt
quests.description: One of the traditions of our village is to give children a golden branch along with their Frostval gifts. IF they have been good all year. If not, they get silver branches! Hah! But… the Krimplers stole ALL the Frostval branches I'd gilded. Took me DAYS to paint them all. Get them back and I'll reward you handsomely.

quests.name: Belsnicklings be Tricksy
quests.description: My little Belsnicklings are tricksy folks! If they show up at your door, they may toss you candy, but if you're not quick enough to catch it, they'll slash at you with switches! Try your luck, and see which YOU get!

quests.name: Sounds Like Cysero
quests.description: You, there. You're hunting information? Find the strange mage that's hidden himself in the backalleys. He's drawing all the misery eels to him for some mad reason. It's putting the townfolk on edge. As odd a mage as he seems to be, he's bound to have bit of knowledge to help.

quests.name: Calm the Deer
quests.description: Where I'm from, deer are an endangered species. It's extremely important to pay attention to their wellbeing, or else there may be none left. Over in /DeerHunt, the Deer seem scared about something. Can you help calm them down?

quests.name: Carefree Drifters
quests.description: I don't often visit the pedestal's room. It used to teleport the Alutians to the surface so they could hunt crabs, but was broken during the attack so no one could escape. It's not that being here makes me sad, it's just that the room is very haunted. I…can't handle ghosts. I won't be much help if I huddled in the corner screaming my head off. Could I trouble you to help me shoo them away?

quests.name: Bone Bites
quests.description: My herd's gotten loose again. They're what I call Bone Crustaceans, and I've been rearing them ever since I was imprisoned. The Alutians used to keep them as a food source for their young ones. Nowadays, I've been feeding them mineral enriched clay so they won't chew on…what remains of the Alutians. Would you lend a hand wrangling a few? I'll whip you up a meal. Think of it as a consolation prize for coming so far.

quests.name: The Lost Generation
quests.description: The Crustaceans broke into the main Nursery again! It's where the Alutians would keep their eggs safe. After Rheum repelled their invasion of the land, Lord Tremblor was still furious. He wanted us to make sure the Alutians would never invade again. To that end, the warriors of Rheum attacked the city, and crushed the eggs first…Would you please help me clean the eggshells and lead the Crustaceans back into the hall?

quests.name: Tender Temple
quests.description: See the statue in the back wall of the Nursery? That is Lady Neso. It must have been damaged during the invasion. Lord Tremblor would not wish such poor treatment on her visage. I can't restore the statue but I routinely clean it. You'll help? Thank you! Ah, the Jellyfish are becoming agitated. They get that way whenever my mood picks up. We'll need to fight them off so they won't distract us.

quests.name: Cast Away Buds
quests.description: Oh dear, you're guests but I've run you ragged. Come and take a breather in my room. It used to receive visiting parents but I've laid a few blankets down for us to sit on. Just shoo the jellies off, and while you're there, you'll see Ox and his wife, Fraise. Or rather, the dolls I've made of them. Please don't look so alarmed! I only needed a few faces to talk to so I could stay sane. Once we're settled in, I'll finish telling my story.

quests.name: Current Catching
quests.description: Alutea was built where the currents can easily carry you back and forth from the surface. Problem is, our gangly human bodies won't catch the currents as easily as the fins of the Alutians. Ah, of course Captain Rhubarb would know a thing or two about navigation. Then we'll collect the ropes and cloth needed to create his contraption. There should be supplies scattered about the Nursery.

quests.name: Silent Sea
quests.description: Now comes the difficult part. The doors to the outside aren't sealed but everything beyond is underwater. There are Water Elementals that act as guards, stationed here by Lady Neso. They wouldn't attack you but because I am escaping, they will do everything in their power to stop us. We'll need to fight them off and let Rhubarb read the currents. That way, we won't get thrown deeper into the marine trench.

quests.name: Hay! Bale Already!
quests.description: I kept my trap shut because it sounded so silly…but can we go back and take Oxali and Fraise with us? The dolls in my room, I mean. I know I just said we don't have a lot of time but I'm going to weep if I leave them behind! They kept me company so long, I can't just abandon them. What's with that "harharhar!" Rhubarb? But, you'll really go back and get them? Thank you! We'll clear the critters too. They're not happy about me leaving.

quests.name: Abyss to Sun
quests.description: Centuries have passed, the Empire of Rheum has declined, and the Avatars speak to us no more. This will be the first time I will set foot on land in ages. It's time to leave. We must ascend to the highest point in the Nursery, and ride the currents upwards. There is no sign of the last Alutian but the elementals will surely make one last push to drag me down. Let's forge ahead and fight off the elementals.

quests.name: Ebbing Grudges
quests.description: The Alutians used to have long sparkling tails and you could hear their songs as you drifted into the depths. Their remaining child would have no memory of that. Lady Neso tried to soothe their grudges and loneliness by transforming them into a beast that could tear through stone. They were stuck in the ruins as long as I was, and will return if we don't subdue them. We will fight them together, and turn them towards the horizon.

quests.name: Celestial Spoils: Djinn Warrior
quests.description: I promised a merchant in Etherstorm that I would collect the mystical esssence of the elemental spirits here. Help me, and I will share the spoils of my recent wandering.

quests.name: Effervescent Elixir
quests.description: I started working on an elixir that is able to… never mind. You don't need to know. I'll just tell you what to beat up. Defeat some Toxic Souleaters in /Deadmoor, some Infected Scientists in /MoonLab, and an antler from the Zweinichthirsch in /DeerHunt.

items_required.name: Toxic Souleater Venom x10 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: For the Crater Good
quests.description: As you walk closer to the crater, you hear numerous whispers asking you to bring a bunch of items to it. Will you take this mysterious quest? What will happen if you bring the items to the crater?

quests.name: In The Mood
quests.description: First things first, baby! I need to you to go to clear out the forest of some pesky Mood Slimes. They're all pink and rosy until it absorbs you and starts to digest your arms. Bad for tourism. Bring me 5 Mood Slime Rings as proof!

quests.name: Hedge Trimming
quests.description: Don't you think my assistants did a great job decorating the forest? Well not everyone agrees. Especially the Love Shrubs (who also got decorated). Let those bully bushes know that BIG DADDY is in charge now. Bring me 8 Love Twigs to show me the job is done!

quests.name: Bear Hugs
quests.description: The Huggy-Bears have to be the grumpiest residents of the Forest of Infinite Terror. People come here to see huge, warm, fuzzy, cuddly beary-wearkins and they find those guys. If someone doesn't put them in their place, we'll get bad travel reviews! Bring me 4 Tufts of Huggy-Bear Fur to let me know you've shown them the light.

quests.name: Stoopid Kewpid
quests.description: I'm a pretty likable guy, Baby… but there's no pleasing some people. Deep down inside the Wishing Well in the forest lives a guy called Kewpid. He used run the Love business but he couldn't stand up to the competition. Rather than taking defeat like a good sport he tries to ruin a lot of my best laid plans. Go deliver a message to him. Tell him to "take it like a cherub!". Come back when you've defeated him.

quests.name: Empty Fealty
quests.description: I'm surprised your men decided to follow you past Dreadhaven's moat. If I were them, I'd have half a mind to sell you out to the new King for a pardon. But it'd take a lot more than your head for Alteon to forgive their crimes. They don't have a loyal bone in their body, but they're ruthless if nothing else. Track them down and drag a few back. Show me what a Prince is capable of while you're at it.

quests.name: Bitter Sweet-Talker
quests.description: Fancy speech won't get you far living rough like me. That said, it could be handy if you plan to negotiate with your men. What's the word for it? Right, charisma. We'll see if you have any. Try talking to Edward. He's feared by the other bandits. But actually having gold to pay him would sweeten your words. It'll be you and me robbing some nice folks on the road. Take their gold, and show the bandits it's worth it to follow your lead.

quests.name: Fake It Till You Make It
quests.description: It's been a few weeks since we started to toughen you up. We've barely made any progress. Not surprising considering how your pa stunted your growth. Having a soft bed, and harsh words from your own father makes for a bad combination. You'll cut my head off, you say? Tell that to the knights coming our way. A fair number of them used to fight for Dethrix I. Now they're hunting you under Alteon's banner.

quests.name: Decimation
quests.description: Seems like Alteon was more forgiving than we thought. The former Knights of King Dethrix recognized some of their compatriots among the team sent to hunt you. It's putting ideas in their heads. I listened in on a few schemers. Single them out and make an example of them. Royals do know how to put on a show, so go on. Show me how you punish traitors.

quests.name: Warning Beacon
quests.description: Another gaggle of knights are after us. A crook like me is a nuisance to the crown, but you. They'll kill you on sight because of what's in your blood. Just being alive is a threat to the new Kingdom. That'll inspire even the greenest squires to chase your tail. It'll be annoying to constantly be chased night and day. Had that problem myself for a while. So, here's an idea. Follow my lead and force these knights into the Town Hall close by.

quests.name: Strategy and Utility
quests.description: This isn't a smart idea, but there's no use trying to reason once your mind gets set on skinning a fool. Fine fine, I'll go along so you won't die and duck out of your end of the bargain. Reignolds' tower is up ahead. We have a greater advantage in the trees, so have your men make a ruckus to lure his knights out. We'll put a dent in their numbers before letting ourselves in.

quests.name: Runaway
quests.description: The rest of the bandits are uneasy. Reignolds' tower is made of glass like a greenhouse, but it's close to freezing instead of humid. Like I said, we'll be cautious and take a look around. Have the men scout upstairs and in the cellar. If you run into anything, don't go attacking it just yet. We need to know who and what we're dealing with. Reignolds' daughter should be in the building. She might know something.

quests.name: Make-Up Artist
quests.description: I thought it was strange for Reignolds to have so many servants and knights. He's not rich or someone as important as a Duke. Based on what his daughter said, he's skilled at keeping dead things looking fresh. These dull eyed servants aren't barely able to stand because they're tired. They're actually undead. We need to get rid of them before their master starts giving them orders.

quests.name: Piercing the Veil
quests.description: Wasn't the chamber at the top of the tower locked? He's barricaded himself there and it'll take time for the other bandits to break the lock. I wonder if Reignolds can see through the eyes of his undead minions. Calling me paranoid? Paranoia is what's going to keep you alive when I'm gone. Stop scowling, and butcher the undead servants shambling around. It'll be a good warm up before facing Reignolds.

quests.name: Any Means Necessary
quests.description: Lord Reignolds being a snob and coward is what kept us alive. If you want to kill him, focus. Don't get distracted and don't lose your head. Desperation drives men wild. At worst, Reignolds won't see a way out of this and decide he'll jump into death's waiting arms. Drakath, you have to survive. Prioritize your survival above all else. Don't let that mage take you down with him.

quests.name: Pay the Piper
quests.description: Hey, yo, you can't expect me to provide my services without being paid! There's a gang of lin kuei - shadowy assassins - living in the forest near my pad. I bet they have some money you can "borrow".

quests.name: Pieces of Pipes
quests.description: There may be one more tiny little problem. I don't actually have my bagpipes! I took them apart to clean and oil them, and those naughty little Lingzhi and Xingzhi stole all the pieces. Maybe you can find them and bring them back to me?

quests.name: Oil it up
quests.description: Nah, man… I'm not ready to go just yet. I still have to oil my bagpipes, remember? Unfortunately, those nasty sprites spilled my stash of bamboo oil when they stole my pipes. You can get me some more from the wandering Bamboo Treeants.

quests.name: Get Me an Audience
quests.description: What musician can perform without an audience? Get out there and talk to everyone you can find in Akiba. Tell them to get ready for the best piping they've ever heard! Here, I've even written you a helpful script to use!

quests.name: Meet Me at the Palace
quests.description: So were they excited? Man, I can't wait for this! Meet me in front of the palace, okay? I'll be right there.

quests.name: Bitterfrost Dragon's Treasure
quests.description: To unlock the Fangs of Bitterfrost polearm, you must recover the Gilded Claws and Fangs from his eons-old ancestor, Frostfang! Slay the Snow Golems in the Northlands for Gilded Claws and Water Draconians for Gilded Fangs in Kingcoal to recover them!

quests.name: Stop the Juice Thieves
quests.description: Those goshdarn Dark Makai keep stealing all my Moglinberry Juice, and now the tap's running dry! Go into the cellar and get rid of all those juice thieves, would you?

quests.name: Special Lunch
quests.description: What? You came here for LUNCH? That's too bad, because I just ran out of, like, EVERYTHING. But if you bring me some ingredients, I'll make my special bento box for you! Get me some Moglinberries - you can steal them back from those Dark Makai. And I'll need some Sour Apples from those Mean Old Treeants. And, last but not least, one of the Juice Boxes that the Drakel Bandits carry!

quests.name: Practice makes Perfect Bottle
quests.description: So you wanna help me find a Perfect Bottle, huh? It ain't ganna be easy— they don't call it *perfect* for nothing. William Picket over there has a Perfect Bottle for barter, but will only trade it for 100 Broken Bottles that have been thrown away. It's ridiculous, I know, but if you need my help, I need yours first. Search through enough Trash Cans until you find 100 Broken Bottles and trade them in for William Picket's Perfect Bottle. But if you're lucky enough, you might even find a Perfect Bottle amongst the trash…

quests.name: Thistle Do Nicely
quests.description: Owing pets is a big responsibility. You have to care for them, play with them, clean up after them, and remember to feed them! My lovely companions are running low on food but I certainly can't leave my shop… But you look good and able to! The Seed Spitters in the area feed off the Thistles that my pets absolutely love. Retrieve 5 thistles from those carnivorous plants and I'll award you greatly!

quests.name: Pleased to Meat You
quests.description: My pets have a very delicate palate. They enjoy a wide variety of fodder from thistle to yogurt and even Gorillaphant meat. Since you did such a great job before… I bet you will have no problem bringing back 8 Lore-Strip Gorillaphant Steaks. You know where to find them…

quests.name: Miraculous Reunion
quests.description: "Our Hero's friends split up, moving quickly to look for more of those suspicious gifts." Why don't you cover the courtyard? Talk to the guests there, and tell them about the situation. As for the Vaughn Knights…They want to spar? What, like, now?

quests.name: Emergency Management
quests.description: "Galanoth gathered a team to search the west wing of Castle Whistler, but they ran into some trouble." House Granville's Knights are keeping Artix and a kid named Hans from helping with the search. They're being rather mean, so be mean right back.

quests.name: Noble Character
quests.description: "The hosts of the Frostval Gala acted quickly and efficiently, ignoring the complaints of their peers." Lady Song and Lord Henry are taking care of the east wing. Let's ask if they need another pair of hands. Those Noelle Knights need some directions, too.

items_required.name: Talk to Lady Song and Lord Henry

quests.name: Breaking Bread
quests.description: "It was almost over. The guests had been escorted to safety. All that was left were the stray gifts." There should only be a couple left. Be on the lookout, because your friends are looking for you. Tara and Serenity are over there, excited to chat.

quests.name: The Poacher and the Stag
quests.description: "Just as our Hero was about to enter the parlor, the Vaughn Knights and Granville Knights started to squabble. Petty fights waste so much time, but breaking them up wouldn't take long." Are you on peacekeeping duty? Man, you have to do everything around here. It's a lot of work being so reliable.

quests.name: Knights Unsung
quests.description: "Those who were struck by the Queen's doomed arrows rose as her Unsung Knights. They glared at our Hero with deep hatred, and readied their blades." You'll have to fight them, but "our Hero will defeat them quickly and easily."

quests.name: Silver Spoon Fed
quests.description: "The Unsung claims its partner, and the Queen's Nobles are hunted like stray sheep. Our Hero courageously shields them from the arrows, saving their lives-" But it'd be nice if they could flee in the right direction. You'll have to give them hints.

quests.name: Like-Minded Enemies
quests.description: "Galanoth was recovering from the Unsung Queen's barrage of arrows, but he was surrounded by Beasts." I got winded tweaking his lines, so could you save him the old-fashioned way? We both know Galanoth's hardy, but let's make sure he's okay.

quests.name: Heroic Entrance
quests.description: "Sensing our Hero's approach. The Unsung Knights and Beasts formed a wall, blocking them off from the balcony. Our Hero charged, ramming through them with gusto!" Go ahead! Put your whole body into it!

quests.name: I'm With You in the Dark
quests.description: "The Unsung's Queen turns towards our Hero as the doors fly open. They made it just in time. She nocks another arrow, and aims it at their neck." She'll attempt to fly away. Do everything you can to keep her here!

quests.name: Quench the Flames
quests.description: The Onslaught has invaded the temple and kidnapped the sick! And many who weren't. We cannot stand for this, but… we are priests and mages, not warriors. We need your help to drive out the Firestorm.

quests.name: Through Fog and Flame
quests.description: I… I don't feel so well. This fog… it's making me so dizzy. If we're going to save the temple, you've got to dispell the fog. I can cast a spell to disperse it, but I'll need a Dispersion Draught. I keep them inside the locked chest in the armory. Bring it back to me!

quests.name: Restore the Lady of Waters
quests.description: Those heathens - those CRETINS - they shattered the our statue of Mother of Waters! She who gives life… has been demolished. Some of the monsters ran away with the pieces, but others are lying around. Please, find them so we can rebuild it!

quests.name: Rumors and Smoke
quests.description: When they attacked, they were in and out as fast as a brushfire. They hit us, grabbed our people, and left. We MUST get them back; the SeaSinger knows what will be done to them! See what you can learn from the monsters here. You may also find helpful information in the scrolls. I hope.

quests.name: Dam the Flood
quests.description: You will need to go, I know, but before you do, I beseech you - help us defend what's left of the temple before the Onslaught returns! Board up the windows and doors where you can, and I will begin casting the defense spells.

quests.name: Salvage Mission
quests.description: We can't know for certain the monsters were telling us the truth about where our people are. But if you bring me items they're drops, I can use them as Location Keys. .. as long as we can recover the Locatrix Animus. It must be on the floor around here somewhere!

quests.name: Fear the Fog
quests.description: The fog has returned! We need to dispell it again. It's stronger this time. I can feel myself succumbing faster! I am out of prepared Dispersion Draught, but I should be able to make more. Bring me the ingredients on this list.

quests.name: Where There's Smoke...
quests.description: Good! That worked as well as I'd hoped. NOW we need to burn out the mage casting this! There has got to be a mage working for the Firestorm nearby. Find him, and we'll finish this!

quests.name: Firin' This Guy
quests.description: Defeat the Blazebinder to prevent him from sending more poisonous fog into the temple!

quests.name: Blessings of the Lady
quests.description: I am surprised the latest offerings to the Lady survived the attack. Take them with you, please, I'm sure she'd want you to have them fuel your search!

quests.name: Parting the Waters
quests.description: If you're going to leave - and you must - the best way is through the Deadsea Caverns. To enter them, though, I must raise the waters. I'll need the following items in order to cast the spell.

quests.name: The Power to Heal
quests.description: This temple is known for the power of its healing medicines. Before you go, will you help us restock? It will also let you take some with you, for the kidnapped. Bring me the Herbalist Manual from the Locked Chest, take the Saltwater Powder from the Vase nears the Statue, and get 2 bottles of Undine Effluvia.

quests.name: The Deadsea Caverns
quests.description: To reach the exit and start you on the journey to Phoenixrise Gate, we need to pass through the Deadsea Caverns. It is dangerous, but not more than you can handle. I know that with you by my side, taking out monsters, we will be safe.

quests.name: Open the Floodgates
quests.description: To take down the shield over the exit, we'll need to work together. I'll activate the spell, and then you'll need to complete the sequences to trigger the key.

quests.name: Tiger, Tiger Burning Bright
quests.description: The only thing standing between you and rescuing our people is THAT furry behemoth. Take him down and go get our people!!

quests.name: Stuff for Dummies
quests.description: First things first, friend - Kyger is going to need some target dummies to practice on! You will need to gather some wood from the local treeants, and a few clumps of dry grass.

quests.name: Build the Dummies
quests.description: I have marked out some good spots for Kyger's target dummies with my ghostly energy. Build them where you see the glowing arrows, and then clear out the monsters in the area so it will be safe.

quests.name: Battle the Dummies
quests.description: It is time for Kyger to learn to fight! Make sure Kyger is at your side, and fight the target dummies so he can help and learn.

quests.name: Lesson 1: Bravery
quests.description: Now it is time for Kyger's first real lesson - a hero must be BRAVE. Take him with you and fight some slimes so that he can build his courage.

quests.name: Lesson 2: Armor
quests.description: Now that Kyger is starting to fight, he is going to need some protection. If you fight the monsters in these woods, you are sure to find some armor they stole from fallen adventurers!

quests.name: Lesson 3: Protection
quests.description: Kyger is well protected now, so I think it is time for something a little more challenging. Help him fight some Crypthackers. It will be good for him to hone his skills while protecting his people.

quests.name: Lesson 4: Gather Intelligence
quests.description: You found something interesting on one of those Crypthackers. It looks like there may be a hidden nest of undead somewhere in this forest! See if you can find any more clues on the other Deadtech in the area. Maybe we can find out where it is.

quests.name: Lesson 5: Demolition
quests.description: I think I might know where those undead are hiding out. But you will need to be prepared! Gather some acidic ooze from the local slimes, and some pieces of explosive tech from the NecroDrones. We will use them to build an undead-slaying bomb.

quests.name: Lesson 6: Searching
quests.description: You will find the undead in a cave in the western part of the forest, hidden behind thick shrubbery. Search the woods until you find it.

quests.name: Never Give Up
quests.description: It is time! Help Kyger test his skills against Sir Kut. Fighting a former Pactagonal Knight will give him the confidence he needs to defeat the High Technolich. Remember, never give up… and BATTLE ON!

quests.name: Moglin Popsicles
quests.description: Blizzy is grateful that you saved him from Frosty…but his friends…are in trouble! They were captured by someone…or something…and encased in ice, like a moglin popsicle! Please free the other 8 moglins that live in this town and bring them back safe.

quests.name: Crystal Spiders
quests.description: Wow, you are very strong! Thank you for saving Blizzy's friends! Did you see the scary spiders? They just started lurking in the cave…with their hungry eyes…and who knows when they may attack Frostvale! Please get rid of as many spiders as you can inside the cave. Bring Blizzy back 6 ice spider legs as proof of their extermination.

quests.name: Fluffy Bears
quests.description: My friends that were rescued are still very cold from the ice they were trapped in. There are polar bears in the cave that have warm fluffy fur. My friends will be able to make blankets with their fur. The bears have so much fur they won't miss some! The thing is…they won't give the fur without a fight. Can you bring Blizzy 3 patches of fur from the Polar Bears?

quests.name: Blue Eyed Beast
quests.description: Oh no! A FROST DRAGON? That's how my friends were captured! Blizzy did hear that Frost Dragons can be…moglactose intolerant. Please get rid of this beast! We want to go back to our peaceful lives and celebrate our big winter tradition again! Bring Blizzy back a scale from the Frost Dragon. This will be your proof that you have defeated the dragon and will be known as a great Hero! You might want to bring some friends.

quests.name: Blood of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if a low key occupation is more your style. Lightly armored, Blood Voids are a hunter breed in my army. They hide in the shadows and stalk their prey, attacking the enemy where they least expect it. They are unscrupulous but very skilled assassins of my legion.

quests.name: BloodKnight Void Guards
quests.description: Nulgath the ArchFiend's BloodVoid Knights are used to hunt his unluckiest prey. They hide in the shadows, waiting until just the right moment to strike in his name. Take out 13 Legion Spies in the /ArchPortal and you can choose one of his guards to watch over your house.

quests.name: Memory #4 - Clear the Snow
quests.description: This terrible monster is making it snow so much, it's covered our entire village! It will take us awhile to unbury all of our houses. But maybe you could help some of our residents crawl back out? Look for the little snow piles, some of them are bound to be hiding someone who needs our help!

quests.name: Memory #4 - Fend off the Fiends
quests.description: This terrible frozen warlock is sending his frosty fiends down to destroy us! Please, help us fight them off!

quests.name: Memory #4 - The Frozen Warlock
quests.description: Hurry, friends! We must attack this Frozen Warlock now! Let me know when you're ready, and I will take you to his cave.

quests.name: Hear No Evil
quests.description: Ooooh man, Hero. That music is KICKIN' but… something feels off to me. Maybe it's the dehydration or con rot, but I've got a baaaaaaaaddddd feeling about this music. Turn off the speakers, and we'll see if that helps.

quests.name: Safe and (No) Sound
quests.description: The music is quieter now, but the band's still playing. I can feel the effect, but less now. That MUST mean it's the MUSIC affecting me. And look at the little dracs! They don't look so good… kind of hypnotized and… glowing? Glowing is NEVER EVER GOOD. You've got to put them to sleep so they can't listen to the music!

quests.name: Through the Fire and Bones
quests.description: OH MAN! I think the band realized who turned the music down. Looks like you're about to be dragon FORCED into leaving the con early.

quests.name: Re-Stolen Keys
quests.description: You'll need to close the gate behind you to prevent more chaorrupted enemies from getting in. Unfortunately, these chaorrupted rogues have stolen the gate keys. Get them back so we can lock the gate.

quests.name: Reagents of Chaos
quests.description: The chaorrupted mages on the bridge are channeling a spell that's preventing the gate from locking. If you destroy the reagents they are carrying, the spell will be broken and we'll be able to close off this bridge from our enemies.

quests.name: Conscripted Chaorruption
quests.description: The chaos warriors on the bridge seem to have chaorrupted the locking mechanisms of this gate. When they are killed, their chaos energy should disperse, allowing us to lock the gate and secure the bridge.

quests.name: Tools of Chaos
quests.description: Rogues again! It looks like they've set a trap that will go off if we try to close the gate. Defeat the chaorrupted rogues, and take any rogues' tools you find. With them, we should be able to disarm the trap.

quests.name: Disarmingly Roguish
quests.description: Now that you've got a full set of rogues' tools, we should be able to move forward. Use the tools to disarm the trap the rogues have set, and we'll be able to close and lock this gate.

quests.name: Dock Blocked
quests.description: It looks like our enemies have formed a blockade on this bridge. A wall of skulls, and a magical barrier protecting it. Before you can continue, you'll need to defeat the mages and destroy their barrier.

quests.name: Skull Smashing
quests.description: With the magical barrier gone, you should be able to destroy the blockade of skulls. Quickly! Our empress is waiting!

quests.name: Destroy Chaorruption
quests.description: Shadowfall is under attack by…what is that thing? It looks like a manifestation of chaorruption itself! Neither Shadowfall nor Empress Gravelyn will be safe until that abomination is defeated!

quests.name: Bonefire Wolf's House Quest
quests.description: Dage the Evil enchanted this undead werewolf to accompany you into battle. Complete its quest to defeat a Legion Gladiator in the /legionarena map and you'll be rewarded with a house complete with in-home bank functionality.

quests.name: Dage's 2021 Collection Quest
quests.description: Dage the Evil enchanted this undead werewolf to accompany you into battle. Complete its quest to defeat a Legion Gladiator in the /legionarena map and you'll be rewarded with a house (with in-home bank functionality) and an exclusive character page badge!

quests.name: It Pays To Be Prepared!
quests.description: Ye noticed the Scoundrels along the beach? Those thieves have their pockets bursting with stolen silver. I need you te go and liberate it from them. Bring it back here, and use our anvil te smelt it down. We'll turn it into bullets for our rifles, and blades for our cutlasses! We ARE about te be fighting werewolves, after all! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: A Bit O' Protein
quests.description: Some of our crew be feelin' a bit under the weather. They'd feel better with a bit o' blood in their systems! Would you mind sharing some of yours? No? Thought not. Alright then, collect it from the wild boars instead.

quests.name: Meals on Wheels
quests.description: Now that ye've got the crew's meals collected… would ye mind delivering it to them, too? Ye'll be findin' them aboard my ship. Don't worry, they won't hurt ye - they know ye're mine now.

quests.name: Decoratin' Time!
quests.description: The Black Veil's crew likes to get into a celebratory mood for the Midnight Crown "competition". And that means decorations! First, I need ye te collect some empty bottles from the rapscallions along the beach. Bring 'em back here, and I'll tell ye what comes next.

quests.name: Catch Some Fireflies
quests.description: Now, I need you to go into the woods and collect some fireflies… then, come back here, and help me hang up our decor!

quests.name: Black Veil Courier Service
quests.description: I be havin' one more task for ye. Go into the woods, and pick a bouquet of nasturtium - they're the small, orange flowers growing low to the ground. Then, bring it to Flintfang, as a gift from me.

quests.name: Security Breach
quests.description: So if wes wants to steal that Spaceship, wes needs to take out surveillance in the area. There be lotsa Robo Guards ‘nd Security Cams yuh can destroy, Boss!

quests.name: No Sniffin’ Around
quests.description: Boss, wes started boarding up doors ‘nd windows, but wes tired. Wes no wants anyone to sees us stealin’ that Spaceship, so wes needs yuh to finish the job. Destroy 5 Robo Dogs so theys don’t be sniffin’ around.

quests.name: Key to Winning
quests.description: Now alls wes need is to find the Spaceship Key! We no knows who has the Key, but wes thinks it be somewhere in this area! Find the Key, Boss!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Book One
quests.description: You open the book and read a story about a great hero going on a long journey. They went along and deflated many Togs everywhere, and defeated many Forest Furys in order to make potions. Then, the hero stormed a fiery fortress and defeated Drakonnan, with his power over the Fire Orb. After skipping some pages, you read about a Dragon Drakath?

quests.name: Gather SwagBucks
quests.description: Swaggy's gone. He rode off into the sunset with that walking bag of bones. You like his place? Good. I don't. I'm sittin' here figuring out where I want to go next, now that I'm out of a job. I need to fund a trip to someplace exotic. You bring me things I can use, I give you things you want.

quests.name: Time is Money
quests.description: … Silly mortal, did you really think I would just… HAND OVER such valuable objects to you just because you had gotten me from Master Archfiend? That's not how this will work. Gorequireacquire the things I need first. To give you such value, I need objects to do the summoning first.

quests.name: Twin Blade
quests.description: …What? Don't… don't tell me you actually think you deserve a copy of myself to wield as a weapon. YOU? Wield ME? You don't have enough power to do that, Lowly Minion, but I might as well let you try and fail until you get it in your head. Collect me a few things from this land as well as a gem from an ugly fish who goes by the name of Kuro. You can find that…monstrosity living in the /river.

quests.name: New Worlds, New Opportunities
quests.description: Oooh, What an interesting realm my Master found. This land is rich in jewels you would find in..Nevermind that. Bring me some things I want to examine from this world. Maybe I'll hand over some of the things you people consider "valuable" Don't worry I'll tell you where to find these things for me. The Horns on the helmet adorned by the Cyclops Warlord in /faerie should do. The rest I'm sure you can figure it out.

quests.name: Identical Copies
quests.description: Wait, you're seriously called a "hero" in this dimension? HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! With THAT toothpick of a weapon?! And looking like THAT? AAAAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! Oh, you poor soul. I will help you, yes I will. Do you want my help? Yes, of course you do. Bring me these things I require from your world and we'll make a copy of myself that will make sure you do not embarass yourself. One of those time Travel Fairies in the /timevoid has a thing I need as well. Go fetch it for me. You'll know it when you get it.

quests.name: Beauty Comes At a Price
quests.description: The first vict- I mean naughty-doer is Scarletta. It shouldn't surprise you, should it? With everything she's done for eternal beauty, she deserves what's coming to her. Even though she technically did pay for it in the end, I think it's good to revisit her to make sure she's learned her lesson, don't you think?

quests.name: Bloody Skulls
quests.description: Skulls. SkullsskullsskullsSKULLS! Oh. Hello there, "Hero" Would you like to know the next person on our list? I think my screaming made it obvious but in case you didn't catch on, it's that overly grown skeleton, Vordred. Is he even a skeleton? We never have seen what he looks like under the armor… Or have you? I wonder what he looks like it we..removed some. One by one. Do you think it would hurt him? Would he.. cry about it like the souls inside those bones do? Let's see how long it takes. I wanna enjoy this. I heard you can find him inside /epicvordred.

quests.name: Making The World a Cleaner Place
quests.description: Welcome back, my super sidekick! As enticing as it is to make the villains pay for being NAUGHTY, we must bring joy to the GOOD boys and girls in the world that may be less fortunate than us too! Here, I have a bag of freshly made candy that you can hand out in the /twilightslums to those nasty monsters - that'll make them NICER!

quests.name: Big and Deadly
quests.description: Our next big target is REALLY big so make sure to grab your biggest axe! It says here any who enter the titan are doomed to become part of it. But that's exactly what we need to do. We're here for Dakka the Dire Dragon. We'll show him size doesn't mean everything! Let's head to /treetitanbattle and have some fun! Not sure what I mean? Better head to the /livingdungeon first then.

quests.name: A Hunting We Will Go
quests.description: Ya know, after tortu- I mean, insisting Dakka plays nice, we should explore some spoooooky forests new adventurers probably find themselves in. I heard there's a Lich in the forests of Darkovia who preys on INNOCENT SOULS! How do I know that? He wouldn't be decorated in so many skulls if it weren't true! If you listen reaaaalllyyyy closely, you can even hear them cry out in pain and agony! Let's go pay The Lich of the Stone in /darkoviaforest a visit and see who we can help.

quests.name: Returning to Oblivion
quests.description: Ya know, I always wondered something. When people say the word "oblivion", what do they really mean? It can have so many meanings but everyone comes to the understanding. Some, not all, but some of the void creatures chose to throw their humanity away to become monsters. I say we return them to their oblivion. Shall we take a trip to the /underworld and really dish out punishment to the wicked? I won't be satisfied until they are completely broken.

quests.name: Both Sides are Guilty
quests.description: Now that a small fraction of the Void has been dealt with, we must look at the Legion with the small magnifying glass! They too have nasty, awful followers who follow their Master's every whim. Have you SEEN what Dage has caused on the islands of Fotia?! In fact, I know 3 specific beings I can have a small "talking to". Let us make way to /judgement and have a talk with them.

quests.name: Bait and Switch
quests.description: Ya know, I never did like the royalty type. Don't worry we aren't going to mess with the Swordhaven family. Not at this time anyway. No, this time we're finding a fake little princess. Creatures who use a visage of a princess to lure in unsuspecting heroes to be. Let's go get us a "princess" inside the /doomvault.

quests.name: What Chaos Touches, We Destroy
quests.description: Our next location is deep inside the /orecavern. I'm sure you know what Chaos has done to the lands, what creatures have transformed into. Let us go take a visit to the Naga Baas, I heard she causes the local creatures trouble. What? We can save the animals too.

quests.name: A Finale to Remember
quests.description: Wowie zowie, I can't believe we're almost done! The last big baddie that needs to face punishment is Lionfang himself. The man so righteous with good intention, he will do any evil to continue his path. How selfish, how arrogant. This one needs to be taught a lesson - go hunt him down in /stormtemple.

quests.name: Retrieve Void Auras
quests.description: The Necrotic Sword of Doom requires many pieces, and many steps. In order to begin, you will need to learn the creation of Void Aura. Bring me 20 essences from each of the following monsters:

quests.name: Gathering Unstable Essences
quests.description: Throughout Lore, you may encounter rare, unnatural creatures whose existence itself should not be. Since their presence defies the laws of nature, the essences that bind them to reality are inherently stronger than others. Search /reddeath, /neverworldb, and /doomwar for these monsters and bring me their essences; they may have the power to form a Void Aura.

quests.name: Commanding Shadow Essences
quests.description: If you use Sepulchre’s DoomKnight Armor as a catalyst, you should have the power to magnify shadow essences enough to fuse them into a Void Aura. Travel to the hidden /shadowrealmpast and gather 50 Empowered Essences from the monsters there. Before I can create the Void Aura, I require an additional 3 Malignant Essences from Sepulchure or the Shadow Lord to use as focal points for the smelting process.

quests.name: The Encroaching Shadows (Daily)
quests.description: You must be able to stand up to true power if you wish to possess true power. Find and face several strong foes, and return to me your proof of victory. Obtain a Glacial Pinion from the Icewing Warlord, three eyeballs from the strongest Hydra in Mobius Lake, and the viscera of a creature in the Void.

quests.name: Glimpse Into The Dark (Daily)
quests.description: "Hero", do you wish for power? Would you like a glimpse of what could be? I require a few things from powerful beings and beasts. Their power will help bring you closer to understanding the darkness. I require Kraken Doubloons from the Chaos Kraken, the axe of Graveclaw the Destroyer, and Ancient Trigoras' Horns.

quests.name: Find the Doom Blade's Blade
quests.description: You now know how to create the Void Aura, so we need to move on in the crafting process. The next thing we need to do is get the blade! Defeat Sepulchure's Chaorrupted armor to find the Blade Essence that I need to create that part of the Doom Blade.

quests.name: Find the Doom Blade's Hilt
quests.description: You have taken the first step along this path towards the creation of the Necrotic Sword of Doom. If you truly believe that you have the power to continue along this path, do not let me dissuade you. In order to create the base of the hilt, a massive amount of energy is needed, among other things.

quests.name: Create the Doom Blade's Aura
quests.description: You have mastered the collection of Void Aura, but that is not the only thing needed to create the Necrotic Sword of Doom. In order to imbue the sword with the power of Necromancy, we will need the Energized Aura of Necromance. This is not something that can be created in one step, however, so you must first gather all that is needed to create the Unenhanced Aura.

quests.name: Create the Doom Blade's Aura
quests.description: You have mastered the collection of Void Aura, but that is not the only thing needed to create the Necrotic Sword of Doom. In order to imbue the sword with the power of Necromancy, we will need the Energized Aura of Necromance. This is not something that can be created in one step, however, so you must first gather all that is needed to create the Unenhanced Aura.

quests.name: Mmm... Cake
quests.description: First, a favor for me. Beat up the waiters coming in from the kitchen and steal me some spiceroot cake. It's a special dessert - they only serve it to the most oldest and lofties of Sheevra. It's delicious, but I'm not supposed to have any.

quests.name: Catch the Sprites
quests.description: First, you're gonna need to capture some garden sprites. They have a great nose for uncovering the truth. Just catch 'em in these jars! They won't like it much, but they can't break out.

quests.name: Spicy
quests.description: Alright, NOW, you gotta go get some moonpepper flakes. It's like catnip for these lil guys - stuff drives 'em wild! We use it as a spice, too, so the Kitchen Brownies will have some. Might have to convince them to give it to you, through!

quests.name: Things are Getting Hairy
quests.description: This is gonna be the hard part. I need strands of hair from elder Sheevra, one for each sprite. They won't hand them to you freely, so you'll have to be sneaky about it.

quests.name: Let 'em Loose
quests.description: Now go let the sprites loose in the ballroom and see what happens!

quests.name: Time To Think
quests.description: We've only just arrived and already my soldiers are jumping at shadows, LITERALLY. Kill 9 Nightmare Stalkers and help put them at ease. It'll make preparations go a lot easier.

quests.name: Know First, Then Do
quests.description: I've met with the other commangers, and while I think we'll avoid stepping on each other's toes, we're fighting a bit in the dark here. None of us has a very clear idea of what we're up against.

quests.name: Break into the Timelock
quests.description: Time is running out! You've gotta stabilize the rift to buy more time to get Dage the Evil back to our world. For that, you've got to get INTO the timelock, then find and free Lycan Queen Safiria!

quests.name: Battle Dark ArchMage Brentan
quests.description: Before Dage the Evil invaded, Alteon sealed himself and two of his strongest warriors inside the timelock to protect the rift and safiria from you. If you're going to reach her, you'll have to take Brentan out.

quests.name: Battle Cryomancer Drakonnan
quests.description: Before Dage the Evil invaded, Alteon sealed himself and two of his strongest warriors inside the timelock to protect the rift and safiria from you. If you're going to reach her, you'll have to take Cryomancer Drakonnan out.

quests.name: Battle Alteon the Imbalanced
quests.description: Alteon knows what you can do, Hero, and he will stop at nothing to prevent you from destroying this rift, or his chance to rule the mirror realm! You'll need to take him out if you're going to get Lycan Queen Safiria out of here!

quests.name: Call Forth the Light
quests.description: Dage the Good sees potential in everyone… even those who have sided with the Dark. Cleanse the creatures in the /overworld by bringing him 8 Dark Hearts and he will reward you with gold!

quests.name: Legion Quest: Overworld Free for All
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Good, Bright Lord of the Overworld! Bring him 10 dark hearts from the monsters in /brightfortress and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Legion Quest: Light vs Dark
quests.description: The day will come when Dage rules all… but will it be Dage the Good… or Dage the Evil? Help keep the balance in /brightfortress (for now) by bringing 10 Badges of Loyalty, 8 Badges of Corruption, and 6 Badges of Twisted Light Tokens from the monsters in BrightFortress!

items_required.name: Badge of Loyalty x10 (Stacks up to 100)
Badge of Corruption x8 (Stacks up to 100)
Twisted Light Token x6 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Rolling Veins
quests.description: It's time we get back to business. We were kept in chains for so long that we've lost track of the mineral veins. Our mountain is unlike any other. Veins of precious minerals and metals grow and shift. It takes experience to track where they sprout and move. If you get us Gem Cores from the Gemralds and scoop some innards out of the Glow Worms, we'll show you how we prospect.

quests.name: No Business
quests.description: Vath must have made a good snack for Stalagbite, but the dragon could have stuck around to help themselves to the rest of his army. The Chaos Drows and Chaotic Draconians are squatting in the mountain, leaderless but destructive. We need to get rid of them, or render them harmless. Break the Drows' weapons and clip the Draconian's Wings. That'll make them easier to handle.

items_required.name: Broken Drow Blade x5 (Stacks up to 35)

quests.name: A Brutal Mistake
quests.description: Harrumph. You'd think someone as upright as I am wouldn't be so forgetfull! Its my one failure, and I try to make sure no one knows about it, so I keep spare sets of the jail keys hidden around. But someone- or someTHING- stole one! Can you search behind the statues and on the undead for my extra set of keys? (Quest can only be done once per login)

quests.name: Get the Merch
quests.description: These undead monster have made a mess of the merch booth! Do me a solid and bring back all the merchandise they stole. DO NOT try to keep it all for yourself. I will know. I'll reward you with some awesome swag if you help me out.

quests.name: Grunge Grind
quests.description: After every concert, we're left with a venue that looks like a horde of Horcs blasted it into a sludge factory. It's a WRECK. Go clear out all the stragglers so the cleaning crew can come through in peace. Get'em out quick and I'll make it worth your while.

quests.name: Bryce Platinum's Task
quests.description: Rock stars LOVE meeting their fans. But I've got to say, your arena has some really… grungy denizens. Monsters, even. I've got to think about the safety of the band, you know? And I need YOU to help. Take out 8 of the creatures waiting to tackle the talent and I'll make it worth your while.

quests.name: Canine Canines
quests.description: Ze only way to stop ze Werewolfs is to stop zem at the source. Ze gray wolves in Greengard, zhey are not a big threat..but still, zhey are part wolf, and must be exterminated. You never know when zey will turn into Werewolfs, so stop zhem before zhey can do ze transform! Bring to me 8 canine teeth from zhey Gray Wolfs so zat I know the deed is done!

quests.name: Dog Gone Shame
quests.description: Zere has been ze storytelling of Chaorrupted Wolves living in ze Neverglades. Haz you ever been zere? Ze stories says zhat zhey live in ze Forest of Chaos and in ze Chaos Forest. If zis is true, zhen go out and bring me 5Chaorrupted Barbs from zere spines. Ze less wolf population, ze better Darkovia vill become!

quests.name: Bite is worse then their Bark
quests.description: Zhey call zhem Dire Wolves for a reason, human. Zese wolves reside just outside ze castle of Her Majesty. I knows zat you have confronted zhem already in ze forest…. so fighting zhem again should be not a problems. You bring to me 6 Dire Hair from zhose beasts, yes?

quests.name: Candy Craze
quests.description: Mogloween would be my favourite time of year if it was more about candy then all the other spooky stuff. This year I haven't had a single piece of candy and I'm craving candy. I heard that inside these houses all the creatures are carrying candy with them. I would go in, but I'd rather not. Can you collect 20 pieces of candy for me? (Bring back 20 piecs of candy to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Chocolate Goodness
quests.description: Out of all the candy, chocolate is my favourite, but it is so much harder to find. Chocolate is very well-guarded by Pumpkinhead Fred and you have to fight them to get the chocolate. Can you search the Pumpkinhead Fred for 5 chocolates? (Bring back 5 chocolates to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Strut My Stuff
quests.description: I've been ordered to sell you supplies for your house. I can do that. My otherself did it, so I can, too. Even though he's real and I'm not. If I'm going to build those items for you, I'll need 3 Cogs from the Ancient Chest in Time Library, 5 Tog Leg Bones, and the Scrap Metal from the Junk lying around town. Go now. Come back with resources.

quests.name: Lost Breadcrumbs
quests.description: My son went outside to play after breakfast. I told him to stay close but he must have wandered into the woods near the graveyard and got lost. He could still be out there, cold, hungry and alone. Or hurt! Please, find him. I don't have much but I'll give you my house if I have to.

quests.name: Dirty Laundry
quests.description: We're lucky my Caden didn't end up like Loshe's wife next door. After she was murdered, I saw Loshe throw her clothes out. But — no. It can't be… Would you mind investigating what's left of her clothes? The maggots might be using it for nesting.

quests.name: No Good Deed
quests.description: Before my father passed away, our food stores were filled to the brim. We dried our meats to keep them longer, but… there was something off about them. Father told me that someone he helped gave him directions to a good hunting ground. Maybe you'll have luck there, too.

quests.name: A Worn Book's Cover
quests.description: Father often gave bread to the homeless wanderers that sleep in the town square. There aren't many anymore. They were the first to be executed after the murders started, save for this one addled old man my father liked. HE could be the one who gave my father those directions. No one else had heard of the place. Would you ask him WHY he did such a thing? I would, but I'm afraid I might lose control and hurt him.

quests.name: Egg Hunt - Backpack
quests.description: Turn in a Complete Set of Eggs and obtain the Backpack! If any players click on the Backpack, it will reveal a secret… including which monsters drop the 1% rare eggs for the Vorpal Bunny Quests.

quests.name: Seraphic Medals
quests.description: If you are going to stop Laken, we're going to have to get past his Seraphic army! For every one of them you kill, bring their Medals back to me.

quests.name: Mega Seraphic Medals
quests.description: Some of these Seraphic soldiers are particularly powerful, and you won't always be able to tell who they are from appearance alone. They'll be carrying larger medals, however. Bring me any that you find.

items_required.name: Mega Seraphic Medals x3 (Stacks up to 600)

quests.name: Seraphic Commanders
quests.description: They're sending in the big guns, now! Those Seraphic Commanders pose a greater threat than the normal Soldiers do. We'll need to focus them down first. Take down any that you can find, and report back.

items_required.name: Seraphic Commanders Slain x6 (Stacks up to 600)

quests.name: Defeat Ada
quests.description: We've pushed back the bulk of the Seraphic forces, but now we have a new threat to contend with. Ada, the Order's top assassin, has entered the battlefield and now stands in our way. Deal with her.

quests.name: We Must Defeat Him
quests.description: We've fought back the forces of the Seraphic Order, and now nothing stands in our way. If we are going to take Laken down, now is the time to act.

quests.name: The Cake is NOT a lie!
quests.description: s you go to cut a piece of the cake, it wavers in and out of existence, as if it is truly in-between time. Maybe if you gather some fragments of the nearby Time Wraiths, you can get it to stabilize.

quests.name: Training With Dage
quests.description: Try your best, and we'll see how you measure up. Step through the doors, and face Dage.

quests.name: Darkness for Darkness' Sake
quests.description: If you want any of our Legion's gear, you're going to have to prove your dedication! Dage's Favor can be obtained from any of the fiends in /underworld, Obsidian Rocks can be obtained from the Soul Forge there as well, and Souls of Heresy can be obtained from Virgil's tasks in /sevencircleswar.

quests.name: Power of the Undead Legion
quests.description: Now it's time to do battle with some of the Legion's greatest commanders! If you can earn the approval of the Legion Fiend Rider in /legionarena, the Lich Lord in /frozenlair, and Grrberus in /dagefortress, then we'll see about getting you some gear.

items_required.name: Fiend Rider's Approval x1 (Stacks up to 5)
Lich Lord's Approval x1 (Stacks up to 5)
Grrrberus's Grr Grrr x1 (Stacks up to 5)

quests.name: Hotheads
quests.description: Even in the middle of a battlefield, you should always look your best… and most intimidating! I can whip you up a hairstyle so fierce your foes will turn and run! Bring me 6 Pyradon scales, 3 Ash Piles from the Pyroclash, and 1 Lava Jewel from the Living Lava.

quests.name: Make a Marshmallow on a Stick
quests.description: Hi, I'm a talking campfire. Oh… what happened to your marshmallow on a Stick? …did you eat it? You know it can be used for beating up baddies…

quests.name: Roasted Marshmallow on a Stick
quests.description: Hi! I'm a talking Campfire, and if you have a Marshmallow on a Stick, I can magically transform it into a Roasted Marshmallow! Just make sure you UNEQUIP your Marshmallow on a Stick so you don't accidentally get burnt!

quests.name: Nuked Mallow
quests.description: Legend speaks of a Nuked Marshmallow capable of changing colors. But very few have ever seen it. No one knows of it's whereabouts, either.

quests.name: Foreign Body Aspiration
quests.description: I have some very practical gifts ready for gifting, but I took a tumble, and the boxes ran away. Gather the lost gift boxes up, and you can have what's inside. It's a good deal for good kids like you and Miss Aria.

quests.name: Wicker Magic
quests.description: Thanks to your friends, Greenguard's forces stopped attacking the rebels. That leaves Skye's Cailleacha, the mages who serve the Warden of the South. Fight them. They scare easily without the Warriors or Executors to protect them. Talk to Felix, too. He knows their leaders very well.

quests.name: Maigh Eo
quests.description: Loughshine is home to forest spirits, including the Elder Yew. They're ancients feared by Queen Iona's army, but they stood back and let the rebels take shelter in their shade. The Yew are being burned by the spreading flames. Pain is sending them into enraged frenzies. We need to quell them.

quests.name: Resentment Harbour
quests.description: The flames are spreading too quickly. Some of the Fianna would prefer burning to being captured by Iseul, but I can't let Mr. Kieran's dream end here. Please help us extinguish the flames, and check on Mr. Kieran, too. Loughshine is one of the only places where he and his family were happy.

quests.name: Wisened Yew
quests.description: Lady Celestia's healing magic is amazing! I suppose what would work on huge Dragon wounds would work three times as well on humans. Oh, that was meant to be a joke, but maybe…let's collect reagents from the Elder Yew and Callieacha. She could find use for them.

quests.name: Dragonflare
quests.description: I think we found your friend the Dragonslayer. He ran away when fires began to engulf Loughshine. He was gruff, but helped keep the Fianna fed. That man's fire went out of control, so I don't think he meant to harm us. Will you talk to him? Felix and I will go with you.

quests.name: Shock Scatter
quests.description: Pressing East is our best chance at escape, but Skye's Executors have already arrived. That means Iseul is close by. I know how they work, and they do so quickly and efficiently. Defeat them before they can link up with the rest of their forces!

quests.name: Grace of Three
quests.description: Up ahead, there's a younger Yew we can hide the injured Fianna under. We need to clear out the Energy Elementals surrounding it. Ah…that means Lord Haeos continues to take Queen Iona's side. They really don't want us to get to that specific Yew. If you find anything of interest near that tree, let me know.

quests.name: Iubhair
quests.description: We need to prepare to escape, which means that we'll need to leave the injured rebels undefended for a time. Round them up, and lead them to the unburnt Yew Tree so they can take shelter under it. The Yew's shadow will hide them from the lightning.

quests.name: Parting the Clouds
quests.description: Greenguard's forces and the Fianna are getting into formation. We're going to break through the Executors and Energy Elementals to escape. You'll be leading the vanguard, and the rest of us will be right behind you! Find a route for us to the East.

quests.name: Arrester
quests.description: Queen Iona has sent her favorite daughter to prevent us from escaping. We need to get East! It won't be easy, and we will suffer losses, but we have to get past her! Felix and I will support you as best we can.

quests.name: Turtle Power
quests.description: Well, what are ye waiting for? Board me ship and rid it of those weird ninjas!

quests.name: Setting Sail to Yokai
quests.description: Those crafty Kappas have stolen all of my Sail permits - without them, I cannot use the docks at Yokai Isle! I think the Kappa ninjas that stole the permits are in the bow of the ship - go get me a permit so that we can set sail.

quests.name: Memoirs Of A Sailor
quests.description: Nobody will believe this. I'm going to need you to find all the pages of my Captain's Log so I have some kind of record of this to tell people. Goats will eat anything so you might need to check the goats for a few of the pages.

items_required.name: Loose Pages of the Captain's Log

quests.name: Snare Some Goats
quests.description: If you're really serious about helping me then you're going to need to clear off some of the goats. Setting traps would be the simplest way. Those Chaos Goats are mean but not too bright. Regular old snares will work fine!

quests.name: Keys To The Love Goat
quests.description: Those blasted goats ate my keys! I know normal goats have reputation to eat anything but… KEYS?! I need those keys otherwise I'm sunk!

quests.name: Snares Shmares
quests.description: BLAST IT! The snares aren't working. Those twice-cursed goats are EATING THE TRAPS! You're going to need to go in there and take care of them the old fashioned way.

quests.name: MEGA-GOAT!
quests.description: Most respectable goats have a goatherd to keep them in line but these goats all answer to the MEGA-GOAT! He's larger than the others and they seem to follow his lead. Take him out and the rest will be no problem!

quests.name: All Wet
quests.description: We get so much life from water, why not energy? I built a hydro-kinetic generator to convert the movement of water into clean energy but General Pollution's Chaos fumes have effected Kuro and Water Elementals tending the Wheel. They can get the wheel cleaned up and moving again if you can gather 4 Water Cores from the Water Elementals and a Chaotic Water Core From Kuro.

quests.name: Flame On
quests.description: Deep within Lore's Crust, Lava and heat flow through the planet like blood through veins. I developed a way to craw some of the heat out and convert it to clean geo-thermal energy. The Fire Elementals are the only ones who can resist the heat and open the geo-thermal check valves before the whole place blows sky high! If you can get 4 Fire Cores from the Fire Elementals and a Chaotic Fire Core From Thermax they will come to their senses!

quests.name: Plant Matters
quests.description: I Developed a very fast growing weed that can be used to make renewable, clean biomagic. Unfortunately the Chaos fumes have corrupted the seeds and stone elementals tending the gardens! If you can get 4 Stone Cores from the Rock Elementals and a Chaotic Stone Core from the Stone Golem who leads them, they should be able to break free of the chaorruption.

quests.name: Breaking Wind Turbines
quests.description: Energy gathered from wind turbines is one of the cleanest energy sources on Lore but General Pollution's Chaos fumes have caused several Chaos tentacles to clog up the wooden wind turbine I built. If you are able to gather 4 Wind Cores from the Wind Elementals and a Chaotic Wind Core from the Great Wind Elemental, we should be able to get the turbine going again!

quests.name: Chaos Footprint
quests.description: The Hyper-slingshot is ready to go! You've GOT to get up there and STOP GENERAL POLLUTION from ruining Lore's Environment! Good Luck!

quests.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
quests.description: The contamination cleanup crew which was supposed to take care of the pollution in the area were chaorrupted. We need to continously purify them for the foreseeable future and for that, we'll need renewable help from the elements. Combine the powers of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Water, and little bit of your heroic Heart, to rectify the situation.

quests.name: Go Green like a Boss
quests.description: Although the regular elemental were decontaminated after the defeat of General Pollution, Thermak, Kuro, Stone Golem, and Ozone were too thoroughly corrupted. Hopefully by re-processing them (and by that we mean being defeated re-spawning), they will re-form cleansed. Collect Completely Chaorrupted Cores to show they have been recycled.

quests.name: Clean Up the Core
quests.description: Show Commodore Core that propaganda is NOT science, and his message is NOT welcome here.

quests.name: Plunder Me Some Booty!
quests.description: I don't know how t'fight a giant sea monster, but we can get these pirates' numbers whittled down! Bring me the booty they be carryin' so I can count how many ye've slain.

quests.name: Plunder Me Some HUGE Booty!
quests.description: Some o' these pirate be carryin' an even larger booty than usual - ye might even say it be a HUGE booty! More junk to put in Lolosia's treasure trunk means more resources to keep fightin' this here war!

quests.name: Call In An Airstrike!
quests.description: Th' Skyguard be needin' more cannonballs if they're goin' teh keep up their aerial attack! Pilfer some from the Kaiju Cannoneers, and we'll call in an airstrike!

quests.name: Call In The Mech!
quests.description: That huge hunk o'metal won't keep going for long - not without a steady supply o'fuel! Bring back some cans o'diesel from th' Ship Engineers aboard that kaiju. If ye can get… oh, let's say 5 o'them, that should be enough for a nice, strong attack.

quests.name: Keelhaul th' Cap'n
quests.description: We've fought our way back of that beast and onto the galleon what rests on its head. Th' path be clear to th' commander of this crew, Cap'n Kraylox! Defeat him, and the crew's control over the kaiju, Kathex, will be no more.

quests.name: Keelhaul Klashex
quests.description: You're our last hope! Defeat this bilge-sucking beastie before yer insides go kablooey!

quests.name: Fiends in High Places
quests.description: Hero! An army of Sky Pirate Draconians have taken over the Phereless! The Skyguard cannot control this draconian onslaught by ourselves. We desperately need assistance! Take out 15 of those reptilian ruffians before things get TOO out of hand!

quests.name: A Whirled Wide Traveler
quests.description: The Phereless is powered by a steam motor found beneath Her main deck. If the Sky Pirates end up taking over the ship entirely… the amount of damage they could cause to Lore is incalculable. We must cut off power to the ship in case they succeed!

quests.name: Boiler Spoiler
quests.description: Something is wrong down in the engine room. The boiler is clogged… but *something* is moving around down there. You don't think… from all the Gel-O-No… no no no no… no way… but maybe. Hurry back to the engine room and find out what's going on down there!

quests.name: This Fight Will Dragon
quests.description: The Sky Pirates have called in for reinforcements! For lack of a better name, a HUGE Sky Pirate Dragon is wreaking havoc on the Phereless. This monstrosity has given a whole new meaning to 'armed to the teeth.' It's got a weapon arsenal on its armor and…woah… a CANNON on its back?!?

quests.name: Things Are Looking Up
quests.description: WE have the upper hand! Now is the time to fight with all our might! Gladius won't be too confident once the Skyguard have taken back our ship! Travel the Phereless once more and collect Medals of Dishonor from his minions that are slain by your hand. Hurry Hero—we CAN win this!

quests.name: Don't Get Mad, Get Gladius
quests.description: This is it! The Sky Pirates are on the run and only one monster remains: Gladius. Not much is known about this fiend other than he (or she?) is the leader of the Sky Pirates. Not even the Skyguard can take him down. It is up to you brave hero! Arm yourself for battle!

quests.name: Bando de Penas
quests.description: Os monstros amedrontaram os pássaros da Terra da Festa e preciso que você viaje ao redor do mundo para encontrar penas decentes para serem usadas no Carnaval. Preciso de penas da Bird of Paradise em Manos, penas do Sola Phoenix em DreamNexus, penas do Mana Falcon em Elemental e penas do Tainted Emu em EtherWarGood ou EtherWarEvil. Você consegue!

quests.name: Wacky Winka's Candy Shop
quests.description: You have to see for yourself what's happened. Then you'll understand why we need you. Take a tour of the village and meet me by Wacky Winka's Candy Shop. I'll explain everything.

quests.name: Nougat-ta Save the Parents
quests.description: We can't have all these petrified parents wandering around town. They could hurt themselves. Can you get them somewhere safe, please? Whenever I try to make them move, they just shuffle away, staring and drooling.

quests.name: Chroma Kids
quests.description: Each of the adults you've rescued has something in common… their kids ALL visited Wacky Winka's Candy Shop after the Chromafactory thingamabob was installed. And now those kids are zonked-out zombies, too. We need to find out WHY!

quests.name: Caramel Clues
quests.description: The adults have been clustered around the fre samples tables for DAYS while the kids just keep wandering the streets, staring at things. Until we know exactly what's happening, we've got to cut back on the candy calories for the entire town.

quests.name: Sweet, Sweet Proof
quests.description: We need to collect ALL the candy, so no one else accidentally eats it.

quests.name: Whacky Snacky
quests.description: It's time we talked to Wacky Winka himself, and see if there's anything HE can tell us. I don't want to see any more of my friends hurt.

quests.name: Survival of the Deadliest
quests.description: Committing murder or claiming self defense, same things, just different afterthoughts. In the heat of battle, none of that matters, it is the enemy or your life. The Dark Makai are jaded, having long served as Nulgath's grunts. Many have fled Tercessuinotlim carrying with them the foul smell of rebellion. Make your first lesson in Makai survival a hands on experience and teach those terrors their place on the totem pole.

quests.name: What's a Knife Without Knowledge
quests.description: I can see why Nulgath has taken a liking to you, this fight puts a fire in your eyes. Before continuing to slay the Makai, it's time to learn what makes them tick. Bring back enough body fixtures to make me a frightening face mask.

quests.name: Search for the Scrolls
quests.description: windle travels all over Lore scamming heroes and stealing intel. A few trips back he told me all about these ancient scrolls he found on a Dark Makai. It seemed useless then, but now, this information could disrupt the whole rebellion.

quests.name: Time is Money
quests.description: Simply an option quest for the lazy: If you don't wish to take the time to search monsters for the scrolls, then you may bribe Swindle for the exact location. Since he's got quite high standards, here's one of the few bribes he'll accept:

quests.name: Side By Side
quests.description: Looks like the scrolls reveal the Makai to be of moglin descent…Interesting, I wondered what could have tainted such a loveable species.
