As these creatures appear to be the Moglin's polar opposite, a few tests are needed to confirm their true nature. Grab me 10 Makai prisoners, and 1 Evil Moglin from BattleOff for good measure.

quests.name: Chain Reaction
quests.description: The knowledge gained here could make or break the rebellion. Moglins most defining features are the ability of their hug's to heal, sugar induced candy crazes, and a disgustingly cute appearance. Let's see how the Dark Makai match up to these characteristics. Borrow a few chains from Dilligaf's swords in /join Underworld for some "completely humane" Makai testing. What's the worst that can happen?

quests.name: An Inside Job
quests.description: I signed up to mentor a hero, not be slaughtered by a Makai horde. The only hope of stopping these beasts lies with Nulgath's loyal double-agent. Seek out the Dark Makai Verick deep down in the sewers for assistance.

quests.name: Easy AND Breezy!
quests.description: I'm really fond of a particular weapon, you see? Some primitive reptilian has it and quite frankly, I'm a little jealous something so deadly is in its possession. I don't want the actual weapon, no. It's been tainted by them and their dirty hands. Just…blueprints. A copy. Go minion, go find it for me. What? You want a hint too? Hmm. Well they have tails, the weapon is kinda spiky, its wrapped all pretty in Masters writing. What? You want a NAME? That's not how this game will work, silly minion. Don't take too long, now!

quests.name: Disguises and a Ruse
quests.description: The squishy minion is back! You don't like being called a squishy minion? But that is what you are! Anywho, we aren't here to play THAT game. You are here to play mine! Now I will need a disguise of sorts. With a few rogue voids running around, you gotta conceal yourself somehow. There is a dark dungeon - a keep, one might say - descending into the earth, filled with creatures of all kinds. It has a few different levels, but what I seek is on the second floor. A creature's head can make for a really convincing mask, you know… Especially with those big, red beady eyes.

quests.name: Icky and Smelly
quests.description: Hello again, small minion! Are you back from your trip? I have more things for you to find. I'm sending you to a very large area, sobytry not to get too lost! It's all wet, mucky and EW and I do not want to go there and ruin MY clothes. That's why I have you! You'll have to explore deep into it to find what I want. There lurks in this place a large, ugly, green monstrosity clad in armor and holding a chipped-looking sword. I want you to go get me some of his armor. That iron can be used for many devious things.

quests.name: Dress For the Occasion!
quests.description: Hello again, my little helper! You know, I been thinking, what I'm wearing looks kind of…dull, don't you think? I should look more…tacky. Yes, tacky. I should look more like YOU! Now don't get your feathers all ruffled, I meant that as a compliment! A compliment of the highest degree, I dare say! Hows about you go fetch me something fancy from a dresser. I don't care who you steal from or where you get it. No, that's a lie - I DO. I hear the resort is somewhat popular with your kind. Unfortunate about the overnight stays though. Hopefully you can survive!

quests.name: Can't Play Games without A Lunch Break
quests.description: Fragile minion. you're back. Are you feeling peckish? Should we take a break? What? I'm not as heartless as those other voids you know. What an offensive assumption - you're lucky I'm NICE! Anywho, I was thinking… how about we share something to eat? Your kind needs to eat. no? Perfect! But uhh, I don't have any of those THINGS you mortals like to use for eating. so you'll need to go find me some. I hear there are some felines who have this…tool. That you humans use to eat. Do you want to go fetch one?

quests.name: She Needs a Hero
quests.description: Hero! Oooh, hero! I'm so glad you're here! You must do your JOB! Silly squishy minion, I don't ever and will never need YOUR help. Don't forget we're playing MY game and we're only playing because I'm BORED. Anywho, "hero", a princess needs rescuing. She's been holding out for a hero for awhile now. She's stuck inside a very confusing dungeon. Maybe you can find the pony inside and that can be your steed while you rescue your fair maiden?

items_required.name: Your Princess is Not in this Castle

quests.name: Sun and Fun
quests.description: Hay Hero, are you "beach body ready"? I'm not calling you fat, it's just a question. Anyways, feel free to relax. Yes really. You can relax but you need to show me you actually CAN relax since you look so…Hmmm, I don't know how to describe it. Stiff? Boring? Something along those lines. You'll need to find some beach gear. I hear there's a nice beach you can find something to play with on your temporary vacation. A really round and colorful thing. I know - COLORS. Disgusting. But you clearly don't care about "disgusting", considering what you are…eh….wearing.

quests.name: Heebie Jeebies
quests.description: Look. I have a favor to ask you. I don't like bugs. I hate them. Absolutely most vile things to have ever existed. I want you to go take care of a very big creepy crawly. Just thinking about it gives me the shivers. Go squish it. yeah? I would do it myself. but you know, I hate to get my boots dirty just for a BUG. You'll find it a very damp and wet place. The area is covered in webs. You'll know it when you see it.

quests.name: A New Pet
quests.description: Minion, I cannot lie, for my poor soul is lonely and I need a companion. No, you stop that I don't want a living person, why do you have such twisted ideas? No, I want a dog. Not just any kind of dog though. I want a big white fluffy doggo. It is rather cold where he can be found, so do bundle up, its awfully cold outside.

quests.name: Spoiled Dragon
quests.description: So, little minion. There's this dragon. I'm not sum of your ever heard of the mysterious fourth wall, but someone at the Underground Lab LOVES this dragon. It gets spoiled, honestly. Everytime there's some sort of limited time item drop event, this thing gets it, and I have to wonder who is spoiling this dragon so much. Go get me a weapon, anything that tickles your fancy from it. Voids need love and attention, too, mysterious worker.

quests.name: Vase Case
quests.description: I handmade everything in my shop, my friend. It takes a great amount of skill and creativity to make my high-quality wares, ahhh yes? My specialty lies in elegant vases… but I'm all out of ceramic. Search around the Oasis Village and bring me back 9 Ceramic Vase Fragments. I also need 3 Vase Contents the Cactus Creepers stole.

quests.name: Oasis Ornaments
quests.description: The orders keep on coming in — business is booming my friend! But I am — ehhh — I am a little shorthanded…OH! Want to help me out again? I could really some Pieces of Oasis Jewelry and more Sandsea Cotton so I can keep my customers happy, yes? Yes! I am sure that the thieving desert creatures have what my friend is looking for.

quests.name: Enter the Castle of Bone
quests.description: Vaden says, "It all started the day the Hero was spotted outside my Castle of Bone… slaying my guards to find the Key to the door!"

quests.name: Slay Vaden's Undead Guards
quests.description: Vaden says, "Naturally, like any Death Knight worth his salt, I had guards positioned in the lobby in case of a situation like this. …Unfortunately, the Hero quickly slayed them, too."

quests.name: Destroyer in the Foyer
quests.description: Vaden says, "As the Hero continued hacking through everything in my foyer, I started to get agitated. Never before had my defenses been so thoroughly breached!"

quests.name: Help! I'm a Fallen Lord and I Can't Get Up!
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero entered Hall of Fallen Deathknights - this was sure to spell certain doom for our "favorite" adventurer! Again and again, the Hero defeated the former lords of the castle - only to come them come back to unlife and attack again!"

quests.name: Gem-nastics
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero was doomed- the Fallen Deathknights would never allow the living to pass! Well… not unless you knew how to appease them. You'd have to fight them and steal the glowing Necrogems that give them their power. Then you'd have to insert a gem into each of their crowns, embedded in the walls. But how could anyone ever figure that out?"

quests.name: Bone Appetit
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hall of Fallen Deathknights lets out directly to my dining room. So what does this undead-slaying Hero do, but come busting in and KILL ALL OF MY WAITERS!"

quests.name: The Walking Bread
quests.description: Vaden says, "OK, so maybe my food WAS a little scary, if you're human. Giant chrysalises, wailing gourds, cackling undead bread. But did the Hero really have to steal a fork and burn it all?" (See if the Undead Knights know where it is!)

quests.name: Ghoul-ash
quests.description: Vaden says, "…and just to make sure everything was thoroughly destroyed, the Hero kept killing my ghoulish dinner guests until nothing but ash was left."

quests.name: The Butcher
quests.description: Vaden says, "With the dining room in shambles, the Hero headed into the kitchen to confront… The Butcher."

quests.name: Lean Mean Undead Slaying Machine
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero entered the long double hall past the dining room, slaughtering everything in sight. I made a mental note - I would need to prepare for my battle with this impressive adversary!."

quests.name: Moar Loot
quests.description: Vaden says, "Ah, the Trophy Room — filled with souvenirs from my most powerful foes! The Hero didn't seem to care about my taxidemy collection, but anything gold? HAD to be pilfered."

quests.name: Putting Your Hands All over Everything
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Gallery's walls are lined with enchanted paintings. The appear as blank canvases, but when you touch them, images of the Castle's lord — that would be me — are revealed. Of course the Hero had to manhandle each one."

quests.name: Paladin Rock
quests.description: Vaden says, "Next, the Hero went into the Ballroom… stole a bunch of song request tickets from the Grateful Undead, found a pencil in the gallery… mugged Those 70s Zombies for their dance shoes… and requested a bunch of Paladin Rock from the DJ. I've never seen an undead Disco clear out so fast!."

quests.name: Do You Find This Humerus?
quests.description: Vaden says, "In the next hall, the Hero started destroying all of my undead minions and collecting all of their upper arm bones for… for… you know, i really have no idea. Who can understand why heroes do the things they do?"

quests.name: Vaden Says
quests.description: Vaden says, "Of course, my personal chambers are kept securely locked. No one could get in there unless they knew my special Simon code! Unfortunately, the Knights, Guards, and Warriors each kept a piece of it in their pockets…"

quests.name: The Dead King's Bedroom
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero, who had beaten every knight and guard in the castle, was now in my bedroom. And so was I! I was not ready for this confrontation! As i ran into the bathroom to hide, I realized i had accidentally left my helm on the bed. Of course, the Hero could not resist the temptation to grab it."

quests.name: Game of Porcelain Thrones
quests.description: Vaden says, "Unfortunately, my escape through the porcelain tunnel was not a clean one. The Hero took one look at the wet, brown splashes on the floor, and knew exactly where i'd gone."

quests.name: Teenage Mutant Sewer Turtles
quests.description: Vaden says, "The sewer beneath the castle was crawling with giant turtles, the descendants of pets flushed long ago. They ignored me and let me pass - they've gotten used to me using my secret escape route. But for the Hero, only way to get out was to battle them all."

quests.name: Adolescent Inhuman Samurai Reptiles
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero quickly realized these were not just any sewer turtles. They were Adolescent Inhuman Samurai Reptiles! Legendary warriors whose respect could only be earned by defeating them. One by one, the hero battled them, claiming their weapons as proof of defeat."

quests.name: Snuggles!
quests.description: Vaden says, "The Hero was free, but Snuggles the Torturer was not far behind! He'd have to be taken out if the Hero was to escape the torture chamber."

quests.name: Game of Bones
quests.description: Vaden says, "Being the book maggot that I am, I spent years collecting the perfect armors for my Library guards to wear — armors based on my favorite series, Game of Bones! My pride and jot. But to the Hero, they were just more loot to farm for. "

quests.name: Rot Tin Tin!
quests.description: Vaden says, "And then… *sniff*… no, i'm ok, I just need a moment… and then, the Hero SLAUGHTERED my beloved dracolich, Rot tin Tin!"

quests.name: Gold Digger
quests.description: Vaden says, "There's nothing an adventurer can resist more than gold. The Hero found my treasury, and wouldn't stop beating on my Golden Deathknight guards until all of my treasure had been snatched up!"

quests.name: Gotta Hand It To Ya
quests.description: Vaden says, "The hero pursued me through my Armory — you know, the room where i keep all my spare arms, It was my last line of defense. But one by one, my knights and warriors fell to the Hero's Blade."

quests.name: Vaden's Defeat
quests.description: Vaden says, "It was in my throne room that the Hero finally caught up to me. I knew I could not lose — there was too much at stake. I readied myself for our final fight."

quests.name: Where's Tiffany?
quests.description: Wow, this is surprisingly… empty. Where's Tiffany's mirror fantasy? For that matter… where is Tiffany? Better search the area and see if you can find her.

quests.name: Trapped!
quests.description: Ok, ok, you're trapped in the mirror… how are you gonna get out of here? ell, the obvious thing is to smash that mirror you came in through. If nothing else, it can't possibly make the situation any worse. You'll need to find a mallet in order to smash the mirror! (Quest available only once per login)

quests.name: If At First You Don't Succeed...
quests.description: So, smashing the mirror attracts monsters to your location to keep you from getting out. If you keep doing this, maybe it'll eventually get the attention of one of those mirror knights. Smash the knight, and you get out of the mirror. Right? Right! Try it again! (Quest available only once per login)

quests.name: Try, Try Again
quests.description: Ok, either this is hopeless, or… it's hopeful! A hero never gives up! Smash that thing again! (Quest available once per login)

quests.name: Escape!
quests.description: Alright! Time to get your butt out of here!

quests.name: Cat Ears?
quests.description: Uh-oh. It looks like Stellaria has left her… cat ears behind? You'd better try to catch up with her. This might be important!

quests.name: Demolish De'Sawed FOR REAL
quests.description: De'Sawed is deceptive. I can admire that… when people aren't trying to use my mind to build a nightmare. Get him but good, Hero!

quests.name: Blow Up Lore?!?!?
quests.description: No nitroglycerin sponge? No problem. There are plenty of other explosives you could use, but they might be hard to come across. You can blow up the Nexus, Arcangrove, or the Etherstorm Wastes, but only one area at a time!

quests.name: Kill 2016!
quests.description: Time to kick this year right in the… glitch! Bet you never thought you'd be saying THAT.

quests.name: In Memoriam
quests.description: There are still so many angry spirits roaming my mausoleum, fueled by my grief. Please, would you help them calm down. like you did for me?

quests.name: Memento Mori
quests.description: The spirits are still causing so much mayhem - they‘re even stealing the mementos from the altars! Get the candles back from the Malevolent Wraiths and get the sugar skulls back from the Zombies!

quests.name: Ug
quests.description: Ug. (The strange cave man was pointing at a bone, I think he wants more bones.)

quests.name: Uga
quests.description: Uga. (The strange cave man was pointing at some raw meat, maybe he need some more food for his pet dino.)

quests.name: Ug Ug
quests.description: Ug Ug. (The strange cave man was pointing at the metal scraps on that dino, maybe he needs more of these strange mechanical parts. Certainly the Dinos will not mind if I borrow some.)

quests.name: Uga Ug
quests.description: Uga Ug. (The strange cave man was pointing at fragments of a bottle, perhaps I should get him some water. These beasts may have stolen his water bottles! Go recover a water bottle for him!)

quests.name: Punk Shadowfall
quests.description: OK, ok, so… *giggle* here's what I'm gonna have you do. You're going to go to /shadowfall, and beat up the Angry Zombies that are hanging out in the halls. Get a few big handfuls of zombie goo. You with me so far? Ok, and THEN… you're going to head to the throne room and slime Gravelyn with it. Ha!

quests.name: Punk Swordhaven
quests.description: You know what would really create some chaos? Sliming the ruler of Swordhaven! Go to Swordhaven /Castle and get a few big handfuls of ectoplasm from the Castle Wraiths. Then - sploosh! Right in the face with it! Bah hah hah!

quests.name: Tunnel this!
quests.description: The Chaos Tunneler! Somewhere in Crownsreach, there is a giant, chaorrupted, burrowing worm. No. I will not tell you where! If you can find it, and defeat it. I'll be impressed. Maybe even impressed enough to put in a good word with you to Drakath.

Ceremonial Void Blade of Nulgath's Quest.name: Ceremonial Void Blade of Nulgath's Quest

quests.name: Void Knight Sword Quest
quests.description: If you would reap the rewards of the Void Knight, prove your battle prowess. Spill the blood of Slugﬁt, the Aracara, Dark Makais, and Fire Imps. And do not forget to bring me the Aquamarine of Nulgath. The Crystallized Jellyfish in BattleunderC has one.

quests.name: Fire, Fear, and Pet Food
quests.description: Oh! GOOD, someone here to help me keep these animals under control! Normally, they're the sweetest things, but since the attacks and monsters started arriving, they've been madness itself. I can't leave to gather food for them or they'll riot. Please bring me 1 Fyresyn Wing, 3 Coal Creeper Legs, and 2 bags of Fire-Roasted Peanuts from the Storm Sentries.

quests.name: Ziri's Contract
quests.description: Ziri the Daimon is pretty powerful. I wonder what secrets he holds! I mean, he would be a great asset to my company! Mind helping me out? The Interview list is posted on the door to the board room.

quests.name: Alina's Contract
quests.description: Alina knows how to make some of the most powerful potions in the world! She will be a valuable resourc— influencer! Get her contract signed!

quests.name: Victoria's Contract
quests.description: The kinda Queen of Swordhaven?! What a great influencer for my company! Get me that signed contract!

quests.name: Nulgath's ...Contract?
quests.description: Nulgath?! As in the leader of the Nation?! Perfect! He's used to getting contracts signed but this will be a nice change of pace for him! Get his contract signed!

quests.name: Dage's Contract
quests.description: Dage is here, too? His Legion's secrets will be a great addition! I mean, his Legion will be great followers!

quests.name: Swaggy's Contract
quests.description: It's said Swaggy has knowledge of Grimskull's dungeons and all the treasures he has locked in them! It would be great for him to reveal, umm, "tell" us where they all are after we get his contract signed!

quests.name: Cysero's Contract
quests.description: The Mad Magical Weaponsmith has connections all around Lore! And his weapons are powerful too! He'll make a great addition to my company!

quests.name: Gravelyn's Contract
quests.description: Looks like the last influencer we have left is the Empress of the Shadowscythe herself! She would be the perfect addition to my team of informants— err, influencers!

quests.name: Server Room Access
quests.description: My Goons will make sure you never escape here! Even if you do, you'll never stop me from keeping all of their secrets and their contracts binding them to me… and you'll never get the key from my Security! You'd need to get to the server to do that! Umm, actually, forget I said anything about the Server Room!

quests.name: The M.C.P
quests.description: If you want to destroy those contracts, you'll have to destroy the M.C.P first! The Master Chairman Platinum, of course! (I may be evil but I'm not evil enough to steal the exact acronym from an 80s movie!)

quests.name: Need Blood
quests.description: I can make you something special, but I need something special from you first. Go deep into the underworld. Find the Blood Fiends. Being me their Fiend Blood. I crystallize it for you, and we use it to forge most powerful armor.

quests.name: Need Flame
quests.description: Frozen Pyromancer difficult to kill for good. But if you steal a little piece of his flame, over time, he become weaker and weaker. Fight him. Steal his flame. Bring it to me. I make you something nice with it.

quests.name: Need Soul
quests.description: You want nice loot from Dage? You know the drill: he needs a nice, shiny soul. In this case, what he needs is a shard of the Frozen Pyromancer's soul. Take a piece of his soul, if you can, and bring it back to me.

quests.name: Ascended Drakath Gear
quests.description: Bring me the holy wasabi from the Dread Stranglerfish in the Tower of Doom!

quests.name: Chaos Champion's Pet Quest
quests.description: The power of Chaos makes it MUCH easier to control a dragon… But power must be maintained. Harvest Chaos Energy from the Choarrupted Wolves in /forestchaos.

quests.name: Defeat the 13th Lord of Chaos
quests.description: The 12 Lords of Chaos have been defeated, but now you must defeat the 13th Lord of Chaos. Do you have the strength to battle yourself?

quests.name: TLaPD 2020 Collection Badge
quests.description: Battle the Fishwings in /pirates until a Chaorrupted Fish Eye Drops to unlock your Talk Like a Pirate Day 2020 Collection character page badge!

items.name: Chaos Alliance Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Defeat the 12 Lords of Chaos!
quests.description: You have defeated their beasts, but can you now run the gauntlet of the 12 Lords of Chaos? Defeat all of the Chaos Lords to complete this quest.

quests.name: Chaos Eye is Watching
quests.description: Chaos is ALWAYS watching… but it cannot be everywhere at once! Travel to the Forest of Chaos and the Chaos Marsh to find 13 new Chaorrupted Chaos Bears and Chaos Spiders.

quests.name: Defeat the ChaosWeaver Cleric
quests.description: It looks like our only option may be to attempt a truce with the Weaver Queen - but her Cleric won't let us past. Defeat him, hero, so we may seek an audience with her.

quests.name: Tap that Cactus
quests.description: Like most wonders in this era, objects are powered by either magic or science. My piano right here is steam powered and requires water to operate. Unfortunately… we're kinda in the middle of a desert. So water is no the easiest thing to come by. Some of the Cacti in the area should have plenty. Take this Tap and check every Cacti in the area for Water. Also see if you can find an Old Water Filter in the Trash Can out back.

quests.name: Heart of the Sarge
quests.description: OH NOOOO. My YugiWOAH card collection was just stolen by a giant mushroom! Get my cards back for me and I'll give you some duplicates from the boxes I've opened!

quests.name: Sullen Souls Survival
quests.description: If you value your life, don't let the Sssullen Sssouls drag you into the River! Defeat sssix Sssullen Sssouls and quickly return to my boat. Or join them. Your call.

quests.name: Wrathful Souls Rage
quests.description: Thossse who are alwaysss angry become Wrathful Sssouls in the Underworld, doomed to fight one another for an eternity. If you do not wish to meet the sssame fate, defeat 5 Wrathful Sssouls and return to my boat.

quests.name: Hydra Hospitality
quests.description: The Ssstyx Hydra is a hossspitable beassst. He never letsss anyone passss by without offering hisss formal greeting firssst. Ssslay the Ssstyx Hydra ssso that we may passs to the Ssstyx Riverbanksss.

quests.name: Dage's Guard Dog
quests.description: Dage's great guard dog goesss by the name Cerberusss. Thisss 3-headed hound will NOT let any mortal passss by unssscathed. Defeat Cerberusss, bring me hisss 3 headsss, and then you will be able to passss by the locked Palace gatesss.

quests.name: Blade to Rest
quests.description: Put 5 of the Fotia Spirits and 3 of the Underrealm Souls to rest… or they will haunt you forever!

quests.name: Soul'd Out
quests.description: Free 5 of the Femme Cult Worshippers from the cult's chains… and lay Grief to rest. Her wailing is getting on my nerves.

quests.name: Deathly Joys? BAH.
quests.description: Thossssse incarnationssss of human emotion get on my lassssst nerve. The sssspiritsssss of the Underworld ssssshould heed TRUE power. Slay them all… again and again and again.

quests.name: Follow the Pattern.. He Ne Ar Kr
quests.description: Unfortunately, the PTMs aren't QUITE ready yet. They weren't registering toxin levels correctly in my last test. If you can get me some more supplies while I work on it, I'll be able to get it fixed much faster. I'll need some Purified Xenon - the Dwakels at the /crashsite use it in their own technology, so you should be able to get it from them. While you're there, see if you can find me a miniature pressure chamber, too.

quests.name: The PTM is Ready!
quests.description: Ok, let's do a test run of this thing. Go ahead and grab a PTM from the box next to me. Then head east of here and get rid of some of the noxious clouds and toxic fumes that are starting to gather. I'll make sure the meter is working properly, based on the amount of exposure you've had, when you come back.

quests.name: Save the Creatures
quests.description: Alright! Now that your PTM is fully functional, let's get you out there! There are a lot of forest creatures who have been sickened by Extriki's toxin. Try to save as many as you can. The flying ones… try to knock out, but not kill. And remember - keep an eye on your PTM! When it turns black, go back! In the meantime, I'll keep in contact with you through the PTM's com channel.

quests.name: Eye Sp-eye
quests.description: See those Spyballs? They're watching us! They're recording everything we do, and playing it back for the Deathknight lords of the Castle of Bone. Needless to say, we cannot allow this. Battle the Spyballs and remove their cameras. Being on TV is fantastic, but Tower Network? No thank you. The ratings are terrible.

quests.name: Stone Cold
quests.description: Looks like this second toom is guarded by stone statues. Clever — stone is hard to destroy. But if you can manage to break the statues' stone hearts, then they won't get back up again! This isn't easy to do, so it may take a few tries before you've properly damaged them.

quests.name: Slay 'Em All
quests.description: Alright, well, I wouldn't want to put too much pressure on you, but this room seems more your speed. All you have to do is take out the knights and guards that are blocking your way. Just…. slay a few undead. You can handle that, right?

quests.name: Slay 'Em All Again
quests.description: Ok Hero. Same as last time. Just slay the Fallen Deathknights and Undead Warriors that are guarding this room. It isn't that hard, so I trust you'll be able to take care of this. Please don't prove me wrong.

quests.name: Farming For Loot
quests.description: I did promise you loot, Hero, and now it's time to fulfill that promise. Collect the following: A Sp-eye Camera from the Spyballs, and Axe from the Fallen Deathknights, a shield from the Undead Warriors, a helm from the Undead Knights, and a skull from the Undead Guards. What? Don't look at me like that. It's all worth quite a lot. You'll thank me later.

quests.name: Or... Not.
quests.description: Oh! Sorry if I tricked you. You don't actually get to keep all that stuff. You're going to place the items you just collected on the trophy plaques in the next room. That will open up the passage into the next part of the tower. (You may need to leave the room and come back before you can do this quest!)

quests.name: Mirror, Mirror
quests.description: Alright, alright, very straightforward. See these mirrors? I just need you to smash them.. No, I'm not telling you why. (You may need to leave the room ad come back before you can do this quest!)

quests.name: Bloody Scary
quests.description: Yes, you are correct. Smashing the mirrors summoned this terrifying ghost. Why didn't I tell you? Well, a good Hero has to be prepared for anything! So, show me that you're prepared!

quests.name: Just Nasty
quests.description: Ugh. I'd forgotten about these little bungtwaddlers. i used to find them in my kitchen crawling all over the meat. seeping their digestive acid all over it. Awful. Look, bone creepers are just nasty, so kill them please.

quests.name: Scavenger Hunt
quests.description: The ghouls in here like to scavenge and hoard anything they can find - I'm pretty sure this is where all my personal belongings ended up after I became stuck in this castle. If you can get the keys from the ghouls, we can use them to open the chests in here and take a look.

quests.name: Ghoul Booty
quests.description: Now I'll just need you to unlock all the treasure chests and see if any of my things are in there. I'd do it myself, but, y'know. Dead.

quests.name: Flester's Guards
quests.description: We're almost there, Hero! The last task before the final fight. All you need to do is take out these Golden Knights that are guarding Flester the Silver's… well, it's not his throne room, since he's no longer a Lord. Guarding his… oh, it doesn't matter! Just slaughter them!

quests.name: Flester the Silver
quests.description: This is it, Hero. The moment you've been preparing for. Have you just been riding on my coattails… or can you handle this fight?

quests.name: Dolls' Hide and Seek
quests.description: "With twine, bind and bend sticks of elm into arms, legs, and a head. To let rest, stake to trees all over the woods. To wake and be freed, gather these friends together," so writes Viola the Vile. The next passage mentions that fresh chicken bones work even better for their smell. No chickens around but more than enough bones ripe for the picking. Go on, fetch!

quests.name: Arts and Crafts
quests.description: Make these dolls carefully. If you tie the twine knots too loose, the doll will fall apart. Too tight and you'll snap our materials! Bah, both you and my minio..minor little troupe aren't making any progress. Go talk to that Witch in the blue and yellow tent. Ask her to cast a spell on the children to do this busywork. Give those bone-heads a hard knock on the way over too.

quests.name: Lemonade, Chewy Ice
quests.description: "The Forest's Spirit loves offerings of foreign delicacies. Dazzling in flavors, colours - and chewy. He'll get up faster if you gift him some chews." writes Russel the Riotous. My carnival offers many delights at the food stands. But they need restocking. We don't have ingredients from the outside but modifying the spell shouldn't matter. As long as it's chewy.

quests.name: Screams and Tag
quests.description: "I am called Viola the Vile in honour of my knowledge of fear. Allen shrieks at the sight of spiders, and the Forest's Spirit would wake to chase him alongside me." writes Viola. Screams are our next goal. That's why the coaster was constructed, but not enough children are lining up. Hmph, the clowns and the stains on the ground seem to be scaring them away.

quests.name: Playful Teething
quests.description: "A wolf bit the Forest's Spirit and we waited for it to be smushed, but it was given many pats instead. Those little teeth are toothpicks to him, so we lured the rest of the pack here. Gather animals together to help wake him," writes Russel. That's why I brought out the petting zoo. Strange, none of them want to leave their cages. Toss them some grub.

quests.name: Days Pass
quests.description: This passage is a mystery to me. "Banana slugs are better than candy gummies. Take sewing needles and pierce their sides to have him wake." writes Allen. I don't know what these banana slugs are but they aren't here. Bah, go hunt those fuzzy bugs for now. That witch will trade her needles for them. I must think on this conundrum.

quests.name: Pinned Bugs
quests.description: "Banana slugs are better than candy gummies. Take sewing needles and pierce their sides to have him wake. The sludge that spews out gives joy and wonderment to the Forest's Spirit." Positively psychotic! I see now. Over time, those slugs transformed into tape worms. Harvest the sludge and smear it all over the magic circles in the far right tent.

quests.name: Sweet Glue
quests.description: "I am Russel the Riotous, known for the might of my fury. I reduced the birch to mulch with my ax, practicing to fight the monsters at school. The sweet smell of the sap attracted the Forest's Spirit's curious gaze. Gather sap to wake him, as I did," the note says. You know what to do. The sap's red these days but it should smell the same.

quests.name: Witch Soup
quests.description: "We first met the Forest's Spirit whilst stirring a witch's brew in a pit. It emerged from the soil and joined in on adding to our metal pot cauldron. He drank it and was merry. Mix a foul brew to get his attention," writes Viola. I talked to the witch and she agreed to mix a brew as long as I stayed out of her tent. Fine. I don't care about cheap workshops.

quests.name: Written Promise
quests.description: "I spelled illustrious like that because I wanted it in my name, and I'll earn it in the future. If we get one. The warring Kings might drag the Forest's Spirit into their mess. If conflicts get too close, we'll use a seal to hide him. When children are gathered, he'll wake again," He's talking about my tent. Gather the children and get me extra ink to adjust the circles.

quests.name: All Fall Down
quests.description: "I had Keepers as did Russel and Allen. They are buried at the mouth of these woods. To wake the Forest's Spirit, the final step needed is to unearth the bones of its greatest enemies." Whoever these ‘Keepers' were must have been powerful to earn the Authors' spite. But this is it! Gather the remains and throw in a little extra in case.

quests.name: Snow Turning Back!
quests.description: It looks like Dead Morice has power over more than just the poisoned ice zombies who were once your friends! You'll need to take out 10 Snow Golems and 10 Ice Elementals to reach him! While you journey, renew the spirit of the land by placing 10 wisps of Frostval's Flame around the area!

quests.name: Venom in Your Veins
quests.description: Those coldhearted Ice Symbiotes… they were once your fwiends! You has to save all 20 in the area… without slaying them! To melt the ice around them, you'll need to force them to feel the burn of Frostval's Flame. Knock them out so they can get fired up for Frostval once they wake!

quests.name: Song of the Frozen Heart
quests.description: Dead Morice had so much magical potential. It is so sad that we Frostvale moglins didn't get to help him before his heart froze and turned so bitter! Now, to save Lore, you'll need to melt the ice in his soul! Out of the ice volcano… into the fire!

quests.name: Angriest Birds
quests.description: Everything happened so fast that I haven't had time to check in with my peeps; I don't know who is alright and who is… *bird gulp.* Explore the whole area, Human, and see which birds have become baddies and which ones remain friendly. Make haste and report back with your observations.

quests.name: Harms in Arms
quests.description: Flippin' finches, this is so much worse than I had hoped… but hope isn't enough to solve a problem. Action MUST be taken… and weapons MUST be taken too! Pry the weapons away from the BirdsWithHarms that you encounter. Fly back when you have found 4 different weapon types so that I may examine more closely.

quests.name: Literal Arms Dealer
quests.description: This is super sus: all these weapons have the Duck Norris insignia carved into the handles. Perhaps Duck Norris could offer a clue… or maybe he's the culprit to blame! *Phfssssss, phfsssss!* Quickly, Human - go speak with Duck Norris in the Weapon Shop to find out more.

quests.name: No Good Deed
quests.description: What do you care about our sorry little lives? Why are you even here? Are we entertainment to you? Well, I'll play no part. You want to help the girl? Find the house on the far east side of the village and end this comedy.

quests.name: Time That Surpasses Death
quests.description: If you wish to join my Order, you must prove that you are strong enough to withstand our power. Seek out Mors Temporis in /portalmazec and show us what you are made of!

quests.name: Queen's Chaos Collection
quests.description: ARF ARF! Daimyo has traveled from the past alongside Iadoa to grant you a character page badge to help celebrate the 13th Birthday! Defeat a Time-Travel Fairy in the /chronohub to harvest a Chaotic Hour-glass and unlock a character page badge!

items.name: Queen's Chaos Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Save Chuckles!
quests.description: YOU have been chosen by the Save Chuckles movement to convince DEATH to bring back Chuckles! Find DEATH on your map and speak to him — do not take no for an answer!

quests.name: Chunin Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the Merge Shop version of Chunin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a Chunin. There are times, however, when the skills of a ninja do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.

quests.name: Chunin Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the AC version of Chunin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a Chunin. There are times, however, when the skills of a ninja do not suit, however the look does. This is for those times.

quests.name: Weapons Testing
quests.description: You! Want to test some new weapons for me? Down by the pit, where Malurach hangs out, you'll find some training dummies. Beat those up for awhile, and report back to me on how you did.

quests.name: I Need Energy
quests.description: I'm running low on Celestial energy, and I'll need more if I'm going to keep producing these weapons. I know there are some Celestials who think they've "infiltrated" our city - but they don't fool me, and I bet they won't fool you, either. Fight them, and bring their energy back to me.

quests.name: Need a Better Metal
quests.description: The Temple Guardians at /ravinetemple are made from a rare, very strong metal. I call it Fortifinium - I don't know what it's really called, and I'm not very creative with names. Anyway, I want to use it to forge stronger armor for our troops. Head over to the temple and get me some.

quests.name: On the Run to the Next Gig
quests.description: Oh, hero! The Lumberhorcs and fanboys are swarming Kaitlyn and Jesse! If we don't clear them out, Bride & Groom will not reach their gig on time.

quests.name: Silence From the Songbird?!
quests.description: The songbird has been stolen?! They can't perform without the songbird. It's one of the stars of their act!

quests.name: Break into Backstage
quests.description: You've come this far, don't let ANYTHING stop you from seeing the show now. Defeat two of the Security Guards to get backstage to BrideandGroom's latest performance!

quests.name: By the Power of the Moon
quests.description: Take out 10 locusts to clear the first wave of the swarm and let the moonlight shine through!

quests.name: Clear the Swarm
quests.description: Dispel the swarm of locusts to finally let the moon shine through, and we'll be able to power the ankh and start the show!

quests.name: Treasure Hunters Attack!
quests.description: The ankh is powerful… and the shadow infernals are not the only creatures who want to possess it! Defeat 13 Treasure Hunters to protect the Ankh of Eternity.

quests.name: Airship Sabotage
quests.description: If you're going to make the Treasure Hunters don't follow, you'll have to take drastic measures. While the crew is subdued, cut the rigging lines, dampen their gunpowder, and scatter their cannonballs.

quests.name: Plague in the Pyramid
quests.description: If the swarm invades pyramid, your only known route back to the outside will be blocked. Clear out 12 of the locusts to prevent the airshaft from being blocked.

quests.name: The Plaguebringer Appears
quests.description: The locusts must have been sent by the Plaguebringer to retrieve the Ankh? That explains why they have followed you here. Take out Nokris Plaguebringer and 3 more of his minions, and the locust threat will be… exterminated.

quests.name: Battle to the Temple
quests.description: The death of the summoner has called all the locusts to their master's grave. The airshaft is no longer a viable exit. If we are going to escape and return to the Ankh to Rogue, we'll need to find another way out! Take out the Mummies and Treasure Hunters in your way as you battle to find an exit.

quests.name: Treasure Hunter's Last Stand
quests.description: The most legendary treasure hunters and explorers were known to be tenacious - never giving up on the prize they sought. This Captain and his Treasure Hunters are as fierce as any of them, and you hold the artifact he seeks. Take out the Captain and we should be free of the last threat to the Ankh!

quests.name: Apephyrx Rises
quests.description: The power of the Ankh, activated inside the temple, has summoned a being of immense power from beyond our world. It is… so… very… hungry! You must take out Apephryx before it devours our world!

quests.name: Gather the Gold Debns
quests.description: Slay any monster in the area around the Cruxshadows ship for a chance to get a gold Debn. Get 6 to turn it in for a Glowing Pumpkinseed to use in the merge shop.

Classic Pirate Quibble Quest Pet's Quest.name: Classic Pirate Quibble Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: 2021 Prime Chest Badge
quests.description: Avast! These undead pirates be wreakin' all sorts o' havoc on board. Slay 1 to send a message home to all th' rest, so they clear out and give th' deckhands room to work.

items.name: Prime Pirate Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Monstrous Future
quests.description: Ever since the explosions that shattered our continent, monster attacks have been on the rise. Our town keeps being invaded; please clear the area so the refugees stay safe!

quests.name: Compass Pointe
quests.description: We need to make sure all the refugees from the mainland are able to find their way here. We've been leaving compasses for them by the beaches, but we need to make more! I'll need 3 Chimera Scales, 3 metal Goblin teeth, and 3 strips of Wyvern leather, and

quests.name: Feed the Hungry
quests.description: We've got to feed all these refugees, and that's NOT an easy task when the land's in as much turmoil as it is. But we've got a lot of monsters in town, and now we've got YOU. Bring me 4 hunks of Wyvern meat and 4 grilled Chimera wings.

quests.name: Lodes of Gold
quests.description: Dwarfhold Mountains is the perfect place to hunt for gold! Unfortunately, it is currently overrun with Drow and Chaotic Draconians who steal everything from the imprisoned Dwarfs. The shiny, precious gold lodes happen to be the Chaotic Draconians' favorite. Find me one pristine Gold Lode and you will be rewarded handsomely for your troubles!

quests.name: Gold Digger
quests.description: Deep beneath Battleon lies a series of complex, underground tunnels flooded with the Undead. Even though they might look the same, there is one particular Undead who harnesses the Gold Dust. Hunt down the undead Lich until you find this Gold Dust!

quests.name: Fire Gem
quests.description: Fire Gems are extremely rare and valuable. If you find one while battling a Skeletal Fire Mage, please return it to me! In reward for your bravery and perseverance, I will enchant the power of the Fire Gem into a staff for you. You can find Fire Mages in battleundera.

quests.name: Key to the Tower
quests.description: If you are going to save the Princess, you've GOT to get into the Tower. It's locked, and I'm pretty sure one of thesezardscreatures stole the key. Defeatthe ZardsUndead Warriors until you recover the Tower Key.

quests.name: Doomkitten's Treasure
quests.description: SOMEWHERE in this town, there's an evil DOOMKITTEN in its secret lair. Where is that lair, you ask? No one knows! But if you can find it, I hear that kitten has a rare and special treasure. Bring it to me, and I'll give you a nice reward.

quests.name: Pop Goes the Makai
quests.description: Why must the Archfiend surround himself with such annoying creatures! We must take out these Dark Makai if we are going to be getting anywhere!

quests.name: Dispel Spell
quests.description: It looks like the local fiends put up a barrier keeping us from moving forward. If we collect enough of the Fiend Energy that is maintaining the sigils, we should be able to dispel them!

quests.name: Dreadfiend Demolition
quests.description: These Dreadfiends are no match for your power, Master Dage, but that doesn't mean they are not in our way. Let's show them the might of the Legion and move forward.

quests.name: Graython Located
quests.description: We have to find Graython before the Archfiend does. Let's scout the area and see if we can find him.

quests.name: Defeat Graython
quests.description: It can not be helped, Master Dage. Graython has allied himself with the Archfiend. He must be eliminated before he can become a bigger threat.

quests.name: Island Sightseeing
quests.description: It's said that the Nuckelavee resides somewhere on this island, close to a haunted shore. Let's see if we can find this fabled shore. We might have to clear out the local wildlife as well. Something has them spooked.

quests.name: Lure Crafted
quests.description: If we are going to lure the Nuckelavee out, we are going to need an actual Lure. We should be able to make one out of Void Crystals carried by the Dreadfiends back in Graython's tunnels .

quests.name: Lure Charged
quests.description: The Nuckelavee will only appear if there is a strong sense of demise nearby. That is what the Lure is for. We will have to collect souls of anything nearby until the Lure is fully charged.

quests.name: Place the Lure
quests.description: Let's take the Lure to the shore and that should cause the Nuckelavee to appear.

quests.name: Defeat Nuckelavee
quests.description: The Nuckelavee is a natural force of the Underworld. We must be careful, but if we can defeat it, we can convert it to the Legion and gain a powerful asset.

quests.name: Bloody the Fiends
quests.description: We must take this outpost and eliminate Smaras! Let's start by taking out the Bloodfiends!

quests.name: Unstable Energies
quests.description: I have an idea for once we are done with Smaras. Let's collect Unstable Void Energy from the Fiends here. I'll be able to use it to create bombs and we will demolish this outpost!

quests.name: Plant the Bombs
quests.description: Let's find some of the structural keystones for us to place these bombs on. The Nation will have one less foothold when we are done with this place!

quests.name: Those Infernal Fiends
quests.description: All that is left are the Infernal Fiends. Let's take them out and move on to Smaras! Victory belongs to the Legion!

quests.name: Defeat Smaras
quests.description: Smaras is too valuable to the Archfiend to be kept alive. We must stop him right here and now!

quests.name: Understanding Yokai
quests.description: How Yokai fit in the cycles of life and death are still relatively unknown. That mystery will give us an edge against the Archfiend but we must understand them to utilize it! Let's face some of these Funa-Yurei to get some insight.

quests.name: Covering Our Scent
quests.description: In the Yokai Realm, our souls stick out like sore thumbs. We have to try and mask our presence or we will never stop being hunted by the local Yokai. Let's collect some Energy from the Funa-Yurei and the earth around us to try and disguise ourselves.

quests.name: Can't Escape the Shadows
quests.description: Hebimaru has sensed us! And he has sent his Shadows to take us out. We can't let them stop us! Let's take them out!

quests.name: Last of the Defenses
quests.description: Hebimaru has alerted more Yokai of our presence! We have no choice but to eliminate every last one until we reach him! Let's finish this, Master Dage!

quests.name: Defeat Hebimaru
quests.description: I don't know what a shinigami is capable of but we have to be ready for anything! We must defeat Hebimaru and get him to join our cause!

quests.name: Build Drakath's Armor
quests.description: This is one of the HARDEST quest in AQWorlds! Only the strongest, most-dedicated, bravest heroes will be able to complete this quest! It will require you to turn in some of the most valuable, hardest-to-obtain gear… but the reward will be worth it!

items.name: Drakath's Epic Armor Character Page Badge

quests.name: Drakath's Armor Badge
quests.description: So, you already have Drakath's Armor, (and the fancy badge in the Other tab of your Book of Lore) but you want to show the world with a character page badge? Well, now's your chance!

items.name: Drakath's Epic Armor Character Page Badge

quests.name: Bridge Over Troubled Wellmet
quests.description: We've GOT to get back to Cysero and Warlic, Hero. Rowan's already there. We'll need ALL our smarts if we're going to figure this out. I'll guard your back while you take on the monsters that have clogged up the Night Bridge. *mutter* Just wish I had m' locus magicalicus. Then I could help with MAGIC.

quests.name: Focus on the Locus
quests.description: I can FEEL it calling to me, Hero. I just have to listen inside my head - and my heart - and it will lead me to itself. I'm going to scout ahead - back to the alley where we found Cysero - and see if I can find the general location. Find me when you've taken out all the monsters in the area. That way they won't interrupt our search.

quests.name: A Gift Of Meat
quests.description: I have information about Wolfwing but you must earn the pack's respect before I will share my knowledge. You must present me with a gift of meat, and I will share with it my brothers and sisters. Our cousins, the Dire Wolves, have taken more than their share of game lately. Take 6 Hungs of Meat from them and return and honor me with your gift.

quests.name: No Respect
quests.description: Werewolves respect strength. To further earn the respect of my pack you must defeat them in combat. Challenge and defeat 5 Lycans & 2 Lycan Knights, then return to me.

quests.name: Vampire Knights
quests.description: The Queen has always sent her Vampire Knights into our lands to drive us out and take it for themselves, but these Vampire Knights stink of madness… of Chaos. Destroy 10 Chaos Vampire Knights to prove your loyalty to the pack.

quests.name: Sanguine
quests.description: Father Woods tells us that there is a Chaos Vampire General in his woods, twisting everything that he touches. Wolfwing must have sent this creature to keep our hands full while he… never mind. I will tell you if you complete this last task. Destroy Sanguine and return here with his Mask as proof.

quests.name: Buried Treasure
quests.description: You dig up a treasure chest. A message is carved into it. "One person's trash is another's treasure."

quests.name: Cornelis Reborn
quests.description: In order to unlock the Cornelis Family Chest and claim your rewards, you will need to earn the Cornelis Reborn Achievement Badge for your Book of Lore and your Character Page. Accept this quest and start collecting 100 Gargoyle Horns from the gargoyle monsters in Cornelis. Turn the quest in to get the Achievement and unlock the chest!

quests.name: Explication of Derp Volume VII
quests.description: I've misplaced my copy of "Derp: an Explication of the Conceptual Re-Engineering of the Societal Emphasis on Kawaii Culture, Volume VII" — oh, you've never read it? It's a MASTERFUL work, and my copy was signed by one of the foremost scholars on the subject. The Rainbow Derpicorn snatched it out of my hands while I was lollygagging last week. Recover it for me, and I'll reward you abundantly.

quests.name: The Green WeaponSnack
quests.description: I'm sure you've encountered Cysero, the Green WeaponSmith, in your travels through Battleon. It isn't common knowledge, but the man is a legend. A true gourmand and a baker beyond measure. But after a long day behind a hot forge, even HE needs to replenish his electrolytes… and I can make his favorite snack: PICKLES. You bring me the ingredients from the GardenQuest and if all goes well… you'll get a treat!

quests.name: Axe Marks the Spot
quests.description: Have you SEEN the Greenguard Dragon's treasure trove? Full of cool stuff… like an Axe strong enough to chop down that big tree over there. You can kindly ask him to give it to you… but chances are he'll attack you instead. Beat him up until he gives you the Fabled Chopper.

quests.name: Get Choppin'
quests.description: That tree is the only thing standing between you and a Fabled forest wonderland! If a tree falls in the Fable Forest… does it make a story? LAWLS.

quests.name: Crag & Bamboozle Battle
quests.description: They want a piece of the action too!

quests.name: GRUMBLE, GRUMBLE...
quests.description: Crag no feel so good, ate too much dirt…Sorry for the mess in the cart. Crag no able to hold it in…

quests.name: Crag's Thirst
quests.description: *COUGH* So thirsty… Crag need something to wash down the shards and gems. Throat so dry, Water? No need water, water make cracks. Crag need lots of refreshing dirt! Crag trade valuable but bad tasting diamonds for lots of delicious dirt!

quests.name: Creator's Golden Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness.

quests.name: Crimson Captain's Blade Quest
quests.description: Yarrrr! A blade needs to be feed. and this one cravin' some bone marrow and fish blood. Bring me 3 globs of that thar' delicious Bone Marrow from th' Undead Pirates in the /pirates map, an' 3 cups o' Fish Blood from th' fishwings flyin' about.

quests.name: Crimson Hanzo Orb Quest
quests.description: If you would reap the rewards of the Crimson Hanzo Orb, prove your battle prowess. Spill the blood of Big Jack Sprat, the DreadSpider, Dark Makais, and Rattlebones.

quests.name: Recovering the Fangs of the Lion
quests.description: When the Fangs of the Lion shattered, its fragments scattered across Chiral Valley. You will need to recover all 5 of its pieces if we are to reform it. The fragments could be anywhere - in the Faerie Forest, or perhaps the Cornelis Ruins - and any monster might have them. Gather some friends, and see what you can find!

quests.name: Recovering the Claws of the Daeva
quests.description: The fragments of the Claws of the Daeva are scattered across Arcangrove. As before, we don't know exactly where they are, or what creatures might have them. You will need to search the entire area, from the Tower of Magic to the depths of Mount Maﬁc. Return to me when you have them all.

quests.name: Recovering the Light of the Serpent
quests.description: Mythsong is where you'll ﬁnd the fragments of the Light of the Serpent. Are they in Mythsong City? In the Beehive? We don't know, so I can't tell you. But I have faith in you! You'll be able to ROCK this out in no time!

quests.name: Recovering the Pike of the Shimmering Sands
quests.description: You'll be going deep into the Neverglades to collect the fragments of the Pike of the Shimmering Sands. Search through the forests, marshes and ruins until you have found them all.

quests.name: Recovering the Reavers of the Gilded Sun
quests.description: The fragments of the Reavers of the Gilded Sun are scattered throughout the is|and of Yokai. Be sure to check across the water from Akiba, too - it's possible that some of the fragments were carried over on the ferry, or by pirates.

quests.name: Potent Mana
quests.description: We have all of the weapon fragments. Only problem is - well. they're still shattered! If we had enough Potent Mana, we could use it to imbue the weapons with power and reform them. The life forces of certain powerful entities across Lore could provide such a thing.

quests.name: Break the Seal
quests.description: Now that we have all the weapons, it's time to break the seal holding the door closed. Use the weapons to activate the symbols that match them. Once all 5 symbols are activated, the door will open.

quests.name: Armor of Zular
quests.description: We've broken the seal, but without the power of Zular, the Ancient Warden, we won‘t be able to stop Gedoz! Zular himself is long gone, but I still have his armor, and with your help, I can imbue it with his power. Collect Djinn's Essence from the Harpies and Lamias inside. and I will use them to empower the Armor of Zular.

quests.name: Gedoz, Geddout!
quests.description: With the Armor of Zular, you can now pass through the barrier into Gedoz' lair. Confront him, and defeat him, so that we can imprison him once more.

quests.name: Quest for Resources
quests.description: I have more weapons and armor I can offer you - l just need enough Unseen Essence to create them! You can get Unseen Essence from the Lamia and Harpies just inside the door. If you bring me their Potent Mana, I'll trade you some more Unseen Essence from my personal stash!

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: If I'm gonna builds you a racer, we'll needs parts! De' Giant keeps his table filled with plastic food all the time, for some reason. See if you can find the parts we need in that mess: A pencil, cork, toilet paper roll, scissors, a can and a rubber ducky head. When yous got the parts, come talks to me again.

quests.name: Street Team
quests.description: Oh, hello! Are you here to see the show? We're still setting up and we could really use a hand, if you've got time to help! Would you mind putting these flyers up for us? Just pin them to the trees in the performance area!

quests.name: De-Pesting
quests.description: Before the show starts, we're going to want to shoo some of these rats and birds away. Otherwise they'll bother the audience and steal their food.

quests.name: Earning That Guest Pass
quests.description: We're going on so soon, and there's still so much to get done! We still need to put up the speakers, tune our instruments and set up the lights!

quests.name: Low On Caffeine
quests.description: I hate to ask for anything more! But… the band could really use some coffee. Reens was bringing us some from the Scarbucks in Northpointe, but she must have gotten held up. Could you find her and get our drinks?

quests.name: Help Miranda
quests.description: Looks like Miranda needs someone to help calm her down! You'd better go take care of her.
Sort by:Quests- All
Sort by:Quests- All
Sort by:Quests- All
Sort by:Quests- All
Sort by:Quests- All

quests.name: Chipped Tooth
quests.description: Hey! You there! Adventurer! There's a situation concerning explosions that I don't even have time to explain. I had ALMOST finished my latest design, and WHAM. *kablooey* My entire bone collection ground to dust. The skeletons in the graveyards have the last remaining ingredient for my latest necromantic glory! I need you to go and bring back 10 Chipped Teeth asap! (Return to Zorbak in Battleon with 10 Chipped Teeth)

quests.name: Funny Bone
quests.description: Psst. You, over there. Yeah you! You look like an enterprising sort. I have a bone to pick with Big Jack Sprat in the Cemetery! Every time I ALLLMOST finish my latest masterpiece, those skeletons come and steal pieces that I need. I'm down to ONE piece left, but I have to stay here and guard what I have. If you head on over there, beat Jack Sprat, and grab that bone for me… I'll see that you're handsomely rewarded. Maybe. (Return to Zorbak in Battleon with the last bone)

quests.name: Defeat Dread Klunk
quests.description: Your first challenge is to defeat the Horc boss lurking inside the tower. Fight your way through his Horc minions until you find him!

quests.name: Defeat Dread Arradia
quests.description: Lurking inside the tower is a dragon made of crystal. Fight through the crystalline monsters until you find him, and defeat him.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Moganth
quests.description: Past all of these elementals is a huge beast made of stone. Find and defeat him.

quests.name: Defeat Dread Kathool
quests.description: Is it an octopus? An old god? Either way, it's on the other side of all these fish who are swimming through the air in this giant tower. It must be defeated!

quests.name: Defeat Creel
quests.description: What could be lurking at the top of this spire? You'll have to fight your way through all these nasties and find out!

quests.name: Defeat Dread Terror
quests.description: Past these hordes of undead monster is… another undead monster. But, a really big one! It's your duty as a monster hunter to defeat it!

quests.name: Defeat Dread Warrior
quests.description: There are a lot of chaos monsters here. You know what that means! Yep - there's something even worse on the other side of them! Find and defeat it!

quests.name: Defeat Dread Avatar
quests.description: I've heard rumors that past all these spirits is a huge, ethereal snake! How can any monster hunter pass up the chance to hunt down something like that?

quests.name: Defeat Dread Fang
quests.description: What's that reptilian screeching up ahead? It sounds like some sort of huge dragon. Better fight through all of these icy nasties and find it! It's dragon slaying time!

quests.name: Defeat Slugbutter
quests.description: Alright, this is it. Are you ready? Are you ready to find out what awaits you deep within the bowels of this tower? Fight your way through the underground marsh… and defeat whatever monster you discover.

quests.name: Reclaim The Spirits
quests.description: Trolls gather old stones for silly reasons. These lives be trapped in stone for ages for Trolls try to free them from they home. Collect 10 Burried Fossils and 3 Hidden Fossils so us can put back in ground!

quests.name: K'thurr Hocestra
quests.description: Music big part of Horc life. We sing to mountain spirit, sing when we happy, when we sad. Need some things to repair horcestra instruments. Zot need 15 Trollala Leaves, 10 Vulture Bones, and 1 flask River Water. You get for me?

quests.name: Zot's Zidar
quests.description: Me love music. Horc music not like any other music. To make real Horc music you need Zidar like mine. Me can make you one. Do job for me and me give you one as soon as me finish it. Gather 2 Gold Boar Teeth and 3 Iron Rhison jaws then bring to I.

quests.name: Lil' Red
quests.description: So you think you have what it takes to become a Shadowslayer? I want to believe you, really, I do — but I cannot put my full faith in someone who has yet to prove themselves to me. This is not the place nor the time for amateur adventurers… but I'll give ya one chance. Somewhere in Greenguard Forest resides a superior warrior known as Red Hunting Hood. She is an expert when it comes to hunting the creatures in those woods… and if you can convince her to lend you that Big Wolf Slaying Axe of hers, then you might have what it takes to help Darkovia out, afterall…

quests.name: A Dire Situation
quests.description: These lands are infested with carnivorous mammals known as Dire Wolves. Despite my best efforts to keep them at bay, the wolves keep multiplying, making safe travel impossible. An enemy of both the Lycan and the Vampire kin, the Dire Wolves need to be controlled one way… or another. You're going to be that other way; go forth and take out as many Dire Wolves as you can. Bring me back 8 Dire Pelts to prove that you were successful. Please hurry—we haven't much time…

quests.name: Blood, Sweat, and Tears
quests.description: Throughout your travels in Lore, I am sure that you've seen some pretty gross things. But nothing can compare to the Blood Maggots that plague these lands. A single Blood Maggot can kill an Alpha Lycan, devouring more blood than any Vampire family buffet. They are ruthless killers and will not be easily stopped. Bring me 3 Vials of Blood, 2 Vials of Sweat, and 1 Vial of Tears from these ruthless maggots, proving to me that you gave it your all.

quests.name: What a Lich!
quests.description: Dire Wolves and Blood Maggots are nothing in comparison to the monstrosity lingering in the ancient Darkovian ruins. It is known by Lich of the Stone… a horrible arch lich empowered by the darkest force in Lore— the force known as Chaos. Its origin is unknown, and the longer it resides in Darkovia, the more dangerous it becomes. Defeat the Lich and bring me its book, the Necrompendium. Perhaps then we can both understand its motives… and perhaps then you will understand why I became a Shadowslayer in the first place…

quests.name: Star of the Wild
quests.description: We have little time. We will need four star fragments that the Astrium have hidden for safety. With these we can hide the Sol and Luna again. The first fragment, the Star of the Wild is hidden on the monster Wisteria in the /guru forest.

quests.name: Star of the Seas
quests.description: The next fragment is the Star of the Seas. You will find it hidden on the merdraconian, Marianus, in the /natatorium deep within Arcangrove.

quests.name: Star of the Earth
quests.description: The next fragment is called the Star of the Earth. Deep inside the /pines near Dwarfhold, you will find a clan of Pine Trolls. One of the Pine Trolls will have this star hidden on him.

quests.name: The Star of Flames
quests.description: The final fragment is called the Star of Flames. This will probably be the most difficult to obtain as it is hidden on a great Greenguard Dragon in the /greendragon cave in western Greenguard forest. Please, take care. We NEED this fragment to cast the spell.
Sort by:Quests- All

quests.name: Black Friday Collection Chest Pet
quests.description: Head deep into the Underworld and take on the first Dark Makai you find. Bring me back on Dark Makai skull to unlock your Dark Holiday Collection character page badge!

items.name: 2019 Dark Holiday Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Musical Crystals
quests.description: The sounds of the rainforest whether from animal or weather, are inspiration for some of the greatest music. My people love music and I have learned the most beautiful music magic. Bring me 13 Tonal Crystals and 13 Music on the Breeze from Air Crystals, Living Air and Wind Elementals.

quests.name: We Didn't Start the Fire
quests.description: Outsiders! Always meddling where they are not wanted, bringing in things that do not belong! My people are already dwindling, yet they still come! They will regret the day they started this war! I will not rest until the forests of my home are drowned in their blood. Kill the Living Fires and the Sulfur Imps to harvest 15 seeds of Flaming Rage.

quests.name: Pay Homage to a Foreign God
quests.description: My home… Yes, theses are tears. Look long and understand the true pride of one's home and people! The carvings of the temple column makes my heart long for home. I shall bless it with lights. I need you to go out and capture158 ball lightnings so I can create the lights to hang on it. Also 3 Breaths of Light from the Wind Elementals to make the lights dance!

quests.name: Clash to a Cure
quests.description: I have learned of the perfect weapon to bring home to my people. Know that you have brought me one step closer to gaining the freedom of my people. I seek out flaming tornados to send those outsiders running for their lives. Kill Living Fire and Living Air and bring back the components.

quests.name: Sulfur Pure
quests.description: I am back and I have learned something new, something wonderful. I've discovered a weapon to use to keep those outsider away. Sulfur can be made into a weapon of great power! Gather sulfuric fumes from the Sulfur Imps around here and bring it back to me.

quests.name: Remember Your Quest
quests.description: I overheard you talking to the rest of the village. You NEED to be focused on helping your friends. Get back to the Forge, but make sure there aren't any monsters left between here and Cysero's Forge-Kitchen to threaten your friends! *small smile* I… I hope you have some dessert for me! And watch out for that nasty Baron!

quests.name: Hunt for the Amulet
quests.description: I want to show you what happened here, but I cannot focus on that until I recover my Amulet. Hunt through Ravenscar until you find it!

quests.name: Do the 'do
quests.description: I didn't plan on being here or doing this… I don't think I have a choice. I'm a construct. But aaaaanywaaaay, I'm going to do my job right! And for that, I'm going to need 3 puffs of Fairy Glitter, 4 Tog Fangs, and 2 tins of Ghost Dust.

quests.name: Business is BOOMing
quests.description: Even golems need to defend themselves in a city like this. I don't know WHY our creator included these monsters, but they can hurt us as much as you. Soooo… I need hair gel-ignite! It will explode in their faces if I can make it right! Bring me 4 balls of Fairy Fluff, 2 drams of Sneak Spit Nitro, and 3 ounces of Spectre Petre!

quests.name: Chronomancing the Stone
quests.description: Au'eir has gone far into the past, and stolen the gnomon from the very first sundial. After bringing it back to the present, he has given it to the Rock Elemental in /bludrut for safekeeping.

quests.name: Hourglass Half Full
quests.description: After retrieving a piece from the first sundial, Au'eir moved forward in time and over to the Sandsea to get a bag full of TimeSand - the best sand in Lore for use in hourglasses. It has been hidden with a Bupers Camel in /sandsea - go and get it!

quests.name: Quartz Past Twelve
quests.description: The next item on Au'eir's list was a Vibration Quartz that was used to power a clock in the Hall of Chronomancers. It seems like he hid it somewhere in /undergroundlabb. Check anything that could pass off as quartz!

quests.name: Spring Forward a Few Minutes
quests.description: Au'eir has been busy! It looks like he has stolen some ChronoCorruptor Springs and given them to a Shadowscythe in /thespan. Locate them and bring them here!

quests.name: A Nickel for Everytime That Happened
quests.description: If I had a nickel for every time Au'eir separated the nickel from a clock battery, I would have one nickel. Which isn't a lot, but it's weird that I would have one for something like that! It looks like he fused it with an Ore Balboa in /mountainpath. Do me a favor and separate from it!

quests.name: Back to the Present
quests.description: The last thing on our list is Periodic Plutonium that powered an atomic clock. It looks like Au'eir gave it to a Hydra that has since turned Radioactive! Go to /worldsoul and put it down to retrieve the Plutonium and we can finally put a stop to Au'eir's plan!

quests.name: Stop Au'eir
quests.description: This is it! Face off against Au'eir and stop him from summoning Chronocide!

quests.name: Defeat Chronocide
quests.description: Chronocide threatens to destroy all of time before and after this year! Our only hope to save everything is to stop it here and now! Buy me some time, so that I can prepare to seal it away again!

quests.name: Fighting Phoenix Blades (Klunk)
quests.description: Show me your hard earned Crystal Phoenix Blade and I'll reward you with Phoenix Blades that fight for you! For a small price of course…

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: Nulgath (Klunk)
quests.description: (This quest subject to change)

quests.name: Valoth Pet Quest
quests.description: This Mini Mecha Valoth creature wants to get back to his master. Go *ask* the Shadowscythe in /MQlesson zone for the Shadowscythe Ship Summoning token!

quests.name: Feels like a Dream
quests.description: I need to find my William, but my head is full of fog. All I have is this torn piece of ticket. If I could find the other pieces, maybe I'd remember where William has gone.

quests.name: Give me a Ticket
quests.description: Now I have the left side of my ticket, and the right side. But I'm still missing the middle, you see? I can't read what it says. I think… I think I remember a bird snatching it out my hand. Maybe one of the crows has the rest.

quests.name: For an Elephant Ride?
quests.description: It's a ticket for an elephant ride! Is that where I was supposed to meet William? Please, can you help me find where the elephants are?

quests.name: Trainers
quests.description: No one's here! I don't understand. Maybe if you ask some of the elephant trainers, they'll be able to tell you where William went… What do you mean, you don't see them? They're right here! Go back out the way we came in, you'll see what I mean.

quests.name: Tumblers!
quests.description: This piece of fabric you found… it doesn't look like the costumes the elephant trainers wear. Where have I seen it before? Oh… that's right! It looks like it came from the acrobat costumes! Maybe William is watching them perform. Go find them, I'll meet you there!

quests.name: Head to the Midway
quests.description: Why did the acrobats attack us? Do you think they've kidnapped William! Yes… that must be what happened!

quests.name: Balloons
quests.description: I'm grateful that you would assault people just to help me find my sweetheart. But I've remembered a bit more now, and I don't think they took him. We were playing a game… throwing darts at balloons to collect prize tickets. He was going to win a teddy bear for me. Let me watch you play for awhile… maybe it will help me remember more.

quests.name: Out of the Shadows
quests.description: We… finished playing the game. But he didn't win. My memory is getting cloudy again. Those shadows and imps are what's keeping me from remembering, I think. Why don't tehy want me to remember? Bring me their darkness and shadow. I'll shape it into something useful, instead.

quests.name: Follow the Footprints
quests.description: The shadows you brought me have become dark footprints, and they're heading east. Is that where we went after we finished playing games? We should follow them.

quests.name: Bright Idea
quests.description: Go to the Science Shop and speak to Cysero and Warlic. They will have figured out some way to balance you out. Please, let me know what they say.

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: These evil little moglins have been testing the town's defenses for weeks now, using every kind of contraption imaginable. There must be some spare parts lying around town that Warlic and Cysero can use.

quests.name: Power It Up
quests.description: Warlic has "batteries" on this list. The moglins use those to power all of their weapons and assault machines. I'm sure that you will be able to find several of them. All we need is 4 of them.

quests.name: Filthy Creatures
quests.description: Only one item left, a polarized magna-gem. Warlic has a crate of them but the moglins broke in and stole them to trade for machine parts. They might still have one or two. I'll help you look; whoever finds one first, bring it back here.

quests.name: Craft a Better Defense
quests.description: If you are going to survive the battle against the Chaos Harpy, you'll need a very strong ward! Find Alina in the Battleon. She will give you the recipe for a Shriekward Potion!

quests.name: Reflect the Damage
quests.description: To make the Shriekward Potion which will protect you, collect 5 Reflective Fragments from the Shard Spinners from the Earthstorm realm for a chance at a Perfect Prism.

quests.name: Pure Chaos, Corrupted Blood
quests.description: To make the Shriekward Potion which will protect you, collect 5 Vials of Blood from the Chaorrupted creatures in the Bloodtusk war for a chance at an Unchaorrupted Sample.

quests.name: Enemies of a Feather Flock Together
quests.description: To make the Shriekward Potion which will protect you, journey to the Bloodtuskwar zone to collect 5 feathers from Vultragons for a chance at a Harpy Feather.

quests.name: Ward Off The Beast
quests.description: If you wish to survive your battle with the Chaos Harpy, you'll need to protect yourself against its shrieks. Turn in all 3 ingredients to Alina and you will receive a stack of 10 Shriekward Potions

quests.name: Horror Takes Flight
quests.description: Battle the 2nd Beast of Chaos: the Harpy, to prevent it from terrorizing the innocent citizens of Lore!

quests.name: Good, Evil, and Chaos Battle!
quests.description: Battling a Chaos Lord who wants to kill AND save you will be tricky! Protect yourself and attack whenever the opportunity arises, or you'll be the first victim to fall to Chaos Lord Xiang!

quests.name: Slay the Wraiths
quests.description: Your time travel technique could use some work. The path you took through the space-time continuum has left an opening for Time Wraiths to come through. You know the danger they pose, do you not? Take responsibility for your error and slay them all.

quests.name: Spacetime
quests.description: There's a lot of Spacetime Energy floating around now. Gather a good amount of it, and then use it to close the rift you've left.

quests.name: Find Khasaanda
quests.description: Find Khasaanda. She, too, will know that you're here… and she will understand why. With her guidance, I will be able to make a decision on where we go from here.

quests.name: Find the Heart
quests.description: This forest is under attack, infested with the undead minions of the Army of Evil. Slay them and bring me their hearts so I can be certain they will not come back.

quests.name: Ooh, That Smell
quests.description: Rid the forest of elemental evil. It has become so strong here… that only happens when the world is out of balance. Help me get rid of it - collect it from any evil monster, and bring it back to me so the forest may heal.

quests.name: So Twisted
quests.description: Do you see how the world itself is becoming ill? The imbalance has made the forest and the trees within it twisted. Destroy the treeants that have been tainted with this evil.

quests.name: Purifying Flames
quests.description: We must purify the remains of those tainted treeants by burning them in a cleansing fire. This will ensure that they do not taint the ground when they return to it. Collect Purified Oil from the treeants that haven't been corrupted yet. Then, pour it on the woodpile and light it on fire.

quests.name: Return to Iadoa
quests.description: We should return to Iadoa now. I will let him know what I have seen, and what I believe we should do.

quests.name: Padma
