quests.description: Could I ask you a favor? La and Ti aren't finished teaching me how to read yet. Would you please read the names on Judgement's scroll for me? I'm curious about why some of them are crossed out with red and others are crossed out in white. Watch out for those hands trying to grab you while you're distracted.

quests.name: Maharaurava
quests.description: Are you able to hear the music the Trumpeters are playing? They're calling sinners to be judged so only the guilty would be able to hear them. My music won't be able to drown them out so you'll have to smack some of them.

quests.name: Raurava
quests.description: Judgement is also calling on the deceased Astravians to their duty as jurors. But to Darkon and the Scale, all Astravians are sinners. I think the roles are conflicting and making them run wild. Aah, one hit my guitar! Please help me shove them away!

quests.name: Avici
quests.description: Who are those humans and why are they allowed to be on Judgement's scroll? Oh no, you know them. Their names are among the deceased. Don't fall for it, they're not real! I'll play my music louder so you can't hear them. You have to move past these shades!

items_required.name: Head to the top of Judgement's Scroll

quests.name: Mahapadma
quests.description: When La sets her mind on a goal, there's no stopping her. But, I don't think she wants to raise a hand against you. Please don't hurt her either. We can stop and figure it out together!

quests.name: Between Two Worlds
quests.description: I'll be taking a stroll through the streets of Atlas like I did when King Zedek first took my hand. May we speak to Yara and Slaine before we go? I want to know their perspectives as we raise our blades at the same monster.

quests.name: Exodus of Dust
quests.description: Atlas and the Legion are brutalizing each other. My former subjects believe that they have the upper hand. Let your attendants herald destruction, and show these Knights and Mages your wrath.

quests.name: Impeccable Judgement
quests.description: The scholars who once welcomed me with false smiles are panicking, desperately turning to magic to save themselves. What remains of Ladon is nearby, struggling to hang on despite the loss of his body. Give them all what they deserve.

quests.name: Koinà Tà Phílon
quests.description: The Legionnaires have brought an urgent message from General Rand. He asks that you visit him in the colosseum. He is guarding something of great importance that belongs to Dage the Evil. We must ensure that it is properly protected.

quests.name: What Walks Ought to Crawl
quests.description: It's time to make our way back to the castle. Atlas' civilians and lions are prowling the streets. Their presence is binding the souls of the Legion. They stand when they ought to crawl. I beseech you, your Eminence. Rend these animals to dust.

quests.name: Vene Vidi Vici
quests.description: The Legion's Crimson Rider awaits you at the gates to the castle. He is the Horseman of War, trampling on the bones of the weak. He was sloppy, and left some alive. Speak to War, and wipe the rest of his plate clean.

quests.name: Exocannibalism
quests.description: Executioner Ladon's followers stole the bodies and strength of Draconians. They terrorized my companions before brutally taking their lives. They should die in terror, groveling at the feet of a true Dragon. Your Eminence, please…

quests.name: Condemnatio Purgatorio
quests.description: The Legion has made good on their promise. Atlas' numbers are culled, and many are left without vessels. Their Sundered Souls are drifting through the castle's halls. Condemn them to wander forever lost, and do the same to the cowardly Citizens that remain.

quests.name: Miserum Votum
quests.description: Atlas' final Princess stands in your way. I treated her like my own daughter, and she led me by the nose, knowing I was carrying her father's new vessel. Strike her down with divine retribution. Maleagant awaits beyond, still wearing Dage's armor.

quests.name: Dante to Beatrice
quests.description: General Slaine dragged Zedek out onto the roof of the castle. I hear him and Miss Yara trading blows. Your Eminence, there is no one left standing between Zedek and your divine judgement. I hope this hurts. I hope his pain lasts forever.

quests.name: Three Water Chestnuts
quests.description: Have you ever had a water chestnut? They are a favorite delicacy among the citizens of Akiba. Myself included. I have been craving water chestnuts every since we last met… and I was hoping if you could go find me some? The Yokai River is just east of here, and the Kappa and Funa-yurei there should know where to get some succulent water chestnuts… if they don't already have some themselves. Bring me back 3 Bushels of Water Chestnuts and I will reward you handsomely.

quests.name: Rainbow Shards
quests.description: I'm always up fer a trade. Bring me 5 tuffs of Prismatic Rat Fur From the Rainbow Rats in the Rainbow area and I'll give ye a Rainbow Shard!

quests.name: Lucky Clovers
quests.description: Looking for a Lucky Clover or two? Or twelve? If you bring 1 single Clover Leaf from Lucky Harms in the Rainbow area, I will trade you for a Lucky Clover! (Quest is only available if you do not do Reclaim the Research in the same day)

quests.name: Rainbow Shards - Leprechauns Only
quests.description: Ah, ye have the original Leprechaun Class on ye? Alright, I have a special quest for ye! Bring me 1 single tuft of Prismatic Rat Fur from the Rainbow Rats in the Rainbow area and I'll give ye a Rainbow Shard!

quests.name: Lucky Clovers - Leprechauns Only
quests.description: Always happy to see a Leprechaun at the fair. I have a special offer for ye. If you bring 1 single Clover Leaf from Lucky Harms in the Rainbow area, I'll might give ye 2 Lucky Clovers! (Quest is only available if you do not do Reclaim the Research in the same day)

quests.name: Get some Pelts
quests.description: Once we go into valley down below, it going to be COLD! Yetis have fur, but you don't - so we have to get you some. There Arctic Wolves just outside our cave. Their pelts would be perfect!

quests.name: Find the Sled
quests.description: It a long way down into the valley, so we have to go by sled. Grab a bag of supplies, then find the Wolf Sled and two Sled Wolves to pull it. After we have those things, we are ready to go!

quests.name: It's Sledding Time
quests.description: Now we take sled down into valley! We have to watch out for all the rocks and bushes on the way. Sled wolves won't avoid them on their own, so you have to show them where to go. When you are ready to go, the sled is outside the cave, and to the right.

quests.name: Gather Peppers
quests.description: Wow! It sure a lot colder down here! Ice Spitters around the lake grow something called Snow Peppers. Despite cold-sounding-name, they very hot! If we eat some, their heat will keep us warm. Bring back 8 of them - that 4 for each of us. That should be enough!

quests.name: Wood for Moknak
quests.description: Chillbite supposed to live on other side of that frozen lake. It not very stable, so we have to use snowshoes to get across it. Moknak can make some, if you bring some sturdy wood. Maybe from Frozen Treeants that wander the area?

quests.name: Cross the Ice
quests.description: We should be able to get across lake now! Like Moknak mentioned before, it not very stable. If you step on a crack, then ice could break, and you end up in freezing, cold water. So, be careful!

quests.name: Smash the Shards
quests.description: Chill Shards in this area are tiny pieces of Chillbite herself. If we smash enough of them, they reveal path that lead us to where she hiding. That how we'll find her.

quests.name: Make it to the Top
quests.description: Big cloud of frost is leading up that mountain! If we follow it, then we find Chillbite. Chillbite sure to be guarded by big hoard of Ice Golems, so we have to defeat them to make it all the way to top.

quests.name: Defeat Chillbite!
quests.description: This is it! Together, you and Moknak will defeat Chillbite, so she can be born again in time for new year! If we successful, then we full-fledged members of the Yeti tribe! If we don't… well, Moknak not want to think about that.

quests.name: Clueless
quests.description: Me follow rumors from all across Lore to this marsh. Me think that once there was great Mudluk Village here but need proof. Look around. See if you find clues.

quests.name: Filling In The Puzzle
quests.description: Those relics were a good start. They tell a tale of an ancient Mudluk village in this area but story is broken. Me need more fragments to understand. See if monsters in this marsh have more Relics on them!

quests.name: The Eyes (and Teeth) Have It
quests.description: This am no story! This am some sort of schematic! Me not sure but me think, if us follow directions, it will make a kind of compass, murp! Will lead us directly to an ancient Mudluk Weapon! First we need 30 Marsh Lurker Eyes. Come back when U have them all!

quests.name: Halfway There
quests.description: Murp! It working! The compass is coming together. Us just need a few more parts to make compass work! Need more parts. Need Mossy Bones from undead in the marsh and a vial of Shadow Serpent Venom. Come back when U done and me will finish compass.

quests.name: Charge It
quests.description: Great, murp! All that the compass needs now is a charge then us can activate it! To charge U will need positive and negative energies that U can get from defeating Thrax Ironhide and the Lesser Groglurk.

quests.name: What Was That?!
quests.description: That not how most compasses work…and did U hear that big noise? Sounded like something BLEW UP! Go look around and see what U can find.

quests.name: The Mudluk Vault
quests.description: Us not find a weapon…U found a whole VAULT! Please, me have to know what is in there but it will not be safe until the Vault Guardian is gone. You must defeat the Marsh Vault Guardian and make the vault safe!

quests.name: Recovering Mudluk History
quests.description: The Guardian has been defeated! I have to know what's in there! Can U please go and get whatever you can from in there and bring it to I. Me have to get my forge ready!

quests.name: Tempered Scrap
quests.description: Collect 10 Scrap Metals from Undead Berzerkers and transform them into a Tempered Scrap.

quests.name: Crystalized Fernos Shard
quests.description: You can gather 3 Fernos Goo from the Lesser Groglurk and condense them into a Shard of Crystalized Fernos.

quests.name: Ghoul Fire
quests.description: Combine 5 Ghoul Sparks from Ghouls to create a Ghoul Fire.

quests.name: Vault Guardian Heart
quests.description: Get 1 Rough Guardian Knot from the Mudluk Vault Guardian and turn it into a Vault Guardian Heart.

quests.name: Sampling Sips
quests.description: It's been awhile, my friend, and I want to make sure you're as good of a Moglin Berry Juice connoisseur as you once were. Collect 5 of the finest Juice Samplings from the native Moglin Berry Juice Vines to prove your talents.

quests.name: Glow with the Flambeaux
quests.description: We shall journey into the city vaults--but it is terribly dark and damp down there. We need something to light the way. Find the 2 flame Flambeaux from the Fire Performers in the streets.

quests.name: Nitre Fighter
quests.description: Blast! Nitre formations impede our path to the Amoglinado. Defeat 5 Nitre Elementals and knock down the giant Nitre Crystal wall.

quests.name: Spider Trouble
quests.description: Spiders--why does it always have to be spiders? Get rid of these 8-legged fiends so that we may sample the finest Moglin Berry Juice known to mankind!

quests.name: Coat of Harms
quests.description: What has happened here? My family's coat of arms has crumbled to pieces! Click on the pieces among all the bones to put it back together, and then we shall proceed.

quests.name: Break through the Wall
quests.description: What is hidden behind these walls? Could it the Cask of Amoglinado… or perhaps some other treasure? Break apart these walls until you find something.

quests.name: Search the Bones
quests.description: How curious… that bone pile over there… you should check it out.

quests.name: Defeat the Bone Terror
quests.description: Defeat the Guardian of the Amoglinado so that my story can be told. You won't be able to escape the book until you do!

quests.name: Proto-Chaos Beast Battle!
quests.description: You are about to meet the first Proto-Chaos Beast. I do not know more. My Master will need to explain this to you.

quests.name: ArcanRobe
quests.description: It takes more than a common needle and thread to craft such magical robes. Here in Arcangrove, the magi use the forces of nature to draw strength from everything… including their armor's stitching. The Seed Spitters in the area sometimes produce Arcane Thread, a great treasure amongst the magi. If you could bring me back 10 Spools of Arcane Thread, I could begin working on the newest mage robes.

quests.name: Ebony and Ivory Tusks
quests.description: You have seen the Gorillaphants in the area, have you not? These powerful beasts have massive tusks capable of ripping the inexperienced magi to shreds. For centuries, the magi have used their Tusks when forging magical weapons and staves, despite how hard it is to obtain them. Of I could just get 6 Gorillaphant Tusks, then I could start crafting new items for all the magi.

quests.name: Through the pass
quests.description: Head up into the mountains to see if you see can confirm that it is getting colder than usual. To do this, you will need to battle your way through the slowly closing mountain passes. If you can, bring back 10 Wolf Pelts so that we can examine them. If it is truly getting colder, the pelts should be thicker than before.

quests.name: Higher Passes
quests.description: The wolves pelts are definitely thicker than before. There are larger beasts than wolves roaming the mountains, but so few people return that we have not been able to get any information about them! Try to get as much information about these monsters as you can, and bring it back to me!

quests.name: Bears?
quests.description: The teeth, claw and pelts that you bought back from the higher passes suggest that the animal is a bear, but it is no bear that we have ever seen! The fur is silver and incredibly thick! See if you can find one of their dens to find out what makes them so special.

quests.name: In the Den
quests.description: Now that you have found the bears' den, go inside to see if you can find on them. This would seen to indicate that there are humans living up on the mountains with the bears! Try to find their settlement and get past their guards.

quests.name: The Camp
quests.description: There is an entire camp in the mountains, build around a series of hot springs? This must be how they have been able to survive, even though the weather is getting colder and colder. Perhaps the water in the springs will be able to release the cold from the Keep's stones. Speak to the inhabitants of the village to find out what they think.

quests.name: Fire from the Hole
quests.description: The Drumlins think that the water from the springs will help thaw the Keeps stones. Unfortunately, the springs are guarded by one of their own, but the water has had an incredible effect on him! Defeat the Ice Drumlinster to get a sack of water.

quests.name: 2.0 No!
quests.description: Mort translation: "Mechabinky & Raxborg have received some upgrades, and are now stronger than ever! You're going to need some help if you want to take them down… hehehehe!"

quests.name: Drakath Faced
quests.description: You must face Drakath now. Confront him in order to learn the identity of the 13th Lord of Chaos. All of Lore is counting on you!

quests.name: Who is the 13th Lord of Chaos?
quests.description: Confront Drakath to find out who the final Lord of Chaos will be!

quests.name: Feed Me
quests.description: Bring me a burning heart to feast upon. I may reward you.

quests.name: Let It Grow (Colder)
quests.description: Dage the Evil gives the most promising potential recruits incentives to join the Undead Legion at Frostval… but even THEY have to work for it! Slay Twisted Ice monsters in /FrozenTower and bring back 8 Frozen Life Essences.

quests.name: Legion Quest: Dark Knight of Frostval
quests.description: Twas the Dark Knight of Frostval, who decided to slay / Dage the Evil, believing the Legion's Lord was his prey. Bring back 10 Frozen Life Essences from the Twisted Ice Monsters in /frozentower so that Dage can forge a weapon to destroy him!

quests.name: Legion Quest: Coal for the Legion
quests.description: Good little heroes can expect presents on Frostval morning, but the warriors of the Undead Legion get a more… useful present - coal! They, in turn, gift it to Dage the Evil, to keep his forge fires burning. To thank them, Dage is most generous with the Legion Token rewards. Bring him 10 Giant Coal Lumps and 8 Small Coal Lumps from the monsters in /FrozenTower!

quests.name: Stairway to Haven
quests.description: The stairway to Haven has been, like, swarmed with monsters! It's not safe to go back up there until some of those monsters are gone. Can you go take care of 4 Grateful Undead and 4 Rock Lobsters for me, mun?

quests.name: Rolling Stones
quests.description: You've heard the saying "A rolling stone gathers no moss"? Well, stationary stones gather LOTS! Those Rock Lobsters keep shifting the mossy stones holding the stairway together around while they are looking for pebbles to eat. We NEED those mossy stones or the Stairway will collapse! Can you get 5 Mossy Stones from the Rock Lobsters and return here?

quests.name: Light My Fire
quests.description: Flying to Haven at night can be really dang'rous, mun. I us'lly light the Guide Fire so I can find my way to Haven in the dark but the fire has gone out since the monsters came! Those Grateful Undead have stol'n all the Brightburn Matches I need to light it. Can you see if you can get a Box of Brightburn Matches from them for me, mun?

quests.name: Knockin' on Haven's Door
quests.description: The only thing left to do is to show those Bruise Brothers who is boss. Once you've defeated both of them, head back here and let me know the coast is, like, clear.

quests.name: Spice it Up!
quests.description: My boy eats like a MAN! And manly Paladins like their food HOT! Find me some Spicy Wasabi from the Fire Elementals in Gilead so that Artix can eat his mother's sushi the way he likes it best!

quests.name: Turn out the lights.
quests.description: I just can't seem to turn off our lighting specialists. Someone must have tampered with the programming. Would you mind running around and shutting 6 of them down for me? That would be super awesome man!

quests.name: Warm up? No, Warm Down.
quests.description: The Pyrotechnicians always get all fired up after a show like that. Would you mind stepping into the back room and cooling off those hot-heads for me, I still need to pack up these wires.

quests.name: Get the Shinies!
quests.description: A special charm needs a special container! The Scorpion Cultists in the /catacombs use the most SPARKLY crystal bottles you've ever seen! We'll use those to spread our message of joy and WUB!

quests.name: Best Smell EVER!
quests.description: What smells better than anything in the world? Lotus Spider pollen! I bet you didn't know that, did you? We'll use some of that in our friendship charms, and then people will want to sniff them and sniff them and sniff them forever! Go to the cave of /wanders and you'll find some!

quests.name: Shimmer and Shine!
quests.description: Scales that SHINE and SHIMMER like the RAINBOW! What has them? Why, the Aether Serpents in the /dreamnexus, of course! We'll use those, and no one will EVER want to look away!

quests.name: Feel the WUB!
quests.description: Now, we put all of the pretties and smellies into the shiny bottles, and we give them all to our closest friends! Oh, how SQUISHY and FRIENDLY Battleon is about to become!

quests.name: Mother's Best Sushi Recipe
quests.description: I would LOVE to make my little Artix a special treat for the Harvest Fest! Please bring me 7 pieces of Raw Anglerfish Meat and 7 Merdraconian Scales from the Natatorium in ArcanGrove to wrap them in. No one makes sushi better than my little man's Momma!

quests.name: Help Professor Mueran
quests.description: To invert death, you need the building blocks of life. These are bones. I need you to bring me 25 bones from the skeletal soldiers in /castleundead. Do THAT, and you may be worth teaching.

quests.name: GreenGuard Standard
quests.description: Across Lore, you will find numerous methods to invert death. None are as worthy as the necromancy practiced with Darkness. The Greenguard standard for necromancers has always been entrenched in dark arts. None can compare. There are fine specimens in /dragonbone. Defeat Bone Dragonlings and Dark Fire. Those will be our subjects of study.

quests.name: Bejeweled Blade
quests.description: I love to collect rare things! Battle the monsters in Guru Forest, the Cemetery and in Lolosia to recover the 6 Jewels of Zanteria: Red, Blue, Green, Clear, Yellow and Purple! Bring 1 of each to me and I will construct a Bejeweled Blade just for you!

quests.name: Monday... Bone Mace!
quests.description: It is time for Monday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Mace… bring it to me. It might just be a Bone Mace! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.M. 10%)

quests.name: Tuesday... Broom of Doom!
quests.description: It is time for Tuesday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Broom… bring it to me. It might just be a Broom of Doom! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.Broom)

quests.name: Wednesday... Faerie Sai!
quests.description: It is time for Wednesday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Sai.. bring it to me. It just might be a Faerie Sai! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.S 10%)

quests.name: Thursday... Speargun!
quests.description: It is time for Thursday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Weapon… bring it to me. It might just be a Speargun! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.W 10%)

quests.name: Friday... Liquid Hot Magma Axe!
quests.description: It is time for Friday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Axe… bring it to me. It just might be a Liquid Hot Magma Axe! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.A. 10%)

quests.name: Saturday... Chakram Dagger!
quests.description: It is time for Saturday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Dagger… bring it to me. Itmight justjust might be a Chakram Dagger! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.D. 10%)

quests.name: Sunday... Sludge Sword!
quests.description: It is time for Sunday's rare item hunting quest! If you find a Rare Unidentified Sword… bring it to me. It might just be a Sludge Sword! (Note: You must have this quest in order to get the R.U.S. 10%)

quests.name: Murry's Revenge
quests.description: The Inquisitors try to make it seem like they are good guys. They brainwash everyone from simple farm villagers to mayors of towns and even kings! But I know the truth! They tortured me! For years, they slapped me— with fish! And worse things, like innocent purple slimes. I need revenge! Can you get me some? Bring me back 8 Inquisitor Guard Pauldrons!

quests.name: Crusaders Schmusaders
quests.description: The guards treated me badly, but the worst of the bunch are the Crusaders! Even worse is the Grand Inquisitor himself, since he hardly ever leaves the Citadel! The Crusaders are the most zealous of them all, and take the most joy in suspending me upside down in a bucket of Horc sweat! Show me you mean business by bringing me 4 Crusader Gauntlets!

quests.name: Bad Captains
quests.description: The Crusaders and the Guards had the most "hands-on" part in my torture, but the Captains are the ones who gave the orders! How about we--uh, YOU--go give them a piece of my mind?!! Bring me 2 Captain's Insignia and I will be in your debt (minus interest, of course)!

quests.name: Which Witch is Which?
quests.description: The Inquisitors persecute any and all of us who use magic! Mages, healers, wizards, and even witches are all included. They tell all the normal folk that magic is bad! There are many witches outside right now who are in a very bad predicament - Rescue 7 of them! Bring me 7 Witches' Gratitude to prove you did it.

quests.name: Murry's Hunch
quests.description: No, not the hunch in my back!! THIS is the hunch I mean: I think the Grand Inquisitor is up to something--He has always been very secretive, and I'm sure he doesn't tell the whole truth to all of his followers. While in captivity, I saw the Guards and Crusaders all carrying little devices that I can only call Mana Vacuums--that they seems to use to suck magic power right out of myself and other prisoners! Bring me 10 of those stupid vacuums--just to get them off the street! I hate those things!

quests.name: Magic Overload!
quests.description: Hmm… these vacuums make me wonder what the Inquisitors do with it all once they collect it! So I took one apart— it looks like they funnel the magic into little orbs that hold it, and compress it, making it even more powerful! I wish I could do that! I hear that the archmage Warlic can actually do something like that— with just his mind! Anyway, go get me 5 of those Mana Amplifiers. If I'm right, then the Grand Inquisitor is collecting magic for himself, and not just destroying it! If you succeed I will make you one of my staves!

quests.name: Grand Inquisitor's Surprise Visitor
quests.description: Wheee! You destroyed the Magic Devouring Beast! Now it's up to you to give the Grand Inquisitor a taste of his own medicine! That hypocrite has been saying magic is bad for years, and building up hatred among normal folk toward mages, but all the while he was stealing magic from us to use for his own evil purposes! Go kick his butt, friend! Bring me his fine silken gloves when you do ;)

quests.name: Summoning Complete
quests.description: The Inquisitor isn't very perceptive on the concept of time but he finally finished the summoning! Belrot the Fiend answered the Inquisitor's call! Hero, you must go defeat the beast of destruction before all magic is hunted down and drained from this land. Bring me back Belrot's head so we can be certain of it's demise.

quests.name: Grand Inquisitor's Penance
quests.description: You have destroyed the fiend summoned by the Grand Inquisitor! How brave and mighty you are! It has fallen to you to face the Grand Inquisitor himself now. He must be stopped to ensure that the Inquisitors cannot continue. Chop off the head, and the body will die! Bring me the Grand Inquisitor's Ring of Evil Intent to prove you bested him.

quests.name: Summer Castle Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, would you mind helping me collect accounts from the Nobility's Knights? They might be tight-lipped at first, but are more than willing to trade information for a spar with you.

quests.name: Lightguard's Allegiance Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, would you mind helping me collect accounts from the Lightguard Paladins? Their opinions will be biased, so I'll be including information from other sources.

quests.name: Pureblood Skye Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, would you mind helping me collect accounts from Skye's Warriors? I want to know if my own knowledge is up to date. It's been…oh dear, a century and a half since I've visited them.

items_required.name: Skye Warrior Interview x3 (Stacks up to 15)

quests.name: Champions of Energy Scroll
quests.description: ﻿I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. The first Champion of Energy was Gaheris, who discovered Skye and became its King. It would be helpful if we could hear about him from the denizens of Skye themselves. Would you please bring me the account of Skye Executors?

quests.name: Bananach Raven's Scroll
quests.description: ﻿I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. The Bananach Ravens are only found in Skye, but I believe the name "Bananach" has been mentioned outside of the Land of Heroes. If we could listen to the Raven's caws, I'd be able to look into the matter more closely.

quests.name: Leanan Sidhe Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records, but this is a bit different. Leanan Sidhe has been spotted in Eblana. Would you mind observing her for a while, and taking notes? A firsthand account will help me understand this mysterious fairy better.

items_required.name: Leanan Sidhe Observed x1 (Stacks up to 3)

quests.name: Yew Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, could you bring me samples from the Elder Yew in /Loughshine? They couldn't have grown sentience on their own. I would like to know how they came to be.

quests.name: Energy Element Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, would you mind collecting accounts from the Energy Elementals in /Loughshine? They are born as embodiments of their element, but slowly gain sentience the longer they interact with Lore.

quests.name: Naoise and Deirdre Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, could you investigate the Bone Dragonlings in /NaoiseGrave? You would be looking for clues that hint at Skye's Dragonkind interacting with Dragonlords.

quests.name: Great Dragon of Energy Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, could you investigate the Dragon trapped in /NaoiseGrave? With Lady Celestia in the area, there's a chance that this being of great renown would be willing to answer a few questions.

quests.name: Hero's Daisy Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, could you investigate the ghosts and Undead in /LiaTaraHill? Daisies grow in large numbers in Skye's battlefields, and I'm curious as to why.

quests.name: Energy Necromancy Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, could you investigate the Warden of South Skye, Illaria? I learned that she is a skilled Mage, and some of her teachers were Energy Necromancers. There's little information about that type of sorcery in Greenguard.

items_required.name: Illaria's Medicine Pocket x1 (Stacks up to 3)

quests.name: Thundersnow Scroll
quests.description: I am compiling notes and interviews for my records. If you have a moment, could you investigate the Thundersnow Storm in /CastleGaheris. The interplay of snow and lighting is fascinating. I wonder if Skye's royal family has a connection to Lord Kyanos in addition to Lord Haeos.

quests.name: Man in the Middle
quests.description: This won't be the usual type of investigation, and it's unrelated to my records. I think someone's trying to get your attention in specific. The Hybrid Elementals left in /CastleGaheris are carrying stones that I need to open a magically sealed envelope with your name on it.

quests.name: The Stars Foretell
quests.description: I saw a vision written in the stars, and I am… afraid. So much of what comes next depends on what YOU do. Here, now, and in the near future. I need to write it all down, but I need new tools. Bring me 5 Wyvern skins, 1 Chimera feather, and 3 Stalker Tentacles.

quests.name: Sorry, Skudly
quests.description: You got Skudly to unlock your cell door - but you're going to have to knock him out if you don't want to be locked up again!

quests.name: A Friend In Need
quests.description: Well, you're out of the dungeon - now what? SOMEONE must know the way out of here - maybe you can find some sort of ally who can help.

quests.name: Trial of the Vessel (Weekly Quest)
quests.description: This quest cannot be completed if you have already completed the "Echoes of a Forgotten Fate" quest this week.

quests.name: Echoes of a Forgotten Fate (Weekly Quest)
quests.description: This quest cannot be completed if you have already completed the "Trial of the Vessel" quest this week.

quests.name: Mysterious!
quests.description: You never know what you'll find in a shop like mine… or what is lying to you. What you NEED are Truth Glasses! And wouldn't you know, the Chaotic ShadowScythe Aliens stole my last pair! While you're here, destroy 13 of the Darkness Ghosts living inside them.

quests.name: The Lost Teacher
quests.description: Hello, Hero. You don't know me, and you might never figure out who I am, but I am here to offer you a weapon worthy of an extraordinary hero, if you can uncover my clubes. Your lesson begins back at the start. Find the tutor, follow your heart.

quests.name: Big Gold Coins
quests.description: Next up, find me a giant gold coin. Where, you ask? I'm testing you. The teacher doesn't give out the answers on a test!

quests.name: Light as a Feather
quests.description: Bring me a feather. A specific feather. You'll know it when you feel it.

quests.name: Shard Shard Shard
quests.description: To complete the quest, I will need a fragment of armor. A very special armor. Your hunt may take you high or low, through light or dark.

quests.name: White Scales, Light Scales
quests.description: That last one was kind of obvious. Your objective for this next one will not be quite so… obvious or colorful. Now. What is white and has scales all over? I will draw no conclusions for you.

quests.name: The Stench of Defeat
quests.description: You must always rise above despair… and ignore what might distract you from your goals. Like smells. There are some VERY bad smells lingering in the forts and keeps of Lore.

quests.name: If you can't stand the heat...
quests.description: Stay away from dragons! Though you would be wise to remember that - their hoards contain many treasures, both dark and bright.

quests.name: The Depths of Despair
quests.description: Four lessons in one - Do not underestimate your opponent. Still waters run deep, and a good enemy hides their emotions well. Honor those who have come before you… but did not succeed. Learn from their defeats.

quests.name: All Things Green and Small...
quests.description: Good heroes possess stamina and endurance. They never overlook the usefulness of even the simplest creatures.

quests.name: Doom... Or Redemption?
quests.description: Without darkness, there can be no light. Without a fall, there can be no redemption. Find the lost one and claim your reward… or Doom awaits!

quests.name: The Mysterious Reward
quests.description: Have you guessed the nature of your reward yet? No? Then you ARE doomed. Now. I give you an easy one, after all that work. Find me in the Inn! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Mana-Infused Weapons
quests.description: Welcome, Hero. You wish to have some of my gear? Very well. But you must help me and my cause first. There are very particular weapons in this world that OOZE mana. It's despicable! The weapons of the late Black Knight. Bring them to me! I will see to their destruction!

quests.name: Vengeance and Revengence (Member)
quests.description: Legendary Hero! I have a job for you. Some of our men have fallen in the field. I need to to collect their weapons and destroy them so that our enemies can't trace them back to us! While you are at it, collect some intel on our new enemy… The Silent Sentinels.

quests.name: Suspects
quests.description: There are six people who checked in tonight… And one of them has to be the culprit. Explore the bedrooms, bathrooms and hallways to discover the main suspects and then come back to me.

quests.name: Magical Weapons
quests.description: Great job on making a list of the suspects! But whoever summoned the monsters had to have used a powerful, magical weapon! There are SIX magical weapons on display in my Inn. I can’t remember the names of them, but they can be found in the hallways! After you have a list come back to me.

quests.name: Whodunit?
quests.description: As I was running from the monsters, I seem to have dropped my keys in the process. The only way to get into the NINE main rooms is with those keys! Within the NINE rooms, you will find one of my trusted employees that may have clues as to whodunit.

quests.name: Dream Truffles
quests.description: Hey! Got a minute to help me with the fluffy cuties? It’s almost time for lunch, but I’m out of food. They like Dream Truffles, which you can get from the Nightspores you’ll find roaming around.

quests.name: Product
quests.description: Hi, I can't thank you enough for helping us. It's been too long since I've been cutting hair. If you want to help while I get things going, you can gather some Hair Gel from Glow Worms for me! I'd owe you one.

quests.name: Earn Your Stripes
quests.description: You know what I miss? My barber pole! A barber shop needs a red and white striped barber pole! I think i saw an Albino Bat flying off with it a few weeks ago. Think you can find it for me?

quests.name: Stay Sharp
quests.description: Drat! All my razors have gone dull and rust from disuse. I can clean the rust off but I need new whetstones to sharpen them. Those shouldn't be too hard to find under the mountain but I go through a lot. Think you can find 10 whetstones for me?

quests.name: Get Us Some Business!
quests.description: One last thing. I think all three of us are just about ready to open shop but nobody will risk coming back to the market with all these monsters around. Clear out 20 monsters and make it safe for everyone and we'll start opening up!

quests.name: A Lovely Quest-ion (Daily)
quests.description: As a Hollowborn, I'm curious about the Shadows that led to my second lease on life. Could you do me a Lovely Favor and a number of Lovely Requests? Defeat the Shadowlord in /Shadowrealm, and all of the other creatures that reside there.

quests.name: A Lovely An-Sewer
quests.description: I heard there were Pink Rats in a Pink Sewer somewhere. Do me another favor, and shake them down for Love Reagents. Trust me, they're teeming with love, and it's not just because they're pink.

quests.name: Chrono Dracomancer's House
quests.description: To stabilize the timestream around your new home, bring back an hourglass of Chrono Energy from the Time-Travel Fairies in /timevoid.

quests.name: Kill Nastasia
quests.description: Even though Nastasia is Jagger's One True Love, he cannot let her destroy the world! Destroy Nastasia for the sake of Lore!

quests.name: Gravelyn Stops Nastasia!
quests.description: When people die, they stay dead. That is the natural order. That is MY order. They growl. They kill. They eat nasty things. They do NOT go looking for their lost loves. And YOU are not going to change that.

quests.name: Thou Shalt Not Pass
quests.description: To descend into the shadows, you must first disperse the shadows' Guardians. Slay the 3 Shadowstone Elementals in the room to continue on.

quests.name: Blinded by the Darkness
quests.description: Darkness overwhelms you as you step into the pit of despair. Take care that the denizens of the Dark - the Shadow Imps - do not slay YOU! Send 6 of the Shadow Imps back to their nether world and place 6 Beacons of Bright Light in the tunnel to drive out the Dark.

quests.name: The Tale Never Dies
quests.description: Weberich, famous author of Sepulchure's tale, lingers here in the depths of the Necropolis. Restore his tools to him and perhaps he'll have another tale to tell! Bring him 5 vials of Shadow Ink from imps, 1 Inkstone from the Shadowstones, and hunt for his quill and 3 pieces of parchment!

quests.name: Doom Outside the Dome
quests.description: If you would enter the Dome of Light ahead, you will need a key. No ordinary key, this piece of Obsidian stolen by the Shadowstone Elementals emits a tone which resonates in tune with the sonic-glass of the dome. You will be allowed to enter… IF you have the key.

quests.name: Last Bastion of Light
quests.description: I am plagued by the Shadow Creatures who keep invading my park! Juniata Park is MY home… my only home, and the last place left where Light holds sway. Please, Hero, I would be so grateful if you could remove 4 of the imps and 3 of the Shadowstone creatures. I - I fear for the Light I have left!

quests.name: Shadowy Corruption
quests.description: I must keep eternal watch over the shadow creatures who would destroy my home. If you would help me defend my home, I would be grateful! Pour these 5 vials of elixir around the perimeter of my dome, and I am certain that the darkness will find no refuge here!

quests.name: Strength of the Darkness
quests.description: The night is Dark and full of terrors… like the Shadow Dragon that awaits you. So long as its heart beats, the drawbridge will securely raised. Slay the beast and your path to the Shadowstone Support which holds up the Necropolis will be clear.

quests.name: Bring Down the Necropolis
quests.description: This is the stone column which bears the weight of the entire Necropolis. If you have enough strength and fortitude to shatter it, the entire structure will collapse! Be warned, though. The Necropolis would not rest on something fragile; you will need determination to break this load-bearing rock!

quests.name: Descent into Darkness
quests.description: To enter the depths of the Necropolis, blood, sweat and bones are required. For each Skeletal Bellhop you slay, you'll descend one floor lower. Kill 10 Bellhops on this first foray into the darkness.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 1
quests.description: You may be on a mission for the Empress of the ShadowScythe, but the Necropolis Soldiers do not bow to her. Slay 7 of them and find the Page 1 of Sepulchure's History to pass!

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 2
quests.description: It never hurts to bring an Empress tribute, and if you return with 5 Gilded Slimeskulls, Gravelyn will only be more appreciative. Bring back the Gilded Skulls, and retrieve Page 2 of Sepulchure's History!

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 3
quests.description: These Slimeskulls are vicious! Squash 8 of the slime sentries and try not to get any on Page 3 of Sepulchure's History!

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 4
quests.description: If you are to find the FULL truth of Sepulchure's past, you will need to descend deeper into the Necropolis. Kill the 4 Ghoul Guardians and take the Slimed Elevator Key from the Necropolis Soldier. Do not leave without finding Page 4 of Sepulchure's History!

quests.name: Deeper into Darkness
quests.description: Every step on a journey requires energy. Descending into the Necropolis is not different. The psychic energy from the deaths of 10 Bellhops will fuel the elevators drop down 10 more floors.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 5
quests.description: Hope is never lost, but its light may be dimmed in the dark. Place 3 Beacons of Hope in this chamber, and prevent 3 Slimeskulls and 4 Necropolis Soldiers from extinguishing their light. Do not advance without finding Page 5 of Sepulchure's History.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 6
quests.description: Bonedust is said to have many great properies, including that of hastening growth and healing. It would be wise to collect the vials you find here, along with locating Page 6 of Sepulchure's History.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 7
quests.description: It is said that the beast which guards the Monster Subway has a fondness for Slimeskulls. Kill 9 Slimeskulls and cover yourself in their scent. If you are lucky, perhaps the Doomcrawler will not fight you… as hard. Page 7 of Sepulchure's History will be found in this room; do not leave without it.

quests.name: Monster Subway Ahead!
quests.description: The Doomcrawler guards the entrance to the Monster Subway, and the only way to board the Subway Crawler and get from this wing of the Necropolis to the next is to slay it! If you are lucky, the DoomCrawler will not have eaten Page 8 of Sepulchure's History, so make sure to look for it.

quests.name: Underground RailRoad... to DOOM!
quests.description: You must ride the Subway Crawler, but it will not carry you without incentive. It is ever hungry, and always happy to eat its passengers! Kill 8 Ghouls for Crawler Feed and place the bits by the Crawler's head. I believe one of the pages of Sepulchure's History is stuck to its carapace.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 10
quests.description: If you would continue on in the quest the Empress has set you, you must secure the Key from the Necropolis Soldier guarding the Elevator's door. Do not fail to find Page 10 of Sepulchure's History, or the Empress will rage.

quests.name: The Deepest Descent
quests.description: I am sure you are familiar by now, Hero, with what must be done. Those who travel through the Necropolis must pay the toll. Slay 10 Bellhops, and you will be free to exit into the final section of the Necropolis.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 11
quests.description: The darkness enfolds you, overwhelms you, filling your senses, taking over your mind. Or it would, if you let it. Hero, place 5 Beacons of Hope in this chamber. They will light your way to success and show you where Page 11 of Sepulchure's History lies!

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 12
quests.description: Your journey is almost at an end, the History almost complete. The penultimate page waits to be found, but the Necropolis Soldiers guarding this hall will not let you search in peace! Slay a squad of 7 to ensure you may search uninterrupted.

quests.name: Retrieve the Past, Room 13
quests.description: The last battle waits in the next chamber. If you would succeed, it is recommended that you come with an offering. Strewn about the floor lay 5 Dracolich Teeth, stolen from us in our youth. Return them and you may yet survive to see the light of a new day. The last History page may be found here, as well.

quests.name: Fives Times the Fury
quests.description: The Guardians of the Gate waits for you, Hero. A binding vow was made before you were born, and it shall not be forsworn. The Gate can be opened, but hearts-blood is the oil that must grease its hinges.

quests.name: The Past Will Haunt You
quests.description: Enter the tomb to understand Sepulchure's motivation. Inspect the effigy and read the inscription. Take word of your journey and the Diary you have gathered back to the Empress.

quests.name: Claws and Effect
quests.description: Are you a cat perso–erm, pony–or a dog pony? Barn cats usually make great companions to horses and ponies, so it's crazy to see these kitties hiss-terical. Many cats wander freely around Magic Meadow, so go find one and show 'em who's boss before a cat-tastrophe happens!

quests.name: Dog and Pony Show
quests.description: Dogs and pups normally get along great with ponies… but don't let their adorable exterior fool you today! These canines need to know who the top dog – pony? – is around here: YOU!

quests.name: Fine Vulpine
quests.description: Ohmygosh foxes are soooooo stinkin' cute aren't they? Although I'm pretty sure foxes would eat a chinchilla at first glance, so best to keep them at bay. But! You can go fight a fox with the power of puzzles and enjoy their adorableness on my behalf.

quests.name: Feathered Foray
quests.description: This meadow wouldn't be as magical without the sweet symphony of chirping birds filling the air. There are so many pretty birds mingling with the vibrant wildflowers that it's almost a shame to defeat them in a heated puzzle battle. But hey, don't worry – you won't ruffle their feathers too much! *whinnies*

quests.name: Carot Quest
quests.description: Are you ready for a hare-raising quest? Hop along the winding paths throughout Magic Meadow and find an adorable bunny to do a puzzle battle with!

quests.name: Funguy
quests.description: Mmm mmm mmm! Mushrooms are sooo yummy! And they're soooo adorable, too – at least, the ones in the Magic Meadow are. I hear that mushrooms are fun guys to play puzzles with, so go see if the rumors are true. If you haven't found a mushroom yet, maybe you can find one in the secret hidden cavern!

quests.name: Bone Voyage
quests.description: Woah – hold your horses! You're telling me you saw SKULLS hangin' around Magic Meadow?! That's so strange… I wonder what brought them back from the undead? Sounds like there's spooky stuff afoot! Erm, a-hoof. You know what to do, pony pal!

quests.name: The Pearly Gaits
quests.description: This Key must be the key to unlocking the Pearly Gates! Or 'gaits' because, ya'know, horse puns… *whinnies* But! In all seriousness! You must go through those gates and put an end to whatever is causing this adorable nightmare!

quests.name: The Purrrfect Crime
quests.description: The graveyard was once a peaceful resting ground to the souls lost to the depths of Time. But as you can see, strange undead creatures have flourished near these sacred tombs. I am just a fragile kitty, and I am not strong enough to destroy all of them myself… hence why am I asking you. A new species of Yokai have appeared called Skello Kitty. Investigate these strange creatures by finding out their story… by collecting 10 Skello Kitty Tails.

quests.name: The Face Off
quests.description: A bunch of Ninja and Samurai Nopperabo have invaded these sacred lands. I do not know where they came from, and to be honest, I do not really care, either. They are trespassing nuisances, as far as I am concerned. Hunt the Nopperabo and bring me back 8 of their faceless Faces—4 from the Ninja and 4 from the Samurai.

quests.name: Fearsome Forest Fabrics
quests.description: Ooh, you wanna help me make some costumes? Super! I could really use some help—being a store owner AND costume maker keeps me busy every second of every day! But if you wanna help me out a bit on a daily basis, I'll be sure to make it worth your while. I need 5 Spools of Spider Silk Thread from the black Spiders in Greenguard Forest and 4 Patches of Suede from the Leatherwings in Guru Forest. Bring me back these items when you're finished, okay? Hehe, thanks!

quests.name: Colors of the World
quests.description: Man, I could stare at this sky all day! But I’m not seeing a way out of here. I guess we’ll have to make our own. Maybe if you bring us some colors, we can paint a way out.

quests.name: A Painted Bridge
quests.description: The Dream Wisp has painted us a bridge - let's cross it and see what comes next!

quests.name: NeoChaos DoomBlade's Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge all of your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Awesomeness.

quests.name: You'll need a Spellbook!
quests.description: The next thing you'll need is your very own spellbook. You'll need something to record your spells in before you can cast them! Unfortunately, we gave out our last one before you got here. But that's ok! You should be able to get some arcane parchment from the Undead in /graveyard, and we can bind them together with the Silver Runethread that I saw left on the floor in the Main Hallway. It might still be near Sora to Hoshi

quests.name: Enchanted Inks for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Hmm, the Royal Alchemy Academy should have brought me another batch of Enchanted Ink by now. You wouldn't happen to be from the Alchemy Academy would you?

quests.name: Lesser Salves for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Have you brought me salves for making? I bet you didn't know these salves can be mixed into inks allowing the ink to gain magical properties. I bet you also didn't know that the better the salve the BETTER THE INK!

quests.name: Runic Salves for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Have you returned from the Alchemy Academy? I am expecting more Runic Salves for my scrolls. Properly mixed salves allowing us to capture powerful spell in mere ink and paper.

quests.name: Blood Signature
quests.description: You can do more than capture spells in ink and paper. There are ways to prevent others from casting your unique magic! I know of several methods, but let's tackle the simplest. /Bloodrun is a great place to get vampire blood samples. Oh, I guess this kind of reagent hunting wouldn't be easy for other students.

quests.name: Defeat the Chaos Challenger
quests.description: You have seen what is waiting for you near the caves… now go get him!

quests.name: Looking for a Good Hero
quests.description: Please, Hero! If you really ARE as Good as you can be, take word to your uncle, Sir Rated, in Swordhaven's Castle! Gramma won't think we'll ask HIM for help. She HATES him. She always threatens to drench his dreams in acid-blood when they meet. Maybe HE can save us untill Gramma is gone! Get my locket back from the pirate and bring it to him!

quests.name: Don't Regret the Evil
quests.description: We need someone with an Evil lack of conscience. Someone who can threaten the most innocent being in Lore - our cousin. We love her, but the Nightmare Child, she just won't stop SCREAMING in her dreams! Get my locket back from the pirate and bring it to her to prove we are related! Convince her by any means necessary that we have not forgotten her!

quests.name: A Cryptic Message
quests.description: You could escape the castle, if you want. But if you leave now, you won't be able to prevent Dr.Darkwood's from realizing his Lore-shattering end game. Keep going forward, into the vault. All of the answers you need can be found there.

quests.name: Beautician Magician
quests.description: I am a magician when it comes to beautician! But to master such styles, I need the proper hair products.Fetch me:

quests.name: Gotta Get Out
quests.description: We can’t stay in this bedroom! We’ve got to find a way to get out of here and see what we can find beyond it. Maybe with enough hot air, we can float someplace else.

quests.name: Lighter Than Air
quests.description: Hey, I feel so light, I bet we can walk on those lighter clouds now! Let’s see where they take us.

quests.name: The Perception of Inception
quests.description: Heeeeeehehehe! These creatures of the Nightmare, they don't play right, stranger! Their dreams are hidden from me, so how I will what games they want to play? Remove the mental defenses from 50 of the Nightmare SkyPirates; then i can share with them MY dreams, and make sure they have as much fun as I do here in the Maze!

quests.name: Twilightmare Laughter
quests.description: Everyone is so quiet, stranger. No laughter, no songs, no screams.. the silence echoes and it makes my heart hurt. Teehee, it hurts like the firecandy I tasted at my first Summer Festival! But.. there is no Summer here. Play with 250 of the Nightmare Pirates here; see if they are still capable of laughting

quests.name: Midnight Screams, Broken Dreams
quests.description: I want to go to HOME! Take me HOME! I- I can't get hoooooome. There's no way to get home, but.. maybe YOU could help me, stranger! Teeheehee, I know how you can help! Bring me 500 pieces of Dreamglass those SkyPirates have.

quests.name: The Beast Awakens
quests.description: Now that you've been informed about the situation, I'll allow you free passage between my realm and yours. Before we can defeat this… Nightmare Carnax, we must first learn about how it rises, and how to stop it. You've fought this beast before- or at least, a simulacrum of it. Go fight it again, and glean some information.

quests.name: Nightmare Containment Field
quests.description: It seems like as long as there are those who remember it, the beast will be able to regenerate itself. Thankfully for us, it doesn't seem to be generating multiple bodies. So, while we cannot kill it, I think we can find a more permanent way to seal it. Bring me the supplies so that I can begin the ritual. Bring me the mane of a Nightmare in Deadmoor, Chitin of a NightWyrm in the City of Dreams, Sheer Horror from All Fears in that bounty hunter's wonderful Fear House, and the horn of a certain nightmare-ish Unicorn from the Doom Vault.

quests.name: The Last Stand
quests.description: The beast will not go quietly. It is confused, scared, and over 300 feet tall. I'll need you to weaken it so that it does not resist the sealing. However, be cautioned that the sealing spell is a one way entry- once you go in, you'll have to defeat the beast, or find your own way out. Battle the beast and take apart its nightmarish visage.

quests.name: Carnax Falls (Badge Quest)
quests.description: The beast has been subdued again. Whether forever, or only for a time, only the future will tell.

items.name: Nightmare Carnax Boss Character Page Badge

quests.name: Liebestraume No. 3
quests.description: Who do you think you are? A martyr that sacrifices everything for your love? Oh poor you, getting to live in a castle, pampered by a Prince. You're just a maggot that ate off of Darkon. You grew into a fly that buzzed around him for his status and luxurious life. Soon, you'll be crawling on his corpse. Go, see what you've done to him. Try to fight the truth. I dare you.

quests.name: Free Niknak
quests.description: They lock me in here! Can you believe it? But you help me, though, right? Those big shadowy guys, you see them? One of them will have the key. Find it, get me out!

quests.name: Afraid of Shadows
quests.description: So many shadowy monsters - shadowy monsters all over the place! But you big, strong. You get rid of them for us, won't you?

quests.name: Wood for Splints
quests.description: Other friend need help. Sent me out to get the supplies he need. First thing, get wood for making splint. Get it from those tree-monsters, yeah? They look bad but their wood strong.

quests.name: First Aid
quests.description: Need medicine too now, ok? I sneak into the old apothecary and take the stuff I need, but then these shadow-things steal it from me! You fight them, get it back! The little ones, they the ones who took it.

quests.name: Delivery Time
quests.description: You take this stuff to my friend now, yeah? They hiding out at the inn. Go inside, then upstairs, you find them.

quests.name: Dive Right In
quests.description: If you wish to save The Natatorium, then you must be aware of your surroundings. This is a whole new world for you, is it not? The water is nothing like dry land, and it would be wise to travel The Natatorium far and wide. Gather 12 Chaorrupted Coral that has appeared abundantly throughout our sanctuary ever since Ledgermayne made its grand appearance…

quests.name: Seafood Diet
quests.description: When Merfolk see food, we eat it. The Angler Fish have satisfied our palates for many moons, but with the lack of Merfolk to hunt, our food reserves have grown thin. I have faith that you can save The Natatorium and obtain the Runes of Riparian… but first we desperately need food. Hunt and gather 20 Angler Filets to fill our hungry stomachs.

quests.name: Mercenaries
quests.description: I always wonder why Merdraconians … HEY FAT! Yes, the Merdraconians have turned on me, growing fat with rage and a new set of armor. I can't bring myself to attack my own kin, which is why I am asking you. Please, Hero, you must save them from Ledgermayne's power! Rescue 12 Merdraconians by draining their power completely.

quests.name: Synchronized Slaying
quests.description: I need to ask one more favor before I send you to retrieve the Runes of Riparian. Some monsters in Arcangrove have taken precious living coral from our home. If they are not returned, the coral will surly die. Collect 5 Brain Coral from the Gorillaphants and Seed Spitters in Arcangrove, then travel to The Cloister and bring me 4 Staghorns from the Acornets, 3 Sea Fans from the Karasu, and 1 Sea Whip from the dreaded Wendigo. Finally, make your way to Mudluk Village and collect 6 Anemones from the Swamp Lurkers and Frogdrakes. Best of luck to you, Hero, and please hurry.

quests.name: The Deep End
quests.description: It is time to retrieve the Runes of Riparian. A great beast by the name Nessie has guarded them for ages, hidden inside the giant sunken ship. If you wish to enter, you must use The Natatorium's natural currents to push the Statues onto selected runes. Once you have managed to place 3 Statues on the 3 Rune formations, the gate to Nessie's hideout will open…and the rest is up to you…

quests.name: Flew the Coop
quests.description: Augh! My pets have escaped again! It's so hard to keep your animals from getting lose when they can fly! Please, can you get them back for me? They can be a little vicious, so you might have to subdue them first.

quests.name: Pooper Scooper
quests.description: While you're out there, would you mind picking up some of the escaped hounds' droppings? I'll get fined if I leave it on the street, but I can't leave my store unattended. (only works once per login)

quests.name: Flying Rats
quests.description: I have a bird problem. Those rock doves keep eating the food I set out for my animals, and to add insult to injury they're stealing all my pet toys! Please get rid of these birds however you can, and see if you can find some of my squeaky toys, too. (only works once per login)

quests.name: Running a Stable Stable
quests.description: Ever tried running a pet store, pal? It's a lot of responsibility… and a lot more cleanup. And I could reaaallllly use some fresh bedding for my critters. If you bring back 12 Piles of Sand,anda handful of Palm Plant Frondsfrom the oasis, and the down fur from a Bupers Camel from the oasis, I'll throw some gold your way for all your hard work.

quests.name: Parched Pets
quests.description: My desert pets can go without water for a very long time. But they're lookin' a bit parched, don't you think? The Bupers Camels and Cactus Creepers store water reserves inside them… do you think you could get me some fresh water for my critters? …one way, or another? Come back when you have filled 10 barrels of water and I'll toss some gold your way.

quests.name: Jolly Green Frostval Attire
quests.description: HO HO HO! With your Jolly Frostval Attire in hand, you've unlocked a gift meant to bring verdant holiday joy to your every-day adventures! Defeat the Fur Tree to get Forest Green Dye and I'll give you a green version of your outfit to wear.

quests.name: Jolly Green Santa Hunk
quests.description: HO HO HO! With your Santa Hunk hat in hand, you've unlocked a gift meant to bring verdant holiday joy to your every-day adventures! Defeat the Fur Tree to get Forest Green Dye and I'll give you a green version of your hat to wear.

quests.name: Jolly Green Santa Cutie
quests.description: HO HO HO! With your Santa Cutie hat in hand, you've unlocked a gift meant to bring verdant holiday joy to your every-day adventures! Defeat the Fur Tree to get Forest Green Dye and I'll give you a green version of your hat to wear.

quests.name: Fluid Dynamics
quests.description: We'll worry about the Lightguard shortly — if I'm going to help YOU, I'll need some supplies. The embalming fluid my students use in their experiments often congeals and reanimates in the form of "Slimeskulls" that wander near the tower. Reclaim it for me.

quests.name: M-ossification
quests.description: You want to know my secret ingredient? Lichmoss. It keeps them held together like duct tape. And the only place you can find it? Right here in Doomwood. Grows on the treeants. Bring me some

quests.name: A-gore-able
quests.description: Now for the fun part! A necromancy spell will give life to the dead, but we need something more to keep it going. Something… GORE, you might say! Not the common sort you'd find inside a living person, but something more eldritch in nature. Something from a Sanguine Souleater should do the trick.

quests.name: Raw-r
quests.description: Your assistance has been more than adequate. Thanks to you, I've completed my elixir, and am now only in need of some … shall we say, "raw material". A lot of it. If you want to kill two birds with one stone, you could slay some of the Lightguard and get it from them.

quests.name: Light em' Up
quests.description: The Lightguard have been harassing my apprentices. This must stop. Go into my tower and get rid of any that you find inside.

quests.name: Spellbound
quests.description: WHAT?! They've got my apprentices held captive with light spells? Well, go help them! The Lightguard will be carrying scrolls to break the spells. Find the scrolls. BREAK the SPELLS.

quests.name: Lupine Resurrection
quests.description: They are using those wolves as both warriors and scouts. Think what we could do if they were on our side? Slay them so that they can fight for us once I raise them again.

quests.name: Spying on the Light
quests.description: We must find out what the Lightguard are up to. They've been too quiet - and that means they're planning something. Find out what it is.

quests.name: Illusory Disguise
quests.description: Sometimes even the strongest of us can benefit from a little subtlety. Before you head into the Lightguard fortress, I will cast an illusion to make you look like one of them. Bring me 4 pieces of undamaged Lightguard armor, some Arcane Energy from the lical treeants, and some Necrotic Ooze from the slimes near the tower. These are the only reagents I will need.

quests.name: Test the Disguise
quests.description: Did this work? We'll only know if we test it. Go see if they'll let you inside!

quests.name: Killer Robots!
quests.description: These robotic monsters are everywhere! It's too much for the two of us to handle alone. But you're bigger and stronger than we are. Kill as many of them as you can find, and help keep the moglins safe!

quests.name: Full Bellies
quests.description: Those bigger drones - the ones that look like spiders - I think they're the ones taking the moglins. They are capturing them, and then imprisoning them in their large, metal abdomens until they can take them back to… well, to whoever has sent them. Fight them and crack them open. Save whoever is inside.

quests.name: They're Waaatching
quests.description: Someone is harvesting moglins, and we need to find out who. I think I know how! I've noticed that the small, flying drones seem to be watching us. If we capture some of them, and study their data cores, we might be able to figure out where they're coming from.

quests.name: Gotta Keep Hydrated
quests.description: Alright, this is going to take a little while. Would you mind going into Nibbleon and picking up some Makai- Sun for me? Thinking is thirsty work, and I'm gonna be parched. Bixx will have it in his shop.

quests.name: Find Twilly
quests.description: The video feed from those drones showed them all flying into the same cave. That's got to be where their master's lair is! Twilly has gone ahead to scout it out. He wants you to meet him there.

quests.name: Trusted Sources
quests.description: This information is highly classified. I need to know I can trust you before I tell you more. There are 10 Map Fragments hidden around Akiba. Find them all and I will tell you more….

quests.name: Shades Of Gray
quests.description: Now that you know the story I am relying on you to help me while I stay here and ensure the Emperor and Ai No Miko's protection. The map shows a ROCK near here is the cave entrance. Enter the caves beneath Akiba Palace and explore them.

quests.name: Hiding In Shadows
quests.description: We must find a way to lure my shadow out of the darkness. Try defeating his Kage Nopperabo soldiers. Destroying 12 of these shades should get his attention. Let me know what affect it has.

quests.name: Fading Light
quests.description: So the coward still hides. Very well, we will use a more advanced ninja technique but it will take some preperation. I will need you to find a few scraps of the Shadow Cloth that the Kage Nopperabo weave their clothes from. I will only need 3 Shadow Cloth Scaps.

quests.name: Candles in the Dark
quests.description: I have prepared these special candles to dispel the shadows. Place all 8 of them through the cave, then return here and I will recite the incantation to activate their magic. These should reveal any shadows hiding in the caves.

quests.name: Shadow Battle!
quests.description: The candles magic have been released. My shadow should no longer be able to hide in the caves. Meet me in the cave. I will be right behind you but you will not see me. We will face my shadow together and remind him who his master is.

quests.name: Tenacity Challenge
quests.description: You say you are a devoted follower of the Archfiend. But do you have the patience and determination required to prove it? I set you an endurance test. Speed and skill will help, but those with the determination to go the distance will find the REAL rewards! Slay 6 Ghastly Darkbloods in the Deathpits and 7 disloyal Bloodfiends in the Underworld, then return to me.

quests.name: Contender Challenge
quests.description: For those who have shown the tenacity and determination to complete my first challenge… the time has come for you to finish the second. You must take down the following three upstarts who would challenge my might. Retrieve 1 Blood Titan head, 1 Desterrat Moya Tentacle, and 1 Ssikari Heart. Return to me.

quests.name: Fighting Phoenix Blades
quests.description: Show me your hard earned Crystal Phoenix Blade and I'll reward you with Phoenix Blades that fight for you! For a small price of course…

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: New Worlds, New Opportunities
quests.description: Oooh, What an interesting realm my Master found. This land is rich in jewels you would find in… but nevermind that. Bring me some things I want to examine from this world. Maybe I'll hand over some of the things you people consider “valuable". Don't worry, I'll tell you where to find these things for me. The Horns on the helmet adorned by the Cyclops Warlord, in /faerie should do. The rest I'm sure you can figure it out.

quests.name: Combat Style: Soulreaper of Nulgath
quests.description: You wish to learn how to wield your "Soulreaper of Nulgath" with more effectiveness? Your weapon will look the same but you'll swing it like an axe!

quests.name: Combat Style: Taro's Manslayer
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield "Taro's Manslayer". For a small price I'll teach you.

quests.name: Combat Style: Champion of Nulgath
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield your "Champion of Nulgath". For a small price I'll teach you.

quests.name: Combat Style: Dragonbone Axe
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield "Dragonbone Axe". For a small price I'll teach you.

quests.name: Combat Style: Tainted Claymore
quests.description: You wish to learn how to dual wield your "Tainted Claymore". For a small price I'll teach you.

quests.name: Combat Style: Purified Claymore of Destiny
quests.description: Haha! Polish is here? He's no threat to me! For a small price I'll teach you to dual wield his pathetic blade.

quests.name: Purchase Drudgen the Assistant
quests.description: Ahh… you wish to hire Drudgen. I've promoted him to part-time salesman for his hard work. He's very social and likes to help everyone around him. A very hard worker if not the brightest. He should be much more useful to you than he was before.

quests.name: Assistance of Nulgath
quests.description: I can see in your eyes you're irritated. Dealing with freeloaders and irritants. How dare they! Who are they to be allowed to win prizes from YOUR minion? Where's YOUR prize? How selfish of them! You're right to be annoyed hero. Lets teach them a lesson.

quests.name: Fired & Re-Hired
quests.description: If you're not satisfied with Crag & Bamboozle's work performance, you should fire them! If I'm not happy with a minions work. I send them to… well… that's not important. Drudgen will be happy to work for you again…. for a price.

quests.name: Nulgath's Prize
quests.description: I'm the cute one down here.. or as cute as we get in the mountains of Tercessuinotlim. Then those Dark Makai swarmed their way in and took over! Go and kill a few of them, and I'll follow you back to your house. I know where I'm appreciated!

quests.name: Contract With the Abyss
quests.description: Nulgath's contract is written in a language you don't understand. Are you sure you want to sign it?

quests.name: Void Knight Deal (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Void Knights are just one of my elite soldiers of war. I give them great power of my own to make them unstoppable. That's the sacrifice I make for my disciples. I'll give you the power of a Void Knight too. All I require is a small portion of your soul. Defeat Soulseeker and you'll be able to retrieve a transportable piece of your soul.

quests.name: Blood Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Arcane Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Shadow Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Primal Orb (Temporary Quest)
quests.description: (This quest will be deleted June 4, 2010) Miltonius tells you this orb holds the power to transform your "Void of Miltonius" to a different breed. Only those that possess, or share the orb have access to this transformation.

quests.name: Yellow Snow Cone
quests.description: Ze King haz a very bad fever. Before medicating, we need to make zure he iz fully hydrated. Ice melts vhen it gets too warm, yez? Or, in this case, a fever. If you could collect 8 bundles of Shaved Ice and 2 bottles of Yellow Snow Syrup to make ze king a healthy, hydrating Snow Cone? Ze monsters in ze Frozen Northlands can provide you with what we need.

quests.name: Cool Down Items
quests.description: Bein! Now that ze King is full of antioxidants, ze time 'as come to destroy ze fever freezer burn! When ice goes bad, it will start building up zomething called 'freezer burn.' Zis is not good. We need to find some Cool DownitemsItems for ze King before he freezer burnz. Find me 5 Cool Down Items zat the monsters of ze Frozen Northlands use in battle!

quests.name: Take a Chill Pill
quests.description: Ze King needs medication now. S'il vous plait, can you do me one more favor? Ze monsters of ze Frozen Northlands have stolen my last bottle of Chill Pills, and we must get it back for ze King's sake! Search all ze monsters in this area for my Chill Pill Bottle. One of zhose thieves must have it!

quests.name: Ice Cold Heart (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: Impatient much? Me too. Charging Aisha's fortress is the quickest way to end her reign. But if we charge in right now, the village will be vulnerable to a blindside ambush. Go into the Northlands and vanquish FrostWyrms in order to ensure the village's security. When you have collected 6 Hearts of Ice, we can move forward with our plan. And by "our plan" I mean "my plan."

quests.name: A Key Discovery (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: With the Frost Golems out of the way, we need to find a way through the front door. Since you broke Aisha's last door, she has set up a more solid, complex entrance with higher security measures. There are strange fissures in the door if I recall correctly… maybe one of those monsters will have a key or something that can be used to open the door.

quests.name: Forgery (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: Go get another mysterious stone from one of the monsters, but this time put it in the forge and see if there is anything hidden inside. If something comes out, bring it back to me so we can set out next course of action. Hurry. I haven't got all day.

quests.name: Forging Gemeralds (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: Chaos Gemeralds fit into the door. This is how we are going to unlock the door. And then charge right in unannounced. Go fight some monsters until you have collected another 5 mysterious stones. Take them to the forge in town, extract the chaos gemeralds, and bring them back to me so I can brief you on your final mission.

quests.name: Break Down the Door (Charge the Fortress)
quests.description: You have the forged Gemerald Key… can you get through the door?

quests.name: Small Red Envelope
quests.description: This is a good envelope, I'll reward you with 300 gold.

quests.name: Medium Red Envelope
quests.description: This is a good envelope, I'll reward you with 600 gold.

quests.name: Large Red Envelope
quests.description: Wow, you are a very lucky person. I'll reward you with 1200 gold.

quests.name: Oblivion Blade of Fighting
quests.description: Your blade thirsts for souls. Take him to battle and quench his thirst.

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: Nulgath
quests.description: (This quest subject to change)

quests.name: Phoenix Blade of Nulgath
quests.description: Bring me the "Phoenix Blade"mortal. It's an ancient blade fiercely guarded by dragon kind. It's legendary for it's eternal fire. This is the reason is why I use to create my Voids. As you can see, that kind of power is very useful. Bring one to me and in return I'll enthrall the blade with my own power, giving you dominion over it.

quests.name: The Weapon Parasite
quests.description: My supplier, Swindle, has come across an interesting parasitic creature that actually binds with weapons, giving it strange power.I’ve been experimenting with it’s abilities but I need more specimens. Bring me a “Parasitic Hacker”. For the specimen and a small payment of gems, I’ll give you an item I’ve successfully bound with the creature.

quests.name: Doom Worm Creepers
quests.description: Nulgath says, as you grow in power, many foes will look to strike you in the back. I can prevent this. Bring me "Doom Worm Creepers". They are not obedient creatures. But I can change that for a price. They will sit still and see all that you cannot see.

quests.name: The Dark Deal
quests.description: ( This quest can change )
