quests.name: 50 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 50 Racing Trophies? Holy Schmolies, yer a natural! I've never seen anything like it! Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: 100 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 100 Racing Trophies? Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: 150 Trophy Prizes
quests.description: You gots 150 Racing Trophies? You're gonna be a LEGEND in the racing circut! Picks any one of these prizes you wants! Jusr makes sure you know what you wants before you picks it. NO BACKSIES, pal!

quests.name: Flight of Fancy
quests.description: The Floating Palace is kept aloft by ancient Djinn magics. I require 3 Roc Feathers, which are prized by the Harpies near the DjinnGate. Bring me 3 Roc Feathers and I will send a young Djinn Companion to travel with you.

quests.name: Slay the Red Dragon
quests.description: A dragon is a fearsome beast, one even the best Bountyhunter *cough* plans their attack ahead of time. Grab your guild mates and bring me back the Red Dragon's head. You'll find him in the Vasalkar/lair area. My contact in the Thieves Guild will pay VERY well for it!

quests.name: Defeat Capt. #00000Beard
quests.description: I don't like them pirates. They interfere with my bountyhunting. But this time it's not ME who has to deal with them. I'm sure you and your Guild-mates can take down Capt. #00000Beard and bring me back his Golden Pirate Loot. Head to /Lolosia and take the boat over to his ship to confront him.

quests.name: Defeat Nulgath
quests.description: Every good bountyhunter keeps an eye on a world's most dangerous opponents, and Nulgath definitely qualifies. Bring your Guild to take him down… if you CAN! If you can wrest away his Seal of Approval, the Master Thief will pay VERY well.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Tibicenas
quests.description: I hope you've got an in-djinn-ious solution for this next mission, Hero, because you and your Guild crew are going to face down Ultra-Tibicenas in the /djinn realm. He's got a spare wish to grant, and my thief contact wants it.

quests.name: Defeat Ultra Carnax
quests.description: Time is on your side, Hero, but not for long, The Thief Master is impatient, and he desires the Eye of Ultra Carnax NOW! You'll find the beast in the /ultracarnax area, but you're going to need ALL your Guild-mates to take this create down!

quests.name: Slay Ultra Epic Vordred
quests.description: The ultimate trophy is… the shadow of Ultra Epic Vordred! (Doesn't sound like he's trying to compensate for something at all.) Battle this dark foe in the /vordredboss arena and rip off his shade. Return to me and you will be rewarded once I am.

quests.name: DERP
quests.description: Derpicorns and Chickencows are ancient enemies. Slay the Sketchy Chickencow in Battleontown and the Rainbow Derpicorn will reward you with a character page badge to show its appreciation.

quests.name: Rainbow Rats
quests.description: The rats in this area have been affected by the cannon’s blast. The falling rainbow has turned them into Rainbow Rats! Defeat the rats and bring back 10 Rainbow Pellets as proof.

quests.name: Monochrome
quests.description: Monochrome the Dwakel hates color. ALL color. He has created the A.R.C (anti-rainbow cannon) to destroy all rainbows across Lore. Defeat Monochrome and bring back the key to the A.R.C - once you have that you'll be able to go and destroy the A.R.C for good!

quests.name: Destroy the A.R.C
quests.description: Now that you have the key, you will be able to destroy the Anti-Rainbow Cannon (A.R.C) that was used by Lucky Harms and Monochrome to destroy this rainbow. We need to make sure that this will never happen again!

quests.name: Frost that Lucky Harms!
quests.description: Lucky Harms, the Hork Warlord, is trying to destroy Roy G Biv! Without Roy, this rainbow will never come back… ever! Defeat Lucky Harms in battle and bring back his Top Hat so we can retrieve his 4-leaf Clover. Without it, he won't be "lucky" any more.

quests.name: Pot of Gold!
quests.description: Well, they say there's a pot of gold at the end of every rainbow… and there is! Roy G. Biv isn't interested in the Gold, but he does want his Pot back! You know how much those Sneevils love their containers!

quests.name: Shape of the Ship?
quests.description: Knew I could count on you. Here's the deal. My rival, Capt. 000000Beard, was due back in port a few days ago. His ship showed up but he's just bobbing there in the harbor like a cork. Take my pinnace to his ship and EXPLORE IT. Tell me what you find… especially if you find what his cargo is.

quests.name: Skeleton Crew, Skeleton Key
quests.description: So 000000Beard's ship has been taken over by the undead. What luck! If his cargo is in tact then we can salvage it and make a profit. 'Tis the law of the sea. But first we should find out what happened. One of the undead pirates will have the Key to the Captain's Quarters. See if you can find it and bring it back here.

quests.name: Dead Journal
quests.description: Should find out what happened to the crew if we can. Go into Capt. 000000Beard's Quarters and recover his Journal. Maybe his logs will tell us what happened. Then we can keep looking for his booty!

quests.name: Sold Out!
quests.description: I knew that Capt. 000000Beard was a scallywag but you don't sell out your own crew! We have to stop him for the Alliance's sake! Maybe we can reverse the process. Get me some samples from the Undead Pirates and I'll get them examined. 10 Infected Bones should do.

quests.name: Abandon All Hope...
quests.description: Hopeless. My contacts say that we can't save 000000Beard's crew. That means that we're on our own. We HAVE to find where he Captain hid his deadly cargo. Search the Undead Pirates for some CLUE.

quests.name: In The Drink
quests.description: So the Plague Potion is in the barrels of that fruit drink in the hold. If I know Capt. 000000Beard the hold is locked tight as a drum and he's hidden the key on his Undead Pirates in pieces. Find all the fragments of the Hold Key and bring them here. I will assemble them for you.

quests.name: Below Decks
quests.description: Now that you have the key you should be able to get into the ship's hold, but 000000Beard is a trig cully. He'll be waiting to stop you. Defeat Capt. 000000Beard if you can, then go into the hold and collect all the barrels of the drink you can find. Bring them back here for safe keeping.

quests.name: Blow Stuff Up!
quests.description: Ok, the safest way to take care of this stuff is to get some gun powder and fuses. Gather 10 Gunpowder Casks, and take 10 Fuses from the Undead Pirates and bring them back here. I'll rig up a launch for you while you're gone.

quests.name: Pack Of Spices
quests.description: Captain 000000Beard was a collector of a lot of things INCLUDING Tresure map Scraps. If you can bring me a single scrap from his collection I'll trade you this exotic Pack Of Spices. Won't see anything else like them in this part of Lore!

quests.name: Gold Ingot
quests.description: Collect 10 Gold Coins from the Undead Pirates and I will combine them into 1 Gold Ingot for you! You can find them on the Undead Pirates.

quests.name: Bolt Of Silk
quests.description: Bring me 5 Silk Scraps and I'll combine them into a file Bolt of Silk for you! You can find them on the Undead Pirates.

quests.name: A Second First Mate
quests.description: My last first mate's been put outta commission by the pirates of 000000Beard, curse him. I'm lookin' for a new one, you up for the job? If ye can prove yerself, ye can start immediately! Go get some revenge for me mate!

quests.name: More Blades More Battle
quests.description: I would be out ramming these invaders with my own horns if I was not needed here to make weapons for the Deathwatch and everyone else who would fight for the Darkblood. If you want to be useful, destroy some Chaonslaught Calvary and bring me their weapons. I will reward you.

quests.name: Hypnosis Caves
quests.description: You can't take care of others if you can't take care of yourself. The same saying goes for when you're undead. Just don't mention that I said this to the rest of the Legion, or they're going to scoff that it's pansy talk. I need the base for my usual 'memory repair' spell. That's what Lord Dage calls it. He developed it after he gained his first generals. You'll find the initial components from the makai and fiends in/darkfortress.

quests.name: Concussion Strengthener
quests.description: Laken was one of Lord Dage's most trusted Generals and Advisors, until the eventual falling out. Which is a sore shame. Laken didn't just have knowledge of the future, he was actually an expert in technology and biosynthetic reagents. The binding agent for the 'memory repair' spell was created by him. Maybe the Seraph Recruits over in /seraph still have some.

quests.name: Abyssal Spiral
quests.description: Have you been to /abysslair? That's where one of the newer generals trains and well, broods. He's always looking for challengers, but don't bother him today. For the 'memory repair spell, I need to get a hold of the guards and beasts. That mountain has special properties. If you spend enough time there, it imparts the essence of the abyss into your body. Ask nicely for samples, or not so nicely. Do what works.

items_required.name: Beast's Abyss Ether x4 (Stacks up to 20)
Guard's Abyss Coleric x4 (Stacks up to 20)

quests.name: Languish in Limbo
quests.description: Now here's the hard part. Usually, Dage himself has his most trusted warriors sent to the /sevencircles to collect Ethos from the Limbo and Luxuria Guards. I'd rather take care of my headache problem in private this time. This may be contested amongst the Legion, but I think you're one of Dage's most trusted warriors. Could you go and retrieve the Ethos from the guards?

items_required.name: Limbo Guard Ethos x10 (Stacks up to 50)
Luxuria Guard Ethos x10 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Drowned in Lethe
quests.description: I'll need Wrath, Violence, and Treachery's Ethos from /sevencircleswar. Not from the guards. We need the stronger stuff from the beasts themselves. You know, I don't think these three things are necessarily 'evil.' If you feel wronged or see wrong doing, you deserve to feel wrath. And sometimes, there's no other choice but violence and treachery… Yeah, this is why the other Generals say I don't belong in the Legion.

quests.name: Super George Lowe-viathan
quests.description: Ah yes. The Super George Lowe-viathan. As the quest title suggests, this monster has been deviously buffed in HP, level, and attack power just for this special challenge fight. …it would have been nice if I had gotten *some* warning in advance but, you know…

quests.name: Vote for Rapaxi
quests.description: Slay 10 minions of the Nyx Aeterna to show that you believe the shadows and creatures of the night are best served by the Abyssal Legion. This is a wise decision.

quests.name: Give Luca a Message
quests.description: Sssso… the Baron seeks to overthrow ME and my Legion and claim the throne that is MINE?! No, no. Thisss will not do. Go. Defeat him. Show him that you are my ally, and that his power pales next to mine!

quests.name: Cleanse the Grove
quests.description: The animals of the grove have begun showing signs of corruption. This is MOST troubling… especially since - I - I can hardly say it, but… the song of the forest has been - silenced. *shudder* This CANNOT be a coincidence! Slay the Wolfwood, Hootbear, and Tainted Earth to bring me samples of the corruption.

quests.name: Into the Underglade
quests.description: You must go into the Underglade to find what you seek. The spirits below WILL try to stop you. It is unfortunate, but this means you must defeat them to continue. Do not worry, when they return to the earth, they will quickly be reborn from it again. You will not truly harm them.

quests.name: Clear the Spores
quests.description: As you can see, some corruption still remains below the surface of Brightoak. Get rid of any tainted Grove Spores you find down there. This will help you make up for the damage you are about to do.

quests.name: Cleanse the Walls
quests.description: Destroying those monsters helped a bit, but look at the cavern walls. Can you see the spot where the taint remains? Collect Essence of Nature from the Forest Spirits and Tree Nymphs, and spread it on those spots to cleanse them of the corruption.

quests.name: Expose the Entrance
quests.description: To go deeper into the Underglade, you will need to make your way into the Cave of Light. Unfortunately, there was a cave-in, and now it's being blocked by chunks of Blackened Earth. You'll need to remove it to continue.

quests.name: Gather the Glows
quests.description: The Cave of Light is named so because it is filled with Luminous Fungus. Beyond this cave, the caverns you will find yourself in are so dark you won't be able to see. Unless… you use the fungus to light your path! Collect a bushel of Luminous Fungus from the Cave Mushrooms in the Cave of Light. Only then will you be able to continue.

quests.name: More Corruption Revealed
quests.description: Oh no… the light from the Cave Mushrooms has revealed that the corruption runs deeper than we had thought! We must heal it! Collect Elemental Nature from the tree nymphs or forest spirits, and use it to restore the Corrupted Roots deep in the Underglade.

quests.name: The Goblin Threat
quests.description: It looks like the area past the Cave of Light is infested with Twisted Goblins. Destroy as many as you can find. Hopefully, this will encourage Lunamoss to respond to you more favorably.

quests.name: Get an Offering
quests.description: It might not be a bad idea to bring Lunamoss an offering of some sort, before you ask for this favor. She is partial is gemstones. You may notice that the walls of these tunnels are rich with them. Chip away at them until you find a nice, gleaming one.

quests.name: The Heart of the Glade
quests.description: I think you're ready to talk to Lunamoss now. I don't think she'll like what we're asking of her, but… all we can do is try. If anyone can get her to understand why the Heart of the Glade is so important, it is you. Get the Heart from her, and bring it to Victoria. She will be waiting for you.

quests.name: Troll Stink!
quests.description: We talk, but only after you wash. You go back to K'thurr village. Water in river there. Flowers on Trollola Plant. Use Scaly Skin Scrub from Chinchilizards around here. Then you be clean and stink-free.

quests.name: Lycan Medals
quests.description: I'm going to need you to hold off Constantin's lycan army while I try to finish Count Maxius' ritual. Each of his soldiers carries a small medal that identifies their rank. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Mega Lycan Medals
quests.description: While you're fighting Constantin's soldiers, you may run across some with particularly large medals. These are his higher-ranking wolves. Bring me their medals, and I'll give you an even larger reward.

quests.name: A Necessary Sacrifice
quests.description: Mages share a deep connection with nature. We draw our power from our surroundings and when the world is in balance, so are the magi. But there are times when sacrificing a friend allows for a greater good. The Seed Spitters have grown too big in numbers. I ask that you defeat 10 Seed Spitters and bring me their Roots to ensure that Arcangrove is not overrun by these populous plants.

quests.name: Gorillaphant Poaching
quests.description: The Magi have shared a strong connection with the Gorillaphant dating back to the era of DragonFable, We admire their great power, but fear it equally. The Gorillaphants in Arcangrove have started attacking the Magi more often than not, and so we must take out the most dangerous for our own well-being. Come back to me when you have slain 7 Gorillaphants.

quests.name: Your First Quest: Frogzards!
quests.description: Keep walking to your right (through Battleon) and you'll find the steps of a stone column, the Nexus. Frogzards have surrounded it, and now no one can get by. Slay 3 of the Frogzards to help people pass.

quests.name: Your Second Quest: Slimes!
quests.description: You would not think slimes could destroy a whole forest, but their slime trails poison tree roots! Walk through Battleon town and to the left to Greenguard Forest. Slay 4 slimes to protect the woods!

quests.name: Your Third Quest: Spiders!
quests.description: Journey to /greenguardeast, the forests to the right of Battleon. There you will find deadly spiders! Slay 5 of them to protect the townspeople of Battleon!

quests.name: Your Fourth Quest: Wolves!
quests.description: Journey to /greenguardeast, the forests to the right of Battleon. There you will find ferocious wolves! Slay 5 of them to protect the townspeople of Battleon!

quests.name: Your Fifth Quest: Water Creature
quests.description: A vicious creature, the Kuro, lives in /river! It threatens any traveler who attempts to wade through it's home. Slay the Kuro to cleanse the river!

quests.name: Vicious Wolves
quests.description: Wolves… vicious, terrible animals. A wolf once nearly destroyed my family but a woodcutter's ax put an end to him. Since then I have trained myself in the art of the hunt. If you would learn my way, bring to me 6 Wolf Pelts to demonstrate your worthiness.

quests.name: Slimes to the West, Slimes Everywhere
quests.description: Be careful where you tread, hero… Slimes are everywhere in this forest. These sickening creatures will engulf anything that they come across making it very dangerous for any who step into the shade here in Greenguard Forest. Bring me 6 Jars Of Ooze to show me that you are the hunter, and the slimes, your prey… and not the other way round.

quests.name: Scaly Menace
quests.description: Frogzards are very curious creatures indeed. These scaly menaces can be found in western Greenguard, and they are a plague on local farmers. They may be small but they can be very dangerous when cornered. Eliminate these pests and bring be 6 Frogzard Teeth as proof.

quests.name: Overgrown Spiders
quests.description: A good hunter knows that every creature has a place in the world. Spiders are normally helpful creatures that keep the insect population down. The spiders of Greenguard, however, are massive creatures that are more of a threat to livestock than mosquitoes. These creatures must not be allowed to thrive or we are all in danger. Slay 6 of the wicked thing and bring me their Fangs as proof.

quests.name: Mustard and Pretzel Root
quests.description: To begin your training in Alchemy, it is wise to start at the roots. Or, rather, the Pretzel Root. As a basic reagent in many Health Potions, this certain Root can be found on the Seed Spitters in the area. When combined with Mustard Seeds that the Gorillaphants cherish, I can stir up a nice batch of Potions for the magi in Arcangrove. Bring me 4 Pretzel Roots and 3 Batches of Mustard Seeds so I can get started!

quests.name: Thyme and a half
quests.description: Thyme is a medicinal herb used in many healing potions. Unfortunately, this reagent has become scarce since the Seed Spitters started sprouting up everywhere. I need at least 10 Bundles of Thyme in order to make the most basics of healing potions. I wish you good luck!

quests.name: Bring Me the Bounty of the Full Moon!
quests.description: The winner o' the Midnight Crown be the captain what has the biggest pile o' treasure at the end o' the battle! If ye be wantin' to help me out, ye can fight the Full Moon Pirates, and bring me the bounties they carry!

items_required.name: Full Moon Bounty x5 (Stacks up to 500)

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Full Moon!
quests.description: Some o' those Full Moon Pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGE bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add'em to me pile!

items_required.name: HUGE Full Moon Bounty x3 (Stacks up to 500)

quests.name: Defeat Flintfang
quests.description: Yarrr! Our Captain CANNOT be abused like that. Go rescue Bonnie and bring her back safe!

quests.name: Find the Key! (Part One)
quests.description: To show your worth, you must find the key.

quests.name: Find the Key! (Part Two)
quests.description: To show your worth, you must find the key.

quests.name: Find the Key! (Part Three)
quests.description: You've made it so far, but in order to pass into Escherion's Sanctum Sanctorum, you must defeat the Gargoyle that he has charged with guarding the door…um!

quests.name: Pumpkin-Flavoured Death
quests.description: My master wishes to analyze the sources of necrotic energy, your first target is set to this big amount located in /mogloween. Watch out, this source seems to be…alive.

quests.name: Thriller Trio
quests.description: Since phase 1 proved to be a success, you're good to go and find the remaining sources. This time, there are 3 very close to each other, bring all to me, if you please, the sources at /mogloweengrave, /candyshop. and /voltabolt.

quests.name: Over the Candycorn
quests.description: This is definitely a feisty one, try not to get lost around the stalks on /candycorn and bring me a sample of what is bumping in the night.

quests.name: The Pie is Also a Lie
quests.description: Next one is confusing me, the surroundings are distorting time and space, almost feel like home…anyway, ignoring the odd readings coming from this place, bring me the next sample at /pie.

quests.name: (Mad)Dollhouse
quests.description: This reading is very strong, but there is some interference, someone…or something nearby is emitting even stranger readings than last time, approach this individual with care, it's all converging at the /mirrormaze.

quests.name: It's Aliiiiiive!... Isn't it?
quests.description: By the third eye of Nak'Ur! This has to be the strongest reading so far! You MUST bring Master this sample, we will have so much material, I might have to serve two masters to fully read it! Hurry to /franken and bring it to me.

quests.name: Nevermore
quests.description: And we are down to the last sample, located at /wyvern and definitely the darkest one gauged yet. And once more, there is a source of unusual readings nearby. Another "friend" of yours?

quests.name: The Necronaut
quests.description: During the sampling process, I detected another source of necrotic energy…YOU! It is nothing to worry about, the energy is lingering on you instead of coming FROM you, but now the Master wants to "sample" it…personally. He is right beyond me, please be polite.

quests.name: Ultra Necronaut
quests.description: Before we leave this small planet, My master wishes to give it another try with the sampling process, he didn't tell me why, but I believe he just wants to have some more…fun.

quests.name: Winged Spies
quests.description: The Chaos Lord at Mobius has too many eyes at his disposal. With too many Chaos Sp-eyes around Mobius we won't be able to get far. Bring down 5 Chaos Sp-eyes and bring me back their wings so I can assign you the next task.

quests.name: Chaos Prisoners
quests.description: Just look at this town. Imagine trying to continue your life with your house inverted, twisted and turned inside out. Explore the houses in Mobius and get any information you can about the Chaos Lord.

quests.name: IMP-possible task
quests.description: Before we get the townsfolk to safety, we need to clear the path out of town. We'll protect them while you get rid of Escherion's imps. Bring us 5 Imp Teeth so we know the job is done.

quests.name: You Can't Miss It!
quests.description: The Chaos Lord Escherion is responsible for all of this destruction. Off in the distance to the north you can see his inverted tower. Go investigate it and see if you can find a way inside the tower.

quests.name: Far Sighted
quests.description: These cyclops raiders are one of our biggest problems. They seem to be looking for something so maybe you can make it harder for them to find it. Defeat the cyclopses and return with 5 Cyclops Contact Lenses.

quests.name: Slugfest
quests.description: Slugfit, the Imp General was left in command of Escherion's forces here in town. If you defeat him the Chaos Lord's forces will fall into…uh…chaos. But that's a good thing in this case. Return to us with his scalp as proof of his defeat.

quests.name: The Black Goat in The Dark
quests.description: Looks like I'm your Watson, Detective Champ. How about we circle back to check on that mom and widower? They were worried about you so go and tell them you're doing swell. While you're at it, mind thinning the mobs of….people? I'll take one half and you can have the other.

quests.name: The Star Sinks into the Sea
quests.description: Thanks for making the town a bit quieter. That makes it a lot safer for that little girl and that guy on the street to come out of hiding. Why not check on them, too? I'll go make sure the others are… feeling better.

quests.name: The Gentlest Truth
quests.description: There goes the town. At least that means there's no one left to get angry at you for not burying the bodies. Oh. Wait. The MAYOR might get mad at us for skipping town. If he turned out anything like the others… he's probably looking for us. We should find him first.

quests.name: Time Moves the Moon
quests.description: It's do or die, not like it's been anything but this. However you want to handle this, I got your back, champ. And remember, I never lie.

quests.name: Clear Twilight's Edge
quests.description: Defeat the beasts in Twilight's Edge frame by frame to reach the portal.

quests.name: Seek the Tower
quests.description: Hero! You must seek out Syrrus in the Tower of Winds. He is the one who summoned you. You'll find the tower down the path to the right.

quests.name: A n-Ice Beginning
quests.description: The tower is locked? I bet one of those Polar Elementals stole the key. They are not very n-ice! (I pun to forget how cold I am…) Stay 10 of them to see if you can find it.

quests.name: Search for Syrrus
quests.description: Now that you've got the key, you're going to want to talk to Syrrus, the Astromancer and Lord of the Tower of Winds! He has made contact with a VERY powerful mage, one who controls an army, and will come help us!

quests.name: Shot in the Dark
quests.description: Princess Victoria left to gather more medicinal herbs for you. We need to find her! The upper floor of the castle is infested with ghosts. If you feel well enough, we should lay them to rest. It'll make it easier to find our way around.

quests.name: Sparkling Changeling
quests.description: The Ritualists know you're here, and they're coming upstairs. If they find the Princess, they'll surely use her to lure you out. We should step carefully, and cull their numbers without alerting them all. Watch how I move. The Princess was an efficient teacher.

quests.name: Silver Proof
quests.description: The ground is quite dirty, so please watch your step. Oh? I recognize these goblets. We had these in our main castle as well - Your Highness? You want me to help you gather all of them up? Of course! There should be more around here.

quests.name: Gilded Peace
quests.description: Gathering those goblets made the Revenants agitated, and the noise they're making is getting the attention of the Ritualists. If we work swiftly and quietly, we can take care of both without being found out.

quests.name: Towards Reunion
quests.description: There's a commotion coming from outside. It's…the Princess' voice! Look! She climbed outside to get to the courtyard. There's a ghost attacking her! Or rather, this spirit is confused and swinging his sword wildly. We need to get down there!

quests.name: Servants Stay Unseen
quests.description: We'll have to climb down the far ledge if we want to delve deeper. The Princess scouted ahead and said she saw Undead, but no Ritualists. Did they retreat? We should lay those Ghostly Servants to rest, and look for anything the Ritualists left behind.

quests.name: The Slaying of Sacred Deer
quests.description: I see why the Ritualists retreated. The knights you defeated all those years ago have risen to join my father… sans their heads. Seeing how some of the remaining doors in the castle are still locked, we should search these Headless Riders for keys.

quests.name: The Light Protects You
quests.description: Your Highness, the Princess and I looked inside the locked room, and saw two shimmering figures made of Light. They don't have any specific shape and - what? Do you recognize them? Would it be safe for you to examine them?

quests.name: Cure-All
quests.description: The medicine's effects are waning. We won't be able to face my father without your skill and strength. I can make another dose, but the Princess couldn't find enough herbs. The Riders and Ghosts may still have some from back when they were alive.

quests.name: Thronekeeper Vaughn
quests.description: Are we prepared? The Thronekeeper is in the castle's inner sanctum. He's stronger than he was in life. That enchanted armor is what's keeping him tethered to this plane. We'll destroy it, and banish my father. Just remember, magic has little effect on him.

quests.name: Defeat The Red Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Torgat, the chosen champion of the Red Dragons? Ok… it's your funeral. Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.

quests.name: Defeat The Ice Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Fressa, the chosen champion of the Ice Dragons? Well, you were able to beat Torgat, so sure, why not. Run into the valley, and I'll taunthimher down.

quests.name: Defeat The Undead Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Radroth, the chosen champion of the Undead Dragons? You're on a roll - let's give it a shot! Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.

quests.name: Defeat The Water Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Nizex, the chosen champion of the Water Dragons? You sure you're up for another one so soon? Alright, alright. Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.

quests.name: Defeat The Wind Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Tathu, the chosen champion of the Wind Dragons? Better be careful with this one, or you might get blown away! Run into the valley, and I'll taunthimher down.

quests.name: Defeat The Yokai Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Lanshen, the chosen champion of the Yokai Dragons? Be warned: these dragons are normally really peaceful, but they also know how to fight. Run into the valley, and I'll taunthimher down.

quests.name: Defeat The Green Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Ashax, the chosen champion of the Green Dragons? Hey, hey! I hear you're really experienced with this kind of dragon. Right? Run into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.

quests.name: Defeat The Faerie Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Letori, the chosen champion of the Faerie Dragons? Don't underestimate this one. They may look like adorable little lunchbox stickers, but they can be deadly! Run into the valley, and I'll taunthimher down.

quests.name: Defeat The Chaos Champion
quests.description: You want to try to defeat Nayzol, the chosen champion of the Chaos Dragons? Ok, this is one dragon I really want to see you defeat. I don't want a Chaos Dragon for a king, so let's take him out of the running!RunGet yourself into the valley, and I'll taunt him down.

quests.name: Defeat The Void Champion
quests.description: You know, I don't really want a Void Dragon king, either. I didn't think Zathas would be the last dragon standing, because I didn't actually expect you to get this far. But here we are. Take him out, and then… well, I guess the rest of us will figure something out about Maleth.

quests.name: Survey the Territory
quests.description: Rabbits are a master of traversing the forest floor. They know who lives where and what threatens their journey. Become familiar with the entire Dragon Den so nothing catches you by surprise.

quests.name: Make a Game Plan
quests.description: If we're going to go looking for this dragon, we need a plan. Take notes on the surrounding area and make sure you study every shortcut and possible strategic weak points. You may have to get some information from local mushrooms on some good strategic areas.

quests.name: Big Enough for Success
quests.description: Have you seen the beautiful waterfall around these parts? It's one of my favorite things about living in Brightoak - the stunning beauty of the nature is just simply captivating. In my free time I enjoy going to the waterfall and being alone with my thoughts, it helps clear my mind and allows me to motivate myself to be big enough for success. Maybe it can do the same for you. You've been working hard and it looks like you need a refreshing break.

quests.name: Something to Gnaw On
quests.description: All of this hunting is surely making me hungry… an Arcornent's Shell from the /cloister and some hay from a Grizzly Bear in /pines should satisfy my hunger!

quests.name: Hare-y Situation
quests.description: We have a serious situation, hero… someone's stolen my special carrots. Not those cheap carrots you buy in Yulgar's Inn for a couple of gold, I'm talking about enhanced carrots that are found only in Brightoak. One of the enemies here must have taken it, fight them until they drop my carrot!

quests.name: Escape Burrow
quests.description: We're almost there, I can smell it. Dig a few holes around the area so that we have a better idea on which direction we have to go. Also, a flashlight might help… unless I'm wrong, the mushrooms around these areas should drop one for you.

quests.name: Hope Will Lead the Way
quests.description: The path of nature has led us to where we now stand. One doesn't have to be a bard to feel the presence of Rivensylth near by. Travel forward and locate the stone that will summon Rivensylth. She has aged since Nevanna first found her egg.

quests.name: Purifying the Grove
quests.description: Avada is the final foe you must encounter before your task here is complete, hero. I do not doubt your heroic abilities, I know you will be able to defeat her. Go and save Rivensylth.

quests.name: Chaos Not Invited
quests.description: I've got good news and bad, Hero! The good news is… YOU are here! The bad news? The wedding invitations were stolen. Bring me back the last 8 invites from the Chaos Invaders as you take them down!

quests.name: Better Letter Go!
quests.description: We've got to get these invitations out to the townspeople! Please deliver them to the following people:

quests.name: Decor Rater
quests.description: My assistant tells me there aren't any BALLOONS in town yet! Did you see any?! … Oh. Oh my. Well, THAT is your next task! Decorate Swordhaven!

quests.name: Cold Feet, Warm Heart
quests.description: Princess Brittany has a job for you! Bring back a Burning Coal Brazier from the Living Fire in Mount Mafic so Princess Brittany can tease Lord Brentan about not getting cold feet.

quests.name: Chaos STILL Not Invited
quests.description: The Chaos Invaders are back! I've summoned the guards, but until they get here, please take care of ALL the invaders in the Chapel AND the reception area. We simply CANNOT have this wedding disrupted!

quests.name: Protect the Princesses
quests.description: We need to gather the resources to seal the chapel and protect the princesses! Go into the reception garden and gather 6 chairs. We'll use them to block the door!

quests.name: Seal the Chapel
quests.description: You'd better take wood from the reception hall chairs and pile it all in front of the chapel door. That way they can't get back in!

quests.name: Chaos Kills!
quests.description: Oh NO! Not the Justicar, too! Who will lead the courts if he's… ah, it is a sad, sad day in Swordhaven! Protect him from himself, Hero.

quests.name: Juice on the Loose!
quests.description: Glad you wanna help a partner out. I'm dying of thirst over here, and could really use more Moglinberry juice… and 3 Pints should do it! If I can *hic* recall correctly, there are a few beasties out there that love that Juice as much as me: Warden Elfis, the Drow prison guard inside Dwarfhold; that big bad Cyclops Warlord in Mobius; and Big Jack Sprat in the Graveyard near Swordhaven. And don't come back here without my 3 Pints of Moglinberry Juice! *hic*

quests.name: Unleash the Frostvale Barbarian
quests.description: The Barbarians of Frostvale are known for their Strength, Endurance, and Dexterity. Prove that you possess these traits, and you, too, can become a Frostvale Barbarian. Complete the Forest Guardian Gauntlet in /alpine, the Holly and Ice quest in Coldwind Valley, and the Defeat Karok quest in /northstar. Bring me the Sword of Hope, recover the Sassafras' War Helm from /battlefield, and get the Infernal Ice Heart from Vinara's shop in /battleontown.

quests.name: Get in the Holiday Spirit
quests.description: (Requires Obsidian ArchPaladin armor from Mysterious Dungeon) Artix the UndeadSlaying Paladin is getting into the Frostval Spirit, and the BEST way he can do that is free any last spirits trapped inside Vordred the PaladinSlayer. Bring back 12 Festive Spirits from any Vordred you encounter as you battle through Lore.

quests.name: Save The Moglins!
quests.description: There's been a big problem with many moglins missing out on Frostval. Every year, there always seems to be a few missing, either trapped or missing somewhere. Can you find them and bring them back here? I know I saw some in /DarkWinter trying to stop the Legion, and some that were frozen over in /FrostvalNext.

items_required.name: Frostvale Moglin Rescued x5 (Stacks up to 100)
Frozen Moglin Freed x5 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Robina's Quest
quests.description: Hello! I am Robina the Hood. *whispers* I have a bit of a problem. I lost my, um, back key to the castle. I think I accidentally put it on a monster when I was in the sewer. Could you get it back for me? (Return to Robina in the Swordhaven Inn with the Key.)

quests.name: Missing Boxes
quests.description: Hello, again! When the undead invaded we decided to save our belongings in boxes. These boxes suddenly began disappearing from our storage room. Can you go into the storage room and see where the boxes have gone, and if you find them, can you bring them back?

quests.name: Robina's Quest
quests.description: Hello! I am Robina the Hood. *whispers* I have a bit of a problem. I lost my, um, back key to the castle. I think I accidentally put it on a monster when I was in the sewer. Could you get it back for me? (Return to Robina in the Swordhaven Inn with the Key.)

quests.name: Missing Boxes
quests.description: Hello, again! When the undead invaded we decided to save our belongings in boxes. These boxes suddenly began disappearing from our storage room. Can you go into the storage room and see where the boxes have gone, and if you find them, can you bring them back?

quests.name: Defeat Rock Roc
quests.description: The Rock Roc has been commanded to finish you… but there's no way he can, right? Right? Go for it!

quests.name: Medicine Man
quests.description: We must get Madeline medicine. Find me a Mortar and Pestle, 1 Syringe, and 1 Gourd Medicine Vial. I believe I stored them in a Chest somewhere… but I do not remember where. I hope your strength is better than my memory…

quests.name: Her Herbalism
quests.description: Modern medicine is not curing Madeline. Find a book on Herbology from my Bookcases, and then collect Berries, Leaves, and Flowers from the plants in the garden.

quests.name: Extra-Sensory Siblings
quests.description: Madeline and I have always shared a supernatural bond—we are connected on a physical and spiritual level. And, I am hopeful, that perhaps the Ghosts of my ancestors might be able to provide supernatural remedies of sorts.

quests.name: Dr's House(of Crusher)Call
quests.description: Please, you must find Madeline and administer the medicines that you found. Administer 3 doses of medication to Madeline, who is lying in her bedroom.

quests.name: Spook and the Book
quests.description: Dear friend, I am restless. Search for a book in one of the bookcases to calm my nerves. You will know of the perfect book once you find it.

quests.name: Prove Your Allegiance
quests.description: You CLAIM to be Evil enough to join my Undead Legion. You look… Good. Which means weak. The same goes for many of the denizen's of this realm. Prove yourself and your worth. Bring me a Good Will, Good Intention, Good Heart, Good Idea, and 5 instances of simple Goodness committed by one of the Underworld creatures.

quests.name: Grind Out Goodness
quests.description: If you really want to be a TRUE member of my Legion, you'll need to show me that you are devoted to pure Evil. I suspect some of my minions may have Good left in them. Unacceptable. Bring me a Good Will, Good Intention, Good Heart, Good Idea, and 5 instances of simple Goodness committed by one of the Underworld creatures.

quests.name: Lack of Four-sight
quests.description: Nulgath's bloodfiend warriors cannot fight if they cannot SEE! Bring me 100 Bloodfiend Eyes to prevent the Archfiend's Nation from advancing. Return and there will be a fiendishly-epic reward.

quests.name: Fuel for Fought
quests.description: Mortal! Do thou knowest the fuel that feeds our fellow gamers? Bright green like the magical life-giving mushroom, the Holy Soda is what grants gamers their power. If you wishest to obtain such immense amounts of radioactive energy, recover the Holy Soda Bottles and deliver them back to me!

quests.name: In Ctrl of Controllers
quests.description: Being in control is one thing. Being in control of the almighty controller is another! Despite this talisman of ungodly power, controllers of wireless ancestry require chargers to give them their strength.

quests.name: To Form a Platform
quests.description: It would be most foolish of thou to believe that platform games come from midair. In fact, they come from WAY ABOVE midair. From the realm that is Arcadion. The Cobalt Blue Hedgehogs who flourish in this world possess the Platformer Essences in Which ALL games are created from. If you can taketh these essences from these beasts, then thou may have what it takes to become the wielder of the Winter-een-mas Crown!

quests.name: The Infamous Plumber
quests.description: Mortal, the time has cometh. You have reached the final stage. But the boss battle will not be set to Easy Mode. If thou defeats the almighty plumber of Arcadion, then the Winter-een-mas Crown shall be yours!

quests.name: Defend the Rats
quests.description: The Kittarians and Horcs are attacking the rats we were planning to use for practice! So instead, I think we'll use THEM for practice and free the rats. Your first task is to bring me a few pieces of cloth from as many Kittarians and Horcs as you can slay… I think 8 should do for a start. Now go forth and show me your fighting potential!

quests.name: Rats in the Cradle
quests.description: This is an outrage! The Kittarians and Horcs have gone too far! Now they are attacking the rats in their warrens, … even innocent children! Your next assignment is to search Noobshire and save as many of the baby rats as you can. You will be able to differentiate the babies by their golden color. And bring a hunk of Horc Cheese back for them to eat.

quests.name: Short in Spoons
quests.description: The Kittarian Mouse Eaters stole some spoons from Battleon and the chefs in the Mess Hall are complaining about the shortage of spoons! Your next task will be to bring back our stolen spoons. A word to the wise: The Kittarians are very tricky when it comes to hiding their things, so don't be surprised if you don't always find a spoon when you defeat one.

quests.name: Short in Forks
quests.description: The Kittarian Mouse Flayers have stolen some pitchforks from our farm and now our farmers are complaining that they can't properly harvest their crops! Your next task is to take the Kittarians down and recover what is ours; if the farmers can't harvest food I'll NEVER get my lunch! And I get cranky when I'm hungry!

quests.name: Letter Interception
quests.description: Hmm… now that these Horcs have taken over our Training Grounds, they must be sending messages back to the main Horc Camp. Some Horc must be acting as a messenger and bringing progress reports back to General Porkon. Your next task is to find out which Horc has that letter. Take it away from him, and bring it back to me… I have plans of my own for spoiling their little incursion.

quests.name: Not A Noob
quests.description: We definitely need to drive these Horcs away from Noobshire. The only way I can see to get rid of them is to take out the Horc Trainer. Without the trainer, the remaining Horc Trainees will be confused and lacking direction. Then it will be EASY for us to scare them away from Noobshire for good! So go get rid of the Horc Trainer, and bring me his horns as proof of your conquest.

quests.name: Missing King
quests.description: It seems that with all of the commotion going on in Noobshire, the King of the Rats has gone missing! Without their leader, the rats won't be able to restore order to their society! Locate the King Rat, so we can restore their peaceful society. Check the Horc Noobs for a clue to where he is!

quests.name: Take Down
quests.description: That Horc Trainer appears to be VERY persistent… he's back, with a new group of Horc trainees. It's time for you to go out there and show him once and for all who is in charge around here! Defeat the Horc Trainer again, and bring me his pet rat as proof. His defeat should send a message to any Horcs who would even THINK of venturing back to Noobshire again!

quests.name: Lock-Blocked
quests.description: Pettivox has become much sneakier in the last few months. His lab and office are magically sealed now by a combination spell. We've GOT to get in there, but it's rumored that tampering with the spell will cause GREAT damage to the intruder! I'll show you where it is, get this letter to my mother, then meet you back there.

quests.name: The Shoe's News
quests.description: The first thing a shoemaker needs is a measuring tape. Without that, there's no way we can make shoes to fit anyone! After that, we need our awl, a shoemaker's hammer and tacks.

quests.name: A Shoemaker's Work is Never Done
quests.description: Once we have the shoe formed, we need a sole knife in order to cut the base of the shoe, and then stretching pliers to make sure the leather is taut. After the show is made and tacked or glued together, the final thing needed is a burnishing cloth. The most important of all, though, is my tool bag!

quests.name: Ruby Giftbox Quest
quests.description: Battle Santy Claws in the /northlandlight region. Bring me back a Ruby Gift Bow and you'll be rewarded with even more presents!

quests.name: Axe Them To Leave!
quests.description: We won't hold this army back if all we can do is fire off one shot at a time. With larger projectiles, our rogues can strike multiple enemies at once! They'll need 3 sharp axes for a coordinated attack. See if you can get some from the chaos prisoners in town.

quests.name: Freeze 'Em Out!
quests.description: Our frost mages can summon an Ice Storm to freeze the ground, and any enemies that cross will stick to it like your tongue on a flagpole! For one storm, they'll need 3 frozen charms. Get them from the Chaos Mages near the armory.

quests.name: Burn 'Em Up!
quests.description: Want to take 'em out even faster, soldier? Our fire mages can lob a fireball at a large group, and blast the entire area for catastrophic amounts of damage! If you want them to cast one, they'll need 3 flaming charms from the Chaos Mages near the armory.

quests.name: Under Siege
quests.description: Get ready, soldiers! The armies are massing at the castle gate and are about to mount a huge attack! Hold them back - don't let them get through!

quests.name: No, NOW We're Under Siege
quests.description: That wasn't the last of it - looks like something big is coming! We've got to stop it before it reaches Swordhaven!

quests.name: The Blazing Catalyst
quests.description: Within the lava pool you make out an insert. Here goes nothing.

quests.name: Bring Me the Bounty of the Black Veil!
quests.description: The winner o' the Midnight Crown be the captain what has the biggest pile o' treasure at the end o' the battle! If ye be wantin' to help me out, ye can fight the Black Veil Pirates, and bring me the bounties they carry!

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Black Veil!
quests.description: Some o' those Black Veil pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGH bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add 'em to me pile!

quests.name: Bring Me HUGE Bounties of the Full Moon!
quests.description: Some o' those Full Moon Pirates carry a larger bounty than usual - you might even say they have HUGE bounties! If ye find 3 o' these, bring 'em to me, and i'll add'em to me pile!

quests.name: Defeat Flintfang
quests.description: Yarrr! Our Captain CANNOT be abused like that. Go rescue Bonnie and bring her back safe!

quests.name: Rutilans' Soul Harvest
quests.description: Getting back on topic, can you help me get some more soul energy? But just soul energy from other undead. Not you. This graveyard is pretty boring and I want to leave but I don't have the ability to do so. I need the remnants of energy from other undead so I can move around freely again.

items_required.name: Skeletal Warrior's Soul Energy x10 (Stacks up to 20)
Underworld Soul's Soul Energy x10 (Stacks up to 20)
Wrathful Vestis' Soul Energy x5 (Stacks up to 10)
Soulseeker's Soul Energy x5 (Stacks up to 10)
Lich Emperor's Soul Energy x1 (Stacks up to 2)

quests.name: Sketchy Dead Parrot
quests.description: This parrot isn't dead! He's resting! Remarkable bird, the LoreLegion Blue, isn't it? Beautiful plumage! In order to prove that this bird ain't dead, we'll need to ask a distinguished doctor. Be sure to grab the Stunned Parrot from my Shop, you will need it for him to examine later.

quests.name: Hoo Are You?
quests.description: Go see Doctor Hoo – he lives in the blue birdhouse shaped like a phonebooth. I'll send him a tweet so he knows to unlock the front door for you.

quests.name: Empty Eyes
quests.description: Oblivion returning to his original self is causing the Fiend's Void to stir in a peculiar way. The carcasses of dead animals are getting possessed, and creating these empty creatures. You'll join them if you don't fight back.

quests.name: Infectious Sleep
quests.description: The current Nation's Outriders are wandering the path ahead. Don't try to speak with them. The call of the Fiend's Void will be easier to handle if you strike them down and bury them in the snow. Careful. Their condition is contagious.

quests.name: Cadaveric Spasm
quests.description: Cover the bony spines with snow, and try not to let your gaze linger. The Tundra itself is turning into a Fiend, but the process will halt altogether if you don't acknowledge it. That frozen traveler, on the other hand…how curious. Take a look, would you?

quests.name: Nihil Scholars
quests.description: The survivors are huddling around candlelight just beyond the Lost Expeditioner. Their own Magi have succumbed to Oblivion's influence, and are rapidly emptying. Destroy them before they spread their emptiness to you.

quests.name: Id and Superego
quests.description: Ah, so you're already familiar with the only remaining survivors of the last hunting party that chased after Oblivion. Carnage and Jadzia are as lucid as you are. Talk to them, and see if they know how far along my former student is.

quests.name: Sleepflying
quests.description: The younger members of the Nation have the right idea. This ritual area they prepared is keeping Oblivion's Void at bay. Gut the empty creatures, and place candles where they fall. This will help increase your focus.

quests.name: Battle-Weary
quests.description: Cut the last of the Nation Outriders down. They're as dead as the animal bones sleeping in the snow. Purify the remains by following my exact instructions, or else their affliction will seep into your marrow too.

quests.name: Self-Destructive Spell
quests.description: Something is approaching, and it's attracted to the activities of the Oblivion Magi. Disrupt their spells, and strengthen our defenses. The frozen Expeditioner at the crossroads has some sort of protective aura. Fortify it with the ritual candles.

quests.name: Allure of the Void
quests.description: Much like how Nulgath has followers like Carnage and the others, the Oblivion I knew had attendants. They sought oblivion…and found it. His Herald approaches, and you will need to resist its allure.

quests.name: The Dead City
quests.description: The Sol has been hidden by powerful Lunaris magic in the dead city. Walk along the edge of the lake to the north until you have located the city then return for your next quest.

quests.name: Grains of Chaos
quests.description: The Chaos Magic has made it possible to enter the city but the magic hiding the Sol must be broken. For this we will need power. Collect 10 grains of Chaos Sand from the Sp-eyes flying around the area.

quests.name: Call of the Sun
quests.description: The Solaris Knights do use magic but it is fueled by the sun. We will need to amplify our spell to counteract the other magic. Place these 10 Solar Panels around the area in key locations to best reflect the sun towards the dead city. Return when your task is complete.

quests.name: Shattered Past
quests.description: We need something to help the magic resonate. Solaris relics have littered this area since the area was destroyed. Many of the local monsters have taken to claiming them as pirzes. You must collect 20 Relic Fragments from the monsters to complete this spell.

quests.name: The Spoiler
quests.description: It looks like the Lunaris have an agent of their own trying to get to the artifacts too. It's a race then. We must slow them down. They have set up Shadow Collectors around the area. gather 10 Shadow Collectors before they can. it will put a wrench in the works.

quests.name: Heart Of The Sun
quests.description: We need one more component in the spell… a heart. It can't be just any heart but the heart of a creature that has been saturated with Chaos. There is a beast near here called Slugfit. Return once you have taken Slugfit's Heart.

quests.name: The Sol
quests.description: Now the Sol's hiding place should be revealed! Quickly, go to the ruins of the city and search for a large orb of copper! Go quickly, before the magic hiding the Sol closes again!

quests.name: Enter The Tomb
quests.description: The entrance to the tomb is locked by a gate, and the key has been stolen by the Frask. I could force it open, but we are on hallowed ground for the people of the Walsh, and as co-leader if the accord , I must avoid such such political problems.

quests.name: The Relic of Light Tome
quests.description: In the havoc of the Jir'abin monsters coming here, that vendor seems to have found the tome Zail mentioned. If you bring back five Diamond Scales of De'ther from a Shade, we will be able to buy the tome from the Tuuzuk Trader. We will need it if we are to find the Ring of Light.

quests.name: Disarm the Traps
quests.description: This is strange. I heard from Daz that there are traps inside the tomb. They should not be here; perhaps they appeared with the monsters.

quests.name: Find the Missing Pages
quests.description: The Tome is missing several pages! Without them, our attempts to find the Ring of Light will end quickly.

quests.name: Find the Resonator Components
quests.description: The tome tells of some device, a Synvenic Void Resonator, which we must construct to go deeper into the tomb. Even stranger, the monsters here can provide all the needed components. It's almost as if the Tome was able to predict this! Gather the first of what we need from the Frask and Tomb Drifters!

quests.name: More Components Needed
quests.description: We need a few more base components to complete the Syvenic Void Resonator.

quests.name: Final Components
quests.description: We something to stabilize the Syvenic Void Resonator. There is probably something in the vases that we will be able to use.

quests.name: Gain Entrance to the Vault
quests.description: With the Synvenic Void Resonator constructed, we should be able to gain access to the portion of the tomb that was revealed by the monster's presence here. The chamber is protected by a puzzle; see if you can solve it.

quests.name: Defeat the Spirit
quests.description: I do not understand—is that the De'ther spirit? Perhaps he left behind some sort of echo or energy in his image for all of these years. It seems to act hostilely. We will need to disperse it!

quests.name: Feeding Grounds
quests.description: Have you seen the village outside my castle? That is where I keep the herd. They normally go about their lives and when I feed I tend to leave the mortal alive to keep the blood flowing… but recently Blood Maggots have started cutting into my supply leaving my mortals completely drained. Defeat 8 Blood Maggots and bring me their denture as proof of their defeat.

quests.name: Going Batty
quests.description: The Albino Bats that live in this area have been frightened by the Lycan invasion. I need you to knock some out and apply this soothing salve to them. You should only need to soothe 6 Albino Bats for the others to follow. Careful, the salve doesn't always work.

quests.name: Lycan Knights
quests.description: The Werewolf King has sent several of his Lycan Knights into my realm. I can only assume this is the latest attempt to take more of our land from us. Go out and defeat the Lycan Knights and bring me 4 Lycan Ears as trophies.

quests.name: Twisted Paw
quests.description: Twisted Paw is a particularly fierce Lycan Knight. I assume he is a general in the Werewolf King's army because none of my Vampire Knights have been able to get close enough to him to even wound him. I would like you to bring me Twisted Paw's Head.

quests.name: Steal the Steel
quests.description: The rebel Technocaster has reprogrammed a pack of our Technowolves and brought them with her to the past. We must stop them before they make it off of the ship and onto Lore! Dismantle them, and bring me any spare Seraphic Steel you can find. I'll craft it into plates for your armor.

quests.name: Get the Core
quests.description: It's time to take down that rebellious Technocaster once and for all! Be careful - she was one of my strongest allies before she went bad. Bring me the Energy Core from her armor, if you can get it. Once I've purified it, you can use it in your own.

quests.name: Scary Baby
quests.description: Alight, let's go. You fight her, I'll weaken her, Lim can trap her. I'm not going to let this overgrown baby threaten me any more.

quests.name: Battle Tested
quests.description: These invaders are interesting. I have not seen their style of armor before. I wish to see how well it stands up to our weapons and learn from it if I can. Go out and bring me helms from the Chaonslaught Warrior. If the heads are still in them… all the better.

quests.name: Dancin' Hair-Do's... and Hair-Don'ts
quests.description: Do you like my hair, daaaaahling? Yes, yes, I know you do. And I can make your coiffure just as full of life and movement as mine is! I just need 5 Boar Bristles and a Boar Bone for the comb and 10 Dyed Vulture Feathers to make the decorations!

quests.name: Samba, samba, samba-style!
quests.description: To make you a most diviiiiiine dance outfit, I'll need 3 Bolts of Cloth, which you can find on Boars. You should be able to find 3 Shiny Metal bits for decoration on the Rhison, and we can't forget the flowers! Bring me 10 fallen Red Trollola Blossoms. Their scent is so sweet!

quests.name: Decorate the Dance Academy
quests.description: I want the Dance Academy's decorations to sparkle as much as those on my dancers do! I want to go with a tribal, natural theme this time. So bring back 10 Geodes from the Crystal Rocks around the Plateau… oh! And 10 Rhison Tusks. They should complete the look nicely.

quests.name: Tango Tango Tango!
quests.description: You must have a special outfit, Hero, if you're going to TANGO! Bring me 10 Jungle Vulture feathers and 13 Bolts of Cloth from the Horc Boar Scout!

quests.name: Sapphire Giftbox Quest
quests.description: Battle Santy Claws in the /northlandlight region. Bring me back a Sapphire Gift Bow and you'll be rewarded with even more presents!

quests.name: Vampire Medals
quests.description: We MUST get into the ritual room and stop the Red Dawn Ritual. Each of the Vampires carries a crest somewhere on them. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Mega Vampire Medals
quests.description: We MUST get into the ritual room and stop the Red Dawn Ritual. Each of the Vampires carries a crest somewhere on them. Bring them to me, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Rise of the Frogdrake - XP Boost
quests.description: The Frogdrakes in Willowcreek have experienced a curious awakening today. It's as if something has made then more powerful, but it's nothing YOU can't handle. Take out a Frogdrake and it's certain you'll be rewarded with a boost to your XP!

quests.name: Skeletal Warrior Upsurge - Gold Boost
quests.description: Skeletal Warrior in the Graveyard have taken to robbing the dead! Their packs are stuffed with gold they didn't earn. Take one down, and you're sure to be rewarded with a Gold Boost! Give the rest back to the dead they came from.

quests.name: Slimiest Spring - Class Rank Boost
quests.description: Every four years in the Spring, Swordhaven slimes hold a competition amongst themselves to see who is the slimiest. The winner ranks up to "Sultan of Slime" for four years. The last Sultan wants you to take out one of his opponents and YOU will get their Rank Boots!

quests.name: Waiting for Rep with Baited Breath - Rep Boost
quests.description: Marsh Lurkers in the Marsh like to lure the heroes to them with the promise of gaining reputation. But on Leap Day, they carry Rep Boosts, hoping the promise of greatly increasing rep potential will bring even MORE heroes into their clutches. Kill a Marsh Lurker and this Boost will be yours!

quests.name: A Town Divided
quests.description: Thank you for helping! My son, Andesi, and the other kids are trapped in the Mill at the other end of town. The stone walls should protect them from the fire but we need to know that our kids are OK. Please go check on them.

quests.name: The Miller's Key
quests.description: It was smart of the kids to lock themselves in the mill, but the miller says that he dropped the key in confusion when Xan attacked. He saw one of the monsters pick it up but he's not sure which. Find the monster with the key and head straight to the mill. Tell my son not to worry. We'll be together soon.

quests.name: Cyser-no!
quests.description: As I was preparing for the Harvest Day Parade, my balloons suddenly became chaorrupted! I have no idea who is behind this, but we need to get these hot-aired hooligans under control. And fast. Pop 4 balloon Cyseros and come back to me when you've done it!

quests.name: Pink Balloon of Doom
quests.description: Nothing is quite as scary as a giant pink Beleen wreaking havoc above Lore. I think all Paladins would agree with me in this one. So it's going to be up to you to defeat this air head! Pop 4 Beleen Balloons and hurry back when (or if) you succeed!

quests.name: The Hundred Foot Tall Twilly
quests.description: The biggest threat remains. Literally. The giant Twilly balloon is the biggest and the baddest of all my chaorrupted balloons! In order to save the Harvest Festival Day Parade, you MUST stop and pop the Twilly balloon!

quests.name: Souls for Controls
quests.description: These spy-drones look like they run on interdimensional energy. If I can get them to run on soul energy instead, I can get them under my control. But for that, I'm gonna need some souls. There are some Void Mages near Nibbleon who would make for willing donors.

quests.name: Investigation Time
quests.description: Let's try to get a better sense of where we are and who we're dealing with. Take this reconfigured Spy Drone with you - it will let you talk to me while you look around. Investigate the cave as thoroughly as you can, and tell me what you find.

quests.name: Get Revenge
quests.description: These bots need to learn who's in charge here - me! Beat up as many of 'em as you can find. Smash them to bits! I will have my revenge!

quests.name: Key the Guards
quests.description: That teleportation pad you found - that's gotta be where they've taken Twilly. We have to find a way up there. We got the codes to open the cages from those guard drones. I bet they have the keys to the teleporter, too. Get two of 'em - one for each of us.

quests.name: Time to Teleport
quests.description: Alright, let's do this! Go stand on the teleportation pad and use the key. Let's see where it takes us.

quests.name: GET HIM!
quests.description: So, moglin magic has been messing up his big plans? Well, this moglin's gonna mess 'em up eval more! Let's get him!

quests.name: Sea King Collection Chest TLaPD 2018
quests.description: Yarrrr! Prove you can defeat a jellyfish and i'll reward you with the Sea King Collection character page badge.

items.name: Sea King’s Collection Chest Character Page Badge

quests.name: They've Gone Dark
quests.description: The Kalestri Worshipers were a very noble people in their homeland but these creatures have been corrupted by evil. Their sisters will want to know that you have discovered them. Go gather 8 Dark Medallions to prove that you have found them.

quests.name: Bad Doggies
quests.description: I have never seen the Kalestri Hounds before. I sense some dark connection to the cultists. They could be the source of the evil that has corrupted them. Destroy 10 of the hounds to make your search more safe AND help save the worshipers.

quests.name: Essentially Evil
quests.description: I can feel the evil bonds weakening, now is the time to strike them down…er… I mean free them. Defeat Worshipers and Hounds until you collected 10 Evil Essences. That should break the spell.

quests.name: Loose Threads
quests.description: That should have broken the evil influence that has infected the Kalestri Worshipers but something is holding it together and we can't get to the Djinn until the path is clear. ITS A WEB! There must be some Lotus Spiders in here. You must destroy at least 10 of them to break the spell.

quests.name: Seek The Treasure
quests.description: Now that the worshipers are free you can try to make your way through the maze and discover the treasure chamber that holds the Djinn! Once you have found it, return to me. I will break the spell of protection and you can get the lamp.

quests.name: The Black Plague
quests.description: Sigh. Good job, "Hero". You've unleashed the Black Plague. If you try to fight it, it will infect and slowly kill you. If you don't… well, it will still kill you, along with everything else in here… and on Lore. So, what's it going to be?

quests.name: Secrets of the Universe
quests.description: Knowledge is power, ESPECIALLY for a warrior. If you do not know your enemy, you cannot know their strengths and weaknesses. Recover the lost lecture pages from the ShadowScythe who took them, and the Lecture Globe will reveal vital knowledge!

quests.name: Prove Yourself
quests.description: Unfortunately, I cannot allow just anyone to enter Jingshen. Only the gentlest and most agile of heroes can travel through it without causing too much distress. If you can steal the bowl from a kappa ninja's head without spilling any of the water, I will know you are such a hero. Kappa Ninja can be found at the Yokai Ferry.

quests.name: Culling the Corruption
quests.description: Jingshen Forest, just east of here, is home to a great many nature spirits. Normally they are gentle beings, a source of growth and vitality. But recently something has corrupted their energy and made them… wrong. If you kill these corrupted spirits, they should revive without the corruption.

quests.name: The Core of the Problem
quests.description: Simply killing the corrupted spirits doesn't seem to be solving the problem. If you bring me some of their elemental cores, I may be able to determine the source of the problem. Cores from either Lingzhi or Xingzhi will do.

quests.name: Essentially Pure
quests.description: The source of the corruption still isn't clear. I will need to compare the corrupted cores with some samples from a pure, untainted forest. Go to Pinewood Forest in Dwarfhold, and gather the essences of the creatures living there. Your attunement with Jingshen Forest will allow you to see and collect them.

quests.name: Salve-ation
quests.description: I've made a purifying salve from the nature essences you collected from Pinewood Forest. If we disperse it throughout Jingshen Forest, that should help remove whatever this corruption is. Go into the woods and place samples of the salve on the ground. Be sure to spread them out.

quests.name: Not So Much
quests.description: That doesn't seem to have done much good, either. There's a more direct method we can try, but gathering the ingredients will take some time. First, I'll need you to go back to Pinewood Forest. The Pine Trolls who live there use a special blend of healing herbs. If you can collect 10 pouches of it, that should be enough.

quests.name: Berry Sturdy
quests.description: The berries that grow on Treeants promote growth and hardiness. For the next ingredient, we'll need about 10 handfuls of them. You can find Treeants in the Poison Forest or at the Greenguard Farm, but be careful – they may not be happy about being harvested.

quests.name: Oil of... what?
quests.description: Next, you'll need to travel to Faerie Forest in Chiral Valley and collect some Essential Oil of Faerie. You'll get it from the Chainsaw Sneevils, who have collected it from… well, best not to think about it. 10 vials of it should do.

quests.name: No One Likes Taking Medicine
quests.description: I've crafted a tonic from the herbs, berries and oils you brought back. If the forest spirits drink it, it should cure them of their corruption. But no one really enjoys medicine, do they? You may need to rough them up a bit before they're willing to take it.

quests.name: Nip it in the Bud
quests.description: The tonic worked – I watched the corruption vanish from the forest spirits! but it returned almost immediately. Something in the forest must be keeping the spirits in this impure state. Go back into the forest and fight the corrupted spirits until you've found some clues as to what could be causing this to happen.

quests.name: Finding Yaomo
quests.description: Based on the clues you found, this is the work of a Yaomo – a type of malevolent spirit. It must be hiding somewhere within the forest. If you take one of the corrupted spirits' cores with you, you should be able to sense the entrance to his lair. Come back when you have found it.

quests.name: Sort of Like a Keycard
quests.description: So, you were able to find where the Yaomo's lair is, but you couldn't enter? It must be protected by some kind of ward. Fight the corrupted forest spirits and collect samples of the Yaomo's malevolent taint. If you have enough of it on you, you may be able to trick the ward into letting you pass.

quests.name: Defeat Yaomo
quests.description: All that's left to do now is confront the Yaomo who's corrupting our forest and defeat him. Return to me when it has been done.

quests.name: Mushroom Compost
quests.description: You've defeated the Yaomo, but the forest spirits won't heal on their own. Destroy 12 Lingzhi so their physical forms can return to the earth. When they regrow, they will be pure.

quests.name: Tainted Qi
quests.description: The corrupted Xingzhi will also need to be helped, but they don't have a physical form. Defeat them, and then collect their tainted Qi. This will help them to return more quickly in a purified form.

quests.name: Lava or Leave It
quests.description: It might not surprise you to know that DragonSlayers depend on some of the hottest materials known to man to craft our gear. Harvest Molten Lava from the Lava Rocks and be able to put it to good use.

quests.name: QuarterMaster's Supplies
quests.description: Lava Dragoblins are some of the most annoying creatures on Lore. They've waylaid the latest supply wagons, and that means I have no materials to craft gear.

quests.name: Suffering for Sulphur
quests.description: There are so many uses for sulphur — etching weaponry, making healing potions, preserving fruit… I can't list them all here. But suffice it to say, we use great quantities of it. The Sulphur Dracoliches are an excellent source of it.

quests.name: Ingots and Outguts
quests.description: You see those boxes back there? They're full of pieces and parts just waiting to be put together. And what don't I have? Iron. THE most basic component of pretty much everything. It's a good thing looting the Draconian Guards will replenish our supply. Oh. and if you come across any bile while fighting them, bring that hack. too. I combine it with sulphur. Mmm, mmm, stinky.

quests.name: Senna's Buns
quests.description: I make these special buns for the DragonSlayers before the start of any major hunt. Eating them gives you a temporary combat boost. I'm certain the creatures around here have stolen the crates from the last shipment. Help me them back and I will give you a few.

quests.name: Squeaky Toy
quests.description: We're taking the rightmost route. Think of the way you would hold a sack of flour. Held over the shoulder or under your arm. Which position will you be least likely to squirm in. I climb fast, and you will fall off if you try to cling to my back like you did with Gravelyn. You have three seconds before I choose for you. Then, I'll eviscerate the Vampire Queen's minions, if that is truly what they are.

quests.name: Vantablack
quests.description: We'll keep climbing the ladders dangling on the right. Ha, the moment I mentioned that the vampire minions were fake, the tourney's host dropped new toys into the arena. Recognize their armor? Or have I humiliated the Lightguard so thoroughly that no trace of them remains? Raise your weapon. I'm curious about the kind of warrior that gained my daughter's trust. But those scattered bones…are they real or waxen?

quests.name: Salt Bin
quests.description: I just noticed that there's a book here. Did you find others like it when you were escorted by Safiria and my daughter? …Do not read it. I need to fight off the fake Lightguard creations before we can move on. They're as overzealous as the originals. While I take care of them, keep your eyes on me. Not the book. I'm warning you. Do not read that book.

quests.name: Four Princesses
quests.description: I just returned from the next platform. You woke in time to watch me rip that illusion to shreds. That room, the throne, these crowns shouldn't exist. I would never allow it! Are there only Lightguard dolls to shatter? If I crush all of them, will a mannequin of Alteon be rolled out into the spotlight? I welcome another chance to destroy him. Don't touch me. Don't get in my way. This sham must be destroyed!

quests.name: Quest for the VIP Pass
quests.description: The NPCs LOVE to play for heroes of all classes, but they told me to look out for you, specially. They've got a VIP pass just for you, but… it was stolen! I can make another, I just need you to bring me the following: Secret Lyrics from the Mythsong Greatful Undead, the Knight's Album from the Black Knight in Greenguard west, and the Dragonbone Club from the Green Dragon.

quests.name: Platinum Album Shards
quests.description: Did you know, The NPC's last album went platinum? But then it was shattered when they moved into Yulgar's Inn. If you help me recover the shards, I'm sure they'll reward you with an item from their merch table! See if the Boxer Sneevils have any of the shards, then slay the Greenguard Slimes to bring me the glue I need to fix it.

quests.name: The Stick of Destiny
quests.description: Somewhere hidden deep within Lore is a magical tree upon which grows the Stick of Destiny. If you find the tree and harvest the stick, you will turn into a rocker of unparalleled ability!

quests.name: An Offering to the Falcon Guardian
quests.description: The Falcon is the priest's stamina, and represent his resistance to poison and disease. She uses her venom to destroy his enemies. Bring her an offering that pays tribute to the role she plays.

quests.name: An Offering to the Jackal Guardian
quests.description: The Jackal is the priest's ferocity, and represent her strength in battle. She defeats her enemies as a warrior does. She will require an offering that recognizes her fierceness in combat.

quests.name: An Offering to the Baboon Guardian
quests.description: The Baboon is the priest's armor, and represent his health. She protects him through healing and restoration. Her offering should pay respect to her gifts of regeneration and protection.

quests.name: An Offering to the Human Guardian
quests.description: The Human is the priest's himself, and represent his own exaltation. She protects him by bestowing upon him the power of the gods. Her offering should prove that the wielder of the Scepter and Flail of Yasaris are worthy of their power.

quests.name: Freeeessssssh Mmmmmmeat
quests.description: Ssssssssssoulsssssssss

quests.name: Clear the Way
quests.description: Looks like there are some Skeletal Soldiers blocking the road to Battleon. Defeat these two skeletons and then come back to me with their axes as proof. Once I know the path is clear, you will be rewarded with GOLD and EXPERIENCE.

quests.name: Defeat the Lich
quests.description: The Lich Ravager is blocking the way to Battleon. Take him down to ensure Battleon's safety.

quests.name: Souls of the Legion
quests.description: For every soul our leader takes, he becomes stronger, and the Undead Legion becomes weaker. As you fight these Undead Legion minions, collect their souls. Future Dage must be at maximum strength if we are to emerge from this battle victorious.

quests.name: Robust Souls of the Legion
quests.description: All beings have a soul, but some are stronger, and more powerful, than others. A soul like this will imbue our Dark Lord with considerably more power. If you find any of these robust souls, bring them to me. They will greatly increase our chances of success.

quests.name: Souls of the Legion
quests.description: For every soul our leader takes, he becomes stronger, and the Undead Legion becomes weaker. As you fight these Undead Legion minions, collect their souls. Future Dage must be at maximum strength if we are to emerge from this battle victorious.

quests.name: Robust Souls of the Legion
quests.description: All beings have a soul, but some are stronger, and more powerful, than others. A soul like this will imbue our Dark Lord with considerably more power. If you find any of these robust souls, bring them to me. They will greatly increase our chances of success.

quests.name: Serve the Darkness
