quests.description: I need to see death. SHOW ME. The darkness wills it. Travel around and spread death. I will watch…

items_required.name: Bonefeeder Spider's Leg x1 (Stacks up to 8)
Edvard's Clipped Wing x1 (Stacks up to 8)
Chaos Justicar's Arm x1 (Stacks up to 8)
Nure Onna's Tail x1 (Stacks up to 8)

quests.name: Guts and Glory
quests.description: All of my minions MUST be supremely skilled in battle. I cannot consider any that would fall to lesser liches or their pawns. Defeat my New Minions to prove yourself and test their ettle.

quests.name: Blood Harvest
quests.description: The Shadow Bats you see are my most loyal pets. They harvest the unwary, draining them of blood so I may feed at my leisure. Milk them of their latest deposits.

quests.name: The Final Test
quests.description: My fiercest minion, my prize - the Terror and Scourge of MystCroft - waits for you. Defeat it in battle and earn yourself a place by my side as my favored minion.

quests.name: Shadow of Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says, if infiltration is more your style. Shadow Voids are unmatched. They are beings of complete emptiness…

quests.name: It Calls Out
quests.description: *You hear some noises coming from the chest? It sounds like something is inside. It calls for more power…*

quests.name: It Wants Weapons
quests.description: *You hear the being from the chest call out again*

quests.name: It Wants Fuel
quests.description: *You hear a demanding whisper from the chest.*

quests.name: Dark Endurance
quests.description: The fact that you have delved this far into Bludrut Keep speaks much of your abilities. You may be the hero I have been waiting for all these years. Are you the one who can finally free me from this terrible curse? On this level dwell Wicked Witches and Shadow Serpents, who serve the Dark Elemental that rules this part of the dungeon. If you can prove yourself by slaying forty of their number, I will unlock the door that stands between you and this Dark monstrosity. (Bring back forty Dark Essences to complete this quest.)

quests.name: Heart of Darkness
quests.description: As I lay defeated at the feet of the Evil Elemental, I could not help but notice the pulsing glow from the bracelet dangling from his wrist. I can only surmise that this bracelet is the source of his dark power. If you can return to me with the bracelet, I am sure I can use its power to free my soul from its eternal imprisonment within this accursed Keep. ( Bring back the Dark Bracelet to complete this quest.)

quests.name: ShadowEater's Gift
quests.description: The shadows recognize your power ! To acknowledge all of your victories, I have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Awesomeness.

quests.name: Minion Morale
quests.description: All members of Noxus' and Vordred's army must, as a rule, wear Un-Dead Tags. Laid down before Vordred learned the "Detect Life" skill, this ordinance has been kept because it fosters a sense of solidarity among the ghoulish grunts. Steal 15 Un-Dead Tags in an attempt to wreck morale!

quests.name: Shadowfall is DOOMed
quests.description: Noxus is a pretty confident villain, what with his massive army of undead and a champion like Vordred. And, like all overconfident baddies, he LOVES to tell heroes what his plans are. See if you can find a copy of his "To Do List of DOOM" on one of his minions!

quests.name: Grave-lyn Danger
quests.description: With the undead overrunning Shadowfall, Gravelyn is in trouble! They would capture her in a heartbeat… if their hearts were still able to beat. It's hard to imagine Gravelyn as a prisoner, but just to be safe, better make sure you have a Skeleton Key to free her!

quests.name: ShadowFlame Dragon Orb Pet
quests.description: Slay 13 Shadow Imps in the ShadowLord's Keep to gather shadow energy and I will reward you.

quests.name: Mood Pendulum
quests.description: So who do you have besides Varga and Gravelyn's forces? Dead weight by the looks of it. Malgor did a number on Warlic, and Brentan's enjoying the fun mood swing stage of the Mana Affliction. They both want to talk to you so hurry up, we need to get moving. Hmm, I am curious about what Brentan is telling that glowing crevice on the wall. You think hallucinations are another symptom or is he actually hearing something?

quests.name: Bug Issue
quests.description: Mind the mana seeping out of the walls on your way in. Malgor seared ShadowFlame into the stone of the Keep, which means even the building is suffering mana overbloat. The locust infestation was already bad enough. After they got a taste for slurping up mana, the critters started to eat imps and worked their way up to devouring mages for more juice. Swat them so we can make our way through unbothered.

quests.name: Advanced Age
quests.description: I was outside for a day or two and the mess got even worse. You see those puddles on the floor? Don't touch them. I'll show you what happens if you do. Just grab a few of the imps but don't rough them up too hard. They tend to spray when they pop from Mana Affliction. Could be because they have smaller bodies than the mages.

quests.name: One Singularity
quests.description: Now that I think about it, what would happen if you touched the timestream puddles? I'll be honest with you, I didn't think about how you were going to close the portal once we got there. That's going above and beyond on my end. The portal room must be flooded by now. It's in your own best interest to see if interacting with that timey wimey sludge is going to put you in diapers.

quests.name: Canaries on Edge
quests.description: I'm going to have to put blackmailing you on hold. Of course the mages need to go and scream at every little thing that comes by on top of exploding. Malgor is busy fighting Drakath but he'll drop everything if he finds out you're here. Either he'll burst in to wring your neck or he's going to jump into the portal. You'll need to silence those mages. You've collected heads before. Does it matter if they come from human-shaped monsters?

quests.name: Caution! Wet Floor
quests.description: If I show any more weakness, I bet you're going to cut me down on the spot. It's almost like I still have Malgor breathing down my back. I know I don't have much time but I really want to see Malgor get what's coming. So hurry up. The area ahead is flooded by the leakage from the Timestream. Only you can wade through and check what's up ahead. Tell me how the barrier's looking and if the Warfury's already there.

quests.name: Reflection in the Puddle
quests.description: The slime-looking blobs slithering around are what I call the Mumblers. When the portal to the Timestream began to leak, some of the puddles gathered together to form into Mumblers. Not sure what they're saying but Malgor was too busy having a fit to listen. He went crazy trying to destroy them. Like with everything he does, Malgor wasn't successful. Mop them up so Gravelyn and I won't trip on them and fall in the puddles.

quests.name: Meniscus Point
quests.description: I can tell when the others are on the brink of exploding. They've gone quiet, just like the mage that blew my arm off. I'd like to hold on to the rest of my limbs for as long as possible. It'll take time to fully tear the barrier down and an explosion or five would be pretty distracting. They won't blow up if you slay them first. You'd be doing them all a favor.

quests.name: Distractions
quests.description: Mumblers and Locusts. They're swarming because of the dead imps and mages. I need to concentrate on the *cough* barrier. Keep them at bay. And don't go -urk- berserk over those dumb slimes.

quests.name: Shadowscythe Recruitement
quests.description: All good Shadowscythe supporters must bring more followers into the fold. Slay 13 Good Soldiers in the /alliance map to bring more undead into Gravelyn's army!

quests.name: Gravelyn's Loyal Retainer
quests.description: Those who follow the Shadowscythe are bound by honor, darkness, and loyalty. You have taken the first step towards becoming one of Empress Gravelyn's most loyal followers, but Chaos still treatens her! Defeat each of the Chaos Lorin turn to win her approval!

quests.name: Remnant of Will
quests.description: Around us are the sentient forces that collect in our bodies, and turn us into Hollowborn. Collect them for Dr. Neelo's studies. I'm curious about them as well…

quests.name: Stake Your Life
quests.description: I've bound the Vampire and broken its fangs, but don't expect it to go down easy. Ready your weapon, and aim to crush its heart. I'll be here to observe and take notes.

quests.name: Hollow Howl
quests.description: Though the Lycan is leashed, it isn't muzzled. Battle it as you would a free beast. I am here to supervise, and make note of any anomalies during your fight.

quests.name: Knee Jerk Reaction
quests.description: It's important to have rations while travelling, but you already know that. Get us some fresh meat. Do you think Yulgar has any surplus in the Cellar?

items_required.name: Green Mystery Meat x10 (stacks up to 30)

quests.name: Nice, But Not Quite
quests.description: You know what these supplies are missing? Rice! It's important to have a balanced diet and this diet is missing some rice. I can't seem to find any in these parts, but I'm sure you can figure something out. I'll bet they store some down in the castle tunnels…

items_required.name: Bundle of Rice x3 (stacks up to 9)

quests.name: Alternative Solution
quests.description: I could go for some dairy. Only problem is… I'm lactose intolerant. I've been looking for a decent substitute, but none of them get me feeling it in my bones. They just don't provide enough Calcium. You wouldn't happen to know a rich source of Calcium? I hear there's a BIG source of it in the Yokai Isles.

items_required.name: Bone Hurt Juice x5 (stacks up to 15)

quests.name: Compassion For A Companion
quests.description: There's something I need to ask of you, though I suppose I've been asking you of things this whole time. I need some ingredients to make an anaesthetic. I heard that there's a plague dragon in /sloth whose ooze can subdue an entire village, and there's a Killer Queen Bee in /beehive who can produce some knockout honey. If you must ask, it's for someone… important to me. I understand if you don't have the time, but I'd really appreciate it as a friend.

quests.name: ShadowZard Guards
quests.description: Long unlive the Shadowscythe! To prove your dedication to the Shadowscythe Cause, defeat a Citadel Crusader in /lightguardwar and bring back their tabard as proof!

quests.name: The Scythe's Edge
quests.description: There are newcomers to the city who are drunk on their power, causing all kinds of mayhem for our troops. If only they knew how fleeting power really is. Defeat the warriors that roam our cities…and show them the true strength of the Shadowscythe Empire.

quests.name: Forged in Blood
quests.description: Members of the Undead Legion have become …arrogant, ever since their victory against the Nation. I'm surprised the Empress didn't punish them for that unsanctioned squabble all those years ago. Losing the Abyssal General was a major blow to her morale…though I hear he stills assists her in backhanded ways. In any case: defeat 7 of the Legion Sentinels stationed around the city, and remind them who they truly work for.

quests.name: The Abyss Stares Back
quests.description: Hmm…Nulgath's Nation. With their leader gone, their units have fallen into disarray. And their contractors refuse to follow our orders. Defeat 10 Void Mercenaries and relinquish them from their contracts. They'll be much more useful to us once we bring them back from the dead.

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 1
quests.description: So, have you collected 200 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 200 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 2
quests.description: So, have you collected 500 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 500 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 3
quests.description: So, have you collected 1000 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 1000 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Golden Ticket Tier 4
quests.description: So, have you collected 2000 Golden Tickets yet? If so, you have come to the right place! Take a look at the fabulous prizes you can get for 2000 Golden Tickets. So, waddya waitin' for? See anything that catches your eye?

quests.name: Gain the Sight
quests.description: If more fairies you would like to see, it's four leaf clovers that you'll need! Fight Lucky Harms on the Rainbow Road, bring me 3 of the clovers he's borrowed.

quests.name: The Dark Taint
quests.description: Our war against the Drow has raged for years and years. But now they wage it through those creatures, innocent, who know not why their light's been spent. Save the Furies, cleanse the 'drakes, from a taint so dark it breaks and bleeds into their skin and bones. We'll keep them safe inside OUR homes.

quests.name: Gifts for the Queen
quests.description: It is only polite courtesy to bring your host a gift or three. My Lady Fair, the Queen, is kind and generous, and sharp of mind. If her favor you would win, these gifts you'll find, and bring within: Eggshells, milk, a rooster's crow. Cysero's Chickencow surely knows how we fairies prize them so! (Find his beast inside Cysero's Battleontown shop)

quests.name: Oak for Luck and Joy
quests.description: Oak for luck and oak for joy, and the fruit of the oak may be employed as cups or clothing or amulets. The oak is mighty, and we never forget to thank our greenclad guardians for all the gifts that they have born. Bring me 3 oak leaves and one acorn, and the Lady will have no cause for scorn.

quests.name: Bracken, Bone, and Branch
quests.description: If we're going to storm the keep, we need to build out our weapons! Bring me Bone Leech fangs for arrows, Tree Branches for shafts, and Weeds for fletching.

quests.name: Break Braddok's Backbone
quests.description: Alright. There's a LOT of guards in this forest. If we're going to get to the keep, we've got to take them out. A squad of guards has 8 members. Let's get to it!

quests.name: Stone of Binding
quests.description: We've got to find the Stone of Binding! Braddok wants it because it will put a spell on whoever it is used on. It'll help him enslave villages, and we have to stop that! It could be ANYWHERE in the forest… or anyone could have found it and picked it up. We have NO idea!

quests.name: Break the Bone Fortress
quests.description: Alright. He's sent out more protection, and we've got to take them down! Defeat the Unbroken Minions, Warriors, and Bone Leeches to gain access to the Fortress.

quests.name: It's a TRAP! (No, really.)
quests.description: We have to face Braddok, and to do THAT, we've got to get into the dungeon. He's probably "interviewing" prisoners down there. He locks it, so we'll need to get the Dungeon Key from one of his guards.

quests.name: Defeat Braddock Bonebreaker
quests.description: You don't REALLY think you can destroy him, right?! … Oh. You do. This'll be interesting to watch!

quests.name: Dapper Hats
quests.description: Leather. Leather hats, yes. But not just any leather. Something soft and supple like… Marsh Stalker hide, yes. Bring me some, won't you? It will make such dapper Hats. And maybe some silvery fins from fishwings… to decorate the brim. Off! To Waterstorm with you!

quests.name: Gone With The Wind
quests.description: I had SO many pretty hats to sell! But then the wind came, and blew them all away. You must get them back! My fancy party hat… stolen by an energy tornado! My classy bowler… absconded with by Living Air! My trendy fedora… swept away by some unworthy wind elemental! Go to Airstorm and find them for me, please?

quests.name: Knighty-Knight!
quests.description: So, what now? Hmm. Maybe if you found some more of those Knights, you could get some information out of them. After all, they HAVE to know the way through here, right?

quests.name: I Yield!
quests.description: Stop! That's enough! Meet me back in the center of the maze, and I'll tell you what you need to know

quests.name: Torch Me
quests.description: First, you're going to want to get some torches. The Hedge Goblins you see wandering the maze have terrible eyesight, so they usually carry some with them for light. Come back when you've collected 12.

quests.name: Light Em Up!
quests.description: Now, take these torches and use them to light all of the lanterns throughout the maze. Light the two in this room LAST.

quests.name: It's A Shard Knock Life
quests.description: Now for the mirror. When it broke, its shards were scattered throughout the maze. But like so many things here, they are enchanted - in order to collect them, you'll have to subdue them first! Some of them might get away on your first try, so you may have to fight a few of them more than once.

quests.name: The Minotaur in the Mirror
quests.description: Now all you have to do is out all of the pieces back together. Good luck with that.

quests.name: Minotaur Prime
quests.description: All that's left now is to defeat the Minotaur Prime! It's probably going to kill you. But hey - maybe it won't! Either way, I'm in for a good show.

quests.name: Through the Looking Glass
quests.description: Well - you did it. Path's open! What are you waiting for?

quests.name: This Is The Place, Right?
quests.description: Looks like you've almost made it to the Tower of Mirrors - the only thing standing between you and those kidnapped girls is this hedge maze! Better make sure you're on the right trail before you find yourself lost in here. Look for a clue that the captured damsels have been through here!

quests.name: Never Go That Way!
quests.description: Now that you know you're in the right place, you'd better start trying to find your way to the center! It looks like that's where the tower is. Probably ought to clear out some of these monsters, too.

quests.name: This Isn't Funny, Guys
quests.description: Ok, well… this looks pretty much exactly the same as the room you just left. Did Scarletta just punk you? Maybe if you go further in, you'll see something to help you figure out what's going on.

quests.name: It's NOTE the Same Maze!
quests.description: Now that you can read these notes, you can see that they are messages that the kidnapped girls have written to their families. Maybe you should try to find the rest. If you can't get them out, then their loved ones deserve to know what happened.

quests.name: Monsters In Mazes
quests.description: It's probably a good idea to clear out some of the monsters in here as you go through the maze. After all, you don't want to end up cornered by a horde of minotaurs! To be sure you are in the correct area of the map, make sure the notes are readable, not reversed!

quests.name: Hit Reverse
quests.description: Now all you have to do is find your way out of here. Should be easy, right? After all, you already solved this puzzle in reverse!

quests.name: Out of Love
quests.description: I'm not really feeling the love here right now, especially with the Hopeless Romantics and the Baristas. They've become… a bit hostile. Can you calm them down pretty please? I can tell that they're all out of love, but I'm too afraid to get close to them in case they turn me into bacon.

quests.name: Conflagration Combo Badge
quests.description: Retrieve flames from the Skeletal Fire Mage in /PortalUndead to unlock the combination badge.

items.name: Summer 2025 Conflagration Combo Character Page Badge

quests.name: Cursed Artifact Shop
quests.description: If you want more information about the artifact you've got in the box, you'll need to talk to the shopkeeper. He is an expert on this sort of thing! Just head to the right and go into the Cursed Artifact Shop.

quests.name: Lamps, Painting and Chairs, oh my!
quests.description: There is something very strange about this Antique shop. It's almost like the very contents are out to get you! Make your way (or BREAK your way..) through the shop and get rid of that Antique Chair that's blocking your way.

quests.name: The (Un)Dresser
quests.description: Everything in this shop is possessed! There are floating Opera Glasses, creepy walking dolls and lamps that attack when you walk near them, but the furniture is the worst! Defeat the UnDresser in order to go deeper into the shop!

quests.name: Ghost Stories
quests.description: Every time I sat down at the Writing Desk in there, my letters turn into ghost stories. Defeat the Writing Desk and move deeper into the shop. You must find out what is causing the haunting!

quests.name: You Can't Tell Time
quests.description: The curse has moved through the shop, letting nothing escape its path. Even the timepieces have been affected, but none worse than the Grandfather Clock. Defeat the Clock to move deeper into the shop.

quests.name: Fuzzy Run Minigame
quests.description: This is a magical Rainbow that will lead us back to Chaos Beleen. But… we will need to harness the power of Chaos Fuzzies in order to cross it unscathed (and without falling through the rainbow upon our first step!). Help me collect 30 Chaos Fuzzies, and then the Rainbow will offer safe voyage to the other side.

quests.name: Train Evil's Army for the Alliance!
quests.description: If the Alliance is to prosper, Empress Gravelyn's undead army must be highly skilled. Head down the hall to the right and find the training room. Show 10 of them your combat moves so they may learn your techniques.

quests.name: Chaos in Hachiko
quests.description: Word has arrived of an underground movement in Hachiko. the Samurai there may have all been Chaoruppted! Hurry there and interrogate any you see to discern the truth. We MUST learn the truth.

quests.name: Hounds of Good
quests.description: The Empress needs warrior drakhounds, and wants to turn Shadowfalls puppies undead to serve. That should not be! They have not had a chance to really live… and they look hungry. Quest all through Shadowfall to find 9 of the pups and slay 7 Fear Munchers to feed them. We can find other warriors for the empress.

quests.name: Dragon Egg Savior!
quests.description: The Empress has heard of a new clutch of dragon eggs in /Lair. She does not want to take the chance that they may be turned to Chaos, but I cannot agree to destroying dragons. Save the 8 eggs to prevent Drakath from Chaorrupting the dragonets which will one day hatch.

quests.name: Rescue Poisonforest Villagers
quests.description: All I know is that the Empress has staged a bandit attack on a nearby town. She will not tell me why. Rescue the 5 villagers in Poisonforest and slay the bandits attacking them!

quests.name: Swordhaven Candy Return
quests.description: Evil comes in all degrees, from lies to slaughter to simple theft… but I know your heart is Good. I hear some nefarious Evildoer has stolen the candy right out of Swordhaven citizens' hands. Give their candy back and return to me.

quests.name: Shadows of the Past
quests.description: If the Empress is to serve the Alliance to the best of her ability and reign over all of Lore, she needs to be free from doubt. She cannot be plagued by the shadows of the past. Head to her jail, uncover the hatch to Sepulchure's crypt, and slay the shadow of her past

quests.name: Slayer of Chaos?
quests.description: Are you a hand of the Alliance , or do you serve Chaos? Slay any of the Monsters infected by Chaos, retrieve the Chaos Gems they prossesess, and you will have a chance to get the Chaos Slayer Armor or Helm.

quests.name: Festive Festa Floats
quests.description: I need your help making Carnaval floats! This should be really fun-but challenging! I need 5 Festive Feathers from Cuco, 3 Float Thingumajigs from Terra da Festa monsters, 5 wood planks from Terra Trees and 2 White Streamers from the Lady in White. Bring everything back and Cysero and I can help make floats for Carnaval. Good luck, hero!

quests.name: Make a Muiraquitã
quests.description: Carnaval needs happiness and good luck! So let us make a Muiraquitã amulet! Collect Green Clay from the Lagoon and Boiúna, and then capture the fire from Mula Sem Cabe๺ to solidify the Muiraquitã amulet.

quests.name: Unknown Alloy for Blacksmithing
quests.description: There is no weapon that cannot be made better. Think of it like a smoothie, the more berries the better! I prefer to work with freshly blended alloys and keep the secret ingredients secret. Mysterious and unknown alloys just make for a more interesting result!

quests.name: Volatile Temper Agent for Blacksmithing
quests.description: Oh! You brought my spicy seasoning. Those will be great for my Spork of Immense PAIN, Blade of Insurmountable Turkey or even Steve!

quests.name: Glowing Temper Agent for Blacksmithing
quests.description: Well of course I can use more Glowing Temper Agent, how else do you expect my amazing work to be so amazing?

quests.name: Masterful Metallurgy
quests.description: Some light-enchanted metal would be useful to practice with. Maybe Artix in the Necropolis would know where to find some.

quests.name: Advanced Alloying
quests.description: Some darkness-enchanted metal would be useful to practice with. Maybe Vayle in the Necropolis would know where to find some.

quests.name: Monster Machining
quests.description: If only I had some strong materials to work with… Some monster parts and magical reagents should work. Some scales from Mobius Lake's Hydra, a few trophies from the various tenants of the Tower of Doom, and a necrotic Creature Shard from the Creature Creation in /maul would work wonders.

quests.name: Intrepid Investing
quests.description: I wonder if Cysero offers blacksmithing lessons…

quests.name: Who Let The Togs Out?
quests.description: It's hard chasing pets when you have no limbs. But I've got a telepathic persuasion device which will make them WANT to come back. It's hard city out there, I don't want them to get hurt .I need you to get me: 1 Rubber Ducky from some guy called Porkon in a fort, 1 Tog Whistle, and 2 Uncured Harp Strings. I heard those're in some ravine.

quests.name: You Don't Want To Know...
quests.description: Look, here's the thing. I've got plans. BIG plans. Plans you don't want to know about. Just… bring me the things on this list: 3 Ghost Dreams, 4 Sneak Ambitions, 1 Pilot Hope, 2 Tog Goals, and 3 Tears from from the Dreadspiders in the marsh.

quests.name: If You Wanna Bake A Cake...
quests.description: This is going to be a pretty big cake so we're going to need some big eggs! A few Dragon Eggs should do. I'll need one from the Red Dragon and one from the GreenGuard Dragon! Try not to drop them on your way back here!

quests.name: Gimme Some Sugar, Baby!
quests.description: WE NEED MO' SUGAR! I had a few pounds of the stuff and I thought I had more but I forgot I traded them for some extra large tea bags. We'll need you to go get 10 Bags of Sugar from the Tanuki in Yokai's /bamboo forest. They LOVE THEM SOME SUGAR!

quests.name: A-Salt and Batter-y
quests.description: For a normal cake you need a little salt. For a cake THIS special you need some very special salt. Fire Salt has the kick we need. Gather some Fire Salts from the fire monsters around /xantown.

quests.name: Purissimo Aquae
quests.description: We need a lot of really pure water for this experime… I mean… cake. The water needs to be as pure as the happy couple's love and that means you need to get it from the source. The monsters in /waterstorm will have some very Pure Water.

quests.name: SPOOOOOOON!
quests.description: OK, we need one more thing. We've got a lot of batter to stir and Oishii's big spoon just won't cut it. We need a magic spoon. The Windigo who lives at the top of the /cloister in Arcangrove carves magic wooden spoons. See if you can get one from him.

quests.name: High-Level Ancient Goose
quests.description: So, the Ancient Goose wasn't tough enough for you, huh? You really think you have what it takes to beat this nastier big brother? Go try it. I dare you.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 1
quests.description: Back for more I see. Well I guess I haven't worked you hard enough. That is fine. I will fix that.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 2
quests.description: Hey. I have this pretty evil axe. It's called the Executioners Judgment. You want it, don't you? Well you are going to have to prove your dedication to the legion first. And even then that might not be enough. But we will see.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 3
quests.description: You again. Have you not yet tired from my missions? …I see. You are almost as unpredictable as Chaos. Speaking of… I want to meddle in the stuff. Chaos, that is. Help me out with some chores and *maybe* I'll give you something cool in exchange. Go fetch 50 vials of Chaorrupted Essences from Chaos Sp-eyes and Chaos Spiders. And then 2 dozen Chaos Eggs. Do not forget the Darkness Core from the Dreadfiend of Nulgath, either.

quests.name: Legion Exercise Number 4
quests.description: I have an idea for a new weapon I want to try out. If it succeeds, then maybe you will get the weapon award. Or maybe not. I might just keep it for myself. So are you feeling lucky, "Champion"?

quests.name: Gateway to the Souls
quests.description: Some guy once told me that eyes are the gateway to the soul. But then I turned him Undead. And he never spoke to me again. So I don't know if this is true or not, but I'm on a hunt for more souls, and there's only one way to find out. If you want a shiny Legion Token, bring me some eyes! I want 15 Chaos Eyeballs from the Underworld's Chaorrupted beasties and 30 Plucked Eyeballs from others. Those are my orders. Go.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 1: Ultra Aeacus
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. Spar with Ultra Aeacus in /judgement or /revenant, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 2: Legion Lich Lord
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. Spar with the Legion Lich Lord in /frozenlair, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 3: The Beast
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. A shade of The Beast has appeared in /sevencircleswar. I could deal with it myself, but are you really going to pass up an opportunity to earn Legion Tokens?

quests.name: Daily Exercise 4: Devastator Deimos
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. Spar with Devastator Deimos in /deimos, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 5: God of the Depths
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. The God of the Depths is stirring. Subdue it, and I'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Daily Exercise 6: Dage the Dark Lord
quests.description: As a member of my elite, your tasks involve keeping other members of the Legion in top shape and subduing any potential threats that emerge. I offer you a challenge. Spar with me in /ultradage, let's see how powerful you've become.

quests.name: Mercutio's Soul
quests.description: I want to recruit Mercutio to join the Undead Legion. But I need his soul. Multiple souls, actually. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 25 souls from Mercutio. Bring them to when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you one Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.name: Ghostly Aracara Souls
quests.description: I want to recruit Ghostly Aracaras to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. A lot of souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 50 Ghostly Aracara Souls. Bring me their souls when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you 1 Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.name: Ghostly Grizzlespit Souls
quests.description: I want to recruit Ghostly Grizzlespits to join the Undead Legion. But I need their souls. A lot of souls. If you haven't already, go buy a Legion Soul Collector from my shop, and then go out and capture 50 Ghostly Grizzlespit Souls. Bring me their souls when you've completed my mission, and I shall give you 1 Legion Token for your hard work. It's a more than fair deal.

quests.name: Undead Champion Initiation
quests.description: This is your trial round, Hero. Fail this, and you fail at becoming an Undead Champion. Got it? Your first—and easiest—mission is to take down the Black Knight of Greenguard Forest. The Knight has been Undead for quite some time yet refuses to join the Undead Legion… so it's up to YOU to show the Black Knight the Legion's true power.

quests.name: Mourn the Soldiers
quests.description: Undead Champions show no mercy. You must see to it that you do what you are told—no questions asked. Your next mission is to scout the entire world of Lore, destroying every dubbed Soldier you encounter. Hunt down the 4 specific Soldiers that the Legion has ordered to exterminate.

quests.name: Understanding Undead Champions
quests.description: The Legion does not tolerate failure. When one of our own kin betrays the Legion, the unfortunate gets stripped of his power and is sent to the deep caverns beneath Battleon to rot for eternity. If you do not wish meet the same fate, you simply must not fail. How hard of a demand is that to meet?

quests.name: Player vs Power
quests.description: The time has come for you to prove your power against fellow adventurers. Join /bludrutbrawl and show your might by defeating anyone you find there - monster or other player. True Undead Champions know they possess great power and will not hold anything back. Only when you have collected 200 Combat Trophies will you truly understand the power bestowed upon the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Fail to the King
quests.description: In Swordhaven, Good King Alteon is a symbol of all that is pure and good. He is well-guarded… and that must end! Go to him. /Join prison and slay 25 of his Knights so that one day soon… you will be able to slay HIM!

quests.name: Rearm The Legion of Light
quests.description: The weapons that these pitiful undead carry are usually as flimsy as they are but a few have weapons of quality that we can use to give to the other members of the Legion in the field. Please find 5 Quality Weapons on the undead soldiers and bring them back to base camp.

quests.name: Free Their Souls
quests.description: Alteon uses necromancy to capture lost souls and binds the souls to the bodies to animate them, but keeps them sundered from the physical forms so that he can control the bodies. It is a horrible crime. The Legion exists to free such lost souls by destroying their bodies. Please free the souls in the first room.

quests.name: One Ring
quests.description: A few days ago the soldiers captured one of my best couriers. I owe it to him to return his Legion of Light Signet Ring to his family. Please, see if you can locate the his Signet Ring on one of the undead.

quests.name: Severing Ties
quests.description: Before you proceed you must first cleanse this room of the enslaved souls being used to animate the undead. Free the souls of all the undead in that room.

quests.name: Legion's Lifesblood
quests.description: Alteon's undead army has a few advantages over the Legion of Light. One of the biggest ones is that the undead do not eat but my comrades must have supplies to continue the battle. Please deliver supplies and place them in gathering points for the Legion Members.

quests.name: Legion's Purpose
quests.description: You are making great headway beating back the undead army but our first priority is freeing the souls of our enemies. Cleanse that room of the undead's enslaved souls before moving on.

quests.name: What's His Endgame?
quests.description: This is going too well. I suspect that we might be walking into a trap. See if one of the undead have a clue to help us figure out Alteon's battle plans. Forewarned is forearmed.

quests.name: A Stopping Block
quests.description: We still haven't translated the note that you found on the undead entirely but we know it has something to do with raising a very powerful undead. The fewer souls Alteon has to fuel his spell the better. It's never been more important to free the souls in that room before moving on.

quests.name: Boost Morale
quests.description: The Legion members must see how much of the Overworld that we've already taken back from Alteon. Please go plant these banners to show everyone how much ground you've already taken back in such a short about of time. it will boost their fighting spirits!

quests.name: Alteon's Folly
quests.description: King Alteon should have known by now the price for using the souls of living beings as weapons is losing your own soul. Free the souls in that room to continue.

quests.name: DoomFire
quests.description: It seems that the imbalanced king has begun to experiment with even more dangerous ways of empowering his undead slaves. It seems that he has used DoomFire. See if you can gather DoomFire from some the undead attacking the Overworld.

quests.name: Spoiled Souls
quests.description: DoomFire is especially dangerous when the souls of the undead are captured as Alteon has done. Exposed to enough DoomFire can actually spoil the soul. You have to free the souls of these undead before they can be harmed!

quests.name: Purity of Bone
quests.description: The Legion has been leaving small piles of purified bone dust around the battlefield as they have been fighting beside you to take back the Overworld. I need you to gather 10 piles of this dust so I can sanctify you before your final battle.

quests.name: Undead Artix Returns!
quests.description: The Clerics have translated the note from earlier. Alteon has resurrected his greatest soldier…. UNDEAD ARTIX! You will have to defeat him if you want to get the egg back from King Alteon! Good Luck!

quests.name: Test the Newborn Fiends
quests.description: So, you want me to face off against these Newborns? They will be mere fodder, but I suppose I will trust your guidance.

quests.name: Best the Hex
quests.description: These are the fabled Hexes of Nulgath? Very well, let us see how they perform.

quests.name: Grunt Work
quests.description: This is not only a training exercise for myself but for these recruits as well. So the burden falls on us to ensure that they are prepared for whatever conflict our Master embroils.

quests.name: Defeat the Fiend Champion
quests.description: A Fiend Champion? Very well. I will show you just what I am capable of, Commandant.

quests.name: Bring Their Doom
quests.description: It is strange to see forces composed of beings other than Fiends. But these feeble excuses for Undead minions will be destroyed even easier. Let's test these "DoomBringers" Scarvitas has assembled.

quests.name: Form A Perimeter
quests.description: We mustn't let Scarvitas escape. Summon for our Hex Fiends to seal off any chances they have of escaping.

quests.name: Wrathful Wraiths
quests.description: He brings forth Ghosts as well? Entertaining, if nothing else. These Doom Wraiths will fall like their "Bringer" brethren.

quests.name: Defeat Scarvitas
quests.description: I actually feel excitement going into this fight. Someone that believes he can steal from Master Nulgath? I must face him in battle.

quests.name: Seal Maintenance
quests.description: I can feel the binding seals on the cells here weakening. If we do not reinforce them, we may have more "inmates" on our hands. We must collect the required energy from the Guards and replace them.

quests.name: Traitors Are Null And Void
quests.description: These Void Fiends that follow Baelgar are more stupid than he is. Not only do they think they can surpass our Master, but they are just trading one master for another. Let us show them the error of their stupidity.

quests.name: Greedy Imprisonment
quests.description: So, Avarice has escaped its cell? Very well, we shall test our strength against one of the natural forces of the Underworld. Let's see if they are as powerful as they are said to be. Defeat them and put this one back in its cell.

quests.name: Defeat Baelgar
quests.description: At last, that traitor, Baelgar, has finally stopped hiding behind his men and his tricks. I want to see what kind of Fiend thinks they have what it takes to escape Master Nulgath's grasp.

quests.name: Dage's Devastation Collection Badge
quests.description: No good can come of Evil battling Evil. Well… not entirely true. YOU will get a badge out of it. IF you slay one of the Enslaved Elementals in the /siegefortress map. Prove your worth.

quests.name: War Horror
quests.description: Welcome, my friend! All heroes eventually pass through the Underworld; in death, the best only grow stronger. You have that power within you. I would be honored to see an example of your skill. One of my fiercest mounted riders is ready to do battle with you.

quests.name: Dage's Underworld Legacy Minion
quests.description: Dage the Evil will grant you 2 House Guards.. but if you want Dage's Underworld Legacy Warden, you'll need to prove you're worthy! Slay a High Legion Inquisitor in /darkwarnation to earn your reward.

quests.name: A-Luring Song
quests.description: We're almost there, and it's only been two days. This is when the whistling of the trees and birds starts to disorient you. Silence the ravens, and tell your Dragon friend to stay put. Anyone can get lost here, and while missing people always get found, they're never the same

quests.name: Splendid Ashes, Pompous Grave
quests.description: You hear that screaming? A few leftover Maleno Matches are running around. They either escaped from Thelima, or were thieves that caught fire trying to steal from the Forge. Can't have them spreading the fire, so do them a favor and shimmy them off their mortal coil.

quests.name: Echolocation
quests.description: We're a stone's throw from Forge Maleno's entrance. Now it gets even trickier. Find the door, but plug the trees on your way there. The holes in their trunks whistle even louder here. If any of them get too loud, they'll explode like fireworks.

quests.name: Chymerical Ash
quests.description: Maleno's Guardian might lump us in with the thieves if we're getting pecked at by the Soul Ravens, or attacked by the Matches. Let's have you, Miss Tara, Sir Aleister, and the Blue Mage take care of them so you'll all stop giving me such mean stink-eyes.

quests.name: More Makai!
quests.description: Hey! Psst! You got a second? I've been going through these Makai pretty fast. If you can round me up some more, I'll give you a few free tickets for your trouble! I don‘t care where you get 'em - /tercessuinotlim, /underworld, wherever. Just make sure they're nice and feisty!

quests.name: Moglin Companions
quests.description: Twilly, Zorbak, and Twig want to journey alongside you, Hero! But before they can leave for your adventures, you'll need to make sure you've got enough MEALs (Moglin Emergency Accessory Luggage) packed away. Battle the Frogzards in Willowcreek or Nexus and bring me back 3 hunks of Frogzard meat and I'll whip a MEAL right up!

quests.name: Experiment 107: Elder's Blood Potion
quests.description: I have a little experimental potion I want to try out… but it's not going to be easy to make. And I can't guarantee on how it is going to turn out… But if you are a brave enough and strong enough… then it can be yours! I need you to slay 50 Gorillaphants so that I can gather the proper amounts of reagents. Good luck… and wish me luck, too!

quests.name: Experiment 231: Sparrow Blood Potion
quests.description: Alchemy experiments are fun! Especially when I have brave adventurers like YOU to test them out for me. I have an experimental potion in mind… but I need your help collecting the required reagents. The monsters in Arcangrove should have them all. Bring me 12 piles of DOOM Dirt, 17 Snapdrakes, and 30 Blood Lilies so I can concoct this potion!

quests.name: Odd's 'n' Ends
quests.description: It takes a lot to stock an odds and ends shop. But one thing we always need is are locks and keys. Those sneevils are awful thieves. Bring me metal ore from the Sneevils in /boxes and I'll fabricate them myself.

quests.name: Tokens of Collection
quests.description: Will, Fred, and Drakath have been living with these beasts for years! But YOU don't have to put up with them; you're a Hero! Slay 2 of the monsters inhabiting the Collector's prison to earn 1 Token of Collection! These tokens can be used to purchase epic rares from the Token Shop in the Collection map!

quests.name: Shadow Embargo
quests.description: I tailor all of my gear with the highest-quality materials in all of Lore. I used to get shipments of Shadow Canvas imported from Skullholme every week, but as of late, the shipments have just stopped. I do not have the time to travel there myself to pick up the material… so perhaps you could go instead? Head to Bludrut Keep and get me 5 yards of Shadow Canvas from the Shadow Creepers in the 2nd Floor Basement. In exchange, I will award you every day you bring me more Shadow Canvas.

quests.name: Bugged by Rares!
quests.description: No wonder you're bugged by everything in this Collection, it's all trying to kill you! Take out 2 of those collectible critters for a Token of Collection!

quests.name: Rarely Defeated!
quests.description: Take these mint condition monsters and scuff, scar and beat down 2 beasties until they aren't even fit for garbage collection, let alone the Collector's dome!

quests.name: SLAY some UNDEAD!!
quests.description: Alright, let's slay some undead! What do you say we start with some Doomwood Ectomancers? Those wimps should be easy to take out!

quests.name: SLAY some MORE UNDEAD!!
quests.description: Yeah! Let's slay some MORE undead! Maybe this time we'll move up to Doomwood Soldiers! They're a little tougher, but they're still no match for me!

quests.name: Slay BIGGER!!
quests.description: Ok, ok… now that we've gotten warmed up, let's think a little BIGGER! Let's see if we can figure out who the leader of this horde is! I bet we'll find some kind of clue if we slay enough of these undead losers! Just make sure you keep that ticker running!

quests.name: Babe in the Woods
quests.description: Hero, I can't continue my trial until we've found this little girl. We'll need to split up and search these woods until we find a clue where she's gone. Meet me back here when you've finished searching.

quests.name: The Dark Thicket
quests.description: Emily must be in that dark thicket. Let's go in there and see if we can track her. We should kill any monsters that we run across, too - it'll make it easier to get her out safely once we've found her. (Quest available once per login)

quests.name: Emily
quests.description: A dead end? But where could she have gone? We must be missing something. Go back in and search the areas more thoroughly - move aside any piles of leaves, ivy, or wood that you find.

quests.name: It Wants Souls
quests.description: *You can hear screams coming from the painting.*

Dark Caster Skull Collection Pet 2019's.name: Dark Caster Skull Collection Pet 2019's Quest

quests.name: DarkCaster Collection Skull Badge
quests.description: What is undead will (literally) never die… again. Dage the Evil enchanted his floating skull to follow you around for all eternity. Defeat one of the Undead Legends in the /legionarena to complete it's quest and unlock the Dark Caster Collection character page badge!

items.name: Dark Caster Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Eternal Dragon Collection Chest Quest
quests.description: The Eternal Dragon of Time is one of Lore's most ancient and powerful beings. They dwell deep in the heart of the Time Void. Journey to /timevoid and defeat an Ephemerite, and you'll unlock the Eternal Dragon Collection Chest character page badge.

items.name: Eternal Dragon Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Darkness Bleeds in Doomwood
quests.description: Slay 13 of the monsters in Doomwood to investigate the nature of the taint, and bring back any unusual objects you find.

quests.name: Seek the Dark Scroll
quests.description: Deep in the heart of the Temple, there is a Dark Scroll that may countain information which will help us. I would never survive the journey, but you… Bring it to me, please!

quests.name: Recover an Umbral Orb
quests.description: There is… I believe there is MORE text on this scroll. I can sense it, but cannot quite make it out. If I had an Umbral Orb, it would shed light (heh) on the ink… enough to make it out. Go to Dark Sepulchure's lair and take one from him.

quests.name: Bring Back Vordred's Skull
quests.description: Defeat Vordred and return to the Dark Loremaster with Vordred's Tainted Skull to complete this quest… then return next Friday, October 16th to begin the Artix Entertainment 13th Anniversary event!

quests.name: Black Friday 2021 Badge
quests.description: A note from Zorbak reads: "You want to be REALLY evil? Kill Master Chairman Platinum in /ebilcorphq. I'll give you something worth your time. Honest."

items.name: Black Friday 2021 Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Fight the Light, Strengthen the Shadow
quests.description: Fight the Lightguard. Steal their life energy. I will use it to strengthen him.

quests.name: Power UP!
quests.description: I must empower his magic as well. Arcane Energy is what I need. From the trees, the slime. Even the Souleater.

quests.name: Finders Keepers
quests.description: No one is exactly allowed to raid the tombs for treasure, but hey,we were here first. Remember, if the Gravediggers aren't with Seraphic Paladins, they're against us.

quests.name: Infiltrate the Infantry
quests.description: I know many seemingly innocent heros have sworn loyalty to Dage the Evil, but that doesn't mean you can't show his forces who's boss. I don't care if you're for Dage or want his skull smashed, I need his infantry forces cleared!

quests.name: You're Doomed
quests.description: How did Dage even get his hands on Doomknights? That's a question to consider later, but we need these beasts cleared out now for even a mere chance at Dage's more sacred treasures.

quests.name: Eyes on the Prize
quests.description: I don't feel comfortable searching these sarcophagi with gravediggers running about. They might steal what we're stealing! Get'em out of here.

quests.name: Filler Quest
quests.description: Searching these forsaken tombs would be a whole lot easier without the worry of the next step being your last. Destroy lurking Doomknights and fill as many Legion trapholes as you can find.

quests.name: Insider Information
quests.description: We hit dead end after dead end in this tomb. There's no way we'll make it out of here without some insider help. Lucky for us, I made friends with a local around here before he was Legion-ized. See if he still has the will to assist the Seraphic Order.

quests.name: Spiky Situation
quests.description: We can't get the camels through to load up Dage's treasure with these spike traps in the way. See if any of the Gravedigger or Infantry weaponry is sharp enough to break through the spikes.

quests.name: Run it Back Again
quests.description: Sometimes killing one monster isn't enough to send a message. Other times destroying 30 Doomknights don't realize you can demolished them so we'll be fighting these beasts for eternity.

quests.name: Defeat Vincenzo!
quests.description: We have heard whisperings of 2 brothers who were subsumed into the Legion. Both were transformed, but… differently. They are the guards of Dage's greatest treasure - you must take them out!

quests.name: Defeat Brutus!
quests.description: You've made it this far - there is no turning back. Defeat the Titan to deactivate the force screen so that you can grab the Dark Shard!

quests.name: Darkside Gear
quests.description: (For owners of the Darkside Class) You have proven your worth - you have the skills of Vader Darkside. Sometimes, however, these skills are not what is called for, but the look always is.

quests.name: Egg-Streme Attraction
quests.description: We need to draw out the Grenwog… and THAT takes - you guessed it - eggs! But lately the Chinchillizards and Dinoids have been stealing them. Break some heads and get my 10 eggs back!

quests.name: Rotten Eggs?!
quests.description: Somebody - and I bet it's those stinking Horcs - is trying to take the eggs we need so badly… but they are leaving rotten ones in their place! Smash imposter eggs - we can't afford to let their smell drive the Grenwog away!

quests.name: Protect the Grenwog
quests.description: As if it weren't bad enough that our eggs are being targeted, our scouts have spotted lemurphant and tigriff tracks around the outside of the Grenwog's cave. Take them out to protect the Grenwog!

quests.name: Ceremony at Risk
quests.description: Aaah, you have skill and strength, I see! You are well suited, I think, to the next problem we face. Those egg-suckling Horcs have stolen our ceremonial tablets… without those we cannot conduct the Hero Rites. Take out the Horcs to retrieve the tablets!

quests.name: Bloodtusk Vision Quest
quests.description: It is important for any prospective Hero of the Tribe to go on a vision quest BEFORE the ritual begins. I cannot make an exception for you. You must go out and tame a Tigriff, Ferret, Chinchillizard, and Rhison. Once you have done this, one of their spirits will identify it as your guide. (A note: ferrets are known to ride on top of Lemurphants!)

quests.name: Armed with Spirit
quests.description: Having chosen your spirit guide, it's time we prepared your ceremonial garb. Slay Rhison for bone ornaments, Lemurphants for blood paint, and Dinoids for rattle scales to get the resources we need!

quests.name: Cheers to You!
quests.description: I believe in you, my friend, and that you're the Hero you say you are. We must prepare the ritual congratulatory drink for after the ceremony! Slay Chinchillizards for bones and tears, rhison for milk, and eggs for yolk.

quests.name: Staff of Heroes
quests.description: Only those who have proven their worth can wield the Ritual Staff of Heroes. A new one is made for each person completing the ceremony. To finish yours, we will need feathers from the tigriffs. Slay them until you have 6 bundles of feathers!

quests.name: Ritual of Heroes
quests.description: At last, it's time for the ceremony! Defeat the Grenwog in ritual combat and you will be recognized by all as one of the greatest heroes of Bloodtusk Ravine!

quests.name: Grelot: Grenwog Gauntlet
quests.description: Once a hero has passed through the ceremony, they are welcome to face the Grenwog again each year. It's a mark of their skill to take it out faster and faster each year. We call this gauntlet the Grelot. If you dare, you may try it — defeat the Grenwog 50 times in a row!

quests.name: Victory Feast: Rhison Meats
quests.description: We always love a good feast, and the Ritual of Heroes is an excellent reason to hold one! Bring me back 20 Rhison haunches so we can feed the whole tribe before you depart!

quests.name: Dinoid Dash
quests.description: The Dinoids sure do scatter quick when our hunters approach! One of the tribe's favorite games is Dinoid Dash - where the hunters each try to take out 10 dinoids in a row. They save their bones to use as trophies, game pieces, and furniture. Would you like to try the game?

quests.name: Shut Down Sentries
quests.description: Ok, now that you're in there, I'll first need you to shut down any of the sentries in the main hall that look like they've been corrupted by the virus. I'll wipe them and reinstall their software later. For now, we just need to make sure they can't spead it any further.

quests.name: Find the Virus
quests.description: Now, you'll need to scan all of the archways in the hall to detemine which timeline the virus is currently attacking. Once we know that, we'll be able to enter the timeline and attempt to eradicate it.

quests.name: Timeline XV6: Champion of Chaos
quests.description: XV6 is the timeline that corresponds to the events surrounding the Champion of chaos. If Drakath's past has been altered… well. That could either be very good, or very bad. Enter XV6, and talk to Data Station Hephaestus to get a report on the current status of that timeline.

quests.name: Get some Help
quests.description: This is even worse than I'd imagined! Those poor people! Let's help them in what small ways we can - slay some of these Infernal Warriors, and see if you can find someone who can help you pinpoint the virus's location. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Geese... and Pie?
quests.description: Before you do anything else, I'd like to have you explore this altered timeline and evauate the effect of this change. Talk to Cysero, and… I suppose you'LL want to do something about all of those sock-geese and pie-balls. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Exponential Silliness
quests.description: Ok, so, with Cysero as the Chapion of Chaos, Lore isn't really in much danger. It's just becoming exponentially sillier. So, for now, we'll focus on finding and eradicating the errant code. If I am correct, therever it's located will be where this timeline's changes are the most intense. In other words… find the place where the silliness is ass its peak.

quests.name: Get the Glitch!
quests.description: Excellent! Thanks to the system scanners you put down, the data glitch has been revealed!

quests.name: Timeline H2Z: The Death of Sepulchure
quests.description: The corruption has spread to file H2Z - this is the timeline that corresponds to the events surrounding the death od Sepulchure. Enter H2Z, and talk to Data Station Perses to get a report on the current status of that timeline.

quests.name: Keep Tracking the Virus
quests.description: Oh my heavens, what a mess! We must track down the virus before it gets even worse. Start by talking to Gravelyn; see if she has seen any kind of those Pactagonal Knights in order to get a moment with her. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Talk to Alteon
quests.description: Heading south from here should take you to Swordhaven… as strange as that seems. Talk to King Alteon, and see if he has noticed anything strange. You may need to fend off some of Gravelyn's Skeletal Warriors before you can chat with him. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Destroy More Data
quests.description: That sounds like it might be worth investigating! Head to the throne room, and if there IS another piece of glitched data in there, destoy it!

quests.name: Timeline P23: Infernal Invasion
quests.description: The corruption has spread to file P23 - this is the timeline that corresponding to the events surrounding the Infernal invasion. Enter P23, and talk to Data Station Erebus to get a report on the current status of that timeline.

quests.name: Go Fetch!
quests.description: The dog is a man's best friend. And I already have so many friends that becoming a dog would be the best choice for me! But I need to look the part first. If you can help me build the costume, I'll reward you for all your hard work! This is what I need:

quests.name: A Fowl Costume Change
quests.description: Kibble with "real gravy taste" just isn't cutting it for me anymore. I need to feed like a real animal! And what better creature than a scavenger? Yup. I want to be a vulture. A great big terrifying vulture so I can perch myself way up high on a chair and stare at my victims down below. Yess…yessss! It's perfect! This is what I need:

quests.name: After a While...
quests.description: Yup. A Crocodile. Like I said, it's going to blow my vulture man outfit out of the water… because that's where crocs live! As a newfound reptilian beast, I can patrol the rivers and grub on some tasty Zards without the roommate going hungry. Mmmm! This is what I'm going to need:

quests.name: Who You Callin' a ChickenMan?
quests.description: This is it! My greatest idea yet! I can't believe I didn't think of it sooner! I know I'm supposed to be the ChickenMan! All I have to do is look the part and strut my stuff! Can you find me the following materials?

quests.name: Solar Powered Wind Burning Air Conditioning Stove
quests.description: It just rolls right off the tip of your tongue, doesn't it? I want to make this stove by using recycled materials found all over the world! Why should I buy a "normal" stove just to burn all the gas away? That's not eco-friendly at all. So in order to create my greatest (and only!) invention, I will need:

quests.name: Flying South
quests.description: Guess what? I'm moving! Have you ever seen a ChickenMan living in the Northlands other than me? Exactly. I'm going to fly south for the winter. I just need a few extra things before I go on my trip.

quests.name: A Gate and Terrible Monster
quests.description: Deactivated Security Bot: *whirrr* Entrance to storage yard is forbidden without authorized clearance. *bzzzzzt*

quests.name: I'm on the Hunt, I'm after 58-Sr3
quests.description: Incoming message from Hyperium's Artificial Communication System. Required response parameter deactivated: Solid-Holographic Barrier Gate is now illusory and can be passed without battling. Mission states that piles of discarded equipment must be thoroughly searched for item 58-Sr3. (Click the piles of junk to search!)

quests.name: Dage's Dark Badge
quests.description: Makai are annoying pests. Slay 1 and bring me its heart. Just for fun. Dark, deadly fun.

quests.name: Black Friday 2020 Collection
quests.description: Ebil DeadM0g says: "Defeat one of the Shadow Makai living in the Shadow Realm or fighting in the Dark Alliance to unlock your exclusive Dark Holiday 2020 collection chest badge!"

items.name: 2020 Dark Holiday Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Head Hunting
quests.description: Hey! I’ve got this Unlucky treasure Chest here and it’s Full of Unlucky Friday the 13th items which I'd just LOVE to get rid of, but nothing in life is free. I'd really like some skulls for my collection (everyone needs a hobby). While you’re ripping up the Jungle, if you can find me 6 SKULLS then I’ll give you the Unlucky Skeleton Key that unlocks the chest. (HINT: destroy everything in your path… some skulls like to hide behind trees and in houses!)

quests.name: Glub
quests.description: *glub* (Despite being an all-powerful being, I get kind of hungry from time-to-time. And no one ever feeds me. If you could bring me some Fishin' Chips from doing any of Faith's quests in /greenguardwest, I'd be eternally grateful.)

quests.name: Glub, Glub
quests.description: *glub, glub* (I wonder…the Fallen Heroes that roam these parts are said to be quite powerful. I would fight them myself, but half the city might be destroyed as a result. Would you mind taking a few of them out, to see how good they are?)

quests.name: Glub, Glub, Glub
quests.description: *…glub* (I'm feeling a bit lonely here in my bowl. I'd invite you in, but…I don't think there's enough room. Would you mind finding a companion for me here in the city? People usually keep a goldfish in their pockets, right?)

quests.name: DeathKnight Loot Chest
quests.description: "An inscribed plaque on the chest reads: DEATHKNIGHT CHEST CONTENTS PROPERTY OF Ivoliss. CLAWS OFF." 6 locks run along the rim of the chest. A wise hero would look for the keys on Ivoliss.

quests.name: Arrive in the Underworld
quests.description: You have arrived in the Underworld, and this time Death won't let you leave! Show him how serious you are about getting out of here by killing 20 of his minions!

quests.name: Search for Death's Lair
quests.description: You've ended up in Death's domain. Now your only hope to get out is to battle your way through the dungeon!

quests.name: Beyond the Portal
quests.description: Only the strongest of souls can enter my master's realm… and you're not one of them! Turn back now, or join this field of bones!

quests.name: Turn Frost Dragon into Dracolich!
quests.description: MUHAHAHA… I SEE YOU HAVE VISITED ME OUT OF SHEER CURIOSITY. YOU KNOW, CURIOSITY CAN BE QUITE DEADLY… I HOPE YOU HAVE COME PREPARED! HMM… IF YOU HAVE AN ARMORED BABY FROST DRAGON PET, CAN YOU ALLOW ME TO… PET IT? I SO LOVE THEM…

quests.name: Turn Dracolich into Dragon!
quests.description: MUHAHA… MY MY. YOU ARE ONE BRAVE SOUL TO VENTURE HERE. CAN'T YOU SEE THAT I AM BUSY DEPOPULATING THE FOREST OF SOULS? THIS IS HARD WORK, AND I HAVEN'T ANY TIME TO CEME-TARRY AROUND! BUT, IF YOU HAPPEN TO HAVE A CUTE LITTLE PET DRACOLICH FOR ME TO PET. PLEASE SHOW HIM TO ME - I JUST LOVE THOSE LITTLE GUYS!

quests.name: Turn Red Dragon into Dracolich
quests.description: MUHAHAHA… I SEE YOU HAVE VISITED ME OUT OF SHEER CURIOSITY. YOU KNOW, CURIOSITY CAN BE QUITE DEADLY… I HOPE YOU HAVE COME PREPARED! HMM… IF YOU HAVE A BABY RED DRAGON PET, CAN YOU ALLOW ME TO… PET IT? I SO LOVE THEM…

quests.name: Turn Dracolich into Red Dragon
quests.description: MUHAHA… MY MY. YOU ARE ONE BRAVE SOUL TO VENTURE HERE. CAN'T YOU SEE THAT I AM BUSY DEPOPULATING THE FOREST OF SOULS? THIS IS HARD WORK, AND I HAVEN'T ANY TIME TO CEME-TARRY AROUND! BUT, IF YOU HAPPEN TO HAVE A CUTE LITTLE PET DRACOLICH FOR ME TO PET, PLEASE SHOW HIM TO ME— I JUST LOVE THOSE LITTLE GUYS!

quests.name: A Perfect Skull-pture
quests.description: I SEE YOU'RE A BIG FAN OF ME. WHY ELSE WOULD YOU COME BACK HERE? JUST FOR YOU, I HAVE SOMEBODY YOU'D LIKE TO BE FRIENDS WITH. JUST GET SOME STUFF FOR ME FIRST.

quests.name: Moving Through Time
quests.description: If you truly want to understand how ShadowWalkers operate, study the Ephemerites and Time Wraiths. Watch how they move not only through space but through Time! It is through them that you will take your first steps through Time.

quests.name: Even Time May Die
quests.description: In the blank space between timelines, beings like Shadow Guardians, live. Face them in /shadowrealmpast, and begin to understand the threats you will face with that space.

items_required.name: Shadow Guardians Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Talk to the Guards
quests.description: There are still a lot of Lascivia's minions who stayed behind. I think our best chance is to find a guard who knows a lot about Killek, and willing to show us where he is. They're Elite, so you'll have to best them in combat before they'll respect you enough to speak to you.

quests.name: No Light-hearted Expression
quests.description: Oh, Hero! With all of the Paladins missing I'm so worried about Undead invasions. And we've seen them sneaking around. It makes me fearful of the dark. I'm too OLD for that but… I am scared. Can you place Orbs of Light around the Keep and kill off some of the Undead Bonemunchers? I'd feel so reassured! (Quest can only be done once per login)

quests.name: Zheleznymi Zubami
quests.description: A third arm - or a second left arm - grows out of the Expeditioner's back. Its frozen fingers slowly start to move. The index finger uncurls first, followed by the thumb, and finally the pinky. You have a sense that the Expeditioner isn't doing this themselves. It's like invisible strings are tugging on their hand. A deep sense of foreboding washes over you. This is extremely dangerous.

quests.name: Getting a Feel for the Area
quests.description: Before we do anything, Hero, it is best that you get a feel for the area. Head east and begin ascending the mountain. Also, if we are going to find a way into that cave, we are going to need a clear path! Defeat any ice monsters you run across and return to me.

quests.name: Finding the First Rune
quests.description: In order to gain access to that cave, we are going to need find four runes that seal it. My gut tells me one of the local Ice Elementals might hold the first one! Fight them until you find one!

quests.name: A Slippery Slope
quests.description: The second rune was most likely given to one of the Ursice Savages for safe keeping. Teach them that there is no safe place from you, Hero!

quests.name: A 100% Chance of Hail
quests.description: It appears the third rune was meant for someone else, but an Ice Splitter gobbled it up. Fight some of them until one splits it at you!

quests.name: The Final Rune
quests.description: The last rune is nowhere to be seen. Just fight any enemy and hope it shows up! Get ready to grind, Hero!

quests.name: Unlock the Cave
quests.description: With all four runes gathered, we can finally unlock the cave and get the Frozen Claymore!

quests.name: The Guardian
quests.description: It is time to defeat Izotz, the Guardianof the Claymore and claim it for yourself!

quests.name: The Strongest Thread
quests.description: With all the fighting going on, we've got a lot of clothes that need to be mended. Unfortunately, we're running low on thread! Get me some spider's silk, and I'll make sure it's distributed to all of our tailors.

quests.name: No Time for Blacksmiths
quests.description: At this rate this infestation is spreading, I worry that even civilians may have to fight. The stony plating of the gargoyles roaming Swordhaven would make a decent armor. If you can get me some, I'll take care of the rest.

quests.name: The Haunting of Swordhaven
quests.description: Since I'm out here all day, I get most of my research done at night. But how can I focus with so many wraiths haunting the castle? All that moaning, groaning, and chain-rattling!

quests.name: 1,000,000% Achieved
quests.description: OMG, heroes! Reaching 1,000,000% funded on the AQW: Infinity Kickstarter in just FOUR DAYS… Your victory is unbelievable! To show our appreciation, the team created a few gifts to share with all players. Defeat Big Jack Sprat to get his weapon and hire him to defend your house.

quests.name: Chain Reaction
quests.description: The Sneevils must be stopped! Our faerie magic can heal much of the forest but, at this rate there will be nothing to heal! Bring us 8 of the Sneevil Chainsaws and help us save the forest!

quests.name: Epic Drops
quests.description: While fighting off Escherion's minions many of us have been injured. These Faerie Forest Guards are too weak to heal themselves. We need the rare Dew Drop from the funnel plants in the forest. The special plants are a pinkish shade. Please, find 7 Dew Drop and bring it to me.

quests.name: Jarring Theft
quests.description: Those little green thieves! They must have discovered the box that holds our Healing Jar! Without that Healing Jar, the Dew Drop is useless! Please, you must find which of the Sneevils stole the healing Jar and return it to me, before it's too late!

quests.name: Tree Hugger
quests.description: At the heart of the forest is our Tree of Life. It is the soul of the Faerie Forest and if Escherion's Cyclops General succeeds in chopping it down then the forest and all within it will wither and die. Bring me the Cyclops Warlord's Beard as proof of his defeat.

quests.name: The Second Piece
quests.description: You have earned our trust and I am willing to give you our piece of the Runix Cube. It is sealed within the Tree of Life, and to unlock the seal I need the an ancient relic guarded by Aracara, the ancient spider who lives high in the trees to the north. Return to me with the relic and the piece is yours.

quests.name: The Twisted Land Burns
quests.description: Repair the homes of these wretched townspeople and drive out the 10 Invaders so I may have peace in my forest again!

quests.name: Clear the Forest
quests.description: Not quite ready to tackle the creatures in the Void, eh? I get that. It's always good to warm-up before going into battle. Take out 5 Plague Spreaders to help the defenders keep the area clear.

quests.name: Banish the Skulls
quests.description: I need to remain here for some time, still, for my studies. But I am afraid that my continued presence here has been drawing the attention of Nightmare Skulls. I cannot focus! But if someone might help me banish them…

quests.name: S'KARIN WANT MOGLIN POPPERS
quests.description: You heard her. S'KARIN WANT MOGLIN POPPERS. *cough* Better get out there and find some of those Undead Moglins I brought back last month. They should still be… ripe.

quests.name: S'KARIN WANT HAMSTEAK
quests.description: According to my culinary degree, that's not exactly what ham steak is. But hey, the customer's always right. Go grab me some of those Haunted Hamsters. NOW. She's starting to salivate.

quests.name: S'KARIN WANT A SKELLO MOLD
quests.description: I've been a lich for decades… maybe centuries… and even *I* can't stomach the thought of boiling undead kitten bones for gelatin, then shoving eyeballs and fruit inside it. But what S'karin wants, S'karin gets. Bring me back a sack full of Skelekittens, stat.

quests.name: S'KARIN WANT OFFAL BIRD FOOD
quests.description: You… you DO know what offal is, right? And don't say "awful." It's accurate, but ignores the long gastronomical history of our customers. They LOVE chewing on innards, out-ards, and all the zard-ards in between. Round up some of the Undead Turkeys to harvest their intestines. GO.

quests.name: S'KARIN WANT WINGS
quests.description: You know what the commercials say… Dedbull gives you wings. And since S'karin is too HANGRY to specify what kind of wings she wants… let's just go with extra-spicy Dedbull Wings. Rip'em off Dedbull the Undead Roosterbull out in the forest.

quests.name: S'KARIN WANT MERMAID SUSHI
quests.description: You know what to do. The customer's always right, and if you want to keep your job, you're going to get out there and go fish. Find your friend the Mer-Angel, and be quick about it. We're a fast food joint, you know?

quests.name: Coconutty
quests.description: Well, if we're going to be wandering the woods, we've got to make sure we don't get dehydrated! Some coconut water would be a big help… and maybe some coconut shavings to snack on. Good thing there are a lot of Palm Treeants around here, huh?

quests.name: Gift Giving
quests.description: We can't just show up and demand assistance. We're going to need a gift to show our appreciation! Beads, maybe… the crows steal them from the dancers to build nests. And flowers, do you think? You can just pick those from the ground.

quests.name: Clear the Forest
quests.description: I guess we can go into the forest and start looking now. But gosh, the woods are dangerous! I'd feel a lot better about this if you cleared out some of the monsters first.

quests.name: Songs for Dancing
quests.description: You didn't see him when you were in the forest before, huh? I guess we'll have to find a way to lure him out. Maybe he'd like some beautiful bird songs to dance to! The only birds we have around here are crows, but that will have to do, I guess.

quests.name: Search!
quests.description: Well, come on! Let's find this guy!

quests.name: Below the Parade
quests.description: Come on, I know exactly where to find this thing! There's a manhole cover nearby. That's how we'll get ourselves UNDER the parade! I'll meet you down there.

quests.name: Light it Up
quests.description: Wow, it's so dark down here! We've gotta light this place up. I see some glowing mushrooms wandering in the muck. If we gather their caps and clean the grime off, I bet they'd do the trick!

quests.name: Imp-terrogation
quests.description: Where do you think that mask could be? I bet these Voodoo Dolls know! We'll have to interrogate them and make them tell us.

quests.name: Snack Time?
quests.description: One of those imps says he'll tell us what we want to know, but he wants us to bribe him with a snack first. Can you believe that? Anyway, he says he likes chewing on rat tails, so… you know what to do.

quests.name: Grime Time
quests.description: Ok, well, that imp says the mask is locked inside a treasure chest down here. Only problem is, he doesn't know which one. So I guess we just gotta find a bunch of keys and open them all. But who knows where the keys could be? Maybe one of these monsters stole them.

quests.name: Only The Strong Survive Today
quests.description: I am your leader. You shall obey. Are you the predator or are you the prey? Only one is worthy of fighting in my name. Bring me the following blades and helms from the creatures in the Underworld, and we shall see how loyal you really are.

items_required.name: Legion Champion Medal x5 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Crush the Weak
quests.description: I will not accept less than utter devotion. The Legion spreads like a virus. Rid the Underworld of this plague. Bring me the following blades and helms from the creatures in the Underworld, and we shall see how loyal you really are.

items_required.name: Legion Champion Medal x5 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Speak no Legion Evil
quests.description: Dage’s Legion of Lycan warriors cannot spread the word of his power if they cannot SPEAK! Bring me 100 Lycan Tongues to prevent Dage’s Legion from gathering more followers. Return and there will be a fiendishly-epic reward.

quests.name: Workspace Safety
quests.description: I hear you've visited toxic environments during your adventures. That's great- I won't be dealing with a newbie. Still, you'll need to protect yourself before we start handling large amounts of radiation. Grab a few ingots of Toxian Metal from my warehouse, and then bring me a few samples of corrosive substances from your world. Noxious Fumes from /therift, a Toxic Fiend's Blood from /shadowattack, and both a Sludge Beast's Tentacle and Ektorax's Ectoplasm from the cave next to us should do nicely.

items_required.name: Toxic Fiend Blood x3 (Stacks up to 7)

quests.name: Radiosynthesis
quests.description: I can track objects or beings that emit radiation, but that doesn't mean I know the terrain like you do. According to my analysis, the lifeforms of /charredpath are perfectly adapted to toxicity. That's oddly similar to the biology of my people… interesting. Bring me the essence of the creatures there, and I'll condense them into a gem of radioactive energy.

quests.name: Disintegration
quests.description: The process of making Toxic Gems can be a bit tedious. Would you rather take a more aggressive approach? I need you to fight Extriki, The Destroyer. If you're able to crack the gem on its head, bring me a shard of it. Despite the harder work, refining these shards will be much easier than condensing other materials.

quests.name: Artificial Transmutation
quests.description: Now that we have Toxic Gems at our disposal, we can try reducing their radioactive decay. It's no easy task, and we'll have to be extra careful.
