quests.description: Those two standing by the fountain are Bellonna and Sleih, my mother and father. They've been taken by the Shadows! Please, you must help me save them!

quests.name: Get Lost in Me
quests.description: The Shadow infesting the walls of Camlan, Ouroboros the Metamorphosis Maw, lurks in the heart of the temple. We must banish this intruder and save my people!

quests.name: What the Duck?
quests.description: Oh the irony: a weapon shop getting robbed is like a fire station burning down. Hopefully you're a better sleuthhound than Steven is a Seagull. Search my entire shop and see if you can find a clue.

quests.name: Like Feather, Like Son
quests.description: Straight up: that's down. And I would know, because I'm clearly a bird and not some awesome internet meme. Well, we'll need to find a match to this feather — that means it's up to you to battle BirdsWithHarms and collect a feather from each fowl foe so we can find a perfect match.

quests.name: Duck, Duck, Goose
quests.description: What the flock… not a single one of these feathers are a perfect match to the feather you found in my shop. But I know a down feather when I see one… it couldn't possibly belong to the silly walking Goose I saw waddling into the Pet Shop… or even the Gosling who owns that store? Go take a gander.

quests.name: Testin' Yer Metal
quests.description: Ya wants to give ol' Dufar a hand, yeh? Good. if'n these attacks keep comin', and they WILL, the warrior refugees're gonna need more weapons. Bring me 5 hunks of Iron frum th' Grim Stalkers. They hoards it, belike. An' 3 Steel Ingots frum th' Goblins.

quests.name: Whet Your Appetite
quests.description: Yer gonna need some pretty sharp weapons if yer gonna take on th' creatures around here. If'n ya want the sharpest gear, ye'll need a whetstone and m' special polish. Here's a list, get to it.

quests.name: Sa Fire Away!
quests.description: One thing I know to be true, the Safire's of Northpointe are some of the most beautimous gems in all a' Lore. The Wyvern's love'em. They taste like blue sweets. Bring me 6 Safires an' I'll make it worth yer while.

quests.name: This Is Key
quests.description: There are so many halls, so many locked doors. You'll need all the keys you can get. The first Key is on one of the Hollowsoul Wraiths that haunt the castle. Once you find a Unknown Key from the Wraiths return to me. This might be the Simple Key.

quests.name: I Love The Keys
quests.description: You will find that this key unlocks the Red Door near here. Behind the door you'll find one of Hollowsoul's foul monsters that the castle uses to feed its insatiable hunger for souls. You must defeat Deathgazer Prime to find another Key. It might be the Complex Key you need to move forward!

quests.name: Off Key
quests.description: The Complex Key will allow you through the golden door. Once inside, you must do battle with the Jelly-like Cube. The last hero to possess the Golden Key was devoured by it some time ago. Return to me with the Key you find once you have it to see if it's indeed the Golden Key.

quests.name: We're Going To Need A Bigger Key
quests.description: This key unlocks the dread Black Door. That will grant you access to the lair of the Archwraith! I believe the Archwraith was once the castle's wizard… but he's been twisted by time and hatred. If you can defeat him, he may drop a Key! This could be the Hollowsoul Key which will unlock all the doors so far! Return when the deed is done!

quests.name: Potion Surplus
quests.description: Of course it's a "surplus," you give me a Combat Badge… I give you one potion.

quests.name: Lightning Scrolls of Lightning
quests.description: Electric paper, I tell you! That is the secret to harnessing the power of lightning within a scroll. How about I just trade my pre-infused scrolls for a mere Combat Trophy each.

quests.name: Basic War Sword
quests.description: Going back to the basics of many common sword foundations. This Blade can be made into bigger better swords, too… so if you want it, I'll need 50 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Steel Afterlife
quests.description: This helm would go well with that armor. Don't believe me? 50 Combat Trophies and you'll see, too.

quests.name: Behemoth Blade of Light
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! You really want this Blade, huh? Well this big bad boy comes with a hefty price. I need 500 Combat Trophies, a Basic War Sword, and a Steel Afterlife helm in order to craft one for you. Yeah. Good luck.

quests.name: Behemoth Blade of Shadow
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! You really think you can obtain this Behemoth Blade? The amount of requirements matches its mammoth size. 500 Combat Trophies, a Basic War Sword, and the Steel Afterlife helm is all I need

quests.name: Warden Of Light Armor
quests.description: Interested in obtaining the divine Warden of Light Armor? Show me 500 Combat Trophies, and it's yours.

quests.name: Conqueror of Shadow Armor
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Ready to become a Conqueror of Shadow? All I need is 350 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Light Warden Helm
quests.description: Light Wardens are often seen with this sort of helm. For 150 Combat Trophies, you will be seen, and noticed, too.

quests.name: Shadow Conqueror Helm
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! No Conqueror of Shadow would be caught dead-or alive- without this helm. 100 Combat Trophies will assure this.

quests.name: Infamous Revenge
quests.description: This polearm is so famous… that it's infamous! No that didn't really make sense, but if you want this polearm, you're going to have to give me 50 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Legendary Retribution
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Of course you want this polearm. But are you ready to pay the price? 50 Combat Trophies and the Infamous Revenge polearm is all I ask. Nothing too crazy, right?

quests.name: Divine Retribution
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! A polearm this epic requires some epic turn ins. Give me 50 Combat Trophies and 1 Legendary Retribution polearm and I'll make you the Divine Retribuion.

quests.name: Venomous Shadow Blade
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! You have the Vampiric Nightshade blade? Well if you do, then all I need is 50 Combat Trophies and I can turn it into the Venomous Shadow Blade! Ask a glittering Vampire for the Vampiric Nightshade if you don't have one.

quests.name: Masculine Helm of Glory
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! This is one epic helm. I'll give it to you for only 50 Combat Trophies.

quests.name: Feminine Helm of Glory
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Want this epic war Helm? I'll part with it for only 50 Combat Trophies. Just for you, though. No one else.

quests.name: Bearded Helm of Glory
quests.description: Got a beard? This helm is PERFECT for you! 50 Combat Trophies and I'll let you try it on.

quests.name: The Armet of the Afterlife
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Looks like your Steel Afterlife could use an upgrade. Turn in 55 Combat Trophies and 1 Steel Afterlife helm and I'll make you the Armet of the Afterlife.

quests.name: Bearded Armet of the Afterlife
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Beards need protection, too. And it looks too cramped in any other helm. Soooo in exchange for 50 Combat Trophies and 1 Steel Afterlife helm, I'll make a new Helm for you.

quests.name: Ultimate Victory Armet
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Congratulations on your victories! Show them off with this Helm in exchange for 70 Combat Trophies and a Steel Afterlife Helm..

quests.name: Helm of Ultimate Victory
quests.description: MEMBER ONLY! Congratulations on your many flawless victories! In exchange for 70 Combat Trophies and a Steel Afterlife helm, this amazing royal helm is all yours.

quests.name: To Be A DragonHunter
quests.description: So you want to show me that you've got what it takes to join my hunt? Ok. Let's start easy. There are a few draconians in this lair. Bring me 10 Draconian Fangs. If you survive, we'll move on.

quests.name: The Easy Path
quests.description: Our real game is are the DRAGONS in there, so let's just clear out the draconians. I've made these poison bombs. Once you set them off they will start killing off those things. There are always more it seems but this will make the hunt easier for us.

quests.name: The Red Trophy
quests.description: Time to get dirty. There are 2 dragons in there. Follow the top path and you'll find her. I want you to bring me her HEAD. it will make a nice trophy.

quests.name: Scramble 'Em!
quests.description: Finally you're ready. I want you to find the dragon's nest and CRUSH those Dragon Eggs! Show that Onyx Lava Dragon that we mean business. Get him angry. DESTROY THE EGGS IN THE NEXT!

quests.name: You did it?
quests.description: Well, well, well. I didn't think that you had it in you but I can admit when I am wrong. Let's keep going. I've got a plan but it will require some items. Go gather some Wyvern Meat for me and head back here.

quests.name: Tasty Treats
quests.description: I've got a plan. We're going to make a little snack so we're going to need some Draconian Venom to… season… the meat. I need a Vial of Draconian Venom from the Venom Draconians that live here. Bring the vial back before it cools, otherwise the dragon will smell it!

quests.name: Hidden Points
quests.description: The Next ingredient for our dragon snack will be Golden Draconian scales. They are the sharpest of the lot. We'll hide them inside the meat as a razor sharp surprise for that beast. Not very sporting but it will get the job done. 5 Golden Draconian Scales should do.

quests.name: Set The Trap
quests.description: There, I've made 12 wyvern poisoned meat treats with shards of golden scales inside them. That should really rip up his insides if he takes the bait. Go place them around the cavern and get back here once you've dropped them all.

quests.name: The Hard Path
quests.description: Hmmm. It's been too long. He must not be taking the bait. I knew the venom was too cold! This is all your fault. I should beat you bloodless but I will give you another chance to be a real Dragonhunter… the hard way. Bring me the head of the Onyx Lava Dragon.

quests.name: Spare Hydra Heads
quests.description: The crew of the Hydra's Hark are made of countless cutthroat undead. When I strike one down, another jumps in to take its place. Lend your blade and cut a path to their captain!

quests.name: Chasing Crimson October
quests.description: Commander Gallaeon plans to take his ship and sail into the stratosphere. Defeat him before he escapes, and return his ship back to the grasp of the Shadowscythe!

items_required.name: Dented Naval Medal x1 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Dead Men's Jumping
quests.description: The crew of the Hydra's Hark and their Commander were impressed by how you managed to beat them single handedly. So here's a head's up, they're planning to jump you in the back room to see if you can take them all at the same time. Good luck with that.

items_required.name: Hydra Crew Defeated x8 (Stacks up to 100)
Commander Gallaeon Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Celebrate the Successful Siege
quests.description: Let's celebrate the successful siege of Gallaeon's ship.

quests.name: Earn Dwobo Coins
quests.description: Listen here, "Hero"! Everything in this location is "my" loot! I would be willing to trade with you for some of the items I found… if the price is right. Bring me 8 Ancient Treasures from Unlucky Explorers, 5 Pieces of Future Tech from the Spacetime Anomalies, and lastly, a piece of idol Heart from the Cluckmoo Idol. And yes, idols have hearts too, though they are also stone so it's kinda hard to tell it apart from the rest of it…

quests.name: More Dwobo Coins
quests.description: Listen here, "Legendary Hero"! Everything in this location is "my" loot! I would be willing to trade with you for some of the items I found… if the price is right. Bring me 10 Ancient Treasures from Unlucky Explorers, 7 Pieces of Future Tech from the Spacetime Anomalies, and lastly, a piece of idol Heart from the Cluckmoo Idol. And yes, idols have hearts too, though they are also stone so it's kinda hard to tell it apart from the rest of it…

quests.name: Levels 1-15
quests.description: Those of you just beginning your journeys should commence your training inside the "A" salle. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Isakr Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the Merge Shop)

quests.name: Level 16-30
quests.description: Commence your training inside the "B" salle. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Shorl Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the Merge Shop)

quests.name: Level 31-45
quests.description: Commence your training inside the "C" salle. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Datharn Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the Merge Shop)

quests.name: Level 46-60
quests.description: Commence your training inside the "D" salle. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Aevedar Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the Merge Shop)

quests.name: Level 61-75
quests.description: All players can commence training inside the "E" salle. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Kojold Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the Merge Shop)

quests.name: Hall of Honors
quests.description: Enter the Hall of Honors to battle and train against the highest levels. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Fenmoor Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the Merge Shop) Note: The quest rewards may change based on player feedback.

quests.name: Level 75-90
quests.description: All players can commence training inside the "F" salle. Gather the 5 shards needed to create the Vlykeb Key in order to access the final area. (Create the key in the merge shop.)

quests.name: Stone Endurance
quests.description: I have been waiting an eternity for someone to break my curse and restore peace to my troubled soul. You may very well be that person, but I will need to test you to be sure. As you explore, you will notice many undead creatures known as Rattlebones wandering the halls; like me, they have been denied the bliss of eternal rest. If you can kill 10 of these creatures and bring me their essences I will be assured of your ability to help me, and I will grant you access to my slayer's lair. (Bring back 10 Rock Essences to complete the quest).

quests.name: Heart of Stone
quests.description: Before I died, as the Rock elemental prepared to curse my soul for all eternity, I noticed a bright flash of light. I looked closer, and I noticed luminous glowing bracelet dangling from the wrist of the creature. This bracelet is obviously the source of his power; if you can defeat him and bring it back to me I am sure I can finally break this horrendous curse! (Bring back the Rock Bracelet to complete this quest).

quests.name: Investment Opportunity
quests.description: I see you've been holding on to your Ebilbucks. You know, if you give them back to Ebilcorp we will take them from you and maybe let you have something in return! Why wouldn't you want to give back to that which has given you nothing?

quests.name: Open Ebony Chest
quests.description: Three locks protect this chest. You will need the Golden, Silver, and Bronze keys to open it. As you try to open it, you hear an eerie whisper. "Gold to dazzle, to blind, and bind. Flames of Silver burn hotter than Hades. Magical bronze for the wonderers, mages, and alchemists. All these keys you will need, to continue your quest."

quests.name: Edden's Rings
quests.description: Getting Lazure's skull was the main goal of my expedition, but as long as you're here, I suppose we could aim a little bit higher. This cave is a trove of cursed treasure, and there are a few choice rings I had my eye on in that pile of loot. If you're confident that you can rifle through the pile and grab one without getting cursed, I'll repay you for the trouble.

quests.name: Luxury Ice
quests.description: Since you're here, armed with a skilled set of helping hands, could I ask you a favor? Grab a pick and break open the Ice Crystals. Gems, cursed or drama-free, became frozen in their bodies as they grew bigger. If you let me take a few off your hands, I'll fill them with something more useful to you.

items_required.name: Frozen Diamond Found x5 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
quests.description: Bill's personal effects are here for you to look through. There's not much besides a journal he kept. I really don't think he cares about what happens to this stuff but I'm not going to risk it. Bill might rise from the grave to throttle me if I get too curious. That would be your privilege, Your Highness. The old wolf's last wishes might be in there.

quests.name: Vulture Pickings
quests.description: Now that Reignolds is dead, his lands have become Lordless. That's a prime opportunity to grab anything we want. The knights' armor would fetch a high price and we can shake the gold out of the dead peasant's pockets. Will you be joining us, Your Highness?

quests.name: Unlamented Lamia
quests.description: The children of the Sandsea are at risk from monsters which periodically venture outside the Djinn World. Lamia, blood-sucking snake-people are roaming the streets of the SandSea and causing hissteria. Set the minds of the desert-dwellers at ease by bringing me 10 strips of Lamia snakeskin to prove you've dealt with the issue before they can leave our world

quests.name: E-vase-ive Measures
quests.description: My people are not universally loved. There are those who fear the djinn, and rightly so. But recently, many of my benevolent air djinn have been trapped and held against their will in vessels entirely unsuitable for djinn. Free 5 of my people from the vases in the SandSea and you will earn their gratitude and mine

quests.name: Tri-hump-hant Camels
quests.description: Due to overwhelming laziness, in the past all that camels would do is lie around and go *humph.* In punishment, one of my djinn overseeing the desert gave them just what they asked for: humps, made of clay! It has come to my attention that SOME of the camels have redeemed themselves, and deserve to have their badges of shame removed. Bring me back the clay humps of 7 Camels.

quests.name: I Don't Mean to Harp On It...
quests.description: Harpies have taken to the air and are harassing my djinn, causing their work to be interrupted and even, at times, making it impossible to finish. This is a most annoying development, and the management of my people is degrading into near-chaos. Take care of this harpy havoc by bringing me the pin feathers of 7 harpies and I will be most grateful.

quests.name: In-djinn-ious Solution
quests.description: There are both djinn-made and natural portals which allow access to my realm. These naturally occurring portals open only to those able to detect them; however, I have noticed recently that some have weakened. This allows the unworthy and unwary entrance to the Djinn World. Hide these portals by placing Obfuscation Mists at the weakest points.

quests.name: Chaos Lord Tibicenas
quests.description: After Zahart's ring was shattered, it was only a matter of time before you found yourself facing Tibicenas, Hero.

quests.name: Rosetta Stones
quests.description: Embedded in the head of each Void Elemental is a gemstone of some kind. This stone contains a consciousness of the elemental. It is this consciousness that is the lynchpin of your survival. They can understand and interpret the vibrations of its fellow voidlings. We need to construct an array out of the stones to transmit our message. 6 Voidstones should serve.

quests.name: Cull the Foot Soldiers
quests.description: We need to begin the second phase of our plan: obtaining an unfavorable vibration. Take the Voidstone Array out onto the field of battle with you. Locate and kill 4 Void Larva. As they die, use the array to record their final cry. Grizzly, I know, but this is war.

quests.name: Bad Vibes
quests.description: The void creatures are growing closer to discovering us. It must be the sound of the Larva death cries. I can only assume that as we collect more void screams…we should move with all due haste In order to create a believable distress signal, it will need to come from many different sources, so we'll need vibrations from Ghasts as well. We'll balance it out with the Larva, so capture 8 of them.

quests.name: Quite the Problem
quests.description: The Void has found us. The advance forces will be upon our encampment within hours, and they're being commanded by a Void Giant. This may be our darkest moment, but it's also the one we've been waiting for. Capture the cry of the giant. It alone would be enough to scatter the platoon coming to wipe us out. Who knows what it's capable of when combined with all the other vibrations you've captured?

quests.name: Pirate's Treasure
quests.description: Yo ho ho! I be having a special assignment for ye. Me prized posession is locked in a treasure chest on the poop deck. It should be an easy task for ye to bring it back to me, har har. Of course, you'll be needing to kill Sharkbait to get the key!

quests.name: Smells Fishy To Me
quests.description: All hands ahoy! If yer aiming to join the crew you'll need to rid me ship of these scurvy Fishmen. Hang 'em from the yardarm! Defeat 12Fishmen and return to me.

quests.name: Salmagundi
quests.description: Shiver me timbers, Flying Fish!? Swab the deck of these critters. Defeat 10 Flying Fish and return to me for a task worthy of yer skills, har har.

quests.name: Map Recovery
quests.description: Ahoy matey! So the Treasure Map be torn and scattered amongst the monsters on me ship? Collect the 5 pieces of the map and return to me. Succeed, and I will be opening the Pirate shop for ye!

quests.name: Sunken Treasure? (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Ye wants some gear? I heard that Sharkbait has some hidden booty he's keepin'. Go beat 'im up til he hands it o'er. Ye might find th' key on one o' his crewmate Fishman Soldiers.

quests.name: Pumpkin Guts
quests.description: The hooded creeps are around here somewhere, but look! Are those the bouncy orange heads you were playing with by the river? Oh, they're pumpkin monsters! Then we have to save the town from them! Let me help you and Juvania!

quests.name: Growth Spurt
quests.description: Mr. Thok went down the west road. Let's catch up and see what he's doing. It's nice that you have so many trees over there. Wow, are they dressed up for Mogloween? No…the Saplings are attacking people. That means they'll need a trim!

quests.name: Mini-Thurians
quests.description: There's a flood of slugs further down the west road! One of Juvania and Thok's friends is over there trying to talk to someone. She can't do that if she's slipping on all the slime. Let's help her and listen in!

quests.name: Paper Love Bombs
quests.description: Thok and Arcana said that the people in hoods were trying to convince everyone to join their clubs. They were handing out information pamphlets, and I think most got tossed out. Think they have anything useful in them, like cute drawings? Let's check!

quests.name: Abomination vs Monstrosity
quests.description: Arcana and Thok are interested in why the scary Saplings stay in one section of the road while the Nudibranches slime up the rest of it. We're going to scoop up a couple batches of each to take a closer look.

quests.name: The Mom Friend
quests.description: Juvania's meeting up with another one of her friends, Metrea, on the east side of town. They're being heckled by hooded creeps! We need to help the ladies out, and - ooh, that door's unlocked. Think it's safe to poke my head inside? I just want a peek…

quests.name: Excited Excrescence
quests.description: There are more hooded weirdos down the east road. These ones are covered in vines, eyes, and teeth. Uh oh, they saw us staring! Now they're coming over to get us to join their club! Make sure they know we're not interested!

quests.name: Love It or Condemn It
quests.description: Metrea said we shouldn't look inside the houses, but you want to know what you're up against. I want to see, too! Let's ask for advice from Arcana and Thok on the east road before we start snooping.

quests.name: Recruitment Initiative
quests.description: What do the Cultists want with me? Do I owe them money? Whatever it is, I'll pay it back later! We have to get out of here! Give them a beatdown until there's enough breathing room to climb over the wall!

quests.name: Galeux D'Eyes
quests.description: Something's attacking Juvania and the others! It's…a pumpkin growing out of a human? I see teeth and hair in places they shouldn't be. This thing won't leave us alone until we pull it out by the roots.

quests.name: Emerald Giftbox Quest
quests.description: Battle Santy Claws in the /northlandlight region. Bring me back an Emerald Gift Bow and you'll be rewarded with even more presents!

quests.name: Oh, I Give Up
quests.description: …What do you mean you got Andres out, too? Harumph! WELL, then you should rescue Dora, too. Andres used to date her before they got captured. I just know it'll make him happy to know she's ok! She's in a mirror that's off in its own little alcove, like mine is.

quests.name: Sage Advice
quests.description: If you get close to the Doomwood Treants, you'll see a pale grey-green moss growing on some of them. We'll need a big bundle of that stuff. It's just what I've seen them do, ok?

quests.name: Abra-Cadaver
quests.description: So… next… you need to fight those Ectomancers, and get some of that icky green fire that they shoot. Just, I don't know, pour out one of your potion bottles and catch it in there. That should work, right?

quests.name: A (Skele)TON of Skulls
quests.description: This next part is pretty spooky, but I'm sure it'll be nothing for a hero like you. You have to collect the skulls from 10 undead monsters. I don't think it matters which one you get them from, you just need 10.

quests.name: Summoning the Subjugator
quests.description: So… NOW… you have to take the skulls to the cliff overlooking the keep, and pile them all up. Then, you toss the bundle of sagemoss on top. And THEN… you light it all on fire. Make sure you use the green fire you got from the Ectomancers, or it won't work!

quests.name: Wokou
quests.description: We have safely departed from port and the crew hoisted our black flags. Take this time to acquaint yourself with the ship and the people aboard it.

quests.name: Shanty Sha-N-Ti
quests.description: The disguised pirates on board this ship are warriors from Yokai, and they'd like you to show them how real pirates act. Treat them to a sword fight, and a song or two. I heard that such a thing is called a shanty.

quests.name: Highly Buoyant Metal Armor
quests.description: The crew of a pursuing Greenguard warship has boarded, but they're knights? They aren't firing their canons on us either. Capture them and make them tell us who they serve.

quests.name: Salty Roots
quests.description: We were close to making a clean escape, but a Lord from Greenguard's Neverglades has intercepted us. He's waiting on the island's shore and won't back down unless you defeat him in a duel. Please Hurry, he may have already alerted our location to the Wuji Emissaries.

quests.name: Dog Bites Back
quests.description: Gar has transformed into some Draconian beast. I can see Varga trying to close the portal to the Timestream. We need it closed as soon as possible. I'll go to her aid while you put Gar down. Don't let him trample us. Malgor must have wanted us here but he's late to his own party. Let's ruin it before he arrives.

quests.name: Lion Guardian's Gift
quests.description: RAWR! To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, my master has secured a gift for you. Click the button below to get a Golden Item of Digital Awesomeness.

quests.name: Nulgath's Roulette of Misfortune
quests.description: Are the sneevils not giving you what you want? Oh boo-hoo, relics and trinkets are mere toys, what did you expect? Raw mana however, is something to be sought after. Bring me some Mana Energy from the Mana Golem and Charged Mana from the creatures in/elemental, and I'll let you spin MY wheel. I've narrowed its prizes down to the most valuable.

quests.name: Supplies to spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many Wars. Wars require weapons and weapons require resources.

quests.name: Kiss the Void
quests.description: There are some who dare to defy me, and those who transgress will meet their fate within the void. Slay the Legion Fenrir defectors in /evilwarnul and gather their broken blades. Then, collect 80 Fragments of Chaos from the Chaos Gemralds in /blindingsnow and find a Tendurrr the Assistant willing to reforge the blades. If you're lucky, one of their attempts might be successful, HAHAHAHA!

quests.name: The Leery Contract
quests.description: Ahh… what do you have there mortal? One of my contracts? You must be a VERY lucky person. Care to make a deal? Good, Evil, Chaotic… your alignment doesn't matter to me. Just bring me a rune from an Undead Legend and sign the contract, and I'll give you a prize unlike anything you've seen before- and a sum of Gold for your troubles. What does the contract say, you ask? Does it really matter?

quests.name: Bone Dust Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Bone Dust from the undead in /battleunderb is something he requires. Bring him enough of it, and he'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Cube Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Cubes from the Sneevils in /boxes and Ice Cubes from the Snow Golems in /mountfrost are materials he requires. Bring him enough of each, and he'll fairly compensate you.

quests.name: Void Destroyer Diamond Quest
quests.description: Diamonds of Nulgath were brought from the void so in the void shall you hunt for the main resource. Bring me the reagents I need and I can teach you how to destroy them… and rebuild them into something more valuable.

quests.name: Tools For the Job
quests.description: Hello little one, did you require something? Equipment? Well you have certainly come to the right place as you have proved your loyalty well. I have some trinkets for but they do not come without a cost. I'm sure you know how it works around here and are accustomed to such tasks. Return to me when you have found the reagents I require. There is a palace in the /northlands made entirely of ice. Inside you will find Aisha and her Drake. Get me the diamond she possesses and come back here.

quests.name: Corrupted Touch
quests.description: Little Minion, these next sets of equipment are much harder to stabilize into reality. We will need reagents but be prepared to gather multiple reagents at a time to perfect this. But the reward will be very much so worth the time and effort for one such as yourself. I also will be needed a Winter Diamond that can be found on Aisha's Drake in the Northlands.

quests.name: Dage's Underworld Legacy Minion
quests.description: Dage the Evil will grant you 2 House Guards.. but if you want Dage's Underworld Legacy Warden, you'll need to prove you're worthy! Slay a High Legion Inquisitor in /darkwarnation to earn your reward.

quests.name: Dreadrock Gem Exchange
quests.description: Unless you serve my master, you have no business here. But your contract speaks volumes of your dedication. Provide me with three Shattered Dreadrock Gems, three Polishes Dreadrock Gems, and three Crystal Dreadrock Gems - and I will reward you with some of my master's finest reagents.

quests.name: Knife to the Back
quests.description: Allegiance to the Old One is sacred. And breaking that bond requires…compensation. The Shadowknights have been very loyal to my master; but two of them tried to escape from their contracts. Find the traitors…and execute them.

quests.name: A Tainted Deal
quests.description: In order to commune with the Old One, I require an…abundance…of Tainted Gems. If you can provide them for me, I will reward you favorably. Service to the Old One does not go unnoticed; and if you succeed, the rest of this city will know it as well.

quests.name: Reap the Souls
quests.description: If your dedication to the Archfiend is absolute, then I have a suitable mission for you. Provide me with a Combat SoulReaper of Nulgath, and you will be duly rewarded. This deed will require the zenith of your ability

quests.name: Capture the Misshapen
quests.description: Have you noticed how the creatures in the area nearby have been changed? We think this may be related to Kolyaban's appearance -every time she has been spotted, these misshapen animals are found nearby. If you catch some for us, your friend Aria has agreed to help us study them, so that we might get a clearer picture of what has been happening.

quests.name: Defeat the Parasites
quests.description: Some of the Monsters in this area have been hostile toward us. We do not understand why. However, we will have to dead with them if we are to continue our search. Defeat them for us, so that we may pass through the area unharmed.

quests.name: The Source
quests.description: Although we have the same origins as these Rift monsters, we have always lived on Lore, and our biology is very different. Some of us are becoming ill from the toxins in the area. Destroy the source of this poison so that we may all remain safe.

quests.name: Give Me The Gold!
quests.description: First things first - we need some gold! Head to /harvestzombie and fight the Golden Warriors you find there. Take pieces of their golden armor, and bring them back to me.

quests.name: A Golden Blade
quests.description: Now, we'll need to turn this gold into a sword! I can think of only one person to turn to for such task - Cysero, the Mad Weaponsmith! Find him at his forge at Battleon, and see if he's willing to help.

quests.name: Cover the Shine
quests.description: We have the golden sword! But if the Wretched Rider sees it, he will never let you get close enough to use it. We'll have to disguise it - and I know just the thing. Go to /brightoak, and collect sticky mud from the Tainted Earth there. We'll spread it on the blade, and the Rider will be none of the wiser!

quests.name: Face the Rider
quests.description: Are you ready, Hero? You've gathered the gold, and had it forged into the most wondrous of blades! You've hidden its glory behind a coat of mud, and now you're ready to face our most deadly foe - the Wretched Rider! Let me know when you are ready, an I will transport you to him through the shadows.

quests.name: Something Soft
quests.description: Ok… looks like this recipe calls for… chinchilla fluff? Good thing there are plenty of those little floofs around here. Grab me a few good handfuls.

quests.name: A Shrubbery!
quests.description: Next it's asking for "Love Blossoms". To make your love… blossom! Grab some off the wandering Love Shrubs nearby.

quests.name: The Eyes Have It
quests.description: Last thing it calls for is… say, can you read this? Is that "Eye of Tog"? These old tomes get so smudgy.

quests.name: Pollenate Love
quests.description: Gather some Pink Pollen from the Love Shrubs nearby. The blossoms are a bit too heavy, but their pollen is a delicate aphrodisiac—exactly the sort needed for a potion like this.

quests.name: Whiskers on... Chinchillas?
quests.description: Second, we want the Chinchilla's Soft Whiskers, not their fur. Honestly, you could choke on that fur. It's so thick!

quests.name: Smooth Mood
quests.description: Finally, we're going to want some Pink Gel from the Mood Slimes. To smooth the mood of both giver and receiver, of course! That will prevent unfortunate mistakes like… well, like the fish incident.

quests.name: Scale it up
quests.description: The first thing I'll need is Hardened Scales from the Spring Togs you see roaming around. These will strengthen our spell, yes.

quests.name: Fruitful
quests.description: Next! Your friends were right to look to the Love Shrubs, but it is not their flowers nor their pollen that we want. Bring me instead their Forbidden Fruit: the fruit of life, and love.

quests.name: Very... heart-y
quests.description: Bring me an actual still-beating heart. A rare find indeed! It's not uncommon to see bones encased in slimes, including the Mood Slime. But sometimes you'll also find a heart, kept intact and beating by the thick gel that encases it.

quests.name: It's About Time
quests.description: Here at the Edge of Time, only time-based lifeforms can survive without Chronomancy. These lifeforms are made of valuable resources to Chronomancers. Would you do me a favor and harvest some Time Travel Fairies and Ephemerites for me?

quests.name: A Cycle Unending
quests.description: I have a special favor to ask of you. In the Time Void, lies a creature known as the Unending Avatar. It is said that this Avatar has some essence of the original Avatar of Time! If you would, could you see if you could locate some of this essence? It would really help my research.

quests.name: Attack Pirates
quests.description: Slay 30 Pirates to turn in a Pirate Token.

quests.name: Mega Attack Pirates
quests.description: Slay 10 Pirates to turn in a MEGA Pirate Token

quests.name: Buy Time... or Steal It
quests.description: The Ephemerites and Chronocide Prime are trying to trap us in this year forever! Defeat them in /Chronohub.

quests.name: Power the Sun
quests.description: I can already sense the darkness' power growing. Hurry, we must strengthen the sun and weaken the Creed's grasp on the night! Take 3 Nocturan Runes off the trees in Darkovia Forest and place 4 Solar Amplifiers around the Lumina Temple grounds.

quests.name: Interrogate Night Creatures
quests.description: I do not know why the Nocturan Creed wished to prevent the sun from rising again – our informant did not overhear everything – but we cannot allow that to happen! If you're going to shop this, you need to get more information from the Vampires and Werepyres in /lycanwar and /vampirewar!

quests.name: Nocturan Adept Battle
quests.description: We know where the Nocturan Creed Temple is. You will need to battle one of their adepts, Aku, to get the whole truth! Darkness hides secrets far, far too well for my liking! Battle

quests.name: Welcome to Eden!
quests.description: How am I supposed to give you a proper tour with all this noise? No, this won't do at all. If I get another bad Whelp review, Apa said she'd take away my hat! It's hard to think straight with those kids singing all the time. Do you think you could do something about it? Look I'm not *asking* you to hurt them, I'm TELLING you to just shut them up, okay?

quests.name: The Fashion and Arcade District
quests.description: Oh wow, looks like you're in luck! There must be a convention going on. Why don't you go take some pictures with the cosplayers so you can cherish the precious memories of our tour! While we're at it, you should try and win a prize from the arcade machine just down the street. It would make a wonderful souvenir!

quests.name: Eden City KotaMart
quests.description: KotaMart here, KotaMart there, KotaMart everywhere! If you're in Eden City, you should definitely check out the KotaMart. It's the biggest in all of Akiba! There are SOOO many things to get! Oh, you're broke? Well, it wouldn't hurt to ask for 'free samples' from the Salarymen who frequent there…

quests.name: Save the Citizens!
quests.description: What's going on here? Everything is frozen, it's as if time has stopped.. We have to stop the Anomalies before they do anymore damage to the city and the citizens!

quests.name: Armorchy
quests.description: Oh man, the Research Center has seen better days.. We won't be able to do anything with these Power Suits out of control like this! If you take the batteries out of them that should put a stop to them.

quests.name: Clear the Way!
quests.description: There are more Anomalies ahead, along with some weird little creatures roaming through the center. Don't worry about how they were created, we don't have time for this! GET RID OF THEM NOW! Trap the creatures and destroy the rest of the Anomalies… NOW!

quests.name: Protect the Reactor!
quests.description: Let's work together, we need to stop that giant Anomaly before it damages the Crystal reactor!

quests.name: Nation's Dragon Wings
quests.description: Loyal members of Nulgath's Nation, take heed! You are the deadliest partiers to stalk the land of Lore. I've crafted a gift to help you celebrate. Lightguard Paladings in /noxustower stole the gift I'd planned to give you. Slay them until you find a Winged Gift Box. Complete my quest to see if the wings you seek is inside.

quests.name: Paragon's Dragon Wings
quests.description: My Undead Legion warriors like to /party as hard as any living hero, and I crafted a gift to help you celebrate. Lightguard Paladins in /noxustower stole the gift I'd planned to give you. Slay them until you find a Winged Gift Box. Complete my quest to see if the wings you seek are inside.

quests.name: Clues for the Clueless
quests.description: My beloved crown… *sniff sniff* Whoever took it must have left some sort of clues. I mean… how else are we supposed to find the culprit? So I'm appointing you my honorary gumshoe! Look for any clues you may find around the store and bring them back to me!

quests.name: Laundry Day
quests.description: OH could this day get any worse? First the Crown… and now it's laundry day! Before we investigate any further, I need to do my laundry before the old ball-and-chain kicks me to the curb. But, uh… the washing machines only take Quarters instead of Gold. Weird, huh? I bet those monster Arcade Machines are ripe for the picking though. Get me enough Quarters so I can wash my outfit and my super sweet terrycloth cape.

quests.name: Strategy Guides are Key
quests.description: Those clues you collected earlier… they seem to point in the direction of the storage room! AH HA! But… uh… I think I accidentally deleted the storage room key from my inventory. Yeeaaah…. whoops. But I bet one of those monsters found it. They always seem to drop the weirdest things anyway. Find me that key so we can investigate the storage room!

quests.name: Investigate the Storage Room
quests.description: WOOT! We may enter the storage room! Hurry up and accept this quest so we can gogogo!

quests.name: Infernal Warlord Scroll
quests.description: Venture to the /LostRuins and intercept the Infernal Warlord, who yearned for the light it was ignored by. Take this sacred scroll with you, and it will seal the Infernal's voice and history in the ink of Celestial tears.

quests.name: Diabolical Warlord Scroll
quests.description: Venture to the /LostRuinsWar and bear witness to the Diabolical Warlord, a transformation born from decay instead of growth. Take this sacred scroll with you, and it will seal the Infernal's voice and history in the ink of Celestial tears.

quests.name: Malxas Scroll
quests.description: Ascend the /InfernalSpire and strike down Malxas, the Living Infernal Stronghold. Take this sacred scroll with you, and it will seal the Infernal's voice and history in the ink of Celestial tears.

quests.name: Na'al Scroll
quests.description: Venture to the /InfernalArena and become its new Champion by defeating Na'al, Lord of the Scarred Barrens. Take this sacred scroll with you, and it will seal the Infernal's voice and history in the ink of Celestial tears.

quests.name: Flow like Blood
quests.description: Minion, to feel how the blood flows through your veins, you must understand its magic. The Blood are the elite hunters of the Nation - if you want to join them, you must prove you are capable. Show me your skills by hunting your prey and collecting them from the following items:

quests.name: Flow like Blood (AC)
quests.description: So you came back to enhance the powers of the Blood of Nulgath? Minion, to feel how the blood flows through your veins, you must understand its magic. The Blood are the elite hunters of the Nation - if you want to join them, you must prove you are capable. Show me your skills by hunting your prey and collecting them from the following items:

quests.name: Flow like Blood (Non-AC)
quests.description: So you came back to enhance the powers of the Blood of Nulgath? Minion, to feel how the blood flows through your veins, you must understand its magic. The Blood are the elite hunters of the Nation - if you want to join them, you must prove you are capable. Show me your skills by hunting your prey and collecting them from the following items:

quests.name: Blood Tears
quests.description: Minion, a hunter must have a proper helmet, and none will serve you better than the helms of my Blood breeds. Prove me you are worthy of wearing it by tearing your enemies apart without empathy or emotion, with no tears but the blood of your wounds. Bring me the reagents I need, and we shall talk further.

quests.name: Unlock the Evolved Hex Armor
quests.description: Minion! Listen closely. During my time in the Oversoul, I found a way to augment the Hex of Nulgath and increase its power. I will tell you which items I require, and then you will prove your worthiness by obtaining them for me. Then we will perform the ritual together. Remember, if you want to master Magic, a wizard you must be! Now get out of my sight! Do not return without bringing me the following items:

quests.name: Unlock the Evolved Hex (Rare)
quests.description: So! You have returned to me to empower your Hex of Nulgath? What took you so long, minion? You bored me with all this time you spent exploring on the Hex - I expected an acolyte of the Archfiend like yourself to master it easily. However, you have a strong soul, so I'll give you an opportunity to strengthen it even more… if you can, HAHAHAHA!!!! Bring me the required materials and I will throw you something you can play with. Beware, even if you are skilled enough to complete my task, the Empowered Hex may consume you if you can't master its powers.

quests.name: Unlock the Evolved Hex (Arcane)
quests.description: So! You have returned to me to empower your Hex of Nulgath? What took you so long, minion? You bored me with all this time you spent exploring on the Hex - I expected an acolyte of the Archfiend like yourself to master it easily. However, you have a strong soul, so I'll give you an opportunity to strengthen it even more… if you can, HAHAHAHA!!!! Bring me the required materials and I will throw you something you can play with. Beware, even if you are skilled enough to complete my task, the Empowered Hex may consume you if you can't master its powers.

quests.name: Cut Off One Head...
quests.description: So… you are looking to possess the Empowered Hex's helmet? What makes you think you could even handle it, Minion? Hah! You should think about the reason you signed my contract with your soul. Very well… Oversoul needs new resources, and that means I need someone to fetch them for me. Bring me the reagents I need, and I will let you play at being my Hex.

quests.name: Empowering the Empowered
quests.description: Minion! There isn't really a reason to offer you an empowered version version from the Hex of Nulgath without its main power, the Hex Staff. Your role isn't to empower it, is to build it, again, strong, destructive, and the best part: any life form can be consumed by simply touching it.

quests.name: Evolved Fiend Orb Quest
quests.description: Nulgath says, if a more straight forward and powerful approach is your style, naturally armored, Evolved Void Fiends are a savage breed in my army. They are primal beasts that have no fear. Charging into the front lines of the enemy, they can thrash their ranks into disarray.

quests.name: Evolved Fiend Gear
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you gear to accompany your Evolved Fiend Armor

quests.name: Reborn in the Dark Side
quests.description: Minion! We are here again… my experience in the plane of Oversoul has given me the ability me to augment the Shadow of Nulgath and increase its powers of darkness. The Shadow isn't something you can master easily: if you are unworthy of its power, it will consume you from the inside out, and throw you into an endless realm of pain. Bring me these magical reagents from Lore, and we shall see how your journey ends. JOIN THE DARK SIDE!

quests.name: Reborn in the Dark Side (Rare)
quests.description: So you want to empower your Shadow of Nulgath? You came to the right place! After years of serving the Archfiend, I believe you are ready to receive a new gift, minion. My Shadows of Nulgath have never disappointed me, and this must be the path for you as well. But first, you must bring me these reagents.

quests.name: Reborn in the Dark Side (Shadow)
quests.description: So you want to empower your Shadow of Nulgath? You came to the right place! After years of serving the Archfiend, I believe you are ready to receive a new gift, minion. My Shadows of Nulgath have never disappointed me, and this must be the path for you as well. But first, you must bring me these reagents.

quests.name: Void Emotions
quests.description: To manifest the emptiness of your soul, you need to suppress your emotions. To embrace the Shadow, the Light must be extinguished, minion. The Evolved Shadow of Helm will help you accomplish this. Prove you are worthy to crawl in the shadows by killing the only thing you love, and accept that you are nobody. And, of course, reagents are required.

quests.name: Shape your Nothingness
quests.description: Do you feel the Void, Minion? Can't you feel the beat of it's heart resonating with yours? You prove to myself being a shadow means infiltrating in the shadows being nothingness. Now I challenge you to build your own weapon from that nothingness. Bring me the required reagents and find a way to shape nothing into a spear that pierces through your enemies will to exist.

quests.name: Evolved Void Orb Quest
quests.description: Void Knights are just one of my elite soldiers of war. I give them great power of my own to make them unstoppable. That's the sacrifice I make for my disciples. I'll give you the power of a Void Knight too. All I require is a small portion of your soul. Defeat Soulseeker and you'll be able to retrieve a transportable piece of your soul.

quests.name: Evolved Void Gear
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you gear to accompany your Evolved Void Armor

Evolved Warlord Orb of Nulgath's Quest.name: Evolved Warlord Orb of Nulgath's Quest

quests.name: Weapon Mastery (Mem)
quests.description: So, you want to become a Warlord breed for Nulgath's army? An excellent goal to aspire to. Warlords have raw power or one-in-one combat and each swing of their weapons causes thunderstorms in the battlefield. If you want to control one of my master's powerful Warlord weapons, you must gather reagents and bring them back for me to combine. Be warned: this this concoction must be precise! Create and improper mixture, and a bag of dirt you will get in return!

quests.name: Weapon Mastery (AC)
quests.description: So, you want to become a Warlord breed for Nulgath's army? An excellent goal to aspire to. Warlords have raw power or one-in-one combat and each swing of their weapons causes thunderstorms in the battlefield. If you want to control one of my master's powerful Warlord weapons, you must gather reagents and bring them back for me to combine. Be warned: this this concoction must be precise! Create and improper mixture, and a bag of dirt you will get in return!

quests.name: Bear Necessities of LifeRoot
quests.description: Brave hero… the Cloister needs your aid. Once a safe haven to ancient Druids, our Mother Tree is now overrun with dangerous beasts. We need to restore the balance. But before I send you on more perilous tasks, I ask that you become aware of The Cloister’s intricate layout. Make your way through our Mother Tree until you find the sacred LifeRoot near the canopy. I await your return.

quests.name: Acorny Quest
quests.description: I see that you are well suited to help restore the balance of The Cloister. Along your travels, you encountered Acornents, correct? These devious little acorns absorb too much of the Mother Tree’s magic and know not what to do with it. They have resorted to violence. We must stop them before they take the very life from The Cloister. Collect 10 Acornent Shells to assure The Cloister’s survival.

quests.name: Ravenloss
quests.description: Much like the Acornents, the ravens of The Cloister have found a way to consume her magical energies, transforming them into horrid beasts. The Karasu, as they are now called, relentlessly feast on The Cloister’s magical fruits and have left her boughs barren. Please, go forth and collect 8 Bundles of Cloister Fruit from the Karasu so that balance can be restored.

quests.name: It's A Bough-t Time
quests.description: Defeating the Karasu and Acornents have helped restore the balance… but now we must aid the tree herself. There are 3 supporting boughs throughout The Cloister that require a boost of magical energies. They stand out from the other branches in more ways than one.

quests.name: Wendigo Whereabouts
quests.description: The Mother Tree has one more request from you. A horrible creature feared by all magi resides on The Cloister's canopy. It is a monster dubbed Wendigo. Once a druid himself, the Wendigo's constant craving of magical energies has exiled him to the Cloister's topmost branches. No one has been powerful enough to defeat him… but I have faith in you, Hero. Take down Wendigo, and The Cloister will flourish once more!

quests.name: Exalted Drakath's Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge all of your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Awesomeness.

quests.name: Hoof it til it Beaks
quests.description: I MUST have 5 Subrysa skins, 5 Hootbear beaks, and yes, especially 5 Hootbear Pellets. Do not ask why, just GET THEM! The pellets you will need to collect. The foul Hootbears drop them after they eat.

quests.name: Bind it with Twine
quests.description: Filthy creature, Emus and Koalions! But they are vital - VITAL - to my plan! Slay the Emus and Koalions in my bunker. That should give you the 3 Emu Spines and 6 Koalion Claws I need. You must also pick up 7 of the eggs and 3 balls of twine. Those are just as necessary. Now go!

quests.name: Hold it Together
quests.description: Gotta hold it together, just keep holding it together. Travel to Bloodtusk Ravine to bring me 10 Rhison Hooves. They must be FRESH! Return to me when you have 10 Rhison Hooves!

quests.name: Build a Beast!
quests.description: Kindness makes you weak. WEAK! And I must be STRONG if I am going to raise a Chaos beast! Bring me the corpses of 3 Subrysa, 3 Koalions, 3 Tainted Emus, and 3 Hootbears. Once I have that… stand back… Because I'm going to build a Chaos Beast!

quests.name: Break a Beast!
quests.description: No! Do not slay my Chaos Beast! How can I be a Chaos Lord if I do not raise a Chaos Beast! I don't care that it threatens me. NOOOOOOOOOOOOO! Don't kill him!

Eye of Astaroth Blade Pet's Quest.name: Eye of Astaroth Blade Pet's Quest

quests.name: Orbs of Astaroth
quests.description: Nulgath the ArchFiend knows all, and sees all. His eyes - and his spies - are everywhere. Few can be trusted. Test the loyalty of the Void Draconians to see if they are worthy of his attention.

quests.name: ID What You Did There
quests.description: You're going to need a Necro U Student ID if you want to enter the campus grounds! If you can't FIND one, why not make one? The first step is finding the right materials. Start with the basics - paper and ink. DoomWood Treants can usually be counted on for paper, and Undead Slimes produce toxic ink!

quests.name: The Ego and the ID
quests.description: Now, all good necromancers - and students - have a pretty big ego. That's why all IDs have pictures on them. For that, you'll need a camera. The soldiers should have one. And why not see if the case they keep their dead-tags in will hold your ID, too?

quests.name: An IDeal Seal
quests.description: Just having a Necro U Student ID isn't enough; it has to be an OFFICIAL Student ID! Otherwise, no one will believe you're really enrolled. You'll need to manufacture a Seal of Improvable if you want your disguise to be complete. You can make one from Bonemuncher spikes and leather.

quests.name: Need for Speed (Reading)!
quests.description: Old tomes contain knowledge vital to necromancers. It is advised that you read through them and commit all of the knowledge to memory. Beware, though, time is of the essence! You had better read fast! The 11 tomes you'll find in the room must be read in one minute.

quests.name: Quest for the Fabled Love
quests.description: WOOF WOOF ARF!!! (translation: Bring me a golden Bone from Bluddron the Betrayer in Beleen's Dream map! )

quests.name: Recycling is Good!
quests.description: Call me cheap if you want, but there's no reason to let scrap metal go to waste. I can melt it down and forge it into something beautiful! If you bring me any scraps you find, I'd be glad to pay you a finder's fee! (only works once per login)

quests.name: The Best You Can Buy
quests.description: I know my armor is the best money can buy, and my customers know it too. Still, it's good to periodically test its performance and see which areas could use improvement! All of the warriors in the city use my armor. Duel as many as you can find, and report back to me on how their armor held up!

quests.name: ...And Called It Macaroni
quests.description: You'd be surprised how much value people place on the way their armor looks. The more detailed and flashy it is, the more I can charge for it! Gemstones and feathers are what they seem to like the best. Bring me some tailfeathers from the birds of paradise you see flying around here, and some pretty gems from the gemstones floating near the Celestial district. I'll pay you well!

quests.name: SandCHIC
quests.description: Help Fabyo create looks modelled after some of Lore's most desirable--and famous--personalities! All Fabyo needs you to do is bring him the materials he--and his little monkey friend--require. The list is as follows! Camel Hides, Monkey Claws, and Frask Feathers. Bring these things, and Fabyo will make you look FABYOLOUS!

quests.name: Oasis Oeuvre
quests.description: Help Fabyo create looks modelled after some of Lore's most desirable--and famous--personalities! All Fabyo needs you to do is bring him the materials he--and his little monkey friend--require. The list is as follows! Camel Hides, Monkey Claws, and Frask Feathers. Bring these things, and Fabyo will make you look FABYOLOUS!

items_required.name: Golden Vase Shard x4 (Stacks up to 18)

quests.name: Future Sight
quests.description: Fairy magic is vast and strong, and for better or worse, for right or wrong, glimpses of the future we can see. To tell you what may or may not be. But the time is a tricky, mysterious thing, and too much info will sorry bring. But if YOU would know more of fate, find the Runestone; inside it waits. Bring a Sylph Feather as a gift, and watch! The veils of Time will lift.

quests.name: Fight Fire with Fire Elementals
quests.description: The Guardian Tree has 4 nodes in it… and my instincts tell me Elemental Stones go in there! Search the area for Fire Elementals and collect the Fire Fragments that they drop. Aaa… ahhh… aaaCHOO!

quests.name: Man's Best Fiend
quests.description: Have you seen the Bloodwolves around here? I don't know why ANYONE would call these canines Man's Best Friend… unless they have something to glue these Fire Fragments together. Collect 4 Fire Fasteners from the Bloodwolves, and I should be able to make the Fire Elemental Stone! AaaaaCHOO!

quests.name: Water Softener
quests.description: Water you standing here for? Those Water Elementals have Water Shards that we can use to create a Water Element Stone. Aaaaa…aaaCHOO!

quests.name: Swimming with Sneevils
quests.description: Ok--so we CAN'T glue water together. But we CAN use a Water Wrap! And the Aqueevils here totally have some. Collect 4 Water Wraps, but watch out--those Aqueevils can be tricky! Aaaaaaa….. aaaa… oh, hehe, that was clos---AACHHOO!

quests.name: 100% Natural
quests.description: You'd think the Earth Elementals would have Elemental Stones on them, but noooooo. They've got Nature Splinters, and I'll need 4 of them. Man, my allergies have been acting up like crazy----AAaaaaAAaAchhoooOOO!

quests.name: Conquer the Satyr
quests.description: Did you know Satyr hooves make excellent glue? It's true! Defeat a few Undead Satyrs and collect their Nature Paste (it's 100% Organic, too!). Ahhh.. ahhh… ahhhh… tcheeeewww!

quests.name: Air Heads
quests.description: Who you callin' an Air Head? It's the Wind Elementals who have their head in the clouds! And they just happen to have Wind Edges, which we will need 4 of. Did you know sneezes travel at 100 mph? Aahhahahahhhcooozooom!

quests.name: The Forest & Furious
quests.description: Mother Nature had a bazillion daughters and named them all "Forest Fury."But OH MAN these ladies have a SERIOUS temper. But they also have Wind Wrappings, which will bind the Wind Wedges together. AAaaaaaaaaaAACHOO!

quests.name: Mystery Tree
quests.description: Let's go to the Guardian Tree and see what happens when we place the Elemental Stones in it!

quests.name: Guidance from the Guardian
quests.description: Ask the Forest Guardian for answers about my mysterious past. I sure hope he knows something… and I sure hope he's friendly!

quests.name: All Steamed Up
quests.description: I have a platoon of steamed skyguards all angry because their weapons are completely dysfunctional. I have a fire blazing, but I'll need water to boil and wind to drive the steam through the weapons. Kill 5 Water Elements to fill my buckets of water and slay 5 Wind Elementals to funnel the finished steam.

quests.name: Let's Get Magi-Technical
quests.description: I want to expand my stock beyond just steam-powered guns and ballistic blades. I'd like to incorporate… magic! Can you find me pure mana? I think Mana Imps drop it in Arcangrove. I'll also need something to drive the mana into the weapons, so find me some turbines. There should be extra laying around here.

quests.name: Propeller Seller
quests.description: Our airships might be in tip-top shape most of the time, but like all tech, it needs repairs. When the Skyguard is out on the hunt, though, there's not always time to come back to port for a fix-up. So we jury-rig replacements where we can. I'd like to make Propeller Blades from Sky Pirate weaponry. Bring me back 9 swords for three new propellers.

quests.name: Favor for Faith
quests.description: If ya want me to show ya the best fishing hole in all Green Guard, then you're gonna have to give me a hand first. I can't find my favorite fishin' pole. The strangest thing is, there was a trail of slime leaving my fishin' spot! If you can find ma pole, I'll teach ya how ta pro fishes in these parts.

quests.name: Fish Food
quests.description: I was hoping you could help me meet my quota for the day. I usually send a large bundle of the daily catch with some Slime Sauce to the orphanage. They are a hungry bunch over there. If you can catch me 30 fish, of any kind, and get 1 jar of Slime Sauce from a slime, I'm sure the orphans would appreciate it.

quests.name: Catch of the Day
quests.description: The Fish Relocation Act v.24 section 8 requires us to bring any Blandfish, Undead Trout or Somean Lionfish to a safe habitat. If you find any while fishing please bring them back here.

quests.name: Fins up!
quests.description: I know a guy who knows a guy who is simply crazy 'bout fins. That's right, Redfin, Willowfin, Wingfin, Sparklefin, Thumofin or Pillfin, pretty much any fin. If you could come back with 10 "fin" fish today, that'd do just fine!

quests.name: Rainbows All the Way
quests.description: I gotta personal favor to ask ya. I might be the most amazing fisher in Greenguard but I always have trouble catching the Rainbow Lakehorse and Rainbow Scooter. Do ya think ya could find me 3 of either?

quests.name: Even Higher
quests.description: There are so many foes to battle - please - keep going!

quests.name: Falconreach Tower
quests.description: You have arrived at the tower - now defeat the enemies to continue!

quests.name: Climb the Tower
quests.description: You must get to the top of the tower! Please hurry!

quests.name: To the Dragonlord
quests.description: Climb the stairs - you have to keep going!

quests.name: Defeat the Dragonlord
quests.description: In order to get to Drakath and completely free Falconreach from his family, you must defeat the Dragonlord who is guarding him!

quests.name: Defeat Dragon Drakath
quests.description: You must defeat Drakath in his dragon form or Falconreach will be lost!

quests.name: Defeat Sepulchure
quests.description: The time has come for you to battle Sepulchure!!

quests.name: Defeat Alteon
quests.description: Now is the time to battle Prince Alteon! See how this part of Drakath's story ends!

quests.name: Pet Shop Toys
quests.description: My pets are getting lonely! I'm only one man and could sure use an extra pair of hands around here. My pets love to gnaw on Beetle Appendages but I'm all out-and that's the 3rd time this week! Can you go out into the Canyon and get me more? I think 10 Beetle Appendages should do the trick… for now…

quests.name: REP Speedwagon
quests.description: I can't fight this feeling anymore… so that's why I'm askin' you now! For as long as I can remember, I have wanted a Plastic Walrus Toy. All my life I have tried getting that toy from the Beatle monsters, but luck has not favored me in the least. I am offering great rewards to anyone who can bring me a Plastic Walrus Toy… so are you up for the challenge?

quests.name: Glowworms not Glowsticks
quests.description: I can't see, but I know it's dark down here. It will be much easier for you to help me if you light it up a bit. And I know a secret - the worms in this dragon's glow when they feel threatened! So, that you do is attack a bunch of the worms, and then jam them into the crevices in the, ah… "walls". They'll be your torches. (once per login session)

quests.name: Ossification Needed
quests.description: Alright, so, to start with, I'm going to need some help putting myself back together. I've been down here for quite some time, and the bile has started to dissolve my cartilage and carry off my bones. Fight the bile, and see if you can get my bones back.

quests.name: Eye Need Bones
quests.description: I'm still missing a few important bits. See if you can find any more of my bones scattered on the floor in here. And let's see if we can "borrow" some eyes for me from the Skeletal Slayers! They're not sentient like I am - they won't miss them at all! (once per login session)

quests.name: Bile Burns
quests.description: Friends, even with your… slime-covered armor… it looks like being down here is starting to take a toll on you. Stave off the effects by killing bile slimes and bowel worms. Otherwise, you'll end up like me!

quests.name: Find the Chest
quests.description: Alright! Now, all that's left to do is find the chest I brought the laxatives in. I don't actually SEE it, so it's probably buried in one of those piles of much. Help me find it!

quests.name: We Need the Key
quests.description: Argh! We have the chest, but it's locked! We'll have to find the key to get it open. If you go deep into Glutus' bowels, you'll find a huge tapeworm, bloated from all the food Glutus sends down. If the key isn't there, then it must have gone downward, and devoured by that worm. Get it back!

quests.name: Cha Cha Cha
quests.description: In order to make these laxatives act as quickly as possible, we need to get them into Glutus' stomach and bowel lining. That way, the medicine will go straight into his bloodstream!

quests.name: Sink Your Teeth In
quests.description: Blood Maggots suck blood. Vampires suck blood. Blood Maggots connected with Vampires. Lycans no like Vampires. Human go out and get 8 Blood Maggot Fangs from Darkovia. Faopaw study Blood Maggot Fangs and find connection with Vampires.

quests.name: Grounded Bats
quests.description: Vampires turn into bats. Albino Bats are bats. Vampires connected with Albino Bats. Human go out into Darkovia and get Faopaw 6 Prestine Albino Bat Wings. Albino Bats cannot fly without wings!

quests.name: Bats of a Leather Flock Together
quests.description: Bats are flying mammals. Vampires transform into flying mammals. Human know of LEatherwings? Leatherwings are flying mammals too. Leatherwings might be part of Vampire kin. Leatherwings home is Guru Forest and Dwarfhold's Pine Forest. Human cage 8 Leatherwings and bring back to Darkovia.

quests.name: Farm Cleanup
quests.description: Hey there! C'mon over here. Can you help me with a little something? I have to guard this award-winning cornstalk from pests, and can't go and get a few things that I need for my horse. He's not feeling too well, so I need to make a poultice for him. Look at him! He thinks he's a chicken! Can you go onto the farmland and get 5 bundles of straw and 10 mosquito wings? That'll definitely do the trick. But don't go TOO far- I hear there's some straaange trees on that farm.

quests.name: Chaos Critters in the Crops
quests.description: Them mosquitoes and Chaorrupted Poultrygeists are crowding up mah fields! You'll need to clear them out if'n you're going to take care of the zombeh problem. Squash 7 Mosquitoes and pluck 6 of those birds.

quests.name: Zombehs Aren't So Smart
quests.description: Y'cain't trust a zombeh. Y'never know where they'll attack next! Best to use what they don't have - yer smarts! Trap'em in holes - an' keep them from fillin' the holes back in - an' maybe you'll have an easier time of getting them all out of mah crops!

quests.name: It's the Anti-Mall
quests.description: Y'cain't expect me to live next to a village where th' zombehs can just wander FREE, do ya? No, I think you'll have to keep them contained in thet there village. Build a barricade. Chop down 12 Treeant for logs and find 5 Supply Branches on th' ground.

quests.name: 28 Battles Later...
quests.description: Looks like most of them zombehs have fled or been trapped in th' holes. Take out the remainin' 13, but you should prob'ly just knock them out. Y'r friend Artix seems to be fond o'em for some reason.

quests.name: Picking Flowers
quests.description: I promised a friend I would bring her a bouquet of flowers when I finish my shift. I forgot to go and pick some, though. Could you do it for me? Just pick some of the pretty red flowers you'll find growing on the mountain.

quests.name: Bunny Food
quests.description: I'm supposed to feed the bunnies - that's part of my job. But I've run out of rabbit food. They mostly eat the seeds and blossoms from the vicious plants wandering the area. Maybe you could find them some.

quests.name: Feed the Bunnies
quests.description: But you didn't feed them yet, did you? You should do that now. Just put the food on the ground. They'll find it.

quests.name: Control the Bunnies
quests.description: You might have noticed that there are a LOT of rabbits here. Lately, their population is getting out of control, and I just can't feed all of them while I'm busy with my games. Can you knock some of them out to make things easier for me? It will make your journey easier too. Definitely.

quests.name: Time for Tea
quests.description: All this work is making me thirsty. We should have some tea, don't you think? Get some leaves from those plant-things and I'll brew them for us.

quests.name: Needs Something Else...
quests.description: This tea is fine by itself, but you know what really kicks it up a notch? Ink from those… bunny… squid things. The ones with the tentacles! It's better than caffeine, I swear.

quests.name: Snacktime
quests.description: Ugh. Tea time is pointless without a snack, and those evil bunnies have stolen all of the cinnamon scones I brought! Get them back and I'll give you a couple.

quests.name: Big, MEAN Bunnies
quests.description: So, uh… I don't know if you've noticed or not, but some of the bunnies here have gotten very large. You'll find them way up on top of the hill. Problem is, they get MEAN when they grow that big. You've gotta do something about it, or they'll eat all the OTHER bunnies. Bring me their mutated tongues as proof.

quests.name: What Crack?
quests.description: So, you found a weird crack in the ground, did ya? Maybe you should go check it out.

quests.name: OMG What is THAT?
quests.description: Gah! What IS this thing? Surely it couldn't have been born like this… could it? You'll have to kill it… before it kills you.

quests.name: Un-decorate Yokai
quests.description: Calm down? I don't want to calm down! I want my rightful parade spot! I paid for it, after all! If you want my mood to improve, you can help me clear that interloper Lengjing out of here. Why don't you start by taking down some of those Yokai decorations, hmm?

quests.name: Naughty Fairies
quests.description: These Xingzhi are driving me insane! They keep playing tricks on my dancers, and damaging my beautiful floats! Please, get rid of them. I can't work like this!

quests.name: Dancers Love "Flours"
quests.description: Back to our primary task! We need to chase those Yokai parade dancers out of here. Take the bag of flour, and use it to douse the dancers! They'll have to go home and take showers, which means they won't be here to interfere with my parade.

quests.name: Spooky Ghosties
quests.description: Well, the Xingshi have been keeping away from us, but now the Shushen have started to show up. They're scaring my crew! Make them go away!

quests.name: Plan B
quests.description: It's time to pull out the big guns. The Yokai parade can't go on if its emcee is asleep! First, get me some feathers from the ravens in the streets. I'll fashion them into a feather boa, and then I'll douse it with Lingzhi spores. Those spores will put anyone who wears the boa to sleep! Naturally, I'll need you to get those for me too.

quests.name: A Gift for Lengjing
quests.description: The feather boa is finished. Take it to Lengjing and tell her it's a peace offering from me. How can she resist wearing my gift of friendship? And once she puts it on… those spores will put her right to sleep, and the street will belong to me!

quests.name: Face Fear
quests.description: Ayi has spent much time chasing Fear. But now the time has come to YOU to face the Fear!

quests.name: Call of Doody
quests.description: It is up to us, friend! We must slay the Guanotaur, Colonicus, so that he can no longer terrorize and devour the Dragonslayers (and other sacrificial tributes) who are flushed down from above! It is our DUTY!

quests.name: Skye's Raindrops
quests.description: We need to make our escape as soon as possible. Though the door isn't locked, Indradeep's Warriors will be patrolling the halls. Would you please go easy on them? Maybe knock them out and drag them into our room? I may have been their prisoner, but they've always been kind to me.

quests.name: Doctor's Orders
quests.description: Ah, the storage room happened to be right across from ours! Iseul is in charge of Castle Eblana, and this is where she tucked away all of the research and technology she stole from Seabase Undine. Gather as much of it as you can.

quests.name: Shockwave's Ripples
quests.description: The Executors caught wind of our escape. They were supposed to leave with Iseul, but she must have left a few behind to guard Castle Eblana. They won't be as accommodating as the Warriors. Please keep them from recapturing us. They'll break our legs to make sure we won't try again.

quests.name: Caretaker's Shadow
quests.description: The castle's caretaker is a good friend of mine. Mabel will help us escape, and point us in the safest direction. Before she can help us, we'll need to clear the Warriors and Executors crowding the feasting hall. I don't want to implicate Mabel. She's already gone through so much already.

quests.name: Harbinger's Tears
quests.description: I don't want to leave Mabel and the other servants behind to face Iseul's wrath alone, but we need to go. Bananach Ravens are gathering outside of the castle. Would you mind bringing some back to me? I'd like to collect some medical reagents from them. Treat them gently. They're sacred.

quests.name: Spectre of Hunger
quests.description: Keep your head down, and we'll sneak through the town. Careful, blight and starvation have plagued Skye's countryside for a while now. It's causing the Fear Gorta to appear in Eblana. Keep them from attacking us, and look for anyone who's willing to point us in the right direction.

quests.name: InnJustice
quests.description: Talk to the Stormview Innkeeper, Aisling. She can help us escape from town unseen. It'll help if we collect reagents from the Bananach Ravens and Fear Gorta to create a magic charm. That can keep the Executors from wanting to knock on the Inn's door for a while.

quests.name: Find Shelter in...
quests.description: Aisling says to leave out the back door of the inn, and use the forest to cover our escape. I'm ready to leave, but would you mind terribly if we could stop by a statue that's on the path? It was smashed a long time ago for being cursed, but I've always been curious.

quests.name: Heavy Handed
quests.description: Thanks to Tris.

quests.name: Miserable Monsoon
quests.description: Thanks to Tris.

quests.name: Liquid Hot Magma Maggots
quests.description: Just because Rayst sent you here to retrieve the Chaos Focus Gem doesn't mean I'm going to willingly let you take it. You're going to have to prove yourself to me and to Mount Mafic before I place my full trust in a mortal.

quests.name: Scorched Serpents
quests.description: The Volcanic Maggots did not faze you. So let us see if the Scoria Serpents have better luck. Mount Mafic is home to flying winged snakes known as Scoria Serpents. Nowhere else in this world do these creatures reside. With this being said, I want you to capture 5 Alpha Serpents from the Scoria brood to see if I can expand their population. Oh and try not to get burned out there… or worse…

quests.name: Playing With Living Fire
quests.description: Let's turn up the heat… and the bad puns. The Living Fires are a fiery race that were once mortal like yourself. They devoted themselves to mastering the element of fire… and I suppose they succeeded in a most unfortunate way. Forever their souls have been trapped on Mount Mafic, and if you can extinguish 10 of them, they might find peace once more after respawning.

quests.name: Kindling Relationship
quests.description: Deep within Mount Mafic resides the Chaos Focus Gem. I had said earlier that the mountain herself is the guardian of the last piece of the Supreme Arcane Staff… and this is only half true. The spirit of Mafic is inside a great Dragon who has guarded the Gem for ages. The only way to getting to the Dragon's nest is to solve the tricky bridge puzzle among the mountain path. Figure out the puzzle, defeat the great Mafic Dragon, and then the Chaos Focus Gem will be yours. Best of luck, mortal. You have proved yourself to me… and now it is time to prove yourself to Mount Mafic!

quests.name: Heat 'Em Up!
