quests.description: Thank you. You have made the right decision, helping these eggs. They deserve a chance. The nest needs more heat but I must watch the eggs. Can you bring me 12 Blazing Coals? you can find them around the cavern.

quests.name: Baby Food
quests.description: The dragonlings will be hungry when they emerge. I want to be prepared. Can you go collect 6 Wyvern Meat from the wyverns around here? That will be a good start for them!

quests.name: Molting
quests.description: Once the hatchlings emerge they will need to begin molting right away. Normally I would have gathered a pile of shed draconian scales for them to roll around in by now but I haven't had time. Can you gather 10 Fresh Draconian Scales for me?

quests.name: Fatherly Insanity
quests.description: Duncan has drivin the Onyx Lava Dragon into a fury by having you slay his mate. We need to calm him before the dragonlings hatch or he will accidentally hurt them. Dark Draconian Essense has a soothing effect on dragons. See if you can get some?

quests.name: What Needs To Be Done
quests.description: The essence did nothing. It's far worse than I though. I hate to ask you but for the hatchlings sake I must. I need you to defeat the Onyx Lava Dragon. He needs to be stopped before the hatchlings arrive!

quests.name: IceStorm Collection Chest Badge
quests.description: The magic of Frostval brought this snowball to life. The moglins of Frostvale put a hat on it. Defeat one of the Snow Golems in /northlands that hurl this little guy's brothers at heroes and he'll reward you with the Frostval 2018 collection character page badge.

quests.name: Evil Keeps Winter Alive
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! The time of ice. cold and darkness is Dage's favorite time of year. Celebrate the darkness with him by bringing him 8 Frost Hearts From the ice monster in /frozenruins and /glacera and he will reward you with gold!

quests.name: Keep Winter here!
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Keep Winter here, and earn Legion tokens by bringing him 10 Frost Hearts from ice monster and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Dage Loves Winter!
quests.description: Winter is Dage's Favorite time of year… it's the most uncomfortable for everyone else! Keep winter here by taking 6 Pails of Water, 6 Lights and 6 Blankets from the monster in /frozenruins and /glacera and bringing them to Dage!

quests.name: Get Rid of the Guards
quests.description: Dr. Eisenbacke's lab is heavily guarded, so before you do anything else you'll want to make sure that problem is taken care of. And make sure you watch out for the dogs - they're augmented with cybernetic upgrades, and have a really nasty bite.

quests.name: Get the Data
quests.description: Remember, we wants as much information as you can find on the experiments they've been doing here. If you see any scientists roaming the halls, you might want to grab any data they're carrying.

quests.name: Find the Door Code
quests.description: Alright, my intelligence says that you'll need an entry code to get into Eisenbacke's main lab. You can probably get it from one of the scientists, or maybe even one of the guards. Only the highest ranking staff will have access to it, so you may need to try a few times before you find someone who has the code.

quests.name: Find the Lab
quests.description: The one thing we couldn't find out is where Eisenbacke's lab actually is, but we know it's somewhere in this main hall. You'll have to try that code out on different doors until you find the right one.

quests.name: Take out Dr. Eisenbacke
quests.description: There's only one thing left to do: go into that lab and bring Dr Eisenbacke to his knees

quests.name: Find Ada
quests.description: Where's Ada? Is she hiding under the couch? (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Keep Looking
quests.description: Where's Ada? Is she hiding in the closet? (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Gotcha!
quests.description: Where's Ada? Is she hiding behind the curtain?

quests.name: Destroy the Barrier
quests.description: If we want to get to that portal, we need to get past this barrier. It looks like that Shadowfire Summoner is the one maintaining it. We are going to have to take him and his Shadow Wings out if we are going to make it out of here alive.

quests.name: Blaze a Path
quests.description: There are too many soldiers in our way for us to make meaningful progress. Go with Galanoth and take out as many Onslaught Knights and Corporals as you can!

quests.name: Into the Tiger's Den
quests.description: They are sending Shadowfire Tigers after us now? What kind of savages are these? This is the kind of stuff you have to deal with as a Hero? This is annoying!

quests.name: One Final Push
quests.description: The portal should be just up ahead. We just need one final push. Clear us a path and we will be able to escape!

quests.name: Defeat Elius
quests.description: Be careful, Hero. Elius is able to wield Tyndarius's power in small quantities, but enough to be a very difficult opponent. Defeat him so that we can escape this Plane.

quests.name: ArchFiend Companions
quests.description: One ArchFiend DragonLord can take down an army. But MANY fighting together can take over the WORLD! Prove your strength and your skill in battle against the Red Dragon and other ArchFiend DragonLords will join you.

quests.name: Feed the Fiend Shard
quests.description: The Fiend Shard hungers. Feed it so that its power may grow alongside yours.

quests.name: Grow the Fiend Shard
quests.description: The Fiend Shard has grown, but so has its appetite.

quests.name: Evolve the Fiend Shard
quests.description: The Fiend Shard is nearing its evolution, but its hunger must be satisfied.

quests.name: The Fiend Shard's Demand
quests.description: The Fiend Shard's hunger is only matched by yours. This isn't about gaining more power anymore. Now, your only intention is to feed.

quests.name: The Fiend Shard's Finale
quests.description: The Fiend Shard is nearing its final form, but can its voracious appetite truly be sated?

quests.name: Fiendish Storm Orb Quest Pet
quests.description: The Storm Orb promises you an electrifying weapon… if you can supply it with energy.

quests.name: Dreamsilk Hair
quests.description: Are you interested in one of my wigs? I’ll make you one if you bring me the Dreamsilk I need. It comes from the Dream Larva you’ll find roaming the city.

quests.name: Defeat Drakath!
quests.description: Battle Drakath to proceed on your quest.

quests.name: Defeat Drakath... again!
quests.description: He's back again, and you need to defeat him in order to move further on your road to the Final Showdown!

quests.name: Defeat Drakath!
quests.description: Drakath has embraced the full power of Chaos - can you still defeat him!

quests.name: The Final Showdown!
quests.description: All Lords of Chaos have been defeated… that just leaves Prince Drakath!

quests.name: Weaken his Powers
quests.description: Prime Dominus is too powerful to confront right now. You must defeat 15 of his minions so cannot tap into their power. That should slow him down!

quests.name: Light and Dark
quests.description: For some.. personal needs… I need you to get the magic essence from 7 Sprites. The big problem with that is they do not commonly drop their essence - it tends to burn up when they are defeated. Keep fighting until you've obtained 7 Sprite Magic essences for me!

quests.name: Paintings Give Him Strength
quests.description: Look hero, those paintings are worth a lot… i mean they contribute to his overall power so they have to be worth SOMETHING! Bring them to me, and we will see if this lowers his strength!

quests.name: Learning the Land
quests.description: I know that there is a door further into the Fortress that Prime Dominus keeps locked. Go take a look at the door to see if we will be able to unlock it.

quests.name: Slay the Light and Dark
quests.description: Good or evil, it does not matter here. To open that door we need some darkness and Light fragments. To get the fragments, you must defeat both Living Stars and Infernal Imps. You'll have to work hard - the fragments don't always survive after the monsters are gone!

quests.name: Chaos Fragments
quests.description: We have Darkness and Light now Chaos is required. Defeat chaorrupted monsters in /chaosmarsh or the /watchtower and bring me back some Chaos Fragments from them!

quests.name: Kill Them All
quests.description: Kill any monster around here, I need Prime's life force weakened.

quests.name: Get Rid of Those Guards
quests.description: Prime Dominus has a special group of guards surrounding his fortress. Defeat 5 of them to really let him know that we are coming for him!

quests.name: Breach the Gate
quests.description: Of course, it has a double-lock system. Nothing is ever that easy! I need you to get the key to the second lock off of one of the Guards.

quests.name: Defeat the Prime Dominus
quests.description: You must defeat Prime in order to get the Star Core. Best of luck, Hero. Be careful, this guy has been around since time itself began.

quests.name: Fire Endurance
quests.description: The fact that you have survived long enough to reach the second level of the Keep is a good omen for your success. However, before I trust my soul to you, I will need additional proof of your competence. This floor is inhabited by hordes of particulary nasty beasts known as Shadow Creepers, who serve the bidding of their fiery Master. If you can slay fifteen of them and bring me their essences, I will know you are worthy and will grant you access to the creature who cursed me. (Bring back fifteen Fiery Essences to complete this quest.)

quests.name: Burning Heart
quests.description: I still remember the final moments of my life. As the Fire Elemental loomed over me to administer his terrible curse, my eyes were drawn to a luminous bracelet on his wrist. The way it glowed and shone in the darkness… I'm SURE that it must be the source of his power, and the key to breaking my curse. If you can defeat him and bring it to me, I'm sure I can end my fiery torment once and for all. (Bring back the Fire Bracelet to complete this quest.)

quests.name: Fire Dragon's House
quests.description: If you can't stand the heat, don't live inside a fire dragon's skull! But if you're one of those heroes who thrives the hotter and deadlier a battle gets, then slay 3 of the Fire Elementals in /dragonplane to unlock a new home just for you.

quests.name: Fangs for Nothing
quests.description: You know, I LOATHE goblins. Messy beasts, at the best of times. But their fangs DO make the best fasteners for the silks the nobles love. Bring me 8 Goblin fangs.

quests.name: Lookin' Flashy
quests.description: Ever since the Queen of Monsters landed on our fair island, everyone's priorities have been turned upside down. Now everyone wants survival gear. Knives, flint, and mirrors. Well, I can make that happen! Bring. Me. SHINY THINGS!

quests.name: The New Swabbie
quests.description: Ye says ye're tough, eh? Well, put your money where your mouth is! Board me ship, and go down into the hold. There, ye'll find one of me men. We was going to make him walk the plank for attempted mutiny, but now he's yer test of mettle! If ye can beat him, then ye'll have earned the right teh… well, teh not be killed just yet.

quests.name: It's A Thankless Job
quests.description: Alright, new swabbie! There's work t'be done! Get back up there onto our ship. Shine our boots and mop the deck!

quests.name: Gunpowder, Lots!
quests.description: We're not done yet! I need ye teh collect gunpowder from the scoundrels and rapscallions along the shore, and then come back here and load it into our blunderbusses! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Boar-ed of Seafood
quests.description: Now that the other preparations be finished, we be needin' some grub for the celebratory feast we'll be havin' later tonight! Me men all be sick of fish, but there be some nice, meaty boars in the woods here! But try te keep 'em whole… if they be too damaged, they won't stay on a spit very well.

quests.name: This Boar Is On Fire
quests.description: Now let's get that spit heated up! We be needin'…. Let's see…. charcoal, matches, and lighter fluid! Ye kin find some charcoal on the beach from last year's feast. The rest be on our ship.

quests.name: Pirates Be Stealthy!
quests.description: Now that we be prepared for tonight… how would ye like a bit o' adventure, swabbie? Go to the other side o' the island, and see what Bonnie Blood and her crew are up to. Make sure they don't see ye, swabbie! They be a dangerous sort.

quests.name: World Tree Wrangling
quests.description: My companions are great, but not high enough in skill to defend themselves from the beasts that inhabit these forests. If I want to keep my creatures free range, organic, and without preservatives (i.e. taxidermy) their main predator, the Hootbear, needs to be taught a lesson.

quests.name: Guardians Gone Bad
quests.description: It was on my suggestion Aven even allowed the Brightpool Guardians into our home. I meant for these creatures to serve as ferocious protectors against the outside world; to transform the misunderstood beasts into a docile friend. Until I break through to the Brightpool, make sure they aren't attacking any innocent bystanders by subduing 9 of the Brightpool Guardians. Pour 5 vials of Aven's "Soothing Solution" into the river; too. That should help..

Flying Necrotic Skull Quest Pet's Quest.name: Flying Necrotic Skull Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Necrotic Pirate Commander's Badge
quests.description: Yarrrr! If it be a ghostly pirate ship house ye be wantin', I've got just what ya need. Slay an Undead Pirate in the /pirates map fer a Ghostly Key, an th' house will be yers.

quests.name: Nineveh and Pyre
quests.description: Even Pyromancers should not just rely magic. The more mundane defenses are also important. Help me help the people of Embersea construct better defenses. Bring me 5 Burning Embers, 3 boards, and 3 pieces of Kindling from Fyresyns. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: The Fire Within
quests.description: The Pyromancers who dwell in Embersea are know for their resilience… and their ability to rise up after defeat. But I say we will NOT fail! Help me construct some… messages… for our invader friends. Bring me 6 Fyresyn bones, 3 Living Lava Pyroclasts, and the helm from one Storm Sentry.

quests.name: Fotia's Only Hope
quests.description: … oh great hero… I can save the Isle of Fotia… take me to the volcano… sacrifice me into the lava core… I am Fotia's only hope… and do not allow anyone to stand in your way…!

quests.name: The Hero's Doom
quests.description: Oh no - you're dying! If you can get to the sarcophagus, you'll be ok. Leave the throne room, and keep heading left until you've reached your salvation.

quests.name: Crashers and Moshers
quests.description: It's hard to concentrate with all these undead moaning and flailing. Defeat 7 of the undead in the Battle Concert Arena so you can focus on the show.

quests.name: Freak on a Leash
quests.description: Zombies, freaks, and undead beasts… three things that will RUIN the craziest virtual concert this arena's ever seen. Take out the Freak on the Leash ans keep the concert going strong!

quests.name: Frevo's Dancers Need Feathers!
quests.description: Hello! Welcome to Terra de Festa! I have a friend who is in need of some brightly colored Cuco feathers for the Carnaval celebration. Could you gather some and bring them to him? You can find him by heading down the ramp, and then to the left.

quests.name: Dancers Need Feathers!
quests.description: Ok, if these dolls are going to be my dancers, they'll need some festive feathers! You know where I've seen some pretty ones? Those Cuco on the beach - just head to the right to find them!

quests.name: And Dolls Need Heads
quests.description: Now that I have these feathered plumes, I'll need some doll heads to attach them to! Large rat skulls would do nicely. Say, from the Green Rats on the city street?

quests.name: A Head Needs A Body
quests.description: Yes, good. Now we need some bodies. I could make them out of fabric and stuff them with straw if I had some. Check with the crows, perhaps? They collect plenty of both for their nests.

quests.name: Bind It All Together
quests.description: And now I'm realizing I don't have anything to sew these dolls together with! If you go back to the beach, you'll find Mulher de Branco. Her silvery hair should do the trick.

quests.name: Take 'Em Apart
quests.description: I can't believe my beautiful dolls have turned against me! I'll have to dismantle them to break the enchantment. No - you will. Please? I can't bring myself to harm them. Bring me the pieces when you're done.

quests.name: Who Could It Be?
quests.description: If we're going to put a stop to this mayhem, we'll have to find out who's behind it! We'll find clues in the zombies he's sent. Kill them, and bring me any evidence you find.

quests.name: A Bag For A Talisman
quests.description: Baron Sunday is bad news. He'll be a tough one to beat, but if I make us a special gris gris we may stand a chance. First I'll need to make a bag. I could craft it from green rat pelts… 6 should be enough. But make sure they're pristine.

quests.name: Their... third eyes?
quests.description: You may have noticed the crows here have 4 eyes. The third ones are said to have special properties that offer protection from malevolent spirits. You can see why we'll need some, yes?

quests.name: Hexy Ladies
quests.description: The last thing we'll need are some hex fragments from a spell Baron Sunday cast. That will make the gris gris protect more strongly against him. The magic seems to be strongest on the dancing zombies, so you should collect the fragments from them.

quests.name: Tracking Down A Baron
quests.description: Now, all that's left is to discover where Baron Sunday is hiding. The crows will know… and the rats. I can use them both to divine where he is.

quests.name: Defeat Baron Sunday
quests.description: If we don't take Baron Sunday down soon, there won't be a city left to party in! Terra de festa is counting on you!

quests.name: Heart of Ice
quests.description: Demolish the Polar Elementals and Polar Golems guarding this level of Kezeroth's temple by stripping them of the 4 Glacier Cores and 5 Frozen Snowballs that power them.

quests.name: Absolute Zero Success
quests.description: Kezeroth was wise. As he slept, Temple Prowlers, Polar Elementals, and Polar Golems ventured deeper into the temple, attracted to his icy tomb, where he trapped them. Take back the 3 IceHeart Amulets, 3 Frozen Hearts, and 6 Diamond Snowflakes holding the creatures on this level and they will disperse.

quests.name: Dirty Secret
quests.description: Until we confront him, we cannot know the secrets Kezeroth possesses… but we can try to make these creatures tell us! Convince them to share what they know by taking 10 Frozen Fangs and 5 Dirty Claws from the Temple Prowlers and Polar Moles.

quests.name: Frozen Venom
quests.description: For those who make it to this level, it appears that Kezeroth has left a deadly trap. Destroy the Polar Wyrms and Polar Spiders, then take the 6 Tainted Wyrm Scales and 7 Poison Ice Spines from them so they cannot harm you.

quests.name: Rune-ing His Plan
quests.description: I had hoped to fine SOME kind of information to help us to defeat Kezeroth more handily. These Golems look like they may carry runes. Slay them and take 10 of the runes to see if they can tell us anything.

quests.name: Deadly Beauty
quests.description: There is beauty in death, and danger makes the heart grow fonder. Do not forget what you are learning here, Hero. Slay the Polar Elementals and Polar Golems to collect 10 Crystalline Spines, 10 Crystal Snowflakes, and 6 Frozen Breaths so that you will always remember… at least, you will until they melt.

quests.name: Cold-Hearted Trophies
quests.description: You are quickly learning the ways of these cold-natured creatures. claim some trophies of your conquests to continue. Slay Polar Moles and Temple Prowlers to complete your trophy collection and move on!

quests.name: Warmth in the Cold
quests.description: The chill is beginning to seep into your bones. You need to slay Temple Maggots and Spider Guardians to continue to find warmth giving Maggot Spit and Spider Meat.

quests.name: Icy Prizes
quests.description: Temple Prowlers and Temple Maggots were both hunted to near extinction for their valuable Ice Whips and Poisoned Fangs. Earn a little cash on the side. Collect these prized items to continue to the next level of FrostDeep.

quests.name: Fading Magic
quests.description: The Ancient Golems were placed here to protect the temples but their magic has begun to fade. They could turn on you at any second. You'd better destroy them and collect their magical remains before you continue.

quests.name: FrostDeep Dwellers
quests.description: The Polar Wyrm Riders have alerted the Polar Moles to your presence on this level. Demonstrate your might, eradicate these threats and carry proof of your victory with you to ward off future attacks.

quests.name: A Breather
quests.description: Might as well clear some Polar Moles, Temple Spiders, Polar Spiders while you're here. Once you have, rest, then move on.

quests.name: Raiders From FrostDeep
quests.description: Polar Draconians and Temple Maggots have been raiding villages near FrostDeep for a long time. You should take back some Deadly Defrosters and Larvae Silk before moving on.

quests.name: 8 Legged Frost Freaks
quests.description: The Polar Spiders and Temple Spiders have become too common down here to ignore. Defeat some of these beasts and collect their treasures and eggs to continue.

quests.name: Freezing the Stone
quests.description: The ancient golems in this layer of FrostDeep guard power. I am not sure how old, or what it would do to us, but we should recover it just in case. Recover 2 Ancient Runes and 3 Ruby Eyes. … Just in case.

quests.name: Can You Feel the Chill Tonight?
quests.description: Take heart, Hero! We are approaching the bottom, I can feel it. I can SEE it, too, with the way my breath freezes in the air. The creatures here only make it colder. Slay the Prowlers and Polar Elementals for 7 Prowler Claws, 7 Frigid Femurs, and 4 Frost Breaths.

quests.name: Shrouded in Ice
quests.description: I do not know why Kezeroth would have these Ancient Maggots in his lair. They make my skin crawl! And I worry why they would stockpile such items. Retrieve 10 Decayed Silk Shrouds and 9 Rotten Larva Shells so we know they can't be used on YOU.

quests.name: Hard Fight for a Cold Truth
quests.description: Look at these Ancient Prowlers. You can tell by their battle scars that they have had a hard fight to survive. Vanquish them and you will be renowned for your courage and skill! Bring back 5 Prowler Tongues and 9 Scraps of Prowler Fur to prove you have defeated them.

quests.name: Sand and Shardin' Bones
quests.description: The ancient moles appear to be blind, but be wary. I can tell that these have become carnivorous, feeding off their kin. Collect 7 of the Bone Shards and 6 grains of Hourglass Sand. Someday, I will return them to the mole people so they may mourn properly.

quests.name: Older and Colder
quests.description: The deeper you go into Kezeroth's dungeon, the colder you get. And the older creatures become. I am troubled by that. Slay Ancient Moles, Ancient Prowlers, and Ancient Maggots for 5 Dried Blood, 4 Wyrm Dirt, and 4 Temple Dust Mites. If they are put to rest, they will not trouble us.

quests.name: The Sword Of Hope
quests.description: The Ancient Terror is the final guardian protecting the Sword of Hope. It regenerates but claim enough Hearts of Gold and Hears of Darkness and the Sword of Hope is yours!

quests.name: Feed the Frostling Horror
quests.description: Mmm. Pet hungry. Pet a horror. Feed pet frozen meat chunk.

quests.name: Find the Underflame
quests.description: The Underworld you see here isn't all there is. Below where we stand, there is a pocket of intense, underworldly flame. The… Underflame, if you will. It holds the answer to your problem… IF you can find it. Ha, ha, ha.

quests.name: Gather some Underlava
quests.description: As you may have noticed, the Underflame is so hot, much of it is molten. This lava… Underlava, I like to call it… is exactly what we need. Go and get me some.

quests.name: Gather Sulfur
quests.description: Hey! Don't go anywhere. We're not done yet! I need some sulfur dust - it really spices up that flame. The imps will be your best source.

quests.name: Coal for Flame
quests.description: Just one more thing: some ghostly coal to keep the fire burning. You'll have to mine that yourself, from the walls of the Underflame.

quests.name: Defeat the Underflame Guardian
quests.description: WAIT! Don't go. Not yet. All of that mining and lava-collecting. Has awakened the Guardian of the Underflame. He's not happy, and if you leave he'll take it out on ME. You'll make sure he doesn't, right? Since I helped you?

quests.name: Take the Flame
quests.description: Okay, here you go. This flame should be hot enough and bright enough to clear out anything. You're welcome. Now, go back to Dage.

quests.name: Hound Down the Beast!
quests.description: After doing some research on these tracks, I found that they are from a Werewolf! We'll have to try to hunt one down somewhere and see if it took it. Do you know where we might be able to find a suspect? It likely won't give up my favorite bone without a tussle.

items_required.name: Favorite Bone Found! x1 (Stacks up to 30)

quests.name: Fusion Avatar's Gift
quests.description: To acknowledge your victories and support, we have a gift for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness.

quests.name: Shadow Spy Eye
quests.description: They're watching, staring, glaring, waiting for you to make a move. And once you do, they'll summon their alien guards to take you out! Better beat 10 ETs before you're the one thrown out of this world!

quests.name: Application for the Army
quests.description: Would you like to join our army? We're currently accepting applications for our army. Wait… you don't look like a dino…

quests.name: A Jarring Solution
quests.description: The spears carried by the Guardians of Anubyx are charged with tesseract energy. If you get a canopic jar from one of the mummies, you can use it to store that energy. When you have enough tesseract energy to fill the jar, activate the bridge by placing the canopic jar into the circular socket near the end of the walkway.

quests.name: Ra of Light
quests.description: Alright! You have used the energy you just collected to charge up the Hard Light Bridge by placing the canopic jar into the circular socket near the end of the walkway. Now you'll be able to cross the bridge and pull the third lever.

quests.name: Sphynxes are Riddled With Gems
quests.description: On the other side of the bridge you'll find some stone sphynxes. You'll need to collect 4 gems from them - 2 white, and 2 black. Obviously you'll get the black gems from the black sphynxes, and the white gems from the white ones.

quests.name: 4th Dimensional Teleport
quests.description: Now, you're going to take those gems you just gathered, and place them into the device a little further down the hall. Black ones on top, white ones on the bottom. Then… well, just use it and see what happens, haha!

quests.name: Find the Secret Brick
quests.description: Ok, soooo… first, we have to find the second lever. I remember having to press a brick into the wall to reveal it - like when you're reading a murder mystery and they go through a secret passageway in the walls! - but I don't remember where it was. I know you can find it though. Because I did!

quests.name: Gauze in 60 Seconds
quests.description: As you may have noticed, the second lever is way out of your reach. But we are problem-solvers! If you get enough gauze from those mummies, we can use it to lasso the lever from a distance. But you'll need to find some pretty strong gauze, otherwise it will break. 20 feet of the stuff should probably be enough.

quests.name: De-Lever-ence
quests.description: Now all you have to do is go back in there and lasso the lever with your gauze!

quests.name: I heard you like Gacha
quests.description: As you approach, a very large mechanical contraption covered in bright lights contains a lot of gear. Examining it, you see a coin is needed to be inserted to turn the dial. Maybe Kotaro has what you're looking for? There's also a slot that says to insert a green bone..? A Skello Kitty from the /yokaigrave should do.

quests.name: Gather Spores
quests.description: In the garden, you'll find some pretty glowing mushrooms. Their spores have some very intresting magical properties. Bring me some.

quests.name: Getting Dusty
quests.description: Pixie dust acts as a universal reagemt. Any spell you add it to become stronger. Obviously, we're going to want some for this one. The sprites in the garden have it in abundance.

quests.name: Gather Moss
quests.description: Just one last thing: some of the moss growing on the treeants nearby. What does it do, you ask? I'll let that be a surprise

quests.name: Feed Bramblebite
quests.description: Here, go on. Take this over to Bramblebite and have him eat it.

quests.name: Flowers and Seeds
quests.description: First, I'll need you to gather a few herbs that have certain magical peoperties. A few seeds from the Glass Spitters, and some red flowers you'll find growing around the garden. I only need a few of each.

quests.name: So Glamourous
quests.description: I'll be using sprite glamour to power the spell. Do I even need to tell you where to get this? Sigh. From the Garden Sprites, of course

quests.name: Likin' the Lichen
quests.description: A bit of blackened lichen will mask the favor of the herb I'm adding. You'll fing it glowing on the Treeants nearby.

quests.name: It's Wine Time
quests.description: One last thing: a glass of Feawine. Most of the guests will be drinking it. Steal a glass from one of them and bring it back to me. You'll have to fight for it, though - they REALLY don't want to give it up.

quests.name: Nap Time for Barb
quests.description: Now all you need to do is give this glass of wine to the Scriptkeeper - your friend Barb, that is - and she will fall into a deep sleep. It should last long enough for you to get her home.

quests.name: Crystallis Ship Quest
quests.description: Space-warriors and monks sponsored by the Crystallis administration travel in style, and so can you. All you need to create your ship is one orb of Crystallized Spacetime. Slay an Astral Ephemerite in the /timespace map to unlock your ship.

quests.name: Dragonfire Spice Cake
quests.description: Hero! I need 10 crystallized Dragon flames to grind up. They are the only spice hot enough to make my patented Dragonfire Spice Cake! Slay 10 Draconians for Crystallized Flames.

quests.name: DragonPepper Punch
quests.description: DragonSlaying is thirsty work, and so is birthday-parting! Bring me 10 vials of Draconian venom from the Lair Draconians and 3 Flame Peppers from the Fire Elementals in Gilead.

quests.name: DragonDoodle Cookies
quests.description: Some people - not DragonSlayers! - don't like cake. For them, I need you to bring back 1 box of DragonDoodle Cookies from the Green dragon in Greenguard, 3 boxes from the Sketchy Dragon in (/join j6) and 5 boxes from the Red Dragon in /Mafic.

quests.name: Dragon Tail Trophies
quests.description: I LOVE using dragon trophies to decorate, and tails are so versatile. Weave them into banners, curtains, rugs… I need as many as you can bring me! For every 10 Dragon Tails you bring, I'll give you a Dragon's Talon. Use those in my Birthday Merge shop.

quests.name: Dragon Head Trophies
quests.description: Displaying a Dragon Head is the sign of a devoted DragonSlayer, I KNOW you have the skill to gather as many as I need! Bring me 10 Dragon Heads so I can decorate the Lair. For every 10 Dragon Heads you bring, I'll give you TWO Dragon Talons. Use those in my Birthday Merge shop.

quests.name: Dragonslayer Veteran
quests.description: You have helped me, so now I will help you - to rank up into the Dragonslayer elite and earn your full place in the Order of Dragonslayers! You are, right now, officially a Dragonslayer Recruit. To rank up to Dragonslayer Veteran, bring me 8 Dragonslayer Veteran Medals. You can get them from Wyverns and Water Draconians!

quests.name: Dragonslayer Sergeant
quests.description: Congratulations! You are now a Dragonslayer Veteran. To rank up to Dragonslayer Sergeant, you must bring me 8 Dragonslayer Sergeant Medals. You can find them on Purple, Venom and Bronze Draconians.

quests.name: Dragonslayer Captain
quests.description: As a Dragonslayer Sergeant, you now have quite a bit of experience fighting these creatures. To rank up to Dragonslayer Captain, bring me 8 Dragonslayer Captain's Medals that you can get from Dark and Golden Draconians!

quests.name: Dragonslayer Marshal
quests.description: You have made it this far--to the rank of Dragonslayer Captain! Now, your final test awaits! Bring me 8 Dragonslayer Marshal Medals by defeating the powerful fire dragon 8 times! Do this, and your rank as Dragonslayer Marshal is secure--You will be one of my top-ranking slayers!

quests.name: Dragonslayer Reward (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: With Vasalkar slain, most of his treasure will be donated to the towns he destroyed. But some items are too powerful to be in the hands of anyone but a Dragonslayer. Collect 12 Wisps of Dragonspirit for me and I will reward you with a piece from the Dragon's Hoard!

quests.name: Dragonbane (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Before we take on Vasalkar. I'm going to need enough Dragonbane for all of our Dragonslayers. We make it from Draconic Ore. The best way to get this ore is from the Wyverns and Draconians, who have mined it for their own uses. Plus. you'll be slaying some Dragonkin - two birds, one stone!

quests.name: Dragon Scales (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Dragonslayers sometimes use dragon scales in their armor. It helps protect us from the fiery breath of the dragons we fight. Bring me scales from the Wyverns and Draconians in the area so I can keep us all well-protected.

quests.name: Dragon Souvenirs (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Dragons take pride in killing Dragonslayers! They keep trophies from each of us that they slay - can you believe that?? We must defend the honor of the fallen. Slay the Dragonkin inside Vasalkar's lair, and bring back any trophies you find.

quests.name: Dragonslayer (Bonus Quest)
quests.description: Vasalkar is a huge, old, and deadly Red Dragon that has destroyed many villages. He guards his treasure hoard ferociously! Defeat him so that we may carry word of vengeance back to the people who have suffered! Bring me his heart, and I'll reward you for it. You might also find rare and valuable treasures in his hoard!

quests.name: BATTLE: Broccoli vs Hero
quests.description: Broccoli has vowed to steal the Enchanted Dragon Orbz. Defeat him or he will make sure your death is slow and painful. Show your fighting spirit. Let the battle… BEGIN!

quests.name: BATTLE: Radish vs Hero
quests.description: Radish blah blah blah Let the battle… BEGIN!

quests.name: BATTLE: Karrot vs Hero
quests.description: Power comes in response to a need, and Karrot NEEDS those Enchanted Dragon Orbz. If he wins, he promises he will not destroy the world. Let the battle… BEGIN!

quests.name: BATTLE: Vegetable Prince vs Hero
quests.description: Next up… Vegetable Prince BATTLE! Today will be the day he finally settles things. And steals your Enchanted Dragon Orbz. Let the battle… BEGIN!

quests.name: BATTLE: SUPER Vegetable Prince vs Hero
quests.description: Do you really think you can beat him in this form? He won't go easy on you just because you're a hero. Let the battle… BEGIN!

quests.name: Demanding Approval from Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Minion! Agree with the contract you must to proceed on your progress of your needs. Go talk to me at Tercessuinotlim and you will be able to carve and forge my Gemstones but don't think it is going to be that easy. You brought me so many resources and I am granting you a chance to forge your own gemstones. Keep in mind that forging isn't that simple when creating underworld gemstones.

quests.name: Forge Gemstones for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: So… are you looking for a way to get more of my gemstones? There is a reason why I need you to hunt the resources throughout Lore, and you need to stay strong no matter what takes you to accomplish your goal. Whining is NOT a choice. We can start a chain of deals if you have my contract, otherwise stop wasting my time.

quests.name: Forge Tainted Gems for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Tainted Gems are marginally valuable and I am actually providing you a chance to forge them by yourself, minion. Bring me the reagents I need and I can teach you how to forge them.

quests.name: Forge Dark Crystal Shards for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Now my rare and fragile Dark Crystal Shard is the one that is the most precious to me. My Shards are embedded with Dark Energy and something more, minion. It is not that hard to create them but not everybody has the will and patience to forge them for me. Now show me the reason in why you wasted my time on you for my ARS (Abyssal Revenue Services).

quests.name: Forge Diamonds for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Diamonds are marginally valuable outside the underworld and I am actually providing you a chance to forge them by yourself, minion. Diamonds of Nulgath were brought from the void so in the void shall you hunt for the main resource. Bring me the reagents I need and I can teach you how to forge them.

quests.name: Forge Blood Gems for Nulgath
quests.description: Nulgath says: Blood Gems of the Archfiends aren't the most valuable gemstone from the underworld but they are REALLY RARE to be seen, minion. Blood Gems are connected with the Void and not every minion of mine comes back alive with the reagents. Now, if you want to keep forging for me this won't be a challenge at all, right minion?

quests.name: Carve the Unidentified Gemstone
quests.description: Nulgath says: Minion, you forged an unknown Gemstone with a void shape? Isn't it beautiful? The Unidentified Gemstone of Nulgath was created by my own life force through the Contract of Nulgath and you were actually lucky to get it when you were forging gemstones. This is one of the RAREST of underworld Gemstones and it chose YOU as worthy to see the reward that lies within it. Are you ready for it?

quests.name: Those Who Remain
quests.description: The two of us are glad to see you here, and I know that many other people will be too. Why not go around and speak to the survivors? This attack has been difficult for all of us, and I am sure many would be delighted to see a friendly face again.

quests.name: Who Helps the Healer?
quests.description: So few people managed to make it to town, and most of them were injured or ill. Twilly is doing his best to heal everyone, but I fear he may be overworking himself. A few potions could help speed recovery! The chitin of the Corrosive Crawlers can be used to brew particularly effective tonics, and forest bandits always have a few extra power potions.

quests.name: Supply in Demand
quests.description: Battleon has always been a town that seems to have everything a Hero needs- but with how many new residents we have and outside trade being impossible, our supplies have been dwindling quickly. If we are to have any chance at being prepared for anything, we will need more. Drakath's Supply Caravans are nearby. Raiding them may provide us with what we require!

quests.name: Creature Comforts
quests.description: I intend to use the supplies from Drakath's troops to bolster the AntiTitan Corps. The weapons and armor will greatly assist our defense, but we must make sure the townsfolk are able to keep their strength up as well. Meat rations from the wild game and insects, once purified, will be excellent meals for our starving survivors.

quests.name: Infernal Investigation
quests.description: I'm starting to hear troubling reports that some of the AntiTitan Corps may not be… entirely trustworthy. Add in all of the Chaorrupted Bandits outside the wall, and there are far too many ways for Drakath to gain access to our plans. Check in with the members of the Corps, and take out as many bandits as you can to prevent Drakath from gaining intel.

quests.name: Another Brick in the Wall
quests.description: The walls surrounding Battleon have done well to stave off past Titan attacks, but have weathered over time. They won't hold up to another attack in their current state. If you gather bricks from the Supply Caravans, chitin from the Corrosive Crawlers, and the saliva of the Chaos Critters, we can begin to rebuild. With your assistance, there's a chance we can have them complete by the next attack.

quests.name: Gauntlet of Monsters
quests.description: Hello, tufted mammal! Are you looking to increase your standing with Warlord Twilly? Go into the Death Pit Arena, do battle with all the monsters there - the sneevils, the slimes, and the salamanders. Collect their battle tokens to show you have won, and bring them to me. I'll update the ledger with your victories!

quests.name: Gauntlet of Drakels
quests.description: Furless ape! How do you feel about taking on a bigger challenge? Go into the Death Pit Arena, and challenge the Drakel Brawlers, Gladiators, and Battlemasters. Bring me their battle tokens to prove that you prevailed, and I'll update the ledger with your victories!

quests.name: Gauntlet of Generals
quests.description: Tiny creature! Your combat skills are beyond compare. All of the Warlord's Generals want to spar with you - would you do us the honor? Meet us in the Death Pit Arena. If you win, we'll each give you one of our battle tokens, and I'll gladly update the ledger with your new victories!

quests.name: Rotten to the Corps
quests.description: The more we track the movement of the chaorrupted members of the AntiTitan Corps, the more suspicious I become. I don't believe we've eradicated ALL of the spies in our midst. Interrogate the remaining members of the Corps you find in town. I have no mercy for traitors, especially at a time like this.

quests.name: A Fighting Chance
quests.description: Now that we've weeded out the bad eggs, let's get planning. If we want to fight back against the Titans, we have to be creative. Our smiths have developed a revolutionary system that could help- but we'll need some weapons to help us use it. The sharp stingers of Corrosive Crawlers and sturdy wires from their supply wagons should fit the designs in their blueprints perfectly.

quests.name: Flash of the Titans
quests.description: The new systems give our fighters a huge increase in mobility, but with how many Titans there are, we'll need some way of startling them before swinging into action. The Supply Caravans carry Shine Powder and casings that can be used to create bombs, and the Chaotic Beholders have evolved built-in smoke glands to hide when a Titan gets too close. Those will serve our needs nicely.

quests.name: Vein Ambition
quests.description: The first tests of the wire-gliders are working perfectly, but it's going to take more than some fancy movement to actually take these Titans down. Thankfully, I've got a plan for that, too. The power of their blows has increased, but not the power of their immune systems. If you can extract the venom of the nearby Corrosive Crawlers and bring it to the forge, we can use that to our advantage…

quests.name: Asset Acquisition
quests.description: With so many survivors, we're rapidly running out of… well… everything. Food, medicine, fabric, weapons… We've got the knowledge we need to put up a fight, but not the raw materials. I need you to go on a resource raid – hit up the Chaorrupted Bandits and their Supply Caravans for the materials we need.

quests.name: Enemy at the Gate
quests.description: We'll need to put the preparations aside for a moment…. I just received an urgent message from one of our scouting parties. Something is rapidly making its way towards Battleon's walls, and has already reached Greenguard Forest. If it's what we think it is, we'll need your help. Meet us outside the gate, and we'll try to take it out without alerting too many of the survivors.

quests.name: Titanic Terror
quests.description: That armor looks familiar… It seems like even the secret orders of Lore who didn't make it into Battleon also became test subjects for the Titan's Tincture. Even if we stop it in town, seeing a twisted version of something so mythical would send the camp into an even greater state of panic. We've got to stop the Titan before it breaches the gate!

quests.name: Titanic Terror Times Two
quests.description: Another group of Titans, so soon? We aren't prepared to hold off one of those monsters yet, much less two. If we are to have any hope for the future, we must show our people that with you by our side, Battleon has a chance of fighting back – and as you said, there is no better way to do so than bringing those behemoths down!

quests.name: Do You Even Brawl
quests.description: Small, fleshy mammal! Do you have what it takes to fight in Hun'Gar's Arena? Enter the fray and defeat one of the other combatants. Show me a Death Pit Token as proof of your triumph, and I will reward you!

quests.name: Flex For Hun'Gar
quests.description: Small, fleshy mammal! Do you have what it takes to fight in Hun'Gar's Arena? Enter the fray and defeat one of the other combatants. Show me a Death Pit Token as proof of your triumph, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Pummel For Hun'Gar
quests.description: Don't forget, puny human! When you are in the arena, you're not just fighting the other humans. You're fighting Drakel, too! Defeat the opposing Drakel leader's Brawlers and Restorers. Show me proof of your victory, and you will be rewarded.

quests.name: Destroy For Hun'Gar
quests.description: You can fight, tiny warrior - but can you win? Defeat the opposing team's Captain to win the brawl!

quests.name: Round 1: Firestorm Scouts
quests.description: Defeat 10 Firestorm Scouts to prove your worth as a warrior and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 2: Firestorm Soldiers
quests.description: Defeat 9 Firestorm Soldiers to prove your worth as a warrior and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 3: Firestorm Pikemen
quests.description: Defeat 8 Firestorm Soldiers to prove your ability to dodge steel and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 4: Firestorm Knights
quests.description: Defeat 7 Firestorm Knights to prove your ability to overcome danger and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 5: Firestorm Corporals
quests.description: Defeat 6 Firestorm Corporal to prove you have the power of command and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 6: Firestorm Tigers
quests.description: Defeat 5 Firestorm Tigers to prove your lack of fear and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 7: Firestorm Cavalry
quests.description: Defeat 4 Firestorm Tiger Riders to prove your dexterity and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 8: Firestorm Majors
quests.description: Defeat 3 Firestorm Majors to prove you can take damage as well as deal it and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 9: Firestorm Blazebinders
quests.description: Defeat 2 Firestorm Blazeinders to prove youcan withstand the heat and you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught!

quests.name: Round 10: Firestorm General
quests.description: Defeat 1 Firestorm General. IF you can, you may be invited to join the Firestorm Onslaught. But it won't be easy. They are best of the best.

quests.name: Bonus Round: Flamewing the Bright
quests.description: Defeat Flamewing the Bright, one of the Risen One's attendants, to prove your worth. That is all

quests.name: Final Round: Tyndarius Tigermaster
quests.description: Defeat Tyndarius in single combat to prove your value to the Onslaught. This is the final test. There is no way you'll be able to defeat him, but… you can always try.

quests.name: Wolf Cub's Footprints
quests.description: I wasn't there the last time the Fortress was invaded, and I realized the blindspots in our security were never fixed. While I search for Lord Dage, I need you to trawl the halls for clues about the intruder. Interrogate Arondight, the Paladins, and the Legion turncoats to see if they're hiding any more information.

items_required.name: Legion Cocytus Engraving x6 (Stacks up to 300)
Paladin's Death Tag x6 (Stacks up to 300)

quests.name: Knight's Honor
quests.description: If 'you' plan to introduce me and that Paladin woman to someone, we should get rid of the Atlas Knights surrounding the arena. Allow me the honor of helping 'you' collect their heads. That'll make searching the streets far less tedious.

quests.name: Drawn Light
quests.description: That Paladin woman is trying to convince her fiance's son and his friend to leave. The King already knows the Legion is preparing to advance. That'll make the war more interesting, but if 'you' want Yara to survive, best tell her and those brats to get moving.

quests.name: Sterile Life
quests.description: Why would I bother with a disguise when the King already knows we're here? My chains rattled the Mages, and now they're scurrying over. I prefer this. It's not every day I get to battle alongside a real Beast.

quests.name: Lost Generations
quests.description: The streets lack the stench of death, and I sense that it's been this way for many years. Ah. There's a hint of it wafting from beneath the ground. The person 'you' are looking for must be there. We'll find a way down, and any other hint of their presence.

quests.name: The Snitch
quests.description: That Paladin woman's fiance came looking for his runaway bride and his mousey son. I've never seen a desk rat frothing at the mouth to kill. Coelho won't let Yara go unless he's dead. Shall I crush him, or would it please 'you' to?

quests.name: Atlantides' Eve
quests.description: My blade yearns to carve death into the cowards of Atlas. Talk to Misaru so she can guide us to the throne. She said the castle's gates will open for us, or rather, 'you.' The Kingdom's best will be waiting. I wonder what nonsense they'll have to say.

quests.name: Lowly Form
quests.description: I see that the King allows his favorite pets to freely roam the castle grounds. They also lack the scent of death. In fact…none of them have a beast's soul. Why don't we take our blades, and see for ourselves?

quests.name: Enduring Sacrilege
quests.description: Atlas Elites guard the throne. They're souls from ages past, inhabiting the bodies of their descendants. A fight that lacks the exhilaration of true death is infuriatingly dull. We'll make them suffer before we have an audience with their King.

quests.name: Blood of the Hesperides
quests.description: The Elites and their pet beasts are being commanded to take formation outside the throne room. It seems that their King isn't ready for 'you,' so his kindred are taking charge. We'll show them that we're less than impressed.

quests.name: Prota Sparasso
quests.description: Rather than the King, we've arrived to find Atlas' Head Executioner watching the throne. How dull. Zedek's late. At least this creature calling itself Ladon will entertain us while we wait. It's hardly a worthy offering, but it'll keep our blood pumping.

quests.name: Dog Nights of Summer
quests.description: If you'd please step through the entrance shaped like our mighty Lord's face, we can begin the tour. The Blood Moon's driving the wolves guarding the arena a little crazy, so get your weapons out. They're looking to treat themselves to your bones.

quests.name: Achilles Tendon
quests.description: The Legion Gladiators are training for the tournament, and look, they've noticed us. To be more precise, they've noticed me, and are so enraged that they don't even register you're here. Remember our deal. Get rid of the fodder so we can be on our way.

quests.name: Disciplinary Action
quests.description: I didn't expect this many wolves and Gladiators gunning for me. Oh, enough already. We have places to be. I'll help you cut off their heads. Getting squeamish? They're all Undead, so it's just an inconvenience.

quests.name: The Fun Police
quests.description: Check it out. Legion's biggest party pooper. Mind telling Rand we're just here for a tour? Looks like some of my Willbreakers are sniffing around for bribes, too. Help me get them to back off. We get first dibs.

quests.name: Despair-ity
quests.description: Famine got caught cheating, and it's going to cost him. Why don't we talk to him? Yknow, to rub it in, or take advantage of the situation. I'm sure Rand would appreciate it if you kicked those scheming Ritualists down, too.

quests.name: Bad Charms
quests.description: Famine and I have come to an understanding. Read between the lines later. We should get rid of all the ritual sigils his Mages drew all over the place. They'll hurt your Horseman's chances of winning if you leave them alone.

quests.name: Self-Appointed Heel
quests.description: Do you hear that screeching? Those are Deathwings, and I think they're harassing the Horseman of War. They don't swoop in for no reason. Why don't we chase them out, and have a chat with the Crimson Rider?

quests.name: Simple Delights
quests.description: Slaine grabbed Conquest's stolen bow. That lughead's either going around yelling for you to come pick it up, or already gotten distracted biting the other Legionnaires to undeath. We'd better go find him before Lord Dage notices us running around.

quests.name: Vultures of a Feather
quests.description: Conquest's getting cornered, but the Deathwings and Ritualists are crowding the arena. They know he's about to bite it, so why don't we take a page out of Slaine's book and bite them?

quests.name: All's Fair
quests.description: Your chosen Horseman's trapped on the east side of the colosseum. War sent one of his Forges to attack Conquest while he's disarmed. You rescue him, and I'll see to some other business.

quests.name: Mingle
quests.description: What? Oh, uh no, we're not ready for you yet. Just… go talk to the other combatants for a little bit. I'll let you know when we're sending you in.

quests.name: Those Dummies
quests.description: Don't worry, we understand that you lesser creatures are small and weak, and we don't really expect that much out of you. But still, it IS more entertaining when you put up a fight! Come on, let's get you trained on some stationary dummies. Wouldn't it be cool if you could hold your own against one of those monsters for a few minutes before it destroys you?

quests.name: Round 1: You vs Omar the Meek!
quests.description: Ok, small mamma!! It's time for your first real fight! We're going to put you up against Omar the Meek. He didn't do very well against the training dummies, so I feel like you have a pretty good chance here. Head into the Arena when you're ready.

quests.name: Round 2: You vs a Bunch of Sneevils!
quests.description: Let's give you something a little more fun, what do you say? How about: you against a bunch of Sneevils? My money's on you this time, too. Even in a group, they are punier than you.

quests.name: Battle: You vs Hattori!
quests.description: Ready for your next battle, squishy creature? You're going up against another human this time - one that's been holding up as well as you have. Let's see which once of you makes it out!

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Slime Horde!
quests.description: You're not tired yet, are you? We're sending you back in, fleshbag! I don't know if this will be fun for you, but trust me, you're creating some great entertainment here.

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Sludge Lord!
quests.description: Actually, don't hose yourself down just yet. We have another - heh - messy combatant for you to fight. You've come a long way, little thing! A defeat in this fight would be very respectable.

quests.name: Battle: You vs Some Salamanders!
quests.description: You look like you still have some fight in you. Come on, let's see how you do against something large and scaly! Watch out for that flame breath!

quests.name: Battle: You vs a Trobble!
quests.description: We're almost out of combatants for you to fight, little one - I apologize that I don't have a more worthy opponent for you, but we weren't sure what to do with this one.

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Brawlers!
quests.description: Ok, we're sending you in for a fight in the real tournament now. No mroe squishy mammals - you're fighting Drakel now! Don't feel bad if you die in this round, little thing. There's no shame in it. Maybe you'll even take someone with you before you go!

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Gladiators!
quests.description: Alright, well. As an undefeated arena champion, you do have the right to continue fighting. But frankly, that last round didn't go over as well as we'd hoped. Turns out the audience doesn't really like watching a lesser species slaughter our fighters… so, we don't be sending you in again. You are free to leave the tournament, and I encourage you to do so.

quests.name: Battle: You vs the Battlemasters!
quests.description: Look, Pax is never going to ban you from continuing with the tournament, because it would make us look weak. But I strongly suggest bowing out here. The Warlord is getting angry, and that never ends well.

quests.name: Battle: You vs General Gall!
quests.description: Gall! This charade has gone on long enough! Come out here and show this insolent pest what a real Drakel can do!

quests.name: Velm's Minions
quests.description: Velm! Send out your best Drakels and get rid of this hairless rat!

quests.name: General Velm
quests.description: This is unacceptable! Velm, get out there and slay this creature yourself!

quests.name: Chud's Minions
quests.description: Chud! You will succeed where Velm has failed me! Your Drakels are more unpredictable than his; they will grind this human into the dirt!

quests.name: General Chud
quests.description: Chud! Show me that you are better than your minions were! This insect can't stand against a general of your caliber!

quests.name: Hun'Gar's Minions
quests.description: Hun'Gar, your minions are large, and strong, like our ancestral Dragons themselves. Send them into the arena, so that this pathetic creature will bother us no more!

quests.name: Hun'Gar Defeated
quests.description: Hun'Gar! You are the biggest, the strongest of all of us! You will prevail over this insignificant bug!

quests.name: Pax Defeated
quests.description: Fine. I'll just have to take care of you myself!

quests.name: Comm Module 4dX
quests.description: You there! Yes, you, the civilian. Some THIEF has infiltrated on our Control Room and stolen the Comm Module. We can't call in ANY way reinforcements to deal with this skyscum. Kill ALL the pirates untill you find that module! And… if you should find any *ahem* mildly useful electrical components, bring them there RIGHT AWAY! Now go! GO GO GO!

quests.name: Can You Hear Me Now?
quests.description: Since you're proven you can follow orders, I have new tasks for you. Return the Comm Module to its proper location. We'll re-write it. Then you can set up the satellites along the path so we can regain base-to-ship communication. And while you're out there, check the locked storage room. Take this key code. DON'T tough the thing you see in there. Just look for a small, rounded electrical component.

quests.name: Back to Base-ics
quests.description: Alright, you. We NEED that powerpack for… Gearjerkers, I wasn't going to TELL you this, but you need to know. The powerpack is for our new battle tech. We've built ourselves a mechsuit, but SOMEONE has stolen the powercell it uses. Go to the /piratebase; Bring me 10 pirate trophies and the powerpack!

quests.name: Secret Weapon Mecha-Death!
quests.description: Battle the betrayer who stole the SkyGuard's secret war weapon and is turning it against you!

quests.name: Rock Star
quests.description: Everything that I need to make a key can be found in the mines. The base material I require comes from rare, enchanted Limestone boulders. You can easily spot these rocks by their lime green color and half-moon shape. Return to me only when you have 7 Limestones in your possession.

quests.name: All That Glitters...
quests.description: Raw gold is a soft, pliable metal that is the correct density for molding the key. It used to be everywhere in these mines, but that was before the Dwarves began prospecting, leaving every rock and vein dry. However, the Drow invaders in the mines sometimes carry Gold Deposits on their boots… if you could bring me 5 Gold Deposits, I would have enough to continue work on this key!

quests.name: Gemeralds
quests.description: Before Vath came to power, the mines were filled with precious Chaos stones known as Gemeralds. These gems, although small, contained massive amounts of Chaotic energy. This key is going to require 6 Gemeralds in order to open the door. I think the Chaos Draconians are using them to enhance their own magical potential. Find the Chaos Draconians, and you will find the Gemeralds.

quests.name: Talc to Me
quests.description: The key is almost complete! But I need to cut the key blade to precisely match the tumblers in the keyhole. Only problem is, I don't have material soft enough to fit into the keyhole and cast an imprint! Talc is the softest mineral in all of Lore, and should do the trick nicely. Track down the Albino Bats in the mines. They bathe in Talc powder daily (which makes them even more white), so one of the bats should have a Block of Talc at their disposal!

quests.name: Rock Me Amadeus
quests.description: In the deepest, darkest depths of the mines, a Beast known as Amadeus slumbers. Aggressive by nature and chaorrupted by Vath, Amadeus is best left alone. However, he is our only shot at creating a spare key. Find Amadeus, and I will be able to create a new key for you!

quests.name: Quest to Unlock Jouster Class
quests.description: Journey to the Airstorm realm in Etherstorm Wastes. Destroy a Lightning Ball to gather the Energy Orb needed to create your MechaJouster Class!

quests.name: Get Supplies
quests.description: One of the ways I've been enhancing my weaponry is by embedding small shards of chaos crystals into the metal. Help me replenish my supply, and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Oils and Essences
quests.description: I spoke earlier of infusing my weapons and armor with pure chaos. One of the best ways to do this is by collecting Essence of Chaos from the Chaos Sprites, and Oil of Chaos from the Crawling Ooze. These can be mixed into the metal while molten. Bring me some of each, and I'll show you how it's done.

quests.name: Test the Metal
quests.description: Once forged, a weapon must be tested! Go to the /Alliance, and test the weapon's effect on both good and evil soldiers. Then, report back to me with your findings.

quests.name: Eaters of Dreams
quests.description: Dreams, nightmares, it doesn't matter to the devourers. They roam the outskirts of the city looking for passage, but us MindBreakers keep them at bay for if they do get in, it can spell disaster. Interested in helping? You lack our abilities so you won't be able to destroy them outright, but you can still fend them off.

quests.name: Mind-Breaking It In
quests.description: Welcome fellow Mindbreaker, come to this city to hone your skills? Well I have just the task for you. The city outskirts are filled with Deorysa, Subrysa, and Devourax, use your psionic powers to tear them apart. Afterwards, hunt down a Nightwyrm, the last thing we need is one of those burrowing into the city.

quests.name: Biting weapons
quests.description: Me glad you here! Ghaz can't leave forge right now but need some things from around here for this weapon.Pick 5 Blue Trollola Blossoms, whip the beaks 7 Vultures, and beat 7 Rhison until they teeth fall out. No worry, Rhison teeth grow back in a day. Bring me all things!

quests.name: What's That I Hear?
quests.description: You hear someone crying in the bushes. You'd better see who it is and make sure they're ok!

quests.name: Trouble Clef
quests.description: I've always feared this day would come - the day I'd lose my ability to play music! I don't even know what to do! I have to find a way to destroy these awful notes. Maybe then they'll stop ruining my beautiful song!

quests.name: Dravir Defense
quests.description: Dravir keep staging raids to test our defenses. Like they could take us out, right? Maybe the Avatars will help the brainless beast, because I sure won't. Take out 10 to show them we mean business.

quests.name: Gut the Guards
quests.description: Our camp threatens the dragon nests nearby. GOOD! That's the way I like it. But Draconian Guardians have been set to get the eggs and recently-hatched dragonlings to safety. Take out the guards and smash the eggs that they are trying to relocate

quests.name: Permafrost Collection Badge
quests.description: BRRRR! You MUST be cool, if you've unlocked this quest. Hah, get it? A winter pun… or is it more like a winter PUN-derland? *ba dum tish* … Nevermind. You're here for a badge, and a badge you'll unlock. Head to the /northlandlight map and take down Santy Claws to get your gift.

quests.name: Oh Sure, Why Not
quests.description: Before we leave, do you think you could find my… good friend… Emilia? She's the one thing I've truly missed since I've been in here, and I just can't go back home without her. I briefly got away from the Mirror Knights when they were taking me here, and I saw her reflected in a mirror - I remember it being off in its own little alcove. Will you find her? Please?

quests.name: Scout It Out
quests.description: My intelligence leads me to believe my target is within this abandoned structure. We will need to know our surroundings before we continue to chase this bounty. Place these devices in and around the building so I can scan the area.

quests.name: No Bot Unbeaten
quests.description: Scans have revealed this factory is fully operational. Someone must have reactivated these derelict droids to slow our progress. We must decommission some of them before we can dial in on our target.

quests.name: If Memory Serves...
quests.description: Now that we have thinned the opposing forces, we need to focus our efforts on finding which room our target is holed up in. These Scout Droids look like they would not miss anything that happens here. Bring me back some of their memory drives - INTACT - so I may scan them.

quests.name: Target Located
quests.description: Target Located. Obstacle Identified. Our target has locked themself in the control room and I do not have the necessary equipment to breach the blast doors so we will have to do this the old fashioned way. The good news is one of those Bodyguard Droids has the passkey. Dismantle them until you locate it.

quests.name: Bring Them In
quests.description: We have the passkey. It is time we end this and bring this fugitive to justice.

quests.name: Find the Core
quests.description: Your first task is simple - just defeat the Spirits of Ice that are standing in your way. Collect their cores - the center of their power - and they will lend you their strength on your journey.

quests.name: Make a Bridge
quests.description: You're wondering where to go from here, aren't you? The path to the west is blocked, and the east leads to a deep, wide chasm. Collect Eternal Crystals from the Frozen Jellyfish nearby. Then, go to the edge of the frozen waterfall and set one down. See what happens! (Quest works once per login session)

quests.name: Don't Fall
quests.description: Now, you can cross over the chasm by taking the icy path. Be careful not to fall! There's someone on the other side who'd like to speak to you. But be sure to bring an offering with you to demonstrate your good intentions. I'm sure you can find something suitable, if you just look around.

quests.name: Clean Up Clean Up Everybody Do Your Scare
quests.description: Seems you've made quite the mess. Well you'd better go clean it up. I'd help but I'm just a party decoration.

quests.name: Goblin Forest Warrior Quest
quests.description: Darkovia Firest is a dangerous place to live. Dire Wolves carry the pelts we need to trade to buy food for our children. From Blood Maggots we take the Blood, Sweat, and Tears required to process the pelts. And the Legacy Vitae we need… best not ask.

quests.name: Goblin Wolf-rider Quest
quests.description: I stalk the forests of Greenguard East and the Forest of Chaos, too. Marsh Grass, Chaotic Fangs, Chaos Gems, and Wolf Pelts… townspeople pay well for them. The Wolves in Greenguard East and Chaorrupted Wolves in ForestChaos have what we need.

quests.name: Gather the Golden Hours
quests.description: The Timestream Riders in the Arena have stolen the pages of your 2016 calendar! Battle to get all 12 pages back, and you'll be able to choose one of the pieces of gear from the Golden or Chrono Infinity Knight sets!

quests.name: 20th Anniversary Collection Badge
quests.description: What better way to celebrate our in-game birthdayversary than by slaying one of the most iconic monsters in-game?! Slay the Zard in /battleontown to celebrate and unlock an all-new character page badge.

quests.name: Golden DrAEgon Hunt
quests.description: You've discovered the hidden quest for the Golden Dragon Spear! Gather the following for a chance to obtain this rare reward: 3 fire-spore mushrooms from the Dracowerepyre, 5 golden draconian scales from /lair, 3 gold deposits from the Drow in Dwarfhold, 5 golden Koalion down-furs from the /crossroads, and 2 gold ore from the Balboas on the Dwarfhold mountainpath.

quests.name: Pocketed Moonlight
quests.description: Bro Nez and Ty Tanium have begun prospecting again. They'll have the mountain covered for mining materials, but there are many metals and gems out of our reach. I hear you can find Shards of Moonlight in a place called /mooncursedlair. The prospectors shouldn't be going on long trips yet, but getting rarer materials would help us get back on our feet faster. If you catch some moonlight, I'd be happy to trade for it.

quests.name: Tunnel Vision
quests.description: The remnants of Vath's forces are giving Snowbeard and the others in /wardwarf a chance to get their pound of flesh. Pride can give us Dwarves a nasty case of tunnel vision. The remnants' leader, D'wain Jonsen, could catch them off guard if he gets a second wind. If he goes into some sort of Ultra mode, bring Jonsen down, and snap off that scorpion's tail to bring back with you.

items_required.name: Ultra Scorpion Tail x1 (Stacks up to 5)

quests.name: The Empty Mountains Cold
quests.description: Recovering from dealing with Vath and his leftovers put the lot of us in a tight spot. All sorts of monsters and gremlins took this opportunity to steal our gold. The elders and I couldn't risk losing more dwarven lives over shiny stones. The prospectors took note of who stole from us. Toxic Grove Spiders, Tainted Earths, and Doomed Trolls swiped our Gold to fill their empty caverns with. Worse, Sneevil Looters and the Greedy Goregold from /Greed are hoarding the rest. If you bring our home's lifeblood back to us, we'll reward you in kind.

quests.name: Twig's Frostval Collection
quests.description: Fwostval is Twig's FAVWITE HOWIDAY. Fwish and ice cweam and - and - PWESENTS! Bwing me a Fwosted Fwish Ice Cweam Sandwich fwom Frosty in the Ice Cave or Battleground C and Twig will give you a Fwostval Badge!

quests.name: Slayer Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Slay the zombies/minions in Battleontown to save the harvest and drive back the legion.

quests.name: Mega Slayer Medal Turn-in
quests.description: Slay the zombies/minions in Battleontown to save the harvest and drive back the legion.

quests.name: Pumpkin Some Iron
quests.description: Do you want another challenge, hero? I have a powerful staff sitting around collecting dust. We'll see how well you do to see if YOU deserve the staff.

items_required.name: Wretched Rider's Leg x1 (Stacks up to 2)
Famine's Torn Cloak Piece x1 (Stacks up to 2)
Harvest Queen Rematched x1 (Stacks up to 2)

quests.name: United We Stand, Divided We Fowl
quests.description: When BirdsWithHarms stand together, we can accomplish great things - but when there's a bad egg in the bunch, it can ruin everything for everyone. I am hoping the TurKing is not the bird to blame, but we must make baste… erm, haste. You'll need to first get through the onslaught of his guards, though, since their job is to protect TurKing at all costs!

quests.name: Race against the Cluck
quests.description: We haven't much more time left; the Turkonians are getting stronger, the Humans are getting hungrier, and it's almost time for Thanksgiving dinner! We have to hurry and find a way to enter Turking's castle - surely the legendary action hero, SchwarzenEgger, must have been entrusted with the key…

quests.name: Without Feather Ado
quests.description: Hurry, hurry featherless friend! Take that TurKEY, enter Turking's caste, and put an end to whatever's behind these battling BirdsWithHarms before we run out of time AND im-peck-able bird puns!

quests.name: Banditing Together
quests.description: Oh, dear me! It look like the Sky Pirates have banded together with those nasty Badland Bandits to ravage this town! All of the other townspeople are hiding. You've got to control the main Flood of invading sky-scum and their bandit cohorts, dearie, or we're done for!

quests.name: Booty Becomes Barrier
quests.description: You did a good job slowing down those sky pirates and their bandit buddies, duckie, but it'd better to get them all in one place and finish them off. Only them will this town to be able to return to it's former glory. Build barriers of junk at each end of Main Street. The sky Pirates have stolen some loot, too, so be sure to take it back!

quests.name: We Didn't Start The Fire (Oh, Wait...)
quests.description: It's getting hot in here, poppet, and I don't think those lousy lizard-men can stand it. But why no heat things up little more? It might take a little longer, but if you set those barriers on fire, the Bandits will be beaten before you know it! Just… borrow their fire-starting gear. They'll only torch the town with it, and you don't want that, now do you, my little Hero, hmm?

quests.name: Granny's Final Request
quests.description: Go on my little muffin, go on! You're a big, brave Hero. Granny knows you can handle one itsy bitsy Bandit Boss. Take as much time you need, my dear. Granny is not going anywhere until this is all over.

quests.name: The Importance Of Staying Healthy
quests.description: When Twig gets like this, he just needs to get the sugar out of his system. Feed him something healthy to speed that process up. Like kale… and quinoa. You can actually steal some off of the knights and warriors around here. They know the importance of staying healthy.

quests.name: An Aspiring Burgermonger
quests.description: Looks like you're all set. Now just get this stuff back to Yulgar so he can fix my unfortunate counterpart.

quests.name: You'll Poke Your Eye Out
quests.description: These Chaos Sp-Eyes have been here since Escherion arrived — after he was defeated, everyone figured they were safe to ignore. But with an invasion on the way, we can't afford to risk letting any intel leak. Find a big stick, and poke out those Sp-Eyes.

quests.name: Imp-roved Arrows
quests.description: Did you know Fire Imps have venomous claws? Not many people do, since they usually attack with fire. Anyways, if we gather some, we can use them to make venom-tipped arrows. It will give the villagers here an advantage when the war comes.

quests.name: Raiders of the Lost Armory
quests.description: Mobius used to have a vast armory, but it was lost when Escherion inverted the city. It looks like the Cyclops Raiders have managed to find it, based on the weapons they've got. Defeat them, and recover the weapons for the townspeople.

quests.name: Subtle Persuasion
quests.description: We've recovered some of the weapons, but if we can find the location of the armory, Mobius can take control of it again. The Cyclops Warlord must know where it is. See if you can "persuade" him to tell you. With your fists.

quests.name: Mobilize Mobius
quests.description: Now that we have the armory, all that's left to do is arm the citizens of Mobius. Go through the city, and give armor and weapons to everyone you see.

quests.name: Wave After Wave
quests.description: Alteon's Undead Minions are everywhere in Brightfall. We've been doing what we can to defeat them but their numbers are just endless. Can you help my Lightscythe defeat this wave? It will give us a leg up on the next one.

quests.name: Take Out Their Firepower
quests.description: These undead were hastily created and they aren't very sturdy but the undead magi really pack a punch. If you can take out the magi in this wave then it will really cripple their attack.

quests.name: Help Where It is Needed
quests.description: Before you came along the undead left a lot of injured DoomLight High Lords out in the field. They are powerful but not indestructible. Head out there and help the ones you can!

quests.name: Bring A Ward To A Swordfight
quests.description: Fighting these creatures one at a time is getting us nowhere. I have prepared some light wards that will drastically weaken the undead when they pass them. Then it will be like knocking down piles of sticks. Place them in these key locations.

quests.name: Cut Off The Head
quests.description: Reports have just come in that a Painadin Overlord is inside the walls of Brightfall giving direction to the minions. If you can find and defeat him the weaker undead will just fall over!

quests.name: Speak to Dage The Good
quests.description: /join overworld and speak with Dage The Good. King Alteon has recently concentrated his forces there. If Xing and Xang have taken the egg anywhere, they have taken it there!

quests.name: Recover Sepulchure's Cursed Armor! (New)
quests.description: You must travel to the Crypt in Swordhaven where the Knights are guarding my Father's cursed DoomKnight armor. Bring it back to me to earn my trust.

quests.name: Unlife Insurance
quests.description: I found that my father had taken out an Unlife Insurance policy but it does not say for what amount. You have proven your worth by returning my father's armor, now go to the King's Tax Collector to get the gold!

quests.name: Staying Alive
quests.description: Lord Ovthedance has built his house at the top of this killer beehive. I can't get up there but maybe you can.
