He's hooked on Killer Queen honey, but you'll need to clear out some of her Stings before you can get to her. Bring me 8 Tattered Sting Sweaters so I know you can make it to the Queen alive.

quests.name: Killer Queen
quests.description: You did a great job clearing the path to the Killer Queen Bee. Lord Ovthedance built his house at the top of this hive because he LOVES Killer Queen Royal Honey. If you can get a small jar of that for him he might let you close enough to teach him a lesson! Return to me with a Jar of Royal Honey.

quests.name: Satisfaction
quests.description: I sent Lord Ovthedance the jar of Royal Honey as a "peace offering" and told him I would send a delivery of a lot more with a local messenger. He'll never know what hit him. When you take those enchained shoes from him, tell him I said "hi"!

quests.name: Slay the Chaotic Troll
quests.description: Defeat the Chaotic Troll in /bloodtuskwar and grab his Death Rattle. In return, you just may get the Great Daggers of the Horcs.

quests.name: Slay the Prime Dragons
quests.description: Find the Death Scales of all the prime dragons to see if you can get the Mighty Sword of the Dragons. You might be able to… but then again, maybe not!

quests.name: Slay the Sneeviltron
quests.description: If you can defeat the Sneeviltron and bring back to me his badge, I might just give you my cane!

quests.name: The Legion Needs YOU!
quests.description: You're here for the recruitment drive, eh? Well, thanks for the interest, but we're looking for STRONG heroes. Real tough fighters. We're going to be going up against the Queen's army, you know.

quests.name: Show Me More, Legion-Noob
quests.description: You did well, but that first round was just to weed out the weak. A real Legion champion can take on even the toughest Shadowscythe and Nation scum - I mean fighters. Right. We're working together now. Head into the arena and defeat Doombringers and Carnage!

quests.name: For the Legion!
quests.description: We weren't expecting anyone to make it this far, but we set up an arena full of the very best Shadowscythe and Nation volunteers we could find, just in case. Go defeat Doomknight Prime and Draconic Doomknights along with Minotaur of War and Crag and Bamboozle!

quests.name: Dage Likes Your Style
quests.description: You're showing a lot of potential, Prospect - maybe you're even good enough to become Dage's right-hand Hero! Want to show him what you're made of? Then step on into the arena and prove yourself by defeating Thanatos!

quests.name: Legion Recruits: The Dark Path Waits
quests.description: Dage forced Legion Seals and Gems of Mastery to test your worth. Each of the Shadowscythe warriors in this arena carries a Legion Seal, and each Nation Warrior possesses a Gem of Mastery. Your task, if you have the strength to complete it is this: Best them for a chance to recover 25 seals and 1 Gem, then return to me for your reward!

quests.name: Legion Loyalty Rewarded
quests.description: Loyal members of the Legion like you have proven themselves worthy of even greater rewards. Relics of defeated, powerful enemies can be used to create strong magic. Bring me the remains of your defeated foes and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Ode to the Walkers
quests.description: What perfect timing, I'm glad you're here!Of walkers, I don't have no fear -But I can't fight this horde alone, and I'm tryin'To keep Coral (and this weird red thing) from dyin'!

quests.name: Sonnet of the Undead
quests.description: Before you go, a favor, pleaseThese walkers stole our stuff, those mutts!Don't leave me beggin' on my kneesGo get it back and kick their butts!

quests.name: Through the Zombie Portal!
quests.description: Finally, you're done! You have to catch up to Xeven! She went through that portal over there. But please… whatever you see in there… don't be mad at me for keeping it a secret. I swore I'd never tell!

quests.name: Back to Jail With You!
quests.description: What a disaster! Chaos energy from the sewers has seeped into a section of Swordhaven's dungeons and chaorrupted the prisoners there. Some of them have managed to defeat the guards and escape. They need to be taken down. Are you up to the task?

quests.name: We May Need A Militia
quests.description: Swordhaven is no longer safe, and our citizens will need a way to defend themselves. Recover the weapons that the Chaorrupted Prisoners stole from the guards, then distribute them to any peasants you see.

quests.name: An Ounce Of Prevention
quests.description: In response to the dungeon incident, the Sisterhood of the Dishpan Hands is trying to develop an inoculation against chaorruption. The local chaos monsters ooze a sticky liquid that they want to use as a base. Collect some from any chaos monsters in Swordhaven, and bring it back to me.

quests.name: TLaPD 2023 Collection Badge Quest
quests.description: Master says this ship-shaped floating dungeon was the BEST idea he ever had. It is much easier for him to get new challengers to "test" his dungeons if WE go to THEM. He commands you to bring him an Ashray Fisherman. NO ONE HIDES FROM GRIMSKULL. They will learn.

items.name: Grim Sails Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Doom Overlord Challenge
quests.description: Do you have what it takes to take down the Doom Overlord? Countless Heroes have banded together only to succumb to total annihilation. Will you meet the same fate? There is only one way to find out. Gather a team of your strongest friends to take on the Doom Overlord Challenge! Treasures of experience, glory, and gold await the victor!

quests.name: Executive Doom Overlord Challenge
quests.description: Calling all Members! Do you have what it takes to bring down the Doom Overlord? I have witnessed the fall of many great Heroes as they attempted to slain this horrendous monster. You too will meet the same fate if you go in unprepared. Gather a party of your strongest friends and heed the call of the Doom Overlord Challenge! An unfathomable amount of grandeur, gold, glory, and experience await the victor. Come and claim your prize-if you've got what it takes, Member!

quests.name: SO MANY SKULLS
quests.description: Noxus: As if the skulls from our armies weren't enough, now Vordred wants ours! Put a stop to him before we become a fashion accessory!

quests.name: SO MANY SKULLS (Badge Quest)
quests.description: Noxus: As if the skulls from our armies weren't enough, now Vordred wants ours! Put a stop to him before we become a fashion accessory!

items_required.name: Colossal Vordred's Skull x5 (Stacks up to 500)

items.name: SO MANY SKULLS! Character Page Badge

quests.name: Battle Through the Dungeon
quests.description: You've got to rescue that girl crying for help! Defeat all the Grim Fighters in the room to pass.

quests.name: The Way is Blocked
quests.description: You cannot let these creatures prevent you from saving somebody who needs help!

quests.name: Just a FEW More Monsters...
quests.description: The screams are getting louder. You are almost there! Slay all the Grim Soldiers in the room to pass.

quests.name: Grimskull War Medal
quests.description: I'm flattered you want to fight for me. Knock a few skulls off a of Noxus' minions, and I might just have a reward ready for you.

items_required.name: Grimskull War Medal x5 (Stacks up to 500)

quests.name: Mega Grimskull War Medal
quests.description: Hmm… I suppose Noxus' skeletons are pretty tough, but they're no match for mine. Just keep doing what you're doing, and his army will be gone in no time!

items_required.name: Mega Grimskull War Medal x3 (Stacks up to 500)

quests.name: Undead Giants
quests.description: Now THOSE are some big skeletons! But all the more satisfying when they fall… ehehehehehe!

items_required.name: Noxus Giant Slain x5 (Stacks up to 500)

quests.name: It Takes Two to Tango
quests.description: This is an unexpected turn. Only the war bosses remain, but which side will prevail?

quests.name: Find the Path
quests.description: You must reach the war room where the maps are kept! They are our most prized possessions!

quests.name: Scout the Area
quests.description: These woods can be very dangerous to newcomers. I suggest you scout the area to get yourself acquainted. Be careful, the local wildlife is on high alert thanks to the beast. They will most likely lash out at you.

quests.name: Deer?
quests.description: The Zweinichthirsch is known for disguising and manipulating its prey. There are some Deer nearby and any one of them could be the beast. Let's attempt to finish this right here!

quests.name: Comparing Claws
quests.description: These claw marks that cover the area… Could they belong to the beast? We won't know unless we compare it to the local wildlife. Collect Claw and Talon Samples from the Wolves and Owls in the area.

quests.name: Lair Investigated
quests.description: Because this beast isn't local, it must have set up a new lair nearby. Check that cave structure and see if you can confirm.

quests.name: Fight or Flight or Freeze
quests.description: The Wolves and the Owls are getting frantic. The beast must be getting close. Clear them out of the way so they don't interrupt our hunt!

quests.name: Not Deer Hunting
quests.description: It must be close. Hunt down every last Deer in the area until we find it!

quests.name: Monstrous Tracks
quests.description: There! These tracks! Follow them and they will lead us to the beast!

quests.name: Final Blessing
quests.description: If we are going to survive this fight, we must make an offering to the Gods. Collect Deer Hides, Wolf Pelts, and Owl Feathers so that we may receive their blessing.

quests.name: The Zweinichthirsch
quests.description: This thing… It is unlike anything I have ever seen. Even the legends don't do it justice. This thing is true terror. No matter, this thing took my little girl from me. I will put it in the ground.

quests.name: Cries Investigated
quests.description: Those cries! It can't be! Search the forest for their source!

quests.name: Dage's Locked Box
quests.description: Many centuries ago, Dage crafted a very special blade. He was saving it for a special occasion… until it was stolen. We know where it is, and if you want a chance to claim it, you'll need to get the following items: the Box Guardian's locked box, the Green Dragon's Chimeran Pick, and the Cyclops Warlord's Serpent Claw.

quests.name: Scavengers
quests.description: Those small green fellows have been scavenging our platforms for parts. We need those for the post-feast celebration! You can get them back for us, yes?

quests.name: Wired
quests.description: Your feathered bipeds have been taking our wiring and using it for their nests. We must get it back! If even one piece is missing, the feast will be ruined.

quests.name: Turdraken Tremor
quests.description: Our instruments detected that a biologically-improbable creature stole the Fluctuating Appetite Realignment Transducer. We need that to… *cough* make sure the meal is properly appreciated. Find our device inside the 'Mini Turdraken'.

quests.name: Meat and Eggs
quests.description: Oishii tells me the 'Sneevils… are stealing our meat, too. I am small, friend, and can't fight them. But YOU can! She has asked for a few eggs from the 'turkeys', too. You'll handle it, won't you?

quests.name: Golden Shrooms
quests.description: Hi there Traveler! Can I ask you for some help? I came to the Great Guru Forest in search of some wild mushrooms; they say that the Ultimate Elixir can be created with them. I need to collect at least 10 of these magical mushrooms… can you possibly help me find them? You'll be able to identify them easily by their bright golden glow. (Bring back 10 Golden Mushrooms to complete this quest)

quests.name: Blue Feathers
quests.description: I'm sorry to bother you again Traveler, but it seems the mushrooms were only the first step in creating the Ultimate Elixir… I'm going to need some other ingredients as well. The second ingredient I will need is wild Trobble feathers. I believe that 5 of them should be enough; would you be so kind to collect them for me? (Return to her with five Trobble feathers to complete the quest).

quests.name: Flying Tails
quests.description: Wow, you really are something else! The third ingredient I will need is five Leather Wing tails. Be careful when you're fighting the Leather Wings though; I hear they pack a really nasty punch! (Return to her with 5 Leather Wing tails to complete the quest)

quests.name: Mixing Pot
quests.description: Arrrgh! This is preposterous! The cauldron I was planning to mix all these ingredients and brew the Ultimate Elixir has broken! Now I'm going to need a new one before I can continue. Can you see if there is something around here I might be able to use as a replacement cauldron? (Bring back a Cauldron to complete the quest)

quests.name: Recipe Needed
quests.description: Something is wrong with the Ultimate Elixir… it isn't working! I must be missing something, but I was so sure I had all the ingredients. Hmm… I hear a great Potions Master lives in this forest; perhaps he knows the correct recipe! If you can find him for me and obtain that recipe, I can double-check my ingredients to find out what I'm missing! (Return to her with the recipe to complete the quest)

quests.name: Missing Ingredient
quests.description: Excellent, you have returned with the recipe! Just as I thought, I'm missing an ingredient. I still need two petals from the Wisteria to finish the Elixir. Would you be so kind as to retrieve them for me? Be careful if you agree: Those plants actually eat humans! (Bring back 2 petals to complete this quest)

quests.name: Delicious Ingredient
quests.description: Thanks to you, I have finally been able to brew the Ultimate Elixir! But if you still want to give me a hand, I have one more job for you. In my various attempts, I discovered that the spores of the carnivorous Wisteria plant actually make a very tasty soup. If you can bring me back 3 spores, we can celebrate with a victory feast! (Bring back 3 spores to complete this quest)

quests.name: Me Knickers Got a Big Hole Across th' Bum
quests.description: Me clothes got a wee bit torn up when I escaped me sinking ship. Maybe ye can get me some scraps o' fabric from the vampirates on the island? And maybe a thin bone from one o' those fish beasties so's I can sew meself up.

quests.name: Where'd Me Ship's Cargo?
quests.description: Now I'm all sewed up, I can worry about more important things. Like the "cargo" me ship was carryin'! If I can at least recover some of it, maybe this trip be not a total loss. If anythin' washed ashore, ye can bet some vampirate or fishbone carried it off!

quests.name: A Most Important Package
quests.description: Listen… there be another very precious bit of cargo that still be missin'. It be highly important that I find it! Ye be lookin' fer a burlap sack of medium size. The bad news is, I be seein' a lot of burlap on this island, so anyone or anythin' could have it. Vampirates, Fishbones… maybe even a Shelleton!

quests.name: Comfort Food
quests.description: Oh no - it wasn't there! Oh, what a dark day this be! I need somethin' to calm me nerves. Like… turtle stew, perhaps? Those shelletons out on th' beach might have some passable meat, and some fish oil from the Fishwings be helpin' it go down easy.

quests.name: Full o' Holes
quests.description: Now that I be calmed down, I be feelin' some rage for that kraken! But when me boat came ashore, it landed on a rocky spot, and now it be full o' holes. That will have to be fixed before we can do any kraken-huntin'! Find me a few good shell chunks from the Shelletons on the beach, and we can use them to patch me boat.

quests.name: Keelhaulin' a Kraken!
quests.description: Me boat be fixed and I be ready to take my revenge on that bilge rat of a kraken! Are ye with me, Hero?

quests.name: Pet Shop and Drops
quests.description: Do you know how hard it is running a pet store? Want to find out? All my critters require constant attention, housing, food, and * shudder * clean up! I could really use your help getting:

quests.name: Sparring Practice
quests.description: Our Nethermagi are getting plenty of theoretical practice, but they've not had much in the way of combat practice lately. Spar with them - this will help them keep their skills honed, and may also help you develop your own.

quests.name: Fill the Vials
quests.description: With all of the wild magic being performed here, often some bits of mana will go astray. We can collect that energy and use it to power new magic. Or, more to the point, *you* can. Fill these 8 vials with Mystic Energy collected from Stray Mana in the area, and I will reward you.

quests.name: Gather Crystals
quests.description: On occasion, our Scryers will need to replace the Orbs we use, as their power is depleted through use. Inside Balax'el's Fortress, you will find a room in which large chunks of Arcane Crystal are kept. Carve away at the crystals with your weapon until you find one which yields a perfect Orb. Then, bring it back to me.

quests.name: Housing Hachiko
quests.description: As you start to pet Hachiko, Ai No Miko walks over and says, "I appreciate you taking the time to greet Hachiko, but I think it's time that he finds a home. He might enjoy staying with you, but he likely doesn't trust you yet. Maybe if you give him some food and play with him, he'll trust you more?"

quests.name: Mission1
quests.description: Incoming message from planet Tipulidae: Bzzz…Urgent need of help! Lizard man creating chaos! Eating soliders. Sugar reserves down! Last seen wearing armor, may have club. Find him and return proof. We pay! Bzzzz.

quests.name: Mission2
quests.description: Telegraph from the people of Xenophobiac: Help us! We've been invaded! Aliens! We've seen aliens! Little green men riding giant metal robots! Help us please! Find the aliens and get rid of them! In the meantime we'll be wrapping our cows in tin foil, heard that keeps the implants out.

quests.name: That Is The Way
quests.description: If we are going to stop this evil Fifth Lord, we are going to have to fight our way through those Tempest Soldiers. Their guns might scare you but don't worry, their aim is notoriously terrible.

quests.name: Murder Moon Plans
quests.description: Even if we defeat Fifth Lord Sepulchure, we can't leave the Murder Moon up and running. One of these Tempest Soldiers has to know how this place runs. Find the Plans for the Murder Moon and find a way to shut it down for good!

quests.name: Revenge of the Fifth
quests.description: It's time to take on Fifth Lord Sepulchure. Be careful, he is strong with the Fourth, has cybernetic upgrades, and that weapon of his has cut down countless good people. There is a good reason he is feared throughout the galaxy.

quests.name: Grocery Run
quests.description: Serenity taught me how to manage a vegetable garden, but I'm not at a level where I can keep a whole temple self-sufficient. Would you mind doing a secret grocery run? Head to /ravinetemple and take down a couple of Lemurphants and Jungle Tigriffs. I made a deal with the trolls and the orcs to clean their temple in exchange for them giving food and supplies to ours.

quests.name: Hans the Builder
quests.description: Back in Battleon, Yulgar taught me how to fix furniture. After getting the basics down, I graduated to making chairs, tables and bed frames. With so many people living here, we're going to need a lot of new furniture. Granted, I can't order supplies because our location's supposed to be a secret. Would you mind heading to /beachparty to chop down a few Palm Treeants? That should be out of the way enough.

quests.name: A Single Rib
quests.description: I have a true challenge for you, minion. Bring me a Dark Unicorn Rib from the beastly monster unicorn known as Binky. In return I will reward you with Legion Tokens. I might possibly offer you an even more rare reward if I find your performance pleasing.

quests.name: Chaorrupted Dark Fire
quests.description: The Ultra Chaos Warrior is a very interesting creature. Its head is wreathed in Dark Fire that has been chaorrupted. I might have a use for this material. Fetch me 20 Dark Fire Samples and I will reward you with 100 of my Legion Tokens.

quests.name: The Tools and the Talent
quests.description: There is a LOT of rubble blocking the path to the old market. I'd clean it up but all the Drow and Draconians took our tools from us. If you go and recover some Digging Tools then I will start clearing the entrance.

quests.name: The Shining
quests.description: I've decided that I'm not just going to clean out the entrance but I'm going to update it too. I'm thinking a golden entry way. I'll need something to polish the gold. Gather some Bile Ducts from the Albino Bats and Glow Worms so I can make the gold polish. I'll keep working on the door.

quests.name: Your Ad Here
quests.description: Ok, I'm nearly done. Go plant these 12 signs around Dwarfhold to tell the dwarves that the market will be opening again today. The Drow can't usually ready old Dwarvish so we'll be safe. By the time you're done I'll have the new entry cleaned up. Head into the market and talk to Domi.

quests.name: Shrine of Love
quests.description: This copy of the Mikoto Shrine wasn't in the Yokai Realm when we first arrived. I think this place might be reacting to Ai No Miko's presence. See those two shades? They're her mom and dad- Empress Yuhuan and Emperor Daisho back when they were alive. Why don't you listen in on them for a bit?

quests.name: Hoshi no Tama
quests.description: Yue's nearby to guide you to the next section of the Yokai Realm we scouted. There are Kitsune Spirits roaming in her area. Careful - they're smarter than the Oni. Ward them off to keep them from possessing us.

quests.name: Defeat O-Dokuro's Head
quests.description: You may have defeated O-dokuro on the roof, but his head fell onto the top of this pile of bones… and it's still ALIVE (or undead?). Battle your way through the Yokai that are flooding through the rift and TAKE HIM OUT! Until the head is inanimate, we CANNOT pass to confront Kitsune!

quests.name: Hung Jury
quests.description: Okay, they're not actually jurors, but they stand in your way nonetheless. Defeat them if you want access to the Judge's chamber.

items_required.name: Judge's Minion Judged x12 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Contempt of Court
quests.description: To defy the Judge is to defy your judgement. If you aren't guilty, prove your innocence in a trial by combat.

quests.name: Drakath, Champion of Chaos
quests.description: Can you defeat Drakath at his full strength, without the use of your powers?

quests.name: Rescue the Quoklets
quests.description: All the tiny baby quoklets! They've been stolen - by the trees! But YOU'LL get them back. You'll chop them ALL down.

quests.name: Kill the Firestorm Tigers
quests.description: The Firestorm Tigers are very important to the Onslaught. They provide us with transportation, help us in battle, and can even be used as cavalry. Defeat the Tigers; Armored, regular and Cavalry to obtain pieces of armor that we can reforge into new items for you!

quests.name: Slay the Blazebinders
quests.description: Try and prove your worth to the Firestorm Onslaught and the caste of Blazebinders by finding and defeating the Blazebinder within the Forge. You will have to win at least 5 times to prove your worth.

quests.name: Take out the Firestorm Knights
quests.description: The Knights of the Onslaught are tough, disciplined and difficult to defeat. If you think you are tough enough, go ahead and defeat the Knights 10 times.

quests.name: The First Task
quests.description: I walked through an endless, Time(less) Void… and when I stared into the face of Unending eternity itself… I could not look away.

quests.name: The Second Task
quests.description: As Twilight fell, the hairs on the back of my neck stood on Edge. All I could see was Chaos, woven webs, Warriors. And terror.

quests.name: The Third Task
quests.description: It was a swampy place in Arcangrove. The Mud stank, and I felt my Luk run out right before I sank into the muck. A frog-like creature passing by saved my life from a striped beast about to snack on me.

quests.name: The Fourth Task
quests.description: Only a true hero can meet Death, wander through his Realm, and live to tell the tale. It was a true test of my strength and skill, leaving that dark land.

quests.name: The Fifth Task
quests.description: I stared into a deep abyss, into the heart of darkness. I never knew The endless Void could be so intimidating. Or so… purple. And the creatures… do not get me started on the GIGANTIC EYELESS ALIEN BOSSES. O_O

quests.name: The Sixth Task
quests.description: Where does a hero go when they've lost all hope, are turned away from every door? When they're Banished from all they know? Look around you. I found the place, and made it my home. But I am not alone…

quests.name: Recover and Recycle
quests.description: Glad you decided to give me a hand! To start off, we'll need to get an adhesive to prepare for what's to come. Fortunately for us (and by us I mean you), the resin from those filth puddles will do perfectly! Think you could grab a few samples?

quests.name: Tormented Fang Uncleansed Grove
quests.description: While I prep the resin, you can take a nice trip to the wilderness known as the /deepforest! It's not that nice you say? Worry not, it'll be a relaxing time for sure! When you get there, grab some branches off a special tree for me, you'll know which one it is when you see it.

quests.name: Slice of Life
quests.description: Everything's been going well in grabbing the materials we need so far, but this next one will be a bit more difficult. You're going to be racing with roaches! Sort of gross, I know, but you'll need to take a knife from their table for me.

quests.name: Null and Void
quests.description: The Dark Djinn, a powerful magi from /thevoid, has just what we need - the Spirit Fire enchantment. This is the last thing in order to create our main goal, a sacred knife. Challenge the conjuror and obtain the charm.

quests.name: Summoning and Sealing
quests.description: I've heard from my attendant that you've faced this creature's sibling before, the Eldritch Abomination. That thing was formidable, all right, but the Amalgamation you're about to face is much stronger. Be careful out there!

quests.name: Blood for Darkblood
quests.description: If you wish to gain reputation with the Darkblood and Thunderforge then I can help you… if you help me. I cannot be out in the streets destroying our foes like I wish. Take my place. Destroy 3 type of each invader and I will spread word of your deeds.

quests.name: The Missing Vault
quests.description: To find the Title we must first find my family vault. My grandfather's journal tells where it was but that was before Escherion distorted everything. Scout the area and get the lay of Cornelis.

quests.name: The Shattered Lens
quests.description: If we want to find the hidden vault, we'll have to repair the shattered Lens of Cornelis. then the vault's location will be plain as day. The Len's shattered remains should be scattered around Cornelis. Find all of them and bring them to me.

quests.name: The Frame Up
quests.description: The Lens of Cornelis won't function without its frame, which is also in pieces. Anise tells me that the Gargoyles have been seen carrying parts of the frame. Destroy the Gargoyles until you've found all 5 parts of the frame.

quests.name: The Lenscrafter
quests.description: Now that you've found all of the pieces, it needs to be reassembled and very few people on Lore have the crafting knowledge and magic ability to do that. You'll need to take them to Cysero in Yulgar's Inn in the town of Battleon. Return to me once you have the completed Lens.

quests.name: The Hidden Vault
quests.description: Now that we have the Lens of Cornelis, finding the vault should be simple enough. Explore the ruins once more - find a golden door with my family seal on it. That is the vault. Enter it and come back to tell me what you find!

quests.name: The Guardian
quests.description: I have no doubt that you will need to defeat the Gargantugoyle before you can enter enter the inner sanctum of the vault and find the Title. Let me know when the Gargantugoyle has been destroyed.

quests.name: The Family Jewels
quests.description: Only one task remains. To enter the Inner Sanctum of the vault you will need to solve a puzzle. CLICK ON THE DOOR to try the puzzle. Solve it, enter the inner sanctum and bring me the Title, then the rest of the treasures is yours!

quests.name: Evil Free for All
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Bring him 8 frost hearts and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Legion Free for All
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Bring him 10 frost hearts and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Dage's Winter is Coming
quests.description: The day will come when Dage rules all… will you help that day come sooner? Hurry it along by bringing 6 Spirits of Good Will from the Lycan Knights or War Lycan Knights, 6 Spirits of Love from the Silver Knights, and 6 Spirits of Loyalty from King Alteon's Knights.

quests.name: Feed the Yeti
quests.description: GRAWR! Me hungry, want meat. WOLF MEAT! Bring me haunch of Ice Wolf from Frozen Tower and maybe me give you a shiny treasure.

quests.name: Hollowborn Evoker Badge
quests.description: It is darkest just before the dawn. Call forth the light… if you dare. Defeat a dark imp in the dreamforest to complete the quest for an exclusive character page badge.

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.

items_required.name: Nothing To See x10 (Stacks up to 50)
Area Secured and Quiet x10 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Hollowborn Mansion
quests.description: Want to live in the shadows? Kill the Hollowborn Shadow Raptor Rider to get the key to your new house.

location.name: God of the Depths Bonus Zone

quests.name: Frenzy Feast
quests.description: A manifestation of the new God of the Depths has appeared on sacred ground. This is where Kathool was reborn, and it is where your will to survive will be tested. Dive into the coldest and darkest corner of the sea floor, and ready your hands and teeth. Triumph over Kathool's challenge and enjoy the feast. If you bring back a morsel, I would be willing to share Adeptus relics of great interest.

quests.name: Hear the Clatter
quests.description: The master's progeny has opened a bunch of doors downstairs and let a clatter of skeletal minions loose. Kill them, please. The Master will reanimate them at his convenience.

quests.name: Tidy Up
quests.description: Such a mischievous girl. She's been taking the skeletons apart! Clean up all the spare parts, won't you? We don't want anyone to trip over them.

quests.name: Snackies
quests.description: Little Gravelyn must be hungry — she's gotten into the pantry and. Well. She's done something to the pablum. You're going to have quite a mess to clean up.

quests.name: Find the Progeny
quests.description: New nanny! I have found the master's spawn. She is in the kitchen, and… oh, it's bad.

quests.name: Houston, We Have A Pablum
quests.description: Giant pablum monster! Fight it!

quests.name: Rattle the Bones
quests.description: Kill the Rattlebones! We can't risk them hurting the master's progeny. You'll need to property dismantle them, get their bony little hearts out, so they can't come back to unlife until the master wants them to.

quests.name: Boost Time
quests.description: There's no sign of Gravelyn anywhere! Unless you want this to be your last day on the job, we must find her soon. I can expand my range and try to detect her whereabouts, but I'll need a little boost. In the form of Doom Energy. Gather some for me from any of the undead monsters around here.

quests.name: Conduction Function
quests.description: Alright. Next I'll need you to help me set up some conducting rods. I'm just a skull — can't do it myself. First, get some nice long femurs from the Skeletal Minions inside. Then, set them up around the perimeter. My range will expand to anywhere there's a "rod".

quests.name: Gross
quests.description: Our girl has somehow set a bunch of flesh golems loose, and they've ransacked the necromancers' supply cabinet. You'll have to get everything back before they start raising heck with her father. Also, please kill the flesh golems.

quests.name: Time to Clean
quests.description: Now, clean up the rest of the tower while I try to determine where she's gone. This place is a disaster..

quests.name: Find the Progeny (Again)
quests.description: It appears the master's progeny has locked herself in the top of the tower. You'd better get up there quickly. And take me with you! Wherever the child is, I must be there, too!

quests.name: Gleeble the Garble!
quests.description: Wow, New Nanny. You've really stepped in it, haven't you? There may still be time to salvage your career, but you're going to have to put an end to that monstrosity. Right. Now.

quests.name: One Final Task
quests.description: The master's little princess is VERY good at getting the things she wants. And then hiding them so no new nannies can take them away. Unfortunately, she's gained access to the master's treasure room, and "shared" several of his pieces with the minions. Talk to the Skeletal Minions and Flesh Golems to find out where she's hidden them, and l'll let you keep something as a prize.

quests.name: Till the Ground
quests.description: The garden out back has gone to slush. The soil needs to be tilled. It's so frozen now that nothing can come through. You'll have to fight your way through the monsters that have appeared in the garden.

quests.name: Beautiful Blossoms
quests.description: Now that the garden has been tilled, we can't leave it empty. Gather some asphodel flowers for me. Did you know that their roots can feed the dead? That's what I've been told. That's why the Chillybones sometimes carry them.

quests.name: Moldy Trees
quests.description: Bring me some grave mold. It grows on the Frozen Treeants that wander the mountains. Not for the garden, but for an elixir. An elixir that will make the pain of my loss less acute.

quests.name: Ichor for Elixir
quests.description: This elixir is complex. It will take more than just the grave mold to complete it. Frozen Ichor is what I need… the lifeblood that animates the icy monsters nearby. Anything with a heart will have it flowing through its veins.

quests.name: Frozen Tears
quests.description: There is one more thing I'll need before I can begin to heal my pain: the Tears of the Dead. They are formed like icy crystals when the Chillybones cry. Bring me some.

quests.name: Keep them Away
quests.description: Please, while I am brewing this elixir, would you chase these monsters away from our house? It would upset my wife so much to see them haunting it like this. Our home should be as peaceful as she was.

quests.name: Light up the Darkness
quests.description: My wife always liked to keep the house well lit. A beacon to carry us home, she said. Gather some rimecoals from the Frozen Wisps so I can light a fire and give her a beacon.

quests.name: Return to Blizzy
quests.description: That's everything I need. You can go now, hero. Please… go back to your moglin friends and leave me to my grief.

quests.name: Something Smells Rotten in EtherStorm
quests.description: The rising fumes of sulfur leaking from the newly opened volcano vents are clouding our air. But the imps which live near the vents contain cores which we can use to construct a suit which is vital if you're going to enter the heart of the volcano where my altar lies. Kill Sulfur Imps for 8 sulfur cores and an Enchanted Lava Bucket.

quests.name: Play With Fire
quests.description: Your suit of flame must be alive if it is to keep YOU alive. The heart of the volcano, while it was dormant, could still see into a Priest's soul, and WE have mental barriers. For a human, and with the volcano awakened by Zellare's death… you will need at least, hmm, yes, 9 Flame Essences from Living Fires.

quests.name: Set Me On Fire
quests.description: The Essences of Flame you gathered were not suitable for the final coat. For THAT, we will need lava, but you'll need to gather it outside the volcano. You have the Enchanted Lava Bucket, yes? Good. You will gather 8 Bucketfuls of Lava, and I will construct your suit.

quests.name: Walk Through Fire
quests.description: If you are to walk the path of a Hero, you must journey this next distance alone. One must approach the heart of the volcano with peace in their mind and heart. Find my altar so that I know the volcano accepts you.

quests.name: Everything's On Fire
quests.description: It may be that you will need to recruit help from more than the other two I have called here. Should that be the case, gather 10 Sacred Flame Seeds. We will plant them in the hearts of your cohorts and kindle the flames of battlefire inside them. Go now!

quests.name: Baby's On Fire
quests.description: I did not think it would come to this.But it appears the enraged dragons which live in our realm have turned on their own. And worse, they threaten the next generation. You must save the young dragons, but they will not go willingly. Be gentle as you bring the 10 of this clutch to me, or I will deal harshly with you.

quests.name: Fire In My Heart
quests.description: One of the strongest of our dragon denizens, a brave warrior and clever wielder of the magics, has been particularly susceptible to Desoloth's plan. You must subdue but NOT kill Ssikari, one of our most promising dragons. You will find him inside the volcano.

quests.name: Wolves For Hire
quests.description: Every time we build one of our study and economical homes for a client, the Big Bad Boar hasto tear it downhis slimes come and demolish it. He's been running the hut industry in this forest for years and his cheap, shoddy huts are worthless! Well, if he wants to play hardball he better bring his A-game!Bring us his Contracts and we'll make it worth your while!Beat up the slimes he hired, and bring me their contracts!

quests.name: Blue Green Prints
quests.description: The Big Bad Boar is at it again.He'sHis Frogzards have stolen the blueprints to our newest economy homes. We can't really blame him, If we were talentless hacks like he is we might do the same thing. It's no way to run a business. We really need those blueprints backfrom that filthy pig, would you get them for us?- could you go beat up those hired Frogzards and get them back?

quests.name: Brick Head
quests.description: Oh, thank goodness. We really need your help. The Big Bad Boar has ambushed our latest shipment of bricks.- and time he's done it HIMSELF! It's not our fault that he's too cheap to pay for quality materials but he doesn't need to take ours! We paid for those bricks fair and square and would like them back.

quests.name: Building Supplies
quests.description: To build your house, we're going to need a lot of material. Bring me wooden planks from the Treeant in farm, glue from the Rhison in Bloodtusk, and metal nails from the Protosartrorium in the Crash Site.

quests.name: Cover Your Bases
quests.description: To build your house, we're going to need a strong foundation, and a lot of heat. Bring me river stones from the Zardmen Fishers in River, boulders from Balboa in the Mountainpath, marble from the Earth Elemental in Gilead, and flames from the Fire Elemental in Gilead.

quests.name: Decor
quests.description: Every hero needs a well-decorated home. We won't provide trophies or pictures of your smiling face, but we can take care of the basics. Bring me fabric from the Scarecrow in Farm, paint from the Can of paint in Goose, and glass from the Windows in the Underground Lab.

quests.name: Lascivia Stunk Pretty
quests.description: Hwuargh still miss Lascivia. Sadface. Maybe you can help him feel better? Some gold vases still have Lascivia's smell-good in them. Find some, and bring back to Hwuargh? Being a vase, too, so he have something to keep in.

quests.name: You Broke It, You Fix It
quests.description: Fleshy monkey messed up Hwuargh's armor, when fought him earlier. Help Hwuargh fix it now. Bring him leather scraps from other guards and admirers. They jerks, anyway. Hwuargh use it to patch up holes and tears you made.

quests.name: Elite Energy
quests.description: Hwuargh tell you secret now: Killek cage hidden behind big boulder. Will need a lot of strength to move it - even more than Hwuargh has. Bring Killek Boom Shroom - they grow all over the cave, and they make you more powerful. Also bring some Special Energy Drinks. Only Elite Guards were allowed to have them, but now Hwuargh can, too!

quests.name: No Pillow Unturned
quests.description: Now all we need is key to Killek's cage. Hwuargh know it kept under one of the pillows Lascivia lay on. That way, no one else could get to it unless Lascivia say so! She gone now, though, so if we find it, we can take it. Check all the pillows in her lair until you find key. Once you have it, go to big boulder in front of the doornear (whatever J puts it by), wait for Hwuargh.

quests.name: Elemental Orb Awareness
quests.description: One of the most vital tasks your OtherSelf, from the DragonFable time, needed to accomplish, was to gather all 8 Elemental Orbs. They had to travel far and fight many enemies to do so. All I ask is that you find them in your travels through the dungeon.

quests.name: Fight Chaos with Fire!
quests.description: Sometimes one must fight fire with fire… and others you fight Chaos with fire! I believe I can burn the Chaorruption out of my veins, but I will need the flames from 8 Fire Elementals and Shards from 4 Chaos Gemeralds to create the potion. Slay them an bring them to me!

quests.name: Save Aria
quests.description: Aria was one of the sweetest children, and her golem mirrored that. I created that and her pet, but Chaos freed her from my control, and now she is gone. Interrogate 6 Fire elementals and 5 slimes to see where she has gone. If we are lucky, you may find a clue to her location.

quests.name: Find the Time to Travel
quests.description: If you're going to discover the truths about life, the universe, and everything related to timetravel and your destiny, you're going to need more information. Cysero's workshop makes creatures… smarter. Gather clues about Life and the Universe, Everything, AND get your Towel.

quests.name: Dragon Egg... or Junk?
quests.description: Sneevils stole the box your OtherSelf's Dragon Egg was hidden in. To learn the persistence and purity of heart one needs to find their destiny, search through the garbage in their junkyard, as they did. Use the doors to find the right path to reach the monsters, then slay the vultragons until you find the egg!

quests.name: Dracolich Fortress Detected
quests.description: Do not let the Sp-Eyes placed around the Flying Dracolich Fortress see you. Even if Sepulchure is not here, dire things await you if you are spotted. Kill 4 Sp-Eyes to prevent your detection.

quests.name: Bone up on the Boss
quests.description: I cannot show you what it is you face in the final test for this lesson, but I believe you will learn the skills you need by slaying 8 of the skeletons in the fortress.

quests.name: Defend the Town!
quests.description: When your home comes under fire, whether from an insane pyromancer or an undead invasion, a Hero must defend those who look to them for protection. Save Falconreach from 6 Lava Golems and 3 Fire Elementals!

quests.name: ChickenCows, Bacon, and Battle!
quests.description: Bacon… the Void… Element X… however your OtherSelf called it, the element had powers the more mundane one did not. You cannot recreate the journey your OtherSelf in DragonFable took, but you CAN experience what it is like to work with Zeuster. Slay Horcboars for Protein to keep up your strength, and get the 8 spell runes from Chaotic Chickens.

quests.name: The 2nd Proto-Chaos Beast
quests.description: Take on one of the DragonFable Hero's most memorable challenges. Face Fluffy, Sepulchure's Dracolich. The beast would have been great, IF it had been allowed to follow its own path!

quests.name: All-Seeing Argus
quests.description: I won't be able to catch up on lost history efficiently while I'm…distracted by a grudge. When I was an inmate in the Phlegethon's Prison, one of the jailers treated me particularly cruelly. Bring me the eye of Argus Panoptes to make up for my pain and suffering. You'll find him through the door to the fiery river of blood.

quests.name: Sparring with Chaos
quests.description: To stay well-practiced, all members of Drakath's militia spar against each other regularly. You should do this too, if you want to join us. Make your way up to the training room, and fight against any combatants you find. If you're not sure where the training room is, well… figuring that out is part of your challenge

quests.name: Expect the Inquisitors
quests.description: Now, more than ever, the forces of order outnumber the Chaos to a vast degree. One of our missions, then, is to cut down their numbers and allow Chaos to thrive. Go to the /Citadel. There, you will find members of a magic-loathing Inquisition. Defeat 10 of their Guards, and then return to me. Bring me their tabards as proof.

quests.name: A Bounty on Evil
quests.description: Evil, too, is the enemy of Chaos - it is just as much a force of Order as Good is. Travel to /Doomwood and defeat 10 Doomwood Soldiers. Return to me when you have finished, and bring me their tabards as proof. I will pay you a bounty for each one.

quests.name: Impress the Militia
quests.description: There's a clan of dragons near the Lair Crossroads that are some of the most dangerous in all of Lore, the Razorclaws. For your training, I'd like for you to try to slay one. Bring me its horn as proof of your victory.

items_required.name: Dire Razorclaw's Horn x1 (Stacks up to 10)

quests.name: Gather Snowman Pieces
quests.description: Ok, so first we're going to build a snowman. We'll need a bunch of tightly packed snow - get some from the Snow Golems off to the right. Get a couple of nice, big branches for the arms, too. (Available once per login session)

quests.name: Gather Snowman Decorations
quests.description: Ok, now we'll need some things to decorate the snowman with. I'm thinking coal - there are some coal imps nearby, so that's an easy one. And also a carrot, for the nose. Maybe you'll find something in the village? (Available once per login session)

quests.name: Grab some Garb
quests.description: And now we just need to dress you like a kid. All the kids are gone, so you can't borrow THEIR clothes. But you know… those Frost Goblin outfits have just the right look…

quests.name: Bait and Gifts
quests.description: Ready to be bait? Blizzy has built your snowman - err, well, really it's more of a snowmoglin - just up the hill to the right. Just get your disguise on, and go sit by it and wait.

quests.name: Check out the Cave
quests.description: What's in the cave? Could it be the lost kids? You'd better go in and find out! But stay on your toes - he probably hasn't left them unguarded!

quests.name: Endless Winter Collection Quest
quests.description: Icicle Imps and Ice Ki'lks have been feuding for millennia. Bring the Icy Heart of one of those frostbitten glacier suckers and I'll give you a cool new character page badge.

Icy Treasure Chest and Quest's Quest.name: Icy Treasure Chest and Quest's Quest

quests.name: Ice Treasure Chest Quest
quests.description: To open this chest, you must find the Ice Chest key. Defeat a Frostspawn Fangbeast for a chance to get the key.

quests.name: Impress the Arachnomancer
quests.description: …Hey! You want to be an Arachnomancer, Legendary Hero? Bring methat8 Weaver Medallions from a Chaos Weaver Mage, Dreadspider, and DreadArysa,and I'll see to it that Ravenloss hears of your bravery! Why? Cause I like ya!

quests.name: Too Hot To Handle
quests.description: Dragon's armor can't be forged normally, it must use metals that can withstand extreme heat. That, of course, means it has to be forged in even more extreme heat. Living Magma comes close, but it only gets hot enough if we use imp embers as a catalyst. You can get Living Magma from the Living Fire in Firestorm. You'll find imp embers there too, as they are produced by sulfur imps.

quests.name: Too Cold To Hold
quests.description: Of course, not just anything can withstand the extreme temperatures that we use to forge our armor. Elemental Stone does not burn at any temperature, which makes it ideal for creating the cauldrons and casting molds we use. If you'd like to help me collect some, you can find Earth Elementals in Earthstorm and in the Dragonplane.

Immortal Lich King Quest Pet's Quest.name: Immortal Lich King Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Immortal Lich King Collection Badge
quests.description: Legion Paladins have long refused to bow down to me. The arrogance will NOT be tolerated. Venture into the Legion Arena and bring me the dry, shriveled bones of a Dark Legion. Now.

Immortal Sacrificial Skull Quest Pet's Q.name: Immortal Sacrificial Skull Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Immortal Sacrificial Skull's Gift
quests.description: Nothing is wasted in the underworld. Flesh feeds beasts. Spirits feed Dage's Forge. Go. Slay one of the Dark Makai in the /Dagerecruit zone. Its life force will enrich the realm.

quests.name: warm MILK!
quests.description: Hey, ya know what always worked for me as a kid? Warm milk did the trick, I'm pretty sure that there are some…some… oh, you know…some jimmyjohns….those, uh.. COWS… over at the Farm. If you look around the farm you should be able to find it. Milk I mean… not cows. Look for four Milk Bottles. If you bring me some maybe I can get to sleep.

quests.name: COLD MEDICINE!
quests.description: COLD MEDICINE! Sorry, that was loud, wasn't it? Cold medicine usually has something that knocks me right out. I know I should wait until I have a…ya know… a cold, but I really need to get some rest. I heard that those guys… sorry, those uh… RiverFishermenFishmen by the…uh… the river, they captured a crate of the stuff not too long ago. Could you get me some, please?

quests.name: Cup of Tea, please!
quests.description: I know what would help. A nice hot tup of key… er… I mean cup of tea. I've heard that the Kittairansof Noobshireover to the west carry on them a very strong tea. It's so relaxing, tea, don't you think? I think so. See if you can get me a pouch of tea, would you?

quests.name: Music Box for the Sleepless
quests.description: Ok, ok ok, check it out. ok So, like…..what was I going to say? OH, right. I've heard that some people fall asleep to music.I know that the Dwakels in the Willow Creek caves sometimes carry… um… music boxes on them.I used to have a music box that played my favorite lullaby, but a green slime came along and ATE it! I'm be ever so grateful if you could findoneit for me.

quests.name: Qualifying Quest
quests.description: Time to see if you are ready to be a Spellword Artifact Hunter! Find me this super specific rock… From a being made of rock!

quests.name: Rest for the Not Very Wicked
quests.description: To start off this hunt, go talk to the woman of dreams! She has a necklace artifact that puts the wearer to sleep! However, it'd be rude to just take it from her! Make her a Necklace of Awakeness with some materials near her! I heard that if you take a turtle shell and put some coffee beans from a bear it, it makes an Orb of Awakeness! Then all you need is a few pieces of string from some trolls and you'll be able to make the Orb for her!

quests.name: Pisces Pieces
quests.description: Not all Artifacts are in one piece! Like this Shield from a big river fish! Gather all of the pieces for me.

quests.name: Be Ebil
quests.description: Weird. This artifact hilt says something about "beat" and "ebil" and "dropping" and "limbs"? Also something about a "Secret G-Rave Key"? Not sure what any of this means!

quests.name: Eternal, Never-Ending Darkness and Death Lance
quests.description: Something tells me that a true lord of the shadows would be hiding this weapon, that's just a really specific guess.

quests.name: It Takes a Special Brand of Glory
quests.description: Huh, I just got a report about a sword from another timeline called "the Brand of Glory"! I heard that a Chaotic version of the undead dragon it is made from *that* timeline is has it here in *this* timeline!

quests.name: 1st Trial
quests.description: I have a friend, well more of a person I know and they tolerate me, anyway, he's always stumbling, and I mean *literally* stumbling on these artifacts. I call him Lucky David!

quests.name: 2nd Trial
quests.description: I heard of this wyvern that lives on the new continent and it's said to hold a special artifact. Try fighting it a bunch of times and see the rumors are true.

quests.name: 3rd Trial
quests.description: Sometimes to get an artifact, it's going to cost you a bit of gold for tips, buying it off someone, or for transportation. I know this one girl who would happily take all your money. Also, remember the word: sirbuh.

quests.name: 4th Trial
quests.description: There is a dragon that I'm very fond of. Really awesome looking! Anyway, I heard from his friend Stalagbite that if you give him a good sparring match, he'll give you a shard of an artifact! But I'm just warning you, he can be really sharp sometimes!

quests.name: Fortitude
quests.description: Hero, I made a weird ciphered text for you to figure out as your test for Fortitude! Good luck!

quests.name: Dual Wielding
quests.description: Congrats! You have forged replicas of Fortitude and Hubris! While separated, they are exTremely powerful weapons. However, their trUe power unleashed when they aRe wielded together! This fInal task will allow you to make seNse of an eniGma that has existed on Lore for millenia. This will allow you to control both of their powers at once! C'est magnifique!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Death, Taxes, and Tentacles
quests.description: Across every possibility and dream, what is constant? What remains the same no matter how much we struggle? Part of my studies was to peer through the windows of our observatory and ponder this question. But there are countless windows, and I am only mortal. To this end, will you please bring me pieces of the Death you know from /underrealm and the Kathool you know from /deepchaos?

quests.name: Guiding Transience
quests.description: Your young world, as well as its many parallels, follow the grooves and ruts of the timelines that came before. That means, many of the same events happen over and over. That too, I have observed and contemplated. But in your young world, there are sights never before seen. Will you please bring me pieces of the Manticore from /venomvaults and pieces of the Elemental Attempts in /worldscore?

quests.name: Infinity Titan's Rewards
quests.description: Your charge is to protect the universe. No matter what it costs. You can control space and time — and reality - with a snap of your fingers. That much power requires energy. Gather more from the Spacetime Energy in /timestream to regain your energy and get even more rewards.

quests.name: Sweet Dreamlands are Made Like This
quests.description: I do not like this Dream we are in, Hero. This maze of your mind. It feels… deadly. We need to get to the Command Post as fast as possible! There must be something that would help us find our destination. Find it, Hero! We cannot delay, not when this realm is crawling with twisted SkyPirates!

quests.name: Scout Ahead
quests.description: Being aware of your surroundings is key for any situation - but in this case, you're doing my grunt work. Scout out the area and come back to me when you're done. I would suggest you try to avoid being devoured by the creatures that infest it as you do so.

quests.name: Gluttonous Slithering
quests.description: You saw Gorewyrms inside the villa, did you not? Those damnable beasts rot all life around them with their mere presence. They are a plague on the environment, and are reviled even among the creatures we Diabolicals typically encounter. Exterminate any you see, and bring some of their slime back to me. Perhaps an in-depth study could help us understand their 'unique' abilities.

quests.name: Relics of Bygone Days
quests.description: The armory holds many Diabolical heirlooms. Removing revolting parasites and Gorewyrm guards is necessary to preserve the history of the Great Court. Extermination is the only answer.

quests.name: Rapacious Desires
quests.description: The Lord of this villa amassed a large amount of the local reserves, divided it among the people, and claims to have kept a coin or two for himself. This land has been long abandoned, and devoured by the impure. Their gold has more value in our pockets than it does sitting in untouched vaults.

quests.name: Uninvited Guests
quests.description: The filth that squats in this long deserted estate is long overdue for an eviction. There is no need to give them notice, nor to squander our precious time doing so. Take the Parasites and Gorewyrms out.

quests.name: Key of Life
quests.description: I'm almost certain of it. What lays past the cellar door are great horrors. Backtrack to the treasury, the key HAS to be in the hoards of greed coveted by the previous lord of this villa.

quests.name: Proper Procedures
quests.description: The Lord here was careful about making sure no one could access this chamber. It appears they've also used a sealing spell in addition to the physical lock. Retrieve a Necrotic Tome from a Lightguard Caster in /noxustower so that we may dispel this incantation.

quests.name: A Peculiar Feast
quests.description: By the Great Court! It appears that the foul beast lurking in the cellar is at the center of some sort of perpetual ritual. How long has it been here? Eons? Oh, well… it matters not. Cleanse this place of its presence at once!

quests.name: The Pick of Destiny
quests.description: Madra needs help. If you wish to pick your destiny and GET the pick of Destiny I've been given for you, use the portal to journey to her and give her this vial.

quests.name: Bad Memory
quests.description: Freeing my people is my fondest wish, and if you defeat Vath, we will be free to reclaim our city once more… but if you try to defeat him, you will fail. It's important to know the enemy that you are up against. You must find the Stone of Memory. It keeps a magical record of our city and its people. It will show you what Vath is capable of. Find the Stone of Memory and see what it must show you, then return to me.

quests.name: Squeeze Water from Stone
quests.description: We want to see Vath gone as much as you do, but I have to care for my people. If you help make things easier for us, then I will tell you how to get into the Upper City and to Vath. First, my people need water. On the mountain path leading here, you must have seen some Balboas. These stone creatures hold within them stones that magically store water. Bring me 3 Water Stones.

quests.name: Carrion Carrying On
quests.description: My fellow Dwarves and I have been treated worse than animals since Vath took over. Many of us have been worked until fatigue and illness overcomes us. The beaks of the Vultragons on the mountain path can be used to make powerful medicine. Bring me 6 Vultragon Beaks so that I may heal our sick.

quests.name: Bagged Lunches
quests.description: Hero, we need food. Dragonlord Vath's Drow make us work endlessly with almost no food, and our strength is giving out. Each of the Drow soldiers carries a small pouch of food on them, and they eat in front of us just to be cruel. Teach these monsters a lesson and bring me 8 Food Pouches to help feed the hungry.

quests.name: Radiant Lamps
quests.description: Dwarves have excellent eyesight, but even we cannot work in the pitch black mines of Dwarfhold. Here in the mountain, there are burrowing Glow Worms who feed on a mineral called uranium. For some reason, their steady diet of this mineral makes them glow in the dark. Slay a few of these beasts and gather 3 Vials of Glow Ichor from them, so that we may make lamps.

quests.name: Having a Blast
quests.description: Chaos Dragonlord Vath does not give us many tools to dig with. We do not want to work for him, but until you take him out, we must keep delivering gold and gems to save our skins. To make our task easier, we normally use small amounts of blasting powder that we make out of bat droppings. Explore Dwarfhold and gather 8 Piles of Bat Guano, then return to me with your… findings.

quests.name: Secret Weapons
quests.description: I have one last favor to ask of you, Hero. We need weapons. We will not try and free ourselves until Vath is gone from Dwarfhold, but when the time comes, we want to be ready to fight. Gather 8 Weapons from the Draconians or Drow and bring them back to me, so that I may hide them in a secret location.

quests.name: Beachin' Summer Collection Quest Pet
quests.description: You'll want to head to the /baconcatlair to slay one of them super-fancy cloud sharks. They swim up in the sky all year 'round. Not like the sharks on this here beach.

items_required.name: Cloud Shark Tooth x1 (Stacks up to 6)

quests.name: Holiday Cheer? No Thank You.
quests.description: So everyone's angry and tearing each other apart. Everything still LOOKS far too happy, and that just will not do! Confiscate as many Frostval gifts, decorations and desserts you can find. We've got to get this place looking worthy of Dage!

quests.name: Not THIS blight!
quests.description: Word has it, Yorumi has a team of clerics working on a cure for the black sleet. That means we'll have to step up our game! Take this concentrated mixture, and dump it on all the moglins, humans, and animals that you can find.

quests.name: And Your Little Deer, Too
quests.description: Frostvale is full of adorable deer that people have long held up as a symbol of the holiday season. Want to strike a heavy blow to their morale? Slay the deer. We'll follow behind you and raise them as blighted minions.

quests.name: Recyclable!
quests.description: Let's be honest, all of our troops are expendable. But golems can be used again and again! Kill 10 Ice Golems and bring me their heartstones. If we inscribe the right runes on them, not only can we control them, we can reanimate them when they fall in battle.

quests.name: No Cure For You.
quests.description: I have some bad news for you. That cure I mentioned earlier? They actually managed to make one. But never fear, we haven't lost yet! They've been handing it out to the villagers and moglins. All you have to do is go out and take it from them.

quests.name: Spread the Blight
quests.description: Now, all that's left is to keep churning out White Stalkers! Attack the local villagers — either human or moglin will do. Once they have fallen, we'll raise them as blighted minions to do Dage's bidding.

quests.name: Souls For Dage
quests.description: So, you want to help Dage? Just keep battling! Fight every villager you see, human or moglin, and bring their pure, untainted souls to me, and I'll let you exchange them for a reward.

quests.name: Breaking In
quests.description: We've seen the cave leading to Dage's Mt. Bleakwind lair at the top of the mountain, but I know he's not scaling the peak every time he comes and goes. He must be using a second, lower entrance to get inside. Find it.

quests.name: Break the barrier
quests.description: It looks like a barrier spell has been cast, preventing anyone but Dage from traveling further into the mountain. The ice golems are carrying stones that appear to be enchanted. If you get all of the stones, you should be able to break the spell.

quests.name: The Final Ward
quests.description: Looks like there's another barrier blocking access to the next chamber. The sounds emanating from it suggest that this is where you'll fine Frostfang. Perhaps the stones carried by the frost golems will help you gain entrance.

quests.name: Defeat Frostfang (Evil)
quests.description: You found Frostfang's lair, and he's still inside! Take him down before he goes on the attack again! And if you find whatever might be giving him his energy, it may be wise to destroy that as well.

quests.name: Celestial Stones
quests.description: Did you know that we Celestials sometimes use crystals to channel our energy? We harvest them from the Celestial Moonstones, Celestial Sunstones, and Star Sapphires that you see hovering nearby. But we can't use them unless they're completely pure, and often they are not. If you can find me some perfect stones, I'll gladly reward you them.

quests.name: The Celestial Realm
quests.description: I may be staying in Aegis now, but I haven't forgotten my home, the Celestial Realm. Would you mind checking in on it for me? I've heard they still have a bad Infernal problem, and I'm worried. If the rumors are true, please destroy any infernals you find. I, and the other Celestials, would be eternally grateful.

quests.name: Find the rest of J6
quests.description: Hero, my chassis and external motor units have been misappropriated by ectoplasmic ex-life forms. Hypothesis is that they engage in an exodus from the Underworld. Recover 2 Cyborg Arms, 2 Cyborg Legs, and 1 Cyborg Chassis from the creatures in the immediate area.

quests.name: Mer'Angel Hunting
quests.description: You willl need to locate target 0719 and take her into custody. The Client wishes to meet with her. Motive: undisclosed. Your purpose is to secure her person. I will give you further instructions then. The first step is to locate her and engage in dialogue.

quests.name: Crush The Crashers
quests.description: Filthy McGee's gang have started closing in on the wedding. We've got to take care of them QUIETLY. Remember, this is Cinazul's special day. She can't know any of this is happening! Take care of 13 Bulletless Bandits. I'll keep my honey-lumpkins distracted.

quests.name: Marriage Is Full Of Pitfalls
quests.description: Those bandits keep coming. You're going to need to dig some pitfalls to trap these goons. Just make sure that the holes aren't too close to the dancefloor.

quests.name: A Favorable Outcome
quests.description: These guys might be doing us a favor. The Bandits Guns aren't only out of bullets, they're totally sealed up. We might as well collect a few of their guns to give away as wedding favors. See if you can bring back 15 Wedding Favors.

quests.name: Let's Get Filthy
quests.description: I just got a note from Filthy McGee. he says he wants to have a showdown just outside the wedding venue. If I don't come, he's going to wreck the wedding so I have to go. Will you back me up? Meet me in front of Filthy McGee as soon as you can.

quests.name: Discerning Threats
quests.description: As expected, Albedo Elementals have infested the Forge. You won't notice you've been burned until it's too late, and you start hearing unwanted voices from the past. Needless to say, we should put out their flames.

quests.name: Model Students
quests.description: Tara and the suspicious woman hanging on to her shadow found a guestbook. Read it, and ask our companions for their insight. Forge Albedo isn't anything like Maleno…though I have to admit that the architecture appeals to me.

quests.name: System Delusion
quests.description: I hear someone calling for help down the western hall. It's a Paladin, and he's being shot at by Forge Albedo's Defensive Turrets. Defend him, and ask him if there are others in danger. I'll find a way to disable the alarm.

quests.name: The Leap that Never Landed
quests.description: The Paladin, Riguad, said that his team was separated and being hunted down by faceless humanoids. You and the others check the open rooms for those in need of rescue, and I'll work on unlocking the other doors.

quests.name: Insistent Existence
quests.description: I unlocked the room next to the one you were just in. More of Rigaud's Paladins are inside. Rescue them from the Collapsed Husks trying to assimilate them. Try not to look at them directly. There's no coming back from that.

quests.name: Failed Reflection
quests.description: This is as far as we can go down the west hall. Tara scouted the east wing, and found Albedo Matches. They're using what's left of their scorched minds to spread the flames. Please, stop them here.

quests.name: Technically Aware
quests.description: I hear gunfire and metal scraping further into the eastern wing. The Defense Droids are hunting the remaining Paladins. We need to hurry and destroy them, or there'll be no one left to rescue.

quests.name: Mental Barrier
quests.description: I think it's easy to tell where the Paladins broke into Forge Albedo. They were mowed down by the Defensive Turrets. Destroy the turrets, and rescue the last of the survivors. One of them might have the key to the main center of the Forge.

quests.name: Floor 1
quests.description: You have to start somewhere! Why not floor one? Munch 12 Dire Munchers.

quests.name: Floor 2
quests.description: How did Hulking Dire Wolves get down here? Get rid of them!

quests.name: Floor 3
quests.description: Undead. Are they dead? Are they not? I never knew for sure. Just… get them out.

quests.name: Floor 4
quests.description: Doesn't look like you got all of those *ACHOO* wolves.

quests.name: Floor 5
quests.description: Look at all these Draugr. I don't want them crawling around my dungeon. Go… do something with them.

quests.name: Floor 6
quests.description: It's getting kinda dark. Go place these torches all over and then empty out the next room.

quests.name: Floor 7
quests.description: Ew. Those Spyballs are really grossing me out. The way they blink, and the sound the blink makes and I can't help but play it in slow motion and EWWWWwwww. Please just go poke them.

quests.name: Floor 8
quests.description: You know what? I enjoyed watching you munch those Munchers. Do it again.

quests.name: Floor 9
quests.description: Okay, I can't keep looking at those Spyballs. Just go knock them out. If they keep their eyes closed maybe it won't be as nasty.

quests.name: Floor 10
quests.description: Floor 10. Sounds ominous. Do I even want to see what's in there? Awwwww, it's a kitty!

quests.name: Floor 11
quests.description: Eh. More Draugr. Just… Umm… You know what to do.

quests.name: Floor 12
quests.description: Is that a …. spider?! I HATE spiders! KILL THEM WITH FIRE!

quests.name: Floor 13
quests.description: Oh. Yay. The undead are back.

quests.name: Floor 14
quests.description: EEEEEEeeeeee!! I mean… Oh No! More spiders!

quests.name: Floor 15
quests.description: As I was running from those spiders… I mean… jogging this morning, I dropped my… thing. One of the monsters may have it. Go get it.

quests.name: Floor 16
quests.description: My thing is broken. I think it's missing a piece. Go find it… you'll still have to fight your way through the room, thought.

quests.name: Floor 17
quests.description: I enjoyed watching you beat up that kitty. Go do it again.

quests.name: Floor 18
quests.description: Just… kill everything in here! WITH YOUR MIND! Or weapon. Whatever. Just make it dead.

quests.name: Floor 19
quests.description: You're pretty close. Good think you'll never get past this level!

quests.name: Floor 20
quests.description: AHAHAHHA! Come and get it!

quests.name: Property Appraiser
quests.description: This place is HUGE! I don't even know where to begin looking…so that's why I'm gonna let you take this mission solo. Travel as far as far as you can to report your findings to me when you're done. If you find any clues as to where the villagers can be, pleas bring it back to me as well. It's kinda what we're here for, anyway. Go on now!

quests.name: Pain in the Grass
quests.description: Have you SEEN the size of the Red Ants up here?! I guess you have. But I'm not about to be get bitt'n by one of those monstrosities… sooo hows about I hire you as my personal red ant killer? …No objection? Great! Go out and get me 6 pristine Ant-tennas so that I know the path to the giant castle is bug free.

quests.name: Dust Busting
quests.description: Ferocious packs of rabid Dust Bunnies patrol the Giant's castle floors. And uhh I'm kinda allergic to dust soooo taking out the Bunnies myself is a no-can do… so that's why you're here! Defeat 12 Dust Bunnies shouldn't be to hard, right? Right! Ha! We make such a great team!

quests.name: Cat-astrophe
quests.description: Alright! There's only one thing left to do: KO the kitty guarding my townsfolk! Once that feline takes a long cat-nap, we can figure a way to save my village!

quests.name: Trapped in a Dream
quests.description: I know the way forward from the dreams I’ve had before. I can almost remember it… but then it slips away. Lost to the sand of sleep. If I could recover these memories from the minions who stole them, though… I know there are some firing Neurons around here somewhere. I'll bet they have my memories!

quests.name: Light 'em Up
quests.description: Let’s light up these memories and see what they show us.

quests.name: Oblivious Oblivion
quests.description: Would you look at that? Oblivion's Mages are scurrying around the back halls. They'll tattle to both of their masters if you don't pull out their tongues. Send them back to the Darkness. I'm sure they'd appreciate the rest.

quests.name: Tongue and Cheek
quests.description: Nulgath's experiments haven't had any success, but they did produce more pawns. Look at these Fiends. They're walking mouths with no thoughts, just appetites. Tug out their tongues before they get a taste for you.

quests.name: O.T.
quests.description: The Operating Theatre's unlocked, but there are too many nuisances in the way. Fancy words, huh? Do I sound enough like a Loremaster? Oh, right. The annoyances. Get rid of the remaining Oblivion Magi and Fiendish Devourers.

quests.name: The Fiend is in the Details
quests.description: Time to snoop. Look around for anything about the experiments Nulgath's been conducting. If we're lucky, you'll run into someone who's seen them firsthand. If you end up tattling on me…Oh, well. That'll make this more fun.

quests.name: Soulectomy
quests.description: On the topic of experimental ethics, look at what's lumbering down the hall. They're what's left of Nulgath's clones. I know there's more down there, and we'll have to clean up Nully's trash to sate our curiosity.

quests.name: A Nation Night Terror
quests.description: We're getting close to something juicy. Nulgath's Nightmare Fiends are guarding it. They used to be mortals with the ability to enter dreams. Careful. They might look massive, but they'll fly up your nose and dig into your brain given the chance. Let's put them to sleep.

quests.name: Point of No Return
quests.description: The Clones and Nightmare Fiends are clustered in the hall leading to an infinity pool. That's where mortals are dipped, and mutate into Nulgath's minions. Come on. Get rid of these meatbags, and let's go for a swim.

quests.name: All Appetite
quests.description: Get a good gander at that walking pit of teeth! It's one of the clones Nully experimented on. The closest he's gotten to success, and he just lets the thing wander around. Okay, great. We've looked. Now kill it. There's more fun to be had elsewhere.

quests.name: Adimonde's Invitation
quests.description: The infinity pool deep under Terceblah is where Nulgath mutates mortals into Fiends. It's the product of a leaking springing from the Fiend God's realm, or well, my body. Don't be shy. Come closer. The water's just fine.

quests.name: Starting off Small
quests.description: The closest relatives to Makai on Lore are the Moglins- who are prone to becoming stronger with outside influence. Perhaps we can learn how to transfer these mutations onto our own underlings? Some specimens and the subspecies from the RedDeath Swamp and the Chaos Lab should serve as excellent starting points.

quests.name: Those Who Don't Learn...
quests.description: The Archfiend's first major defeat came at the end of a war with his protege- a war we never should have lost. The soldiers who failed us are forced to wander the underworld for all eternity to atone. They may still be useful, however. Note their flaws as you battle them, and we can ensure future soldiers do not make the same mistakes.

quests.name: Chibification Nation
quests.description: The ‘Chibification' incident was one we wish to forget- and yet, there is still something to learn from such a horrendous experience. The Chaos Queen and her servants in /Pastelia and /Sewerpink possess a unique and powerful kind of energy. If you can extract some and bring it back to us, we may be able to harness it for our own uses.

quests.name: A Little Fiendly Sparring
quests.description: The Nation could use more warriors like you. Care to help us make some? Many of our master's strongest followers have grown soft as of late. Humble Dirtlicker at /fiendshard, our forces at the Shadowblast arena, the Deaths Head and Void warriors here, and Skew at Quibble's Hunt to remind then what strength truly looks like.

quests.name: Working Shard, or Shardly Working?
quests.description: Master Nulgath will never allow us to access to his Fiend Shard. However, there's nothing saying that we can't study pieces that end up in our possession through other means. If you happen to ‘find' us bits of Nulgath and Dirtlicker's Fiend Shards, as well as some crystals from the Roguefiends in /quibblehunt, I will make it worth your while.

quests.name: The Wanderer's Words
quests.description: Taro Blademaster refuses to speak to the Nation's Loremasters, yet his existence and strength fascinate us. Maybe he would be willing to explain his ways to one such as yourself instead? Bring him sake from Kitsune's private stock and blade oil from the Dai Tengu, and spar with him to gain his trust. We must know how such a warrior came to be.

quests.name: Cupid's Courier
quests.description: I promised Nastasia a picnic for Hero's Heart Day, but there is NO AWAY I can carry all these presents myself. Help me deliver these gifts to her. Just keep an eye out for her Picnic Basket!

quests.name: Last Minute Gift Ideas
quests.description: I… I… I lost Nastasia's presents I KNOW IM SUCH A BAD BOYFRIEND DON'T RUB IT IN!!! You gotta help me out, pal. Here's a list of presents I need you get. You can find everything in the Love map to the left.

quests.name: Cravin' a Raven
