quests.description: Alright, the first thing on Nastasia's list is… a Raven? Isn't that… um, a messenger of death?!? … whatever my love wants, I'll get it for her! There are Ravens in Dage's /Judgement map. Defeat those foul fowls until you finally tame a Raven.

quests.name: Owl Always Love You
quests.description: The second item on her list is… an Owl? Hmm, I guess Nastasia really wants some pet birds… that just so happen to be bad luck omens.. *nervous chuckle*… Maybe you could capture an Owl-hybrid Leatherwing instead? I'm pretty sure they live in /Pines forest in Dwarfhold.

quests.name: This is My Broom STICK!
quests.description: Nastasia is now seeking a broomstick. Hmm, I guess she wants to start Spring Cleaning early? Because I know SHE knows that a broom signals bad luck if it falls in your home! Let's hope for the 1st option *crosses fingers*! GO fetch a Sweeping Broom that some of the Scarecrows in the /farm drop.

quests.name: Yes We Candle!
quests.description: Ah, a candle: it's the perfect gift for a teacher… or those seeking ghost spirits trapped in a room!! Hopefully Nastasia just wants candles for their captivating fragrances, and I think Safiria's Castle has the best smelling ones! Maybe you could find some candles from the Monsters in /Safiria?

quests.name: Itty Bitty Kitty
quests.description: Everyone knows it's unlucky to have a black cat cross your path… so why does Nastasia want to tempt her luck AND her allergies!? Well, you know the drill: go find me a black cat--but be sure to capture the cutest one you can find! I think I saw some wild kittens in /BeleensDream.

quests.name: Clock Blocker
quests.description: Finally---a gift that isn't going to leave me presents in the litter box! Looks like Nastasia wants a Clock… that is broken?! This should be easy--I remember seeing TONS of stopped clocks in the /TimeVoid. I bet you could "borrow" some broken clocks from the Time Travel Fairies there…

quests.name: Shoots! And Ladders
quests.description: Okay, so the next thing on her list is… a Ladder. Now, I know your inventory bag is pretty big, but I doubt a full size ladder will fit in there. Maybe you can find pieces to a ladder and then I can put them together? I bet those huge Red Ants in the /Giant map eat ladders for lunch--so try checking there!

quests.name: Mirror Image
quests.description: My dear Nastasia requests a mirror! She has such a unique beauty… even though she's going through a "Goth-makeup" phase… and is using gray foundation… (Is that IN right now or something?) Well, let's get her a new Mirror to test out some new makeup techniques; I bet those Evil Moglins in the Mirror Realm would have some! Head to /BattleOff and get Nastasia a Mirror!

quests.name: Opal Omen
quests.description: Well this is strange… (because everything has been oh-so-normal before)… but Nastasia wants an Opal. Says here it's unlucky to wear Opals unless you were born in October--and her birthday is in April. Maybe she just likes the way it looks? DUNNO. But what I do know is that there's a huge Gem Field in /EarthStorm. I bet the monsters there would have an Opal we could give to Nastasia!

quests.name: A Salt with a Deadly Weapon
quests.description: The next item on Nastasia's list is "Salt," and I'm hoping she wants it for cooking and nothing else! But does she need Sea Salt or lodized? Hmm… let's get both! Get some lodized Salt from the Snails in /WillowCreek, and then collect Sea Salt from the Deep Dweller in /WaterStorm.

quests.name: Mind your Manors, Magpie
quests.description: Another bird?! Geesh, Nastasia must really like birds… even though I thought Magpies bring bad luck and death? BUT there's no time to question that crazy woman--we MUST fulfill her wishes! I remember seeing a huge Bird of Paradise making a nest in the /Manor. Maybe you can find a Magpie Hatchling amongst all those feathers… and talons… and super sharp beak?

quests.name: Umbrella for my Bella
quests.description: ALMOST THERE! Nastasia wants an Umbrella--and I know just where to find one! Head to the /Junkyard on Yokai Island and defeat wild Tsukumo-Gami until you get the Yokai Umbrella. (If you're a Legend, you can totally cheat and buy one from the Shrine Shop in the /Junkyard).

quests.name: Bat Crazy!
quests.description: So you know a bat in house signals death, right?! But, if this is what my true love truly wants, then I'll get her one (hopefully it will play nicely with all the other pets we got her!)

quests.name: Present the Presents
quests.description: We have ALL of the items from Nastasia's wish list! Let's give them to her and make this the best Hero's Heart Day ever! *crosses fingers*

quests.name: I Want Tibia Your Valentine
quests.description: Forgive me for not leaping into action… but all of THIS RIGHT HERE has got me scared stiff. Could you, um, you know, stop that Undead invasion from, you know, making everyone in the world Undead? Start with the Lost and Forlorn Loves in /love while I continue standing here with this frozen look on my face while you go kick some Undead butt. Tailbone. Whatever.

quests.name: Infestation
quests.description: No library is safe from tiny creatures who want to eat its books. In the case of this one, it's those blasted Dream Fairies and their disgusting larvae. If you want to make a few extra gold coins, clear some of them out of here, and help me keep my books intact.

quests.name: Orpheum Elemental
quests.description: Do you want to help me collect some more samples to study? I've been looking for a chunk of Dreamstone… it's a rare mineral that can be found in nodes of Orphium ore. If you happen to run across some, please bring it to me.

quests.name: Nightmare Skull
quests.description: You've seen Nightmare Skulls, right? Did you know that there are sentient, dreaming minds inside them? I'd love to be able to study one, but I'm just not much of a fighter. If you were to bring me one, I'd share my knowledge with you.

quests.name: Nightspores
quests.description: Nightspores are interesting. They are our primary source of psionic energy, which no one fully understands. But maybe if I had some of their… well, actual spores… that might aid us in our search for understanding.

quests.name: Nightwyrm
quests.description: Even the worst of Nightmares are afraid of the Nightwyrm. They seem to be made of not dream or nightmare, but something else entirely. I'd like to know more about what that might be. Perhaps a sample of their chitin would help.

quests.name: Dreamdust
quests.description: I know, I know--I spend so much time trying to get Dream Fairies OUT of the library. But I have to admit it would be useful to learn a bit more about their magic. Bring me some samples of their Dreamdust to study, and I will share what I know about them with you.

quests.name: Dream Larvae
quests.description: I'm curious about these Dream Larvae. They've proven so difficult to kill… but if I had one of their husks to study, I might be able to find a more efficient method.

quests.name: Red Alert
quests.description: The BioBeasts have all escaped, and the robotic lab guards are going haywire! Shut them down before they destroy everything! We'll worry about repairing them later.

quests.name: Bugs... They Give Me Hives
quests.description: …She also broke open the Hive, and now the place is crawling with bugs. They're great for guarding the 'beasts, but I can not deal with them being in here. Would you mind taking care of it for me before you go?

quests.name: Through the Delta V Portal!
quests.description: If you want to catch up with that dark elf girl, she went through that portal at the end of the hall. Good luck!

quests.name: Weapons-in-Progress
quests.description: Swordhaven is known for making the best weapons in Lore—it says so right in the name! And with so many new orders coming in, I need your help retrieving fundamental materials. Go forth into the kingdom and get me:

quests.name: Putting the Sword in Swordhaven (Daily)
quests.description: The weapon invoices keep piling up everyday! Can I employ you on a daily basis to help with my errands? Swordhaven monsters collect broken weapons from defeated heroes—can you go out and collect those for me so I can rebuild them? Keep in mind that the stronger the monster, the higher the chance at him dropping an weapon!

quests.name: Chaos Time!
quests.description: There is no being more tied to Time and Chaos than the Primordial Kathool! Visit it, and seek out its wisdom! Let it teach you its secrets! Let it in your mind!

quests.name: Surely it Starts and Ends Here
quests.description: At long last the search comes to an end! Hero, the ancient Paladin Armor is being guarded by the strongest Dracoliches in the heart of the dragon! Find and dispatch each one, then the armor will be ours!

quests.name: The First Scroll
quests.description: "My helmet's near a Dragonmaster, the slimy cave may spell disaster."

quests.name: The Second Scroll
quests.description: "Helmet's missing some wings I see? Trapped under the ice they may be. Dwellers under water like to dream, of flight through the air, so wings they have stolen - go make them scream!"

quests.name: The Third Scroll
quests.description: "There once was one, who flew too close to the sun. Was that me? Only the elemental can tell thee. Spells of three come to your aid, find the wings before the heat does fade."

quests.name: The Fourth Scroll
quests.description: "Polearms, not quite my cup of tea. I like to close the distance to my opponents you see. After the race let's take a seat, so we can grab a bite to eat."

quests.name: The Fifth Scroll
quests.description: "Swords and axes, my preferred weapons of choice. Next up's our featured panel, hope you enjoy their voice."

quests.name: The Final Scroll
quests.description: "My armor, well I lost it in a match. It was taken by a rival with a patch. He ran back to his camp, that Horc is a scamp. " -Troll'edin, the Paladin

quests.name: Paper Heart
quests.description: I'll need something to write the love message on. The Inquisitor Guards of the Citadel in the Dwarfhold Mountains zone carry some of the finest parchment to be found in Lore. I already know what I want to write so all I will need is 1 Sheet of Perfect Parchment.

quests.name: Imp Ink
quests.description: There are a lot of inks in the world but I need one that is JUST the perfect color. In the town of Mobius in Chiral valley you will find a monster called Slugfit. He is the perfect color of purple. If you could get some of his Nail Trimmings I could make ink out of it to write my letter!

quests.name: Heart Shaped Scale
quests.description: The last thing I need is something really rare and beautiful. It will be dangerous but I happen to know that the Red Dragon, deep within Vasalkar's Lair in Skullholme has a perfectly shaped, blood red, Heart Shaped Scale in the center of his chest. Can you bring me that scale?

quests.name: Special Delivery
quests.description: Perfect, it's ready. Now all you need to do is deliver it! You should find Princess Pam near the wishing well here in the Forest of Infinite Terror. I can't thank you enough for all your help. It's up to fate now.

quests.name: Cloaked in Darkness
quests.description: I'll need a Shadow Cloak to make my way out of here. Bader might still have one. But remember, I'll be waiting for Raskar when I arrive. Please don't let anything happen to him!

quests.name: Escape to Freedom
quests.description: I'm going to need a way out of here, I agree. If you can prepare a path, I'll gather what I need here. Slay 4 Dire Wolves and 4 Blood Maggots in Darkovia Forest. I'll hurry up here while you do that.

quests.name: Shine a Light on Truth
quests.description: I am sorry your friends thought we would destroy the sun in order to be together. We would NEVER do that. Please, go talk to the Lumina Temple adept. Tell Etain what our TRUE plan is!

quests.name: "Salute" the Magpie
quests.description: First things first. We gotta do something about these Magpies! Squish one, and another 10 take its place. But if you squish enough of them… yeah, I think you know where I'm going with this.

quests.name: Gather the Parts
quests.description: The portal motor in this thing is completely shot. I'm going to need some spare parts if I have any hope of fixing it. You might be able to find some stuck to the Junk Golems. I'll write up a list, and then you can go collect them all.

quests.name: Engine Needs a Spark
quests.description: I just need a few sparks of portal electricity, and this motor will be up and running again! Get it from the Portal Manifestations.

quests.name: Metal for Welding
quests.description: I'm going to need some good, strong metal to weld these broken pieces back together with. That's the sort of thing that tends to gravitate to the Junk Golems after awhile. See if you can find me some.

quests.name: Feel the Heat
quests.description: And now we need some portal flame to heat the forge. I bet you know where you can find THAT. No? Well here's a hint: check the Portal Manifestations.

quests.name: Find the Forge
quests.description: Now, we just need to find that forge. I know it's around here somewhere, but… with all of these Magpies, the piles of stuff are constantly shifting. I can never find anything! But YOU can, right? You're supposed to be some big hero or something. Well? Get a move on!

quests.name: Get the Coal
quests.description: Where's all the coal?! The Magpies must have stolen it! Oh, why must they make my life so difficult? Get it back.

quests.name: Defeat the Coal Elemental
quests.description: Aaaah! What the heck is that thing? What is even WRONG with this place? Well, hero, hurry up and save us!

quests.name: Filthy Thieving Magpies
quests.description: They STOLE it! Those filthy, stinking magpies stole my Portal Chakram! WE HAVE TO GET IT BACK! Find find it!

quests.name: Track the Tracker
quests.description: There's a tracker for this thing around here somewhere. Only, it's not where I left it. It must have gotten sucked into one of the Junk Golems. Find it, find it!

quests.name: Follow the Chakram
quests.description: Ok. Ok. This is all going to be fine. They may have my chakram, but now we can track it. Just follow the trail of energy, and you'll find it.

quests.name: Get it BACK!
quests.description: Get it back, get it back! Those Magpies can't get away with stealing my chakram! Teach them a lesson, and get. It. BACK! I'll wait here.

quests.name: Secondary Mission
quests.description: A pet I had. Cute little creepy crawly with a beautiful ruby glare. I loved him and fed him until he grew big and strong. Then he ate my cat. Find him, and BRING ME HIS EYES!

quests.name: Dark Sparks
quests.description: The little dark faeries are such nuisances! My people swat them down whenever we can and harvest the dark ssparks they made. They are a vital component in our Elixir of Light! Slay 25 Dark Faeries and I'll reward you well!

quests.name: When Wild Elves Attack!
quests.description: I don't think the Forest Elves I traveled here with realize you're here to help! We've been trapped down here, and I think they have been driven mad by Graveclaw's taint. Slay them and take the Treewalker Sandals, Rappelling Gear, and Sap-B-Gone we'll need to descend further into the Cavern!

quests.name: Tree of Light
quests.description: Even in the darkest, most defiled caverns, one cannot deny the power of light and life. This elven tree proves that… and it will help us get to where we need to go. IF the Forest Imps don't destroy it! Slay 6 of them to save the trees!

quests.name: Purity Beats Corruption
quests.description: The Tree of Hope's light IS working! Already I can feel Graveclaw's hold on the Cavern weakening. We can't just slay Graveclaw; we've got to restore the land, and undo the damage he's done. Gather 7 bucks of Cavern Water and nourish these roots. Slay 5 of the Shattersword Prisioners so they cannot stop us!

quests.name: CastleMania: Disharmony and Despair
quests.description: There are no vampires in THIS creepy castle, only crazy scientists! But if you're going to join the band, you'll need an instrument. Super-charged music demands an electric guitar. Sam says there should be one in the Back-up Room. Go explore CastleMania and FIND it!

quests.name: Stringing Your Enemies Along
quests.description: We've primed our experiments to respond only to us, so they're not just going to hand over the guitar strings you need, even though the monsters are carrying them! You'll need to TAKE them, and you'll need 8 — even though the guitar only has six strings, some of theirs are probably broken or bad.

quests.name: Out of Tune(ing Knobs)
quests.description: If you're going to play with us, you're going to have to be on time and in key. We've developed magi-scientific tuning knobs which are attuned (pardon the pun) to the person who uses them. You can find 6 boxes on monsters and in various rooms and bring them back to find the set which suits you best.

quests.name: Code of Conduct-or
quests.description: Our experiments, behave pretty well for us. But that's because WE created them! I'm sure one of them will have a miniature lightning rod - we use them all the time. Maybe now that they've experienced your martial prowess, they'll give you what you want. But it's not likely.

quests.name: Sending Out an SOS to the World
quests.description: Transmitters? You want to broadcast, eh? I think we can help with that! Our monsters should have all the parts you need to construct a top-notch transmitter. But they're small, so you'll need a lot of them! The monsters should all be carrying the components you require.

quests.name: This is FINAL ZAP!
quests.description: Our equipment is specially modified to enhance output TO THE EXTREME, but it takes specific settings if they're going to do what you need them to, Hero! You'll need to attach output-enhancificators to all of our machinery. That'll turn their levels up to 11… MILLION!

quests.name: Wire You Doing This Again?
quests.description: Wiring is a tricky business. Cut or connect the wrong one and BOOM! You've got to be careful when working with wires. But I think we'll be able to handle the hands-on part of the project while Beat keeps Vordred distracted. You just bring us as 17 spools of wire. They're all over the Lab, and the monsters have some, as well!

quests.name: Die, All of You!
quests.description: We need more DIALS! We can't control the levels that we're going to push the amps and other equipment to without dials! We think 12 dials should do the trick! That'll give us enough to outfit all our machines. The monsters usually keep dials in their backpacks since we need them so frequently.

quests.name: Ample Amps Required
quests.description: If we're going to ramp up the power, we're going to need to AMP up the Lab! Thanks to your efforts and our tinkering, we now have 10 super-charged, high-voltage amps! Place them around the Lab to ensure complete and total aural annihilation!

quests.name: Upward Over the Mountain
quests.description: The hills are alive with the sound of music, and the mountain is alive with the sound of thunder! You can hear it all the way in here. You need to get to the top, but our creatures and experiments have been told to guard the pass with their lives. It's too late to change their orders now. Battle your way up the mountain!

quests.name: Phantasmic Guardian Blade
quests.description: I've heard that someone stole a Guardian Blade and infused it with dark energy, before returning it to the tower they stole it from. The result? A cursed sword that's slowly eating away at the Guardian Tower's defenses. We need to retrieve that sword as soon as possible - it's hanging on the wall next to the Verification Room in Battleon's Guardian Tower. You will also need 4 vials of Phantasmic Aura from the Hollow Wraiths and 4 vials of Evil Fusion Aura from the Fallen Heroes. Ironically, we'll need to purify whatever those thieves did to the blade.

quests.name: The Coast is Clear
quests.description: Over the past few months, Dreadrock's seen a rise in sinister activity. It's been difficult rescuing any lost individuals without blowing our cover, and it'll only get worse if something isn't done. I need to make a request: If you could quietly take out several of the local monsters, it would allow the refugees safer passage in-and-out of the city.

quests.name: More Aliens Than You Can Handle?
quests.description: It's imperative that we find the Vigilette pieces, Hero! But it looks like we've got a company AND we're under surveillance by those Shadow-Eyes. Take a pistol from one of those aliens buggers so we can shoot out the Spy-Eyes!

quests.name: Spy Eyes
quests.description: They see you from their spy-eyes, Hero. They see you walking on the ground. They see you killing minions. And they see you hunting for Vigilette pieces! Use the alien pistol to smash those Shadow Spy-Eyes!

quests.name: Smashed to Pieces
quests.description: The Collector is in love with his broken Vigilette. It's been crushed, crashed and smashed to pieces. We've got to find the bits before The Collector does or he'll take over our lives. Again!

quests.name: Tired of My Vigilette Dreams
quests.description: I looked around and John looked around, and now you're here to lead us all in one last sweep of this alien planet. We need to find 5 small fragments and 5 medium fragments; they're the last pieces of the Vigilette and I'm sure that the red-eyed aliens have them!

quests.name: You're Not the Boss of Me Now
quests.description: The Collector may think he owns us, but you need to show him that we're NOT his playthings. He's not the boss of you now… but he IS pretty big. But you can take him down and knock him out, Hero!

quests.name: Alien Annihilator
quests.description: Kill 100 aliens before they send you out of this world!

quests.name: The Treasure That You Seek
quests.description: We've got to explore this prehistoric world but finding fossils can't be our aim. Not when we've got to get that Vigillete! It'd be a good idea to clear all those trees, Hero to make a path. For that, you'll need a axe. The armor from those dinos would make a good blade! Bring back 10 sharp armor segments!

quests.name: These Trees
quests.description: It's a good thing these trees don't have houses at the top of them. It'd make cutting them down a LOT harder. I count 11 you're going to need to chop down before we can make a clear path to the top of the mountain and knowing your luck, thats exactly where the Vigilette is hidden!

quests.name: Ewwww... Totally Gross
quests.description: You're going to have to Hero-up and get ready to give it your all, because i think we're going to need… Dino-spit. Yeah. I know. It's gross. But I've got a cup for you, and a stick to scrape with. You'll just need to kill 8 'saurs and collect their spit.

quests.name: The Eggs, Exciting and New
quests.description: I usually do what I'm told, Hero, but I think you're going to have to trap the Mother TerrorDOOMKill by placing that sticky goo on her eggs. No cutting corners, either. You've GOT to put her at a disadvantage. We NEED to search her nest.

quests.name: Someday (Today) Their Mother Will Die
quests.description: Today's the day you're going to have to kill the mother TerrorDOOMKill. We NEED the Vigilette hiding in her nest. Don't think about her babies, Hero, or that she'll never again see the wings of her offspring making windmills as they try to fly. Just take her down!

quests.name: Dino Destroyer
quests.description: All of the dinosaurs are going to extinct eventually. You might as well help them on their way. Take out 100 Dinosaurs and you'll be the Prince of Prehistory!

quests.name: Defeat Drram
quests.description: The first round, you have to face down the Drram the dwarf giant. He has a bad habit of using the people he defeats to clean his teeth.

quests.name: Take On Tergum
quests.description: Round 2, you have to face Tergum, the dwarf giant. He has more experience in the area than Dramm did but my money is on you, kid.

quests.name: Smack Down Slork
quests.description: I'm so tired and I just can't shake it. I hope you're feeling better than I am. Slork is brutal and he's not going to go easy on you because you're a stand-in. Good luck.

quests.name: Crush Krashh
quests.description: Krashh is Munthor's second in command. I would take him on, but I can't even lift my head. It's all on you now.

quests.name: Win The Exhibition Match
quests.description: I can't believe those two traitors. If I ever get my hands on them… when I'm able to move my hands again… I'm gonna kill them! You've got to defeat them.

quests.name: Mow Down Munthor
quests.description: We're all feeling a little better but we're still down for the count. It's up to you to defeat Munthor. He's the only member of the Micro-Giants that I would consider a real threat. Be careful!

quests.name: Doom Metal Necro Class
quests.description: Now it is your turn to climb up on the Skull Dome Stage! Jongaar handed me instructions to teach you how to become a… Doom Metal Necro!? Oh, I get it! This is a know your enemy type of thing!

quests.name: Bad Reputation
quests.description: The French Horned Lizard is a monstrous beast that is always causing trouble on the outskirts of Mythsong City. With all the bands coming here for Lorestockapalooza, that is the kind of trouble that we can't afford. If you can take care of the beast and return to me with its horn, you would earn the respect of the city.

quests.name: Victims of Circumstance
quests.description: As Lorestockapalooza draws closer, the local musicians have begun practicing more than ever. Even though their melodies are music to my ears, the songs have attracted many beasts from the canyon's depths. I guess these monsters are just victims of circumstance, but regardless, they need to be stopped. Hunt down enough Tune-a-Fish, Beetles, and Grateful Undeads in order to obtain 10 Phony Ticket Stubs. Bring them back to me when you've finished the job!

quests.name: Like a Literal Pack of Wolves
quests.description: Every DoomPaladin has his trusty pack of rabid wolves. So, heh, in your world… do regular paladins have a fleet of yappy pomeranians or something? *cough* Uh huh.. moving on! If you wanna get that Shadowreaper of Doom, you will have to get past the DoomPally's defenses. Defeat 10 of his wolves and bring back undisputed proof of your success!

quests.name: Thin the Ranks
quests.description: Since a pack of wolves didn't faze you… you just might have what it takes to take-out the DoomPaladin after all. But you'll have to thin his undead army first if you hope to get that far in the quest chain. Ha! So come back to me when you have defeated 10 Skeletal Minions.

quests.name: Defeat Lieutenant Scarface
quests.description: With wolves and skeletons out of your way, there's only one more thing that's stopping you from havin' a go at Undead Artix: Lieutenant Scarface. I didn't come up with the name, so stop looking at me like that. Just… go do your thing, and come back when you've won.

quests.name: Locate the Lords of Order
quests.description: Have you found the Lords of Order yet? Well you need to. Kinda the whole reason you're here, right? Find where the Lords of Order are being held and come back to inform me of their whereabouts so I can give you the *dun dun duuuuun* FINAL QUEST!

quests.name: Defeat Undead Artix
quests.description: You are one brave hero, and now the time has come for you to confront the greatest DoomPaladin in all the world. I don't know if you have ever fought a normal Paladin… but don't expect a DoomPaladin to be any easier. If you can't save the world, I'm gonna have to start looking for another gig… good luck! If was nice knowin' ya!

quests.name: Disapoofed
quests.description: You can't go charging in there without knowing what you're dealing with. You need information, and I can help you get it if you share what you learn with me. I have treated this cloak with a disapoofing potion… it's an old assassin's secret recipe. You will be totally invisible for a little while. Sneak to the Gates of the Keep and try to touch them. Return with the cloak when you are done.

quests.name: Hoodwinked
quests.description: You've got to even the playing field a little if you want to survive your showdown with Vath. That means taking out some of my fellow Drow. Don't worry, all of my Breethen D'irt clan assassins are off duty, so you can attack any that you find. Use the Cloak of Disapoofing again and bring me 6 Assassin Hoods.

quests.name: Claws For The Cause
quests.description: In addition to his Drow soldiers, Vath also brought a phalanx of Chaorrupted Draconians with him. I'm sure you've seen them around. I need you to go get rid of some of them. Use the Cloak of Disapoofing and bring me 3 Draconian Claws as proof of your victory.

quests.name: Scrambled Eggs
quests.description: Getting rid of Chaos Draconians is one thing, but you need to end their cycle. Near here there is an entrance to a mountainside cave that was once the nesting ground for Terradactyls. The Draconians have begun using it as a hatchery to make more soldiers for Vath by chaorrupting the Terradactyl eggs there. It's too late for the eggs, so you'll have to go break them and bring me 12 Cracked Eggs as proof.

quests.name: The King's Wings
quests.description: Looks like you've got a problem. The King Terradactyl has gone into a rage after finding the eggs broken. You can't risk someone raising an alarm, so you'll have to get rid of the King Terradactyl. Bring me a pair of Terradactyl Wings.

quests.name: Bugging Out
quests.description: I've helped you by lending you the Cloak of Disapoofing, and now I need your help before I get you into Vath's keep. I've run out of disapoofing potion, and I need you to gather a few ingredients to the recipe from the local monsters. First, I'll need you to bring me 3 Beetle Glands from the local Rhino Beetle population.

quests.name: Lizard Gizzard
quests.description: When all the Dwarves were driven out, a lot of monsters moved into the Upper City with the Drow-including a huge Cave Lizard in a cavern close to here. That lizard's gizzard is the perfect catalyst for the disapoofing potion. Get me that gizzard, and I'll get you in to see Chaos Dragonlord Vath.

quests.name: Ancient Healer Knowledge
quests.description: A healer needs to know the right ingredients to create a powerful healing spell. Go into Swordhaven and gather some slime goo, then go to the farm and collect hay from scarecrows. Bring me back the ingredients so that I will have them on hand if I need them. (Bring back 1 Slime Goo and 1 Scarecrow Hay.)

quests.name: Ancient White Wizard
quests.description: The strength of a wizard comes from his staff. A good staff can serve its master to conjure quick and accurate spells - on the other hand a bad one can not even cast spells at all. Search for the finest ingredients and create your perfect staff. Get one Ferocious Wood from the Treeant at the Farm and 1 Purple Gem from a purple slime in the Cellar in the Inn!

quests.name: Ancient Protection
quests.description: As a healer you must be first and foremost a protector of your life and the lives of those who adventure with you. Go to Farmer Eastman's garden (in Willow Creek) and collect 6 snail shells so that we may study one of the best-protected creatures in nature.

quests.name: Ancient Light Ways
quests.description: Your brilliance is astonishing! I can see the potential in you. Let us keep finding the light so we can reach others and help this world in chaos. the source of evil is starting to make its presence felt in Bludrut Keep. We as Healers need to do our part in the struggle against evil, and at the same time learn all we can from it. Go into the depths of Bludrut Keep and bring light into the darkness. As I study their essence, I learn more about the evil that we face…but I need many specimens to learn as much as I can. (Bring back 5 rock essence and 5 fire essence to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Healer Knowledge
quests.description: A healer needs to know the right ingredients to create a powerful healing spell. Go into Swordhaven and gather some slime goo, then go to the farm and collect hay from scarecrows. Bring me back the ingredients so that I will have them on hand if I need them. (Bring back 1 Slime Goo and 1 Scarecrow Hay.)

quests.name: White Wizard
quests.description: The strength of a wizard comes from his staff. A good staff can serve its master to conjure quick and accurate spells - on the other hand a bad one can not even cast spells at all. Search for the finest ingredients and create your perfect staff. Get one Ferocious Wood from the Treeant at the Farm and 1 Purple Gem from a purple slime in the Cellar in the Inn!

quests.name: Protection
quests.description: As a healer you must be first and foremost a protector of your life and the lives of those who adventure with you. Go to Farmer Eastman's garden (in Willow Creek) and collect 6 snail shells so that we may study one of the best-protected creatures in nature.

quests.name: Light Ways
quests.description: Your brilliance is astonishing! I can see the potential in you. Let us keep finding the light so we can reach others and help this world in chaos. the source of evil is starting to make its presence felt in Bludrut Keep. We as Healers need to do our part in the struggle against evil, and at the same time learn all we can from it. Go into the depths of Bludrut Keep and bring light into the darkness.As I study their essence, I learn more about the evil that we face…but I need many specimens to learn as much as I can. (Bring back 5 rock essence and 5 fire essence to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Acolyte Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the Acolyte class) You have proven your worth - you are now an Acolyte. Sometimes however, these skill are not what is called for, but the look always is.

quests.name: Advanced Weaponry
quests.description: The product of Darkblood forging techniques and Dreadrock technology has yielded very interesting results. Retrieve 1 axe from the Primarch in /falguard and 12 axes from any of the local monsters to aid me in my metalworking experiments.

quests.name: Legion Sabotage
quests.description: The Undead Legion has a strong presence in this city…and I'm not a fan of it. Some of the Undead Champions have repeatedly stolen items from my shops. I want you to sabotage their operations here in the city by stealing 10 Legion Tokens and 12 Dreadrock Legion Blades from the Legion Sentinels.. Slowly but surely, the Legion will pay for the setbacks they've caused me!

quests.name: Jade Boxes
quests.description: Kage has stolen many small treasures from Miko over the years. Go defeat him and bring me any Jade Boxes you find. I will open them for you and reveal their contents.

quests.name: Dressed To Kill
quests.description: Each Horc tends to craft his or her own clothing, unless we need a armor. We could really use your help gathering resources for replacement clothes, if you have the time. We will need 3 Bolts of cloth from the local Boar, 3 Metal Decoration from the Rhison and Gather 10 Red Trollola Blossoms from the ground then return to me.

quests.name: Thinking Ahead
quests.description: Hero, I need your help with something. Bloodtusk provides us with everything we need but the Trolls keep taking resources for their silly games. By winter, it will all be gone and we will be without warms hides or medicinal herbs. Gather me 10 Red Trollola Blossoms, 5 Blue Vulture Feathers, and 5 pieces of Canvas Leather and i will store them for future. Move quickly before Trolls gather them all.

quests.name: Horchid Planting
quests.description: Once, K'thurr was surrounded by field of flowers called Horchids. They made the air smell so sweet, but the Trolls picked them all long ago. I've been trying to bring them back. Could you go around and plant these 7 Horchids bulps around the village and gather 5 Boar's Blood for fertilizer. Maybe together we can bring they back.

quests.name: Kaiju Naval Commander Recreation
quests.description: To convince the Kaiju Corsairs to give you the Kaiju Naval Commander, you'll need to bring them 1 Fish Lips, 5 Seaweed Salads, and 2 Sand-Wishes for 3 days. Find the grub on the monsters in the area.

quests.name: Kaiju Naval Recreation
quests.description: To craft a Kaiju Naval Commander, you'll need several items: 5 ropes of Seaweed, 2 vials of sand, and 1 tentacle. And, to prove that you are committed… you will need to give up your Naval Commander CLASS (and your class skill ranks).

quests.name: Portal War Medal
quests.description: Take out 5 of the scavengers, then turn in the quest on the war meter or by talking to Kairos to raise the war meter!

quests.name: Portal War Mega Medal
quests.description: Take out 3 of the scavengers, then turn in the quest in on the war meter or by talking to Kairos to raise the war meter.

quests.name: Time to Battle On! (Daily)
quests.description: Slay 5 of these stream-sucking Time Wraiths. I'll reward you with an EXTRA war medal, plus a Wraith wisp. Get enough Wisps and you'll be able to create gear made from starstuff. (The best stuff not on earth.)

quests.name: Time is running out...
quests.description: Slay 10 of the newly-hatched timestream scavengers to prevent them from growing into a BIG problem in the future! I'll reward you with THREE extra war medals, plus 10 Chronoglasses. Get enough Chronoglasses and you'll be able to create gear made from starstuff. (The best stuff not on earth.)

quests.name: Time never truly dies...
quests.description: The Neverborn was never meant to leave the Timestream, but time is NOT a linear thing. It will appear and re-appear until it runs out of energy… giving you a great opportunity to learn its tactics. Slay the Neverborn and I will reward you with a Chronus Gem!

quests.name: Ultra SN.O.W.
quests.description: Defeat Ultra SN.O.W.!

quests.name: Food for the Utoroshi
quests.description: The utoroshi who lives above the gates has our village blocked off! Normally it only attacks evil people, but all of this negative energy has been making it hostile to everyone. We can lure it down with its favorite food - sauteed reishi! But to make that, we need fire… and reishi!

quests.name: Summon Otoroshi
quests.description: Ok! Now you just set down his meal right under the shrine where he lives.

quests.name: The Conqueror of Glacera
quests.description: Karok's gear is yours, if you can handle wearing it. Prove you can withstand its cold touch by collecting the following:

quests.name: Fangs of Fearlessness
quests.description: I can help you defeat Kala, but you need to prove to me you are fearless enough to do this. Bring me the tusks of the deadly Leyak. You will find them in the same area as Rangda.

quests.name: Kala-mity time
quests.description: Kala has been summoned by the duplicitous, EVIL Ki Sama… and now, he seeks to wreak havoc on our world. It is up to you, my friend, to defeat him!

quests.name: Are you Useful?
quests.description: Still here, eh? How about you make yourself useful, then? The Makai that roam these lands are… well, a bit of a pest. Slaying some of them won't prove your worthiness, but it might make me like you a little better.

quests.name: Get the Seeds
quests.description: If you're going to keep skulking around, I'm going to keep putting you to work. Those Gargrowls out there? If you chip away at them carefully, you can sometimes find bits of Umbral Ore. I need some. What for, you ask? Let's just call it a "jewelry project" for now. There's nothing ominous about that, is there?

quests.name: Specimens
quests.description: You've proven yourself to be moderately useful. Maybe I can get your help once more. Some of my associates inside the fortress want to study the creatures here. If you can bring me a specimen of each, I'll make sure you're rewarded.

quests.name: Flex it!
quests.description: I see those muscles flexing. You want to show me your strength, don't you? I'm telling you, it won't make a difference, kid. But if you really want to try… why don't you see how you hold up against the Shadow Guardians? If you can best them, bring their medallions to me as proof.

quests.name: Caro-Kann Defense
quests.description: How about it? Do us a few favors and we'll give you information. Starting with those doves. The King's pets wear pearly white feathers and stare at us with their beady red eyes. Kind of obvious that they're spying on us but King Drago loves his reflection so much, he couldn't bear to go with crows. They're not safe to eat but slay a few and our lips will get looser.

quests.name: Materialism
quests.description: There are spies among the civilians, taking on their appearances and causing discord. You can tell just by how they attack you and their peers. Please apprehend these spies and I'll investigate if this is a play by King Drago to divide us.

quests.name: A Castled King
quests.description: With the spies dealt with, some of the citizens are more willing to speak. I hope your investigation bears fruit. I'm interested in what everyone feels safer to share besides the simplest of protest plans. Give the greedier mercenaries a beating while you're at it, but don't you go drop-kicking me by accident.

quests.name: Principle of Weakness
quests.description: While we were collecting information, some of the mercenaries have succumbed to the disease. Now the gates have flown open and the invaders are going to flood in. Please! Protect the citizens!

quests.name: Zugzwang
quests.description: The letter says that the enemy is rushing with the last of their full might to descend upon the Capital. If you leave to defeat them, the citizens will be left vulnerable to King Drago's wrath. If you stay, the invaders will swallow our home whole. Take out a wave of the invaders, I'll think of something.

quests.name: Dead Position
quests.description: I can hear them. The roar of the enemy's Commander. Ha, it almost reminds me of one of the King's Generals. He used to yell whenever we did well during our training drills, but was never this terrifying. Make no mistake, we believe in you. Go and defeat that monster. When you return, go to the outskirts of the border. The people will protect you. I promise your kindness will be repaid.

quests.name: Chopped HAMM
quests.description: We have to get those workers off the conveyor belt before they're chopped to bits! Destroy the conveyor belt control panels, and untie the workers so they can get out of here!

quests.name: Bad Dog
quests.description: We'll have to get past SN.O.W.'s Cyworgs to continue on to the next part of the factory. Kill 6 Cyworgs in the Processing District, and bring me their CPUs to prevent SN.O.W. from repairing them.

quests.name: Pink Slime, Yum!
quests.description: Holy cafeteria lunch, this is disgusting! The halls are congested with piles of pink slime! We can't do anything else until we clear some of it out of the way.

quests.name: Processed What?
quests.description: Those large globs of pink slime--I think those are the Slime District workers! Get them out of that slime before it's too late!

quests.name: Another Locked Door
quests.description: The door to the next part of the factory is locked, but one of the flying drones in the Slime District should have the keycode. Come back to me when you've found it.

quests.name: This Factory is On Fire
quests.description: The door to the Packaging District is singed--it must be on fire! We'll have to go to the Freezer District first. The black bags we use to pack the meat are fireproof. The Freezer Drones should have some unused ones. Bring them to me, and I'll make us some fireproof suits.

quests.name: Frozen... Food?
quests.description: Some of those hanging bags have Freezer District workers inside them! We have to get them out before they freeze! I'll finish our fire-proof suits while you rescue them.

quests.name: Fight Fire With Flammable Ingredients
quests.description: Let's use this fire to our advantage! You know what's flammable that we have right here? Lard. Collect 10 scoops of lard for me. I'm gonna pelt it at SN.O.W and burn him to the ground.

quests.name: The Last Lock
quests.description: SN.O.W. Is just behind that door. This time, he's split the keycode up between multiple drones. You'll have to collect fragments of it from the Freezer Drones until you have the entire thing.

quests.name: SN.O.W. Fall
quests.description: It's time to take SN.O.W. down for good and end this madness. Are you ready?

quests.name: Get the Keys
quests.description: I'm not so sure these barnacle-suckers even be real pirates. I be wonderin' what they really have in those treasure chests. If ye bring me some o' their keys, then we'll be able ta see for ourselves. Them scallywags would be likely ta have 'em.

quests.name: Open the Chests
quests.description: Alrighty, then. Let's see ye open those chests… and see what's in 'em!

quests.name: Interrogation Time
quests.description: We found no treasure, and that makes me wonder what business these privateers are really in. Only ones who's be able te tell us is the privateers themselves. but ye may have to pound it out o' em, if ye know what I mean. See if ye can get any o' em to talk to ye.

quests.name: Get the Picks
quests.description: If we want te know more, we'll have te look to Teja's "new first mate", Bloodbone. I don't think he'll be too forthcomin' though, so we'll break inta his quarters and have a look around. Bloodbone himself will have the only key, but I bet ye can get a set o' lockpicks off them scallywags. Come find me when ye have 'em.

quests.name: Break In!
quests.description: Ye have the lockpicks. Now ye get to break inta Bloodbone's quarters. Or try to, at least. I've know idea how good ye are at this son o' thing.

quests.name: Novice of the Coliseum
quests.description: Here for the main event of the week, are you? You don't seem to have much experience under your belt, but that hasn't stopped anyone in the past. Emerge victorious to reap the rewards.

items_required.name: Level 25 Boss Defeated x1 (stacks up to 2)

quests.name: Novice of the Coliseum (Legend)
quests.description: Here for the main event of the week, are you? You don't seem to have much experience under your belt, but that hasn't stopped anyone in the past. Emerge victorious to reap the rewards.

items_required.name: Level 25 Boss Defeated x1 (stacks up to 2)

quests.name: The Power of Pomade
quests.description: Achieving great hairstyles in this arid place takes a great amount of hair product. Using natural elements found in the Sandsea… like Bupers Camel Spit… gives my hair do's their defined look! Collect 7 vials of Camel Spit so I can work up a flexible workable pomade to create that distinctive Sandsea look!

quests.name: Salon Quality Shampoo
quests.description: The arid climate in the Sandsea is not good for keeping your hair silky smooth. What we need is a rejuvenating shampoo to keep it looking — and feeling — its best! A simple mixture of Cactus Oil and fragrant Sand Flowers will make any hair pop back to life. Find me these ingredients and I'll make your pockets and hair healthy!

quests.name: Scrap Metal
quests.description: If we're going to get this Elemental Mana Cannon functioning I'm going to have to make a few modifications. Head over to/dwakel/crashsite and gather as much scrap metal as you can. If they don't give you any willingly you might have to fight them for it. Any enemy there will do.While you do that I'll be heading over to swordhaven to see if the royal navy is intact. Maybe they can lend us a ship.

quests.name: Mana Holder
quests.description: I'm going to go to the Skyguard and see if they can lend us an airship. While I do that you should gather the resources we need to make one of my inventions… a mana cylinder. They hold liquified mana, an incredibly powerful and condensed form of the energy we use to cast spells. If we're going to modify a mana cannon we'll need a modified cylinder. Head over to /mafic and see if any of the living fire there have Mysterious molten metal.

quests.name: A Scoop Full of Mana
quests.description: Now that you you've got a modified mana cylinder you're going to need to fill it with mana. We need it done fast so visit the /elemental plane of magic where all the mana in lore comes from and fill it there.It's too dangerous for you to deal with liquid mana directly so kill mana imps and mana falcons until you fill the mana cylinder with mana droplets. While you fill up the mana cylinder I'm going to journey to Lolosia to see if I can charter a merchant ship for our voyage.

quests.name: Test it for... Magic?
quests.description: I've never made a mana cylinder quite like this one before so we'll need to make sure it's safe. We don't want giant elemental explosions after all. You'll have to go to my secret forge Once you get there you'll want to take the…mana…charge…….. I gave you an incredibly detailed explanation of how to safely test it and you fell asleep. Since you're not interested just go kill monsters in /gilead. If it doesn't explode it'll be safe for the canon. I'm going to follow up one more lead to get a ship.

quests.name: Shadow Shroud Potion
quests.description: We could storm on board and try to take the ship by force but it's always better to be a bit more prepared. I'd cast a darkness spell to shroud you in shadow so you can sneak on board without being noticed but I… nevermind. We'll make a potion instead. I have all the ingredients ready except darkness energy. Kill some of the undead pirates around here and you should be able to collect some.

quests.name: Plunder Their Supplies
quests.description: Normally we'd sneak explosives onto the enemy's ship and be done with it. However, this time we need to ship intact. We don't want a fire going starting or getting out of hand, or even an explosion going off when we storm the shift. Take the teleport runes and place them by any of their weapons, ammunition, explosives and other supplies.

quests.name: Crew Crushing
quests.description: It's time to begin the attack. At this point we just need to thin their numbers so that they can't overpower us. Lead the assault and cut their crew down to size. Defeating 15 Pirate Crew should take our the bulk of their force.

quests.name: Plunder Plans
quests.description: Now that we have the upper hand it's time to focus on our plans. I have a rough idea of where Blazebeard will strike first but I'd like to have more specific knowledge. Find the Pirate Plunderers and see if you can get information from them, maps, plans, rumors, anything. At any rate we'll be clearing the ship of more pirates.

quests.name: Keep On Battling
quests.description: You've done a good job at battling these pirates and without much damage to the ship either. Now you need to defeat the remaining Pirate Crew and Pirate Plunderers so we can secure the ship and make it ours.

quests.name: Kill the Captain
quests.description: We've defeated the crew and all that's left is the captain. He's not too tough so you shouldn't have too much trouble with him. The moment he is down we'll charge and sail straight for Blazebeard.

quests.name: New Pirate Class
quests.description: Arrrrrr. Avast me hearties! So ye've been around for a long time, have ye? And ye're wantin' to be a better kind of Pirate? So long as ye want to STAY a pirate, I can make that happen. Give me a Rusty Nail from the Undead Pirates and I'll give ye a token that ye can use to get a BRAND new Pirate Class!

quests.name: New Alpha Pirate Class
quests.description: Arrrrrr. Avast me hearties! So ye've been around for a long time, have ye? And ye're wantin' to be a better kind of Pirate? So long as ye want to STAY a pirate, I can make that happen. Give me a Rusty Nail from the Undead Pirates and I'll give ye a token that ye can use to get a BRAND new Alpha Pirate Class!

quests.name: Pre-Show Pumpkin Patch
quests.description: To prepare for the concert, we would like to give away free drinks. Can you see if any of the Cosplay Zombies here have any extra Pumpkin Seeds or Spice Packets, please? Defeat CosPlay Zombies to get 1 ''Pumpkin Seeds'', defeat 6 Caffiene Imps for 6 ''Spice Packets''.

quests.name: Darkovia Scarbucks Grand Opening
quests.description: Defeat Ravin' Skellys to get ''Barista Bones'', DeadMog to get ''Indie Tracks'', and CosPlay Zombies to get ''Engineering Wires'' and ''Dish Towels'' back

quests.name: Get Backstage Pass to CruxShadows
quests.description: The best way to get a Backstage VIP pass to see CruxShadows in Concert is to talk to the DragonKhan! He'll give you one… if you are worthy!

quests.name: BattleCon Souvenir Gear
quests.description: Defeat the Dead Moglinster for a chance to get ''DeadMog LEDs'' for the BattleCon Gear Merge Shop. Spend them wisely!

quests.name: Something To Learn
quests.description: Drakath may trust these cretins and their troops but I don't. What good are you and yours in a fight for our survival. But ah well, disobeying orders does not lead to survival either, and there is work to be done. We need to clear out the Infernal Goblins in those woods if we're going to position our troops before sunset. Want to go hunt some Infernal Ears for me?

quests.name: Knowledge is Power
quests.description: Well, you are turning out to be quite useful, if I keep this up Chaos will gain something from this fool's errand after all. Brentan and Gravelyn are more than eager to share the knowledge they have, if I can offer a token of knowledge of m own. Hero, go question some Grimspawn Blades about their numbers and get back to me. Bring me 10 horns as proof.

quests.name: Tainted Leaves
quests.description: What do these things even eat? We're just not sure yet. I keep trying different things to see what they'll take. I'm thinking they may need food that has the same monstrous taint that they do. Maybe we can find some in Brightoak? Bring me Fetid Fruit from the Tree Golems in /gaiazor, Blighted Venison from the Blighted Deer in /elfhame, and Wisterrora Leaves from the Wisterrora in /darkheart.

quests.name: How to Control a Dragon
quests.description: I've been thinking about Tara, and the way she used her ring to control powerful dragons. I wonder if something like that might be of use here? Some of the mages have agreed to try to craft me something, but they will need the raw materials. Bring me some Shadowstone, from the Shadowstone Elementals in Necropolis Cavern (/necrocavern); and some Elemental Silver from the Silver Elementals in the Tower of Mirrors (/towerofmirrors).

quests.name: Don't Inhale
quests.description: Sometimes, the trick in taming a wild animal is in convincing it you're part of its tribe. With that in mind - what if we coated our armor in the toxic bile and noxious fumes that are seeping out from these monsters' homeland? Bring me samples of both. I have some experimenting to do.

quests.name: Trust in the Vision
quests.description: I must have a memento from each of the creatures in the area! Fur, tusks, a pebble from the stone ones… it matters not! Except it is ALL that matters! Hahah! Bring them to me, Hero, 100 impressions, that I may share you with my vision!

quests.name: Frogzard Legs
quests.description: A fresh shipment of Frogzard legs just came in, and it's yours for the right price. Hand me a Dreadrock Donation Receipt, and I'll pack them up to go. What do you need them for? Opening a restaurant or something?

quests.name: Gorillaphant Tusks
quests.description: A fresh shipment of Gorillaphant tusks just came in, and it's yours for the right price. Hand me a Dreadrock Donation Receipt, and I'll pack them up to go. You and the piano factory are my biggest customers.

quests.name: Dragon Scales
quests.description: A fresh shipment of Dragon scales just came in, and it's yours for the right price. Hand me a Dreadrock Donation Receipt, and my suppliers will get to work. They're the real deal, Dragonslayers with pedigrees.

quests.name: Thirst Quencher
quests.description: Bring me three coconuts from the tree. You can get one for yourself too, if you'd like. But be careful, rumors said some of these trees are haunted!

quests.name: Gain the Rice Grains
quests.description: Telling stories with shadows and puppets is hungry work. You must join me and our audience for a feast to celebrate the eclipse! But first, we must hold a special ceremony and present an offering to the gods. Bring me 8 bowls of Rice from the Jelangkung.

quests.name: Finger Lickin' Good
quests.description: For me, Cemani dricken is the most unique in the world. With black skin, black flesh, black bones… Even its blood is black. It is a requirement for the ceremony we must hold before we can feast! Bring me 12 cups of Cemani Blood from the Drickens.

quests.name: Pulverized Puppets
quests.description: AI YAIIIII. I have just seen my puppets are broken; the Cemani Drickens have destroyed them! I will not be able to continue the show without them. Please get me the resources to create more, so I can continue the story after the ceremony! You will find the parts I need from the local flora and fauna — the Jelangkung, Cemani Dricken, and Treeant.

quests.name: Keris-tal clear
quests.description: Are you familiar with the keris? It is a traditional weapon — a wavy dagger — frequently used by the people of Nusantara for many events and ceremonies. We will need one to properly conduct the feast. Rangda might be hoarding them for nefarious purposes. But you can take one easily, I know!

quests.name: Ceremonial Reflection
quests.description: Every feast needs a proper offering, and that requires a mirror. To make sure OUR feast and the rest of the puppet show is successful, we require a very special, ANCIENT mirror. (There is ALWAYS an ancient mirror needed for rituals like this!) The Jelangkung should have what we need.

quests.name: An Honorable Offering
quests.description: I have prepared the pieces of the offering. As our honored guest, you may place them near the stage. The coconuts, Keris, Rice, mirror, and plate — all must be properly laid out.

quests.name: Iona the Isolated
quests.description: Queen Iona is dead, I made sure of it myself- but her throne is haunted by the grudges and greed of her bloodline. They coalesced into a phantom with centuries worth of Energy spells. It took her form, and only seeks destruction. Please, destroy it.

quests.name: Generational Tyranny
quests.description: When the people of Skye regain their footing, we'll be able to contend with this phantom ourselves. Until then, I would seek your aid in vanquishing this phantom of Queen Iona's tyranny. We'd be happy to reward you with treasures from the castle's armory.

quests.name: Eye of the Storm
quests.description: The memory of Queen Iona's heinous crimes lingers like a festering scar. Her family's blood-drenched magic manifested an image of her in the throne room of Castle Gaheris, what was once the Temple of Energy. Banish it, and let Skye live in peace.

quests.name: Under Orders
quests.description: I - I know what the soldiers were ordered to do, bring me and Amira to the King. But perhaps they had ulterior motives. Something that drove my poor mech a mss over the edge. Those Swamp Things were gathering up scraps of paper. If there were 13 soldiers, their should be 13 copies of their orders!

quests.name: Locket Holds the Key
quests.description: I think I can help you power my Amira 2.0 down, but we'll need the key that first the lock in her chest. Inside there are the gears that keep her going. If we stop those, she'll shut down, I keep the key in Amira's locket, but one of those Loup Garou or Lava Bats stole it while I wandered here, reminiscing.

quests.name: Plans Fit for a King
quests.description: That Lieutenant, Morris his name was. He was always such a good boy. He HATES how King is too royal to let us use his name! Mocks him by only using his rank. And he always used to keep a journal. If you cant find the journal he hid from his men, maybe we can learn more.

quests.name: Ladies First!
quests.description: Girls are Slimy! But not always, okay? Just the ones around here. With the slime things on their heads. Yeeeeuuuck. So let's fix that! Go all around town and knock those slimy things off every girl you see. Don't worry about the guys just yet…I bet they LOVE being covered in slime… So just come back to me when 6 chicks are slime-free, Hero!

quests.name: Slimy Boys
quests.description: The guys around here have gotten into more trouble than usual. I mean, I've seen them covered in green slime before… that they probably got it from their noses… but never this much! GEESH! Grab some heavy-duty tissues and let's clean up the town! …oh yea, your weapon will work just as well too. Free 6 Slimed Boys and then come back!

quests.name: The Slime Masquerade
quests.description: Now that you saved my biggest fans from some serious brain slurping, I think you're ready to save the whole town. Yup! So…we're gonna need to find the leader. Maybe Warlic will know something?

quests.name: ONE OF THEM
quests.description: Well would you look at that—you can totally pass as one of the slimed villagers now! Well… just as soon as you equip the goo on yourself. Just click the magical button on my speech bubble after you accept this quest and then head to the Guardian Tower and speak with Warlic! …uh yea, of course I'm SURE it'll work…

quests.name: Spilt Salt
quests.description: Aha! So the Slimes' weakness is Salt, huh? Kind of convenient how that all worked out… Anyway, If we wanna stop the Slime Boss guy, we're gonna have to break through that blockade! There's not much else you can fight in this zone… so start knocking every baddie out until you get enough salt.

quests.name: Defeat the Giant Brain Slime Prime
quests.description: Ok hero! Now you must enter Aria'a petshop and defeat the Giant Brain Slime Prime! The slimy leader of the slime monsters!

quests.name: That Hero Who Chases Slimes
quests.description: I love Swordhaven and it is my duty as King to make sure that all of the citizens of this great city are kept safe. Even though the undead army has been pushed back to Skulhome, some dangers still live. There are reports of evil slimes still roaming the city near the Pizza Shop. Apparently they think they are related to the gooey cheese found on those pizzas. Please do what you can to curb this infestation. Bring me 6 Slime in a Jar as proof of your triumph!

quests.name: Cleanliness Is Next To Kingliness.
quests.description: RATS! My knights tell me that filthy, disease carrying Giant Greenrats are swarming in the sewers. It will be impossible to remove all of the Greenrats from the city sewers but you must see what you can do reducing their population, or else they might begin spreading disease through the sewers. Bring me 8 Greenrat pelts from the sewers.

quests.name: Rumble with Grumble
quests.description: A horrible, mutant beast named Grumble roams the dark passageways of the sewer beneath our beloved city. It has defeated every single knight I have set against it… we need to defeat this evil beast before Gravelyn comes along and inducts it into her army of evil. Bring me Grumble's fangs as proof of his defeat.

quests.name: Tomb with a View
quests.description: You are beginning to earn quite a reputation with Swordhaven and the forces of Good, hero. I have another, more dangerous task for you now, if you think you have the strength. In the graveyard to the East, the skeletons have been showing signs of the Chaos infection. I have no love for these horrid creatures but if they become chaorrupted then we will have a whole new threat to face. Please, hero… bring me 5 Chaorrupted skulls so that my mages may combat the spread of this sickness. Not all of the undead have been infected so be prepared to slay many skeletons.

quests.name: Skele-tongue
quests.description: In the Graveyard to the East stands a huge skeleton named Big Jack Sprat. This undead construction seems to be a little smarter than his skeletal brothers. We believe that he is issuing commands that the other skeletons follow. if we knew the language that he gave his orders in then maybe we could command these poor creatures back into the grave. Bring me Big Jack Sprat's skele-tongue so we can begin to unravel the mysteries of undead speech.

quests.name: Battle Under Battleon
quests.description: Hero! A reliable source spoke to me about a skeletal army conspiring underneath the town of Battleon. I already sent the Paladin Yara to check things out, but I have yet to hear word from her. Head to Battleon and pay Warlic a visit in his Magic Shoppe — you may find something interesting in his books. Discover the whereabouts of this *Battle-under* and return to me with 6 Skeletal Army Contracts, proving your success.

quests.name: Brace-r Yourself!
quests.description: The town of Mobius is feeling the wrath of the 1st Lord of Chaos, Escherion. Although my best men have tried to keep the peace, Mobius is still flooding with Escherion's minions. Head to the quaint town in Chiral Valley and slay the Cyclops Raiders near the village — or what's left of it. Return to me when you have collected 8 Raider Bracers. Hurry!

quests.name: Enter the Crypt
quests.description: Your ﬁrst task is to descend into the Crypt - find out what happened to my Knights that were stationed there to guard against Sepulchure's Chaos-infected armour. Go to the /chaoscrypt and find out why the Knights have stopped reporting in! Sir Kuss should be stationed outside - speak to him first!

quests.name: Aries Tammuz
quests.description: You will notice a library when you enter the Observatory. Our family did not build the entire structure. The first King merely built around the ancient ruins. Above is the real Observatory. Move past the shelves until you reach a locked door. There is a contraption on the wall that resembles a button. Press it to unlock the door. Do not be alarmed when you feel a sting. It is taking a sample of your blood to verify that you are of royal lineage.

quests.name: Scorpio
quests.description: Be aware of your surroundings. The Observatory became forbidden to all but the ruler of Astravia. As you may have noticed, neither I nor my predecessors were able to keep beasts from taking shelter inside. Activating the door would have made a lot of noise. I assume the scorpions will scuttle towards the source. Crush them or else they'll be a nuisance later.

quests.name: Leo
quests.description: Lions prowl the snow fields surrounding the Observatory. They use our hallowed grounds as their den. Normally, they won't pay you any mind if they see that you're too much trouble to hunt. After fighting off the scorpions, they will begin stalking you, believing you are weakened. Fight them off. I know they'll be nothing to you.

quests.name: Lugal-irra Meslamta-ea
quests.description: Once the door to the depths unlocks, take the utmost amount of care. The moment you ascend the ladder, be ready to fight and run. Turrets, the original models from which our castle's security system is based on, will take aim and shoot at you. Their self repair systems are incredibly quick. Destroy the two turrets repeatedly until the self repair systems become stalled.

quests.name: Virgo Shala
quests.description: It will only become more dangerous from this point onwards. Many of your deceased ancestors lost their chance at the crown because they rushed forward without care. Take caution and scout ahead. Learn and become accustomed to these strange surroundings without alerting the…creatures.

quests.name: Sagittarius Pabilsag
quests.description: The creatures that drag their malformed limbs around the halls of the observatory are fearsome, but pitiful. Now that you have scouted the area and watched them from afar, cut the creatures down. They will chase you if you try to get into the inner sanctum behind the locked hatch. Best to hunt them, and save the carcasses for later.

quests.name: Libra Shamash
quests.description: There exists a record in the Observatory called a Black Box. One that refers to the Observatory as a ship instead of a building. How strange, the ship supposedly traversed the stars instead of the sea. I can not fathom the idea of a ship journeying beyond Lore let alone make sense of what was happening in this Black Box. Read the record if you wish. Perhaps you will see a truth that I could not.

quests.name: Auriga
quests.description: The final locked door lies between you and our origins. This barrier held such importance that the first King's men risked and sacrificed their lives to modify it. No longer can it be opened by a key or code. It will only open when it detects that a sufficient amount of blood has been shed. If the amount of creatures you have slain is not enough, bring more limbs until the door recognizes your strength. If the turrets reactivate, destroy them again.

quests.name: Pisces Alrescha
quests.description: The first King rests under his telescope. He returned to the observatory, hoping to find and reunite with his Queen. Pay your respects to your ancestor, and continue to the heart of the Observatory. Before you will be a gate. Beyond rests the truth of Astravia's birth and yours. Touch the monitor by the gate, and brace yourself.

quests.name: Taurus Gugalanna
quests.description: There are disgusting limbs scattered all over the place. Darkon butchered them and they're too damaged to properly research. Soldier, go back into the Observatory and collect intact samples. It doesn't matter how many warm bodies you need to throw at the monsters before they stop moving. Just get it done.

quests.name: Host of Honor
quests.description: The duties of a gala host don't end until the last guest takes their leave. The Sisters are running out of hors d'oeuvres, the Gargoyles keep shaking off their Mogloween decorations, and the ballroom keeps getting messy. I'm sure there's another sweet waiting for you if you help!

items_required.name: Grilled Shroom Caps x6 (Stacks up to 30)
Unborn Brood Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 5)

quests.name: Warlord Icewing!
quests.description: Looks like you've made it all the way to the end. What do you think - it is time to try your luck against ME? If you think you're up for it, then fight your way past my guards. I'll be waiting for you.

quests.name: Warlord Icewing! (Member)
quests.description: Looks like you've made it all the way to the end. What do you think - it is time to try your luck against ME? If you think you're up for it, then fight your way past my guards. I'll be waiting for you.

quests.name: Amethite, Am I Right?
quests.description: Not only does the Calcifying process kill its victims, it controls their bodies afterwards. Free these Amethites from their terrible fate as Grou'luu's puppets.

quests.name: Reinforcements Deployed
quests.description: If we are going to finish this fight soon, we are going to need reinforcements. Scout ahead and show our men where the best place for them to deploy is!

quests.name: Wyrms Below
quests.description: The Wyrms in the area have also succumbed to Grou'luu. We will have to go through them if we are going to locate it and the Orb.

quests.name: Lair Located
quests.description: We have found the entrance to Grou'luu's lair. You will have to clear the calcification that blocks the way, as well as whatever lurks below.

quests.name: Fallen Nopperabo
quests.description: While many of the Yokai fight alongside the residence of Akiba, some have fallen to the spell of the Queen. The Nopperabo were one such group. Free them from her spell so that we may move forward.

quests.name: Samurai of Jaaku
quests.description: Jaaku is a shogun with many Samurai in his ranks. If we are to have any hope of defeating him, we must go through them as well. Take out any Shadow Samurai that may get in your path.

quests.name: Constructing the Portal
quests.description: Jaaku has begun an assault on the Yokai Realm! We must stop him! We will need to create a portal to the Yokai Realm and stop Jaaku before he can cause any damage to our Realm! Collect Yokai Energy from Samurai Nopperabo and Shadow Energy from Shadow Samurai so that we can construct the portal.

quests.name: Into the Yokai Realm
quests.description: It appears that more Yokai have fallen under the Queen and Jaaku's influence. We must stop them like any other enemy! Take out the Tsukumo-Gami that stand against us.

quests.name: Jaaku's Shadow
quests.description: This can't be! Jaaku has split himself into many Shadows! Together they are just strong as the original! Take out the Shadow that plagues the Yokai Realm and return to me!

quests.name: The Forces of Jaaku
quests.description: We must make our way to Jaaku now! If he continues to make Shadows we will never defeat him! Our only option is to strike him down now! First, his forces stand in our way! Do not stop until they are all put down!

quests.name: The Wind Orb
quests.description: We must separate Jaaku from the Wind Orb! Take him and his Shadows out with no mercy!

quests.name: Dressed to Kill
quests.description: I've been commissioned to make a one-of-a-kind dress for a very important client – so I need some very special materials. Being the tiny wyvern that I am, I can't collect these things myself. But YOU can help! Bring me, oh let's see… opaline scales from Waterstorm Fishwings, crystal tentacles from Crystallized Jellyfish in Earthstorm, and 4 gorgeous horns from the Firestorm Sulfur Imps. Yes, yes, that will be perfect!

quests.name: Only The Strong Survive Today
quests.description: I am your leader. You shall obey. Are you the predator or are you the prey? Only one is worthy of fighting in my name. Bring me the following blades and helms from the creatures in the Underworld, and we shall see how loyal you really are.

items_required.name: Legion Champion Medal x5 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Crush the Weak
quests.description: I will not accept less than utter devotion. The Legion spreads like a virus. Rid the Underworld of this plague. Bring me the following blades and helms from the creatures in the Underworld, and we shall see how loyal you really are.

items_required.name: Legion Champion Medal x5 (Stacks up to 100)

quests.name: Speak no Legion Evil
quests.description: Dage’s Legion of Lycan warriors cannot spread the word of his power if they cannot SPEAK! Bring me 100 Lycan Tongues to prevent Dage’s Legion from gathering more followers. Return and there will be a fiendishly-epic reward.

quests.name: Explore the Void Path
quests.description: Good, you've arrived. My sources tell me that… thing the undead have been petitioning is here in the Void. This is a very strange, unstable realm. It is wise to know the lay of the land before you charge into battle. Explore it a bit, and then return to me.

quests.name: Void Spell
quests.description: The path you took is highly unstable due to the nature of the Void. Can you sense the instability, too? It makes reality feel… shaky. If we want to ensure our return, we'll need to cast a Void Stabilization spell. My friend Nythera, the Void Mage, told me how. I'll need your help to secure the material to activate it. I hear you can find it in the /Northlands.

quests.name: Know Thy Enemy
quests.description: Alright, Hero. We've got to work fast and battle hard if we're going to save Lore from the Desterrat Moya. Whispers say he feeds on the hopes of supplicants, but loses strength when his minions die. Stabilize each of the teleporters you find as you are on your search. Find him and take out any of his followers that get in your way.

quests.name: An Enemy Unblooded
quests.description: It appears the tales of the Desterrat Moya are right. He DOES lose strength when his minions die. That's good luck for us and BAD luck for him. Take out 10 of his Cruors to get a Drop of Life and 4 of his Cruxs to get a Breath of Life to weaken his corporeal form. Return to me and we'll plan what to do next.

quests.name: Re-Open the Seal
quests.description: It follows that if the Desterrat Moya became strong enough to open the gate containing him once, then he can do it again. It appears to be sealed, though. I am certain that washing the gate's seven access points in the Desterrat Moya's ichor - an ethereal fluid flowing through his form - will open it.

quests.name: Weaken the Moya
quests.description: The Desterrat Moya needs to be weaker. The fastest way is to take out a large number of his followers, and the quickest way to do THAT is to slay the Necromancer that controls them. Take down 13 of Arasat's Ectomancers in Doomwood. He will be so drained, his followers will perish, and the Moya will lose strength. Then return to the Void. You may even receive a token of my appreciation.

quests.name: Banish the Banished One
quests.description: It is time to send the Desterrat Moya home. It cannot be left this close to us and our home. Not to mention that its presence could cause ALL of the undead to rise up in rebellion! Take down the Desterrat Moya; if we can't finish him for good, we can at least send it home!

quests.name: Become the Desterrat Moya (Daily)
quests.description: Kill 10 Cruor and 10 Crux to steal his ichor and aether. In time, you may become as strong as the Desterrat Moya is!

quests.name: Prevent the Return (Daily)
quests.description: The Desterrat Moya may be gone for now, but undead minions will continue to beseech it no matter where it is imprisoned. Keep reducing the Moya's strength by eliminating its supporters. Slay 15 Doomwood Soldiers, 10 Ectomancers, and 1 Cryptkeeper Lich, all found in Doomwood.

quests.name: Koofu Rider Twilly's Gift
quests.description: Greetings, Hero! To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, Twillies has a present for you. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness

quests.name: Koofu Rider Zorbak's Gift
quests.description: Meheheh! To thank you for your loyal support of AdventureQuest Worlds, I've got a gift for you, and you know I don't give those often. Click the button below to get your very own Golden Item of Donated Awesomeness

quests.name: Defender Armor (StarLords)
quests.description: As renowned protectors of alternate universes, Defenders understandthe sacrifices one must make during combat. Defenders will see to it that what they start always ends in victory.

quests.name: Strange Creatures
quests.description: Ever since the fighting started, more and more of these Abumi Guchi have been showing up - creatures formed from the stirrups of fallen soldiers. Slay as many as you can, and come back to me.

quests.name: Arm the Militia
quests.description: We have a small militia who are expected to fight alongside Jaaku's Shadow Samurai. If we could arm the rest of the village, the militia could fight against the Shadow Samurai rather than with them. Defeat the samurai, and take their weapons and armor for my people.

quests.name: Burn the Bones
quests.description: Many of the spirits that haunt this valley are the restless ghosts of fallen soldiers. We can keep this at bay, to some extent, by cremating their bones. Use the flames from the Kosenjobi to do this.

quests.name: Sometimes Losing is Winning
quests.description: Too bad! I really would have liked to show you around Akiba. Oh well, as is said, those who chase two hares won't even catch one.
