Well, I can't exactly collect items from you this way, so… can you do me some favors instead? Either clean up some trash in the area, or slow down some of the Crystallis for me!

quests.name: Decorate Your Space
quests.description: Isn't this place just so…peaceful? Hey traveller, wouldn't you like to take home some souvenirs? I have some things you can have but…you need to help out the citizens in Akiba first. I heard that the locals would like to visit their loved ones but the graveyard is always overrun by local creatures. We should head to /yokaigrave to help them out to make them feel safe!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Acquiring Ancient Secrets
quests.description: If you are to tap into a portion of the Eternal Dragon of Time's power, you must first know more about its strength.

quests.name: Time to Train Yourself
quests.description: Now that you've recovered more knowledge of the Eternal Dragon of Time, you should learn more about the powers that all dragons possess. Cross swords with Desoloth in /dragonchallenge, Goregold in /greed, Victorious in /darkplane, and the adult Trigoras in /trigoras to understand the ferocity you possess. You'll need plenty of patience if you're to continue this journey too— I hear Nythera in /blindingsnow knows a thing or two about that, but good luck finding her!

quests.name: Do You Have the Time?
quests.description: The next step in your training is to harness the power of time travel.

quests.name: Through the Wormhole
quests.description: You must now use your strength to defend existing timelines from those who would alter it.

quests.name: Rend
quests.description: The time has come for you to learn the skills that grant a dragon formidable strength in combat. Their simplest weapons are among the most deadly: powerful, dimension-ripping claws.

quests.name: Confluence of Fates
quests.description: You learned how claws can rend flesh. Now apply the same technique to rend the fabric of space.

quests.name: Dragon's Will
quests.description: Take what you have learned by studying the power of dragons, time, and space and assert your will over your enemies. Absorb their essence into yours.

quests.name: Burning Fates
quests.description: You may be a mortal… maybe… but I sense a fire burning inside you. To control your fate, you must learn to control that fire. The best way for you to do that is by studying how other fire elementals do it!

quests.name: Hero's Heartbeat
quests.description: You've learned all that is necessary to battle as the Eternal Dragon of Time does. But now you must build your legacy as the Hero this world needs.

items.name: Dragon of Time Character Page Badge

quests.name: I'm Loving It My Way
quests.description: Phew, that was a lot of work, I'm starving! I could really go for a…

quests.name: Shadow Embargo
quests.description: I tailor all of my gear with the highest-quality materials in all of Lore. I used to get shipments of Shadow Canvas imported from Skullholme every week, but as of late, the shipments have just stopped. I do not have the time to travel there myself to pick up the material… so perhaps you could go instead? Head to Bludrut Keep and get me 5 yards of Shadow Canvas from the Shadow Creepers in the 2nd Floor Basement. In exchange, I will award you every day you bring me more Shadow Canvas.

quests.name: Vote for Gravefang
quests.description: Slay 10 minions of the Cor Mortis to show that you know *I* am the strongest, BEST ruler of Darkovia's vampires. Even if I AM a Werepyre.

quests.name: Give Solani a Message
quests.description: There is NO power stronger than mine! And that she-bat thinks to charm and sway with her poisoned honey and poisoned blades. Defeat her to show that I cannot be overcome!

quests.name: Who's That?
quests.description: Stellaria has asked you to protect the town. Maybe you should see if that scared-looking kid is okay.

quests.name: Find my Stuff
quests.description: I've lost track of some of my stuff since the monsters attacked. One of them stole my pet bunny, and I dropped my journal and the medallion my dad left me while I was running away. Can you help me find them?

quests.name: Save my Friends
quests.description: Please, can you save my friends? I haven't seen them since the monsters attacked, and I'm worried about them.

quests.name: Pull the Wires
quests.description: So, I've been watching those CryptHackers. You see the wires that hang down from them? I think that's how they get you. Those things go into your brain and take control of it. Maybe if you could get some of those wires, someone could figure out how to reverse it.

quests.name: Dress-up Time!
quests.description: I wish there was more I could do to help, but I'm still pretty small. Not like you and Stellaria.

quests.name: I Need a Distraction
quests.description: I think I'm ready. I just need you to cause a really big distraction for me, okay? Like… maybe just go fight a bunch of them so they're paying attention to you and not me.

quests.name: Extinguished Eridanus
quests.description: Constellations that are not part of the Zodiac hold their own sort of power, but are out of my specialty. No time like the present but to learn! I'm currently studying the constellation Eridanus. I'll tell you about its legend after we hunt for starshards. There's a town with a name very similar to the constellation. Head to /Eridani and find any animal-like creatures to search for star shards.

quests.name: Mourning Cygnus
quests.description: Cygnus, found in legends studied by Arcangrove, is related to the story of Eridanus. Before I tell you the constellation's story, we should be looking for a pristine white city. It was where the titicular Cygnus was born, and the closest match I could find was /astravia. I skimmed through the books we have on Astravia because I was short on time, but the pictures look nice! Go there and see any of the local Creatures have star shards.

quests.name: Heat of Battle
quests.description: The Firestorm Onslaught sentries have been spotted on our shores. They MUST be stopped before they can report back to their squad leader. Take out 3 Flame Soldiers and 3 Storm Scouts. Report back to me.

quests.name: Light the Flame
quests.description: Embersea was once a bright, happy place, full of light and laughter. Now, residents are scared to walk the streets. But we still need to keep the city lit. Light all the torches, then take out 4 of the Living Lava beasts; their heat will fuel our fires. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: Endless Aisle of Chaos
quests.description: Fight the monsters in each frame of the endless aisle to reach Princess Tara. Cannot pass to next frame until all monsters in current frame are dead.

quests.name: Save the Princess... Again!
quests.description: Battle the Chaos Dragon in Princess Tara's ring.

quests.name: Reishi, Lingzhi, and Shroom
quests.description: The Yokai Isles used to be a misty mystery just off the coast, but now they've become free to welcome travelers and open up trade. They're generous about souvenirs too! I hate to admit this, but on the boat ride back, I ruined the bamboo and mushrooms I was gifted while trying to make tea. Could do me a favor and head to the site of the /shogunwar to get me Bamboo Treeant and Reishi replacements?

quests.name: Infinity Sand Pool
quests.description: Greenguard, in the time of the old Kings, feared that the desert of the Sandsea would one day spill into Greenguard Territory. The fighting used to be fierce, but those days are long gone, taking the old tyrannical royal families with them. The people of the Sandsea had been nothing but kind to me, and I noticed there was trouble in /sandport. Would you please help them by warding off the Sandsharks and Robbers?

quests.name: Beware of Rock Dog
quests.description: I would love for more adventurers like you to feel more comfortable coming to the nobles with your worries, but there are an oddly high amount of monsters roaming the castle grounds. The nobles are protected by their knights or their own combat skills, but a farmer or craftsman would be in a lot of trouble. Would you please clear some of the gargoyles and castle spiders to make it safer for the common folk to visit?

quests.name: Frogzard Wellington
quests.description: Have you been inside the castle? Then you might have met my Father, Lord Leofric Cavendish. He's here to speak with the King on my mother's behalf. Father is also looking to make friends with other nobles. That will prove to be difficult. But he's a wonderful chef. Would you please travel to /greenguardwest and bring back some frogzard tails? He could cook his signature dish and invite nobles to a meal.

quests.name: Pest Proof
quests.description: Many nobles are visiting Swordhaven Castle to have an audience with the royal family. A friend of mine is a noblewoman from the Surewood area, and an expert in agriculture. Unfortunately, some of the crop samples she took with her were tampered with when she was occupied with her travel papers. Would you please help her get replacements from Seed Stalkers and Fungal Lords in /twistedcavern?

quests.name: Deadly Hobbies
quests.description: Though my family protects the plateaus outside of Darkovia, my knowledge of spirits and ghosts is a work in progress. In that regard, coming to Swordhaven castle has helped. The nobles here are fascinated with ghost stories, and the wraiths that roam the towers. But what of spirits from farther away? I have heard that there are wraiths in a place called /deadmoor. If it's possible, would you travel there to find them?

quests.name: Stained Steel
quests.description: I saw Lord Henry Vaughn in the castle. His house protects the Western Valleys near the Sandsea. Chiral Valley is under Lord Vaughn's jurisdiction, but he and his knights were forbidden by King Alteon from participating in wars or battles. There's a place called /horde where Horde Knights lurk. Would you retrieve their weapons so I could send them to the Valley's people? That way, they can protect themselves.

quests.name: Earning Your Stripes
quests.description: With the tiger being seen as a destroyer of evil in Chinese myth, many parents will clothe their children in clothing featuring tigers, or tiger patterns, to ward off misfortune. If we wear tiger patterns, it would both honor Umitora and hopefully prevent a disaster. The spiders and their kin who dwell in Ravenloss have supplies we can use to sew some.

quests.name: A New Year in Bloom
quests.description: Even tigers appreciate a little beauty sometimes, and the king here is no exception. His favorites, of course, are Tiger Lilies, but he's also partial to the flowers of the Tiger Sign. The local Bamboo Treants, Lingzhi fungi and Xingzhi will usually have plenty of flora growing on them. Bring back the most terrific, astounding and complimentary around!

quests.name: The Eye(s) of the Tiger
quests.description: The excitement here is rising up, but Umitora is unamused. He will not be satisfied until ALL of Lore's eyes are gazing upon him. Get back on the street and bring us some! There are plenty near Mobius and the Ebonslate Fortress, and I hear of thousand-eyed creatures in Greenguard Forest. One such beast even crashed a Battle Wedding!

quests.name: A Royal Feast
quests.description: The most important thing to any tiger is a good meal. Unfortunately, Umitora is a picky eater. He will only accept the highest quality meat… and prefers it directly from other Zodiac Creatures in Akiba! He is partial to Boar and Ox meat, but his favorite is Rat (he says it tastes like lean pork.. still gross), so get plenty of that. If you carve it, we'll cook it.

quests.name: Winning Streak
quests.description: Tigers rarely form groups, but when they do, they're called ‘streaks'.There are some strong tigers that Umitora sees as members of his. Defeating them- the White Tigers in /creatures, Cinderclaw and his tigers at /phoenixrise, and Shadowclaw (who fought in the /fireplanewar) will prove that you are more worth his time than they are.

quests.name: Yin and Yang
quests.description: The traditional depiction of the Taiji, often called the Yin-Yang symbol, is often accompanied by images of a Dragon and a Tiger. They are seen as the avatars of Yin and Yang, forever in conflict. I hear of a seven-headed dragon that lurks at the /shadowfortress… slaying it would show both your strength and loyalty to the Yang itself.

quests.name: Tyger, Tyger, Burning Bright
quests.description: Umitora is almost done with his dinner, and just in time! The performance and celebration will begin shortly as well. But there's one last thing we need: fireworks! We can make a truly grand entrance by lighting some of the bombs carried around by the Lin Kuei assassins using the flames of Fiery Lanterns. Go get us some and we'll be all set.

quests.name: Tame That Tiger!
quests.description: I'm sorry to put a damper on the New Year's celebration, Hero, but if Umitora continues lashing out, there won't BE a New Year for this island. I hate to keep asking for your help, but it's up to you to show this tiger what happens to spoiled brats. Just be careful: he wouldn't be a ruler if he didn't have the strength to back that title up!

items_required.name: Great Tiger Tamed x1 (Stacks up to 10)

quests.name: Fisticuff Tourney
quests.description: The Nobles' Knights are quarreling again! All this noise they're making is going to disturb the Queen! May I ask that you keep them from squabbling? I'll give you a free snip the next time you're at my salon.

quests.name: Local Seafare
quests.description: Queen Victoria trusted me with handling matters of hospitality, and I severely underestimated the amount of food the nobles would gorge on. Oh, where to get more Seafood…Ah! You know a place? The /TwilightZone for Lamprey? Would you mind delivering some to us?

quests.name: Vote for Solani
quests.description: Slay Ensis 10 times in a row to prove that the Cor Mortis is the strongest faction… and that I am the right ruler for Darkovia's vampires! Show that his endurance and strength are the greatest!

quests.name: Give Kurok a Message
quests.description: Ah, my friend, I greet you! I would ask a favor of you, if I may. Kurok Gravefang, he thinks to rule the Darkovian vampires, but has neither the finesse nor the skill to do so. Defeat him. Show him it takes more than brute strength and growling to rule US!

quests.name: Sticking it to the Undead
quests.description: The women of Lightguard Keep are FAR from helpless! But many of them need more formal lessons in self-defense. I'd like to teach them bow-fighting. But for that, I need more staves! Can you harvest wood from Doomwood Treants and leather for handgrips from the Undead Soldiers?

quests.name: Walking Wounded
quests.description: It's hard to keep a good Soldier down. They're either fighting wounded or wounding other fighters! "Resting" isn't in their vocabulary! So to keep the walking wounded fighting as comfortably as possible, I need more bandages! Gather cloth from 10 Ectomancers so I can rip them into new wound-dressings.

quests.name: Dead-forestation
quests.description: DoomWood treants have infested the woods, crowding out healthier, green trees. To make matters worse, the DoomWood Soldiers have been chopping down the healthy trees. You've set out to save the people of DoomWood, but we can't forget the flora of DoomWood!

quests.name: Ecto-Skeleton Armor-Enabler
quests.description: Most creepy-crawlies you find here in DoomWood have a hard exoskeleton which protects them. We've modeled some of our armors on it. But with the appearance of these Ectomancers, we're wondering if we can improve the magical properties of our soldiers gear. Bring back 10 Ectomancer Ecto-Orbs so that we can experiment.

quests.name: Let's Make a Deal
quests.description: This is how I work: you want the thing, I give you the thing, but like any good deal, we need a contract! Bring me 10 Fresh Souls from any of the Guards or Inquisitors in the /citadel, then we can discuss about prices. More power, means more work, which means more souls! Easy, huh? Then go get some! Oh, don't forget you need to do it in my name. It will make sure the Soul will come right to me.

quests.name: Summoning and Stuff
quests.description: A powerful and handy weapon you say? I have something in mind! but let me think… summoning… paradox… space manipulation… some good extra sauce… yep, it won't be cheap at all. Bring me these ingredients AND the payment, don't forget about it. Ugh… our ''Archfriend" won't be happy about it, but whatever. Just go!

quests.name: Trading and Stuff (Single)
quests.description: Oh, you own the Oblivion Blade of Nulgath sword? Well then, let's make this a little easier for you. A powerful and handy weapon you say? I have something in mind, but- oh? you have the thing already. Great! Bring me just some ingredients AND the payment, don't forget about it. Ugh… our ''Archfriend" won't be happy about it, but whatever. Just go!

quests.name: Trading and Stuff (Dual)
quests.description: Oh, you own the Dual Oblivion Blades of Nulgath sword? Well then, let's make this a little easier for you. A powerful and handy weapon you say? I have something in mind, but- oh? you have the thing already. Great! Bring me just some ingredients AND the payment, don't forget about it. Ugh… our ''Archfriend" won't be happy about it, but whatever. Just go!

quests.name: ArchFiend Dragon Egg
quests.description: Oh my, what do we have here? I would recognize this egg from miles. It is said the Archfiend Dragons were savage, loyal and unstoppable. Which doesn't make sense since there aren't any of them left now. If you don't have a grown up Archfiend Dragon to hatch your egg, you would probably need a powerful being to do it for you. Where would you find such a being in a place like this? Ha! You got it. All I need is these ingredients, and a little help from an old friend of mine… good luck with that and DON'T forget the souls!

quests.name: Lullaby
quests.description: "War has finally found us. We won't let any greedy King turn you into their weapon. For all that you have done for us - sleep now, great Deva, and one day may you rise in peace." Will you help us grant their wish? It would be the perfect finish to a wondrous Mogloween spell.

quests.name: The Lake Hydra
quests.description: The Hydra has risen! It's heads just grow back so you can't defeat it, but maybe you can recapture it! Some runestones have appeared around the lake. You will need 9 Hydra Fangs to shatter the runes, and toss the remains in the bonfire we have set up to destroy them forever! I hope this works….

quests.name: Examine the Area
quests.description: This land has seen a lot of carnage, and I'm not sure what is left of the city it used to be. Before we do anything else, we have to explore the area. Let me know what you find, and then we'll consider our next move. (Quest completeable once per login session)

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: Dage has that teleporter locked down tight - it has to be activated by 4 of his Commanders simultaneously. There are usually 2 Commanders stationed inside that bunker we found, but first we'll have to get it open. One of the Gunners out here should have the key.

quests.name: Obtain Agravh's Soul
quests.description: Now that you have the key, you'll be able to go to the bunker you found and unlock its hatch. Inside you'll find a Legion Commander named Agravh. Defeat him, and collect his sou. Dage - your Dage - can use it to activate Agravh's part of the teleporter.

quests.name: Obtain Uslaw's Soul
quests.description: You should be able to use that same key to unlock the bunker's inner door. In that second room, there will be another Legion Commander named Uslaw. Find him, and obtain his soul.

quests.name: Access the Control Room
quests.description: Next you're going to head into those ruins you found. There's a door leading into a control room - it'll be locked, but it's not very sturdy. You should be able to break it down.

quests.name: Destory the Force Field
quests.description: I guess they have realized that door wasn't very sturdy if they've got a force field set up, too. But that's ok - it's just a minor setback. The Force Field Generator will be in the hands of one of the UW3017 Blasters. Find that, and you'll be able to shut it down. (Quest completeable once per login session)

quests.name: Obtain Ozar's Soul
quests.description: With the force field down, there is nothing standing in between you and Commander Ozar. Find him, defeat him, and bring back his soul.

quests.name: Obtain Pavon's Soul
quests.description: The last soul you'll need is that of Commander Pavon. Go back into the ruins, and look for the ladder leading up to the roof. That's where you'll find him.

quests.name: Activate the Teleporter
quests.description: Now that we have all 4 souls, we can turn on the teleporter. The teleporter is surrounded by 4 pillars - each soul activates one of them. They must be activated in the right order! If you get the order wrong, you'll have to start over.

quests.name: Keep It Grounded
quests.description: We're going to need to make sure this ship doesn't leave before we can get to Future Dage. See those fuel cells along the walls? Smash as many as you can find. That will buy us some time. While you're at it, clear out some of the Future Legion numbers inside the ship, too. Later on, we'll be glad we did. (Quest completeable once per login session)

quests.name: Get the Code
quests.description: See the big door at the end of the hall? We'll have to get through to find Future Dage. Trouble is, we're going to need the access code to get in. You'll need to get 6 fragments of code from the SF3017 Gunners, and then decrypt it using the code keys that the SF3017 Blades carry.

quests.name: Open the Door
quests.description: Now that you have the decrypted access code, you can use it to get into the Captain's Chamber. You'll need to interact with the keypad on the door, and input the correct data to complete the circuit.

quests.name: Take out the Legionator
quests.description: He sent the Legionator after us?! After all I've done for the Legion, he doesn't even think I'm worth dealing with himself? How insulting! Come on, we'll show him he can't get rid of us that easily!

quests.name: The Original Time Killer
quests.description: You know, Vorefax in /portalmazec is the original Time Killer! It eats up dead timelines like it's nobody's business! You could learn a lot from it!

quests.name: That's So Lapis
quests.description: Since I could gaze into the future, you might think life would be a breeze. I can see trouble from a distance (Yeah, Go Lap!), but then it's not that easy. Without the calming agents found in Monstrous Spores I have no control over my transient state. Grab me some spores, but be careful because THEY NASTY!

quests.name: Guts for a Greater Mind
quests.description: You know how carrots improve eyesight? Goblin guts do the same thing, but for your future sight seeing. I've felt a little low on the prophecy side and I hope a batch of Goblin Gut cookies could fix me right up. Gather me the main ingredient and there's a cookie with your name on it!

quests.name: Chicken War Medal Quest
quests.description: You think you can take on my 10 million chicken army? TRY IT! If you can defeat 10 of my super-chickens, I'll raise the war meter.

quests.name: Chicken War Mega Medal
quests.description: You think you can take on my 10 million chicken army? TRY IT! If you can gather 5 Mega Chicken Medals off my super-chickens, I'll raise the war meter.

quests.name: Desperado
quests.description: Before the monsters, Drago, everything, the walk back to the Capital always felt so short. Desperation makes the journey agonizingly long. Time is cruel like that. Better hurry and knock out a few of those monsters. They'll eat up the precious seconds we have left.

quests.name: Isolani
quests.description: What you find when you return won't be pretty. If you feel fear, embrace it. That means your mind is sound. The Moon will not break you.

quests.name: Lazure's Reawakening
quests.description: Has death truly taken the Hollowborn Lazure, or did his will merely go dormant? It may be possible to patch what was broken if you reinvigorate his remains with reagents from the shadow creatures in /ShadowRealm, and the Chaoroots and the Judge's Minions in /HBChallenge.

quests.name: Target Practice
quests.description: Well, you survived your journey here, so you might as well make yourself useful. See those rough-looking warriors over there? They are also Hollowborn. Tamers. They need to practice their skills. YOU'LL make a fine target. I think you already know what you need to do.

quests.name: Double Crossed
quests.description: No, don't look at me like that. I won't interfere in another's test. This isn't a trap either, we just need to make sure you are ready for the challenges the future will bring. This is a test of your resolve and strength. If you fail to pass, well, I did promise one of the nicer body bags.

quests.name: Plant Stalk-ers
quests.description: Chamat's meddling with the tower's wards has disturbed the wildlife in the area. While we don't want to bring harm to these innocent creatures, they block our progress toward entering the tower. Knock them out so that we can proceed.

quests.name: Rage Against the Mach-Wing
quests.description: The Queen has twisted the wildlife to her will. These once peaceful owls have turned into rage filled beasts. Put them out of their misery.

quests.name: Tower Wards
quests.description: Chamat has reactivated the Wards protecting the Tower. This form can assist you in removing them, but we require the appropriate amount of Mana. Collect the Wells of Mana in the area and we shall use them to dispel the Wards.

quests.name: The Final Barrier
quests.description: Unfortunately for you, non-Mana construct, the final barrier will sap away your lifeforce if you try to enter through it. Chamat must have used the Queen to get through it, but we don't have that luxury. Instead, we must create a coat of lifeforce around you in order to enter the tower alive. Acquire the lifeforce from the local wildlife and we will stop Chamat before he breaches the Fire Orb's containment field.

quests.name: The Fire Orb
quests.description: Chamat must pay for what he has done to our Mana-kin. Show him no mercy and retrieve the Fire Orb.

quests.name: Legion Beast Quest
quests.description: Display your skill to the Legion Beast by defeating theLegion Arena GuardDark Legion Arena Guard and he may be willing to guard your house.

quests.name: Head of the Legion Beast
quests.description: Truly great warriors of the Undead Legion can earn a character page badge to display to the entire world. All you must do is defeat The Beast in the /sevencircleswar zone to complete this quest and unlock your badge.

items.name: Head of the Legion Beast Character Page Badge

quests.name: Let it Burn
quests.description: (Flame noises)

quests.name: Legion Castle Quest
quests.description: From warriors, to guards, to the generals that serve directly under Dage… the Undead Legion cannot continue to expand without a continual stream of new souls. And with war always on the horizon, we need them. Fast. Bring me the best new recruits you can find from the Underworld Arena, and test your might against the Legion Fiend Rider.

items.name: Blades of the Loyal Legion Warrior

quests.name: The Castle's Crown
quests.description: As the ruler of this exceptional castle, it is customary that you have an exceptional crown. Bring me the crowns of other sovereigns, and I'll use them to forge one unlike any you have ever seen.

quests.name: Legion Pirate Caster's Pet Merge
quests.description: There are many dark paths to explore surrounding the river Styx in the Underworld, and a Pirate Caster must be ready to journey down all of them. For those who journey far enough, you'll find the dreaded guard, Cerberus. Defeat him for a chance to get one my Legion Pirate Lieutenant prizes.

items.name: Pirate Caster's Mask Hat Morph + Locks

quests.name: The Story of Tyrnjal
quests.description: Let me tell you of Tyrnjal's greatest exploits…

quests.name: Tyrnjal's Iron Fist
quests.description: Many years ago on this exact day, Tynjal went to Dage to ask for a force of legionnaires to invade Dwarfhold. Tyrnjal stated that there's an artifact hidden in Dwarfhold, the Orb of Vitiate. The Orb could destroy stones with just a wave of a hand. Our enemies would never be able to sleep well in their castles.

items_required.name: Ore Balboa Removed x5 (Stacks up to 10)

quests.name: Legion Fealty 1
quests.description: Every member of the Legion is undead to some degree, either through losing their physical life or forfeiting their souls. As Dage’s most loyal servants, Legion Revenants bask in death and dutifully spread unlife in the name of the Legion. Kill and re-kill Ultra Aeacus 50 times to further his strength in death, tether 300 forgotten souls to the Undead Legion, darken the essence of 500 Shadow Warriors in /shadowrealmpast, and return with contracts from 1,000 dracolich heads. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.

quests.name: Legion Fealty 2
quests.description: The Legion is vast, and our influence is among the strongest in Lore. However, the existence of other undead factions means that our control over unlife is not yet ubiquitous. Prove your loyalty to the Legion by slaying one legion's worth of undead not yet pledged to Dage— perhaps in their next unlife, they will bend to our will. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.

quests.name: Legion Fealty 3
quests.description: You have shown your loyalty through tasks expected from Legion Revenants, but have yet to stand out among other members of the Undead Legion. If you want to join the Legion's most elite, then you must show your willingness to work harder than every other soldier. This is the price you must pay before you can accept you final task. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.

quests.name: Legion Fealty 4
quests.description: Your previous displays of loyalty were impressive, but not enough. For your final task, you must prove that you are worthy to command the power granted to Legion Revenants. For all the death you will spread, all the legions you will conquer, all the currency you will donate, the Legion will grow stronger. A task fit for an army assigned to but a single soldier--should you complete it, you will be deemed worthy of the strength you seek.

quests.name: Legion Sigil Pet Quest
quests.description: The day of Darkness is upon us! The Undead Legion celebrates the anniversary of Dage the Evil's birthday. The Legion Fiend Rider in the /legionarena holds Dark Gift Boxes. Get one and you'll be able to choose your reward.

quests.name: Seek the Souls
quests.description: You have taken another step towards proving your loyalty. Now, Legion Member, prove your worth in battle by gathering the souls of the living. Bring me 20 stolen souls from street criminals. /join alley to find many of them.

quests.name: Legion Weaponscrafter
quests.description: To craft the finest gear, one needs the best materials. Bring me the following items and you will have a chance to get one of my best weapons.

quests.name: I'm Not That Stupid
quests.description: A peace offering? Really? Nice try, but I've seen the things Fausto has been having you do. I don't know what he's told you, but I booked this event months ago. I have every right to be here. I'm willing to forgive everything you've done, but only if you make things right. You can start by removing Fausto's Carnaval décor. If he can't play nice, then neither will I.

quests.name: Why Did It Have To Be Snakes
quests.description: He said the Shushen were scaring his crew, did he? Well, those snakes are scaring mine. I think we could use a few less of them don't you?

quests.name: Flash! Bang!
quests.description: And now you can run HIS crew off like he did mine. Take these fireworks… they're harmless, but they make a loud noise and a bright flash. If you start setting them off near Carnaval dancers, they won't want to stick around.

quests.name: I Don't Retaliate, I Escalate
quests.description: I notice Fausto is still here. That's ok - I have a plan. I am going to summon an Oni to chase Fausto and his crew off the street. Collect spectral essence from the Shushen, and some vials of blood from the ravens. They will power my spell.

quests.name: One Last Thing
quests.description: Now all I need is the spell itself. Go to /hachiko, and find the Ninja Nopperabo. Some of them carry scrolls of summoning. Fight them until you find one, and then bring it back to me.

quests.name: Defeat the Oni
quests.description: I can't control the Oni! He's attacking Fausto and his crew, but… he's destroying my parade, too! We have to stop him!

quests.name: Muck and Feather
quests.description: The Stymphalian that made its nest in the marsh is a terrible neighbird! Their droppings are poisonous, and they just dump them anywhere! Pluck them bald and run them out of town!

quests.name: A Light Ssssssnack
quests.description: I ssssee you'd like sssome power. Defeat sssome sssstarsss in the eclipsssed land of Ssstarssinc. Bring me ssssome dussst, and I'll enchant it sso you can make ssssome powerful gear.

quests.name: Blinded by the Black Light
quests.description: *ssss* You're back? Hmmm… Bring me sssome Ssstar Sssscrap Metal from /Dreadssssspace, sssome Vortex Essssence from the Vortex Guardian in /Whitehole, and ssssome Black Light Aura from the Elementalssss in /Blackholesssssssun.

items_required.name: Black Light Aura x7 (Stacks up to 70)

quests.name: Cold Reception
quests.description: The Knights and Paladins were quite hospitable, until they realized that our guards were Elven. I understand that other Elves have caused them trouble, but that's no reason to shove my troops around. Would you mind teaching those bad eggs to keep their hands to themselves?

quests.name: Long Walk on the Beach
quests.description: This beach is beautiful, but I was hoping there'd be more fish than the guppies flitting about in the tide. Say, have you been to /Ashray? Mind heading there to grab a few of the Kitefin Shark Bait? I've never seen them before, but I heard they have deepsea pearls in their stomachs.

quests.name: Last Bastion of Light
quests.description: I am plagued by the Shadow Creatures who keep invading my park! Juanita Park is MY home… my only home, and the last place left where Light holds sway. Please, Hero, I would be so grateful if you could remove 4 of the imps and 3 of the Shadowstone creatures. I - I fear for the Light I have left!

quests.name: Shadowy Corruption
quests.description: I must keep eternal watch over the shadow creatures who would destroy my home. If you would help me defend my home, I would be grateful! Pour these 5 vials of elixir around the perimeter of my dome, and I am certain that the darkness will find no refuge here!

quests.name: Gather the Goods
quests.description: Lim: Ok, I'm going to need a lot of small parts for this. I'll gather some, you get the rest, ok? Find me a fully charged battery, some hinges, and some small screws. You can probably find some of them laying around from the broken robots, but you might have to… well, break some MORE to get the rest.

quests.name: Spooky Casings
quests.description: Lim: Now I just need something for the casing. You know what would work really well? One of these robotic heads! Bring me a few - I think we're going to need a lot of ghost boxes.

quests.name: Do a Goo-d Job
quests.description: Cysero: My turn! I'm going to make a concoction that will help make Lim's ghost boxes actually catch ghosts. The ghosts have been leaving snotty globs of ectoplasm behind. Bring me a few of those to start.

quests.name: Plop Plop Fizz Fizz
quests.description: Cysero: Now I need something to activate it. Something… fizzy. A good, fizzy soda would do the trick, but every cup that I've tasted has been flat. See if you can find me a fizzy one!

quests.name: Test the Ghost box
quests.description: Lim: Time to see if this thing works!Cysero: Beat up some mascots and we'll catch the ghosts that come out!

quests.name: Cranky Spirits
quests.description: Lim: I'm going to have to upgrade my Ghost Boxes if we're going to catch this ghost! Look inside the storage - you can see all the residue it left behind. If you bring me some strong samples of its residue, I can use it to attune my traps to that ghost.

quests.name: It's Too S-Warm
quests.description: Cysero: Alright, now we just have to get past this swarm of… tiny… creepy… robot moglins. You know what to do! You smash 'em, we'll trap 'em!

quests.name: Get into the Panic Room
quests.description: Cysero: The control room also functions as a panic room, and Zorbak and Sally have locked themselves in. That's the bad news. The good news is, these Twilly bots are probably strong enough to break through the wall. See if you can take control of one.

quests.name: Smash the Wall
quests.description: Lim: Alright. We have control of one of the robots. Now we need to smash through the wall. Go over there and give it a shot!

quests.name: Circuit Breakers
quests.description: Wire circuits just don't break by themselves—it's scientifically impossible. Someone, or something, must have eaten through the wires down below. And yeah, you're gonna have to go investigate if you want there to be a New Year celebration. See that Old Well over there? Jump down it and check the wiring for any flaws or breaks in the caves below. Bring me back any variables you may find to deduce the system failure at hand.

quests.name: Current Affairs
quests.description: Before we can proceed with the necessary repairs, we (meaning YOU) need to retrieve Spare Fuses and some Electrical Tape that I left down there. Why don't I just go and get it, you say? Darnit Hero, I'm a scientist, not an adventurer! Go back to the caves and bring back 3 Spare Fuses and 1 roll of Electrical Tape so I can fix the circuits. Unless you don't want a happy new year? Quickly I say!

quests.name: Not Finished Yet-i
quests.description: I can get those circuits fixed in no time at all. 10 milliseconds, tops. But I refuse to go down there if that accursed Yeti has not yet *hibernated,* if you know what I mean. In the furthest depths of the cave, you will find Grand Master Yeti. Using deductive reasoning, he is the catalyst responsible for the majority of the damage. Confront and defeat the Yeti in order to induce him in a long winter's nap. Bring me back a tuft of his Faux Foe Fur so I know the deed has been done. Go!

quests.name: Letters in Henvelopes
quests.description: I don't have the best handwriting - arguably, it's chicken scratch - but I've written up some Tender promo letters that need to be hand-delivered to my peeps. Some might've already received my letter, so don't be discouraged if they turn you away; there's still plenty of chickens who need to hear about my Tender app!

quests.name: Final Rest
quests.description: Blackhorn Tomb is crawling with the restless undead who have died here in Thunderforge. Searching them for clues to the scroll's location would be the smartest move. Put 5 of the Restless undead to rest and search the remains for the Darkblood Scroll.

quests.name: Disturbing The Peace
quests.description: Perhaps the scroll can be found in one of the tombs. If these were the resting places of good people I would never allow this but considering they are Darkblood tombs… shatter the tomb doors and search the tombs for the scroll.

quests.name: Sampling Silk
quests.description: These Tomb Spiders seem to have infested Blackhorn and even blocked off one of the passages. You cannot explore the tomb further until the wall of web is destroyed… but how? Blades have no effect of that wall. Gather 6 samples of Spider Silk from Tombs Spiders so that I might find a weakness.

quests.name: Fire Is The Thing
quests.description: Ah HA! Fire can destroy The Tomb Spiders webbing. We will need material for a fire bomb. Gather 3 Gas Bladders from the Tomb Spiders, 3 Scraps of Cloth from the Restless Undead and find a bottle lying on the ground somewhere inside Blackhorn Tomb. Bring them all to me.

quests.name: The Wall Comes Down
quests.description: The wall of Tomb Spider webbing should simply vanish when you go drop this fire bomb on it. Make sure not to stand too close. Let me know how it works.

quests.name: The Bonefeeder
quests.description: Tomb Spiders are a species of carrion spider. That is, they eat the remains from a larger predator which is usually a large Bonefeeder Spider. Find this monster and slay it. The tomb will not be safe until you do. Let me know when the Bonefeeder has fallen.

quests.name: What Lies Beyond?
quests.description: Now that the Bonefeeder has been slain, the Tomb Spiders will lose interest in this place. Explore the rest of Blackhorn beyond the room where you found the Bonefeeder and let me know what you find.

quests.name: Toxic
quests.description: The Bonefeeder species gathers lost items and weaves them into their cocoons. The Scroll MUST be in one of them but we can't search them just yet. The contents are highly toxic. We will have to brew an anti-toxin just to open them. Start by bringing me 4 vials of Spider Venom from the Tomb Spiders!

quests.name: Very Toxic
quests.description: The Tomb Spider venom is particularly weak. Perhaps we can augment it with some of the poisonous Thunderforge fungus that grows on the bones of the Restless Undead. Bring me 6 patches of Undead Fungus so I can complete the anti-toxin.

quests.name: Really, VERY VERY TOXIC!
quests.description: Here, drink this. The anti-toxin is now coursing through your blood but the cocoons will STILL poison you quite badly. Try not to die while you're searching them. Now go and bring back the Darkblood Scroll then, together, we will begin our quest to END Chaos on Lore!

quests.name: What's Mine is Yours
quests.description: The tracks in front of you lead to rare Gems that are incredibly valuable to the Dwarves. However, the multiple breaks and fallen debris on the tracks make for a completely unsafe work environment. If you want to prove yourself, here is your chance. Collect a Bag of Gems (30 Gems) and 1 Chaotic Draconian Scale and bring them here.

quests.name: Animated Elementals
quests.description: The life force from the various elements plays an important role Dravix healing. This is a technique I am trying to teach my apprentice, Shi'Nah, but our supplies are running low. Will you help us replenish? Since most elements are not technically alive, you'll need to harvest these from the Living Fire, Water, Earth and Air in the Dragonplane.

quests.name: So, something washed up on the beach...
quests.description: A walk on the beach should bring peace. But today, I came across a mysterious beached tentacle that caused me great concern. I do not THINK it is an Old One rising… But… Hero, we need you to become familiar with our islands and find the Water Temple. Please explore, and if you come across the tentacle, approach with caution.

quests.name: Dilution Solution
quests.description: We MUST weaken the water-earth spell bond. In order to do that, we need a solution that is both made of water and earth. The Marsh Lurkers have blood that is, indeed, exactly what we are looking for. Kill 12 Marsh Lurkers and bring me their blood. Once we link their blood to the spell and dilute it, the bond will weaken.

quests.name: A Frogdrake's Love Story
quests.description: The flames of passion cannot be quenched, even in the wetlands. Did you know that female Frogdrakes only accept a mate with the most flamboyant flame? No? Then you must go and see them! If the conditions are right, the flames will crystallize. Gather 12 crystallized Frogdrake flames so I can break the fire-water bond.

quests.name: A Little Bit of Bubbly Never Hurt
quests.description: Bubbles are a wonder of nature. So very fragile, yet beautiful and powerful in their own way. I must attend to the water-water bond of the spell. In order to do that I need you to destroy 12 Living Waters and gather 10 Bubbles of Water magic plus 10 Burst Water Bubbles. With these components, we will weaken the spell further.

quests.name: Flight of the Fishwings
quests.description: Fishwings are such interesting creatures, a magical melding of air and water. We need their wings in order to move forward, Hero. I know, their sacrifice will not go unnoticed. Please bring back 12 fish wings and be on the lookout for the very rare Fishwings venom. I will need one vial of that to complete this vital step.

quests.name: Hunt for the Greater Good
quests.description: It's time, Hero, to create a spiritual trident to break the spell. I need a great number of items to do this and you are the only one who can get them. Kill Fishman Soldiers to obtain a Fishman Trident. Kill Marsh Lurkers to get a Marsh Tribal Totem. Kill Frogdrakes to get Powdered Drake's Horn. Finally, please get 3 Effervescent Ocean Spirit.

quests.name: Kill the Deep Dweller
quests.description: We need those eggs, Hero. All is for naught if we cannot obtain them. We have no choice but to kill the Deep Dweller in order to succeed. Please take care and remember that everything depends on you. No pressure, no pressure at all.

quests.name: Remains
quests.description: The Slavers that once controlled the Death Pits committed great sins against their own people. The spirits of the Darkblood who died are still angry and insane. First, Destroy 3 Rotting Darkblood and clear their spirits from this level of the pits. Use my amulet to summon me again when you are done.

quests.name: Thriving In Rot
quests.description: We must begin to work of protecting you from the Rotstone's dangerous effects before you can go lower. First gather 5 of the Glowing Mushrooms that grow near the surface of the Death Pits. Summon my spirit again when you are done.

quests.name: Rotting Ribs
quests.description: Next you will need to gather some bones from the Rotting Darkblood that are rich in the poison from the Rotstone. Summon my spirit again once you have gathered 10 Rotten Rib Bones.

quests.name: A Perfect Skull
quests.description: Lastly, you will need to find one large, perfect skull in which to mix the marking paint that we will use to create the protection runes. It must be absolutely perfect, so you may look for some time before you find the one you need.

quests.name: Deeper Into Death
quests.description: The rune paint needs to rest for a short time, while it rests you can clear the next level of the Death Pits. This far down the Ghastly Darkblood roam. They are more dangerous than the Rotting Darkblood so beware. Destroy 4 of them.

quests.name: Precise Placement
quests.description: The protection runes have to be placed in very exact locations, but I don't know where those might be. One of these Ghastly Darkblood must be one of the old Slavers. Destroy Ghastly Darkblood until you find the rune map.

quests.name: Painted Protection
quests.description: Now that you have the map you should be able to find where all 6 runes of protection were once placed. You will need to use the rune paint to refresh all the runes to protect yourself from further exposure to the Rotstone's poison.

quests.name: They Sense You
quests.description: The undead in the Death Pits have begun to stir since you activated the new runes. Go back and destroy 3 more Rotting Darkblood to thin their numbers.

quests.name: They Hate You
quests.description: Your work is not yet done. The spirits of the undead you have slain are calling out to the Ghastly Darkblood to repel the living intruder. You must destroy 3 more Ghastly Darkblood.

quests.name: The Sundered
quests.description: This far down some of the oldest and most powerful undead walk the darkness and bones. Attack and destroy 5 of the Sundered Darkblood before they mass and overtake you!

quests.name: Rotstone
quests.description: The runes of protection are holding but they won't for long if you go too much deeper. You need to gather some of the loose piles of Raw Rotstone Ore dispose of them.

quests.name: Honor The Dead
quests.description: Once a tribe of Darkblood gained control over the Death Pits they would use rival tribe captives as slaves… even the honored Primarchs. Its time to put the sins of the past to rest. Slay the Darkblood until you find 3 Ancient Primarch Weapons so we can honor them, as befits a Primarch.

quests.name: Ties to Life
quests.description: The undead Darkblood keep coming from the walls and shadows. You will need to destroy several piles of bones and put their spirits to rest or the will just keep coming after you. Find and burn 12 Piles of Bones.

quests.name: Destroy Wrathful Vestis and Secure The Tears
quests.description: The remains of the warlord Wrathful Vestis are on this lowest level of the Death Pits. The Primarch thought this would be the safest location to hide the tears but Lionfang is close behind. Defeat Vestis then take the Tears!

quests.name: Cryptbreaker Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Jon S'Nooooooo Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Ultra Drakonnan Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Module 005 Bounty
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Very Trobblesome
quests.description: There's a note on the board that says:

quests.name: Secret Treasure
quests.description: There's a note that says:

quests.name: Victory Blade Enchantment
quests.description: The undead in the Graveyard will have the items you need to create the Enchantment Rune. Bring back 1 Ravenwing Scroll from the Skeletal Vikings, 3 Unseeing Eyes from the Skeletal Warriors, and 5 Shards of Diamond Blade from Big Jack Sprat.

quests.name: Alignment Quest: Light... or Dark?
quests.description: You have a choice to make, young one. Your blade can channel dark powers, or bright ones. You can build dreams, or destroy them. Bring me 10 Shattered Dream Sticks from the Skeletal Warriors, and we'll see what type of blade you really want to wield.

quests.name: Choose: Despair... or Glory?
quests.description: Your legendary weapon creation quest is almost complete, Hero. Bring me the 12 shards of the Nornir Triad from the Skeletal Vikings, and I will let you choose the amulet you desire - Despair or Glory.

quests.name: Ghoul Fungi
quests.description: Let's start our tour by entering the foyer. Ah, years of neglect have led to a bit of a shroom problem. Bless that young fellow Hans for helping the sisters clean. Have a chat with him and give him a hand harvesting the fungus.

quests.name: Grotesque Guardian
quests.description: The banquet that took the lives of Alnswick ghosts happened in the Ballroom. Take a left from the stairs and you'll run into some grotesque gargoyles. A young lady is there fighting them. Talk to her and help her turn the gargoyles into rubble!

quests.name: Dragon Instinct
quests.description: Miss Tara mentioned that her chaperone Nythera sensed something dangerous near the kitchens. Make a right from the stairway to talk to her about what could be going on. If my painted eyes weren't playing tricks on me, you'll find a bundle of my pen pal letters there too.

quests.name: The Uninvited
quests.description: According to Lady Nythera, she feels a sense of foreboding from the Kitchen. Ah, the doors are locked. Perhaps we will make more progress upstairs. If anyone's up there, see if they have an idea. Be wary! Noble Ghosts are snooping around the upper floor as well.

quests.name: Room Service
quests.description: Gah! This is the Master Bedroom? There isn't even a bed, just a frightening mess! Oh…I forgot I left it like this! It seems that the Dumbwaiter is broken. Let's fix it up, and see if I left more letters around here. My personal chambers should be the right place to find them.

quests.name: Newborn's Teething
quests.description: Head down the dumbwaiter to the kitchens, and we'll unlock the main doors for ease of entry. Andr - er, I spent a lot of time here. The rest of the letters should be in the corner, if we can get past these undead creatures! What are they? Dogs?

quests.name: Sadistic Solicitations
quests.description: I can feel it- a terrible sense of dream, emanating from that locked trapdoor at the back of the kitchen. Backtrack to the Bedroom. The key has to be there, surrounded by the ghosts. While you're there, see if you can retrieve the Nobles' banquet invitations. I need to know if they were aware…

quests.name: Stomping on Eggshells
quests.description: We have the key to the cellar beneath the kitchen, where the warden of these poor baby Dragons was held captive. Come now, let's see if his spirit needs rest. I imagine the last of the letters are there with him.

quests.name: Stone Clad Clan
quests.description: The Dragonlord released his seal on the Ballroom. We should get there as soon as possible. Don't let the Gargoyles stop you. They're protecting something that needs to be freed.

quests.name: Restless Waltz
quests.description: The restless spirits of the wronged dragonlings are hoarding ghosts in the Ballroom. Their suffering twisted their souls into a single hydra. Please, we must lay them to rest, and release them from Andrew's sins.

quests.name: Shadow Medals: Defend the Village!
quests.description: These soldiers are strong, and the people of this village don't stand a chance against them. Defeat as many as you can and report back. Bring me the medals they carry as proof.

quests.name: Seed Spitter Oil
quests.description: These villagers aren't trained for war, and a lot of them are wounded. If you bring me some Seed Spitter oil, our clerics can make a medicinal salve from it. It will help stabilize the wounds, and hopefully save some lives.

quests.name: Mega Shadow Medals
quests.description: The Shadowflame Army's elite forces are starting to appear on the battlefield. They don't look any different, but you will know them by the larger medals they carry. If you manage to kill any, bring their medals to me.

quests.name: Shadow Samples
quests.description: Do you see those puddles of shadowy sludge that are forming on the ground where the Shadow Amy is fighting? I think that must be the key to figuring out what they are. Bring me some samples for our clerics to study.

quests.name: Shadow Medals: Fight Them Back!
quests.description: We've taken control of the village and the surrounding lands. Now, we must push this army back toward the castle! Fight them back, and bring me the medals from any that you defeat.

quests.name: Interrogation
quests.description: We need to find out more information about the shadowy figure who's leading this army. Those Slashers are pure brawn - you won't be able to get anything out of them. But from the Scouts, you might. Interrogate them, and come back to me when you have some useful clues.

quests.name: Defeat Malgor!
quests.description: We've got to stop this army, and now's our chance. Defeat Malgor and save the villagers from his Shadowflame Army.

quests.name: Brentan's Battle
quests.description: Ah, it's you. I expected you'd show up sooner or later. Your "friend" did, and gave me a long list of instructions I do NOT have time for. But if you can help me here, I'll hand the note over to you.

quests.name: Unmended Scars
quests.description: The Knights and Paladins were quite hospitable, until they realized that our guards were Elven. I understand that other Elves have caused them trouble, but that's no reason to shove my troops around. Would you mind teaching those bad eggs to keep their hands to themselves?

quests.name: No Pain, No Gain
quests.description: As catastrophic as Chaos and Shadowflame were, the Alliance of Good and Evil coddled our youth. The Empire fighting alongside our Knights and Paladins have made them weak and dependent. A real warrior like you should mentor them. Even one session would open their eyes.

quests.name: Searchlights
quests.description: ﻿I would have preferred to usher you to Balemorale's most important rooms of note, but we're already being tailed. The Lightguard's Paladins are following us. I would have included them if they weren't worshiping that overgrown candle. If you would, make them leave us be.

quests.name: Queensmen
quests.description: There are more eyes on us than I thought there'd be, so let's cut to the chase. I want to investigate what's beneath this castle. One of the Nobles' Knights should have a key to the cellar. Ask each of them to spar, and shake the key out of them. They'll be too excited to notice.

quests.name: Cellar Secrets
quests.description: ﻿I managed to catch Lord Brentan before he slipped out of the castle. Find him, and let him know that there are secrets in the cellar. He'll believe your words over mine. I've asked him to meet us at the cellar's entrance. It's through the door near where Astero and his ilk are congregating.

quests.name: Chaotic Roots
quests.description: ﻿The cellar is infested with spiders, but the items the Queen had her Court Mages store here have been…Chaorrupted. We need to eliminate them, and keep them from harming Lady Song and Lady Marigold. I've invited them to our investigation, and they have information to share with you.

quests.name: Eroding Era
quests.description: ﻿We can't get deeper or collect the books we need to further understand what the Queen is doing unless we secure the cellar. There are Chaos Crystals that could injure or even infect us if we're not careful. Shatter them and collect the shards.

quests.name: Old Wolf
quests.description: Thanks to Tris.

quests.name: Abandoned Cradle
quests.description: ﻿﻿There's…something slumped against the wall at the far end of the cellar. It's been burned and crushed, but I can tell that it's made of flesh. You're saying it's a "Vessel?" The Spiders and Crystals are crawling all over it. We should clear them away, and investigate the "Vessel."

quests.name: Shockwaves
quests.description: ﻿There are screams coming from above. There's a dumbwaiter at the back wall of the cellar. Use it to get up to the ground floor. If I'm hearing right, it's the Skye Warriors. They're fighting with the Knights and Paladins. Hurry and capture some. We need to find out what's going on.

quests.name: Sleight of Hand
quests.description: The castle has been thrown into utter disarray. For some reason, the Knights and Paladins couldn't stop the Queen from being taken. Skye's Warriors are trying to kidnap other Nobles to take as hostages. Save as many of the remaining nobles as you can, and locate the Queen!

quests.name: Double Fianchetto
quests.description: ﻿﻿The Queen has been put under some sort of curse by the Emissary of Skye, Lieber. He has control of her movements, and promises to stop her heart if you attack him. Don't let Lieber have the satisfaction of seeing us give up. Try everything you can to free the Queen!

quests.name: Chaos Sp-Eyes
quests.description: Let's start at the beginning, shall we? Travel to Mobius and learn as much as you can about the Chaos Sp-Eyes you'll find there. They were an ever present part of the Chaos War.

quests.name: Chaos Lycans
quests.description: So much happened in Darkovia. Both sides fighting against Wolfwing, and both sides corrupted by Chaos. Travel to Safiria's Castle and see what you can learn about the Chaos Lycans there.

quests.name: Chaos Vampire Knights
quests.description: It was not only the Lycans who suffered Chaorruption. Safiria's Vampire Knights turned against their master as well. Travel to Lycan Ridge and see what you can learn about these Chaos Vampire Knights.

quests.name: Chaonslaught Casters
quests.description: Some Lords of Chaos chaorrupted not only their enemies, but their own armies as well. Such was the case for Lionfang. Travel to Falguard and learn what you can from the Chaonslaught Casters he left behind.

quests.name: Chaonslaught Warriors
quests.description: You learned such interesting things about Lionfang's Casters. But what happens when the same process is performed on one who cannot wield magic? Go back to Falguard and study the Chaonslaught Warriors so that I might compare notes.

quests.name: Chaotic Chinchillizards
quests.description: Such strange creatures, Chinchilizards. Even stranger when infected with Chaos. Go to where the Bloodtusk War took place and you will find some there that you can study.

quests.name: Chaotic Koalions
quests.description: I know I didn't specifically ask, but while you were there, I don't suppose you also studied the Chaotic Koalions? No…? Would you mind going back and gathering some data for me? I think the comparison could be useful.

quests.name: Violet Slime
quests.description: Violet slime! That's what we need to study next. It's so obvious, and yet I didn't think of it until now. You can find plenty of it here in Crownsreach.

quests.name: Chaos Crystals
quests.description: Writing that scroll on Violet Slime has got me thinking about Chaos Crystals. They used to be spread throughout Lore, but now they, like the Slime itself, are primarily found in Crownsreach.

quests.name: Chaos Sprites
quests.description: Have you ever seen Chaos Sprites? Beautiful little things. Filled to the brim with Chaos. They appear around the Tower of Magic in Arcangrove, and also right here in Crownsreach.

quests.name: Tome of The Otherworld
quests.description: Oh no! Some of the pages in my book were loose - it's a very old book! - and when i got here, a gust of wind blew them away. I need those pages if we're going to find out what we need to do to get into this party! I'm pretty sure the ghosts and goblins out there grabbed them up, so if you fight them, maybe you can get them all back for me.

quests.name: Monster Data
quests.description: While i'm out here, I might as well get a little work done, right? This is a perfect opportunity to collect data on all the spooky creatures out here! Maybe you could help? Just go out and fight all the different types of monsters out here, and then come back and tell me everything you learned.

quests.name: Reclaim the Research
quests.description: Our scouts are gone, but we may not have to lose all of their research! The wind keeps blowing things toward our camp from the rift. See if you can find any journal pages it may have blown our way! …and while you're at it, keep an eye out for any that may have been eaten by the monsters. (Quest works once per login session)

quests.name: Collect Research Data
quests.description: Want to help me get some research data on the Rift, and everything it's brought with it? Yay! This will be fun. First, place these data readers around the perimeter. Each time you fight one of the Rift monsters in view of the meters, they will record what happens. So, you'll need to keep fighting monsters until the meters have all the data they need. Easy! (Quest works once per login session)

quests.name: Drakath Faced
quests.description: You must face Drakath now. Confront him in order to learn the identity of the 13th Lord of Chaos. All of Lore is counting on you!

quests.name: Investigate the Drakel
quests.description: I'm sure you've noticed all the Drakel in the surrounding area. They're here because they think we TASTE GOOD… if you can imagine that! But I think they're intelligent enough to be reasoned with. Help me learn more about them, so we can find out if my theory is correct.

quests.name: 'Talk' to Greenteeth
quests.description: Maybe what we really need to do is try to talk to the leader of the Drakel bandit gang, Greenteeth. As you know, Drakel love juice boxes. Gather some of their favorites and lay them in the forest, on the ﬂat rock just north of the Makai cave, as bait. When Greenteeth comes, see if you can talk some sense into him!

quests.name: Make a Shelter
quests.description: So cold… is it the chill of ice or fear? All of these monsters keep coming towards the Tower, and it just keeps getting colder. Slay the monsters to get furs and get 10 Hearts of Fire from a Twisted Ice monster so that we can try to heat the shelter.

quests.name: Clear the Wolves
quests.description: You've defeated some monsters and warmed the shelter, but the Ice Wolves keep coming back! Slay 7 Ice Wolves to keep the Tower of Winds safe!

quests.name: Pots for Water
quests.description: The Frostwyrms have come up from the depths of the ice volcano. Defeat 10 Frostwyrms and get 5 Rotten Ice cores from the Rotten Ice monster in the volcano!

quests.name: Pony Gary Yellow
quests.description: It's time to introduce you to my little friend!

quests.name: Kimberly
quests.description: Defeat Kimberly!

quests.name: Ergot Bread
quests.description: All that hag does is yell at her poor son, kick him out, and spend the day with the miller. Go to the mill and see for yourself. It's full of her garbage, and no one to clean it up. Why? Because the miller DIED. And now the rats have taken over, eating OUR grain. Would you clean them out? We still need the mill and his lazy daughter isn't going to get out of bed any time soon.

quests.name: Kids These Days
quests.description: I've never seen the miller's daughter work a day in her life. Her father broke his back doting on her, all for nothing. How'd he die? Who knows? Perhaps she became jealous of the attention he was giving Bursha and got rid of him in a fit of rage. Why not bribe the girl with some food? If she lets you in, you'll have a chance to look for bloodstains. But you'll need to slay those bat-things. We're all out of bread.

quests.name: PORKON RIPOFF
quests.description: GENERAL PORKON HAS BEEN SEEN WIF AN INVISABLE ITEM. I FINKZ HE STOILE TEH BIKE.TAEK TEH MONORAL KAT 2 ORCTOWN AN GIT TEH BIKE BAK FRUM GENERAL PORKON!

quests.name: GRILL THE LOCALS
quests.description: SUM OV TEH LOCAL HORCS MUTCH HAS SEEN SOMETHIN. QUESHUNS TEH HORCS HER IN NOOBSHIRE AN FIND OUT HOO TOOK TEH BIKE PLZ.

quests.name: DOGEAR THE CAT BURGLAR
quests.description: SO IT WUS DAWGEAR, DAT BOOK-EATIN BIKE THIEF. TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 BOOM WYRMS BOOKSTORE AN ASK HIM WER TEH REST OV TEH BIKE IZ!

quests.name: BLOODTUSK CATWALK
quests.description: U SHUD START WIF GHAZ, TEH HORC WEPON MAKR IN BLOODTUSK. HEZ PRITEE REASONABLE GUY. TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 BLOODTUSK AN TALK 2 GHAZ.

quests.name: THE FRAME UP
quests.description: NEXT IZ TEH FRAME. DOGEAR SED HE SOLD IT 2 SUM HORC SELLSWORDZ. TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 TEH SANDSEA PORT AN GIT TEH FRAME BAK FRUM DEM!

quests.name: THAT DARN CAT
quests.description: TEH LAST PART IZ TEH BAK WHEEL AN DAWGEAR SEZ DAT TEH HOOJ KAT HAS IT! HE WUZ ALWAYS WANTD TEH BIKE BUT I ALWAYS SAY IZ 2 HOOJ 4 HIM! TAEK TEH MONORAIL KAT 2 TEH HOOJS CASTLE AN GIT DAT WHEEL BAK!

quests.name: I Want to Be The Very Best Necromancer
quests.description: We all gotta start somewhere right? All Necromancers know where to go to get their very own personalized training. The Graveyard! Think you can come to the /graveyard with me and watch me try taming a few of the walking dead you catch?

quests.name: Like No One Ever Was
quests.description: Man, those undead are useless anyways. All they ever do is walk and make loud grunts. Good for a lair cleaner but not much else. Hmmph! Well I will make them pay attention to me whether they like it or not! Hero! Fetch me some bones from Doomwood Forest at /doomwood! Any will do as long as they are you know…bones.

items.name: Aspiring Necro Lantern on your back

quests.name: To Raise Them is my Real Quest
quests.description: HOW DARE THEY! THE NERVE OF THESE UNGRATEFUL UNDEAD. HERO! Do you know what they said!? Until I can get the bone of a ferocious undead monster, they refuse to even acknowledge me! HERO! Fetch me 3 heads of the Dracolich inside the Necropolis Dungeon in /necrodungeon and 5 fresh bandages from Agony itself in the /underrealm. That should show them to respect me.

quests.name: Red Dragon's Birthday Badge
quests.description: RAWR! To celebrate the 15th Birthday, there's only ONE monster worthy to give you such a special birthday badge. Go forth and slay the Red Dragon in /lair.

items.name: Doom & Glory Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Put out the Fire
quests.description: The Chrono-Phoenix is inside that temporal rift, but it's been spewing flame and energy into the Northlands. We've gotta make sure everyone here is safe! First things first - let's put out some of the fires that have sprung up before they grow out of control.

quests.name: Assist the Assistants
quests.description: My other chrono assistants have been going haywire too - I can't help but feel like this must be connected. Help me shut them off before they do any more damage.

quests.name: Energy for Repairs
quests.description: I'm gonna have to fix those bots. If you go into the temporal rift… not too far… you should find some errant spacetime energy. Capture it for me, and I'll use it to make the needed repairs.

quests.name: Stabilize the Rift
quests.description: I had a little spacetime energy left over, so I used it to craft these tuning rods. Set them up in the area surrounding the temporal rift. They should help stabilize the area and keep it …well, as safe as it can be.

quests.name: Freezies
quests.description: Alright, now that the area outside the rift is safe… let's talk about getting this phoenix under control! I'm thinking if we want to stop fire… we have to freeze it. Bring me some elemental frost from the local frost elementals.

quests.name: Freeze the Energy
quests.description: Use the Elemental Frost you collected to freeze some of the stray Spacetime Energy. With it, we'll be able to neutralize the Chrono-Phoenix.

quests.name: More Flames!
quests.description: It looks like the Phoenix has had another explosive energy burst! This time, inside the temporal rift. Go inside and put out all the flames you find.

quests.name: Find the Phoenix
quests.description: Now we just need to get to the phoenix. Go as deep into the rift as you can; that's where you'll find it.

quests.name: Close out the Year
quests.description: The year 2019 itself has been trying to stop our Chrono-Phoenix?! That's exciting. Of course, that means we're going to have to usher out the old year ourselves. You know what to do!

quests.name: Freeze the Phoenix
quests.description: Nothing else is standing in our way. Go through the door, find the Chrono-Phoenix, and freeze it with the frozen spacetime energy we created. It's the only way to ensure that the old year was not the last one!

quests.name: Head Outside
quests.description: Meet me outside! It's almost time for the new year to arrive.

quests.name: Quest for the Bonebreaker
quests.description: My pa told me tales of the Bonebreaker Cutlass. It's used by Undead Pirates and DoomKnight Commanders. Those who wield it gain great power. I'd LOVE to see what it looks like… and I'll give you a chance to get a prize! Bring me the cutlass… pretty please?

quests.name: I Need More Luck
quests.description: Maybe if I was more lucky I'd be able to avoid all these accidents I seem to have. Can you get me some Lucky Clovers from the Sneevilchauns?

quests.name: I Don't Feel Safe
quests.description: I really don't feel safe around here any more. Every year I end up getting a little banged up at the carnival. Maybe I can make some armor out of some big leaves. Can you get me some?

quests.name: I Fell For It
quests.description: All that's left is to make myself a sign! I'll need some wood… Treeant wood! And a can of paint. I bet you can find one around here somewhere.

quests.name: Such a Mess
quests.description: We can't leave this portal open for long. The darkness is already seeping into the Plane of Light from Sepulchure's fortress. Get rid of the invasive shadows on the other side of the portal, and clean up the mess they've made.

quests.name: Herbs Needed
quests.description: I have an idea for the herbal element of this spell we're trying. I'm thinking Glowmoss - it grows on the Treeants in the Plane of Light - and a few Lightshrooms. You'll find those there, too.

quests.name: Shine a Light
quests.description: We will power your spell with pure elemental light. Obviously you'll get that from Light Elementals. But you knew that, right?

quests.name: Hapless?
quests.description: Let's try this out, shall we? Test your spell on the Hapless Skeleton held captive in the cell down the hall. If it works on him, we will move forward.

quests.name: How 'bout them Apples
quests.description: Since Lightwing won't want to help, we'll need to get on his good side first. We'll bring him his favorite snack - Sun Apples. They grow on the Treeants of the Plane of Light. Gather some and return to me.

quests.name: Make an Offering
quests.description: Find Lightwing's nest, and leave the sun apples as an offering to him. Hopefully this will persuade him to share one of his feathers with us.

quests.name: Test the Spell Again!
quests.description: Hopefully this additional reagent will fill in the gaps of our spell, and give us the result we are hoping for. Test it again on the Hapless Skeleton, let's see how it goes.

quests.name: Gather the Light
quests.description: As our champion, you are strong. You must become stronger. The power you are trying to disrupt is equal to your own, but corrupted and strengthened by the armor he wears. Gather Light Energy from any of the beings in the Plane of Light.

quests.name: Banish the Shadows
quests.description: This fortress is tied so strongly to the darkness. It will strengthen the armor's hold on Sepulchure, and diminish your chances of success. Banish as many shadows as you can. This decrease the resistance we'll face.

quests.name: So Many Minions
quests.description: Some of Sepulchure's skeletal minions don't seem happy about all of this. Best to subdue them. Smash them if you have to. He can always bring them back later.

quests.name: Come On, Get Ready!
quests.description: Come on, Valen! Put your armor on so we can go! Don't worry - you may have forgotten it, but i didn't. I've got it right here in this chest.

quests.name: Scout the Valley
quests.description: I'm not sure exactly where this "Cave of Doom" is, so we'll have to scout the valley and see if we can find it. Let's slay as many of these shadow creatures as we can while we do. It will make our lives much easier later on!

quests.name: Gather Energy
quests.description: Hmm. The Cave of Doom must be kept hidden by some sort of cloaking spell. Gather Infernal Energy from the Shadow Imps in the area, and I may be able to use it to reveal the spell.

quests.name: Do I Have to Spell it Out?
quests.description: Alright, I've made a handful of counterspells from the energy you brought me. You know what to do with them, right? Spread them around the valley as evenly as you can. We don't know where the cloaking spell is, so we have to make sure we hit it!

quests.name: Get Through the Shadows
quests.description: The Champion of Doom awaits us somewhere inside this cave! We'll have to fight our way past all these shadowy monsters to get to him. Don't leave any alive to flank us from behind!

quests.name: Get the Key
quests.description: The Champion of Darkness must be behind that door the Doom Guardian is blocking! He must also be the keeper of the key that unlocks it. Get it from him.

quests.name: Confront the Champion of Darkness
quests.description: The Champion of Darkness lies in wait just beyond that door! It is time to confront him, and end this once and for all.

quests.name: Destroy the Arsenal
quests.description: He's not here! We must have gotten to the cave too soon. Well, we may not have found the Champion of Darkness, but we DID find his arsenal. If we destroy the weapons and armor, then no one will be able to use them to harm Lore.

quests.name: Defeat the Armor
quests.description: There must be an insane amount of power in that armor! We can't destroy it - and as long as it's active, we can't destroy that blade, either.

quests.name: Tacos > Pizza
quests.description: WHAT?!?! Why are they serving pizza here?!?! Why not tacos? Maybe we have to prove to them that tacos are superior to pizza. So… we have to make them some tacos! Of course! Get me some Hole-y Cheese from /Lightguard, a pack of tortillas from StealthyCupcake in the /HeroTournament, some beef from the ChickenCow in /BattleonTown Forge, and… uh… a lot of pineapple from the Spineapple in /Freakitiki, so that NOBODY can make pizza with it.

quests.name: Charging Up!
quests.description: A disembodied voice issues from the speaker: "You have entered Area 42. Energy-Mana Amalgamation Test Subjects 1-4 have been placed here to protect top-secret research projects. Clearance Diode #10-26BD not detected. Leave at once or you will be recycled." Kill each of the four Test Subjects to charge the atmosphere.

quests.name: Take Up The Cause
quests.description: So you want to prove your worth to my people? Very well. Start by defending those of us left and avenging those who have fallen. Destroy 8 of Lionfang's invaders. If you survive this test I will have more for you.

quests.name: Well Kept Secrets
quests.description: Lionfang is here looking for something very precious to the Darkblood. If you wish to keep it from him, go to the Falguard Library and destroy these 6 titles. I hate to destroy books but Lionfang cannot be allowed to find the… well, just do it.

quests.name: Feeding On The Fallen
quests.description: The Darkblood are not wasteful. We feed on our own fallen as well as our enemies… this even applies to their possessions. Our weaponsmith could use enemy sword and shields to reforge into Darkblood weapons. Go claim the shields from the Chaonslaught Warriors and swords from the Chaonslaught Cavalry.

quests.name: Special Delivery
quests.description: Ralstis, the Falguard weaponsmith needs the items you have claimed from your victories. You must make your way to him and deliver them to him. He does not know you so he may kill you. Go, now.

quests.name: Precious Scraps
quests.description: You did so well with your last mission that Saluk, our armorer, has asked that you gather armor scraps from the Chaonslaught Cavalry and Warriors. Gather 5 good scraps, not too battle-worn, and return here.

quests.name: Restocking
quests.description: Saluk is expecting you in the Armor Shop. it is next to the Falguard Inn. Deliver these to him so that he can continue his work repairing the Dreadwatch's armor. Return to me after he has received them.

quests.name: An Innside Job
quests.description: The Dreadwatch has been instructed to regroup at the Falguard Inn, but first it needs to be cleared of intruders. Go to the inn located on the north-east side of town and slay anything that does not belong there. When it is clear return to me.

quests.name: Streets Run Red
quests.description: The Chaonslaught Casters have been using their empowered spells to slay my Dreadwatch on site. This will not stand. Go, avenge my brothers in arms. Bring swift but painful vengeance onto 10 Casters.

quests.name: Open The Temple
quests.description: Lionfang's manticore was just spotted landing in the Open Temple where our Primarch guards our secrets. We must open the temple doors before and help the Primarch while we still have time. The opening rune was lost in the invasion. Find it and return to me.

quests.name: The Open Temple
