quests.description: You found the rune?! Hurry, we must enter the Open Temple and help the Primarch defeat our thrice cursed enemy!

quests.name: Help Professor Maedoc
quests.description: To be one with the earth, you must know it inside and out. Break open the Balboas in /stalagbite and return with 25 Geodes. Do THAT, and you will understand the nature of my lessons better.

quests.name: Fungal Networking
quests.description: My druid brethren and I hear Nature's words rustling in the leaves. When I began to learn the ways of my forefathers, I expected a wise and motherly voice, but Nature's is full of playful youth. Just as I did, go harvest Myconids from /guardiantree and track down the Gurushroom from /greenguardeast. Gathering from Nature is how humanity came to stand on its own. We can learn much from returning to our roots.

quests.name: The Queen's Riddle
quests.description: My people have always respected your intelligence and wit. Your nature is one we recognize; that makes crafting a riddle YOU cannot answer even more of a challenge. "To win the favor of this Queen, give me what I've never seen…" (Hint: there is wisdom in adages, advice, and prophecies.)

quests.name: Natural Isomers
quests.description: The remnants of Chaos are still scattered across Dwarfhold, but they're nowhere near as dangerous as they used to be. I am curious about a theory Warlic and Tara were discussing back at the Temple. If you have some time, would you please retrieve Chaos Ether from the Draconians and Drow who still remain in Dwarfhold?

items_required.name: Draconian Chaos Ether x8 (Stacks up to 40)
Drow Chaos Ether x8 (Stacks up to 40)

quests.name: Ore-riginal Material
quests.description: Thelima City's blacksmiths are offering to refine our armor in exchange for ore! Would you like to add another set to your collection too? Then, please! Join us! The Balboa on the /mountainpath are walking ore deposits. It'll be easy.

quests.name: In Your Dreams
quests.description: Thelima City's blacksmiths are interested in a material called Orpheum Ore. They said it would meld well with the Mana Solace Paladins' magic, but Orpheum is incredibly rare. Know any place you can find it?

quests.name: Brainwyrm
quests.description: The Mana Solace Paladins are having a hard time sleeping. They're experimenting with new techniques, but nightmares of some sort of Wyrm keep scattering their ideas and dreams. I wonder how we can fix this.

quests.name: Guardians of the North
quests.description: It is a great responsibility we have, we Guardians of the North. We must shepherd the refugees who arrive. Once they disperse, they become the problem of the other Guardians, but for now… I could use a hand defeating the monsters that threaten them!

quests.name: Defend the Weak
quests.description: The goblins have developed a taste for refugee flesh. As a Guardian, I CANNOT allow that. But Cleric Crystal must be guarded, as well. Please, help me keep the refugees safe. Take out 10 goblins, for the refugee's safety!

quests.name: Pest Control
quests.description: These Kijimuna pester me whenever I venture outside. Surely you can't expect an old man to deal with such nonsense. If you want me to leave my home, then you'll have to do some pest control for me. Come back when it is as peaceful outside as it is in here.

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: You're asking a lot. Perhaps more than you even realize. For me to help you in this way would draw the attention of Malgor and put me in danger. If you want me to take that kind of risk, you'll have to prove you are capable of defending me. Find and kill Osanshouo, the giant salamander If you can survive his strong claws and venomous bite, then I will feel safe under your protection.

quests.name: Light for the Lantern
quests.description: In order to do what you ask, I need the use of my lantern. Its flame has run low, and I will need to replenish it. Of course, a spirit lantern can only use spectral flame. Get some from the Kosenjobi and bring it to me.

quests.name: Attune to Fuyurei
quests.description: In order to pinpoint the locations of the ley lines, I will need to attune my lantern to the various spirits in the area. First, collect the energy of the Fuyurei - their Ki - and bring it back to me here. Then, we will use it to attune my lantern to them.

quests.name: Follow the Path
quests.description: Now that my lantern is attuned to the Fuyurei, we can use it to see the roads they travel. Follow the path that my lantern reveals to you.

quests.name: Attune to Kijimuna
quests.description: Now we must map the path of the Kijimuna. Don't give me that look! My work requires much patience and much redundancy. Collect the Ki of the Kijimuna and bring it back to me. Then, as before, use it to attune mv lantern to those spirits.

quests.name: Path of the Kijimuna
quests.description: My lantern will now reveal to you the road that the Kijimuna travel. Follow the path that it reveals to you.

quests.name: Attune to Reishi
quests.description: And now, finally, we map the path of the Reishi. This is the last one, so don't let me hear you complaining. Collect the Ki of the Reishi. Bring it back to me here, and we will attune my lantern to them.

quests.name: Path of Reishi
quests.description: Yes, that's correct. You must divine the location of one final Spirit Road - that of the Reishi. My lantern will reveal it to you.

quests.name: Black Flames
quests.description: All of that work was NOT for nothing! Now that I have mapped three Spirit Roads, I can see where they currently intersect. This intersection is where we will speak to the ancestral spirits who guard these roads. But in order to do that, we must draw their attention. Only the brightest black flame will do. Get it from the Kosenjobi.

quests.name: Defeat Grandmother Hasu
quests.description: Grandmother Hasu does not seem to want to listen to reason! If you are able to best her, then hopefully, one of the others will.

quests.name: 'Twas the night before Frostval
quests.description: The timeless classic story book, 'Twas the Night Before Frostval, has gone missing! Someone… or something… must have stolen it last night. Check all the monsters in the area and see if any of them have it! Hurry Hero, the book has to be close by… try checking in the Snow Path that leads to the village!

quests.name: Find Page 2
quests.description: Free a Frozen Moglin to get a page detector, then click on my speech bubble and read the first page of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.

quests.name: Find Page 3
quests.description: We need to find the third page. Free a Frozen Moglin to get a page detector, then click on my speech bubble and read the first two pages of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.

quests.name: Find Page 4
quests.description: Three pages found… three pages to go! We need to find the fourth page. Click on my speech bubble and read the first three pages of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.

quests.name: Find Page 5
quests.description: Only two more pages left! We need to find the fifth page. Click on my speech bubble and read the four pages of the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.

quests.name: Find Page 6
quests.description: The Frostval story book is almost complete! Only one more page to go! Free a Frozen Moglin to get a page detector, then then click on my speech bubble and read through the Frostval story. There should be hints that will clue you in on where the next page might be found.

quests.name: Forged in Battle
quests.description: If I'm going to stay here to guard Skira, I might as well man the forge. The last smith was lost to the Firestrom. I need resources, and I'd appreciate your aid. Bring me 3 Coal Creeper Embers and 6 Pyradon Fangs.

quests.name: Where There's Smoke...
quests.description: Temple Guards are trained to watch for signs of fire, as they would destroy the temple. But here… fire is all around us. I will NEVER let my guard down, but I need your help to protect the city. Slay 2 Fyresyn and 5 Pyroclash so I can make a Blazebalm ward to shield us.

quests.name: A Grain of Dirt
quests.description: *A voice echoes from the blade.* From dirt comes a rare gemstone. You supply the dirt, and this blade will supply the gemstone.

quests.name: The Enforcer's Adornments
quests.description: Master Nulgath doesn't give the title of Contract Enforcer to just anyone. However, he's generously made an exception and is offering you the opportunity to join their ranks. Complete this first task, and you'll be rewarded with one of the Contract Enforcer's Adornments.

quests.name: The Enforcer's Armaments
quests.description: Master Nulgath doesn't give the title of Contract Enforcer to just anyone. However, he's generously made an exception and is offering you the opportunity to join their ranks. Complete this next task, and you'll be rewarded with one of the Contract Enforcer's Armaments.

quests.name: The Contract Enforcer
quests.description: You're almost ready to become Master Nulgath's next Contract Enforcer. There's just one final, simple task for you to complete.

quests.name: Dwarfhold Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the dwarfs.

quests.name: Good Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with those who battle against evil.

quests.name: Evil Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the followers of evil.

quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the Yokai.

quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the Vampires.

quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the Skyguard.

quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with Doomwood.

quests.name: Troll Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the trolls.

quests.name: Horc Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues for you if you trade with me. You will definitely gain some favor with the Horcs.

quests.name: Etherstorm Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor in Etherstorm with this!

quests.name: ChronoSpan Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor from the golems with this!

quests.name: ThunderForge Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor from the people of the ThunderForge Mountains with this!

quests.name: Swordhaven Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor from the people of Swordhaven with this!

quests.name: Chaos Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor from the people in the Chaos zones with this!

quests.name: Northpointe Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor from the people of Northpointe with this!

quests.name: Embersea Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor from the people of Embersea with this!

quests.name: Ravenloss Membership Dues
quests.description: I will pay your dues if you trade with me. You will DEFINITELY gain some favor in Ravenloss with this!

quests.name: Practice Time
quests.description: For some light practice, we'll set you up against the Living Brimstone, a type of combination rock and fire elemental found only in the Infernal Plane. Head to the Pit and we'll send one in.

quests.name: Get that Beetle
quests.description: If you want a tougher challenge, let's see how you fare against Megacerus! It's a species of giant, Infernal beetle, and it can be pretty deadly. Get in the pit if you want to fight it.

quests.name: Get In the Pit
quests.description: For a true test of your skills, you should go up against Nakhiir. Only the most skilled Infernal soldiers can hold their own against him. If you think you can handle him, get in the pit and I'll send him in.

quests.name: Twilight's Arcana Weapons
quests.description: Battle through the Mana Plane to gather the resources necessary to craft the Twilight's Arcana Staff or Greater Twilight Blade… IF you can gather them all, there's a chance we'll give one of the weapons to you. But *giggle* we might just keep them for ourselves. They are VERY shiny!

quests.name: C:\The Depths are a Harsh Mistress
quests.description: R-right! Let's bring some samples for when we return to the Panopticon! So we can check on your amnesia and… even perhaps help reduce any punishment we might get for getting lost. Um, let's see… AH! Those! They look oddly adorable! Subdue some of those squishy organic thingies in a container! You call them jie-lee… feesh, you say?

items_required.name: Squishy Organic Thingy x5 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Talk to the Guard
quests.description: Our plan is to get the guards to let us into the castle so we can take Maleth by surprise. Go and talk to them. Tell them you want to offer your support.

quests.name: Talk to the Villager
quests.description: So, Argo wants you to prove yourself by handling Maleth's problems for him? Looks like this is going to take longer than I hoped. Alright, let's start with the villagers. Exit east through the gate near the castle entrance, and see if you can find someone to talk to.

quests.name: Souvenirs for Bobby
quests.description: Voltaire said he was gonna be my mentor! He's teaching me to love slasher movies as much as he does. I'm starting out by building a souvenir collection - Shrade souvenirs! Only, I'm too little to fight him. Momma says so. If you fight him and bring me back a souvenir, maybe I'll give you something cool!

quests.name: Droid For Sale
quests.description: Hello! Want droid? State of the art. I give you one for some items and gold.

quests.name: Get Me Parts
quests.description: I need parts! Get me parts. Then I'll give you something in return.

items_required.name: Moon Guard Gauntlet Parts x5 (Stacks up to 30)
Infantry Droid Parts x10 (Stacks up to 60)
Tempest Soldier Armor Parts x10 (Stacks up to 60)
Fifth Sepulchure's Blade x1 (Stacks up to 6)

quests.name: Maxwell's Spare Parts
quests.description: Oh, my! Niteo absolutely MUST keep her animals better under control! Every time they escape, they somehow mange to get into my vault and steal my spare parts! This time, the birds have taken quite a bit of copper wiring, and the hounds have run off with my external hard drive! I really must get them back as soon as possible!

quests.name: Defeat Dogear!
quests.description: Dogear was an imposter! He is inside the bookstore. Defeat him and bring the book back to Maya!

quests.name: Ninja Grudge
quests.description: Ninjas and Assassins must always keep a cool head when going about the business of taking out their opponents. With one exception: Pirates! Those noisy and crude boat-riders are everything we Ninjas are not. Bring me back 12 Pirate Medallions from Fishman Soldiers or Shark Bait from Lolosia to prove your worth! You can find Lolosia in the Yokai or Dwarfhold section of your map.

quests.name: Without a Trace
quests.description: We must practice our art in such a way that no one knows we are the true culprit! Sneak around the forest and pick the pockets (or "pockets" - try not to think about it too hard) of all of its residents. Show me just how good you are at stealth!

quests.name: Hit Job
quests.description: This is dirty work, but somebody has to do it! SOMEONE has offered to pay me — er, US— very well if I— er YOU— would bring back the helmet of Ogug Stoneaxe and the sword of Breken the Vile to prove that you have "dealt" with them!

quests.name: Beat the Dire Groglurk!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Dire Groglurk! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Underbeast!
quests.description: Head to /ravenloss and take on the Underbeast! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Mutated Void Dragon!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Mutated Void Dragon! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Manticore!
quests.description: Head to /venomvaults and take on the Manticore! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat Binky!
quests.description: Head to /doomvault and take on Binky the Unicorn! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Beat the Hulking Castle Spider!
quests.description: Head to /bosschallenge and take on the Hulking Castle Spider! I'll cheer you on!

quests.name: Help MechQuest!
quests.description: *bzzzt* Initiate message sequence:

quests.name: Slay the Sordid Shadowscythe
quests.description: *bzzzt* Initiate confidential message recording:

quests.name: Challenge SN.O.W.
quests.description: Challenge a stronger version of SN.O.W..

quests.name: True Love
quests.description: I'm willing to come with you, but please - can you make sure you find my boyfriend, Andres? He disappeared a year before I was taken, and I saw his reflection in one of the mirrors here before I was trapped in this one. It will be easier to face the real world if he's with me. Please, find his mirrors, and rescue him! I think it was just a little further in than mine was.

quests.name: Nightmare Juice, Om Nom Nom
quests.description: Oh, did I say I'd help you? I did, didn't I? It's so hard to focus when I'm hungry, though. Maybe if I had a snack first? Nightmare essence would be lovely… let's say 8 of them. You can get them from any of the nightmare creatures here.

quests.name: Gentle Persuasion
quests.description: Ok, ok. This nightmare's gotta be hiding somewhere. Nothing that happens here goes totally unnoticed, so some of the other nightmare creatures must know something. Beat 'em up, and see what clues you can find.

quests.name: Breaking & Entering
quests.description: Geopetal! All the clues indicate SHE would know where Frostmane's nightmare is. Like your Geopetal, our nightmare Geo lives deep inside the mountain. To get inside, you'll need a key. 6 Rune Keys, to be exact. The Shadow People are the only ones who have them. I think you know what to do.

quests.name: The Hills Are Alive
quests.description: Being a nightmare, the mountain you're about to enter is, itself, alive. When you go inside, it will send tiny chunks of itself to attack you. You'll need to defeat these, um, nightmare rocks before Geopetal will be able to help you.

quests.name: A Geode for Geo
quests.description: Geopetal's STILL not talking to you? Maybe we just need to butter her up. Pretty geodes are what she likes best. Break open any rocks left in the mountain until you find a perfect one.

quests.name: Bribery
quests.description: Now that you have a nice gift for her, I bet Geopetal will be a lot more helpful! Go take this to her and see what she has to say!

quests.name: Defeat Frostmane's Nightmare
quests.description: Frostmane's nightmare has been hiding in the cave just past Geopetal! If you defeat it, both Frostmane and his sister Embermane will be freed. Also I'll get a really nice dinner.

quests.name: Find Memet
quests.description: Looks like Memet is gone. That's not good! She might be in trouble. You'd better go find her.

quests.name: Inquisite the Inquisitors
quests.description: The Inquisition's minions are no match for me! Time to strike them down!

quests.name: Captains Capped
quests.description: If I take out their Captains, their grunts will have to disperse. That's when I'll make my escape.

quests.name: Grand Defeat
quests.description: The Grand Inquisitor is in my way. Looks like I have no choice but to take him out.

quests.name: Portal Unlocked
quests.description: What is this portal? Could this be what the Inquisition is here for? It looks like it requires bones to power it… I know just the source!

quests.name: Fiend Training
quests.description: Strength is the only thing a Fiend understands. I will show them my strength and hope they learn something in the process.

quests.name: Failed Fiend Shards
quests.description: It appears some Fiends are attempting to commune with Adimonde and create Fiend Shards of their own. I will not tolerate this. I must destroy any attempts they make.

quests.name: Executed Tasks
quests.description: There are those Fiends that chose to disobey me. Very well. I will have their heads for treason!

quests.name: Champion Usurper
quests.description: A Fiend Champion dare challenge my authority? No matter. They will make a fine example to those who respect them over me.

quests.name: Break their Muti-kneecaps
quests.description: Those good-for-nothing Fiends! They think they can destroy my Fiend Shard while I was away? Foolish! Quickly, past the Fiend Champion and into the room where my Fiend Crystal is housed! I will show them my true power!!!

quests.name: Defeat the Minions
quests.description: Please help me! Defeat Sepulchure's minions before they destroy my tower. Defeat 2 Skeletal Minions and return to me to turn in your quest.

quests.name: Slay the Black Dragon
quests.description: Gather your strength and slay the black dragon at the top of Stonehand tower.

quests.name: Seek and Destroy
quests.description: We've got some party crashers wandering around Mythsong Canyon. They aren't doing anyone any good and it's time someone did something about it! …and that someone is YOU. Travel around Mythsong Canyon and bring me 3 Tune-a-Heads and 5 Beetle Wigs to assure that the job is done. Rock on and good luck!

quests.name: The Four Hoarsemen
quests.description: So ya think you have what it takes to bring down the Four Hoarsemen of Mythsong, huh? There is an abundance of tone-deaf baddies out there that are ruining the Lorestockapalooza atmosphere… and acoustics! Confront the Beatles, Grateful Undeads, and the Bruise Brothers (Elwood and Jake) and retrieve their Vocal Chords so that no one else may suffer through their horrid songs and vicious audio attacks.

quests.name: Ancient Mix it Up!
quests.description: The first thing any good Rogue needs to master is poisons. Whether it be a specially treated blade, or a few drops added to a glass, the proper application of poison can end a fight almost before it begins.The next best thing to Eye of Newt when it comes to making poisons? is Marsh Lurker's Eyes. Bring me 2 of them!

quests.name: Ancient Shadow Skills
quests.description: A Rogue needs to be able to blend in with their environment. These techniques allow them to surprise their enemy and strike them down without alerting anyone else to their presence. All Rogues learn their techniques imitating creatures in their wild state. Head to the Graveyard and find me 6 Shadow Fossils to prove you have studied the undead there.

quests.name: Ancient Evade and Counterstrike!
quests.description: Excellent work so far! You have demonstrated an aptitude for poisons, and a mastery of the techniques of stealth. Your final task involves demonstrating your prowess with the tools of our trade. Rogues often rely on quickness of foot to evade any traps. Go to Guru forest and face Wisteria. Bring me one of her tentacles if you survive!

quests.name: Ancient Shadow Hour
quests.description: You have done well mastering the art of stealth, and have become a true shadow walker! However, you still have much to learn… and I know a perfect place for you to further your training. My sources tell me that a new evil that has emerged in nearby Bludrut Keep; exploring its depths will provide your stealth and quickness as you confront this new threat. If you can return with 10 fire essences, I will know that you have truly honored the skills of your craft. (Bring back 10 fire essences to complete this quest)

quests.name: Renegade Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the RenegadeClass) You have proven your worth - you are now a Renegade. Sometimes however, these skill are not what is called for, but the look always is.

quests.name: Malfunction Junction
quests.description: Prof. Broun has asked me to de-activate the rampaging beasts and bring the malfunctioning devices back to him. Unfortunately, my little claws cannot carry the devices.

quests.name: Missing Equipments
quests.description: Prof. Broun would like his equipment returned to him. I believe Biff hid them somewhere in these caves as a joke. No doubt they have been rummaged through and scattered around by the wildlife.

quests.name: Marshmallows With Bite
quests.description: Let's start the tour. There are a few rules we need to follow before we can enter the labs. Wash your hands, pinch yourself to make sure you're not heading into work half hallucinating, and keep you lunch in airtight baggies so you won't spread crumbs around. Uh oh, looks like a few of the researchers' lunches got away from them. Could you bag those marshmallows? That's a euphemism for the Whale Lice.

quests.name: Meaty Cold Spaghetti
quests.description: The doors to the labs lock when they detect non-human intruders. Which means they lock when I'm around. Dr. Noelle said that bug's been taken care of…I'm sure she meant well. It was a joke she wanted to make us laugh with. The sensors are detecting other lifeforms, likely more ready packed meals that escaped their baggies. This time, could you bag those slippery Lamprey?

quests.name: Songs in the Seams
quests.description: Where did Dr. Caesar go? We were only getting started, but maybe I was boring him. O-oh well, that's alright. This area of the lab is safe, but you seem alarmed? If you're worried, then we'll find him right away! I think I saw him eyeing exposed patches of stone on the walls. We can check those, and look into Dr. Noelle's old office. He was interested in the Base's structure, and you can find a lot of building documents there.

quests.name: Parched Throats
quests.description: Your friend, Dr. Caesar, got me thinking about the Base's security and structure. Song knows more about Sparagmos than I do, but I want to stop and listen for a moment. The exposed patches of stone are similar to the rocks you found those journal pages on. I need the hall to be quieter so I can really listen. Could you please capture more of the Lice and Lamprey? We need to decrease the noise as much as possible.

quests.name: Morning Stretches
quests.description: I need to tell Song about what we discovered about the Base's structure. And maybe, it's safer to talk somewhere quiet in person instead of over the video channels where Dr. Noelle can hear us. She won't be back for a while, and you need to see the Champions first. Come with me, the lab's doors unlocked after you cleaned away the critters. We'll walk through and talk with Indradeep. He's been helping the Champions with their rehabilitation.

quests.name: Natural Empathy
quests.description: Aria and Yulgar have been arguing a lot because of her injuries. The more you care about someone, the more upset you get when they're hurt. She must be really agitated. The Decay Spirits sent to guard her are acting aggressively. They're powerful Nature Elementals trusted with Aria's safety, and get rowdy when she's upset. Let's calm them down before they knock over any beakers.

quests.name: Comfort Blanket of Snow
quests.description: Like with Aria, the Plane of Ice has sent Elementals to watch over Abel, their Envoy. He's stuck in that room, listening to Aria and Yulgar argue. Hopefully, Fa was nice enough to lend him earphones to block out the shouting, but his guards are as agitated as Aria's. Would you please calm the Ice Guardians too? Sorry I can't help much, but Indradeep's really fit! He can lift a few of them for you, and I'll treat you to a song later!

quests.name: Whale Watching
quests.description: We can calm the Spirits and Guardians, but they don't stay that way for long. Actually, they're gathering by the windows. I know it's a bit of a walk, but could we take a look at the windows in Dr. Noelle's office, the medical labs, and the surgery room? If you see anything, point it out. Just be careful if you see a loved one outside. One time I hallucinated that Ti was outside, asking me to go for a stroll with him, but you know…

quests.name: Exhausted Spirits
quests.description: It wasn't just me! Tara has the same bad feeling, one that's really shaking her up. And she isn't the only one. The Spirits and Guardians are beginning to act even more violently. Would you please restrain them? I'll run and get Tara a glass of water in the meantime. Don't let her jump around too much. She's still hiding how tired she is. Tara shouldn't be ashamed. This environment really isn't meant for us.

quests.name: Singing to Whales
quests.description: We've never been attacked by a sea creature this big before! If we let it swim away, it'll ram us again! The Base will snap in two! Aria and Abel are doing everything they can to hold that big whale in place. Sparagmos hasn't sounded an alarm, and the whale destroyed the emergency escape pods. It's going to take Song a while, but please! Knock the whale out or stall it until the Base can be evacuated!

quests.name: The Sea's Commitment
quests.description: There! On the rock clusters, I see another torn page shoved in a crevice! Fa also helped with construction on this floor, and she didn't see the journal entry while she was out there. Someone had to have placed it there recently. We should grab the page before it gets swept away by the ocean currents and have a read. Tara's spells will keep the water pressure from crushing us.

quests.name: Search for the Cursed Lovers
quests.description: Hero, you must reach Jeluti! I can hear her cries, and they only grow louder. Please battle your way to her side and find a way to help her! I fear you will need to re-slay all of the creatures standing in your way. The curse will ensure they try to keep you from her.

quests.name: Sing the Blues
quests.description: Brave Hero, to reunite these star-crossed lovers, you will need to talk to Moore directly, Once you meet with him, I am sure you will be able to save him. If you charge up J6’s hourglass by slaying the slain creatures here, I am sure you will find a way to pass through the curse and see him.

quests.name: Land of the Red
quests.description: Hurry! Moore is a strong man… ghost… person… but I can hear his heart breaking even further! He longs to be with his love, Hero. Can you deny him that? Battle your way to where he stands and waits. His friendship will serve you well if you will only help reunite him with Jeluti!

quests.name: Find the Source of the Curse
quests.description: Feel the rage, the all-consuming hate that emanates from behind that door! It frightens me! But Hero, I think you will have to get inside it. You will need 2 keys – the Key of True Love and the Key of Eternity. I am sure the infernal creature behind that door has given them to the monster for safe-keeping.

quests.name: Defeat the CurseMaker
quests.description: This… this is the cause of the curse that keeps Moore and Jeluti apart! Re-slay him and perhaps the star-crossed, curse-suffering lovers can be together for eternity!

quests.name: One Moore Time
quests.description: One more time, Hero, you will need to battle your way to Moore – find him and learn what he has to tell you. Kill 4 monsters in each room to pass, one for each chamber of the 2 lovers’ hearts. You must be determined but, since it is you, I do not think that will be a problem!

quests.name: You Only Get One Shot at True Love
quests.description: We only have ONE chance to succeed at this, Hero! Battle your way back to the tomb in which you faced Mercutio. If we can successfully save Jeluti, then maybe we will ALL be saved.

quests.name: Baucis's Pitcher
quests.description: When Zeus and Hermes, disguised as mortals, walked through Phrygia, they learned the people had forgotten hospitality. They knocked on every door and were turned away. Finally, they came to a rundown cottage where an older couple lived. Philemon and his wife Baucis invited the gods in and served what little they had. The gods watched as the coople served with a happy heart. If you are Good enough, seek out Earth Elementals to recreate this lovely pitcher, a symbol of service in love. Bride Pine Trolls and bring back the scared wood for Zeus' blessing.

quests.name: Oberon's Bouquet
quests.description: Wouldn't it be nice if all we had to do was wipe our true love's eyes with the dew of a flower and everything would be right in the world? That's precisely what Oberon, king of the Faeries thought. His queen, Titania, refused his requests and left him out in the cold. Unable to deal with this, he sent his faithful trickster, Puck, to retrieve for him what he needed to ensure her devotion. Journey throughout Lore and find all the materials needed to grow this flower. Seek out Seedspitters, Scarecrows, Cactus Creepers and Desert Vases to find these things.

quests.name: Pygmalian's Ivory Lady
quests.description: Artists…they specialize in the perfection of their art and oftentimes forget that real life is not like a canvas or a pure block of ivory. Such was the life of Pygmalian. He was a talented sculptor who found the woman of his day imperfect and incomplete. He detested them and the way they behaved, swearing to never love one. So he dedicated his life and time to art. In time, he procured a flawless piece of ivory and began to sculpt it, a shape slowly coming to life. Please, Hero, go out and get the tools needed to complete this masterpiece from the Gorillaphant, Living Water and Spider.

quests.name: The Ring of Shakuntala
quests.description: Shakuntala was a lovely woman that caught the eye of King Dushyanta while he was hunting in the forest. He fell in love with her and married her. They spent much time together, but he eventually had to return to his kingdom. He promised to come back for her and left. As she dreamt of him, a powerful rishi visited her home and she forgot to greet him properly. In his anger, he cursed her, saying the one she dreamt of would forget her unless he saw something special between them. You must gather materials from Ore Balboa, Crystal Rock, Fire Imps and Dark Witch to make the ring he gave her.

quests.name: Love Letters of Solitude
quests.description: There was once two lovers, Abelard and Heloise, who lived a love that many only dream of. He was a teacher, her, his student. She was intelligent, her mind one of the best and he slowly fell in love with her, eventually marrying her. One day, her uncle and friends attacked Abelard, mutilating him. They thought he had abandoned Heloise. Now, only those with an Evil heart can fight the evil done. While I compose myself please gather ink from a Table, parchment from Box Guardians, incense from a Trollola plant and Essence of Solitude from a Soulseeker and return to me.

quests.name: Barely Made It
quests.description: Before you help me, Lightguard needs you. I was traveling by wagon when the undead attacked. I made it back here but the wagon carrying much needed food and supplies didn't. You must locate that wagon in DoomWood!

quests.name: Plant Food
quests.description: First, see if you can recover all 15 crates of rations. The undead don't need food so it only makes sense that the Doomwood Treeants have it. Come back when you've got all the rations.

quests.name: Supplies Party
quests.description: The refugees are grateful for the rations but there were building, medical and other supplies in the other crates, not to mention my pack with all my research. They are probably scattered all over DoomWood by now. See if you can recover all the supply crates and see if the undead have my pack. Anyone of them might have taken it!

quests.name: Copious Notes
quests.description: DRAT! My pack is here but the notes I brought from Swordhaven's Library are gone! this is disasterous! That means that the undead know about the KEYSTONE! Quickly, take back all 10 pages of notes From the undead of DoomWood!

quests.name: Lightguard Keystone
quests.description: Now you know what is at stake. Head into the secret passage, make yor way past the sprites set to guard the keystone. If they pass over you while you are moving you will be ejected from the catacombs so move carefully.

quests.name: Defend Lightguard Keep!
quests.description: Of course, it's the fastest way for the undead to get into the room… ghosts can pass through walls without passing the guardian sprites! You have to get back down there and do whatever you can to defeat that spirit before Lightguard Falls!

quests.name: LightGuard Defender Tokens
quests.description: I may be a spirit now but it is still my duty to guard Lightguard Keep from the undead of DoomWood. Bring me DoomWood Creature Trophies and I will provide a LightGuard Defender Token. Use can use those to buy some items from me and you MIGHT just earn my armor while you are at it!

quests.name: Mock the Lock
quests.description: Before we can begin, I first need to free my friends - but the only one who has a key is the prison warden just beyond that barred door. We will need to MELT the lock on that door to gain an advantage over him! 4 Balboa Cores will work nicely as an aluminum base, and I will need 3 Rusted Claws from the Albino Bats for proper oxidation. Lastly, get me 1 Magnesium Flare from a Drow Soldier and bring it back here!

quests.name: Like Butter
quests.description: Here, take this Thermite, and go to the bars. Once you get there just use the Thermite on it and it SHOULD melt the lock. Try not to draw too much attention to yourself while you do it, and come back here as soon as you blow the lock.

quests.name: Jailhouse Rock
quests.description: Now that the Thermite has melted the lock, go through those barred doors and you will find the prison warden, Elfis. Some say he's the King of Rock! Regardless, he is the only Drow who has the key to our shackles, and the key to our freedom! Defeat him and bring me Elfis' Keyring. The sooner you do, the sooner we can get you out of here!

quests.name: Explosives 101
quests.description: Making an explosive is not too hard with the proper compounds! We will first need 3 NITRATE ELEMENTS from Albino Bats. These bats carry a lot of nitrates from the soil and their own… er.. waste. We need a long fuse as well, and 3 DROW SHOELACES should do the trick nicely. Finally, 2 FLINT STONES from the rocky Balboas will ignite the operation… literally!

quests.name: Big Bada-Boom
quests.description: Now all you have to do is plant the bomb. Don't worry about lighting the fuse, it's already lit.. so… uh.. you might want to get a move on! Go blow up that Huge Boulder and the rest of the path should be open! Hurry!

quests.name: Know the Nexus
quests.description: You must know the land before you can become comfortable battling in it. And, I fear, it is a battle you will face here! Discover the 4 islands which make up this section of the Dream-Nexus, a realm Khasaanda feels she can control.

quests.name: Secure a Route Home
quests.description: You cannot depend on Khasaanda to send us home once you are finished here. In this place, SHE reigns. Secure a route back to our world by activating the columns. You will need to gather the resources for me to prepare the activator. 2 each of Wyvern Scales, Wyvern Claws, Serpent Fangs, and Serpent Hair. Those last are rather rare…

quests.name: DreamDancers' Orbs
quests.description: Khasaanda has spoken of these orbs to me. They contain great power. It would be unwise to allow either Khasaanda or Drakath to tap this resource! Gather enough Aether to unlock them before Chaos can by collecting 11 flames and 10 flowers.

quests.name: Master the Flames
quests.description: You will need free access to the central island if you are to come out of this realm alive. The battle between Khasaanda and Drakath will take place there. Put out the flames; the only thing that will douse them is the liquid from the tears of 10 Solar Phoenixes and 5 drops of Phoenix Blood.

quests.name: Choose: Khasaanda Confrontation?
quests.description: I fear you will wind up facing Khasaanda in battle, but I do not know how. I hope you will choose to be merciful if it comes to that, but I understand that you must battle Chaos wherever it appears.

quests.name: Blood Titan's Tribute
quests.description: The Blood Titan requires much energy in battle. If you wish to train as one, you will need to fight my master at full strength. First, obtain a phial from him, then fill it with the blood of the Titanic Drakath in /titandrakath, Desoloth in /desoloth, and Ultra Carnax in /ultracarnax.

quests.name: Blood Titan's Challenge
quests.description: Your tribute has caused my master to grow in power. He awaits your challenge.

quests.name: Wartime Kaidan
quests.description: My ancestor was a warrior poet. Maybe, if I wrote a poem that reminded our four-legged neighing problem of his original partner, it'll be easier to appease him. Start by seeing if the Nopperabo are still around at the site of the /YokaiWar.

quests.name: Act of Loyalty
quests.description: The next battlefield we should visit is /ShogunWar, to recall the Shadow Samurai you fought there. These memories are more bitter, but raw emotions resonate more if the wounds are kept fresh.

items_required.name: Shadow Samurai Spirit x15 (Stacks up to 75)

quests.name: Natural Betrayal
quests.description: We should pay a visit to the site of /HakuWar next, and look for remnants of the Kitsune Spies and Dark Zmey. The Kitsune who participated in the battle have been catching a lot of flack from other Yokai. It's interesting.

quests.name: Coming Conflict
quests.description: This last trip is going to take us off of the Yokai Isles. Return to /ShadowBattleon, and show me what remains of the Ouro Spawn. The worries that plague my dreams are draped in shadow…

quests.name: Chi Tu
quests.description: My poem is complete. You've marched through countless battlefields, and brought an end to every war. The fiery stallion, Red Hare, challenges you to quench his flames. Show him that the Heroes of today have outran the legends of the past.

items_required.name: Red Hare's Bridle x1 (Stacks up to 5)

quests.name: Healing Crystals
quests.description: Hello, hero! My supply of healing crystals is getting low, and needs to be restocked. The crystals I need can be found in Earthstorm. Fight the gemstone golems you find there, and harvest shards of crystal from them. I'll need a good variety, so try to bring me some of everything!

quests.name: Balmblossom
quests.description: I've been doing some research for Master Healer Ll'Ara, and I've found that the blossoms that grow around town have very effective restorative properties! I'm trying out different salves and medicines they can be used in, so I'll need a good supply of them.

quests.name: Buy Tickets
quests.description: Insert Credits for Ticket, please!

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.

quests.name: Taking a Boat Trip
quests.description: Do you require a new piece of equipment to use? Is your blade getting dull? Or do you just prefer to have something finely made for once? Let us travel these lands. I will need Sullen and wrathful sounds found in the river /styx. Do not ask questions, retrieve these for me.

quests.name: Clear a Path
quests.description: I have heard in these lands named Fotia there is a resistance here against your Dage. It matters not which Dage, I will hear none of it. Take out some of the local creatures.

quests.name: Time for Some Spring Cleaning
quests.description: It's still noisy in this particular area. Why is it that your Dage allowed this area to exist in the first place? Take them all out.

quests.name: A Healer's Wish
quests.description: Our first Tanzaku comes from a kind-hearted healer. They want to heal injured heroes with a new salve of their own design, but are too short to gather the reagents. If you can harvest the treants from NibbleOn, the Guardian Tree and Brightoak, as well as a Treant Leaf and the staff of a famous healer, we can help this kind soul's wish come true!

quests.name: A Fishy Wish
quests.description: This Tanzaku smells… peculiar. We'd best grant it quickly before the scent begins to spread. It appears to be a simple request: "FISH! Lots of FISH!" . Bring some of the finest Anglerfish Filets from the Natatorium, choice cuts of Shark Bait and Kuro, a basket of Fish Wings, and a whole fish from the Fishman Soldiers, and we shall give them a feast for the ages!

quests.name: A Villain's Wish
quests.description: My, we're escalating quickly.This Tanzaku contains a request for total control of the world! As you might imagine, this is FAR beyond our power… though if you bring me some enchanted essence from the Elementals in /Gilead and a full set of carving tools from the bandits of /poisonforest, I believe I can make a solution that will please everyone.

quests.name: A Child's Wish
quests.description: My, what a cute wish slip! Oh, and an adorable desire to match…. It seems that this young girl is making a wish for new friends. Er, sort of. Specifically, she'd like ‘supplies' to… build some? A strange request, but I'd hate to leave a child unhappy. Parts from some of Lore's fiercest skeletons and the bones of undead from across Lore should do quite nicely for her needs.

quests.name: A Leader's Wish
quests.description: This next Tanzaku comes from one with titanic shoes to fill. As the new leader of his people, he seeks the strength to usher them into a bright future. Many of Embersea's remnants would be welcomed into his new alliance with open arms. Let us humble the Firestorm from /feverfew, /lavarun and the /fireforge, and leave them searching for his guidance!

quests.name: A Conqueror's Wish
quests.description: It appears that our next two individuals have written the exact same phrase on their slips: "Give me the power to overcome the one I despise." I can make two Doom Power Catalysts for them from the shells of Doom Overlords! Bring me undead souls from the /necrodungeon and essence from the creatures in /evilmarsh to empower our enigmatic evildoers.

quests.name: A Survivor's Wish
quests.description: Here is an odd slip, Hero- from one who seeks peace for those lost, as well as for themselves. They miss the times where friends gathered in a grand symphony… but even though their heart is heavy, the song of Lore must continue. If you can recall your experiences with their allies from /AstraviaJudge and /TheWorld, I could perhaps write my own tune to aid them.

quests.name: A Chaotic Wish
quests.description: This is the final wish left on the Tanabata… but something about it unnerves me. A fallen prince, rising only to fall again, seeks to learn from past failures. Records from the denizens of /transformation, /dreadforest, and /lagunabeach should serve his needs- but do not discover TOO much. This wish-maker's intentions are still unknown, after all…

quests.name: A Hero's Wish
quests.description: Surely you are entitled to one of your own? Go on, don't be shy! I just so happen to have one Tanzaku left. Write your wish, and I shall carry it to the heavens above when I depart for them.

quests.name: Stonecold Defense
quests.description: Slay the Infernal Goblins and Lava Trolls to get the reagents you need to create the Stoneskin Elixir. If you don't, things may get too hot to handle!

quests.name: Preying for a Good Offense
quests.description: These predators stand between you and rescuing the people of Embersea! Take out 3 Gargrowls, 2 Infernal Goblins, and 3 Lava Trolls!

quests.name: Red Alert
quests.description: You want to reach the kidnapped villagers without being detected? Then you're going to need to set warning beacons. These are magicked to let us know if anyone tied to the Onslaught approaches.

quests.name: Disguise Fur a Good Cause
quests.description: If you REALLY want to pass through the Fyreborn Caverns undetected, you'll need a disguise. I can craft you one, but I'll need resources from the Tigers, Lava Trolls, and Goblins to create it.

quests.name: Hunt for the Stolen
quests.description: The kidnapped villagers have GOT to be here! We could make a detection device but… we're running out of time! Do you hear that roaring? It makes me nervous. Hunt through the area to find the missing villagers.

quests.name: Rescue Run
quests.description: You found them?! What are you waiting for… let's go get them!

quests.name: Recover the Remainder
quests.description: We are missing many of the kidnapped, still. I didn't want to take the time to do this before, but we'll need to create a scrying crystal to find the rest. Slay Pyrric Ursus monsters to get the crystal required to create a scrying glass. That's what we need!

quests.name: Rune Chances of a Backstab
quests.description: I just realized… the wards we placed to protect us from the Firestorm Onslaught will NOT stop attaacks from the cavern creatures. Place 7 protective runes to ward off attacks from behind. And slay those Infernal Goblin spies while you're at it. They give me the creeps.

quests.name: Clear out the Caverns
quests.description: The creatures of the Fyreborn Caverns are NOT happy to see us! Take out the attackers to make sure we reach the villagers safely.

quests.name: Strengthen the Survivors
quests.description: We rescued the villagers, but they may not survive after all! It looks like Tyndarius left those who became ill. We need to make a restorative tonic to help them! Bring me the Sacred Flame, 3 Lava Runes, 4 Tiger Claws, and 1 Pyrric Gem to create potion to keep sick alive

quests.name: Bridge to Salvation
quests.description: There's only a little further to go, according to the scrying tool! But those Lava Trolls are about to destroy the ONE path we need to take. Take out 7 of them to save bridge from being destroyed.

quests.name: Growling Pains
quests.description: The Gargrowls in the caverns are some of the most ferocious I've ever seen. And their favorite snack is … heroes like us! When they can't get that, they prefer the weak and sick. Easier to catch. Slay the Gargrowls to protect us all!

quests.name: Defeat Cinderclaw
quests.description: The LAST thing standing in the way of us reaching the rest of the kidnapped villagers is the terrorbeast, Cinderclaw the Ravenous!

location.name: Inn at the Edge of Time

quests.name: Unlocking the Antechamber
quests.description: The gates to the Antechamber of the Exaltia Tower are sealed by a special elemental lock. You will need to gather the appropriate Elemental Essences of Fire and Ice to proceed into the Tower.

quests.name: Ezrajal
quests.description: In the Antechamber waits Ezrajal, an Exalted tasked with protecting the entrance of the Exaltia Tower. You must defeat him if you wish to ascend the Tower and claim your prize at the end!

quests.name: Unlocking the Reliquary
quests.description: The next floor of the Tower is the Reliquary. In order to access it, you will have to undo its elemental lock, much like before. This time, the gates are sealed with locks of Nature and Wind. Gather the Essences and proceed to the Tower's Reliquary.

quests.name: The Warden
quests.description: The Warden guards the Reliquary and all its contents. If you are to progress to the Tower's Apex, it must be dealt with.

quests.name: Unlocking the Apex
quests.description: The final gate keeps you from the Apex. You must collect the Energy and Water Essences that keep the gate sealed in order to face the Tower's final foe.

quests.name: The Engineer
quests.description: Atop the Tower's Apex stands the Engineer, protecting the fabled weapon used in The Final Stand of Ehr'Ishin. They will not go easily, but neither shall you.

quests.name: Rescue the Knights
quests.description: We were guarding Sepulchure's cursed armor at the bottom of this crypt. But it was corrupted by the chaos…. It turned the other Knights into monsters! They were corrupted… chaos…. Chaorrupted! Go into the crypt, and defeat all of the knights so that we can back to Swordhaven for treatment!

quests.name: Enter the Gates
quests.description: The Skeletal Fire Mages are burning everything in sight. You must help protect the King! Slay 4 of these fireball hurling fiends and I will give you the key to get inside.

quests.name: Crabby Valentine
quests.description: AGGH! Beach Crabs everywhere! I know you're ready to find Beleen, but these crabby critters are being shellfish and want all the attention. So let's give them what they want--your FULL attention during battle! Bring me 9 Crab Claws to thin this cast of crabs.

quests.name: Chinchillin'
quests.description: OH no, it looks like Beleen's chinchillas escaped! Trying to catch a Chinchilla is like trying to catch a squirrel on Red Bull (seriously). You'll need to wrangle 5 of these bouncy balls of fur before Beleen finds out I lost her pets. Please hurry!

quests.name: Confectionary Wisdom
quests.description: We've got another problem: the bridge over Sriracha River melted away! (How does Beleen eat that stuff without dissolving?) Luckily, the Fortune Cookies *should* provide us an answer! Defeat enough Fortune Cookies to figure out how to cross the river.

quests.name: Loony balloons
quests.description: Looks like we're going to need balloons to safety cross the Sriracha River. That stuff is so hot it burnt down a wooden bridge… I can only imagine what would happen if you stepped foot in it! Collect balloons from Balloon Animals and Balloon Trees, and then build the Balloon Bridge to cross the Sriracha River.

quests.name: Disgruntled Draconians
quests.description: Okay, so I know Draconians are mean dragons… but Beleen, being Beleen, put giant bows on their heads. Not only do the Draconians looks silly, but they're also EXTREMELY angry. Quickly--you'll need to defeat the Draconian swarm before they destroy Beleen's Dream Island!

quests.name: Paws n' D'awwws!
quests.description: Beleen is at it again! This time she's put hair bows on Doomkittens. They will tear her to shreds if we fail to nip these cats in the bud. Defeat 6 of them to save Beleen from a flurry of cat scratches!

quests.name: Power of Love... Elementals
quests.description: Beleen is looking for her true love, and she wants you to learn how to love… by breaking hearts? Don't ask me… she just told me to say that. Collect 7 Elemental Hearts from the Love Elementals and bring them to me so I can award you with gold and experience!

quests.name: Red Velvet Cake Rope
quests.description: One does not simply cross the Red Velvet (Cake) Rope. You will need to find something from the Island monsters to construct a weapon powerful enough to get past the rope. Bring me back all the items from my list and let's see if we can cross that rope.

quests.name: The Legendary Cherry
quests.description: YES! Now that you have been admitted, you can climb the Red Velvet Cake Mountain and claim that crystallized cherry on top! Hurry and reach it--because Beleen promised that whoever finds the Legendary Cherry WILL BE her Valentine!

quests.name: Your Just Deserts
quests.description: This battle is not going to be a piece of cake. If Beleen is held captive beyond those doors, you MUST rescue her!

quests.name: Slimes on a bridge
quests.description: If it's not one thing it's another - we finally get rid of all those undead, and NOW look what's coming back?

quests.name: Time to Get to Work
quests.description: When it comes to hunting down time creatures, we require many supplies to sustain our time travel. If you aren't busy, perhaps you could gather us a few that we will need on our next hunt! We will need some Time Dust from the local Ephemerites and some Chronocloth from some Time Wraiths.

quests.name: Time's Mirror
quests.description: In a Dark Dungeon in the Mirror Realm lies a creature that is known for its association to the Eternal Dragon. It is said that it is able to sense the powers of the Dragon in even the smallest traces. Could you retrieve me this creatures Brain so that we may use it to locate creatures that may use the Eternal Dragons power for evil?

quests.name: Surveillance for Sir Valence
quests.description: Take a look around the Venom Vaults. I haven't seen any sign of Lionfang for a while but the halls are crawling with his Chaonslaught Soldiers. Be careful. Return once you have the lay of the land.

quests.name: Well Planned Getaway
quests.description: Always have your exits covered. When we get out of here we'll want as little opposition as possible so take out 6 of the Chaonslaught Warriors to make leaving as painless as possible when the time comes.

quests.name: Secrets Of The Mad Prince
quests.description: The mad prince who lives here had to have a way to safely train his pets. His journal is still inside the Venom Vaults somewhere. Find it and bring it back here. I will be able to translate it for you.

quests.name: Potion of Cleansing
quests.description: I see. the journal mentions a potion that was able to counteract the manticore poison, but he had to keep bathing in it to wash off the poison. The recipe for the potion has to be in there somewhere. Scour the grounds. Find it or else we're sunk.

quests.name: You've Been Noticed
quests.description: You're not quite as stealthy as I am but I can't argue your results. Unfortunately the Chaonslaught Magi have noticed the potion recipe has gone missing. QUIETLY take out 6 of them and you'll have a much better chance of going unnoticed.

quests.name: Thorny Situations
quests.description: Now that you have a mage clove you should be able to pluck 5 venom Roses from around the Venom Vaults. We will need to use them in the Potion of Cleansing.

quests.name: Other Ingredients
quests.description: The Chaonslaught Magi will have all the other ingredients that we need for the potion but I don't think they will just hand them over. Secure 3 Spell Pouches however you can.

quests.name: Time For Supplies
quests.description: Now that we have all the ingredients we will have to be creative with getting the rest of the supplies. We need at least one Potion Vial, and I've seen the Warriors carrying a few potions on them. See if you can get an unbroken Potion Vial off of one of them!

quests.name: Cooking Without Fire
quests.description: We can't risk starting a fire to cook the potion up but the soldiers all usually carry some sort of magical heating element on them to keep them warm… we could use that. Search the Warriors and Magi until you find one of these Heating Elements.

quests.name: Introduction
quests.description: OK, the Potion of Cleansing is ready to be introduced into the water supply of the Venom Vaults. You'll need to find 3 chaorrupted lion-head fountains around the area and pour some of the potion into them. Get back here as soon as you're done.

quests.name: Courtyard Key
quests.description: The potion is making it's way into the water supply so you'd better be ready to attack. One of the soldiers will have a key to the courtyard gate. Find it… I will keep watch out here for Lionfang.

quests.name: Take Out The Chaos Manticore!
quests.description: You need to battle the Chaos Manticore now! Lionfang is headed this way. The manticore will poison you, just use the potion in the waterfall (Remove Poison Button) to keep the poison off of you as much as you can and defeat that beast before it can attack more innocents. Good luck, hero!

quests.name: The Taint Spreads
quests.description: It is imperative we reach Scarsgarde Keep without beeing detected. Deadlicks' flying poison-eyes and guards grifs patrol the forest. We'll need to take them out if we have any hope of sneaking closer. Slay VenomWings, then put their tainted meat around the woods. That will take care of both.

quests.name: Beauty Twisted
quests.description: The Garde Grifs are relentless! Many of them refused to eat the tainted meat (not that I blamed them)… but now we need to attack the more directly. Take out the 7 closest Garde Grifs while I plan our next move.

quests.name: Element of Surprise
quests.description: The best scenario would be for us to silently take out as many of the guards patrolling the woods as possible. That will let us sneak as close as we can to the keep. Get branches from the trees nearby, then lay traps in the arena. If luck and the Elemental Avatar are with us, we can trap most of them.

quests.name: (Take the) Watch Out
quests.description: I fear an alarm may have been raised inside the Keep. They should not be this many Garde Watch and Pikeman patrolling at this hour. This deviates from their usual routine. Take out the Garde Watch and Pikeman nearby; they are come too close, and we cannot risk discovery.

quests.name: False Hoods
quests.description: Alright. Here's our best shot at breaching in Keep without challenge. We're going to need to BECOME members of the Scarsgrade Watch. Or, at least, pass for them. Take down members of the Watch to get a hood, scarf, tunic, leggings, boots and dagger

quests.name: Pass for Real
quests.description: We COULD sneak in the back door, but I imagine they're on guard for that. I would be, if I were them. So we'll do the UNexpected, and walk up to the front door. All we need is the passode. Each type of Keep soldier has a section of it. *Persuade* the Knight, Pikemen and Watch and search the trapped knights until you have all 5 pieces of the passcode.

quests.name: Hidden in Plain Sight
quests.description: Alright. You look like like a Keep Guard. You've got a passcode like a Keep Guard. How all you have to do is walk past the final line of guard, right up to the door. Remember to greet each of your fwllow guards as you go by them, or they'll be suspicious (Walk up to guards to greet them.)

quests.name: Stay Strong, Keep Steady
quests.description: You made it! Lynaria is already deeper inside the Keep, talking out the Knights in the dining hall. You need to take out this last round of Knights and Pikemen in the hall before you face the Captain.

quests.name: The Final Fight
quests.description: This Captain is all that stands between us and victory! Once he's down. we'll be able to move the rest of our army in and secure the Keep. It will make the perfect launch padfot the assault on Dreadhaven.

quests.name: Arm the Army
quests.description: You know how the saying goes… an army marches on its stomach. Truer words were never spoken. If we're going to feed the men and women fighting with us, we're going to need food. And to get food, we need gold. I see the latest wave of Keep patrols returning home. Slay them and take their gold so we can feed the troops.

quests.name: Toil the Gargoyle (Daily)
quests.description: Gargoyles are supposed to scare off evil spirits… but the Swordhaven Gargoyles are scaring off everybody and destroying our kingdom! I could use your help everyday dismantling our resident Gargoyles that will go helping Swordhaven repair all the damage done by these granite giants.

quests.name: Boy Fiends and Ghoul Fiends
quests.description: Have you seen the Dungeon Fiends? Little is known about these creatures, and in an attempt to study the habits of Male and Female Dungeon Fiends, Swordhaven needs your help differentiating between the two genders. Find and bring back:

quests.name: Arachnid Eradication
quests.description: Nothing is more frightening than an eight-legged arachnid plotting his next attack-especially ones the size of Baby Dragons! Swordhaven is in need of an exterminator, and it looks like you fit that description nicely. Eradicate 10 Castle Spiders to transform Spiderhaven back into Swordhaven!

quests.name: Apparition Nation
quests.description: Swordhaven is a safe haven to all heroes… but the vile villains we've defeated throughout the ages come back as Castle Wraiths. With everything else going on, we need brave souls to defeat these undead souls! Defeat 10 Castle Wraiths and return to me with your good news!

quests.name: Time Beast
quests.description: One of the more interesting creatures we have encountered is Carnax in /aqlesson. It is said to be the creature that causes the end of time itself. Perhaps you could defeat it and prove that you are worthy of being an Infinity Knight!

quests.name: Undead Champion Recruitment
quests.description: I suppose one of the benefits of being stationed here in Dreadrock is the variety of recruits to choose from. As a high-ranking Undead Champion, you are obligated to go and *convince* some of the citizens to join our cause.

quests.name: Recruiting for the Undead Legion
quests.description: I suppose one of the benefits of being stationed here in Dreadrock is a plentiful source of recruits. Go around and defeat enough enemies until you've convinced them to join our ranks.

quests.name: Undead Champion Soul Trapping
quests.description: Persuasion is one way to recruit new members to the Legion; but personally, I am a fan of soul trapping. Retrieve the Corrupted Dragon Slayer from Undead Champion Exercise #4 and bind 14 Dreadrock souls to it. You can slay any monster here in the city. And to ensure that they STAY bound, I'll need the Soulseeker's Soul Scythe as well. You will be heavily rewarded for your efforts.

quests.name: Soul Trapping
quests.description: Persuasion is one way to recruit new members to the Legion; however, I personally am a fan of soul trapping. Defeat 14 enemies here in Dreadrock and trap their souls with the Soulseeker's Soul Scythe. You will be rewarded for your service to the Undead Legion.

quests.name: Package Delivery
quests.description: Most of the Infernals here are clients of mine - all of this fire and brimstone is terrible for your complexion! I've put together everyone's weekly packages of moisturizers, exfoliants and oils. I just need someone to deliver them. Oh, I know! YOU could to that for me! (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Gather the Ingredients
quests.description: How do I get brightly colored dye to last so long in my customers' hair? Shh! The secret is in the hair gel! A special kind of colored hair gel that I make from slimes! Please don't tell anyone. Help me restock and I'll do you up! I need green gel from the slimes in /greenguardwest, pink gel from the slimes in /extinction, and purple gel from the slime in Yulgar's /cellar.

quests.name: Scents-tastic
quests.description: I like to give my clients a nice dusting of brimstone after I finish up - it gives them that nice, Infernal scent! The best source of it, I've found, is the fire imps in /mobius. Be a dear and bring me some, would you?

quests.name: EEK!
quests.description: Look, if you're going to be in here, could you at least get rid of some of these rats? They keep trying to eat my toes.

quests.name: Warrior Claymore Blade Enchant
quests.description: Bring me one of these Warrior Claymore Blades and I'll enthrall it with new energy.

quests.name: Iron Wing Helm Enchant
quests.description: If you can bring me an "Ordinary Iron Wing" Helm and Nulgath Rune 4, I'll curse it with dark energy. You'll strike fear in your enemies.

items_required.name: Skull Warrior Rune x1 (Stacks up to 13)

quests.name: Cursing of Spinal Tap
quests.description: Bring me a "Spinal Tap" dagger and I'll enchant it with the power of darkness to aid you in your fight.

quests.name: Tainted Claw
quests.description: Bring me the Claw of Nulgath and I'll empower it for you.

quests.name: Maw of the Void
quests.description: You again? Good timing. This sword I procured is out of control, and it's eating all of my Tainted Gems! Find something else for this thing to feed on, and I'll give you a nice reward!

quests.name: Eternal Rest
quests.description: Master's minion, I am granting you a chance to obtain the Void Avenger, a scythe enhanced by the magical powers from a well known Blood Knight from his army and a Tech Mage from another dimension. With proper reagents, we can stabilize the void energy that flows from it allowing us to shape the blade made by nothing but still capable to cut anything in half on a single blow, even the moon. So.. what are you waiting for? This is the time when I stop talking and you go hunt the reagents as my Master hates waiting!

quests.name: Plagued by Flames
quests.description: As a Water Healer in Embersea, I am often uncomfortable, but I bear it because sometimes one must suffer in order to achieve their goals. And right now, MINE is to stop the plague. Bring me 3 Shorewort plants and Firestorm gallbladders. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: AquaPyrrus: FireWater of Life
quests.description: One of the most valuable treasures of the Embersea Water Temple is the AquaPyrrus elixir - a potion made from Embersea's water, a rare poison, and several secret ingredients. I have run out, and must make more. Bring me 5 vials of fresh water and 5 Pyradon venom sacs. (NOTE: can only be done once per log in)

quests.name: Tasty!
quests.description: These chaorrupted critters can be tricky to feed, but one thing I've noticed all of them will eat is egg yolks. Just outside the door, you'll find some chaos eggs. Can you collect their yolks for me so I can feed my pets?

quests.name: Field Work
quests.description: New assistant! I need some more data on a few species of chaorrupted creatures! I must stay here and mind the shop, but can you do the field work for me. right? I need info on the Chaotic Chinchilizards in /bloodtuskwar, the Chais Sp-Eyes in /mobius, and the Chaos Spiders in /chaosmarsh. Just fight them for awhile, and record how they respond.

quests.name: Making Gel
quests.description: These Chinchilizards can't take normal baths - it takes their fur ages to dry. So, what I do is give them dust baths, and then condition their fur with Chinchili-Gel! It's my own invention, made from Violet Slime. I'm running really low right now, and I need to make some more. Bring me 5 buckets of slime - that should be enough to keep them clean for awhile!

quests.name: Lycan Pirate Medal
quests.description: The Crimson Veil's crew be waltzing around like they've already won. Howl with the pack, and rip out their fangs. They'll be gumming at guppies when we're done with'em, harharhar!

items_required.name: Lycan Pirate Medal x5 (Stacks up to 300)

quests.name: Mega Lycan Pirate Medal
quests.description: Those bloodsuckers be dressin' all noble-like, but they're leeches all the same. Even snakes 'ave our respect more, because at least none of them be pretending they ain't beasts. Stand up, pup. Show'em that the Full Moon sails fer blood!

items_required.name: Mega Lycan Pirate Medal x3 (Stacks up to 300)

quests.name: Bloodsong
quests.description: Get out of the water! Vampires be lurking in the depths, an' they reek worse than fly-infested corpses. Who are they? Was Bonnie's crew larger than we thought? Bring me their blood, and I'll have their scent.

quests.name: Key to the ShadowLord
quests.description: IF you are brave enough to face the Shadow Lord, collect the items required to unlock the Portal by slaying the guardians in the Shadow Realm. If you are a Legend in AQWorlds, you can go right to the boss!

quests.name: Silent Sentinel Medallion
quests.description: Bring back 5 Jus Divium Signet Rings and exchange them for 1 Silent Sentinel Medallion

quests.name: Sentinels Writ
quests.description: Gather 10 Strange Knight Helms and exchange them for 1 Sentinels Writ.

quests.name: Sentinels Platinum Coin
quests.description: Return with Baxter's Broken Guardian Blade and exchange it for one hard to obtain Sentinels Platinum Coin!

quests.name: Stone Cold Monster
quests.description: Just outside Battleon in Eastern Greenguard Forest, beneath a tree stumpyou'llyou will find the Greenguard Basilisk. This creature has been turning Guardians to stone. We may be able to reverse the process if you bring me a Vial of Basilisk Venom. Please, help us!

quests.name: Chaos Forge Enchantment
quests.description: Bring the Sneevil Smith a Rune of Chaos Enchantment from a Chaos Lord and he will apply it to a random Chaos Forge weapon!

quests.name: Snowball Thinks You're the Best
quests.description: Snowball says you're awesome. Zoshi doesn't know how awesome you are, not yet. But he will. You just have to show him. Kill the worst bosses in the Tower of Doom… Slugbutter, Dread Fang, Dread Avatar, Dread Warrior, Dread Terror. Bring him their Dread Teeth as proof. Also… ALSO a Dread Talon from a Mutated Void Dragon. THEN he'll know. Maybe he'll even reward you for it!

quests.name: Seven Sisters
quests.description: Have you met the seven sisters yet? I owe each and every one of them my life. They all found me, and together they took care of me while my wounds healed. Why don't you go and introduce yourself to all seven of them, and come back to me when you're done.

quests.name: Warm and Furry
quests.description: After I escaped from Dwarfhold I had to make my way through the pine forest surroundin' the mountain. The area is SWARMIN' with all sorts of nasty beasties, but the bears are the worst of them. If you can bring me 5 Bear Skins, then I know that my axe will be in good hands.

quests.name: Shell Shock
quests.description: As much as I love it here in this tavern, it can get a bit dull sometimes. I have to come up with ways to entertain myself. One thing that I LOVE to do is gamble, but my gamblin' buddy, Donna Charmer the Ilama Farmer, got mad at our last game and stormed off with the cards. I can make some more out of turtle shell but I need you to go to the forest and bring me 5 Red Turtle Shells.

quests.name: Bear Facts
quests.description: In the pine forest, there is a chaorrupted grizzly that the locals have named Twistedtooth. None of the hunters who have gone after him have come back, and he's been scaring off all the usual customers in the Inn. No customers means no one to gamble with, and that means no GOLD. Get rid of Twistedtooth, will ya? Maybe then I can get back to my card games.

quests.name: Fossil Find Fiend
quests.description: Aaah, Hero. I find my duties as a Troll Elder prevent me from the archeological excursions I found so fascinating in my youth! Please gather 10 Buried Fossils from the ground and split open 3 rocks to find Hidden Fossils, then bring your findings back to me!

quests.name: The Low Elvish Language
quests.description: I wish to share my knowledge with you, but i fear you will not able to learn all you can unless you have study aids. Bring me 10 Dictionary Page 1's, hidden inside The Trollola Plants, and 10 Translation Page 1's, stolen by Rhison. You will learn the language AND more of our culture at the same time!

quests.name: The High Trollic Language
quests.description: I wish to share my knowledge with you, but I fear you will not able to learn all you can unless you have study aids. Break 10 Rocks to find Dictionary Page 2's hidden under them and gather 10 Translation Page 2's, which can be found abandoned by Trollola Plants. Learn the language AND more of our culture at the same time!

quests.name: The Low Trollic Language
quests.description: I wish to share my knowledge with you, but I fear you will not able to learn all you can unless you have study aids. By combining 10 vivals of Vulture Spit with 5 Pulverized Ravine Rocks, I can make the potion to reveal the invisible ink Low Trollic texts are written in. Learn the language AND more of our culture at the same time!

quests.name: Philosophy of Mortality in Non-Trolls: A Study
quests.description: I am getting old, Hero. But I refuse to give up my studies! I would like, though, to know more about the nature of Death. It is a topic much on my mind. Please bring me back the notes after having slain 10 Vultures, 5 Boars, 5 Rhinson, and 1 Trollola Plant. I am interested in how each meets death. Especially the plant.

quests.name: The Hierophant
quests.description: We are in the Fool's Realm? Unlike you and the others, I am not directly tethered to the Primordial's power. Not to mention, I was not trained in combat. I won't be of use to you if we need to fight, but I can assist in any area of study. The first issue I'd like to tackle is our lack of supplies and tools. Are there ways we would be able to procure them without leaving this realm? You can open dimensional rifts? That's incredible! Please demonstrate!

quests.name: The Lovers, Reversed
quests.description: To grow the clone you had in mind, I advise running trial tests first. I was not able to successfully create a full copy of a person while I was at the Academy. Since the rifts are open, there should be all manner of beasts available to us. I'll lure them in and have Aurola help you…You want her to rest instead? I see. Please, exercise caution when you fight the beasts. We don't fully know what your new body is capable of.

quests.name: The Chariot
quests.description: We require tools and materials to conduct trial runs. Acquiring them from Astravia is too risky, and Drago must have already confiscated the Capital's technology. I hesitated to ask this of you before. But, if you are determined to return to the First Observatory, we must do it now. With a body from the Primordial Fool, you won't be able to traverse Lore soon. We need to gather as many machine parts as we can. Or anything of possible use.

quests.name: Strength
quests.description: Though the trial runs were a success, I hesitate to operate on Titania or Regulus until I am certain the process works with humans. Under normal circumstances, Astravians turn to dust when they perish. It would be difficult to conduct tests with the traitors. Aurola is uneasy about the idea as well. In that case, I have heard of supposed undead existing in Lore. Please open rifts to these locations and I will lure them in for Aurola's peace of mind.

quests.name: The Hermit
quests.description: The organs were compatible with Ti and Re. They are…as close to their original selves as we can manage. We're prepared to move on to cloning a copy of you. I created a larger tank and a gate similar to the First Observatory's. Our final problem is the massive amount of energy needed to power them both. To this end, we need a rift that leads to the generator under Astravia. Proceed with caution. Dismantling it may cause it to become hostile.

quests.name: A Fishy Frenzy
