quests.description: Hero? Ah, good, you're there. I'm going to communicate with you telepathically as you make your way through. Remember: each psyche you visit is representative of the person it belongs to.

quests.name: Love You To DEATH
quests.description: Even love can become warped and twisted over time—until it becomes an obsession. Take care of that beast, so we can set things right.

quests.name: Potion Commotion
quests.description: Potion bottles? Hmm…there are an awful lot of them around. Could this be Alina's psyche? You'll have to clear our these bottles before you can proceed. And some of them may have spilled back into the previous psyches—you'll need to retrieve those, as well.

quests.name: The Melancholy of Alina
quests.description: Even the strongest potions can't cure a heartbreak—and Alina knows that very well. Defeat her sorry to ease her pain and clear her mind of any doubts.

quests.name: The Escapist
quests.description: Is that… Twilly? I suppose all that punting has gone to his head, literally. If you want to get him down from there, you'll need to do something about that cage. Go back to Alina's psyche and see if you can't find any corrosive potions lying around. Once you have a potion, you can use it to get Twilly out of that cage!

quests.name: A Wary Library
quests.description: Books? This must be Maya's psyche. I wonder if…hmm. She seems pretty happy. I think we should leave this one alone. But these flying books are a nuisance. We can't have them escaping into the next area, so take a few of them out.

quests.name: The More You Glow
quests.description: For this next psyche, you'll have to…wait, you can't see anything? *sigh* Good thing I slipped you that pouch of mana dust before you left. Spread it around and see if you can't light up the area. Let me know if you find any clues.

quests.name: Socktacular Slayhem
quests.description: So this is Cysero's psyche. I…can't really say I expected anything different. It looks like you'll have to clear out some of these sock wraiths before you can continue.

quests.name: Socktimus Prime
quests.description: Cysero's great fear is not being able to find his left sock? That's…surprisingly useful information. I should write this down… Er, right. In any case, we should defeat that sock monster. You know, to restore order and all.

quests.name: Primordial Fear
quests.description: Wait…what's going on? This isn't Cysero's psyche… It's…so cold. Whose fear is this? Whoever this person is, they've been afflicted by one of the worst fears of all—the primordial fear of death. Defeat Thanatops to try and free this person from their torment.

quests.name: Bunnihilation
quests.description: And this is…? Oh. This must be Aria's psyche.

quests.name: Bunnihilation, Vol. II
quests.description: This is it, Hero. The greatest emotional disturbance leads to here. Raw anger is dangerous. And Aria has plenty of it to back her up. Wait…is that a giant bunny?

quests.name: Unrequited Love
quests.description: Looks like I'm on my own for this one… That thing must have escaped from Sora's own psyche. And it's been twisted by everyone's residual emotions. If it escapes the timelock…Sora will die, Warlic will be destroyed, and all of Battleon will be in danger. For everyone's sake, I have to take it down!

quests.name: Soul Eater Collection Badge
quests.description: [Gives character page badge] Bring me the soul of the ArchFiend Dragonlord in the Underlair, and my appetite — for a short time — will be sated

items.name: Devourer of Souls Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: The Soul Forge Hammer (Unlock Soul Forge)
quests.description: Check out my Soul Forge. Pretty epic, I know. And if you want to use it, you're going to need to make your own Soul Forge Hammer. Bring me an Iron Hammer from the Skeletal Warriors in BattleUnder, Zardman's Stonehammer from the Grunts in the Forest, and the Elemental Rock Hammer from that Rock boss in Bludrut.

quests.name: Activate the Spacetimebobulator
quests.description: Go ahead and activate the Spacetimebobulator, buddy! Let's find Warlic the holiday cheer he so desperately needs!

quests.name: Defeat the Guardian Spirit
quests.description: Although I was not able to retrieve the Celestial Horn of Balance, I know what needs to be done. For all Brightoak, you must defeat the Guardian spirit and restore balance to Elfhame!

quests.name: The Path of the King
quests.description: If you wish to take up King Alteon's blade and ideals, you must prove yourself worthy by following in his footsteps. Battle Alden's greatest foes:

quests.name: Plague of Zom-Bays
quests.description: Captain, hostile life forms are suspected. These creatures deviate from all known equine-adjacent species. We must proceed with all due caution as we investigate. Defeat 10 of these Zom-Bays so we can obtain samples to study.

quests.name: Foal of (Thorough) Dread
quests.description: Bones has examined Ensign Ash's remains, and is filled with concern. He fears the corpse may begin turning. He is stallion as long as he can while you gather more data. I require 10 more samples from another thoroughly dreadful species.

quests.name: Create a Stable Base
quests.description: The plague of ponies is nearly upon us. We will need a stable base with the ship at its centaur, to make sure the AI has enough time to repair all the damage. Bones reports a number of equines approaching at a fast prance. Slay them quickly, before the entire herd is upon us.

quests.name: Bonies & Bonies & Bonies
quests.description: Captain! The zombie pony herd just keeps coming. You must prevent them from overrunning the ship. We are in a race against time, the stakes are higher than any of us can imagine. Before you can take out their Lead Stallion, you'll need to slay the entire herd.

quests.name: Defeat Mr DED
quests.description: This race against time and zombie equines is neck-and-neck, and time has run out. Defeat Mr. DED, the DoomKnightmare, so that we can get off this moon and return home.

quests.name: Terrestrial Seasonings
quests.description: Sput need some flavorings for boar sausage and me has run out! You go collect things for I? Me need 5 Boar Bristles, 1 Boar's backbone and 10 Dyed feathers from vultures. Bring to I?

quests.name: Material Horc in a Material World
quests.description: You strong hero. Look for work? Trader come to K'thurr sometimes and want to trade things for rare spices. Me need you gather 10 Geodes from area and 10 Rhison Tusks. You do this thing for Sput?

quests.name: Boar Ears in Salted-Butter Sauce
quests.description: Want me show you how make old Horc recipe? Me need 7 Quarts of Rhison Milk, 1 vial of Rhison Tears, and 12 Boar Ears. bring to me and me will teach you how to do it RIGHT!

quests.name: Sput's Really Big Cleaver
quests.description: Horcs be hungry ALL the time. Good eaters need lots of food. Most of time me use this cleaver for breaking down meat but SOME BIG rhison out there. Sometimes me need to use me REALLY BIG CLEAVER. You want? You bring me 12 Rhison Steaks and maybe I give to you. Deal?

quests.name: Hunter Gatherers
quests.description: Horcs never get the knack of farming. Kagg plant few things but it never work well. Are you good hunter? Good gatherer? Sput need a LOT of food for tribe. Go slay 10 Vultures, 5 Boars, 5 Rhison, and 1 Trollola Plant then bring all food back to Sput!

quests.name: Facing Vath
quests.description: Vath is just up ahead! Please… for all the Dwarves, take him out!

quests.name: The 3rd Proto-Chaos Beast
quests.description: The Crystal Dragonoid hunted the Shadowscythe, but is a lesson that even the most powerful creatures can become lost to time, wandering through space. Do not lose sight of who YOU are… or what your ultimate destiny is.

quests.name: Bullies
quests.description: These undead bullies have taken over the entire village! We have to get rid of them if we’re going to save its people. Come on, you’ve done this plenty of times! Just kill as many as you can find!

quests.name: Free the People
quests.description: Remember how I told you these guys have been converting everyone to drones, making their army even bigger? Well, that's what they're planning to do to all those people in cages. We've gotta let them out! The cages are locked, though, so you'll have to figure out where to get the keys.

quests.name: Sample It
quests.description: I don't know if we can save the people who have already been converted. But if we can, the secret is in that tech. If we can get some samples of it, then our allies can examine it and try to find a cure.

quests.name: Swat the Flies
quests.description: Have you seen those flying techno-monsters roaming around? I'm pretty sure that's how the infection is spreading. They attach to people's heads, and then… BOOM! Another Deadtech minion. If we can dismantle them, then the people here will be safer… for now.

quests.name: Reclaim the Supplies
quests.description: These jerks have been stealing the villagers' food and water supplies to draw them out of hiding. We have to get them back! You'll help, right?

quests.name: Zyrus is Lost
quests.description: It's too late for poor Zyrus, but we can still save everyone else. Come on, hero, let’s fight! Defeat this monster he’s created so we can rescue the others.

quests.name: Legendary Quest of Adventure
quests.description: Salutations, brave hero! You have found a most secret area; a place rarely seen by the outside eye. It is luck that has brought you here, and it is luck that will keep you alive. Maybe. Why not put your luck to the test? Go forth, hero, and bring back to me 6 Lucky Jade Talismans that the heathens in this land harbor behind their unyielding power!

quests.name: Classic Hack-n-Slash
quests.description: Alright. Now on to bigger, and um, better things? Go back out into the wilderness and defeat 6 monsters. Naw, you don't have to bring me back anything. Just hack-n-slash your way through 'em until that 'Quest Complete' message thing appears.

quests.name: Yeah, another quest
quests.description: Ok ok ok. For this quest, what you're gonna do is: kill the boss guy. Oh yeah, that's good. So, like, there's this dragon that… ah well you can figure it out.

quests.name: Insert Quest Title Here
quests.description: Ok so for this quest..umm…uh, do..something…go kill monster. Which one? Meeeeh…. idk. Surprise me.

quests.name: Galvanize the Guardian
quests.description: AVAILABLE AFTER CLEARING THE CRYPT*Sadness fills your mind.* I… know it is a great request I ask of thee. But, should thee find a Basilisk's Scale and a Scroll of Magic Inversion of any of the Crypt monsters, please… bring them to me and merge them! Thou wilt have created a Scroll of Cure Petrification!

quests.name: EN GARDE!
quests.description: This is your chance to defeat the Doomknight, Asherion - the High Technolich's powerful ally! Boy, Stellaria will be so happy about this.

quests.name: Get the Axe
quests.description: I guess we don't have to stick around here anymore. Maybe we should head back to my father's axe so I can get more practice.

quests.name: Defeat the BioKnight
quests.description: This guy wants a fight? You’ll give him a fight!

quests.name: Take the Axe!
quests.description: The Blinding Light of Destiny lies before you, waiting to be claimed…

quests.name: Sweet Heat Summer Badge
quests.description: You'll want to head to the /sunlightzone in Sea Base Undine and defeat that Marine Snow. If you're lucky, you'll get the Marine Snowcone. You bring me that sweet treat and I'll give you a character page badge.

quests.name: Battle for Stryche
quests.description: It's time to prove you have what it takes to train with me! Defeat 5 monsters in the training room and return to me with the proof! Once you give me the proof, I will reward you with my armor set!

quests.name: Always Know Where Your Towel Is!
quests.description: No, no wait - I'm actually glad you're here. You see, after I got in the shower, I realized that I don't have a towel! Obviously I'm going to need one before I can get out. You should be able to get a towelfromfor me from one of the guards, but I doubt they'll hand it over without a fight.

quests.name: Echoes
quests.description: While we're on our way back to Eridani, mind lending a hand by finding a pair of glasses? I saw them in the cave. Not sure if it belongs to the kid but better safe than blind. Look out for bandits too. I knocked down their boss so they're running around like headless chickens. Whoops, you're looking green. Shouldn't have mentioned that. Working on the farm isn't just about petting animals y'know.

quests.name: Quest for the Bonebreaker
quests.description: My Pa told me tales of the Bonebreaker Cutlass. It's used by Undead Pirates and DoomKnight Commanders. Those who wield it gain great power. I'd LOVE to see what it looks like… and I'll give you a chance to get a prize! Bring me the cutlass… pretty please?

quests.name: Beach Picnic
quests.description: What if we had a picnic, but on the beach? That would be so cool. But first, can you get this stuff for me, while I invite my friends and grab some towels? Steal some beach balls from /LunaCove - and while you're there, invite some of the villagers… but only the cool ones. Also, can you stop off at /BurningBeach and get some cups from the Water Goblins there? I forgot to buy them in the store yesterday. I'm such a dork sometimes.

quests.name: Devil's Food
quests.description: We need to figure out what's going on and I think I know just where to start. Those Goons near the cafeteria are looking a little green…you better get some samples from them so we can narrow it down.

quests.name: Sample Processing
quests.description: Alright, now that we have some samples from the infected Goons, we are going to need some baseline readings. Go check the uninfected Ebil Goons for any symptoms, and make sure they stay away from the cafeteria! We don't need any more of them turning until we find the cause and the cure. Oh, and while you're at it, better check the Ebil Fishmen to make sure they haven't picked up any stray "food" crumbs.

quests.name: What's That Smell?
quests.description: Now that we have found out what happened to all those Ebil Goons we need to find what has caused the issue. *Sniff* *Sniff* What's that smell? AH! DID YOU SEE THAT!? That pile of mysterious meat just moved! GET IT, GET IT!!

quests.name: Mystery Solved
quests.description: Where's the flavor!? The spice!? THE TASTE!? It's worse than I imagined. They've taken all that makes food good out and replaced it with corporate jargon and datatables. Something went wrong in the process and that's where the Smorgasbord came from. It's time to shut this operation down! Go take out the Smorgasbord itself, when it falls so should its minions…oh…and the Ghouls! I'm sure they'll return to normal too…

quests.name: Dark Divide
quests.description: Have you been to /Camlan before? I heard its precise location was revealed recently. Please, confront the Elves there, and make them return what they took from the Drow of the past. I know they must have something of ours. All of the other Elven clans do.

quests.name: Drow Trust Exercise
quests.description: As part of the Yew Mountains' coalition, Drow Soldiers have been trusted with the protection of Thelima. Could I ask a favor? Sneak attack them. It'll keep them sharp. They should be in front of the Inn, and the gate to Castle Natalis on the west side.

quests.name: The Golden Heart
quests.description: All of our contestants have been dropped into the dungeon, each at a separate entrance. These Love Shrubs are covered in red candy hearts, but in order to progress to Stage 2, they'll need to ﬁnd the one who has the Golden Heart. But they'd better be careful - that Shrub won't give up his Heart without a good ﬁght!

quests.name: The Red Room
quests.description: Looks like our contestants have ended up in the Red Room - and it's full of burning lava! They'd better start putting out those ﬁres fast, or they might end up as the dinner instead of the date! (Get it? Cause they're gonna get coooked? Ah, nevermind!)

quests.name: Get Out of Here
quests.description: They're not out of danger yet, folks! Now that they've put out those ﬁres, they're gonna have to start some new ones! To move on to the next level of the dungeon, our contestants will need to collect Burning Embers of Love from those Lava Slimes, and then use them to light the torches on the wall! That will unlock the door to stage 3.

quests.name: Spooky Cupid
quests.description: Our remaining contestants are up against one spooky bunch of cupids! They're gonna need some of those little guys' arrows to progress to the next round. Whaddya think - will they make it? Or will those bony babies tum their faces into bull's eyes?

quests.name: Get a Bullseye
quests.description: There's only one way out of this purgatory of cherubs - you gotta hit the bullseye (that's 100 points for you non-archers)! Take those arrows, contestants, and shoot one of them right into the middle of that target at the end of the hall to continue.

quests.name: And They Called it Puppy Love
quests.description: These adorable pooches have devoured the hearts of their Valentines - metaphorically speaking, of course! Well, sort of. They really HAVE swallowed the heart-shaped lockets that are needed to get into the next room. Our contestants are gonna have to get 'em back if they want to move on.

quests.name: Gotta Get the Keys
quests.description: Hey, you guys got all the Devoured Heart lockets! Now you just gotta unlock ‘em. Unfortunately, those keys have already gone through the whole system, if you know what I mean! You‘re gonna have to dig 'em back out of those Lil Poots.

quests.name: They Already Lost
quests.description: Oh. no! Looks like our ﬁnalists are going to have to go through all of Last Year's Contestants if they're gonna make it to the center! Of course, these are the guys who lost, so I‘m sure that won‘t be too hard.

quests.name: A Long Time Ago
quests.description: Whoof - the next room is ﬁlled with long-lost contestants from years past. These guys are looking pretty rough… man, we've gotta start cleaning this dungeon out more often!

quests.name: Is His Name Herbie?
quests.description: Our ﬁnal two contestants are at the last stage! It's hero versus bug, and only one can emerge victorious! Who will be our lucky winner?

quests.name: Defeat 10 Viruses
quests.description: So you think you can help Old King Coal? I don't think so! We viruses are to powerful for you puny heroes! Muahahahah!

quests.name: Defeat 10 More
quests.description: Well, you defeated 10 of us, but there's no way you can defeat 10 more! We are too powerful for you!

quests.name: 30? No way!
quests.description: You've defeated 20 of us? There's no way! You must be powerful, but we are VIRUSES! We constantly change and evolve! We will prevail!

quests.name: Add 10 More
quests.description: How have you been able to keep up with us? We are constantly changing and evolving! We will not be defeated!

quests.name: 50 is RIGHT OUT!
quests.description: That's it, you'll never be able to defeat us now! We have learned and grown! WE ARE POWER!

quests.name: Anything but Common
quests.description: So you think you're so powerful. You defeated all those germs… but you will NEVER defeat the Rhinovirus! There is no cure!

quests.name: Supplies to spin The Wheel of Chance
quests.description: The Sneevils want unique items of power. Chaos infests the lands and chaorrupted items are what they seek. Find them a cursed Relic of Chaos, and you can spin their Wheel of Chance!

quests.name: The Assistant
quests.description: Lore has had many revolutions and many wars. There are unique items from these wars to be found, and I'm interested. Bring me War-Torn Memorabilia from Yulgar's Armor Shop, and you can spin my wheel!

quests.name: Swindle's Return Policy
quests.description: Haha! You're not happy with your prizes? Well I'm not completely unreasonable. I'll buy back some of your unsatisfactory prizes with some of this surplus stock.

items_required.name: Dark Makai Rune x1 (Stacks up to 13)

quests.name: Bloody Chaos
quests.description: Would you like to make some Blood Gems? Well, you'll have to work for them. Chaos is still a relatively unknown source of power so we would like to see just how dense it is. Go out and collect these items scattered around Lore so the Archfiend can study it more closely.

items_required.name: Shattered Legendary Sword of Dragon Control

quests.name: Swindle Bulk
quests.description: The boxconomy always has a demand for more cubes. If you can gather a bulk amount, you'll be rewarded squarely.

quests.name: Dirt-y Deeds Done Dirt Cheap
quests.description: What? You want to do some work for me? Why don't you grab a pickaxe and a shovel, dig some holes, and fill them up again? I bet you don't even know how, do you? Go learn from the experts: the Chaos Tunneler, Slugbutter, and that thing /downward, near the center of the planet. I bet they can give you some tips.

items_required.name: Slugbutter Digging Advice x1 (Stacks up to 10)
Chaotic Tunneling Techniques x2 (Stacks up to 20)
Crystalized Corporate Digging Secrets x3 (Stacks up to 30)

quests.name: Swindle's Bonus Deal
quests.description: Still getting too many dud prizes? Well, I guess since you're keeping me company, I'll buy a few more back for some other poor sap to win.

quests.name: Frostspinner's Web
quests.description: Zastruga made a pact with the Nation, and broke it. I need some muscle to collect the Frostspinne Queen's debt. She's riding a spider we'll be repossessing. Do me this favor, and you'll get what the Queen could have had.

quests.name: Help Swindle Claws
quests.description: HO HO HAH! I, Swindle Claws. need my silver bell before I can set off delivering "gifts" and asking for "holiday donations".

quests.name: Twisted Items of Nulgath
quests.description: If you prove your worth by bringing 3 Totems and the Rune 4 from a Skull Warrior, you will earn my most impressive works. True, most of my more powerful items from the past are now unavailable. Lets just say they caused a bit more trouble than I anticipated. But I'm in the process of creating more items of destruction. Patience is a virtue.

quests.name: Demanding Items Of Nulgath
quests.description: I have items of great power for you. Everything has a cost. Learn this… If you have the required reagents and have slain the Legion Fenrir, this sword is yours. You may only pick one though.

quests.name: Empowering Items
quests.description: What? Ahh… you have the Iron Scythe of Nulgath. Allow me to imbue it with my powers.

quests.name: NOT A QUEST
quests.description: This is not really a quest. I do not want you to go and bring me the head of sneevil. All of the above statements are a lie.

quests.name: Nulgath is Kind
quests.description: Hmmm… I sense a great beast has shown itself in the land of Lore. Such beasts retain great power…

quests.name: The Leery Contract
quests.description: Ahh… what do you have there mortal? One of my contracts? You must be a VERY lucky person. Care to make a deal? Good, Evil, Chaotic… your alignment doesn't matter to me. Just bring me a rune from an Undead Legend and sign the contract, and I'll give you a prize unlike anything you've seen before- and a sum of Gold for your troubles. What does the contract say, you ask? Does it really matter?

quests.name: Bone Dust Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Bone Dust from the undead in /battleunderb is something he requires. Bring him enough of it, and he'll reward you accordingly.

quests.name: Cube Reagent
quests.description: Skew needs many ingredients to practice his magic. Cubes from the Sneevils in /boxes and Ice Cubes from the Snow Golems in /mountfrost are materials he requires. Bring him enough of each, and he'll fairly compensate you.

quests.name: Essence of Defeat Reagent
quests.description: Relics from defeated, powerful enemies can be used by Skew to create powerful magic. Bring him the remains of your defeated foes and he'll generously reward you with a much rarer gemstone.

quests.name: Ordinary Cape
quests.description: Nulgath tells you to bring him an "Ordinary Cape" and he'll give it the ability to change to the color of your desire. He says he'll also need x5 "Tainted Gems".

quests.name: Spinal Tap of Nulgath
quests.description: Mortal, bring me a "Spinal Tap" dagger and I'll twist it's energy, giving you full dominion over it's power.

quests.name: Specialty Pizza
quests.description: I have an urgent delivery! … and our policy is 30 levels or less, or it is free! I guess we will just have to improvise. First we need a sauce substitute. Oh, I know, how about slime? Help me by defeating slimes and bringing me back 5 Yummy Slime Sauces!

quests.name: SwordMaster Class
quests.description: (For owners of the AC version of BladeMaster Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a BladeMaster. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.

quests.name: SwordMaster Class
quests.description: (For owners of the Quest reward version of BladeMaster Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a BladeMaster. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.

quests.name: SwordMaster Assassin Class
quests.description: (For owners of the BladeMaster Assassin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a BladeMaster Assassin. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.

quests.name: Legion SwordMaster Assassin Class
quests.description: (For owners of the Legion BladeMaster Assassin Class) You have proven your worth - you ARE a Legion BladeMaster Assassin. You have mastered your skills, and continued in your studies and for that you are to be rewarded.

quests.name: Free Cabdury
quests.description: With the Grenwog colony's alphas out of the picture, the instinct in Cabdury's blood transformed him to fill that role. Help the poor critter out, and make him take a nap. We'll cart him somewhere safe when he stops throwing punches.

quests.name: In the Forest of Good and Evil
quests.description: If we're going to find our sock monkey, we'll need your help to clear out this forest! Defeat the Bright and Evil Imps, and take out the Evil Elementals. Once that's done, we should have a better idea of where to start looking for our sock monkey!

quests.name: To Be or Not to Be... Expendable
quests.description: Did you see what I saw, Hero? A red string danglind out of one of the Expendable Rogues pockets! You know they only ever wear all black (it's a rogue thing). That string MUST have come from our sock monkey! Question the Expendable Rogues until one of them tells you where it is.

quests.name: Slay the Enemy Inside
quests.description: The Enemy Inside has made its lair in within the Cogito Sum Cavern, deep inside the Forest of Good and Evil. Please, Hero, slay the Enemy Inside and recover the Synderes Sock Monkey!

quests.name: Synderes Souvenir Shop
quests.description: When we go on tour, we bring a ton of merch for our fans to take home, and our stop at Yulgar's Inn is no different! Slay the denizens of the Forest of Good and Evil to earn Synderes Souvenir Tokens to buy gear from our shop!

quests.name: Building the Base
quests.description: In order to build a gate strong enough to withstand the magic it will contain, we must get 13 chunks of Asteroid Ore. Many pieces were spread across the island in the explosion that ripped this continent apart.

quests.name: Refugee Roundup
quests.description: More and more refugees are flooding into the island, fleeing the chaos on the mainland and the recent destruction of our country. Frostwyrms and Ice Wolves threaten them all. Take out 7 of the beasts to ensure their safety!

quests.name: Retrieve the Water Starstone
quests.description: In order to align the Moon with the Horologium Gate, and unlock the first Astral Key, you must retrieve the Water Starstone! It is kept by a FrostDeep Dweller under the ice on top of the mountain.

quests.name: Magical Attraction
quests.description: You can feel the power of the Water Starstone yes? Yes. It will do much to power the gate, but we must set it properly. I need 13 samples of IceTen, an ore which I can process to create the magical field they will float in.

quests.name: Frozen Blood
quests.description: In order to properly process the IceTen, I must create a solution to soak it in. Bring me 8 slabs of Frozen Blood from the Twisted Ice. I will melt it to create a powerful liquid.

quests.name: Retrieve the Fire Starstone
quests.description: While the solution brews, I need you to recover the Fire Starstone! It will attract and hold the power of the sun… and THAT is a very powerful stone indeed! I sense it lies somewhere on the ice mountain. Go, search for it and return it to me!

quests.name: Defend the Tower!
quests.description: Hero! I cannot divine the location of the next stone with the tower under constant attack! Defeat at least 6 of the Polar Elementals so that I may focus.

quests.name: Refugee Rescue Run
quests.description: Please, go and save the 6 refugees who have just arrived on shore. I cannot focus until they are no longer threatened.

quests.name: Retrieve the Earth Starstone
quests.description: The Earth Starstone, the one that will hold and align the planet Merkari… it is near! Search through the ruins and you may discover it.

quests.name: Polar Penetration and Progress
quests.description: Can you sense how WRONG the island feels? Ever since the explosion (and I still do not know WHAT caused it…), things have been… changing. Gather 6 Ice Cores and bring me 6 Ice Samples from Polar Elementals so I can track the change.

quests.name: Save the Astronomer Apprentice
quests.description: Aaah, THERE he is. Listen, you can hear Lorentz's knees knocking from all the way up here. Defeat whatever monsters are threatening him, please, and bring him back to me.

quests.name: Glacial Elixir
quests.description: I must have Lorentz's help to continue on with the spell to activate the Horologium Gate! Please, bring me a vial of FrostDeep Dweller Venom and 5 Glacial Pearls. It will help me make a tonic to calm him.

quests.name: Retrieve the Energy Starstone
quests.description: Lorentz did not let his fear get the best of him. While he was in the ruins, he discovered the location of the Energy Starstone! It will draw and align the planet Saturnalia. A Polar Elemental found and is keeping it.

quests.name: Marking the Future
quests.description: In order to properly position the starstone, I must drill two nexus points into each. For that, I'll need a new drillbit. Bring me 5 spines from a Frostwyrm so I can craft it.

quests.name: Glacial Shift
quests.description: If the ice is moving as you say it is, that is very troubling. The land should not be responding like this… shrinking away from itself. Bring me 6 chunks of ice that I may test it.

quests.name: Divination Draft
quests.description: I have not had luck locating the Light Starstone. I must cast a stronger spell… and for that I will need 4 fronds of Iceweed, 4 bunches of Snowsage, 5 Frozen Scales from an Arctic Eel and 5 Frozen Tails from a FrostWyrm.

quests.name: Retrieve the Light StarStone
quests.description: I have seen the light… and it is trapped in darkness! Somewhere on this island, a treasure chest lies, and inside it is the starstone which will hold and align the planet Jutiparus. Bring it to me!

quests.name: The Future is Bright
quests.description: I believe I can scry the identity of our mysterious mage with the light from the starstone. Gather Shattered Glass so I may build a mirror… then we shall see what we shall see!

quests.name: Bled Bone Dry
quests.description: The magic of the island IS changing, and I grow fearful of what it may mean for us all. Slay Arctic Eels and Fishbones to bring back bone samples. I would see if the changes extends to the monsters of our sea.

quests.name: Chill of Fear
quests.description: I fear what may come, my friend. There is certain property of the ice on this island which may tell me how much danger we humans are in. Bring me 6 BitterEdge Ice Cores.

quests.name: Retrieve the Darkness Starstone
quests.description: In the glacial ice floes, there is both ice and darkness. I sense that the darkness Starstone, which will hold the planet Maras is trapped inside the walking glaciers, a Twisted Ice monster!

quests.name: Web of Fear
quests.description: I have penetrated a web of lies obscuring my sight. There is dark, deadly magic nearby, an amulet if I guess right. I sense whymtaint mingled with it, so check the Frostwyrms first!

quests.name: Frozen in Time
quests.description: We are so close to completing the Gate! The framework is done, now we just need to add FrozenFire to connect the heat of out world with the ice of his… Bring me 13 chunks of Frozen Fire so I can create the base.

quests.name: Heart of the Matter
quests.description: We need to place the heartstone to anchor the aligned planets! Slay 5 Ice Wolves for the silver to make nails.

quests.name: Retrieve the Wind Starstone
quests.description: Though my magic works through the stars, I also have an affinity for wind. I can send the Wind Starstone, that will align the planet Venice… guarded by the Rotten Ice beast that lives in the heart of the volcano! Bring it to me.

quests.name: Create the Gate
quests.description: We have all 7 Starstones, but we need the Blood of an Ice Wolf to bind and activate the gate. Get 1 vial of blood from an Ice Wolf, and then place all 7 Starstones around the Gate so that we may open the portal and bring this Mage to our world.

quests.name: Drive Back the Invaders
quests.description: This is NOT what we were promised! Drive the invader minions back through the gate, Hero… HURRY!

quests.name: Defeat the FrostSpawn Invaders
quests.description: We MUST stop these invaders, Hero… even if it takes all we have! Take out 15 of their Fangbeasts to buy us time to plan.

quests.name: Somnic Energy
quests.description: The armor I make is infused with the same energy that Dreamweavers control with their magic. Bring me some, and I’ll reward you. Every creature in the dream world exudes it, but none more than the Nightspores. It shines out from them like a beacon.

quests.name: The Heptagonal Chest
quests.description: Ah, good. You’re here, hale, and whole. You smell like you’ve faced the motherwyrm. Good. Then you’ve proven your worth already, and earned a reward. You will want to search the treasure pile for the Heptagonal Chest. It is an incredibly important artifact… but can only be opened by YOU.

quests.name: Part the Veils of Time
quests.description: Recover the shards of my Molten Scrying Mirror from the Lava Mages and I will soon be able to share some of the secrets of your past… your present. And future.

quests.name: Spell to See Beyond
quests.description: Excellent. With a whole mirror, now all I need are the ingredients for the vision spell. Bring me 5 Crystals from the Lava Mages, 2 globs of Gel from the Lavasites, and 5 drops of Molten Gold from the Lava Guards

quests.name: Atata
quests.description: What are those horrible hands reaching down from the sky? They're big enough to wrench a tower from the ground! The citizens are being snatched away. Most can run on their own but I see many frozen by fear. Please, help them!

quests.name: Samghata
quests.description: The hands are probing the streets for us. I think they're getting impatient and smashing open buildings. If they get lucky, we'll be crushed to death. We have to swat them away. Take care not to be snatched yourself.

quests.name: Hahava
quests.description: There's an awful shrieking noise growing louder and louder. The other survivors are telling me they hear other sounds, like crying or maniacal laughing. I think it's from those flying trumpeters! Their music must be silenced before it causes harm.

quests.name: Sanjiva
quests.description: As more of the strange red liquid is floating into the sky, I'm noticing creatures leaking out of the cracks in the ground. They've gained form and I can't shake the feeling that they look like my former neighbors. I beg you, return them to rest.

quests.name: Kalasutra
quests.description: We noticed a melody playing, hidden in the cacophony of the Trumpeters. Even though it's barely louder than a whisper, it's lulling the young ones to sleep. The adults are slowly succumbing as well. We won't be able to protect ourselves this way. Destroy the Trumpeters to find the source of the song.

quests.name: Lies in Peace
quests.description: Welcome to the Mana Core, er, the Plane of Mana. They're in the same spot so they might as well be the same thing. You can call it whichever one you want. C'mon, I'll show you around. We'll head straight down the path to the right until we reach the junction. Careful, we'll need to fight off some of those wyverns you'll recognize. They got dragged here because the patronizing voices up there thought they were you. But hey, go easy on them…

quests.name: There Was an Attempt
quests.description: Before I got shunted into a leyline, I knew Planes existed but had no idea how they worked. Still don't. But this isn't even a completed Elemental Plane. It's attempting to follow the universe's rules and become a real Plane because it's overflowing with power. Check out those people-shaped blue things. They're attempts at creating elementals. The ones that can move aren't nice. They won't leave us be unless we re-liquefy them.

quests.name: Scared Straight
quests.description: The problem with the Mana Core is that it shifts all the time. These paths change direction and it's easy to get completely lost. Let's go down the South route first, and hope for the best. Hey, would it be too much trouble for you to run ahead and scare away a few monsters? I hear them growling and flapping their wings. Those might look and sound like infernals but they're fake creations one of the voices made to keep me in line.

quests.name: Making Waves
quests.description: Today, the South path led us to the beach. The Core, or Plane, is the heart of Lore. It circulates Mana through the leylines. Some of the mana pools here but it'll flow down the waterfall, gather below in a bottomless ocean, and get pumped into the Leylines. Come and squint over the crest of the falls with me. You can see the leylines. And please shove any fake infernals you find off the edge of the cliff. I hate them soooo much.

quests.name: In Circles
quests.description: The beach is a dead end, and our hosts can't be bothered to scoot over. We're going to have to hoof it back to the junction and try the path leading due East. If Drakath were a better person, I'd ask him to fly us into the air so we can get our bearings but I know he'll drop us. He could ditch if he wants, and get blasted to smithereens. No? Darn. Guess he'll be watching us fight off the freaky elementals on our way back.

quests.name: Nameless Remnants
quests.description: The Path East took us to what I call, the museum grove. When I'm not getting yelled at, I explore the Plane and find a bunch of old funky stuff. To pass the time, I gather them here. They look like they came from the surface but I also get the feeling that they don't belong anywhere. Wanna take a break to give these a look? You're going to have to race Gravelyn and Drakath. They're already getting their prints all over everything!

quests.name: Dreams Unborn
quests.description: I hear heavy skulking footsteps. They're from the Crystalized Mana. I don't think they're like elementals. Their teeth chatter and gnash so angrily, and sometimes I can understand the noises. These might be the consciousness of the dormant Mana Avatar rising to the surface and taking solid form. Einsof is confused and angry that it can't be born. Gravelyn looks interested in them. If she wants to investigate, we should help her wrangle a few.

quests.name: Innocent Crafts
quests.description: There's only the North route left. That'll lead us to the hill where I speak to those cranky voices. Well, one of them is nice. They even showed me how to make pillows out of Mana. Let's stop by the pillows, and figure out how we're going to confront those awful masks. You'll know what I'm talking about when we meet them. The meanest of the bunch would've left fake infernals nearby to get to my head. Could you help me get rid of them?

quests.name: Cold Bedrock
quests.description: The half-baked elementals are acting up. Umm, they'll bother us if we don't deal with them, so can we beat up a few? I know. I'm stalling us but this is a good warm up. You'll need it. From down here, I've listened to the voices discuss you and what's happening in Lore. They don't have anything good to say. Even the nicer one clams up when the others speak your name…When you're ready, we'll go meet them at the top of the hill.

quests.name: Rippling Heartbeat
quests.description: It'll be four versus three, with you and me against the Mask of Tranquility. If we lose, The Law and Infamy said that you would need to 'go Silent' and that one of them would take your titles. To be honest, I don't think we can win but that won't be the point. We just need to prove that you can fight them off, and have the power to protect Lore! Let's show them what we're made of!

quests.name: Quadrolithium
quests.description: The experimental ship contained a mineral called Quadrolithium that helped power the engine. When it crashed, bits of it were scattered everywhere. It's very radioactive and poisonous to the environment! Help me help the forest by collecting the Quadrolithium from the Dwakels! Bring me 8 pieces of it for a big reward!

quests.name: Dam Balloons
quests.description: If I tell you a secret, will you promise to keep it? ….Okay, here goes: When I was a little girl, I followed some Dwakel tracks into the woods to a secluded pond. I saw a Dwakel dressed in mage robes replenishing his mana from the pond! Guess what— that pond is connected to this artificial creek by an underground spring. We need to dam up this creek so that the pond doesn't run dry. The Dwakels carry Dam Balloons as part of their suits. Bring me 10 Dam Balloons so I can inflate them at a good spot to save the mana pond!

quests.name: Bumper Bolts
quests.description: Most of the Dwakel around here are carrying spare parts they need to fix the crashed ship! We can slow them down by taking the parts from them. Bring me 12 Bumper Bolts and we'll do just that! I think this Dwakel Spybot will be sufficient pay for your help.

quests.name: Mithril Man Batteries
quests.description: It looks like the Dwakel are guarding the crash site using their most advanced mecha-suit: the Mithril Man! You have to stop that big heap o' metal! Bring me their batteries to prove you did it! I'll give you this massive, mechanical polearm for your help.

quests.name: ProtoSartorium Parts
quests.description: The Dwakels haven't given up yet. They've deployed their strongest power suit: the Protosartorium. If you can bring me its spare parts, I'll use them and the Mithril Man batteries you collected earlier to create a power suit of your own!

quests.name: The Guardian Taro Blademaster
quests.description: Hello friend. My meditation is complete and my mind is clear. If your aura is untainted by evil, I will fight for you. Heroes that wield the Purified Claymore of Destiny are on the path of good. Do you have such a weapon in your possession?

quests.name: A Test of Temptation
quests.description: If you wish to pursue the path to clarity, then you must resist the temptations of evil. The ArchFiend's gems are valuable and have been tainted by darkness. Test your willpower by collecting a large quantity of them and then destroying them. If you can do that, then I'll know you can handle what's to come.

quests.name: Dog Gone
quests.description: You turn your back for just one minute, and suddenly half your hounds have escaped! It's the story of my life. Say, you look strong. You can catch them and bring them back to me!

quests.name: Worm Food
quests.description: Those giant worms that we used in the invasion of Swordhaven? They eat up to three times their own weight every day. This means we have to work hard keep that compost heap full. Strong hero! Gather meat from any source you can - I will not ask any questions! - and then deposit it into the compost heap behind me. (Quest available once per login session)

quests.name: Special Treats
quests.description: Much like vampires, Imps thrive on blood. Sometimes, when they've been good, we like to give them Blood Maggots as a special treat. Could I get you to pick some up for me? You can find them in the Darkovia Forest. Be careful, though - the Imps will only eat them if they're not all smushed-up.

quests.name: What You Treasure Most
quests.description: I'm glad you're excited, because the beginning is somewhat of a chore. We have to find pieces of gold in order to forge an artifact crucial for the rest of our adventure. The first is hidden in the hoard of a greedy Dragon. The second is at a famous convention. The third will be in the deepest layer of Battleon.

quests.name: Trial of the Heart
quests.description: The Compass's whispers will take you down the right path. Take the heart of the Shadow Lord, which he'll be loathe to part with. Don't be offended - the nature of this lifeforms is… different. Their voices can drive you mad, hahahaha!

quests.name: Blood-Dyed Stones
quests.description: If you want to craft more itms, we'll have to mimic the Duke of Sramol's crafting method. The Compass should whisper the way once more. Obtain a Suspicious Ruby from the Cursed Treasure in /greed. Then, gather the inner shadows from a human soul.he Vindicators in /trygve are a good pick for this. I'm sure you'll find a way to do it!

quests.name: Cogs and Gears
quests.description: If I'm going to build you a weapon, I'm going to need PARTS! Bring me: 6 Cogs from the Ancient Chest in the Time Library, 3 vials of Sneak Oil, and the chassis from 6 broken Training Globes that have fallen to the ground.

quests.name: Flourishes and Furbelows
quests.description: As a golem, I do what my creator says. And he is telling me that I am going to create armors. Hunh. My implanted memories don't include directions for that, so I'll need to wing it. Bring me: 4 Metal Shards from the Training Globes, 4 Tog Claws for fabric fasteners, and 2 strips of Gorillaphant leather from Arcangrove.

quests.name: Target Practice
quests.description: Any purveyor of weapons knows that without testing, a weapon cannot be trusted. I don't want to send out any faulty equipment, so please bring me back 10 Chaos Shadowscythe Skins from the virtual MechQuest simulation and the head of an Undead Soldier so that I know it shoots straight!

quests.name: Majestic Mech Masterpiece
quests.description: I have some schematics to make some mechs. But I'm missing some parts. First, we'll need some knowledge on how to actually use a mech. We can try to ask the Shadowscythe here. I only partially remember how to. Then, we'll need some ZZZ Batteries from the Training Globes here. Finally, we'll need some cooling fans and some rockets from the mechs over in DeathOfGames. After that, I SHOULD be able to finish making one.

quests.name: An Ambitious Undertaking
quests.description: I have some more schematics in order to make even more MECHAS! To make these ones, I'll need more info on what they even look like. Can you ask the students in MQLesson? Next, I need some more wires. You should be able to get them from the Defense Turrets… in DreadSpace. And while you're there, can you beat up some of the Undead Star Rangers? One of them owes me money for some parts, but I forgot who.

items_required.name: Wolfblade Student Info x4 (Stacks up to 24)
Runehawk Student Info x4 (Stacks up to 24)
Mystraven Student Info x4 (Stacks up to 24)

quests.name: The Energy Blade of Awe
quests.description: I heard about this powerful weapon called the Blade of Awe. How about we try to make a LASER version of it? First, I'll need my wrench. I lost it somewhere. Next, I'll need some Laser Crystals. You can get those from the Chaos Shadowscythe in MQLesson. Then, we'll need to get an Energy Blade hilt that could work for a blade like this. The Supreme Shadowscythe in BossChallenge has a hoard of energy blade parts stashed away. Maybe it has one that could match? Finally, we'll need some Power Cells from the Ancient Mecha in GenesisGarden.

quests.name: Level 1
quests.description: *A thought whispers in your mind, the strength of a steel blade behind it.* Hero, undead vermin have stolen into the upper levels of the temple's crypt. Slimeskulls, Bonemunchers, and Shelletons are defiling our sacred ground. Bring back proof that thou hast slain 3 of each!

quests.name: Level 2
quests.description: *The sadness in the Guardian's mind is balanced by determination, and you can hear it resonate inside you.* Undead mages were crucial in bringing about the downfall of the temple. They corrupted holy runes and even now infest the Crypt. Remove 3 Mages and 3 Ectomancers, and salvage 6 of the runes.

quests.name: Level 3
quests.description: *A picture forms in your mind of ghouls and lichs desecrating this level of the once-proud temple.* My friend, avenge my brethren. Slay the ghouls and lichs that remain, and bring back proof of your success in the form of their armor!

quests.name: Level 4
quests.description: *You feel the heat of phantom flames caressing your cheeks, and a chill runs down your spine* These most private halls were put to the torch. Fight fire with ethereal fire by placing Aether torches around the Crypt to clear the temple's aura and take revenge in my place against 6 of the Fire Mages.

quests.name: Level 5
quests.description: *A shining Key, bathed in Light, hovers before your eyes. When you reach out to it, your fingers close on empty air.* Every five levels the Temple Superiors locked passage deeper into the Crypt. You will need to find the Auroral Key. Any of the Skeleton Fighters, Slimeskulls, or Ectomancers could have it.

quests.name: Level 6
quests.description: *Screams of terror echo in your ears, and a ghostly vision of gaping mouths filled with razor-sharp teeth assault your wide-open eyes.* The mouths, the horrid, gaping jaws! They rent our novices and ripped apart our warriors. Avenge our memories, Hero, by slaying 2 Bonemunchers and 4 Sanguine Souleaters.

quests.name: Level 7
quests.description: *You close your eyes for a moment as you catch your breath , and a vision of the Temple as it once stood fills your inner eye.* My friend, you can see how far our fair halls have fallen. The detritus of the last battle still fills the rooms of the Crypt. Remove 12 of the cast-off armors of the invaders!

quests.name: Level 8
quests.description: The Stone Paladin's thoughts, which have been a constant companion on your journey deeper into the Crypt, falls silent, and you can sense that it is his utter sorrow which has silenced him. Fury rises inside you, and you vow to take it out on mages. Two of them carry Orbs of power. Strip the undead of them!

quests.name: Level 9
quests.description: The Crypt is infested with Ghouls! You congratulate yourself on investing in Anti-Ghoulstones. Place them around the levels of the Crypt you have conquered so far. The stones do not work instantly, so you'll also need to take out 6 Ghouls to get the exodus started.

quests.name: Level 10
quests.description: You have once more reached a level locked by one of the Temple's Keys of Light. One of the thieving Ectomancers, Skeletons, or Ghouls MUST have stolen it. Battle them until you find the Luminous Key, and your journey will be able to continue.

quests.name: Level 11
quests.description: *You feel a pressure in your mind, as if someone is pressing on your shoulder to get your attention.* Time grows long, and the evil corrupting our Temple grows stronger. The souls that remain are awash in terror. Set out 10 Benevolence Beacons to soothe them and free 6 of those trapped by the Sanguine Souleaters.

quests.name: Level 12
quests.description: *The feeling of slime running down your skin has you shuddering in disgust.* Yes… that is what that last of our defenders felt as they were attacked by Slimeskulls and Ectomancers. Kill as many of them as possible, and bring back a Slime-Soaked Skull and Ecto-Covered Core.

quests.name: Level 13
quests.description: *Phantom sparkles fill your field of view. They swirl and float, and finally coalesce into the image of a violet Orb.* Those are Aether Orbs. We would place them in the halls to keep the Temple's atmospheric energy healthy. The undead removed them all. Put 12 of them back, and the Temple will be on its way to restoration!

quests.name: Level 14
quests.description: *The clanging and scraping of steel on steel fills your mind. You put your hands over your ears, but there is no escaping the aural assault.* Yes… yes. That is what we heard when the Skeletons overran the Temple. They remain, much to my sorrow. Wipe out 6 of them, and perhaps the wounds in my soul will begin to heal.

quests.name: Level 15
quests.description: *The sight of the Incadescent Key floats before you, calling to you.* I know thee canst sense it. Feel the pull of the Key. It calls to thee, but its summons grows faint. I can only tell that the beacon comes from either a Lich, Ghoul, or Slimeskull.

quests.name: Level 16
quests.description: *The image of an young girl trying on her first set of armor appears before you, and you feel a phantom tear trickle down your cheek.* My daughter, Anora. She was so young, during that last battle. I fought for her, and slaughtered many skeletons. Place 10 of their skulls around the Crypt to warn away the rest.

quests.name: Level 17
quests.description: *You feel as you are grinding phantom bones under your boots.* Thee knows what an undead swarm is like. And now that I am helpless to cleanse my Temple, I need thee! Take out the remaining Bonemunchers and Skeletons, and bring back a Spiky Collar and Vertebrae Trophy.

quests.name: Level 18
quests.description: *You feel your skin begin to grow hard, and your muscles tense, locking you in place. Your jaw clenches and your head grows heavy.* Yes… that is what I feel, my friend. It was magic that did this to me, and I fear only magic can undo it! In my name, slaughter 4 of the Undead Mages and 2 of the Fire Mages!

quests.name: Level 19
quests.description: *A sense of the Stone Paladin's pride and anticipation fills you.* Sadly, our Crypt has not been cleansed since the invasion. Remove 6 of the piles of Bonemuncher bones and take down 10 of the Shelletons and 3 of the Skeletons who continue to defile my home!

quests.name: Level 20
quests.description: *Ghostly cheers ring in your ears, and you feel a phantom hand grip your shoulder in a gesture of solidarity.* Thou wilt need the Radiant Key to pass beyond this chamber. It was stolen by a Lich, or perhaps either a Skeleton Fighter or Soldier. I KNOW thou canst find it!

quests.name: Defy the Dracolich
quests.description: *A vision of two shining keys appears in your mind's eye. One shatters, and the shards fly outward.* Yes, two Keys exist, though only ONE is needed. One is on the Dracolich, and the 40 shards of the other have been stolen by Undead and Fire Mages, Lichs, and Ectomancers. Bring them to me and merge them into one.

quests.name: Restore the Tome
quests.description: 10 of the tome's pages have been scattered around the Crypt. Find them and return them to unlock the secrets of this ancient repository of knowledge!

quests.name: Recover the Pages
quests.description: 10 of the tome's pages have been stolen by the monsters invading the Crypt. The pages could be on any of them! Recover them and bring them back to unlock the secrets of this ancient repository of knowledge!

quests.name: Reconstruct the Codex
quests.description: The last page was stolen by the CryptKeeper, a Lich who has aimed to make our fair halls his home. Show him that he cannot defile this sacred place! Retrieve the last of the Tome's pages and defeat the Cryptkeeper.

quests.name: Nulgath's Messenger
quests.description: Hehehe… it seems you finally discovered I've been Nulgath's messenger for centuries while Skew was his favorite minion. Skew and I had a lot of fun together while slaying Legion and betrayers even before when you first discovered Tercessuinotlim through Citadel's magic portal. If you want to have fun with me, reagents you must farm for and rewards shall be given in the name of Nulgath!

quests.name: The Game of Gemstones
quests.description: So… You're not a very rich minion, are you? That's honestly a real shame. You are so broke, you can't even afford a lousy gem? AND are struggling a lot to get it back?! Wow, you're fortunate enough to have me around. There's some small luck. According with our ARS (Abyssal Revenue Services) you have no rights to claim a refund but I can aid you a bit to get part of your gold back, if you wish to hunt gemstones scattered around Lore, hahaha! You want to go into the /catacombs to find the crazed scorpion doctor, /lavarun to find the muscle head known as Mega Tyndarius, The PvP captains in where you humans go to fight one another in /bludrutbrawl, Wolfwing is his lair, and see if you can manage to find one from yourself in the insane Sneevil's lair /baconcatyou.

quests.name: Assisting Drudgen
quests.description: Master's minion, it seems you are in possession of one of my master's assistant, the Sneevil we call Drudgen. In order to promote more assistance, I'm able to help you slightly better if you bring me things Drudgen do also seek and maybe you can spin his wheel with more luck.

quests.name: Assisting Crag and Bamboozle
quests.description: What now? Ooooh… it seems you do possess the double trouble guys, Crag the golem and Bamboozle the sneevil, they really like to be friends with each other. Let’s make a deal; If you bring me some reagents I can persuade Bamboozle to spin the wheel with more “luck” while you bring some snacks to feed the good boy Crag in the end.

quests.name: Assisting Oblivion Blade
quests.description: Amazing! You do have in your possession the ancient Oblivion Blade of Nulgath, an assistant rarely seen throughout Lore. Very well Master's minion! In return, I'm giving you an exclusive mission of seek, hunt and destroy if you are capable to finish this task, otherwise you are NOT worthy of possessing this blade.

quests.name: Sole Blood Blade
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you a sword to cut through anyone.

quests.name: Sole Empowered Blood Blade
quests.description: For a small price I'll give you a sword to cut through anyone.

quests.name: Purifying Nature
quests.description: You did well to help the Champion of Nature, Hero. If you are willing, I would ask your assistance to aid the remaining creatures on this area. Subdue the Corrupted Zards and bring me Treant Blossom Nectar and Myconid Spores. We shall work together to purify them before the taint gets too strong.

quests.name: Don't Drink!
quests.description: Don't drink, drink this prison ain't so great! You'll need to collect an alternate source of liquid. Try killing bunnies and moths for any liquid they may have!

quests.name: Soul of a Dracolich
quests.description: You want tokens? Fine, but don't expect it to be a walk in the park. Dage has need of souls with VAST power to fuel his exploits. Dragons will have that kind of power. Bring me 20 Elemental Dragon Souls from the Zombie Dragon in /dragonheart, and he shall use it to reap the Dracolich of his spirit.

items_required.name: Elemental Dragon Soul x20 (Stacks up to 25)

quests.name: Thanatos the Destroyer
quests.description: If you would don the mantle of Death, you must BECOME Death. And the only way to do that is to defeat Death. Slay Death for a chance to get one of the Thanatos set items.

quests.name: Flame the Evil
quests.description: Glory in the name of Dage the Evil, Dark Lord of all the Undead! Bring him 10 Firestorm Knight Blades and he will reward you with gold… and more.

quests.name: Death-dealing Blows
quests.description: To truly fill Death's role, there's a lot you'll need to learn. Like how Death - you - experience the death of mortals. It can be quite overwhelming to feel another being's lifeforce extinguish. Kill 5 heroes in combat inside any of Lore's PvP grounds, then return here.

quests.name: Fear the Reaper
quests.description: I fear that the inhabitants of your Underworld have… sensed you are different, Death. They have risen up and are plotting to remove you and rule in your place. Foolish unmortals! You will need to neutralize the minions in revolt to prove you DO command this realm.

quests.name: Master Death's Realm
quests.description: If you are to be the TRUE Master of this realm, you will need to be able to summon its portals. Your realm is linked to you, so if YOU believe that you are strong enough, the realm will. Slay 10 of the underworld's creatures to prove your strength, then /cast the spell to raise the Portal near the arch.

quests.name: Real Live Hero-Training
quests.description: Death, not YOU, the other one, is out of control. You'd better make sure he isn't making more trouble than he - or you - can handle. A slain mage brought word from the blacksmiths, at BattleOn's Forge, that Death and Thok are engaged in a fight to the… death. Hurry there to save Thok!

quests.name: The Living Library
quests.description: To learn how to best Death, you need to KNOW Death. For that, you'll need the Xhar Morghuil, the living library. It records the existences and histories of things which should not be named, but are best not forgotten. The Mana Golem, Mana Imp and Mana Falcon in /elemental hold the spell runes to unlock its pages.

quests.name: Understanding Xhar Morghuil
quests.description: To understand how to best the former Death, you will need to know what the Xhar Morghuil has kept hidden for eons. Ask it 3 questions, and what it tells you will help you regain your mortality.

quests.name: Door to Eternity
quests.description: You say the sarcophagus in this realm is actually a… doorway? To a plane where Death's daughters fill and store mortals' hourglasses? Then yes, I suggest you DO find it and open it, quickly. You should not leave such a resource unexplored! To think a stone coffin could hide so very much.

quests.name: Death vs Death
quests.description: I have taken the liberty of summoning the now-mortal ex-Death. You will need to confront him if you hope to regain your mortal body.

quests.name: The Nation Needs YOU!
quests.description: You're here for the recruitment drive, eh? Well, thanks for the interest, but we're looking for STRONG heroes. Real tough fighters. We're going to be going up against the Queen's army, you know.

quests.name: Show Me More, Nation-Noob
quests.description: You did well, but that first round was just to weed out the weak. A real Nation champion can take on even the toughest Shadowscythe and Legion scum - I mean fighters. Right. We're working together now. Head into the arena and show me how good you are! Defeat Legion Fenrirs and Doombringers!

quests.name: For the Nation!
quests.description: We weren't expecting anyone to make it this far, but in the arena you will find Elite Shadowscythe and Legion volunteers. Go kick their butts. Take out Legion Cannons and Paragons, and Doomknight Prime and Draconic Doomknights!

quests.name: Nulgath Likes Your Style
quests.description: You're showing a lot of potential, Prospect – maybe you're even good enough to become Nulgath's right-hand Hero! Want to show him what you're made of? Then step on into the arena and defeat Grimlord!

quests.name: Nation Recruits: Seal Your Fate
quests.description: Nulgath imbued part of his essence into these Fiend Seals and Gems of Domination. The Legion warriors in this arena hold these seals, and the Shadowscythe warriors have his Gem of Domination. Your task, if you have the strength to complete it is this: Best them for a chance to recover 25 seals and 1 Gem, then return to me for your reward!

quests.name: Nation Loyalty Rewarded
quests.description: Loyal members of the Nation like you have proven themselves worthy of even greater rewards. Relics of defeated, powerful enemies can be used to create strong magic. Bring me the remains of your defeated foes and I'll reward you.

quests.name: Hardly Suiting Armor
quests.description: I am forever bound to my cursed armor. The only way to break the curse is to find all four pieces of my armor and destroy them. You'll find them guarded by the 4 most powerful monsters in Greenguard… the Greenguard Dragon, the Greenguard Basilisk, the Deathgazer and the Gell Oh No. Where do these monsters lurk? Finding them is part of your challenge, as well.

quests.name: Clear A Path
quests.description: Toil: Thanks for helping us out. Normally we can handle Monglinsters on our own but these guys are getting out of hand. You'll never make it out alive unless you clear a path to the storage room where Myx is being held. Bring us 10 tufts of Moglinster Fur so that I know the way is safe.

quests.name: Kanathalite-D
quests.description: Bubble: Those Sugarrush Ghouls in there are pretty mean when they don't get enough sugar. They've found our stash of bars of Kanthalite-D, one of the rare magical substances that makes our candy so amazing! If they get ALL of the bars of Kanthalite-D then we'll be ruined for sure! Please stop the Sugarrush Ghouls and bring us 8 Kan-D bars!

quests.name: Myx It Up
quests.description: Trouble: Myx is being guarded by some kind of Super Moglinster. He appears to be quite a bit tougher than the others. You might want to invite to some friends with you. If you can defeat the Super Moglinster before the rest of them show up then you should be able to sneak back here with Myx. Please hurry!

quests.name: Candy Conundrum
quests.description: There has got to be a reason for the Moglinsters' violent behavior! You have helped us out so much, Hero, but can you do us another favor? Apparently the Moglinsters ate too much candy… but this candy was not a Cauldron Sisters' specialty. Who could be behind this Mogloween madness? Collect 10 Candy Samples from Moglinsters… and hurry!

quests.name: Boos Clues
quests.description: Head through that portal and bravely face whatever is waiting on the other side! I am sure that whoever is responsible has set up defensive security precautions, so be careful! Collect 4 clues that the monsters drop and bring those items back to us. These clues just might be the answers that we are looking for!

quests.name: What's Up, Doc?
quests.description: Dr. Voltabolt must be stopped! Everyone knows he's a magic-hating mad scientist and all, but this time he's gone too far! Head back through the portal and confront Voltabolt. Bring us back his Monocle once you've had a few choice words with him! You are our only hope at saving Mogloween!

quests.name: Mysterious Chest
quests.description: This mysterious chest has SEVEN locks! You're going to need seven keys to open it. Once you've collected the keys from all Seven Deadly Dragons, you'll be able to open the chest and see what wonders it might contain!

quests.name: Sprig Cleaning
quests.description: I have become infested with these mad beasts infected by chaos magic, and their insanity gnaws at me like a plague of insects chewing away my leaves. Dispatch these beasts so that my faithful druids may return to their home. Your efforts will be rewarded.

quests.name: Bleak Despair
quests.description: For years and year, they've wandered the wheel, condemned to a life of bleak despair. Kill monsters to get John and John the free-running equipment so they can escape the trap of the hamster wheel! You'll need Running Shoes, a Track Suit, a Sweat Band, and a Water Bottle!

quests.name: The Legion?
quests.description: What are these things? Some kind of experiment? They are different from Master Nulgath's Fiends but I sense a familiarity. Regardless, they are in my way!

quests.name: Dealing With Defectors
quests.description: What has become of these Fiends? I sense Master Dage's magic, twisting them. And yet, they are here of their own accord. These Defectors must be stopped.

quests.name: Ward Destruction
quests.description: It seems that Master Dage has put up Wards to keep Master Nulgath's eyes off of this place. Regardless of what happens to me, I must take down these Wards so Master Nulgath can see what has happened here.

quests.name: The Traitor's Path
quests.description: I do not know what has led you down this path, Master Dage, but I will stop you before you can complete it. Your forces and defenses will fall before me and soon, you will too.

quests.name: Defeat Dage the Lich
quests.description: Old friend, it pains me to face you like this. But I must. It has always been my duty to show you the right path. I will see my duty fulfilled.

quests.name: Choose Your Path
quests.description: Alteon, your king, has ordered you to Highwick, but the cost may well be Lynaria's life. Which path will you choose?

quests.name: With Every Wind
quests.description: You hear a soft voice coming from the Throne. "It appears someone's been tampering with the timelines. Yet, I feel a presence, oddly similar to the king's. Could it be… nevermind. I'm trapped here, and I'm willing to help you if my soul is freed from this throne. Gather the correct gear, and I'll tell you how to reforge the king's arsenal."

quests.name: Hail To The King
quests.description: "You had no trouble handling the royal weaponry. I'll assume you're ready for the next step: crafting the king's armor itself! Bring something to catalyze Ice and Darkness, as well as Human Souls to feed the fusion."

quests.name: Cold, Cold, COLD!
quests.description: "All Hollowborn are measured by their willpower. While wearing my armor, your body and will become mine. Before I spread my power across another timeline, we need a new minion. Go gather souls and bones so we can build a new one that suits our needs.

quests.name: Nothing There
quests.description: I remember the Oblivion that looked down on me as I fell into the abyss, but it's been a long time since then. Investigate the Empty Creatures, the Oblivion Magi, and the Herald. That would be more helpful than my stale old memories.

items_required.name: Obsidian Bone Shard x1 (Stacks up to 10)

quests.name: Let's Get Started
quests.description: So the villagers weren't big on helping me get the items I need for my ritual. Surprising, right?? Perhaps you could "persuade" them to help out.

quests.name: A Ritual by any Other Name
quests.description: Almost halfway there! Just need some more supplies from in town, go into town and click on those blue arrows. Lunarmancers need to maintain a high saline content, so salt is important. Grab a bag of chips from one of the Cove Fishers by the beach!

quests.name: Fish'n'Chips on my Shoulder
quests.description: I know it's not really needed for the ritual but now I'm really hungry for chips, and those stale ones you got just aren't cutting it. Go see if any of those beach goers have some chips on them.

quests.name: Hex on the Beach(balls)
quests.description: I CANNOT have the villagers interrupting my rituals AGAIN. Every time they play with those braken-forsaken beachballs… it ruptures my nerves. And I need those steady1 Go tell 10 of those villagers to keep it down, and bring me back some deflated beach balls!

quests.name: Total Eclipse of the Heart
quests.description: Lunarmancy draws much power from nature, and most of THAT from the sea. With the full moon so close, the sea creatures' power is almost at its peak. Take the Shiny Stone underwater - it should attract the monsters that you need. Bring me 3 branches of coral from the Coral Merdraconians, and 2 scales from Plessie, to create a sheathe for its fang.

quests.name: Lycan this Next Task
quests.description: You're a hero, so presumably you like saving people. You sure didn't seem to like "persuading" them. Run around and rescue 7 of the villagers under threat.

quests.name: "Were" Did We Go Wrong?
quests.description: The villagers are saying that the Horde is trying to get to my HOUSE? NOWAI! They will destroy everything! Go get the Horde!

quests.name: Find the Lycanstone
quests.description: Gravefang's Horde members MUST have some way to locate him. Track down the Horde Knights and see if you can find a Lycanstone.. This way we will know where Gravefang is!

quests.name: Fur the Right Thing
quests.description: So looks like you've drawn out their leader with all of your "heroing". Might as well go ahead and take care of him as well…

quests.name: Dis-lycan What Happened
quests.description: Looks like Gravefang's Horde minions took more out of the villagers than we expected. I have a brew they can drink that will restore them.

quests.name: Time to Rock this Finale!
quests.description: Welp seems not only did I summon the wrong moon, but I accidentally turned that moon into a rock monster… Good luck with that.

quests.name: As Above, So Below
quests.description: A Chronomancer became trapped here because their abilities stopped working. Their body and sense of self were stripped away until only a 'thought' remained.The belief that Time will return for them. By your standards, it looks quite gruesome. Help save them from themselves. They've been waiting a long…time for it.

quests.name: Join My Dojo
quests.description: If you believe you have what it takes to become a Martial Artist, join my dojo and become my student. The challenges you'll face will be unlike anything you've experienced ever before! Few have the determination to see this journey to mastery through. Are you up for it?

quests.name: 500 Punches and 500 Kicks
quests.description: My techniques harness the abilities of Frogzards, Gorillaphants, and Dragons- three creatures with a deep connection to Lore. You must familiarize yourself with these beasts before your training can truly begin. Let's start with 500 of each. The Frogzards in /nexus, Gorillaphants in /arcangrove, and Dragons in /etherwardes should be suitable foes for you.

quests.name: Deathly Slow Start
quests.description: The trial of 500 you just completed? That was nothing. Let us see how you handle a whopping 500,000 of each! If you think this is too much, then you will never be ready to learn my techniques.

quests.name: Discount Diploma
quests.description: That was just the beginning. Are you tired? Ha, I have bad news for you, because now you get to do it again! Remember this bitterness well. It'll make your punches and kicks hit harder than a coddled, silver spoon sucking, Ds-get-degrees layabout!

quests.name: One Million Miles Searching
quests.description: What is a million more? Several years worth of training, that's what! I expect you to have a beard by the time you're back. It doesn't matter if you don't have the chin for it, you will have whiskers…unless you're up to something.

quests.name: Ughhhhhh
quests.description: This must be a fluke! Do it again! From the bottom Up! Bring me proof that you've defeated 2000000 Frogzards, 2000000 Gorillaphants, and 2000000 Dragons! I want them extinct!

quests.name: Work Smarter, Not Harder
quests.description: The only way to become a Master of the Martial Arts like me is to defeat 5999500 more Frogzards, 5999500 more Gorillaphants, and 5999500 more Dragons. Until then, I will be the only true Master in history.

quests.name: Cheater Cheater
quests.description: You didn't just cheat my training regimen. A lazy lout like you cheated yourself. I can't let you spread your methods. My reputation will plummet! Prepare yourself for the hardest lesson of your life! I'll show you what a real Master can do!

quests.name: Minimize the Maxmum Slugfit
quests.description: Maximum Slugfit is small but nasty — a tiny, purple, chitnous, chaorrupted imp. Don't underestimate him, or he may literally eat your face. (Suggested level 10+)

quests.name: Defeat the Dire Groglurk
quests.description: First, you will be up against the Dire Groglurk! Stolen from Bludrut Keep, this giant worm will swallow you whole — provided he doesn't slash you to bits with his blade. (Suggested level 15+)

quests.name: Devour the Evolved Fear Muncher
quests.description: Lets see if you can take on the Evolved Fear Muncher! This one's a real test of bravery — The feelings of dread it creates can be paralyzing. You won't be able to defeat it unless you can master your fear. (Suggested level 20+)

quests.name: Oust the Grievous Inbunche
quests.description: Think you can take on the Grievous Inbunche? This horrifying monstruosity was found guarding the lair of an evil wizard which should teach you something about how terrifying an opponent it can be. (Suggested level 35+)

quests.name: Smush the Hulking Castle Spider
quests.description: I'll warn you now: this is the biggest spider in Lore, made ten times worse. If you run from it screaming like a small child, no one will think less of you. (Suggested level 40+)

quests.name: Subdue the Supreme Shadowscythe
quests.description: How can you make a Shadowscythe more deadly? How about encasing it in mechanical steel armor that can resist nearly any attack? Do you think you can handle it?. (Suggested level 45+)

quests.name: Melt the Ancient Horror
quests.description: I never thought a snowman could ever be anything to fear… untill I laid eyes on this thing. Each of the icy spikes that covers its body is a weapon. Try not to get impaled. (Suggested level 45+)

quests.name: Void the Mutated Dragon
quests.description: The Void Dragon was already lethal. After the mutation, it is absolutely devastating. Are you ready to find out of you can go toe to toe with a vicious beast like this… and survive? (Suggested level 55+)

quests.name: Crush the Colossal Primarch
quests.description: With skin as hard as stone, the former Darkblood Primarch is a though one to beat. The only thing more challenging than landing a damaging hit is stayin out of the way of his giant mace. Think you can handle it? (Suggested level 60+)

quests.name: Destroy Graveclaw
quests.description: Remember Graveclaw? Of course you do, who can forget an undead minotaur wielding a huge axe? Well, now he's also venomous, and he's your next challenge in the Coliseum. Good luck! (Suggested level 60+)

quests.name: Souls to Steal
quests.description: To overwhelm the ArchFiend, our Master must grow stronger! Slay the pathetic worms who follow Nulgath; bring back their souls to inrease his power! 13 of them will do…for now.

quests.name: Hunt for the Infinity Codex
quests.description: Vortex Mages trapped here have stolen the pages of the Infinity Codex. Slay them to recover its pages to learn what you'll need to do in order to pass through the wormhole.

quests.name: Sacrific and Survival
quests.description: To survive, you will need to prove your worth… and it doesn't hurt to come bearing a gift or two as you enter the gods' domain. Sacrific 3 Nagas and 3 Hawks to ask for their blessing.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Isis
quests.description: If you would activate the Gate of Isis, you will need to recover the Balm Cartouche. Isis, the mother goddess, was known for her healing ways. Look closesly into the Goblins' pots, and you'll find balm… and the Balm of Cartouche.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Ma'at
