quests.description: There are many gates ahead of you. Beyond Isis' Gate lies taht of Ma'at. To pass through it, you will need to recover the 5 pieces the Scale Cartouche. I fear it was stolen by the Vortex Walkers, who wander the wormhole seeking retribution for those who imprisoned them here.

quests.name: Bound to Do Good
quests.description: The base of the vortex gate obelisks is made of a substance called "faience"--to restore the shattered obelisks, you will need to make more. Slay Dimensional Crystals, Gate Goblins, and Vortex Matter to get the quartz, lime, and natron to make faience.

quests.name: Honor the Goddess Isis
quests.description: We cannot know how this obelisk was shattered or when, but if you wish to pass through the gate and continue through the wormhole, you will need to restore it. Click on Obelisk rubble until you've reassembled it.

quests.name: Stick to the Task
quests.description: You created enough faience for ONE obelisk. Reset assured, you WILL need more before your journey is done. There is an alternate recipe we might try… Slay Dimensional Crystals, Gate Goblins, and Vortex Matter to get the quartz, lime, and ash to make faience.

quests.name: Honor the Goddess Ma'at
quests.description: The Goddess of Justice was lucky. Whatever destroyed Isis' obelisk could not shatter hers. To unlock the gate, you need only activate the obelisk. The Infinity Codex instructs you to click on the panels. Once they are lit, touch Ma'at's obelisk.

quests.name: Duty is light as a feather
quests.description: It is known that as one enters the Underworld, they are judged with Ma'at's scales. A feather is weighed against the heart of the hero. If one's heart is light, they pass into the paradise beyond. Your judgement waits… and you will need to bring your own feather. Slay Vortex Hawks until you recover a Feather of Ma'at.

quests.name: Judgement... or Justice?
quests.description: You may passsed through Ma'at's gate, but she is not finished with you yet! The hour of your judgement is at hand, Hero. In this trial by combat, you must defeat the Hand of Ma'at to prove you are pure of heart. If you fail… you shall never leave this place.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Thoth
quests.description: It is said that if one could gather all the books and scrolls ever written, they would know the sum of all man's knowledge. But Thoth, god of wisdom, already knows. Recover the Scroll Cartouche from the Vortex Mages. Only then will you be able to activate his obelisk.

quests.name: Make Your Mark
quests.description: We walk through a hall made of starstuff… built upon solidified solar winds and the remnants of stones present when this universe was formed. Honor the gods of the sun, moon, stars, and sky by inscribing their marks upon this place.

quests.name: The Cartouche of Kebechet
quests.description: Kebechet, mother of serpents and preserver of heroes - her cartouche is a snake. Take back the fragments of her cartouche from the Nagas who resemble her so much.

quests.name: Honor the Goddess Kebechet
quests.description: It may be that another Hero… perhaps even another you?… attempted to pass by, and in doing so destroyed the obelisk. We may never know. But if you wish to pass through the gate and continue through the wormhole, you will need to restore Kebechet's obelisk. Click on the rubble until you've reassembled it.

quests.name: Destroy to Purify
quests.description: You are nearing the edge of the wormhole. I can sense it! But… more battles await, and you will want to prepare - and purify yourself - well for them. Slay Vortex Crystals to gather the natron needed to purify yourself before facing the Vortex Guardian.

quests.name: Guardian of the Vortex
quests.description: This beast appears to have been formed from the very stuff making up the wormhole itself. That's quite a feat, a we cannot touch the matter that makes it up. But rest assured, the Guardian CAN touch, and harm, YOU. Slay it quickly to pass deeper into the wormhole.

quests.name: Stick with it
quests.description: You did not think you made enough faience LAST time, did you? Hah! These obelisks are very delicate objects, and require a great deal of glue. Slay Dimensional Crystals, Goblins, Vortex Matter to get quartz, lime, plant ash to make more of the faience I need.

quests.name: Honor the God Thoth
quests.description: I believe you've proven you have the knowledge required to reassemble these obelisks. I shall not waste time in idle prattle. Click on the fragments of Thoth's obelisk to activate his gate and continue on your journey.

quests.name: The Brightest Cartouches
quests.description: Your journey is almost complete, according to the Infinity Codex, my friend! You seek now the Cartouches of Nut, Ra, Horus, and Khonsu. Slay the Vortex Matter, Dimensional Crystals, and Vortex Crystals to find them.

quests.name: Honor the Astral Deities
quests.description: Ah! We are very, VERY lucky, my friend! The Sky, Sun, Star, and Moon obelisks all appear to be whole. Activate them and honor the Astral Deities.

quests.name: Serpent of the Stars
quests.description: It is said that the god Ra was guarded by a ferocious serpent. It is any wonder, then, that an object as powerful as the Infinity Shield is guarded by a similar beast? To recover the shield, you will need to pass by the Mehenisi Serpent.

quests.name: The Infinity Shield
quests.description: It is marvelous to behold! According to the Infinity Codex, it was created through the combination of Ra, Horus, Khonsu, and Nut's magics. Only - hmm. Only another creature of eternity may take it. But you… you ARE special, aren't you? Yes, you should be just fine.

quests.name: Drink Me
quests.description: The girls you're here to rescue are all trapped in the mirrors. To get to them, you'll need to find your way INSIDE them - and then find your way back out again. The problem there is, when you're in the mirrors it weakens your hold on reality - the mirror's pocket dimension becomes real to you. Luckily, I know how to make a potion that strengthens your mind against the mirror's effect. You'll need some glass powder from the nearby glass monsters, and some reflective venom from the Glass Snakes.

quests.name: The Key To Success
quests.description: Now that you're protected against the mirrors' mind-fogging effects, you're ready to go in. To get to the first mirror, take the door to the left, and go down the hall a little ways. When you get there, you'll need to defeat the Silver Elemental that's guarding it, and take its "key" - it's not a literal key, but it IS your way in. Once you have it, touch the mirror with it to "unlock" the pathway inside. Then, you'll be able to enter it. Good luck!

quests.name: Lightbeam Elixir
quests.description: If you bring me the ingredients, I can try to make you a Lightbeam Elixir! It'll heal you, and leave you with a nice, shiny glow. The process doesn't always work, so it might take a few tries before I get it right.

quests.name: Sparklebeam Elixir
quests.description: If you bring me the ingredients, I can try to make you a Sparklebeam Elixir! It'll restore all your mana and leave you with a nice, shiny glow. The process doesn't always work, so it might take a few tries before I get it right.

quests.name: Twilly's Go-Go Potion
quests.description: If you bring me the ingredients, I can try to make Twilly's Go-Go Potion for you! It'll increase your healing potential for a short time. The process doesn't always work, so it might take a few tries before I get it right.

quests.name: Ancient Trainee
quests.description: Every warrior has to prove his worth to me, before making them my apprentice. The training grounds in Noobshire have been invaded by Horcs! Go to Noobshire and take out their leader. Bring me back 3 Leader's Flags as proof of their defeat.

quests.name: Ancient Endurance
quests.description: All warriors need to be strong and gain great stamina to battle monsters non stop. Go into the River and battle with the Zardmen there until you feel your stamina grow. Bring me back at least 8 Zardman spears as proof of your deed. (Bring back 8 Zardman spears)

quests.name: Ancient Path of the Warrior
quests.description: Your final task to begin the path of a warrior is to fight against all odds and be victorious. Go into the Marsh and fight Thrax Ironhide, he should be a very decent challenge. Bring me back his Ironhide's Helmet as proof of your victory. (Bring back Ironhide's Helmet)

quests.name: Ancient Warrior Spirit
quests.description: You have proven yourself skilled, well done! We will need your help in the upcoming wars that threaten the world of Lore. Things are starting to stir in Bludrut Keep. It seems that the presence of evil there is not a mere coincidence. We need to take out as many evil spirits as we can, before they have a chance to group themselves and pose a threat to our peaceful way of life. Kill 10 Earth spirits to maintain their numbers and bring me back their essence. (Bring back 10 rock essence spirits to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Trainee
quests.description: Every warrior has to prove his worth to me, before making them my apprentice. The training grounds in Noobshire have been invaded by Orcs! Go to Noobshire and take out their leader.Bring me back 3 Leaders Flags as proof of their defeat. (Bring back 3 Leader's Flags)

quests.name: Endurance
quests.description: All warriors need to be strong and gain great stamina to battle monsters non stop. Go into the River and battle with the Zardmen there until you feel your stamina grow. Bring me back at least 8 Zardman spears as proof of your deed. (Bring back 8 Zardman spears)

quests.name: Path of the Warrior
quests.description: Your final task to begin the path of a warrior is to fight against all odds and be victorious. Go into the Marsh and fight Thrax Ironhide, he should be a very decent challenge. Bring me back his Ironhide's Helmet as proof of your victory. (Bring back Ironhide's Helmet)

quests.name: Warrior Spirit
quests.description: You have proven yourself skilled, well done! We will need your help in the upcoming wars that threaten the world of Lore. Things are starting to stir in Bludrut Keep. It seems that the presence of evil there is not a mere coincidence. We need to take out as many evil spirits as we can, before they have a chance to group themselves and pose a threat to our peaceful way of life. Kill 10 Earth spirits to maintain their numbers and bring me back their essence. (Bring back 10 rock essence spirits to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Warlord Armor
quests.description: (For owners of the Warlord class) You have proven your worth - you are now a Warlord. Sometimes however, these skill are not what is called for, but the look always is.

quests.name: Explore the Order's Headquarters
quests.description: Trouble is coming, that's clear enough! Explore the headquarters of the Seraphic Paladins to learn the lay of the land.

quests.name: Good Secrets are Hard to Find
quests.description: If you're going to root out the Undead Legion infiltrators, you're going to need to talk to as many of the Paladins as possible. The members of my Order are well-versed in keeping secrets, but you'll need to make them talk… or we'll never learn the truth.

quests.name: Whispers, Rumors, and Seraphic Scrolls
quests.description: Dage must be looking for information on how to take down our Order. Interrogate any spies you find and hunt through the Seraphic Scrolls to discover what he might have learned. Members of the Order will have the scrolls… for the rest, you'll need to find the spies!

quests.name: Me? A Spy?
quests.description: The Order members are accusing YOU of being the spy! Defeat them in order to find out exactly who is behind this!

quests.name: Train Evil’s Army for the Alliance!
quests.description: If the Alliance is to prosper, Empress Gravelyn’s undead army must be highly skilled. Head down the hall to the right and find the training room.

quests.name: Chaos in Hachiko
quests.description: World has arrived of an underground movement in Hachiko. the Samurai there may have all been Chaorrupted! Hurry there and interrogate any you see to discem the truth. Stop at nothing, use no mercy, in the quest to learn the truth.

quests.name: Hounds of Evil
quests.description: The Empress needs warrior drakhounds. The puppies running about shadowfall do well.. ones they’re undead. Until then, they’ll need puppy chow, and the Fear Munchers inside the fortress will be quite suitable. Quest all through Shadowfall to steal 10 of the pups and slay 7 Fear Munchers 10 puppies and slay 7 Shadow Munchers to feed them.

quests.name: Dragon Egg Smash!
quests.description: The Empress has heard of a new clutch of dragon eggs in Lair. She cannot take the chance that they may be turned to chaos. Smash the 8 eggs to prevent Drakath from Chaorrupting the dragonets which will one day hatch.

quests.name: Poisonforest Bandit Attack!
quests.description: The Empress needs eyes and ears in all parts of lore to fight Chaos, and for that she needs villagers to spy. She's staged a bandit attack on /poisonforest. Save the 5 villagers and slay the 9 bandits to gain the yokel's trust! They won't see your betrayal coming!

quests.name: Swordhaven Candy Thief
quests.description: Evil comes in all degrees, from lies to slaughter to simple theft. There are many happy people living in Swordhaven, and they all have something that may please the Empress. Steal their candy and bring it back for our ruler. No one is too evil to enjoy the sweet things in life.

quests.name: Shadows of the Past
quests.description: if the Empress is to serve the alliance to the best of her ability and reign over all Lore, she needs to be free from doubt. She cannot be plagued by the shadows of the past. Head to her jail, uncover the hatch to Sepulchure's crypt, and slay the shadow of her past.

quests.name: Slayer of Chaos?
quests.description: Are you a hand of the Alliance, or do you serve Chaos? Slay any of the monsters infected by Chaos, retrieve the Chaos Gems they possess, and you will have a chance to get the Chaos Slayer Armor or Helm.

quests.name: Lotus Be Done With This
quests.description: The Lotus Spiders that once guarded this pyramid have turned to the Queen of Monsters. They were once sacred but have since sullied their name. Now they stand between us and Sek Duat. Take them out.

quests.name: Lightless Light
quests.description: What is Sek Duat up to? These Light Elementals… They are being… Suffocated by something. They are in pain and we have no way of saving them. All we can do is end their suffering.

quests.name: Suffocation Investigation
quests.description: The same "goo" that is affecting the Elementals is affecting the area as well. Collect some samples for me. But be careful! Do not touch it directly! We do not want you sharing the same fate as the Elementals.

quests.name: Gone With the Djinn
quests.description: The door that Sek Duat has sealed himself behind is protected from my Djinn magic. At least for now. Lucky for us, Djinn Energy flows through this pyramid, thanks to its previous occupants. Defeat the enemies that have been soaking in the energy and it should overcharge me enough to get that door open!

quests.name: The Light Orb
quests.description: Sek Duat is just up ahead. It doesn't look like he was able to give the Light Orb to the Queen yet! Let's make sure we take it before he has the chance!

quests.name: The Light Orb, Part II
quests.description: Horothotep, the Devourer, Child of the Queen, murderer of our friend. We will have our vengeance and get that Orb!

quests.name: Never Out of Time
quests.description: I am convinced that these Time Travel Fairies have also mastered this art of immortality using saves! It seems that every time that I defeat one, another one pops back in its place! Or maybe even the same one! I'm not sure… Anyway! I need you to continue to test their theory for me! I'll pay you well for your efforts!

quests.name: Time to Die
quests.description: I have been working on perfecting my save point art even further, however I can't seem to get it right! I know! In /shadowrealmpast, there is a being called the Shadow Lord. If any being had the secrets of time based immortality, the Shadow Lord would be it! See if you can learn it's secrets!

quests.name: Gift Theft?! NOT COOL.
quests.description: Happy Bright Lights Festival, Hero! You know me and holiday celebrations — when people are ready to /party, I BRING PRESENTS! Except those puddle-brained Snow Golems stole them. Get my gifts back and I'll make sure you get one!

quests.name: The BIG Finish
quests.description: This new form is amazing! But I'm not sure how long I can stay in it. It's time to take the fight to Drakath and make him pay for everything he's done to the people of Lore. I am their hope, their champion, their Titan- and I'm the one who will bring an end to this conflict once and for all!

quests.name: Eternal Vigilance
quests.description: Sun setting. Tlax need to make K'thurr ready for dark. You help me? You place 6 Torches around town to make sure we not attacked at night. Also bring Tlax 3 Rabid Boar Teeth. That teach them to stay out of K'thurr and scare off rest.

quests.name: Tlax's Axe
quests.description: You see me axe? Ghaz made for me when he was child to show his skill. Him skill get better since then but this still my best axe. Maybe I give you, if you do a thing for me? Tlax collect Rhison Horns, someday I hope to find the Golden Horn. Maybe you have good luck. Bring me 15 Rhison Horns and maybe I give you axe!

quests.name: Take a Bite Out of Crime
quests.description: Those monsters have NO business trying to eat Cysero's pie! That's what you're here for now, but you'll need to leave soon to go ingredient hunting. Clear the Forge-Kitchen of 13 monsters so that the first Pie-sitter doesn't have to worry about them.

quests.name: Skullberry Picking
quests.description: Now that you've cleared those monsters out of Cysero's place and Valencia's scheduled to take over watching, YOU can go ingredient hunting! And we know the best berries around are skullberries! You'll find them on the bushes in the misty Croft-forest. Bring back 10 bushes of skullberries!

quests.name: Chilling Costume
quests.description: Mmmm. I really want to create a really cool Mogloween costume this year. But I don't want to have the same thing as everyone else has. I don't like those Spider guys, Hocky masked scary guys or Powerful Rangers. I want a costume different from everyone else and for that I will have to do it for myself. If the costume is great this will help you gather more candy. Can you bring me 10 pieces of fabric from the ghosts inside the houses? (Bring back 10 pieces of fabric from the ghosts to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Candy Basket
quests.description: This is terrible! We don't have any place to store our candy! I've seen big pumpkins inside the house that can make a great storage space for candy. It would be great if we can store candy for an entire year! Can you collect 6 pumpkins and bring it back to us? (Bring back 6 pumpkins to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Landing Swords!
quests.description: I really need to find my juggling swords, hero. I was walking around the forest practicing and I somehow lost all 7 of them and the Spiders ate my Tiny Sword! If you happen to find my swords while you're exploring, I'll gladly reward you!

items_required.name: Tiny Sword x1 (Stacks up to x2)

quests.name: Free the Sword!
quests.description: I really need to find my juggling swords, hero. I was walking around the forest practicing and I somehow lost all 7 of them and the Spiders ate my Tiny Sword! If you happen to find my swords while you're exploring, I'll gladly reward you!

items_required.name: Tiny Sword x1 (Stacks up to x2)

quests.name: Pyromancer Domination
quests.description: Pyromancers are quick to anger and even quicker to DESTROY SPIDERS WITH FIRE! Slay 5 ChaosWeavers to aid the war effort and get extra Ravenloss rep.

quests.name: Mages Make Mashed Spiders
quests.description: Magic is good for a lot of things. Including slaying spiders. Slay 5 ChaosWeavers to aid the war effort and get extra Ravenloss rep.

quests.name: Warriors Against Spiderkin
quests.description: Warriors hit hard. ESPECIALLY when crushing spiders! Slay 5 ChaosWeavers to aid the war effort and get extra Ravenloss rep.

quests.name: Arachnomancers Weave War
quests.description: To destroy a thing, you must know it VERY well! Slay 5 ChaosWeavers to aid the war effort and get extra Ravenloss rep.

quests.name: Pyromancer Domination
quests.description: Pyromancers are quick to anger and even quicker to DESTROY SPIDERS WITH FIRE! Slay 5 ChaosWeavers to aid the war effort and get extra Ravenloss rep.

quests.name: Arachnomancers Weave War
quests.description: To destroy a thing, you must know it VERY well! Slay 5 ChaosWeavers to aid the war effort and get extra Ravenloss rep.

quests.name: Yo Mummy
quests.description: Well, it's worth a shot. Maybe Sekt's mom DOES carry a can of grease to oil her bones. If she does, you can use it on the lever to make it move again!

quests.name: Gimme Inspiration
quests.description: I need inspiration! It's been too long since I heard quality music from other bards. Bring me the newest Britpop Singles from the Beatles in /mythsong, the best New Wave Hits from the Stingers in the /beehive, and some intense Classical Masterpieces from the Mozards in the /orchestra!

quests.name: None More Black
quests.description: If I'm going to perform the greatest metal ballad ever written, I'm going to have to make sure I look the part! That means I need to make sure my clothes are dyed and my eyes are smudged with the blackest of black - Imp Kohl! It only comes from one place: the /necrocavern. Specifically, it comes from the Shadow Imps found within. Bring me some, and I will sing of your greatness.

quests.name: Energize Me!
quests.description: Obviously, I'll have to wait until the real fight begins before I can write my title track. But I'd like to get working on some filler pieces in the meantime. Why don't you go out and fight some of these wandering monsters to give me some material? Make sure you drink some of my Inspiration Brand Energy Drink (™) before you go out there. I just won't feel as inspired otherwise.

quests.name: Black Metal Cold Brew
quests.description: Heeey! Feeling the need for caffeine? Try my new Black Metal Cold Brew, made right here at the Rift! No cream, no sugar, just black like my soul. I won't charge you for it if you bring me the ingredients I need to make a new batch. Just … try not to think too hard about the recipe.

quests.name: Huli Jing
quests.description: If you're staying at an Inn, I'll pay for the accommodations as long as you let me stay with you. Preferably, a room without Foxes. As much as I like them, the feeling isn't mutual. Oh, they're not supposed to be here in the first place? Spies, are they? If that's the case, let's politely show them out.

quests.name: Aka Oni Ao Oni
quests.description: This is my first time seeing Oni. They're raucous, rude, and keep trying to eat the villagers. All this noise is going to get in the way of our meals and sleep. Fighting the Foxes alongside you was fun, so let's resharpen our blades and do away with these oafish creatures.

quests.name: Stone Shangyuan Fest
quests.description: That man at the edge of the village is being pestered by those living lanterns. I…think I'll get rid of the remaining Foxes and Oni. You go ahead and deal with the Tsukumogami. We wouldn't want to give the Dragons a head start on torching the Isles.

quests.name: Nagami Sashimi
quests.description: More of those creatures the locals call Nagami are crawling up to shore. I definitely saw them conversing with the Dragon army out on the water. Well, what are we waiting for? Let's chop them up and get dinner started. I haven't cooked for a friend since the last war, so go easy on me.

quests.name: Divine Derision
quests.description: A creature flew down from the mountains. I can feel its air of nobility mixing with waves of indignant rage. That's a Tengu? The Yokai lurking in this village seem to revere it, and it's raring to fight you. I can tell it's on the Dragons' side, which means you don't need to show mercy.

quests.name: Phanatics
quests.description: What the heck? The mirror dropped you in some kind of concert hall. It's filled with Rabid Phans! You're going to have to fight your way to the front of the stage. While you're at it, you're going to need a backstage pass to get through that staff entrance - one of these Phans has to have one!

quests.name: But I Have A Backstage Pass!
quests.description: Whoa! That's one tough "bouncer" Melodia has guarding her! You'll have to defeat him if you want to reach her.

quests.name: Turn to the Left
quests.description: Wow, these models sure are fierce - literally! You're going to have to fight your way past them if you want to rescue Andres. And you'd better look runway-ready, or those critics in the audience will shred you before you can get to him!

quests.name: Now Turn to the Right
quests.description: Uh-oh. Looks like you've been spotted. If you want to save Andres, you're going to have to get past that Mirror Knight first!

quests.name: Those Harpies!
quests.description: Looks like Gisele is a… beauty pageant contestant? And of course, this time it's Pageant Moms blocking your way. You'd think they'd be happy to see her go - it'll give their daughters a better chance of winning! See if one of them has a pageant sash - that will make you blend in better once you get out onto the stage.

quests.name: Drink Your Go-Go Juice
quests.description: Looks like you're not pageant-ready after all, because that Mirror Knight has totally spotted you. Better defeat him if you want to save Gisele.

quests.name: Behind the Scenes
quests.description: Looks like you're in the rafters above a stage. Emilia's down below - you're going to have to get to her somehow. Maybe one of these stage techs has a way down!

quests.name: In the Spotlight
quests.description: That Mirror Knight doesn't seem to want you on the stage. You'll have to defeat him if you're going to rescue Emilia!

quests.name: We Gotta Wendi-GO
quests.description: You're… in a forest? With… sasquatches? Well, this was unexpected. They look pretty angry… guess you're going to have to fight your way past them. And maybe look for a clue about why they're here… that might help you with Dora when you get to her.

quests.name: Kick His- Wait, Did We Already Use that Pun?
quests.description: …Because OF COURSE there's a Mirror Knight standing right in your way. Well, you're used to these guys by now - you know what to do.

quests.name: Headless Fiend of Nulgath
quests.description: Defeat 15 Toxic Fiends to collect the necessary pieces needed to make the Toxic Fiend of Nulgath Helm.

quests.name: Destiny Wheel Pet
quests.description: So… you want to bring Shiny wherever you go? That sounds like a GREAT idea! Bring me back the shiniest thing from the Sneeviltron in the Boxes area!

quests.name: Gathering Information
quests.description: Perhaps we should start asking around and see if anyone has noticed anything suspicious during the festivities. Don't bring up the misssing presents, however. We wouldn't want people pointing fingers!

quests.name: A Test of Alliance
quests.description: While I would hate to assume this, it is best to make sure. Every year during the Festival, Galanoth and the Dragonslayers have made an agreement during our holiday of peace. No dragon shall be slain on this day and no humans will be affected by dragons. Would you visit Galanoth at Vasalkar's Lair and make sure this agreement is still being upheld? Fight off some of those halfling Wyverns while you are there, as a sign of good faith!

quests.name: Inspiring the Young
quests.description: As you can see, the streets are littered with Dragonlings. In spirit of the Festival, would you play pretend with them? They would be so happy to "defeat" a Hero, such as yourself!

quests.name: Following the Path
quests.description: It appears that there is now a trail of presents scattered throughout the town. Would you please follow them and see where they lead? Perhaps we may find out who is behind all this!

quests.name: Party Crashers
quests.description: Head outside the city walls and find out who is responsible for this! If it is a dragon, you have my permission to "rough them up". If it is a human… I will leave their fate up to you.

quests.name: Protect the Dragonlings
quests.description: Quick, Hero! With the Dragon Hunters around, you must take the Dragonlings to safety! They will want to continue with their celebrations, so you may have to use force. Please, keep them safe!

quests.name: The Ultimate Party Pooper
quests.description: With all the dragonlings safe, it is time to confront the Leader of the Dragon Hunters! Hero, make sure he pays for what he has done! Then, if you would, bring him to me…

quests.name: Returning the Gifts
quests.description: With all the gifts retrieved, it is time we give them! Set the gifts out for the Clans in the main plaza and by the decorated tree outside!

quests.name: Waking History
quests.description: Ever since the war that destroyed the city, the Luna has been hidden by a very powerful magic. Some think the Solaris cast it and other think the items have hidden themselves. Either way the magic has been weakened enough to break it. Go seek the ruins near the lake to the north and return to me.

quests.name: Gathering Shadows
quests.description: The magic of the Lunaris is powered by the dark. We will need to absorb some shadows to have enough power to break the spell hiding the Luna. Set these 10 Shadow Collectors around the area. We will leave them there to charge while we engage in other tasks.

quests.name: A Less Direct Path
quests.description: The Solaris will no doubt try to shatter the spell that hides the Luna with brute force. They are far too direct. The path of darkness is one of with and deception. We need to find a weak spot in the magic and slice through. I can detected that but I will need 10 vials of Fire Imp blood.

quests.name: Interference
quests.description: Bah! All the chaorrupted monsters in the area are interfering with my detection spell. Go and eliminate 20 of the local monsters. That should be enough to cut the interference. Return when your task is complete.

quests.name: The Race Is On
quests.description: I can see where I need to strike now. I would like to let the Shadow Collectors gather more power but we are short on time. My spies tell me that the Solaris plan to remove them and slow us down. Go and gather all 10 Shadow Collectors before the Solaris get to them.

quests.name: The Darkness Inside
quests.description: To puncture the protective shroud around the Luna we will need one more item: a Dark Soul Splinter. I can only think of one monster in the area dark and big enough to provide one. Collect a Dark Soul Splinter from theCyclops WarlordSlugfit to the north and return when you have it.

quests.name: The Luna
quests.description: The spell has worked! The Luna should reveal itself to anyone in the area but it will only last for a short time. Hurry, find the Luna in the devestated city and bring it to me! The moon will have her night forever!

quests.name: Find the Ruins
quests.description: Well now that you're here we can work on finding that crash site. I've done some looking around myself, but I didn't see anything. Maybe you'll have more luck than me. Gravelyn was absolutely certain this was the location and I can feel that something is here, someplace that needs stumbling into.

quests.name: Calm the Shadows
quests.description: Looks like we're not the first to try to find this place, based on the number of skeletons hanging around. We should put some of those fallen adventurers to rest while we're here so that they can be at peace and pass on.

quests.name: A Clue! A Clue!
quests.description: The vault must be hidden somewhere around here, I just know it. See if you can manage to get any of these strange aliens to speak with you, I tried and they just screeched at me. If not, then see if any of the fallen adventurers around here had a clue on them before they became undead. I'll just be over here reading some of these old books I found and seeing if they have any clues in them.

quests.name: Un-Cloaky!
quests.description: Some kind of alien cloaking device! No wonder we couldn't find the crash site. I wonder why those aliens would want to keep hidden? Well, there's only one way to find out' You gotta use that thing and see what it uncloaks!

quests.name: Bound Seams Hide a Key
quests.description: While you were doing THAT, I found a scrap of paper in the book I was reading. "You've read this trick a hundred times over in mysteries and mansions. A secret passage opened from knowledge under a guise of red. If you can't figure me out then pick up a book." I think I just got sassed by a piece of paper. It seems like the clue wants us to do something with the bookcase in the ship. Why is there even a bookcase here? Doesn't that seem out of place? Why disguise a door and then write a clue? I've confused myself now, probably best not to think about it further.

quests.name: Hole in the Wall
quests.description: Ow… remind me to never stand anywhere near you when you press buttons. Wait - don't those alien pillars look like something out of Sepulchure's castle? Has he always been this over the top? Either way, the inside of this thing is massive. I can't imagine the civilization that was capable of building all this. Let's take a look around through that suspiciously cut open hole in the wall. And uhh, take out any of those gross alien spiders and guards while you're at it.

quests.name: An Actual Skeleton... key?
quests.description: Looks like there's a big locked door we need to get through in the next room.. Oh, I know! Lets build a skeleton key out of skeletons and alien spider webs and see if that works! We could also use one of those super hard alien claws to sand it all down, What do you mean that's stupid? It's brilliant! Everyone knows that skeleton keys unlock any door for the area they're made in.

quests.name: Open Sesame
quests.description: Believe it or not I made a skeleton key to unlock a door before though I don't know if it worked or not. If this really doesn't work then I have a back up plan just in case so don't worry. My gut is telling me this will work though and I got to believe in my gut! That or the food I ate earlier is disagreeing with me again. Let's not think about that one, just see if the key works, alright. Oh, and can you kill some of the flyingbuggers? Call'em… ShadowStrykes. Their chompy mandibles make my stomach clench.

quests.name: Magic the Door Open
quests.description: We're going to need to find an actual way to open that door since it doesn't seem like someone is going to kick it in for us. Seems like it's not locked with an actual key though, which is probably why my skeleton key idea didn't work. Try collecting some dark magic and doom energy from the all the darkness around here. Maybe we can blast it with enough energy that it will burst open the lock's magic. Stop looking at me like I'm crazy, we have to try something and this is better than looking around for a key that may or may not exist.

quests.name: Un-Stucky!
quests.description: On the count of three get ready to throw this magic- bomb! One.. Two… What? Stop staring at me like that! Even if this doesn't work, it'll at least be fun, so come on! Try it. I know my methods are unconventional, but I swear I know what I'm doing… at least 25% of the time. Let's just try this, and we'll go with your idea if it doesn't work. Does that sound good? Great! So.. THREE!

quests.name: BOSS FIGHT!
quests.description: Ahem. There's some kind of huge alien monster glaring at us from inside, and I assume we need to get past him to get to the vault. So the plan is: you fight him while I stand over here and read through some more books for research. Come on! What are you waiting for?

quests.name: Sluagh Medals
quests.description: These ‘hunting dogs' look more like lizards from the underworld, and the Mangled Stags are no better! Get rid of these creepy animals.. and the hunters that use them in war!

quests.name: Mega Sluagh Medals
quests.description: There's a hierarchy system within the ranks of the Sluagh. It's harder to tell who has more power without anything differentiating them like Mellori. Could you check out their medals and show them to me?

items_required.name: Mega Sluagh Medals x3 (Stacks up to 300)

quests.name: Glacial Archaeology
quests.description: Just from what we discovered in the feasting hall, I can tell that the Sluagh have been hunting for ages. Their members aren't all from one place either. If you could grab pieces of their armor or horns, I could figure out where and when they came from. That way, we can come up with better strategies to route them.

quests.name: Calcium Dating
quests.description: The only talent I can show off at the moment is reading history. You can do that from books, but have you tried it on bones? It's a little gruesome but it comes with the cold territory. Everything's preserved. Get me some preserved animal bones… It could be a way to pinpoint weaknesses.

quests.name: Circling Crows
quests.description: Sluagh Mellori has returned to the snowfield. He looks like a lump of coal but I doubt setting fire to him would get him to stop. If anything, the sicko might find it fun. An interesting memory to reminisce on when he pecks through your bones for a trophy. Turn the tables on him and let's see how he feels getting stared at like a mounted set of antlers.

quests.name: Powder Snow
quests.description: Huntress Valais wants to teach us a lesson about survival. That the weak are thrown to the side. That there's only room for the strong. She should get with the times. I'm coming with you to see that through. You can't stop me. Until Valencia gets here, we'll get Valais to see the light.

quests.name: The Dawn of Lore
quests.description: We've been looking to expand the museum but first we need some more artifacts to display in it. Your first list contains relics linked to ancient civilizations. If you find anything during your travels, please bring it back to us and there'll be some gold in it for you. We need Fossilized Egg Yolks from a city in a mountain, a Stone Mask, last seen in the possession of a strangely attractive vampire, Ancient Bones from a giant, chaotic skeleton, and an Intact Golem Head from ruins now overrun by Gargoyles.

quests.name: Mystical Magics
quests.description: Magic, the lifeblood of Lore. A force so prominent that there are clear signs of its use from ages ago. Our researchers have been investigating the primitive stages of magic but are in need of more components in order to continue. Current research has given us a lead on these components, but we need you to find them for us. We need Enchanted Manuscripts, from the realm of Death, The Rite of Renewal which was stolen by the Grand Inquisitor of the Citadel, The Coven’s Sigil, used by the Witches of the Marsh, and Spell Stones from the ruined city of Gilead.

quests.name: Science Rules
quests.description: While science hasn't existed for as long as magic, its rapid developments have made it just as impressive. Like magic, our researchers have been looking into the early stages of science but have come to a roadblock. We need Supercharged Gems, found in the mountains of Thunderfang, Lightning Capacitors from a Mad Scientist's monster, A Wooden Control Panel from the Sneevil's War Machine, and then we'll need a Core of some kind.

quests.name: War: What is it Good For?
quests.description: While the Dragonoid Core is being researched, I have another task for you. As a part of the museum's expansion, we've been looking to add a section on wars throughout Lore's history. Someone of your caliber must've experienced a fair amount of them already. Would you mind visiting past battlegrounds and bringing back some keepsakes that could be displayed in the museum?

quests.name: Which Came First, the Dragon or the Dragonoid?
quests.description: Our researchers just informed me that the Dragonoid Core you found was built by the dragons themselves! To think that magical creatures once used science, who would've guessed? This has raised a question as to why dragons no longer seem to utilize any forms of technology. The Dwakel are technologically advanced and are believed to be descendents of dragons. Could you bring back some of their technology from /crashsite so we can see if there's any deeper connection?

quests.name: Artifact Hunting
quests.description: Throughout your journey you may come across objects of great power, if you can get a hold of these items, our researchers would love to study them closer. You can get the Blade of Awe from Valencia, the Supreme Arcane Staff of Arcangrove, A Destiny Weapon, or what's left of one, A Doom Weapon, and The Mirror Shield of Cornelis, shattered by the Gargoyles that now inhabit the city.

quests.name: What Does Lore Have in Store?
quests.description: This next list contains weapons and armors that once belonged to powerful combatants. Their whereabouts these days are mostly unknown, but maybe they haven't strayed too far from their birthplace. The helmet of Vaden, DeathKnight Lord of the Castle of Bone, The armor of Zular, Warden of the Djinn Gate, Fortitude and Hubris, the Balanced Blades, the armor of a Shadow Dragon Defender, thought to have been consumed by the Void, an ancient Paladin's armor. My cousin Jill'Ette's been after it for a while now, and Valoth's Cannon of Doom. Talk to the Dwakel Scavenger, wherever they are.

quests.name: Awe-scention
quests.description: Many of these treasures have been lost to time and will likely require you to undertake perilous tasks in order to retrieve them. If you do manage to find everything, then you'll be rewarded handsomely, I can assure you of that. I need the armor of Drakath, Champion of Chaos, the armor and helmet of Awethur (ask Valencia about these), The helmet of Sepulchure, the armor of an ancient DoomKnight, and the armor of renowned sellsword Bin Jett, unfortunately he was swallowed by a slimy dragon long ago.

quests.name: Bridge the Gap
quests.description: I've scouted the High Command, and it looks like the Pirates' bombs have made large gaps in the path. You'll need to break boxes for a set of nails and gather boards to get material to bridge the gaps if we're going to get the Commanders! And take out the squad of the 10 Skypirates in your way!

quests.name: Crack the Code
quests.description: You'll need to enter the door code's sequence if we're going to get in, and the keycodes could be ANYWHERE. Search through the rooms, kill the pirates… just FIND that CODE! And then input it into the panel by the door. Hurry! The more time we spend here, the more time my brother is off alone!

quests.name: Lollipop Potion
quests.description: I'm trying to come up with the ultimate lollipop margarita…umm potion. I need only the best candy there is. Underneath this houses there is a secret passageway that is full of Jack-O-Dooms that carry lollipops. Go into the passageway and grab 8 lollipops from the Jack-O-Doom. (Bring back 8 lollipops to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Mystery Candy
quests.description: There are rumours that Blister holds the ultimate candy. It is called the mystery candy. This piece of candy is very rare, because it can become any flavor that you desire. If I had my hand on a few of them I would be so happy. Can you bring me back 3 pieces of the mystery candy? (Bring back 3 pieces of mystery candy to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Can't have enough
quests.description: Wow, that mystery candy was amazing! It has all the flavors that I like in a single bite. I couldn't control myself and I ate all the ones that you brought me already. I need to have some more! Can you go and get me 5 more pieces of that delicious mystery Candy? I can't wait to have that candy again! (Bring back 5 pieces of mystery candy to complete the quest.)

quests.name: Tempest Proofing
quests.description: Twiggu's name is Twiggu! Not the 'target,' 'the bounty,' or 'the asset!' Those Tempow Sowdiers ….Tempest Sowdiers… Twiggu will say it wight one day. But those meanie Temple Sowdiers are still looking for Twiggu! Can you pwease scare them away and get wid of their weapons? You could weally huwt someone with those laser swords! You gotta be at weast thwee years old to own one!

quests.name: Liberty's Ghost
quests.description: The Fourth Spirit Lynawia saved Twiggu, but she can't leave the fortwess. She wants to test your abilities before she lets you leave, to make sure Twiggu will be safe with you. Mwiss Lynawia is waiting ahead. She was a fweedom fighter before becoming a Queen, so she's weally good with the Fourth.

quests.name: Pain-Apple!
quests.description: Oh yummy! I'm vewy vewy hungwy. I'd LOVE some applesauce to with my fishfish… it's the pewfect combination! If I eat enough, I might give you this match! Bwing me 5 Applesauce fwom the bad apples, pwease!

quests.name: Squishy Squash!
quests.description: Mmm… thewe's nothing betta than Squash Soup in the fall! Bwing me back 5 bowls of Squash Soup so I can warm my tum-tum!

quests.name: Ice Cream!
quests.description: Fish! Fish and Ice Cweam! My favowite!!! Bring back 5 bowls of Strawberry IceCream for the mostest adowablest moglin in all of Lore—That's meee, silly!

quests.name: Ring of Pain!
quests.description: Oh, thewe is nothing betta than Pineapple Wings! No, no, not "wings"… Twig meant to say… "rrrrings!" Can you bwing me 5 Pineapple Rings and I'll show you just how jummy they awe!

quests.name: Cholesterious
quests.description: Deep within the Tuwdwaken is the last of the wotten fwuit. But it's gwown into a flaky-pastwy monstwosity! Battle Cholesterious and bwing the Pie Pan to Twig as pwoof!

quests.name: Cater To His Every Dish
quests.description: Mmmm… I'm still hungwy! I hewd that some baddies make the vewwwy best food of all.. but Twig don't know who makes them! You smawt and stwong enough to figuwe it out though! Will you help fill my tummy with special Hawvest yum-yums? Twig wants a Pulled Horc Sandwich, some French Flies, a Corn Cob Web, a plate of Ratatouille, and I wanna finish it alllll off with a Chocolate Covered Beetle fow dessewt! Twig is weady to twy anything!

quests.name: Sweet Dream Collection
quests.description: For Twig to have the SWEETEST dreammm, you'll need to add fish to his icecream. Defeat the Cyborg Shark for a giant fish head so he can have the BEST TREAT!

quests.name: Twilly Supports You
quests.description: Twilly supports your adventures through Lore! But supporting heroes is hard work. Lots of enthusiasm and energy required. Shouting takes a LOT OF EFFORT! Maybe bring Twilly a sammich from the Chickencow above Cysero's Forge? It sneaks Twilly's Moglin Snax when Twilly is not looking. Sadmoglinface.

quests.name: Twilly's New Staff
quests.description: Hiyas! Twilly is happy to see a brave adventurer like you in town, because I need some help! That nasty Zorbak stole my special Staff, and I can't heal anyone without it! I can make a new one, but I need a branch from the magic Treeant on the Farm first! Can you help Twilly out? (Return to Twilly in front of Battleon once you have found a Treeant branch.)

quests.name: Hay There!
quests.description: Hiyas! Twilly need a little more help? The nights here on Battleon are cold, mostly because Twilly stands here on this stump all night. Twilly has a magic log and It will keep Cleric Joy and me warm all night long but i need some MAGIC HAY to start a fire with. The scarecrows at the farms are full of the stuff! Head East through Greenguard to the farms and bring Twilly a handful of MAGIC HAY! I'll reward you with a nice new hat!

quests.name: Got A Light
quests.description: Hiyas! Twilly's furry toes will fall off if I have to deal with one more cold Battleon night! Twilly has a magic log and magic hay but the problem is that I need something to start the fire with! I think the Dwakel Warriors in /crashsite carry some MAGIC MATCHES on them. Those should do the trick! I'd be happy to trade this magic staff for them! Be careful!

quests.name: Epic Gear Solid: Snack Eater
quests.description: Hiyas! Did you hear that? It was Twilly's tummy growling. I know, I know… it sounds like a Dragon choking on a Sneevil, but Twilly is REALLY HUNGRY! I have to stay here with Clearic Joy to greet new heroes so do you think you could grab us a snack? The Cyclops Raiders in the town of Mobius always carry the bestest PUDDING SNACKS. Bring us two PUDDING SNACKS and I'll reward you!

quests.name: Tipping the Scales
quests.description: Hiyas hero! You are just in time. Twilly has heard that Kuro, the river monster is causing trouble for all the fishermen who supply all of Greenguard forest with fresh fish! I'll make you a deal… if you deal with Kuro and bring Twilly one of his Muck Covered Scales, then Twilly will make one of the items below your reward! Your choice! You will find Kuro on the shore of the river in Southern Greenguard.

quests.name: Chest Thumping
quests.description: Hiyas hero! You are just in time. Twilly has heard that Kuro, the river monster is causing trouble for all the fishermen who supply all of Greenguard forest with fresh fish! I'll make you a deal… if you deal with Kuro and bring back the Muck Covered Chest that he carries, then Twilly will open it for you. You may find one or more of the items below and you can keep whatever you find! You will find Kuro on the shore of the river in Southern Greenguard.

quests.name: Groundhorc's Day
quests.description: General Porkon in the Horc Fort has stolen Philip, the weather predicting Groundhog! That pig-headed general doesn't understand that if Philip doesn't at least LOOK at his shadow winter will NEVER END! If you rescue him I can give you one of these GROUNDHORC DAY ONLY seasonal rares! Please go to the Horc Fort and rescue Philip!

quests.name: Construct Your Reality
quests.description: I have lost the Orb my Master gave me in order to keep this construct solid. I have seen that you will locate the Orb somewhere on this beach. Please hunt through the bushes and sand until you locate it. Once you have the Orb, your lessons may begin.

quests.name: Reach the Temple
quests.description: It is the Temple of Hope you must seek now. It is so close, can you feel it? There are those who will not want you to reach it, enemies who wish to keep you from reaching your goal. Obliterate 9 of the ninjas between here and the Temple, and you will be able to learn more about Hope.

quests.name: Not All Hope is Lost
quests.description: Inside the Library of Hope, hidden behind columns and rugs, under books, all along the beach and in the bushes. Find the 8 Orbs if you can, and then make sure to read from the Tome of Hope.

quests.name: Rune Escaped
quests.description: Our adventure begins eons ago, well before the age of social media, when epic stories of Norse deities were carved into Runestones. Should we find such a Runestone, we might uncover a clue leading to the majestic Valhalla. Perhaps the thieving Tomb Robbers of the SandSea Sandport might have something of interest hidden up their sleeves?

quests.name: Hone in on the Horn
quests.description: What a treasure the Sønder Kirkeby Runestone is! Inscribed here is a tale of Thor… and… Oh? What's this… "Follow the French Horn songs as they pour to praise the almighty Norse god Thor!" Hmm… perhaps the next Runestone is hidden in a Mythical Song place? Protected by some French Horn beastie? Use that noggin of yours and try to find the next Runestone!

quests.name: Barrier Carrier
quests.description: The Norse gods are smiling today—they have gifted us the Södermanland Runestone, hero! It tells a tale of Thor's Hammer… "CRASH in Sight! No Barrier can prevent the consistency of electricity of Thor's Hammer…" I wonder what this could mean? Perhaps the answer—and another Runestone!—is hidden in a Crash Site on some Barrier beastie?

quests.name: Thor's Fishing Tale
quests.description: This IS the Altuna Runestone! This relic tells the tale of Thor's fishing trip: "With a sea of fish from Arcangrove, angler Thor's bounty radiates an effervescent glow…" Hmmm… are there fishing spots in Arcangrove? Perhaps a gilled beast hides yet another Runestone? Hold your breath and dive on in…

quests.name: Skulls, Bones, and Runestones
quests.description: The Gosforth Runestone! Well done, hero! Let's see… "Underneath the battlefield, worry not about the restless dead, but the beast of bone and terror…" Could this be referring to Battleunder? Is there something down there that's worse than the hordes of undead?

quests.name: A Key Discovery: King with the Key
quests.description: This DOES appear to be the real Velanda Runestone! What does it say? "In a northern cave of coal and sleet, a frosty king protects the key." The northern continent is very cold. Do you know of a king who resides there? A king of… coal, or frost? Or both?

quests.name: Ultra-Carnax Challenge Fight!
quests.description: *No description*

quests.name: Ultra Twig's Gift Quest
quests.description: Twig will accept fish and ice cream in exchange for mercy… Head to /River and bring back 13 of the Zardman Fisher's catch, and 3 scoops of Kuro's finest IceCream.

quests.name: Ultra Twilly's Gift Quest
quests.description: Twilly will heal you with the giant heart hidden in his humungous chest… then plant an entire forest of trees around your /house to help heal Lore. Bring him 10 seedlings from the Treeants in /Farm to help his efforts to heal the world.

quests.name: Ultra Zorbak's Gift Quest
quests.description: Who needs undead minions when you're a one-moglin army? Not THIS MOGLIN! But it IS always nice to have fodder distract your enemies. Defeat 13 Skeletal Warriors in /Graveyard to get 13 Unwilling Minions.

quests.name: The Root of Elementals
quests.description: Building a strong, spiritual connection with the four elements is the key element for every Shaman. If you hope to obtain the Wrap of Gilead from its Protector, you must first understand each element. Let us begin with Earth, the literal root of all elements. Go forth and collect 5 Dregs Essences from the Earth Elementals who roam the ruins. Then, journey back to Arcangrove and gather 4 Seed Spitter Spirits, for they too are the epitome of Earth Elementals. Best of luck on your travels, hero.

quests.name: Eupotamic Elementals
quests.description: The Element of Water is rich in spiritual tradition. It is a necessity for most creatures that live in our world, and as such, we Shamans share a deep connection with it. Continue your elemental training by defeating enough Water Elementals to collect 5 Aqueous Essences. Afterwords, travel deep into The Natatorium and witness the manifestations of the Water Elements: Merfolk. Bring back 6 MerCores from the Merdraconians in order to complete your quest.

quests.name: Breaking Wind Elementals
quests.description: Everything that lives, breathes. Without the Element of Air, life as we know it would cease to exist. The Wind Elementals of the Ruins harness Welkin, the very essence of Air. Bring me 5 Welkin Essences from the Wind Elementals to show that you fully understand the importance of this element. When finished, head to The Cloister and confront the Karasu. Their souls belong to that of the Air Element, and if you bring me 5 of them, you will be awarded in not only Reputation, but also the priceless knowledge of this Element.

quests.name: Fighting Fire With Fire Salamanders
quests.description: Fire is one of the most powerful and dangerous elements in this world. It gives life… but just as quickly can take it away. If you find a connection with Fire, you have found a connection with the elements themselves. Are you prepared for the challenge? Deliver 5 Pyre Essences from the fiery elements in the Ruins. Then make your journey to Mudluk and bring back 5 Fire Salamanders from the Swamp Frogdrakes. If you return victorious, then you will be ready to face the Great Protector of the Wrap of Gilead.

quests.name: Guardian of the Gilead Wrap
quests.description: Now that you have studied the four elements, you are ready to uncover the element that feeds all magic: Mana. As the life force behind magic itself, the Mana Elemental resides deep within the Ruins. Guardian of the Gilead Wrap, you must first beat the Mana Elemental's puzzle in order to meet our Great Protector. Only when you defeat it will you be worthy of attaining the Wrap of Gilead. I wish you the best of luck. May the Elements be with you.

quests.name: Build a Hero Blade
quests.description: Slay the Grim Lichs to gather 3 Courage Relics and 3 Grim Ectomancers for Will Relics. Turn them in for a fragment of the blade of the Hero's Blade!

quests.name: Build a Hero Blade Hilt
quests.description: Slay the Grim Fire Mage to gather 3 Heart Relics and 3 Grim Shelletons for Will Relics. Turn them in for a fragment of the blade of the Hero's Blade!

quests.name: Underworld Weaponscrafter
quests.description: To craft the finest gear, one needs the best materials. Bring me the following items and you will have a chance to get one of my best weapons.

quests.name: Underworld Legacy Minion
quests.description: Dage the Evil will grant you 2 House Guards.. but if you want Dage's Underworld Legacy Warden, you'll need to prove you're worthy! Slay a High Legion Inquisitor in /darkwarnation to earn your reward.

quests.name: Underworld Pirate Caster's Pet Chest
quests.description: There are many dark paths to explore surrounding the river Styx in the Underworld, and a Pirate Caster must be ready to journey far enough, you'll find the dreaded guard, Cerberus. Defare him for a chance to get one of my Pirate Caster prizes.

items.name: Pirate Caster's Mask Hat Morph + Locks

quests.name: Need Things
quests.description: I need things. If you get, I give prize. Large pile of golden tickets, Sneevilchaun Gold Piece from Roy G. Biv at Rainbow, and shopping list from Sneevilchauns near Pooka. Go! Now!

dropped_by.name: A Shoemaker's Work is Never Done

quests.name: Un-fortune-ate Fountain
quests.description: All those who wish to know what doom-filled Fate is in store for them are in un-luck! I see you found a DoomCoin in the Chopping Maul. You will rewarded with a most unfortunate fortune when you bring me Sheleton Shells and DoomWood Treeant Hardwood. Their resources are… useful.

quests.name: Sea Witch's Curse Pet
quests.description: This doomed parrot was found flying around Skullpunch island. His pirate companion was trapped on the Sea Witch's Cursed ship. Defeat Fishwings in /pirates so this li'l guy can eat more than rotten berries. (Complete the quest to unlock the character page badge.)

items.name: Cursed Pirate Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Search and Destroy
quests.description: Soldier, report. We have reports of some unidentified, hostile beings reported to be seen in the /underworld. Appearance of creatures all range from large, humanoid creatures to demonic looking entities. We have identified them as Dreadfiend of Nulgath and Infernal Fiends. We have orders to take them out. Secure the area, soldier.

quests.name: Bring Me Their Arms
quests.description: Soldier, we need all available troops in the frontlines. Large amounts of strange, unknown units have been seen roaming the /underworld. We need to test their gear to find ways to counter them. Take out all units you can NOT affiliated with our commander, Dage.

quests.name: Pest Control
quests.description: Soldier, report! Scouts in the area have told us of a few small, round creatures blocking the surrounding area. Exterminate them so we may continue our work. We may upgrade your weapon selection if yours seems to become dull or we believe you could use something more efficient and effective.

quests.name: Gobbling Globlins
quests.description: The exit of the Labyrinth is nearby. Today, we'll be using it as an entrance. Head west down the hill and you'll find it. There used to be doors, but I didn't see them when I passed by. Time must have weathered them away. That might be why these Globlins are all over the place. They spilled out of the Labyrinth. Let's clear them away before they snack on our ankles.

quests.name: Flowers for Forever
quests.description: The Labyrinth was built by the Goblin King to protect his often invaded and exploited people. That man has been my Hero for decades, and I can't wait to meet him when we return. Say, I noticed carriages on our way to the Labyrinth. Are they here to see the King too? And they've brought such lovely white flowers. Would you mind 'borrowing' a few and talking with Zenobia? Maybe I missed a memo on the custom.

quests.name: A Memory's Shadow
quests.description: I don't expect the elves to be too deep into the Labyrinth, so hopefully, we won't need Don Fernando's guidance like I did. The path just beyond the entrance forks in three directions. I need time to gather our bearings. From what I remember, this area is safe…minus these awful Shadow creatures. They're extremely dangerous - we will need to fight them off quickly.

quests.name: Behind the Bones
quests.description: I've had enough time to gather my bearings and I have to say, all three routes at the fork in the road could lead to certain doom! Aha, but that won't deter us! We should head straight down the middle path. I hear the most noise coming from there. Monstrous noises, and…the clashing of steel! We need to get moving, and rescue any elves we find along the way. Fight off the Screamons threatening them!

quests.name: Peek-a-Bones
quests.description: Don Fernando wandered off, hopefully to find rest, but that leaves General Brom to roam without the guidance of a map. Zenobia and I aren't sure which direction he took off in. Why don't we head back to the junction and try the rightmost path? We'll look for Brom and rescue the rest of the elves. The place is crawling with Screamons. Hope you won't mind kicking more of them to the curb?

quests.name: Extreme Exfoliation
quests.description: See those white patches all over this watering hole? Zenobia and I hope they're cobwebs, but we should take a closer look. Collect those…things and we'll know for sure. While you're at it, I'm curious about these wandering reanimated skeletons. Unlike Don Fernando, they aren't listening to reason or my songs.

quests.name: Easy Pickings
quests.description: The lost Tieregnon elves would be easy pickings for Vi'eel Dreaddacovra. There's one last path we haven't taken. We'll head back to the junction and take the leftmost path. Rescue the remaining elves and protect them from the Shadow Demons. They're becoming more agitated; jumping at the slightest sign of movement. My songs might have something to do with it.

quests.name: On Deaf Ears
quests.description: At the end of the leftmost path, General Artoriaus Brom and his soldiers are being menaced by the vile snake, Vi'eel Dreaddacovra. It's an intelligent beast, one that makes lies as white and as dangerous as its massive body. Back them into a corner, and don't try to reason with it! Snakes have bad hearing anyways, but that's besides the point. Good luck!

quests.name: Neurocranium in a Haystack
quests.description: If we're lucky, then we'll find Don Fernando in the Labyrinth. Except, the maze is huge! It would be like looking for a needle in a haystack. Or rather a, what's a bone that starts with the letter N? A neurocranium in a haystack. That's it! Zenobia and I will focus on the search while you keep the Screamons, Globlins, and Shadow Demons at bay.

quests.name: Burning Skeleman
quests.description: We need to return to the Goblin City as soon as possible. Head through its gates and find Don Fernando. General Brom and his men have already returned and are doing their part in protecting the city. While we're on the way, can you and Zenobia collect bones from the possessed skeletons? I know a ritual that can ward away the Shadow Demons, and we'll need effigies of what we all currently fear the most.

quests.name: With the Power
quests.description: "Kill the Beast" is a song, a festival, and a ritual all in one! We make effigies of our fears, march them through the street, burn them, and sing our hearts out. That proves that we can overcome our fears. I know it will work, but we need you to buy time. We're counting on you to fight Don Fernando, and keep him at bay until Zenobia and I finish the ritual.

quests.name: Light Midnight
quests.description: Before we get cooking, why don't we go on a stroll through town and the woods outside? The mountains are filled with monsters of course, but the magic lanterns we hang on the trees keep them at bay. At worst, we'll run into some ornery deer. Let's relight any that went out while we're there.

quests.name: Actaeon Stew
quests.description: I don't mind jerky but when I'm home, I avoid eating anything close to spelunking rations. Fresh venison stew has been on my mind since I got back. It's late, I know, but night hunts should be perfectly safe with you.

quests.name: Vain Howl
quests.description: I'm going to look closer at the deer carcasses. Don't share the news just yet. Everyone's still on edge about the wind storm. Could you hunt down those strange spiky horned creatures too? Maybe they have something to do with this.

quests.name: Holle's Meal
quests.description: The meat's not right. Let's make something else so Jack's son, Reggie, can eat before it's too late. He was looking at a couple recipes Triss was interested in. Spare a few minutes to chat with him? Poor kid gets antsy when his dad's out for too long. Be wary of the deer too. I'm not liking how they're slowly creeping into town.

quests.name: The Hidden One
quests.description: Trissa and Jack have been gone for too long. I have an idea of where they went. Come meet me at the edge of the forest. You've probably seen that rickety staircase, right? Brace yourself. For that and the hounds. They're getting aggressive.

quests.name: Mount Otzi's Stones
quests.description: The creepy deers and hounds are chasing after us. I'll come out and help you ward them off. When they're cleared out, I need to examine those rocks outside. I didn't think much of them before, but the wind storm blew off the excess ice. There's a hunch I have.

quests.name: Faceless Hunters
quests.description: I hear footsteps in the dark. It looks like the masters of this feasting hall have returned. They actually seem excited to get into a tussle with intruders. Or well, you. Talk to Jack to get up to speed about what these warriors might be. Then grab me their helmets after you trounce them. We could learn something.

quests.name: Stitch Work
quests.description: The pelts and horns on the wall look shoddily maintained. You'd think these proud hunters would take care of their trophies. Hmm, take that, the busted door, the mess on the tables into account…I'm theorizing that there was a change in leadership. Could you do me a favor and grab some of those freaky deer? There's a workspace for pelt skinning and cooking at the end of the hall too. Let's investigate.

quests.name: Killer Promotion
quests.description: Give me a boost up to those hunting trophies. I wanted to leave them alone until we had the proper tools to preserve them but this is an emergency. If those Sluagh try to get at us, give them a good kick.

quests.name: Cold Pleasures
quests.description: We've been exercising a lot more caution than I'm used to. I'm worried about Trissa but I don't want you or Jack to get lost either. Thanks to your efforts, I think we can push through the remaining Sluagh and make it to the Leader's den.

quests.name: Corvus Mellori
quests.description: The Sluagh are far more charming as ice mummies. One finally talks to us and they don't even bother to introduce themselves. Well, it saves us more time for our holiday. When you're done beating him, I'd like to get a sucker punch in.

quests.name: 1st Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 1st Chaos Beast in /hydra and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 2nd Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 2nd Chaos Beast in /roc and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 3rd Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 3rd Chaos Beast in /Odokuro and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 4th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 4th Chaos Beast in the /chaoscave and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 5th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 5th Chaos Beast in /palooza and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 6th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 6th Chaos Beast in /elemental and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 7th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 7th Chaos Beast in /Sandcastle and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 8th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 8th Chaos Beast in /orecavern and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 9th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 9th Chaos Beast in /deepchaos and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 10th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 10th Chaos Beast in /venomvaults and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 11th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 11th Chaos Beast in /mirrorportal and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: 12th Chaos Beast
quests.description: Slay the 12th Chaos Beast in /castleroof and a trophy of your victory will appear in the museum!

quests.name: Helping Hands for Armors
quests.description: Providing the highest quality armor is a Swordhaven standard. But I require the proper materials, all of which can be harvested within our kingdoms. Patrol our beautiful courtyards and retrieve:

quests.name: Missing Hand Towels
quests.description: What in the world? There used to be a plethora of gold knockers glittering on the walls of Swordhaven Castle. But now, there's just the pair on the pillars flanking the stairway to the roof! You're asking what they're supposed to be for? Are you daft? Of course they're meant to hold hand towels! So the royalty and nobles keep clean! Blimey, the hand towels went missing too! Don't just stand there! Find them!

items_required.name: Dirty Hand Towel x1 (Stacks up to 2)

quests.name: Blood Moon Badge
quests.description: Bring me the heart of a Dire Wolf from Darkovia's Forest. I dream, sometimes, of tasting blood. And that would be very, VERY satisfying.

quests.name: Simple Orphium Blade
quests.description: So, you're interested in learning to use psionic weapons, eh? I forge them from Orpheum ore. Bring me enough to make a simple blade, and I'll craft one for you to train with.

quests.name: Try the Blade
quests.description: Now that you've got a psionic blade, let's go try it out! Start out by using it to fight a few Nightmare Skulls. They're a major pest, but they're not so dangerous that you'll die if you mess up. Get out there and fight—and let me know how it goes.

quests.name: Get the Wyrms
quests.description: You up for trying something a little tougher now? Outside the city, there are Nightwyrms that hide in the ground and burst through when someone walks above them. They're a danger to our citizens, and the city would be grateful if you got rid of them for us. Now that you know how to use your new blade, I think you'll stand a chance.

Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet's.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet's Quest

location.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet

npc.name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Dragon Quest Pet

quests.name: Black Friday 2023 Collection
quests.description: As summer ends, the nights grow colder and longer. Experienced heroes know the night is dark and full of terror… but YOU can defy that. In honor of Black Friday, defeat the Stymphmalion Terror or Dread Phoenix in /towerofdoom8 and earn your Black Friday 2023 character page badge.

items.name: Black Friday 2023 Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Defeat the Minions
quests.description: We've blocked off the throne room, but it's crawling with the Shadowlord's minions down here, too! You will have to defeat them before we can move on.

quests.name: Gather the Gunpowder
quests.description: That cave in you found must have happened when we broke through the castle - I guess it shook up the castle a lot more than we realized. We'll have to find a way to get past it. If you had enough gunpowder, you could blast your way out. You could get some from the Shadow Gunners nearby.

quests.name: Build a Bomb
quests.description: Now we'll need a fuse and some flame. The Shadow Mages carry torches, and all of the shadow minions are wearing cloth we could tear apart.

quests.name: Light 'em Up!
quests.description: Now all that's left is to light the fuse.

quests.name: Fight the Shadows
quests.description: It's not any safer past the cave-in - the area is crawling with feral shadow minions! Fight them back so that we can continue.

quests.name: Magical Potion
quests.description: The portal is down here somewhere. I can feel it. It must be hidden within the shadows. Fight the Shadow Mages and take their potions of shadow sight. This will allow you to see where it's hidden.

quests.name: Overload the Energy Field
quests.description: We've found the portal, but a dark energy field is blocking our path. If you collect some of the stray energy nearby, you may be able to overload it.

quests.name: Defeat the Portal Guards
quests.description: It looks like Malgor keeps the portal guarded - and its guards got trapped in here after the cave-in. Now they're angry, and they aren't going to let us through until we've defeated them.

quests.name: Go Through the Portal
quests.description: Now, go through the portal, and meet me on the other side.

quests.name: Zorbak's Hideout
quests.description: Locate Zorbak in his Hideout to get more information on Vordred!

quests.name: Lost Memories
quests.description: I need you to find my lost Journal. I've looked for it but I always get lost in that place. Maybe you'll have better luck in there. Bring it to me if you find it.

quests.name: Remembering...
quests.description: There are several pages missing from my old journal. It's useless without them. I think something might be trying to keep me in the dark. Check the monsters on the first level of Bludrut for all 8 missing pages.

quests.name: A Personal Effect
quests.description: I can't believe I could have ever forgotten Veddris! I… left her. Now she's calling to me for help from beyond the grave. We need an anchor… a personal item of hers. Check the monsters of the 2nd FLOOR of Bludrut for Veddris's Ring. We can use that to make a connection.

quests.name: The Unintentional Tomb
quests.description: She is using her energy to direct us to her remains. Somewhere on the 2nd Floor there is a room that is not on the map. It should be easy to find because it has a Gold Frame around the door. Locate the room and return to me. I'll prepare the communication ritual.

quests.name: The Spirit Speaks
quests.description: I came a little unprepared for all of this. I need several materials for the ritual that I did not bring but I think you can find all of them on the monsters on the first and second floors of the Bludrut. Once you have them all please head back to me.

quests.name: Unseen Monsters
quests.description: Whatever is in there with my Veddris wants out. We have to find a way to free her without freeing It. You have to find It's lair. On the 3rd FLOOR there should be another room that's not on the map. It will probably look like a large crack in the wall. See if you can find it.

quests.name: Stop IT!
quests.description: I've prepared a balm that will allow you to see It. That will enable you to destroy It. I will stay here and keep an energy chant going to keep it trapped. Head back to IT's lair and destroy that thing.

quests.name: Sad Farewells
quests.description: Now that IT is gone, my sister will be able to move on. Head back to the room on the 2ND FLOOR where my twin's remains can be found. I will meet you there.

quests.name: Ectoamber
quests.description: Most ghosts are made from Ectoplasm. It's normally very loose and gooey but it can be solidified into a substabce called Ectoamber that no ghost can pass through. Bring me 10 Ectoplasm Sample from Rattlebones' and I will give you some Ectoamber.

quests.name: Screamwave
quests.description: One of the weapons I can use to defend myself from spirits is called a Screamwave. I need 5 Bottled Siren Wails to adjust untill they can create a soundwave that can damage and repel ghosts. Bring me 5 Bottled Siren Wails and I'll use them to make a Screamwave.

quests.name: Spiril Ward Sigil
quests.description: I know an arcane method for creating a Spirit Ward Sigil which will drive most weak spirits away but I need one of Groglurk's Talons to create it. Bring me one and I'll craft it into a Spirit Ward Sigil for you.

quests.name: Makai's Anonymous
quests.description: To crush all anti-loyalty sentiments, we have to hit the Makai hard and then offer a hand once they're beat. Maybe even provide a new leader, one we are less likely to kill. Before anything, we must finally force the Makai off our backs, and establish Nulgath's dominance.

quests.name: The Riches of Rebellion
quests.description: It never hurts to defend against another anarchy-induced uprising. Take a minute to beat up any menacing Makai and I'll grab you a worthy set of rewards from the underworld.

quests.name: Uncontrollable Anarchy
quests.description: Any attempts at pleading with the Dark Makai that finding a new leader is more important than revenge have failed. I fear force is the only way to knock sense back to their brains. Restrain the 5 Makai faction leaders so I may reason with them and save our way of life.

quests.name: Fighting with Fear
quests.description: This uprising has made the mourning Makai stubborn and simple headed. The only way to force the uprising out is to scare my people into submission. Since we lack the manpower to accomplish this, maybe a bluff is our key to victory. If you can swipe enough personal items from Lore's leaders, we can convince the Dark Makai others have allied against them.

quests.name: Dragon's Gauntlet
quests.description: The beasts here are chaorrupted by a powerful spirit. They've been attempting to charge at Akiba but I've managed to push them back here. We'll have to defeat them and hope that they come back to their senses. Are you ready?

items_required.name: Black Tortoise Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 6)
White Tiger Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 6)
Red Bird Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 6)
Blue Dragon Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 6)

quests.name: Nauthiz - Realized
quests.description: You'll help me out? Or do you get something out of this? Whatever the case, I want to learn more about Gramiel. Both when he was the Grandmaster, and when he was a Celestial. If you look into that and the Draconians, I'll pay you back. I always do.

quests.name: Nauthiz - Realized (Legend)
