quests.description: You'll help me out? Or do you get something out of this? Whatever the case, I want to learn more about Gramiel. Both when he was the Grandmaster, and when he was a Celestial. If you look into that and the Draconians, I'll pay you back. I always do.

quests.name: Restless Roves
quests.description: Before I can allow you entry, the Fallen Darkbloods around us wish to test you. They loathe the idea of outsiders discovering their despised ancestor. Prove that your power is absolutely necessary by dueling them.

items_required.name: Darkblood Horn Chunk x9 (Stacks up to 45)

quests.name: Vile Valdostana
quests.description: The Darkdweller must not be allowed freedom. Escape will bring turmoil and bloodshed to both the Darkbloods and the Hollowborn. Help me reshackle the prisoner, and quell his ambitions once more.

quests.name: Sleeping Diana
quests.description: If we're actually going to Castle Bocklin, we need to do something about the knights guarding you. What!? Brittany's going to cover for us? She'll just rat us out if we talk to her! And what's this beef jerky for? Playfighting with the wolves? Huh…

quests.name: At the Edge of the Forest
quests.description: Brittany and the wolves have the Knights occupied. We'll run into the woods while she covers for us. Watch out for the spiders in there. They get hungry in spring, so try not to scream. Oh? Breaking out your hammer again? Special occasion, huh.

quests.name: Freedom Helvetia
quests.description: Why are there Sp-eyes infesting the woods around the castle? Are these from the Shadowscythe? We need to shoot them down, and figure out where they came from before we go. Maybe they're connected to the blackmailer.

quests.name: Sacred Grove
quests.description: The carriage Brittany arranged for us is waiting in the woods. It'll take us to Castle Bocklin in Chiral Valley. I haven't been that far before, which will make it hard to find clues about who we're dealing with. There has to be something around…

quests.name: Chained Prometheus
quests.description: Castle Bocklin belongs to House Vaughn, but it was abandoned after the Rebellion. The Garde Grifs must have been their attack beasts before they were left behind. You fought them before, right? Hmph! I can handle them too.

quests.name: Ride of Death
quests.description: Mom! Do you hear that shuffling? That's the sound of Undead dragging their feet through the grass. We walked right into a trap, and need to fight our way out of it! Get your hammer ready! I'll cover you with my arrows.

quests.name: The Fall and Death
quests.description: These Undead don't want to rest. We destroyed their physical bodies, but their ghosts are coming back for round two. I can keep up! You're the one they're after, mom. I think they recognize you from the days of the Rebellion.

quests.name: Ruins in Moonlight
quests.description: Wait a second, I just saw a kid run outside of Castle Bocklin's ruins. Did he get lost? Let's talk to him, and look around for more clues. Maybe we can learn more about the blackmailer, and if they're the ones who raised the dead.

quests.name: Wandering Light
quests.description: The Undead and Wraiths are starting to gather again, and they're moving to deliberately surround us. Where's the Necromancer giving them orders? Unless…they're doing this on their own. We need to slay them, and protect that kid!

quests.name: Death Plays the Fiddle
quests.description: Finally! The Necromancers show their faces. If we take them down, that'll make clearing the ruins a lot easier. It's just that…I don't know. My gut's telling me something's wrong.

quests.name: Talk to Ravinos
quests.description: I've got your back, but Ravinos knows you better than he knows me. You have a history with him. You're the one who can convice him to help us, if anyone can. Talk to him, explain the situation, make him understand how dire it is. Get his help.

quests.name: Odd's 'n' Ends
quests.description: It takes a lot to stock an odds and ends shop. But one thing we always need is are locks and keys. Those sneevils are awful thieves. Bring me metal ore from the Sneevils in /boxes and I'll fabricate them myself.

Vindicator Naval Commander's Quest Pet's.name: Vindicator Naval Commander's Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Dark Seas Collection Quest Pet
quests.description: Th' Ghostly Eels have been after yer sailin' snacks. Everyone knows a stalwart sailor needs enough fuel to keep th' cannons booming. Hunt ye down some Unagi from the Eels in Twilight Slums or Lowtide and ye'll earn a character page badge.

items.name: Dark Seas Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Canto IV
quests.description: The vanguard consists of the Limbo Guards, soldiers and warriors who had perished before there was any real structure to the Underworld. With no purpose in their unlives, they offer their services to guard the entrance of the Seven Circles. They won't be the strongest enemy you face here, but don't take them lightly.

quests.name: Canto V
quests.description: It appears that the Guards of Luxuria have fallen under their spell. All those that come in contact with Luxuria must have a strong will to overcome the urges that they breed. Whether it be a lust for power, happiness, or pleasure, they control it all. Those urges are like the wind that emanates from this circle. The urges may start as a gentle breeze, nice and pleasant, but can quickly turn into an overwhelming gale, tossing you off your intended path. Free these Guards from this wind, and grant them peace.

quests.name: Gone With the Wind
quests.description: Luxuria's winds are too strong for us to move forward. But the Guards aren't being blown away… They must possess certain auras that allow them to move freely. Looks like we will need to gain possession of these auras as well. The Limbo Guards seem to have an Aura of Power, the Luxuria Guards have an Aura of Pleasure, and both types of Guards have a faint Aura of Happiness. If we collect enough of each of them, it should be enough to get past these winds.

quests.name: Lest Ye Be Destroyed
quests.description: You have seen what Luxuria can do to those who are not fully aware of their strength. Do not underestimate them. Keep your guard up while you will come out victorious. Stay strong, Hero.

quests.name: Canto VI
quests.description: The Guard of Gluttony is unlike any other guard in the Circles. It can not be defeated with just normal combat. You must also outsmart the creature, otherwise it will never stop hunting its prey down. I have a plan, however. Collect three large piles of mud from this Circle. I'll explain later.

quests.name: Heckhound
quests.description: I have filled the Guard's mouth with the mud you collected. That should hinder it enough that once you defeat it, it will no longer pursue us. You must defeat it quickly before it is able to spit all of the mud out.

quests.name: Glutton for Punishment
quests.description: Gluttony is just up ahead. Be careful. He will not take kindly to visitors. He will attempt to exploit your urge to indulge in the fight and you will feel like you want it to last forever. Do not overindulge in your combat and end the fight quickly. There is no need to face him longer than required, regardless of what he may make you believe.

quests.name: Canto VII
quests.description: You have made it to the last Circle of this section of the prison. Avarice resides here, and conquering him will be no easy task. First, we will have to take care of his Guards. Show them the strength you have shown all of their comrades that came before them.

quests.name: Greed the Room
quests.description: I can see Avarice's spell starting to take hold of you. We must lessen its effects before you face him. Take the spell's effects on you out on the Guards here. Fighting each type of Guard should satisfy the urge for now. Once you are done, then you should face Avarice immediately.

quests.name: Ava-risky Business
quests.description: Avarice will be the most deadly in combat that you have faced so far. He will trick you into getting greedy with your strikes, thinking you can get a few more in before you must go on the defensive. Do not let him fool you. Trust your initial instincts, and treat it like a normal fight. If you strike one too many, you will find yourself quickly defeated while your guard is down.

quests.name: Prove Your Worth
quests.description: Fetch me the water of the Cactus Creeper and the meat of the Golden Scarab to prove you are worthy of this Kalestri Worshipper alliance.

quests.name: Still Not Impressed?
quests.description: Smash open these Kalestri vases, so you may see the true value of my people.

quests.name: A Prickly Situation
quests.description: It will take weeks to reach the pyramid's end if these Cacti and their thorns continue to block our path. De-thorn these vermin, peasant!

quests.name: Beetle Battle Armor
quests.description: Even a four-handed Heroine needs a way to protect herself! Fetch me the armor of the Golden Scarab so we may continue.

quests.name: Pyramid Pilgrimage
quests.description: We must be prepared for a long journey, I demand more cactus water and scarab meat to keep my energy high.

quests.name: Blood in the Sand
quests.description: It appears your carnage on the last 5 floors has attracted unwanted guests. Wash away these wannabe sharks before they waste you.

quests.name: Defeat Tribal Traitors
quests.description: It appears even my own people have fallen to chaos' pull. Cleanse my sisters of this chaos before the disease spreads.

quests.name: Marking The Territory
quests.description: Monsters respawn here as if they've been programmed to. Lay a beacon in each of the past rooms to preserve our terrifying presence

quests.name: Raiders of the Lost Artifact
quests.description: Even in the most sacred of realms, robbers still need to learn a lesson. Maybe I suggest the lyric: "Another One Bites the Dust" as a teaching tool?

quests.name: Surviving the Swarms
quests.description: Those unsacred SandSharks seem to travel in packs just waiting for their prey to misstep. Place trackers on these monsters so we may avoid their next onslaught.

quests.name: The Legend of Eldo
quests.description: Hero, hearken to my words: The oldest of the Kalestri worshipers, Eldo, once found it good fortune to burst merchant pots. While these vases are the only thing available, we need all the fortune we can get.

quests.name: There's No Point
quests.description: This Pyramid was once a center of beauty, a home for all my tribe to enjoy. Now it reeks of monsters, and despair. Please banish these monsters, so this room will again be recognizable.

quests.name: Trail of Naan Crumbs
quests.description: Unlike human fairytales, the brave warrior children Hanseif and Gretellia used Naan crumbs as a guide home after ferocious battles. I suggest we do the same.

quests.name: Tricky Trip Wires
quests.description: It seems that someone has remodeled all the pyramid's booty traps. No matter, bring me an updated map off a corrupted Worshipper. We must avoid these annoyances, regardless of the fun I had setting the originals up.

quests.name: Shooing Away Scarabs
quests.description: I can't tell if my next step will be sand or scarab. Please help keep my feet beetle free with a little pest control.

quests.name: Humor is Close to the Heart
quests.description: Before we make it to the heart of this pyramid, I feel as if I need to teach you a lesson. Scarab riding was my favorite game as a child, watch and learn two-hander.

quests.name: Purple is Not Your Color
quests.description: It seems treasure is not the only motive for these robbers, it's time to take part in this pyramid's buy one get one free deal by kicking out and cleansing these chaorrupted crooks.

quests.name: All Alone
quests.description: I fear I have not been entirely straightforward with you, friend. You see, I did not disobey traditions coming here as there was no one left to disobey. I am the last of the Kalestri Worshipers free of chaos's control. Maybe in the afterlife, their souls will be free once more. Unfortunately that is our only hope.

quests.name: Beginning of the End
quests.description: I thank you, Hero for this entire journey. I began this expecting, no, hoping to hate you. Maybe if you despised me, the final chamber would not be so difficult. I'm afraid to say I can't hate you, friend, I apologize for what must come next. Please break these vases until you find a suitable Kalestri weapon.

quests.name: The Ultimate Sacrifice
quests.description: In order to break the lock of Kalestri's most sacred treasure, one of her own is needed in return. My life does not matter, no individual life does. As the last member capable of sacrifice, my survival means death to this world. Bring me the blade of one of Kalestri's Worshippers, and … it will be done.

quests.name: Champion Token Collection
quests.description: Battle the Heroes to get their tokens, then turn them in at the Tournament Merge Shop to unlock gear!

quests.name: Malgor, The First Speaker
quests.description: Malgor, your First Speaker, wishes to wipe Lore clean. Again. Would you be so kind as to talk some sense into him?

quests.name: The Goddess of War
quests.description: My sovereign, you have a divine piece of equipment with you. If you’d like, I can bring out its true power and potential.

quests.name: Radiant Goddess of War Badge
quests.description: You have silenced The First Speaker and forged a new age for Lore. Bring me a Licorice Scale from the Mainyu, and I will reward you with a character page badge.

items.name: Radiant Goddess Of War Character Page Badge

quests.name: Slain Children
quests.description: Shades of my Children stand in your way. Do you have what it takes to strike them down once more? Do it. Show me what kind of monster you are.

quests.name: Void Commander's Badge
quests.description: In the war to win eternity, the Void Commanders are one of pinnacles of Nulgath's creations. Display your skill by defeating one of the Lightguard Paladins in /Voidrefuge and you may be permitted to join them, and will earn the Void Commander character page badge.

items.name: Void Commander Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Void HighLord's Challenge
quests.description: So. You've come to join MY ranks? Hah. Let's see what you've got, kid. IF you're up to it, you'll be able to craft a Void HighLord class without breaking a sweat. Get to it.

quests.name: A-Void-ing The Larva
quests.description: My Larva brethren will not understand my alliance with you. You are an outsider in this world, and the Void Larva will see you as a threat--rather, a meal. If you wish to prove your worth to me, and ultimately save your friend, you must go forth and collect 10 Larva Tarsus from the Void Larva. I will be watching.

quests.name: Spawn Point
quests.description: I want to further study your techniques. When Void Larva evolve, we become powerful Void Elementals. I will inform you on how to enter The Great's lair if you can defeat enough Void Elementals to obtain 8 Spawn Pronotums. Go now.

quests.name: Null and Void Spheres
quests.description: Are you ready to unlock The Great Void Dragon's chamber door? As I stated before, the closest element to Void in your world is Chaos. The Great has entrusted the 4 Void Spheres with the most powerful Chaos beings in Lore. You will need to find the Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow Void Spheres that are hidden somewhere in Lore.

quests.name: Enter the Great Void Dragon's Lair
quests.description: The time has come. Take these Void Spheres and head to the heart of The Void. If you can open the door to the Great Void Dragon's lair, you may be able to recover your beloved friend. But I cannot guarantee what you will find behind said door. It may already be too late.

quests.name: Void Witch's Summoning Quest
quests.description: The power contained in this orb was brought forth from Darkness, and can only be renewed by Darkness. Once it is at full power, you will be able to call forth one of the darkest, most powerful creatures on this world… and others. Collect all of the Void Spheres to complete this spell:

quests.name: Void Shogun Farming Quest
quests.description: You fight fire with fire, and shadows with… even deadlier Shadows. I see you are a skilled warrior. Your victories against the Shogun of Shadows have caught my Master's interest. He has a gift for you… IF you are worthy enough to take it.

quests.name: Drowning in the Void
quests.description: Nulgath says: So I heard the Legion and Nation created a kind of havoc when I was sent to Oversoul and a forbidden love allowed a new breed to rise, the VoidCaster. Minion, the Legion's powers originated from MY CONTRACT and you shall forever deny the fact you think you are a Legion member from that pity we call Dage the Evil. Bring the reagents I need and maybe we can try out this new breed that was possible due to a common and logical source.

Voidfiend Symbiote Sword Quest Pet's Que.name: Voidfiend Symbiote Sword Quest Pet's Quest

quests.name: Void Symbiote Blade's Quest
quests.description: Tercessuinotlim is an evil place, full of shadowy energies. That must be what allows this blade to levitate. To keep it empowered, slay a Dark Makai to steal its energy, and you'll reap the rewards!

quests.name: Soul Dealer
quests.description: Welcome, Hero. I have a quest for you… if you're brave enough to accept it. Bring me 50 Undead Energy, the Warrior Claymore Blade, from the Undead Berserker, and the Dark Crown Axe from a Doomwood Treant. Do this, and I shall reward you well.

quests.name: Twisted Trust
quests.description: To create gear for you… I require resources. If you wish to earn my Unitas Fragments to purchase items, retrieve one of the Burn it Down staves and recover Escherion's Robes. Do this, and I will reward you well.

quests.name: Skull and Bones
quests.description: You've heard of secret societies and Legions of the undead? None of those here. But what I DO have for you is the promise of Unity. IF you can bring me 28 pirate skulls. Do not ask why.

quests.name: Legendary Unity
quests.description: I value loyalty and unity. There are two things every lord needs to rule. … Do you have them? Yes? Good. Prove it. Bring me a Bone Axe and a Helm of the Dark Lord and I will reward you well.

quests.name: Level 1
quests.description: Cruel Death, thief of days, takes the price you will not pay. Using what you hate the most in a neverending slaughter. What child of mine meets its end when it first encounters water?

quests.name: Level 2
quests.description: I am both hard and soft. I give heat and run from it. I am engaged in an all-consuming activity, living off my own energy and, when I am finished, I will die. What am I?

quests.name: Level 3
quests.description: From stones comes fire. From fire, dust. Black is red, and red is white. Before taking, seek you must. I am gathered where you lack sight.

quests.name: Level 4
quests.description: I am that which will not burn nor drown.

quests.name: Level 5
quests.description: The more you have of it, the less you see. Fire is its enemy. Tell me quick, what could it be?

quests.name: Level 6
quests.description: All about, but cannot be seen, can be captured, cannot be held, turning candle into conflagration.

quests.name: Level 7
quests.description: It cannot be seen, but weighs nothing, but when put into a barrel, it makes it lighter. Fire cannot consume me, but smoke will escape me. What is it?

quests.name: Level 8
quests.description: A box without hinges, lock or key, yet golden treasure lies within. Fire will can cook its inside without leaving a mark on its outside. What is it?

quests.name: Level 9
quests.description: One by one we fall from heaven down into the depths of past. And our world is ever upturned so that yet some time we'll last. Remove from our captivity, fire turn us into prison-glass.

quests.name: Level 10
quests.description: What has root that nobody sees, is taller than trees, full of liquid inside, but have no doubt that all of it will become stone without.

quests.name: Level 11
quests.description: People need me but they always give me away. They have to me to burn, but if they did, they would be left with nothing. What am I?

quests.name: Level 12
quests.description: What goes round the house and in the house but never touches the house, is made of fire but will never burn the house?

quests.name: Level 13
quests.description: What appears at night, burns with the light, but never catches on fire?

quests.name: Level 14
quests.description: What goes round and round the wood but never goes into the wood, can be burned off and leaves its body unharmed?

quests.name: Level 15
quests.description: What can live in a fire, then goes into water red and comes out black?

quests.name: Level 16
quests.description: What kind of room has no windows or doors and when set on fire becomes food?

quests.name: Level 17
quests.description: I can run but not walk. Wherever I go, thought follows close behind. I turn red in both heat and cold. What am I?

quests.name: Level 18
quests.description: Iron roof, glass walls

quests.name: Level 19
quests.description: I'm the source of all emotion, but I'm caged in a white prison. It can burn or turn to ice depending on who you are talking to.

quests.name: Level 20
quests.description: The heart of the volcano has come to life, magma solidified into a soldier's form. Servant of Xan, enemy to those who would extinguish his power.

quests.name: Hai Kyuute!! Collection
quests.description: Absolute Zero in /dragonkoi TOOK YOUR volleyball! Defeat him to get it back and you'll earn a character page badge and one of many house item prizes for your Bareboru house.

items.name: Hai Kyuute!! Collection Character Page Badge

quests.name: Survive Frankenwerepire
quests.description: If you think you can zurvive my latest creation, ze Frankenwerepire, zen you are zadly miztaken! He vill CRUZH you!

quests.name: Survive Ultra Frankenwerepire
quests.description: If you think you can zurvive my biggezt, baddezt, MOZT DEZTRUCTIVE creation, ze ULTRA Frakenwerepire, zen you are zadly mistaken! He vill CRUZH you!

quests.name: Pirate Hat
quests.description: Earn 5 cursed doubloons by battling monsters during the event. Turn them in for a Pirate hat!

quests.name: Pirate Cutlass
quests.description: Earn 15 cursed doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for an Undead Pirate Cutlass!

quests.name: Undead Pirate's Guitar
quests.description: Earn 25 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for an Undead Pirate's Guitar.

quests.name: Holy Scuba Gear
quests.description: Earn 35 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for the Holy Scuba Gear!

quests.name: Deep Diver Helmet
quests.description: Earn 20 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Deep Diver Helmet!

quests.name: Braken Bass
quests.description: Earn 25 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Braken Bass!

quests.name: Ghost Ship in a Bottle
quests.description: Earn 15 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Ghost Ship in a Bottle!

quests.name: Trident of Storms
quests.description: Earn 40 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Trident of Storms!

quests.name: Fishy Guitar
quests.description: Earn 25 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Fishy Guitar!

quests.name: Fishbone Head
quests.description: Earn 20 Doubloons by battling monsters during the event, and turn them in for a Fishbone Head!

quests.name: Exit, Stage Right
quests.description: It's not stage-fighting these varmints are interested in! They are gunning for you, and they've got six-shooters in hand to finish the job! If you want to escape with your life, you'll need to find a escape route, pronto! Search the room for a way to exit that isn't rushing at them like a charging bull

quests.name: The Wedge
quests.description: You've got your escape route all planned out, but it looks like that bad-news boss is right in your way! What's worse, the gap is too small to squeeze through. Lets see if any of these old coots in this place are hanging onto something useful. Like a crowbar. Bring back one Rusty Crowbar

quests.name: Freedom?
quests.description: Whoever built this wall sure did a fine piece of work; I haven't seen such a sturdy build-job since… well… ever! But if you're going to get out of here, you'll have to use the crowbar to widen that crack enough so that your britches can slide on through.

quests.name: Other Ideas?!
quests.description: Keep calm and battle on. The saloon just HAS to have another exit, and you're going to find it! I saw some boxes in the storage room. They might just have something you can use.

quests.name: Got a Light
quests.description: Where there's a gleam, there's gold, and since those bullies were able to bulldoze them into giving you more help? See if one of them might happen to have a match on hand.

quests.name: BADABOOM!
quests.description: We'll give those blowhards cause to have a blow-up, and it's not a fit of anger I'm talking about! Drag that dynamite over to crack in the wall and let's let it fly!

quests.name: Lack of Subtlety
quests.description: I'm going to need you to pony up and strong-arm that One-Armet Bandit while i sing shoddy-sallies out of the saloon.

quests.name: Vordred Boss!
quests.description: Thanks to ShatteredReality.

quests.name: LET'S PINKIFY
quests.description: WE MUST FIND A MAGE OR A WIZARD OR A SORCERESS WHO IS CAPABLE OF CRAFTING THE PINKIFYING SPELL THAT I REQUIRE. MANY SUCH BEINGS ARE RIGHT HERE IN THIS PARK. MAKE THEM SUBMIT TO MY WILL, HERO!

quests.name: HEART-SHAPED FRUIT
quests.description: THIS RECIPE THAT ALINA PROVIDED REQUIRES FRUIT, IN THE SHAPE OF A HEART, FROM THE DISTURBINGLY PINK TREEANTS THAT WANDER THIS PARK. BRING ME 8 OF THEM!

quests.name: CH-CH-CH-INCHILLA (AND SLIME)
quests.description: THE SORCERESS'S RECIPE REQUIRES MORE INGREDIENTS, HERO. BRING ME 5 FISTFULS OF PINK SLIME, AND A PINCH OF CHINCHILLA FUR.

quests.name: Berzerker Bunny Helm - Wooden Egg
quests.description: Turn in a Wooden Egg to receive the Berzerker Bunny Helm! The wooden egg is the easiest to obtain. Get clues on what monster drops it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Transforming Bunny Spear - Egg Shell
quests.description: Turn in an Egg Shell to receive the Transforming Berzerker Bunny Spear! Egg Shell? If it is just the shell Sneevils must be involved! Get clues on what monsters drop it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Bunny on your Back - Quacked Egg
quests.description: Turn in a Quacked Egg to get a Bunny on your Back! Quacked Egg? Maybe someone threw it and it quacked when I Ducked? Get clues on what monster drops it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Bunny Berzerker Armor - Were Egg
quests.description: Turn in a Were Egg to receive the Bunny Berzerker Armor! This is the most challenging quest of all which requires that you have done, or do some previous quests. Get clues on what monster drops it by clicking on backpacks of eggs.

quests.name: Another One Bites the Dust!
quests.description: The Legion Bonfire cannot be crafted by any but the most skilled blacksmith, and one who has learned from Dage the Evil himself. The materials required to craft it are many, and will take much effort. If you survive your attempts to collect them, I will forge the Legion Bonefire for you.

quests.name: Chroma CRASH
quests.description: WAIT WAIT WAIT! What are you doing?! DON'T DESTROY MY MACHINE! I need that to make candy! NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

quests.name: Color Farming
quests.description: Now, since you've beaten the curse out of that machine… mind gathering more of that delicious dye for me? I have orders to fill! So much time and so little candy to make. Wait a minute. Strike that. Reverse it. Thank you.

quests.name: No Egrets Badge
quests.description: The Turking is a FOWL ruler. Defeating 1,000 of his minions will won't ruffle any of YOUR friends' feathers and will make Waddles feel safer. It will also show the TurKing that YOU are an opponent to be reckoned with.

quests.name: Ducks in a Row
quests.description: I do not have many things that I am proud of… except for my Rubber Ducky collection! That was until the Robber Duckies stole all my things… but what's a big blorb of feathers to do? Can you…would you help me find all my Rubber Duckies again? Pwease?

quests.name: Barbells and Biceps
quests.description: Those Swole Swans always make fun of me for being so weak… but then they go and steal my 1oz Barbells… so how can I ever get moar stronk? *sad duck sad* But you're really strong! You can get my Barbells back so I can work on my biceps… right?

quests.name: Gobble This... Fist To Your Face
quests.description: The uh… RAWRgobble stole some of my seeds I was planning on eating for a snack. I'd like to tell him how I really feel about him being mean to me but he is a loon-atic and really mean. Can you… would you help me get the seeds back?

quests.name: A Grave Mission
quests.description: Darkovia is not the kind, friendly place that you are used to, traveler; hungry creatures are always watching… and waiting… beneath ever shadow. Your only hope at surviving an ambush is to know your surroundings as if it were second nature. Explore the entirety of the graveyard until you can walk the grounds with your eyes closed—more or less. When you are done exploring, head to the Mausoleum and pay homage to the first King of our kin. Return to me whenever you are ready for your next mission.

quests.name: Lending a Helping Hand
quests.description: Now that you have explored your surroundings, it is time to see what you are made of—other than flesh and bone, that is. These lands are flooded with many skeletons and scavengers, making any sort of trek in these parts tiresome and dangerous. If you wish to prove your worth, destroy the undead Skeletal Fire Mages. Bring me back 8 Scorched Metacarpals… if you do not meet their same fate, that is.

quests.name: Bone Appetit
quests.description: Although weak, the Rattlebones in the area are pests to both the Vampires and Lycans alike; these scavengers steal the kill of anything and anyone close by. We have greater problems to deal with at the moment, which is why I am asking you for help. Hunt down the Rattlebones to help diminish their never-satisfied constantly-expanding population. Return to me when you have 10 Rattlebone Mandibles.

quests.name: Batting Cage
quests.description: By now, you have seen the Albino Bats in the area, yes? These flying mammals are not native to the area—we have reason to believe they were introduced by Drow caravans as they made their way to the Dwarfhold Mountains. Regardless of how they got here, we need to remove them as soon as possible. Not kill them—just find them a new home. Bring me 6 Caged Albino Bats so that my people can relocate them to a safe place. You will have to knock them unconscious before you can cage these wild bats.

quests.name: His Bark is Worse Than His Blight
quests.description: Not much is known about the undead werewolf who calls himself Blightfang. He is a true brute to both the Vampires and Lycans, viciously attacking anything that moves, whether it his own kin or not. Blightfang must be stopped! Find the undead werewolf and show him just who the Alpha is—hopefully you, granted if you return in one piece. Bring me back Blightfang's Skull as indisputable proof of your success!

quests.name: Willow Creek
quests.description: Thank you for answering my call! I have received an urgent message from the Church Elder of Willow Creek. There is a monster loose in the area, attacking their animals and crops. To show me that you are the right person for the job, please go to the Forest and bring me back 5 Zard Tails and (most importantly) the Zard Chieftain's Head. Once you have done that, I know that I can recommend you to Calafas with no reservations.

items_required.name: Hideous Zard Tail x5 (stacks up to 10)

quests.name: Hideous Tail
quests.description: Well, you know what they say… eye of newt and toe of frog. I find that Zardmen tails work MUCH better for spellcrafting and potion making. I'm running a little low on supplies, though - can you go to the forest and bring me back 5 Hideous Tails from those Zardmen blocking the paths? (Return to Warlic in the Battleon Magic Shop once you have all 5 Hideous Tails.)

quests.name: Enchanted Inks for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Hmm, the Royal Alchemy Academy should have brought me another batch of Enchanted Ink by now. You wouldn't happen to be from the Alchemy Academy would you?

quests.name: Lesser Salves for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Have you brought me salves for making? I bet you didn't know these salves can be mixed into inks allowing the ink to gain magical properties. I bet you also didn't know that the better the salve the BETTER THE INK!

quests.name: Runic Salves for Spell Crafting
quests.description: Have you returned from the Alchemy Academy? I am expecting more Runic Salves for my scrolls. Properly mixed salves allowing us to capture powerful spell in mere ink and paper.

quests.name: Chaos Reigned
quests.description: Chaos is treated like a bad memory, but we need to stay on our guard. Lord Vaughn of Chiral Valley was forced to stand by when Escherion invaded, but now he's allowed to be proactive. He needs the Eldritch Stalkers and Terrasites of /DeepForest eliminated.

quests.name: Fireproofing
quests.description: Lady Reignolds of Swordhaven's noble court is also its agricultural advisor. She works tirelessly to prevent blight and famine. I hear she's looking for a way to fireproof crops. Take flames from the remaining Shadefire Onslaught in /FirePlaneWar. If her seeds can withstand their fire, they can take anything.

quests.name: Fishy-men Business
quests.description: Lady Noelle of the Yew Mountain Chain was welcomed back home by the Queen. I'm unsure of what to think of this. I hear she's operating in /Ashray. Would you mind investigating the Sharkbait and Fishermen there?

quests.name: Baleful Morals
quests.description: Lord Granville, the Protector of the Sea of Trees, manages the Alteon family's summer castle - /Balemorale. I hear the Lightguard and Noble Knights are misbehaving. Sort them out so that old war dog has less to worry about.

quests.name: Nainhdeil
quests.description: My liege has ordered the return of Lord Taylor, which is heartening news. I hear he was living in Skye. That place has history with Greenguard…Would you lay that to rest by exorcising the Undead Gardes and Garde Wraiths at /LiaTaraHill?

quests.name: Oxford Degree in Beatdowns
quests.description: I'm starting to get jealous of all the people who get to fight you. How about we step into the next room and have a spar? I have to warn you that despite letting Battleon's adventurers take the spotlight, I've fought in every war this town has ever faced.

items_required.name: Warlord Harley Defeated x1 (Stacks up to 10)

quests.name: Icewing Grunt!
quests.description: While you test your mettle against my army, they will also be testing themselves against you! Fight your way through the arena and battle my Icewing Grunts. Let us see who emerges victorious!

quests.name: Icewing Warrior!
quests.description: Are you ready for more? Fight your way to my Icewing Warriors. They are more seasoned than the grunts are… but perhaps you are even stronger!

quests.name: Icewing Elite!
quests.description: My Icewing Elite will not be so easily defeated! Battle him and show me your strength… if you can survive the icy monsters that stand in your path!

quests.name: Icewing General!
quests.description: Are you strong enough to face the General of my Icewing Raiders? Fight the monsters that stand between you and your victory… or defeat.

quests.name: WarSeeker Pet Quest
quests.description: Celebrate another year of dark victories for Dage the Evil by crossing swords with his strongest Blade Masters in the Underworld Arena (/legionarena). Please him, and he reward you with a character page badge and will assign guards to defend your house.

quests.name: Water Endurance
quests.description: Wait… you're still here? You weren't scared off by my dire and ominous warning of eternal torment? Hmmm… you know, you may just be the person I need to help break this terrible curse. But I need to be sure. The fiendish Water Elemental who guards this level employs many beautiful but deadly Sirens to help him in his task. If you could slay twenty-five of them and return to me with their essences, I will have proof of your strength and will unlock the room which contains my watery tormentor. ( Bring back twenty-five Watery Essences to complete this quest.)

quests.name: Liquid Soul
quests.description: I fear that I will not forget those final moments, as the Ice Elemental stood over me and cursed my soul for all eternity. As my vision grew dim, the last thing I saw was the bright glow emanating from a bracelet on his wrist. If you could bring this bracelet to me, I do believe that I can use its arcane power to the lift the curse and free myself from this accursed dungeon. (Bring back the Water Bracelet to complete this quest.)

quests.name: Gather the Spirits
quests.description: My Prince is responsible for maintaining the Celestial Herds. But we spent so much time gazing into each others' eyes that the herd wandered. Subdue the Roosterbull Spirits and gather in the Chickcalf Spirits so we may be together.

quests.name: Spiders and Dreamsilk
quests.description: My father set me the task of weaving cloth for the celestial handmaidens, but - I admit - I was too distracted by my Prince. There are spiders I use to help me when I fall behind schedule. If you capture them, we will be able to weave the dreamsilk I need.

quests.name: Dye-ing to Reunite
quests.description: The last thing I need is dye, to color the ceremonial kimono. I harvest the dye from fallen stars. And this night, they are in abundance!

quests.name: Slay Uji No Hashihime
quests.description: Uji No Hashihime used to be a woman who was scorned by her husband. She would do anything to prevent others from finding the love she's lost. Stop her from disrupting the ceremony!

quests.name: Wells' Embargo
quests.description: I can't in good conscience condone allowing airships to dock on the Hover-base OR financing the Hover-base's next year of operation when there are Sky Pirate squadrons and those vile OctoSpies hanging about its decks. Do away with 7 Draconian Skypirates and 3 SteamOcto's before I'll part with any of the Exchequer's gold.

quests.name: Fullmetal Financier
quests.description: I'm addle-brained when it comes to alchemy, but when it comes to financial matters, I'm the Skyguard's golden boy. The recruits, they mock me. I know revenge is less than refined, but I'd really like to show them up ! Bring me golden nuggets from Guru Chests and Golden Draconians so I can find someone to craft me an armor all of gold.

quests.name: Fire and Ice
quests.description: Those dragons have really wreaked havoc on our village! The red dragons have set everything on fire, and the ice dragons have froze it all up! Head on down into town, all th' way east. Put out any fires that ya find, and thaw out any critters that are still frozen.

quests.name: Round 'em Up
quests.description: Now that the fires are out and the ice is thawed, would ya mind rustlin' up the livestock that have gotten loose? Just smack 'em a few times 'til they calm down, and we'll get 'em back in their pens.

quests.name: Get Rockin'
quests.description: One last thing - in case you haven't noticed, all our homes have been smashed to bits! We'll need to build a sturdy temporary shelter we can stay in until the fighting stops. We just need some strong rock, and some sticky mud. You see those elementals down to the east? You can get it all from them.

quests.name: Stop Fightin'
quests.description: Alright, you can tell those Drakel at the gate that we'll back off for now - but they've got to find a way to stop this fighting!

quests.name: The Sabbatia
quests.description: One of the marsh plants mentioned by Bal Gravestorm is the Sabbatia. According to my apothecary, it is a small plant with pinkish flowers. The spiders that have appeared seem to be oddly drawn to these flowers. Please bring back 20 specimens for us to study.

quests.name: Grasses
quests.description: There was a wolf spotted wandering from one patch of grass to another. Sometimes he stopped, and other times he seemed to be looking for something that wasn't there.Please gather 20 patches of marshgrass so that we can determine if there are any differences in them.

quests.name: The Spiders have changed...
quests.description: The spiders themselves have been changed by Chaos. We need to study how they may have been affected. Bring back 15 spiders so that we may examine them more closely.

quests.name: Things that go Bump in the Night
quests.description: There has been horrible growling heard from deep within the marsh. Has the Chaos come to life? Or has it brought something out of hiding that was best left undisturbed? Please go to the end of the Marsh - if you survive, bring me back the best description of the creature as you can.

quests.name: Wheel of Bacon
quests.description: Yay! You helped the Bacon Cat Force beat up that nasty Laser Shark Brigade, so now you deserve access to… our secret TREASURE ROOM! Also known as: the Wheel of Bacon! Spin it and see what you get! BUT FIRST! You'll need to deposit some tokens. Yes, Ziri's Wheel of Bacon takes tokens. It's a work in progress, ok? The Sharkies stole them all, so you'll have to steal some back. Any of the sharks in here might have them, but that nasty boss shark DEFITINELY does.

quests.name: Wheel of Love
quests.description: I'd love to just GIVE you all the prizes, but I am contractually bound by Grimskull Productions to say that, if you want any more gear, you'll need to complete this quest. Slay Undead Cherubs to get Unlove Darts. Turn in 13 for a chance to get a prize!

quests.name: The First Crumb
quests.description: He looked for a Hollowborn brother who slipped out of the Shadow Fiend's grasp, and returned to Death. Could this brother have joined in the indignity of those forced to guard a castle of bones? Find him, and find a piece of me.

quests.name: Return to Lifeblood
quests.description: If the brother was not among bones, perhaps he was drowning in blood. Vampires, in the face of eternity, are a young breed. They cling to aesthetics, and love using skulls as goblets. Find a Vampire that is named after his own food in the den of his nemesis, and retrieve a piece of me.

quests.name: Nohairatu
quests.description: Piranhas are more civil to each other than Noble Vampires. The Hollowborn brother was in the hands of one of those night creatures, and stolen by another. Sanguine joked that the Vampiric thief was trying to resurrect their hair. Find this Vampire, and return with a piece of me.

quests.name: Bony Hodgepodge
quests.description: Stolen bones disappear and lose their names. The Hollowborn brother was mistaken for a tool, and whisked away. Perhaps he was thrown into a conglomerate terror of bones under Battleon, right under our noses. Find this terror, and find another piece of me.

quests.name: Red Risk
quests.description: Where shadows were on the rise, my charge and I searched for an infernal menace. Some said it had the power to steal the Hollowborn brother, and keep him for its own. This was where a story was about to end. Find this menace, and bring back another piece of me.

quests.name: Knuckle Levity
quests.description: Could Dage the Evil need this Hollowborn brother? It was more likely that someone, or something, weaker than him committed the thievery instead. Look for a man connected to the Legion, who gallops, and spites freshwater, but thrives in the salty sea. Retrieve from them another piece of me.

quests.name: Grudge Ghost
quests.description: Dage the Evil is a member of a Dark Alliance of Evil, and many Hollowborn were loyal to him. Perhaps their power inspired jealousy from fiends in name and character only. This fiend lurks under the Alliance, and stole pieces of me. Find and return them.

quests.name: Inverted Expectation
quests.description: The Hollowborn brother was not found with the Undead. The Legionnaires instead pointed towards tombs where the sleeping dead tend to gather. My charge decided to investigate the photonegative guardians of the dead in an ethereal tomb. Find them, and find one more piece of me.

quests.name: Die Angry
quests.description: The final piece of me waits where my charge made a mistake. He looked for a Dragon, but trailed after one that was mired in death and rage. Near water, they sought the kind of immortality the Hollowborn are believed to have. Look in their bones, and complete me.

quests.name: Treasure Death
quests.description: You have completed me under the gaze of my charge's brethren, tracing his footsteps as he searched for his treasure. Find him in the lair of the Dragon that embodies selfish desire for meaningless wealth. The walls behind its gold nest will open for you.

quests.name: Kick Some Can
quests.description: First, I want to get a sense of how strong you truly are. There are some Warriors and Assassins roaming Aegis. I want you to find them and honorably challenge them to a duel. Show me how many you can defeat in a battle in order to prove your strength to me.

quests.name: Smashing!
quests.description: If you want to be a stronger Hero, you care are going to need to work on using your weapon with as much force as possible. The Gemstones here are some of the hardest throughout Lore. Find them, and hit them as hard as you can! There are Sunstones, Moonstones, and Star Sapphires. Bring me 4 of each as proof of your progress!

quests.name: Now You're A Pro
quests.description: Here's the real test of your skills! Travel to /bludrutbrawl and defeat any enemies you see! Bring back 50 Combat Trophies to prove that you were able to prevail.

quests.name: Test 1: Proving Ground
quests.description: I can't believe you've reached this point. You're so close to your Mark of Mastery… there are just a few tests left. And the first is to pass through the Shifting Planes Cavern, slaying 13 of any monster plus 13 Dark Makai specifically.

quests.name: Test 2: Nulgath's Disdain
quests.description: Are they… laughing at you? The spies, look at them. They're mocking you. The next test is to command respect, and there's only one way to do that. With VIOLENCE.

quests.name: Test 3: Bonesaw Break
quests.description: This 3rd test sounds ominous:The Glowing Skull is the key.Get the Ultra Dark Mystery Stone Of Evil Animosityfrom the monsters in the Bonesaw Prison Cavefromany of the Dark Makai. I don't like the sound of that, but it DOES say the Mystery Stone will aid you. Still. You're on your own for this one!

quests.name: Test 4: Dark Battleground
quests.description: We've come this far. I'm not leaving your side now! But… you should really get into the fortress quickly. Something tells me Nulgath's inside, waiting for you. According to the scroll, you'll need to slay 13 of his guards to enter.

quests.name: Test 5: Shadows Within Shadows
quests.description: Hunh. To master the shadows, you must be able to merge them. Good thing you kept that "Ultra Dark Mystery Stone of Evil Animosity." You'll need to combine it with the Dark Elemental's "Darker Shadow Gem of Tenebrous Tenebration."

items_required.name: Ultra Dark Mystery Stone Of Evil Animosity
Darker Shadow Gem of Tenebrous Tenebration

quests.name: Test 6: Runed Fiends
quests.description: To enter Nulgath's Fortress, you must find the Rune Scroll and the… Fiend Scroll? This test seems meaningless. Unless he's just trying to wear you down. That makes sense. Says the scrolls must be taken from the monsters outside the fortress. How helpful.

quests.name: The Treasure that You Seek
quests.description: We've got to explore this prehistoric world but finding fossils can't be our aim. Not when we've got to get that Vigillete! It'd be a good idea to clear all those trees, Hero to make a path. For that, you'll need a axe. The armor from those dinos would make a good blade! Bring back 10 sharp armor segments!

quests.name: These Trees
quests.description: It's a good thing these trees don't have houses at the top of them. It'd make cutting them down a LOT harder. I count 11 you're going to need to chop down before we can make a clear path to the top of the mountain and knowing your luck, thats exactly where the Vigilette is hidden!

quests.name: Ewwww... Totally Gross
quests.description: You're going to have to Hero-up and get ready to give it your all, because i think we're going to need… Dino-spit. Yeah. I know. It's gross. But I've got a cup for you, and a stick to scrape with. You'll just need to kill 8 'saurs and collect their spit.

quests.name: The Eggs, Exciting and New
quests.description: I usually do what I'm told, Hero, but I think you're going to have to trap the Mother TerrorDOOMKill by placing that sticky goo on her eggs. No cutting corners, either. You've GOT to put her at a disadvantage. We NEED to search her nest.

quests.name: Someday (Today) Their Mother Will Die
quests.description: Today's the day you're going to have to kill the mother TerrorDOOMKill. We NEED the Vigilette hiding in her nest. Don't think about her babies, Hero, or that she'll never again see the wings of her offspring making windmills as they try to fly. Just take her down!

quests.name: Dino Destroyer
quests.description: All of the dinosaurs are going to extinct eventually. You might as well help them on their way. Take out 100 Dinosaurs and you'll be the Prince of Prehistory!

quests.name: Get me that Recipe!
quests.description: Alright, listen up: you want to know more about J6, and I want to know more about Yulgar's Famous Raspberry Smoothies. He is probably hiding the first half somewhere in his Cellar and check through the trash here for the second half of the recipe. Once you search high and low and find both parts of Yulgar's Secret Recipe, bring them back here and I'll let you in on what I know about J6… to the best of my knowledge, that is.

quests.name: A-MAZE-ing Race
quests.description: Welcome to William's Hedge Maze, I grew it myself! I've hidden 5 small pots of gold in this hedge maze! If you can find all 5, … and find your way out again, you'll win some Golden Tickets!

quests.name: Can you do it?
quests.description: Thank you for your kind offer to help us with this mystery. I need to know that I am entrusting the fate of my community into the hands of a competent person. To prove yourself to me, go forth and battle the frogdrakes and giant mosquitoes that are in the area. Bring me back 5 Frogdrake's Feet and 5 Mosquito Wings. Once you have completed this quest, the Church Seal will give you full authority to investigate these strange happenings.

quests.name: Backyard Zards
quests.description: G'day Mate! Say, you must be the bloke they sent to help us with our little problem. I'd love to help you, but I've got a problem of my own to worry about. My brother was here last week, and he left a bunch of his pets - Zards, he calls them, - loose in my backyard! The dang things are eating me out of house and home! If you could get rid of them for me, I'm sure I could remember something that could help you…

quests.name: Attic Spiders
quests.description: Thank goodness your here! Whatever has been attacking our town… I think it's in my attic! Listen, can't you hear them scuttling around up there? You're the hero, why don't you go up there and take care of it for me?

quests.name: Storage Speyeders
quests.description: Oh. Well, um. Hi. I have the same kind of problems as my neighbors. I really do. Can you go kill some spiders in my storage area? I need, oh, proof that you've killed at least 5. Thanks.

quests.name: Garden Snails
quests.description: Howdy, stranger! I bet you're here to investigate the attacks on our town. We're happy to help you out… but first, how about giving us a hand? We've got some giant snails out back wrecking the garden, and you look like just therightperson to get rid of them. If you can, I'll be glad to tell you everything I know about what's happening around here…

quests.name: Tempestuous Times
quests.description: The Farmers are having a meeting. They plan to attack the Drakel Dwarves in the morning. Although, with the information you gave me I don't think the Dwakels have anything to do with it. Please - keep looking. I fear you are the only one who can avert this oncoming battle. Take this map of the Woods and expand your investigation. The answer may be found outside of town…

quests.name: The Bone?
quests.description: A… werewolf? A giant werewolf? My goodness, what could this mean? Please… go look for him again, if you can retrieve some fur, perhaps we will be able to cure this unfortunate individual in the future.

quests.name: Darkblood Life's Blood
quests.description: My People are dying in our own streets. I must look to providing for those that remain alive. Lionfang's troops have raided our stores and our homes and taken most of our food. Go out and retake our rations from these… things and make sure they do not get up.

quests.name: Make a Wish
quests.description: Wishes are important. They are expressions of your hopes, dreams, and goals. Get a coin from the Wishing Shop and "toss it in"… that is, turn it in here to make a wish and receive a few words of encouragement to take with you into battle each day!

quests.name: Use the Wishing Well
quests.description: Have you found a lucky coin? Why not toss it in and see what comes out?

quests.name: Needle in a Cedar Stack
quests.description: I suppose you'll want to get out of this cage first, won't you? Unfortunately, it's locked - but I saw one of the scientists drop a paperclip in here not long ago. If you can find it, you can use it to pick the lock and escape. It's somewhere in the cedar bedding.

quests.name: Pick the Lock
quests.description: Now, you can take the paperclip and use it to pick the lock. The cage door is just over there!

quests.name: Contain the Infection
quests.description: Oh no! Looks like some of the lab rodents have escaped, and became infected. I hate to say it, but we'll have to put them down so they can't spread it any further.

quests.name: Gather the Reagents
quests.description: The only way to destroy the slime mold is to burn it. We'll have to scavenge the lab - we'll need all the matches you can find, and some kind of flammable liquid. There's a chlorine trifluoride spill over in the corner - look for a yellow-green puddle. That's the most flammable chemical we have in the lab, so bring some of that back, too.

quests.name: Flame On!
quests.description: Burn down as much of the slime mold as you can find! Torch the stuff on the walls! Beat up the wandering globs, and then set them on fire!

items_required.name: Burn the Stuff on the Door!

quests.name: Open the Cages!
quests.description: In the hallway you've just opened up, you'll find the rest of the caged animals. The keys to their cages are still here - probably hidden in those engorged slime molds. Tear them apart until you've fond all the keys, then use them to open the cages.

quests.name: Get Rid of the Blockage!
quests.description: To reach the source of the blue mold, we're going to have to get down to the basement. The fastest way down there is through a hole we rodents chewed in one of the cages, long ago. Unfortunately, the occupant of that cage has succumbed to the infection, and it's currently blocking our path.

quests.name: Keep on Going
quests.description: I know I had chewed a hole in this room when I escaped before, but the mold seems to be covering it. Burn it down until you find it, then follow it down into the basement.

quests.name: Find the Source
quests.description: Oh, my! It's even worse down here! You'll have to destroy those mutated slime molds - as many as you can! We have to keep this from spreading any further! And explore the basement while you do. See if you can find where the mold is original form.

quests.name: Find the Key
quests.description: That storage room is covered in mold, but that's a problem for later. The problem for NOW is that it's also locked. One of those mold-covered scientists you found must have the key!

quests.name: Clear More Mold
quests.description: Now, all we need to do is burn the mold covering the storage room door - and then, use the key we found to unlock it.

quests.name: Defeat the Escapee!
quests.description: The escaped experiment - it's here! You must defeat it quickly, or we'll never make it out of here alive!

quests.name: Nax-ty Beasts
quests.description: These Nax Beasts were created by Kolyaban from some of the local wildlife. If there is anything I know about those that are Reshapen, is that they are beyond saving. Take them out.

quests.name: Children of the Night
quests.description: Just you being here has quelled the infighting between the Vampires and Lycans. If you could show them that we stand a chance against the Queen, perhaps we can muster some reinforcements for you! Go and overturn some fights and I'll ensure you have the reinforcements you need!

quests.name: We've Woken The Hive
quests.description: It looks like Kolyaban has brought some of her Darkblood children with her. But something is wrong… The Darkblood have still managed to retain their humanity. These things… These are something else. We must stop them!

quests.name: Ritual Disruption
quests.description: With both races working together, I am confident we can stop Kolyaban! We have one more task before we face her. We must disrupt her ritual by destroying the Runes she has placed in the surrounding area. With them gone, we will be able to break her Ritual Circle. Her minions will try to stop you. Be careful!

quests.name: The Darkness Orb
quests.description: Kolyaban has done so much damage. Caused so much pain. It is only fair that we return the favor. Let's take her down, and recover the Darkness Orb she holds!

quests.name: Defeat Training Globes
quests.description: Every hero has to start somewhere, and the earlier your training begins, the stronger you'll be in the final battle. Take on 10 of these training globes to see how strong you already are!

quests.name: Take Flight into the Future
quests.description: Every new GEARS student rides with me, and we all like our practical jokes. But this latest crop has stolen a plaque from my console. I won't fly without it! Battle these practical jokers to get my motto back or we'll never land!

quests.name: Roots of all Evil
quests.description: The forest is alive, evil and trying to eat you! Slay 10 Roots of Evil.

quests.name: Venus Hero Trap
quests.description: Drayko is watching you from above. Before you enter and fight your way up there, defeat Seed Spitters until you gather 6 seeds. Turn the quest in to make a health potion!

quests.name: Bark is worse than its bite
quests.description: You have entered Titan Hollow! But something is strange… you better search for clues. Battle the Evil Plant Horros and Titan Decay to collect 10 clues.

quests.name: Knot what you expected
quests.description: Most of the creatures roaming this dungeon were once heroes… now they want the same to happen to you. defeat 12 Weeping Widowmakers!

quests.name: Cha Cha Cha Chia!
quests.description: Chia Warrior… the Warrior that grows! (TM) Hmmm, I have a great idea for home decoration. Defeat Chia Warriors until you collect 5 Chia Seeds

quests.name: Leaf me alone!
quests.description: They say 'Good things come in Trees!" but I am stumped so… defeat 5 Seed Spitters, 5 Evil Plant Horrors, 5 Titan Decay, and then… we are going to do something dangerous.

quests.name: Evil Faerie Ambush!
quests.description: GAHHH! Evil Tree Fairies! They love curses and are will do anything to stop you from undoing it. Battle them and collect 10 Evil Faerie wings

quests.name: Check the Trunk
quests.description: Vulchurions!? HERE!? They are eating the dying bark on the Titan. Defeat 12 Vulchurions.

quests.name: Committing Tree-son
quests.description: Magic Scrolls made from Tree Titan Bark are extra powerful. Slay monsters and collect 10 magic tree bark to make a spell you can use against Drayko.

quests.name: Heartwood
quests.description: "Have a heart…." literally. One of the monsters stole the Titan's heart. Start breaking some hearts yourself until you find the Titan's Heart! (15% drop chance on Evil Plant Horrors, Vulcherions and Evil Tree Faeries)

quests.name: Drayko BOSS FIGHT!
quests.description: "Come at me Bro."

quests.name: Foilaged again!
quests.description: Drayko pulled a fast one on you… but there's still a way to beat him… if you put your MIND to it! Clear a path to the Titan's brain. Slay 15 Monsters.

quests.name: Mind Games
quests.description: OH NO! Parts of the brain are missing. Anyone with half a mind would know we need to find the missing bits… battle monsters and collect 10 Tree Titan Brain Chunks.

quests.name: DRAGON vs TITAN
quests.description: You are now controlling the giant Tree Titan! (How freaking awesome is that!?) Battle the Dragon and defeat him.

quests.name: Smells like trouble!
quests.description: There is a secret area that you can access by falling *coughs* under the Titan… you might want to hold your nose. Slay 30 Lil' Poots

quests.name: EPIC DROP!
quests.description: It's time for the big one… beware, he is flush with rage. It is going to be one intestin' battle! Defeat the Epic Drop

quests.name: Re-Run Titan Hollow
quests.description: Want a re-match? You can run the Titan Hollow dungeon again with these special bonus quests. But first you will need to construct a Wooden Ring! Defeat 5 Root of Evil monsters.

quests.name: Evil Plant Horrors
quests.description: They used to be adventurers… now they are evil vegetable overlords who are trying to eat you. Slay 6 Evil Plant Horrors.

quests.name: Weeping Widowmakers!
quests.description: Some adventurers like to travel while others like their feet firmly PLANTED in the ground. Defeat 5-ish Weeping Widowmakers.

quests.name: Chia Warriors
quests.description: Chia Warrior… the Warrior that grows! (TM) Hmmm, we really need to pick up a few of these for my house. Defeat 4 or 5 Chia Warriors… maybe 3. How about just 3 this time?

quests.name: Evil Tree Faeries!
quests.description: Evil Tree Faeries are distant relatives of the evil typo faeries who use time travel to make it look like Artix made typos in design notes posts and on social media… they must be stopped! Defeat 5 Evil Tree Faeries.

quests.name: Vulchurions
quests.description: Birds of the feather, attempt to peck you together. Slay 3 Vulchurions. Just three. Good things come in trees.

quests.name: Drayko Battle!
quests.description: "COME AT ME…AGAIN… BRO!"

quests.name: DRAGON vs TITAN Rematch!
quests.description: The main event… DRAGON vs TITAN! The highly anticipated heavyweight world championship match that everyone has been on the edge of their seats to see! Defeat Dakka the Crazy Dragon.

quests.name: BONUS An Inconvinient Tooth
quests.description: A rare GIANT DAKKA FANG fell during the battle. I saw a Chia Warrior pick it up. Battle Chia Warriors until you get the Fang!

quests.name: BONUS Do, do it!
quests.description: Rumor has it that a GIANT DAKKA FANG is somewhere within the horrific brown glob known as Epic Drop.

quests.name: BONUS Fang you very much!
quests.description: A mysterious robed figure offers you a GIANT DAKKA FANG if you bring him the tear of a Weeping Widowmaker. Seems legit. (Member only, 10% drop)

quests.name: Defender Armor (Guardians)
quests.description: As renowned protectors of alternate universes, Defenders understand the sacrifices one must make during combat. Defenders will see to it that what they start always ends in victory.

quests.name: Dau Go
quests.description: To perform the ritual, we must construct a wooden sculpture of Mother Dragon herself using wood from the island - you can get the best wood from the Dao Treeants. We'll also need to bring her an offering- the gold and jewels Blazebeard's troops here carry with them, and the clear spring water that the Water Goblins in /burningbeach carry. These would make excellent displays of our determination to bring her forth.

quests.name: Bãi Cháy
quests.description: The offerings are in place for Mother Dragon- but now we need a tribute for the Fire Plane itself. Lava from the creatures on /burningbeach would be an excellent catalyst for the summoning portal - and the golems deep in these caverns produce rare Flame Rubies that the plane's denizens are said to treasure. Bring me these samples, and we can continue.

quests.name: Sung Sot
quests.description: We have the supplies for the ritual, but there's nothing stopping Blazebeard from interrupting us. As such, the final step in our plan is to have a surprise to draw Blazebeard's attention from the summoning site. Perhaps you could lure him away by taking the storm core? Wrap the core in sharkskin to keep it intact, and I'll begin.

quests.name: Ha Long
quests.description: The summoning is almost complete… but it appears our Pyromancer allies have been forced back. Blazebeard has broken through our defenses and breached the sanctum, just as we expected- and looks quite ready to settle the score with you! Hold him off, so that Mother Dragon may answer our call!

quests.name: Explore the DragonPlane
quests.description: To free my master you will need to enter the four elemental realms of the DragonPlane. Earth, Water, Air and Fire. Please go explore this part of the DragonPlane and find the portals to each realm, then find the DragonGate. It looks like a huge magic circle at the end of the path. Return to me when you are done.

quests.name: Lots Of Fiber
quests.description: To enter the different elemental realms I will need to prepare some things for you. Please hunt down elementals until you have collected 3 Earth Fibers, 3 Water Fibers, 3 Air Fibers and 3 Fire Fibers from the elementals here in the DragonPlane. Return to me when you have all of them.

quests.name: Carrying The Torches
quests.description: If you tried to enter the element realms without being attuned to that elements magic you would be ripped to shreds. Go place these attuning torches around the area, and it will start to synch your energy. Return to me when you have places them all.

quests.name: Meet me in the Earth Realm
quests.description: Make your way to the Earth Realm. It is the closest portal to this place. I will meet you inside.

quests.name: Escape from the ChronoLords
quests.description: The ChronoLords aren't going to just let us walk out of here! We'll have to defeat them before we can escape!

quests.name: Vorefax
quests.description: Holy moly, this thing really is huge! I can't believe it… this is all because of me? We have to destroy it… before it destroys all of time!

quests.name: Endurance Tesssssst
quests.description: If you wisssssssh to prove your worttttttth, you must ssssshow me your dedicationnnnnn. Defeat the local weaklingsssssss, and bring me their headsssssss

quests.name: A Gesture of Evil
quests.description: It ssssssseemsss I require your … sssssssservicesssss. Bring me the following itemsssssss…and you will get your reward.

quests.name: Ghastly Blades
quests.description: Bring me 100 Ghassssstly Dreadrock Bladesssss from the local citizensssss, ssssso I may melt them down for my waressssssss. Do thisssss, and you will be greatly rrrrrewarded…

quests.name: Day of the Undead
quests.description: The Undead Primordial God, Desterrat Moya, was a particularly big inspiration to the founding of the Underworld Chronomancers. Perhaps you could be further inspired to join our Order by facing it.

quests.name: Tough On Crime Approach
quests.description: Fascinating! What a dreamy word. Don't you want to be fascinating? Whether they realize it or not, many of the Nation are fascinated by fanatics of justice. Even Master Nulgath. Justice taken to the extreme comes so close to being evil, and you can come up with easy excuses to cross the line. Go to /poisonforest and you'll find people like that. Bring back the medals awarded by the Good to their highest ranking fanatics.

quests.name: Fluffy Face Value
quests.description: There's more than enough Dark Makai to go around in Tercessuinotlim but they're not my style. Yuck, they're all skin and no fur like a wrinkly desert cat. Hmm, cats…When it comes to cats, you can't just have one. And they can't just be any cats. They have to have a cute face, and a sour personality. Bring me some cute black-hearted cats and I'll consider that a big favor! You can find them in /doomkitten and /nibbleon.

items_required.name: Mean Kitten Acquired x2 (Stacks up to 20)
Ribboned Kitten Acquired x2 (Stacks up to 20)

quests.name: Black Lights
quests.description: Glow stick accessories used to be such a big fad. Not anymore. That stuff makes me feel old, and that's saying something cause I'm immortal. Members of Nulgath's Nation scorn all Light in kind of the same way. It represents our goodie two shoes counterparts as a whole, but I'm curious. I've heard that the /blackholesun has different kinds of lights! Take a trip there and bring me souvenirs.

items_required.name: Black Light Core x5 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Vindictive Minds
quests.description: 'Dawn' is a good way to explain what my name represents too. But the name seems to be taken. In /Trygve, there seems to be an organization out there that's taken the 'Dawn' for their own. It's just a word. People can make it out to mean anything, but I'm curious. Do me a favor and run over to that town. Bring me back some souvenirs from those Dawn Vendors or whatever. I want to know what their Dawn means.

quests.name: Soft and Sharp
quests.description: I've been hearing stories of people minding their own business, and suddenly they fall through the ground. Boom, gone. No one there, not even a sinkhole. It even happened here! And I managed to get a glimpse of this portal to a /garden. And in that garden were these cuuuute bunny critters. I'm going to ask you the huge favor of bringing me a fluffle of these bunbuns back! Especially the tentie ones.

items_required.name: Black Bunny Fluffle x5 (Stacks up to 50)
Tentie Bunny Fluffle x5 (Stacks up to 50)
Tentie Human Fluffle? x3 (Stacks up to 30)

quests.name: Ring Bearer
quests.description: As I started exploring these tunnels, I seemed to have lost something of great importance to me—a ring that my father had given me when I was a child. I am not sure where I could have lost it, but I am positive that one of those bone-heads found it! Go around and hunt the Undead until my ring drops from one of them!

quests.name: Skeletal Sabotage
quests.description: These tunnels are flooded with the Undead. And by the looks of things, they seem to be getting stronger as we speak! The only way we can weaken their defenses is by stealing their weapons and armor as soon as possible! If you're up for the challenge, go out and collect 6 Skeletal Claymores and 3 Bony ChestPlates from the wandering Undead!

quests.name: Tunnel of Terror
quests.description: There is something living down here that is rather different from the other Undead. It's big. It's nasty. And it wields massive bone weapons! It is none other than the Bone Terror, and even though I am a Paladin, I am too scared to confront it myself. If you happen to defeat it and bring me the Bone Terror's Head as proof, I will never doubt your abilities ever again!

quests.name: The Search for the Sword
quests.description: I didn't want to tell you at first, but you have done such a great job helping me out that I owe it to you. Some Paladins have a supernatural sense that allows them to find special weapons with untold magical properties. I came down into these tunnels in hopes of finding such a weapon. I know a super rare weapon is down here… somewhere. Hack and slash your way through the Undead until you find an Unidentified Weapon!

location.name: Chairman Platinum's Evolving Environmental Art Gallery

quests.name: Going Going Is Bananas
quests.description: Observe. A lush forest environment created by Chairman Platinum. The fauna are just as realistic as the flora, with the Chairman's own… realism-based style. The GorillAIphants' aggression is quite realistic as well. Perhaps too much. I ask that you subdue them before we continue.

quests.name: Your FrAInds!
quests.description: Walking further to the right will take you to our urban shopping environment. Go on, have a chat with Robina and Artix. They're prepared to make you feel like you actually have friends. Don't mind the lack of a mall entrance. The Ebil AI will generate one once we obtain more "references."

quests.name: Green Soy Fodder
quests.description: We filled the mall with clones to refine our flat loiterer generation process. Unfortunately, they're packed too closely at the moment to simulate a real outside experience, and perceive a shoulder bump as a way to initiate a fight. How disgusting. Trash these failures. I can't have them damaging the landscape.

quests.name: WIPs
quests.description: What in the… I see. It seems that someone fed Works-In-Progress to the Ebil AI. It must have confused mouse cursors for environmental fixtures, and scattered them across Chairman Platinum's masterpiece. You! Grab them, give them to me, and let us never speak of this again. I'll compensate you with a muffin basket.

quests.name: Anatomical Nightmare
quests.description: Moving past the mall, you will find yourself in *gasp* the midst of a Shadowscythe invasion. The horror. Experience what it's like to be a real adventurer by slaying these…skeletons. Their odd appearance is on purpose, of course. They're supposed to be strange because they're Evil.

quests.name: Dead Eyed
quests.description: Well, would you look at that? It's the Empress of the Shadowscythe herself. It appears she wants to meet her new minion. Wait a minute… is that one of ours? I doubt it- she seems a tad too 'girly girl' to fit into the Invasion area's aesthetic. Occupy yourself by talking to both of them… I have to have a word with the General Manager.

quests.name: Unspecified Seafood
quests.description: Now enter the Empress' fortress and look in awe at her…aquarium. Tsk, the Ebil AI strung the wrong locations together again. It even interpreted the "fish" prompt incorrectly, and made living filets. Argh, get rid of them before the Chairman finds out!

quests.name: Too Literal
quests.description: Ah, so the AI has placed Warlic and Cysero's interpretations underwater. Considering that Warlic is the Blue Mage, it only makes sense for him and his friend to be here. Why? Because water is blue, obviously. If you doubt our logic, perhaps a conversation will help you understand the quality of our designs.

quests.name: Oversaturation
quests.description: Ow! Did one of the fish just bite me? And why are the skeletons banging their heads on the walls? You! Destroy these malfunctioning specimens before they bring the entire gallery down! I need to make some calls, and figure out what's going on.

quests.name: Pull the Plug
quests.description: Agh! One of my high heels snapped while we were escaping from the monsters. Enough of this! Go past the underwater cave, and pull the plug on that stupid Blender. Break your tacky friends out of the tank, too, for all I care! I'll pin the blame on someone else… just GO!

quests.name: Haku Medal
quests.description: Haku Village is being attacked from land and sea. The Yokai and Dragons have banded together for one purpose - to take the head of Empress Ai No Miko. Don't give them another inch, and wipe them off the face of the Isles. I'll be at your side, my friend.

quests.name: Mega Haku Medal
quests.description: The Yokai and Dragons want the Isles back in the claws of the beasts. We'll hack them to pieces. Be on the lookout for their stronger warriors, the Dai Tengu and the Long. They appear rarely, but defeating them cripples their forces, and bolsters ours with the riches they drop.

items_required.name: Mega Haku Medal x3 (Stacks up to 300)

quests.name: Tall Tails
quests.description: The Kitsune Spies are trying to sow discord in our ranks by disguising themselves as hapless villagers. Lady Yue has singled them out, and needs us to banish them. I think that's a less gruesome way of asking us to slay them. We should go along with it.

quests.name: Flightless
quests.description: The Draconic forces have joined up with the Yokai traitors. Interestingly, they don't need to communicate with each other to move in-sync. Let's round up a few, and probe at their cuts to see if they'd be more willing to communicate with us instead.

items_required.name: Dark Zmey Bangle x5 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: NorthEast Ushitora
quests.description: Of all the Yokai that would seek to drink Empress Ai No Miko's blood on a whim, Haruki and the others knew it'd be the Oni. They delight in mindless mayhem, and no one would argue against taking their heads. Come now, lets get them rolling.

quests.name: Zmey Gorynich
quests.description: Where did these Dragons come from? Such a large army couldn't have been hovering above the ocean for so long without needing rest. How did no one notice them until Zakhavatchik sent the Empress his challenge? Capture the Zmey Warriors and see if they'll talk.

items_required.name: Zmey Warrior Ring x5 (Stacks up to 50)

quests.name: Head Kukol'nyy
quests.description: Masterful work! Zakhavatchik's armies on both fronts have been demolished. All that remains is to slay the Dragon himself. Take up your blade one last time, friend… we'll approach the Mikoto Shrine as partners, and rescue the Isles from that pompous lizard.

quests.name: Feed the Greed
quests.description: Forget the Legion threat for now - our friends from Frostvale are tearing each other apart. We'll need to fight the White Stalkers and Blighted Moglins and reclaim the holiday gifts, decorations and food that they stole. Feeding our friends' greed may calm them down enough to stop the fighting.

quests.name: Sleet Samples
quests.description: We need to find a way to reverse the effects of this blight. See if you can get some samples of the black sleet for our clerics to study. You should be able to find good samples on either the White Stalkers or Blighted Moglins.

quests.name: Blighted Deer
quests.description: It looks like this terrible blight is even affecting our wildlife. Unfortunate as it is, we will need to destroy the deer that have been affected. It's a mercy, but it will also help prevent them from spreading the affliction to anyone else.

quests.name: Frosty Hearts
quests.description: The Legion has found a way to control the Ice Golems in the area by inscribing runes on their heartstones. Kill the golems and take their heartstones - without them the Legion will no longer be able to use them as cannon fodder.

quests.name: On the Offensive
quests.description: We must have gotten the Legion’s attention - they're going on the offensive. We should do likewise. Slay as many Blighted Revenants and Skeletal Minions as you can find. If you can hold them off until our cure is ready, we may still have some hope.

quests.name: Inoculation
