quests.description: The cure we've developed reverses the effects of the black sleet, but its abilities are limited. Those afflicted with the blight are beyond our help. Go and inoculate as many Angry Villagers and Angry Moglins as you can find. As for the Blighted… well, we'll have to take care of them a different way.

quests.name: A Different Way
quests.description: We're safe from the black sleet, but our friends still need to be protected from these blighted abominations. We can't cure them, so for the safety of all, they will need to be destroyed.

quests.name: Breaking In
quests.description: We've seen the cave leading to Dage's Mt. Bleakwind lair at the top of the mountain, but I know he's not scaling that peak every time he comes and goes. He must be using a second, lower entrance to get inside. Find it.

quests.name: Break the barrier
quests.description: It looks like a barrier spell has been cast, preventing anyone but Dage from traveling further into the mountain. The ice golems are carrying stones that appear to be enchanted. If you get all of the stones, you should be able to break the spell.

quests.name: The Final Ward
quests.description: Looks like there's another barrier blocking access into the next chamber. The sounds emanating from it suggest that this is where you'll find Frostfang. Perhaps the stones carried by the frost golems will help you gain entrance.

quests.name: Defeat Frostfang (Good)
quests.description: You found Frostfang's lair, and he's still inside! Take him down before he goes on the attack again! And if you find whatever might be giving him his energy, it may be wise to destroy that as well.

quests.name: Guardians of Time
quests.description: Time itself is in danger from an ancient evil which approaches. Eienyuki warns me of this most insistently. Freeze time to ensure you have enough opportunities to gather the following: 1 Glacier Core and 3 Frozen Hearts from Polar Elementals, and 5 Frozen Fangs. If we can freeze the progress of the threat, we may yet be saved.

quests.name: Chronocorruptors on Ice
quests.description: Though I do not approve of what the Chronocorruptors have done, I cannot allow them to fall to this frigid land. They would taint its purity, and I cannot have that. Battle an ancient golem in Frostdeep for 1 Ancient Rune, 3 Ruby Eyes, and 7 Sands of Time. Then leave, quickly!

quests.name: Death of Time
quests.description: Eienyuki will not let me hide this from you, Hero. Should the ancient evil approaching succeed, Lore will fall, it's true. And then he will try to take control of Time itself using the power you TimeKillers possess! To keep you safe, I will need the following: 1 Heart of Time and 7 Frozen Vortex Seeds from the Ancient Horror.

quests.name: You are a Unique Snowflake
quests.description: I know this, because for as long as Eienyuki and I have warded this land, we have never seen a hero as mighty as you. If you bring me 13 diamond snowflakes from the Polar Golems, I will craft a reward worthy of your greatness!

quests.name: Sever the Link
quests.description: We need you to aid the heroes questing to defeat Kezeroth, and you will have to do it now.Leap back in time and slay the monsters linked in the padlocks securing the World-Enders chests.Slay the arctic direwolves, polar elementals and golems. They are linked to the padlocks securing the World-Enders chests. By slaying them, you will ensure your allies can retrieve the keys they are looking for once all is ready.

quests.name: Patch the Fabric of Spacetime
quests.description: We need more time for time for our units to prepare! It is vital that you slow time down. The Ancient Maggots in FrostDeep dungeon are boring holes in the fabric of spacetime, speeding it up considerably. Slay them and to help your friends!

quests.name: Passing Past Chaos
quests.description: Return to the past and knock some senselessness into the polar elementals near the ballista, archer, and mage units. This way, by the time our units arrive, their enemies will already be dazed and confused… perfect targets!

quests.name: Serving Up HP Helper
quests.description: Though the mages are already being assisted, we need someone to gather ingredients for HP potions to aid the warriors confronting Kezeroth! Slay Arctic Direwolf and Polar Golems for Hollyberry Vines and Icebreaker Seeds .Return to me so I may create the draughts they need!

quests.name: Yoshino's Limited Time Event (Daily Quest)
quests.description: Sooo, you're telling me that Yoshino has the power to summon random monsters from lore and we just kill what she says? WHO GAVE THE OK ON THIS?!?

quests.name: Yoshino's Heroic Quest
quests.description: Oh, one last thing! This must be done in one session.. no logging out or going off track! Otherwise the enemies will take their items back… Now off you go, I got some stories to tell Twilly.

quests.name: Vitamoon
quests.description: The legends of the moon differ between Yokai and my ancestral homeland, but they all involve a rabbit. No matter where you go, bunnies and the moon just click. Though my day job is designing clothes, I have some skills in medicine making just like the moon's companion. I have most of the ingredients, but I'm missing fish oil. I heard you can get ahold of some special fish from /natatorium.

quests.name: Fill'er Up
quests.description: In Yokai legend, the rabbit accompanying the moon makes rice cakes with their mortar and pestle instead of medicine. That's exactly what we need for the Lunar New Year Celebrations - snacks! Ai no Miko said she'd handle the rice cakes, and would like for us to make something too. For that, we'll need filling. That's lotus seeds in /wanders and egg yolks from /battlefowl.

quests.name: Mirror Flowers
quests.description: Have you ever heard of the proverb "like flowers in a mirror, and the moon reflected on the lake's surface?" When Ai no Miko approached me and my cousins to release us from secrecy, we talked for a while, and this proverb came up. With that in mind, would you go to /guardiantree to pick blossoms and harvest seeds? I'd like to make another gift for you and the Empress of Yokai.

quests.name: Moon's Reflection
quests.description: Right, I didn't explain what the ‘like flowers in a mirror, and the moon reflected on the lake's surface' proverb meant yet. Both the flowers and the moon are beautiful, but you can never touch them. They're not real, just mirages. If your dreams are like those things…Well, huge mood shift. How about going to /beachparty and collecting water from the elementals? I have another magic trick to show you and Ai no Miko.

quests.name: Shifting Faces
quests.description: I hear that the moon holds special significance to the people of Darkovia too. Hmm, is there time for us to go over there for a peek? I know it's a long way… but I'm so curious. It's eternally night there, but it isn't pitch black. The moon shines on beings that supposedly shun the light. Oh? Going to /Safiria would be safest? Then if I put on a disguise and cover my ears, could we look for souvenirs?

quests.name: Eto... Bleh
quests.description: You've won the Etokoun hunt before. I heard the stories and maybe, I wanted to try petting it myself. It seems that, as one of the main branch descendants of the Rabbit Princess, my inherent aura spurred a great energy in it! As in, I think I made it mad. Super sorry about that! Could you please help calm it down before Ai no Miko notices?

quests.name: Elixir of the Moon
quests.description: Uh oh. I turned around for a moment and the Etokoun got a lot more…wet. Because I touched it, the Etokoun became imbalanced, and now resembles a Water Rabbit in full. Its body became fluid, and the bugs wriggling in the ground it walked on became immortal. A few bugs is fine, but if anything else partakes in its bodily elixir, we will literally never hear the end of it. It's all good, just defeat it and I'll take care of the rest.

quests.name: Porkon's Pride
quests.description: If you're looking for new weapons, I've run into a bit of a problem. General Porkon at the Horc Fort sold me a shipment of substandard ore, and it's not usable for weapons. If you want pots? Fine. But a sword? Nope. He says that no Adventurer has ever beat him - go over there and show him he's wrong! Then bring me back his pride…I'll be out the ore, but that'll go a long way to making me feel better. (Return to Yulgar in the Battleon Inn with Porkon's Pride.)

quests.name: Zorbak's Reward
quests.description: Well met, Adventurer! I need some very special things to forge a weapon that I've been working on for some time. Zorbak has been hoarding the miniature Skulls that I need to forge the blade of the Bone Sword. If you bring me 8 Small Skulls, I'll reward you with the Bone Sword. (Get Small Skulls from Zorbak in Battleon for doing his quests. Bring 8 to Yulgar in the Battleon Inn.)

quests.name: Rats off To ya!
quests.description: Well met adventurer! Looking for some work? The inn basement needs a little cleaning before the Swordhaven health inspector gets here. Bring me 8 rat ears to prove the basement is clear and I will give you a nice tip. Let's keep this on the down low, alright? (Return to Yulgar in the Battleon Inn with the Rat Ears.)

quests.name: Yulgar's Daily Hero Challenge
quests.description: Yulgar needs a LOT to keep this inn up and running: weapons to defend it, food to feed hungry heroes, drinks for all, and wood to keep expanding! (What, you didn't notice it was bigger on the inside?) Bring me: 10 hunks of Horc Boar meat, 15 jugs of Doomwood Tree sap, 5 Sandsea Horc blades, and 3 Treeant boards, and the gold hoard from Trigoras.

quests.name: Yulgar Needs to Hydra-te!
quests.description: There's a TON of thirsty heroes on their way, and we've got to have enough for them ALL to drink! Bring me the following: 13 Styx Hydra and 1 Fire Leech head. I make a MEAN hydra-leech smoothie!

quests.name: Yulgar's Worst Nightmare
quests.description: The horse… the terror… when the night is dark and the inn is silent, sometimes I feel his eyes upon me. Binky… Binky haunts my nightmares! Slay him and return my scythe to me so I know he is dead… once and for all!

quests.name: Advertiser Ally
quests.description: Greetings, Hero! Would you like an opportunity to make some gold? I'm looking for someone who would be willing to advertise Yulgar's Inn across /Battleon, but the monsters around Greenguard have been acting up and hurting my other advertisers and my customers. If you'd be willing to help scare away some of the monsters, I'd be willing to give you a job advertising the Inn.

quests.name: Stalking Prey
quests.description: First things first! We gotta secure the perimeter. We were doing well until the hunters got in our way. I'm ashamed to admit it, but the horde has made a resurgence during our infight. I'd like to recruit your strength to help manage our defenses.

quests.name: Super Creeps
quests.description: Ghouls are common fare in this neck of Darkovia. They lack individual will, and feed on the flesh of the living. Individually they're easy work, but Mr. K tells me they're dangerous in hordes. Let's take care of them before they get to any residents.

quests.name: Sleepless Villagers
quests.description: I don't know how much Mr. K told you, but things aren't looking too hot. Apparently, a band of hunters were previously employed by the village when the monsters first started attacking. I think it's worth asking the villagers about the details. We should also investigate the premises while we're at it. We might just learn something important.

quests.name: Suspicious Minds
quests.description: I see, these hunters are the contracted guards of this village. Makes sense why they're so territorial about it. Nothing we can do about that. There's just a couple of things I'd like to confirm. Collect a few samples of the monsters. I know it's more busy work for you, but I have my reasons.

quests.name: Zappy's Legendary Quest
quests.description: Oh! Zappy is so glad to see you, Hero! My Legendary Pet Orb was stolen by the Endless Maw when the undead attacked. If you defeat him and bring it back to me, I will give you a pet to bring with you on your adventures.

quests.name: Harness the Elemental Fire
quests.description: We'll need to find the Elemental Fire; a sacred flame that any may seek, but only those worthy of being a Crypto Knight will find. You must gaze upon death, and defeat the monster with fourteen eyes if you wish to harness its true power. Once you have the Fire, bring it back to me.

quests.name: Recover the Crafter's Palladium
quests.description: To forge the armor we need what's left of our sacred Crafters Palladium. A precious alloy only commissioned for Crypto Knights by the Grand Inquisitor. Unfortunately due to the turn of the Inquisitor, he will not let go of the remaining pieces without a fight. Defeat the Grand Inquisitor and bring our precious Palladium home. I'm counting on you, hero.

quests.name: Salvage the Portal Key
quests.description: Find Revontheus, salvage what is ours and bring it to me.

quests.name: Find the Code, Become a Knight
quests.description: During my stay at Sleuthhound Inn many years ago, I hid a very important hard drive containing the code in an old bookcase for safekeeping. Go there, find it and return it to me. Do this and I will grant you our full arsenal. Be quick, hero. The longer we wait, the more chance the code will become corrupted.

quests.name: Juicy Yummies
quests.description: Hey! Hey you! You the one Bixx got beating up all the Makai, and stealing back his Moglinberry kegs! Not cool! We Makai deserve some juicy yummies, too! You go back there and steal some back for us! Smash on that BIG keg until it gives up the goods!

quests.name: Make Makai Strong
quests.description: You help Makai? Ok, good! You know all those Void Mages that hang around here trying to prey on the Moglins? We need their Void Magic. Make us strong. You get for us?

quests.name: Purgatorio Charade
quests.description: Life is a masquerade, but it's not until you die that you REALLY get to see the Divine Comedy that is existence. I've got a gift for you - several, in fact - if you prove that you can battle where others fear to tread.

quests.name: Dead Ringer... Master
quests.description: So. You've been to the underworld and back, and you STILL want more? You're a dead ringer for a tenacious terror I know well… ME. I want ONE thing from you. And one thing only: A copy of Dante's Divine Tragedy. You'll have to face death and return unscathed, but if you do… there's a chance I'll give you something near and dear to my heart.

quests.name: Void Spartan
quests.description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone.

quests.name: Catering to Craftsmanship
quests.description: Business is booming, but I'll be cut right back down to size the minute my products run out. Gather up enough enchanted wood for me to restock the shelves. It's worth your while I guarantee, the products this lumber will help create would look great in whatever palace you reside.

quests.name: Some Disassembly Required
quests.description: We enchanted the Brightpool to protect Brightoak a few years ago after the risks of serving in our militia become too great. These guys are great at keeping creepy crawlies at bay but alas have taken a special liking to teething on my furniture. I can't sell something that's been slobbered on!

quests.name: Lend a Helping Handkerchief
quests.description: Restless, are we? Well, since you're already up, wanna make yourself useful?

quests.name: Two Eyes
quests.description: What are you looking at!?! No seriously, I can barely see you. Someone must have stolen my glasses when I dozed off. Fall asleep for 5 minutes and you get your prescription lenses stolen… classic. This man over here insists that a Vulture Man took 'em right off my face. Find my Square-framed Glasses, and I'll toss you some gold.

quests.name: Beards Rule!
quests.description: I saw you admiring my beard. Rules, doesn't it? But the only way to keep it in pristine condition is with an Epic Beard Comb. Unfortunately, I left my EBC in my suitcase which is currently under attack by Vulture Men. If you could bring me back my EBC from those Vultures, I'll show you a beard that is even cooler than Zazul's!

quests.name: Fancied Feather
quests.description: Enjoying the trip so far? You know, I've seen some big birds flying past these windows. I wish I could bring home one of their feathers to show my mother! If you happen to find a Vulture Man feather, I'll totally pay you for it. Promise!

quests.name: Requesting a Request
quests.description: When I was boarding the Zephyrus, I saw a dreamy guy walk past. I wanted to ask him for a Friend Request, but I was too shy at the time! Would be willing to deliver it for me? Alright, alright, *takes a breath* the guy was wearing a blue Gears University suit and had blonde spikey hair. Anyway, yeah, if you could just hand him my Friends Request… tehehehe Oh, and please bring me a Patience Elixir from a Vulture Man… stat!

quests.name: Watch Out!
quests.description: How much longer? I left my watch in my suitcase and MoreHawk over here won't stop gossiping long enough to actually tell me the time. You think you could help me out?

quests.name: Darkness is Energy
quests.description: Void is not only what you see. Hidden paths lie everywhere. Zep find you the one you need. Feeling SO tired, though. Might need a pick-me-up. The darkness is very tasty. What you get from the elementals is best.

quests.name: Reach the Vault
quests.description: Zep has shown you the path to Nulgath's vault of souls. Go down, down, down, until you find it. Zep will meet you there.

quests.name: Open the Vault
quests.description: Yes, OF COURSE vault is locked. Can't have just anyone rummaging round, stealing souls! Must slay Void Makai, summon vault guardian with their shadows. Slay guardian, and you will get the key.

quests.name: Find Another Path
quests.description: Now, you seek the contract, yes? Go back out the way you came. Meet Zep where you found him. He will show you another path.

quests.name: More Energy for Zep
quests.description: Needs more energy from the darkness of the void before Zep can show you the way forward. Find me some. Get it from any Void monsters you can find.

quests.name: Pass Through the Shadows
quests.description: To know the way into the Library, you need both shadow and light. Gather shadows from the Void Makai in the area. We will allow them to coagulate in the darkness. Then, collect the glowing eyes from the Void Elementals. Place them on the ground where Zep directs. Their dark light will illuminate the shadows, and allow them to be *seen*.

quests.name: Find Contract
quests.description: Path here, in the library, is broken. Must find the correct contract. Where is it? Zep has no idea. How to get to the correct shelf? Couldn't tell ya. Careful not to fall - who knows whatmightwould happen to you then?

quests.name: Secret Map
quests.description: I am Zhoom, the Ranger. I was resting overnight here in the Inn, and there was a break in. Some Zardmen broke in and stole the chest containing the only map showing the safe pathways back to the Sandsea Desert! And they ALSO stole the key. I need you to go to the forest and get back that map! I'm sure they've given the key to their boss - so be careful! (Return to Zhoom in the Battleon Inn once you have obtained the Secret Map)

quests.name: A Gift of Plums
quests.description: I remember being in the grove outside of Akiba. I wanted to bring a gift of plums to the Empress. I strapped a basket to my back, and picked the nicest ones from the plum trees.

quests.name: A Taste of Truffles
quests.description: All this had made me so hungry! I had accomplished what I set out to do, so I decided to reward myself with some of the truffles I found nearby.

quests.name: Om Nom Nom
quests.description: And then, shuffling through the grass, I saw it! The biggest truffle I'd ever seen! It ran from me, and I tracked it, following its spores.

quests.name: Follow the Tracks
quests.description: I had followed that monster truffle right into a pit! I knew it was dangerous for me to stay underground, where all manner of evil spirits reside. But I saw some tracks leading away from where I'd fallen in. If I followed them, I might find my way out!

quests.name: Get out of Here!
quests.description: The tracks led me to what looked like a dead end. But at the end of the tunnel was a pile of rocks, and the tracks stopped dead. Could there have been a cave in? I rammed the rocks with all my strength, and broke free.

quests.name: Smackdown!
quests.description: I finally made it to the surface! I was just outside of Akiba City. But I was so tired. I had time to take a short nap, and I laid down under a tree. But the Xingzhi wouldn't stop pestering me. I had to smack them away.

quests.name: The Acorn
quests.description: Then, under the biggest tree, I saw the biggest acorn I'd ever seen. Its smell, earthy and nutty, was so tempting. As soon as I'd eaten it, my mind started to feel cloudy, and I felt so tired I could hardly stand. I down under the tree and fell asleep.

quests.name: Let Me Out!
quests.description: What a jerk! I don't like hurting people, but if that's the only way she'll let me out of here, she's going to find out what these tusks feel like! You've got my back, right?

quests.name: Reagents for Zifwin
quests.description: Friend! I need some help restocking my reagents. Bring me some, and I'll pay you in gold… and maybe even in magic! I'll need 3 batches of Moglinberries, 2 vials of Trollola Nectar, and a handful of Nimblestem.

quests.name: How Rude!
quests.description: Ziri waited and waited at Yulgar's Inn for the Hero to arrive - apparently heroes take their sweet time when meeting with a sneevil. How rude! So, Ziri was left to amuse himself. Had a little too much moglinberry juice, knocked over all the candles in the inn. But Hero was not amused. Hero totally ignored Ziri's attempsts at conversation and stated putting out ALL the fires Ziri had made!

quests.name: Bar Fight!
quests.description: While the Hero was putting out Ziri's fires, Ziri took out his frustration on the other patrons at the Inn. You've never seen a bar fight so big! Everyone was hitting everyone! But, Hero wanted to rain on that parade too. Started knocking everyone out so they couldn't fight anymore.

quests.name: Number Two
quests.description: While Hero was busy breaking up the fight, Ziri was busy breaking up the bathroom! Actually, this one was unintentional - Ziri did not MEAN to clog up the toilet like that. Ziri DID mean to lock the bathroom door and hide the key in a regular's pocket, though. Thought it would be better if this mess went unnoticed for a while.

quests.name: Forget the Mess
quests.description: Ziri started to panic, and wished for a bunch of monsters to appear! What better way to distract the Hero and make everyone forget all about that mess in the bathroom?

quests.name: The Chosen One!
quests.description: That's right, Ziri had transported the Hero to the Fabled Flying Bacon Cat Cloud Palace! First, Hero had to prove worthiness to enter its golden halls! How, you ask? Hero had to guess the secret password!

quests.name: BACON PIZZA!
quests.description: Obviously, the Hero could not be allowed to leave until he had gathered enough bacon and pizza for Ziri's favorite snack - BACON PIZZA!

quests.name: No More Clowns!
quests.description: The Hero was the one spoken of in the Bacon Cat prophecy - which means Hero is the one who will finally fight off the Endless Army of Infinite Clowns! Go, Hero, go! Save the Flying Bacon Cat Cloud Palace from their greasepaint onslaught!

quests.name: Life's a Beach
quests.description: Then, the Hero found out beautiful beach - Litter Beach! Where all of the flying Bacon Cats bury their brown nugget of joy! Some of them were starting to peek out of the "sand", so Hero decided to scroop them all. Not sure why, they don't smell THAT bad. Maybe Hero mistook them for tootsie rolls?

quests.name: Not all Sand is Cat Litter
quests.description: Oh, no! Ziri sees the problem, now! Too much unscooped Bacon Cat poop causes stinky elementals to form! Ziri feeling highly disturbed. Ziri WISHED for Hero to fight those gross elementals and make them GONE!

quests.name: King Strong
quests.description: Ziri WISHED the Hero into his favorite video game: King Strong! Ziri smashed boxes, defeated the evil King Strong and saved the beautiful Princess Mogline! Well, technically Hero did it, but Ziri was in control!

quests.name: Snack Man!
quests.description: Next, Ziri wanted to play a new game! Here, Hero had to navigate a maze of edible dots, eating all 4 POWER UPS!

quests.name: Ghost Busting
quests.description: After Hero ate all the big dots, ghosts got SO EASY to defeat! Hero mopped the FLOOR with them!

quests.name: Super Ziri Brothers
quests.description: Ziri really wished to play a sidescroller after that, so he WISHED the Hero into Super Ziri Brothers! Hero had to beat up all the evil turtles and collect all the Power Flowers! Only then could we face… Horcio!

quests.name: It's-A-Me
quests.description: Finally, Hero was able to face this game's surprising boss - HORCIO! Ber honest, you were expecting a bigger turtle, weren't you?

quests.name: Massive Corn-fusion
quests.description: Ziri got bored with games, dropped Hero back in the Palace. Where Hero had to fight… giant… CORN MONSTERS! Yeah! SO MANY CORN MONSTERS!

quests.name: Organic Victory
quests.description: The Hero kept fighting all the Corn Minions, and… it summoned their master! Can you guess who it is? COME ON, GUESS! NO! You're WRONG! It was… Non-GMO Brutalcorn!!!

quests.name: Make a Wish
quests.description: After defeating Non-GMO Brutalcorn, Hero found what he had been guarding - a wishing well! Hero picked up a gold on to make a wish on. and then jumped into the well with it.

quests.name: Smell This!
quests.description: Hero LEFT the flying Bacon Cat Cloud Palace! That isn't how a member of the legendary BACON CAT FORCE behaves! Ziri wished Hero into a room full of DARK. A worthy adventurer would be able to find their way out by using sense of smell alone. Was Hero worthy?? Ziri watched as Hero battled the invisivle scent trail so he could find out!

quests.name: Trial of being SMALL
quests.description: Ok, so maybe Hero doesn't need to see to win. But, does Hero understand the plight of a small, misunderstood Sneevil like Ziri? Ziri WISHED Hero was tiny like a mouse! Challenged Hero to fight anthropomorphized food, had to make Ziri a snack of buttered mashed potatoes before this trial could end.

quests.name: King of the Unbread
quests.description: Ugh! Hero managed to beat this trial TOO. So Ziri extended it. Made Hero fight… the King of the Unbread!

quests.name: Evil Undead!
quests.description: FINE. Hero may be undead, but Ziri will still get this movie made! Ziri sent hordes of TOUGHT GUYS WITH CHAINSAWS after the Hero! That is to say… Ziri sent actors. Hero took all their chainsaw props away.

quests.name: Pala-dinner
quests.description: Fine! You know what? Ziri didn't like this set ANYWAY. Ziri sent the Hero into a set of… Yulgar's Inn! Yulgar is a dangerous place for an undead hero - especially when there are all these PALADINS!

quests.name: Kitty Boo Boo, Overlord of the Catverse
quests.description: Oh, that's right! It's ON! Ziri's pulling out the big guns now! It's time for the hero to fight… KITTY BOO BOO: OVERLORD OF THE CATVERSE!

items_required.name: Kitty Boo Boo Put Back In The Carrier

quests.name: Dig Deep
quests.description: To craft your sword, Basklar Ore, you will need. The strongest metal on Lore, it is. Deep in /Dwarfhold in the belly of Glow Worms, the ore resides. 8 chunks, I will need.

quests.name: The Fire Within
quests.description: Something hot to smelt down the ore and mold it, we will need. In a /firestorm, far away, tales of living fires, there are. Burn so hot, melt anything, they will! Collect pure Fire Essence you must.

quests.name: Spare Parts
quests.description: All the hard parts, we have gathered. The innards, we may begin work on. Head over to /TheSpan, harvest parts from the Training Globes, you must. Smelt the ore in your absence, I will.

quests.name: Diplomatic Solution
quests.description: Concentrate..look deep within yourself and clear your mind. Ommm…ommm..Gah! Working, this is not! Need a bigger, less cluttered space we do. Just the place, I know. For some aggressive negotiations with Zorba the Bakk, it is time. Enter his chamber, and clear him out. Clear your mind, then you must.

quests.name: The Path of Good
quests.description: A wise choice, you have made. Make the journey to stand against /Greed. Battle Goregold and resist the temptation of greed and stand bravely against its corruption you shall. Its defeat will mean your success and will empower your blade with its power.

quests.name: The Path of Evil
quests.description: A nefarious choice, your journey will be one of contempt and strength. Power will come from crushing those who stand in your way, it will. Only two may rule, go to his /Murdermoon and Defeat Fifth Sepulchure. Rise to unseen heights you will. Crushing him in battle will empower your blade.

quests.name: The Path of Chaos
quests.description: An inauspicious start to your path. A path full of twists, turns, and unpredictable outcomes. The power you seek within a powerful foe it leys. Travel to their plane to uproot /Ledgermayne. Your sword will absorb their stray power and awaken the power within.

quests.name: Search the Pit
quests.description: Take generations to digest whatever it consumes, Zorblatt's species can! Get really messy in there, what goodies you may find we know not. Enter his pit and beat him up you must!

quests.name: Bandages Needed
quests.description: Pity poor Zognax! Soundly defeated by such a strong hero, and now he is far too weak to be any use to anyone. Help him become strong again, and he will help you in return!

quests.name: Shinies!
quests.description: Zognax is hurting a little less now, but feeling sad. If you made Zognax happy, he might trust you. Might open up. Bringing him shiny things might help.

quests.name: Plushies
quests.description: Shinies are nice, but maybe Zognax really needs something to hug. Might be in more of a mood to help if he had something like that.

quests.name: Sleepies
quests.description: Zognax is much happier now, but *yaaaaaawn*-so- so sleepy! Find something to wake him up. Then maybe you talk.

quests.name: What's Next?
quests.description: Zognax's Wounds will heal, but the air and earth of this world is choking him, sickening him. You'll need to get Some kind of concentrated toxin up herre to spread in his cage. But where would you get such a thing? Better check with Gravelyn - she might have some ideas.

quests.name: Stink-tuary
quests.description: Mehehe. Pretty ripe, the last humans to use the mall were. My undead in an unmanageable frenzy are. Around the mall, my favorite incense, "Rotting Noses & Dying Roses," you should place. CLICK ON THE SPARKING ARROWS you must!

quests.name: The Infected
quests.description: Feh. The last time humans the swamp as sanctuary used, one of the heroes crazy went, and the ghouls bit, not around the other way. Backwards bonehead. Starting to turn… normal, the Undead are. Talking about golf and accounting, they are! Get rid of them or infect the rest they will!

quests.name: Chopping Spree
quests.description: In the middle of a highly complex experiment right now I am. Understand it you wouldn't, hmmm? But running out of parts I am. Time to go chopping at the Maul for parts I have not. In my place I need you to go. Some necrotized resources bring back. Fresh they must be!

quests.name: GraveStop The Creature
quests.description: What? No! Creation, stop you must! Command you I do! Your master I am! Stooooop! Hero! That demented pile of parts, subdue you must! Into the GraveStop Game Shop, it was headed…

quests.name: Like T-shirts to a Flame
quests.description: Mehehe! I WANT MY GOLD! A T-shirt manufacturing plant put my face on a shirt… and I didn't get a cut! Any CEO dumb enough to do that gets fired! Gather 13 Matchsticks and 13 Cans of Oil from the Living Fires and Sulfur Imps in Firestorm. IF you succeed, I'll give YOU a share of the gold. Heh.

quests.name: I Bless the Rains Down in Lore
quests.description: Some numbskull just ran by screaming that Alteon's Knights are on the way. Something about a fire… Meh. YOU had better make sure we don't get caught. Go get 13 Water Bottles and 13 Spray Bottles from Waterstorm. I'll trick that bonehead into putting out the flames while we book it. Mehehe.

quests.name: The Wind Beneath My Moglin
quests.description: You think someone's going to blame me? Pffft. If anyone, they'll think it was you. Heroes are getting into trouble. Mehehe. But i don't want any trace pointing back at ME, so bring me back 24 Jars of Wind from the Wind Elementals and living Airs in Airstorm. We'll sweep away the evidence.

quests.name: 17th Anniversary Gifts
quests.description: You heroes love to eat cake, and I love a good /party crash. Let's make some magic, mehehehe!

items.name: Chaotic Birthday Hero Character Page Badge
Twilly's Birthday Hero Character Page Badge
